title: LVRE: A Local Visual Reasoning and Editing Agent for Optical Chemical Structure Recognition
comment: 14 pages, 4 figures, 3 tables. Accepted at IFTC 2026
summary: Optical chemical structure recognition (OCSR) demands strict all-or-nothing graph fidelity, where a single misidentified bond order or formal charge makes the predicted graph differ from the reference structure. While vision-language models (VLMs) can reinspect ambiguous visual regions, unconstrained full-graph regeneration often introduces regressive errors into previously correct substructures. We present LVRE, a training-free visual agent that refines molecular graphs via targeted visual inspection and reversible transactional editing. Rather than regenerating the entire graph sequence, LVRE examines a high-resolution crop alongside the global diagram and local graph neighborhood, proposing modifications to named graph records that a deterministic controller checks. A controller executes each proposed modification as an isolated transaction, and a visual review module arbitrates which edits to commit or roll back. Across four foundation VLMs, LVRE improves graph accuracy by 8.0-8.5 percentage points over single-pass recognition and by 3.0-3.3 points over fixed local review. In a paired evaluation of 1,000 diagrams using Gemini 3.8 Flash, LVRE achieves 100 successful repairs while introducing only 15 regressive errors, in contrast to global reflection which yields 65 repairs against 30 introduced errors. On this paired set, LVRE introduces half as many errors on initially correct predictions as global reflection.

AI.tldr: LVRE：一种免训练的可视化智能体，通过定向高清局部重检与可逆事务化编辑来细化分子图，避免全局重生成带来的回归性错误，在四个基座VLM上使图精确匹配率提升8.0–8.5个百分点。
AI.motivation: OCSR要求"全有或全无"的图级保真：单根化学键级次或形式电荷的误判即导致预测图与参考结构不一致。VLM虽可复检模糊视觉区域，但无约束的全图重生成常把原本正确的子结构改坏（回归性错误）。
AI.method: 提出免训练的视觉智能体LVRE，不做整图序列重生成，而是结合高分辨率局部裁剪、全局结构图与局部图邻域进行定向检视，对具名图记录提出修改；由确定性控制器将每次修改作为独立事务执行，并由视觉复核模块仲裁提交或回滚。
AI.result: 在四个基座VLM上，图准确率较单次识别提升8.0–8.5个百分点，较固定局部复核提升3.0–3.3个百分点。Gemini 3.8 Flash的1,000张图配对评测中，LVRE实现100次成功修复、仅引入15次回归错误；全局反思为65次修复、30次引入错误。在初始正确的预测上，LVRE引入的错误仅为全局反思的一半。
AI.conclusion: 将视觉复检限定于局部并用事务化可逆编辑约束改写范围，可在不训练的前提下显著提升OCSR图保真度，并大幅抑制对已正确子结构的破坏。

title: T2T Technical Report: Synthesizing GUI Agent Trajectories at Scale from Video Tutorials
summary: Training generalist GUI agents requires large volumes of interaction trajectories comprising screenshot sequences paired with grounded UI actions, yet collecting such data through human demonstration is expensive and difficult to scale. Although public software tutorial videos contain rich operational demonstrations, their continuous pixel streams lack discrete action boundaries, semantic intents, and precise spatial coordinates, making them difficult to use directly for model training. To address this, we present T2T (Tutorial-to-Trajectory), a fully automated pipeline for synthesizing GUI agent trajectories at scale. T2T spans desktop, web, and mobile platforms to convert unannotated video tutorials into structured, executable interaction trajectories. To guarantee trajectory quality, T2T combines active segment filtering, keyframe identification via localized UI change, shortcut-free observation frame selection, presence-aware grounding, and two-stage action-space normalization. These refined trajectories are then converted into multi-task training views spanning navigation, planning, forward dynamics, and grounding. We fine-tune Qwen3-VL-8B on a subset of the more than one million human-annotation-free training samples generated by this pipeline. Evaluations show that the model achieves consistent gains across multiple benchmarks covering desktop, web, and mobile environments, including OSWorld-G, ScreenSpot-Pro, AndroidControl, and AgentNetBench, indicating improved core capabilities in grounding, step-level instruction execution, and trajectory-level decision-making. Notably, all gains are achieved without any in-distribution training data from target domains. Learning exclusively from trajectories extracted from public videos via the T2T pipeline, the model exhibits cross-application and cross-task generalization capabilities.

AI.tldr: 本文提出T2T（Tutorial-to-Trajectory），一个全自动流水线，可将无标注的公开软件教程视频转化为结构化、可执行的GUI智能体交互轨迹，跨桌面、网页与移动平台，并生成超过100万条无人工标注训练样本；基于其微调Qwen3-VL-8B，在OSWorld-G、ScreenSpot-Pro、AndroidControl、AgentNetBench等基准上取得一致提升。
AI.motivation: 训练通用GUI智能体需要大量“截图序列+有据可依的UI动作”轨迹数据，但人工演示采集成本高、难以规模化。公开软件教程视频富含真实操作演示，然而其连续像素流缺乏离散动作边界、语义意图与精确空间坐标，无法直接用于模型训练。
AI.method: 构建全自动T2T流水线：覆盖桌面/网页/移动三平台，将未标注视频教程转为结构化可执行轨迹。质量保障环节包括（1）主动片段过滤（active segment filtering）、（2）基于局部UI变化的关键帧识别、（3）去除快捷键依赖的观测帧选择（shortcut-free observation frame selection）、（4）存在感知定位（presence-aware grounding）、（5）两阶段动作空间归一化。随后将轨迹转换为导航、规划、前向动力学、定位四类多任务训练视图，并用其微调Qwen3-VL-8B。
AI.result: 生成超过100万条无需人工标注的训练样本；在桌面、网页、移动多环境基准（OSWorld-G、ScreenSpot-Pro、AndroidControl、AgentNetBench）上均取得一致增益，表明在grounding、步骤级指令执行与轨迹级决策等核心能力上均有提升。且所有增益均未使用目标域的分布内训练数据。
AI.conclusion: 仅利用T2T从公开视频中提取的轨迹进行学习，模型即展现出跨应用、跨任务的泛化能力，验证了“视频教程→可执行轨迹”这一自动化数据合成范式的有效性，为GUI智能体训练提供可规模化、低成本的替代数据来源。

title: Technical Challenges for Ultra Fine Pitch Hybrid Bonding
comment: Symposium manuscript version of the paper published in the IMAPSource Proceedings 2026. The final published version is available through IMAPS. 10 pages, 14 figures
summary: Hybrid bonding is rapidly emerging as a foundational technology for next-generation advanced packaging, enabling ultra-high-density interconnects required for heterogeneous integration of chiplets, logic, memory, and specialized accelerators. As the industry pushes toward ultra-fine pitch interconnects approaching single- digit microns and below, significant technical challenges must be addressed across the process flow. These challenges include achieving extremely tight wafer and die alignment tolerances, maintaining surface planarity and cleanliness at the nanometer scale, controlling copper dishing and dielectric erosion during CMP, and ensuring defect-free oxide and copper-copper bonding interfaces. In addition, scaling hybrid bonding to ultra-fine pitch requires improvements in metrology, defect inspection, thermal management, and yield control to support high-volume manufacturing. Integration with complementary technologies such as silicon interposers, wafer-to-wafer and die-to-wafer bonding architectures, and heterogeneous material stacks further increases process complexity. This presentation reviews the key technical barriers to ultra-fine pitch hybrid bonding and discusses emerging process solutions and equipment innovations required to enable reliable, high-density interconnects for future high-performance computing, AI, and advanced system-in- package applications.

AI.tldr: 该文是一篇关于超细间距混合键合（hybrid bonding）技术障碍与解决方案的综述性报告摘要。
AI.motivation: 面向小芯片（chiplet）、逻辑、存储与专用加速器的异质集成需求，先进封装需实现接近个位数微米及以下间距的超高密度互连，而现有工艺在此尺度下面临多重技术瓶颈，故需系统梳理关键障碍并探索新工艺与设备方案。
AI.method: 以工业流程视角系统性综述超细间距混合键合的核心技术挑战，涵盖晶圆/芯片对准公差、纳米级表面平整度与洁净度、CMP中铜碟形凹陷与介质侵蚀控制、氧化物与铜-铜键合界面无缺陷化；并讨论量测、缺陷检测、热管理与良率控制的提升，以及与硅中介层、W2W/D2W键合架构和异质材料堆叠的集成。
AI.result: 摘要未给出定量实验数据，主要归纳了超细间距混合键合在工艺、量测、检测、热管理与良率方面的关键障碍，并指出需要新兴工艺方案与设备创新加以应对。
AI.conclusion: 超细间距混合键合是高性能计算、AI与先进系统级封装（SiP）实现可靠高密度互连的关键使能技术，其规模化量产依赖工艺、量测、检测与设备创新的协同突破。

title: Whole-Slice Misses Escape Round-Trip Filtering and Volumetric Dice in a Source-Free Flow-Matching Segmenter
summary: SymmAdapt, a source-free flow-matching segmentation pipeline, relies on two quality gates: a round-trip filter on pseudo-labels and volumetric Dice in evaluation. We audit both on 120 AMOS CT patients unseen in training and adaptation. The model often misses the spleen on whole slices, severely so in 30.0% of patients. The round-trip filter passes 83.31% of these lost slices, because its round trip reproduces the miss and the filter scores only organs present in the pseudo-label. Volumetric Dice depends on how much volume is missed, not where, and self-training leaves 96.5% of lost slices lost (96.6% on a second noise stream). A model-free repair, Chain-and-Fill, met all pre-registered endpoints on 119 further patients and could not be distinguished from SAM 2 propagation in severe-group gain, with 1/357 rather than 63/357 harmed patient-seed pairs. Reporting lost slices next to volumetric Dice makes the error visible at no cost.

AI.tldr: 该文审计源域无关流匹配分割流程SymmAdapt的两个质量门（伪标签往返过滤与体积Dice），发现二者对"整层漏检"系统性失明：往返过滤放过83.31%的漏检切片，体积Dice不反映漏检位置；并提出无模型修复方法Chain-and-Fill。
AI.motivation: SymmAdapt依赖往返过滤筛伪标签、体积Dice做评估，但这类门控可能对"整层器官完全缺失"这类结构性错误不敏感，需要在训练与自适应均未见过的数据上验证其可靠性。
AI.method: 在120例未见AMOS CT患者上审计两个质量门：统计脾脏整层漏检发生率、往返过滤对漏检切片的通过率、自训练对漏检切片的修复率（含第二条噪声流对照）；并在另119例患者上以预注册终点评估无模型修复方法Chain-and-Fill，与SAM 2传播对比严重组增益及受损害的patient-seed对。
AI.result: 30.0%患者存在严重脾脏整层漏检；往返过滤以83.31%比例放行这些漏检切片，因其往返重建复现了漏检且仅对伪标签中存在的器官计分；体积Dice只依赖漏检体积量而非位置；自训练后96.5%的漏检切片仍漏检（第二噪声流为96.6%）。Chain-and-Fill在119例上满足全部预注册终点，严重组增益与SAM 2传播无显著差异，受损patient-seed对为1/357（对比63/357）。
AI.conclusion: 往返过滤与体积Dice均对整层漏检失效，且自训练难以自我纠正；在报告体积Dice时同时报告漏检切片数可零成本暴露该错误；Chain-and-Fill是安全（损害率低）且有效的无模型修复方案。

title: TopSDF: Topological Signed Distance Field for High-Quality Triangle Mesh Extraction from 3D Gaussian Splatting
summary: Recent advances in 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) have demonstrated its effectiveness for photorealistic novel view synthesis. However, extracting clean, watertight, explicit surface meshes from 3DGS remains a critical challenge. Previous methods approximate geometry via discrete Marching Tetrahedra, where each grid vertex is assigned a single scalar signed distance value. At complex geometric boundaries and thin structures, this suboptimal parameterization forces severe compromises across shared vertices, causing gradient collisions and geometric frustration. Furthermore, existing optimization objectives neglect element shape conditioning, producing degenerate triangles. We introduce TopSDF, a framework that models the signed distance state as a multivariate Gaussian random field. By learning latent topological covariances across tetrahedral vertices, our formulation expands local degrees of freedom for SDF estimates, allowing the candidate mesh vertices to be placed flexibly along the bipolar edges in the tetrahedra as driven by such topological correlation. Concurrently, we directly integrate variational meshing energies into the joint optimization, coupled with an energy-driven Gaussian densification strategy to improve triangle mesh quality. Our experiments across Mip-NeRF 360, Tanks & Temples, and ScanNet++ show that TopSDF achieves state-of-the-art mesh-based novel view rendering (+0.86 dB PSNR on Mip-NeRF 360) and triangle-mesh quality (from 0.37 to 0.49 aspect ratio).

AI.tldr: TopSDF将四面体顶点的SDF建模为多元高斯随机场，通过学习潜在拓扑协方差扩展局部自由度，使网格顶点可沿双极边灵活放置，并将变分网格能量融入联合优化，实现高质量水密网格提取。
AI.motivation: 从3DGS中提取干净、水密、显式表面网格仍是关键难题。现有方法基于离散Marching Tetrahedra，每个网格顶点仅赋单一标量SDF值，在复杂几何边界与薄结构处，共享顶点被迫妥协，导致梯度冲突与几何失配；同时现有优化目标忽略单元形状约束，产生退化三角形。
AI.method: 提出TopSDF框架：(1) 将SDF状态建模为多元高斯随机场，学习四面体顶点间的潜在拓扑协方差，扩展SDF估计的局部自由度，使候选网格顶点在拓扑相关性驱动下沿四面体内的双极边灵活放置；(2) 将变分网格能量直接集成到联合优化中，并配合能量驱动的高斯致密化策略以提升三角网格质量。
AI.result: 在Mip-NeRF 360、Tanks & Temples和ScanNet++上，TopSDF取得基于网格的新视角渲染SOTA（Mip-NeRF 360上+0.86 dB PSNR），三角网格质量（宽高比）由0.37提升至0.49。
AI.conclusion: 通过将SDF参数化为具有拓扑协方差的高斯随机场并结合变分网格能量优化，TopSDF有效缓解了离散四面体参数化下的顶点妥协与退化三角形问题，同时提升渲染保真度与网格几何质量。

title: ARC-VLN: Adaptive Recursive Computing-based Visual-Language Navigation
summary: Efficient aerial visual-language navigation (VLN) requires reducing model storage and inference costs while maintaining instruction-conditioned action prediction. We present ARC-VLN, a token-type-aware recursive computation framework built on a language backbone with shared parameters. ARC-VLN retains full-depth computation for text and action tokens while adaptively selecting exit depths for visual tokens. Representations of early-exiting visual tokens are retained, and active-token compaction shortens the sequences processed by subsequent recursive blocks. To mitigate routing collapse to a single exit depth, we design a dedicated learning strategy that encourages the model to distribute visual tokens across multiple exit depths.On OpenFly's Test-Seen and Test-Unseen subsets, ARC-VLN achieves the lowest navigation error and the highest success rate and success weighted by path length among all compared methods. Meanwhile, it reduces the average number of decision steps per trajectory, total floating-point operations, mean model inference time per trajectory, and average GPU memory usage during inference, indicating its great potential as a VLN backbone for lightweight applications.

AI.tldr: 提出了ARC-VLN：基于共享参数语言骨干的token类型感知递归计算框架，对视觉token自适应选择退出深度，实现轻量高效的空中视觉语言导航。
AI.motivation: 空中视觉语言导航（VLN）需在保持指令条件动作预测能力的同时，降低模型存储与推理开销。
AI.method: 使用共享参数的语言骨干；对文本与动作token保留全深度计算，对视觉token自适应选择退出深度（early-exit）；保留早退视觉token的表示，并通过active-token compaction压缩后续递归块处理的序列长度；针对路由坍塌至单一退出深度的问题，设计专门的学习策略，促使视觉token在多个退出深度上分布。
AI.result: 在OpenFly的Test-Seen与Test-Unseen子集上，相比所有对比方法取得最低导航误差、最高成功率与最高SPL；同时降低每条轨迹平均决策步数、总FLOPs、每条轨迹平均推理时间及推理期间平均GPU显存占用。
AI.conclusion: ARC-VLN在提升导航性能的同时显著降低计算与存储成本，有望成为轻量级应用的VLN骨干网络。

title: Beyond Raw Similarity: Prior-Aware Fusion for Out-of-Distribution Detection
summary: Out-of-distribution (OOD) detection in vision-language models presents unique challenges due to the reliance on cross-modal similarity. Even when embeddings are well separated for in-distribution (ID) data, similarity scores can remain overconfident for OOD inputs. A common remedy is to adapt the model on ID data, but adaptation discards the pretrained geometry that made the similarity meaningful. We propose multi-modal logit fusion (MM-Log), which keeps both by pairing a gradient-free zero-shot prior with a task-adapted branch in each modality and fuses their four cross-modal similarity channels into a single OOD score. Because the zero-shot priors are never adapted, the cross-channels act as a consistency check between the pretrained and adapted geometries: an OOD input that fools the adapted branch through a shortcut must additionally agree with frozen CLIP to retain a high score. We formalize this as a margin bound showing that the fused score is provably penalized by disagreement between the zero-shot and adapted branches, a signal to which adapted-only scores are structurally blind. MM-Log requires no auxiliary OOD data, negative prompts, or test-time adaptation, and trains on few-shot ID data alone. Across Far-OOD, Near-OOD, and Hard-OOD benchmarks, MM-Log consistently outperforms strong CLIP-based baselines.

AI.tldr: 提出多模态logit融合(MM-Log)，将冻结的零样本先验与任务自适应分支在每种模态上配对，并把四路跨模态相似度通道融合为单一OOD分数，在无需OOD数据、负提示或测试时自适应的条件下于Far/Near/Hard-OOD基准上稳定优于CLIP类基线。
AI.motivation: 视觉语言模型的OOD检测依赖跨模态相似度，即使ID嵌入分离良好，OOD输入的相似度分数仍可能过度自信。常见做法是在ID数据上自适应模型，但这会丢弃使相似度有意义的预训练几何结构；而已自适应分数对"预训练与自适应几何不一致"这一信号结构性失明。
AI.method: MM-Log：在图像与文本两种模态中，各将无梯度的零样本先验与任务自适应分支配对，融合四条跨模态相似度通道形成单一OOD分数。零样本先验始终保持不更新，从而跨通道充当预训练几何与自适应几何之间的一致性校验——仅靠捷径骗过自适应分支的OOD输入还须与冻结CLIP一致才能维持高分。作者以margin bound形式化该机制，证明融合分数可证地被两支分支间的不一致所惩罚。方法仅用少样本ID数据训练，无需辅助OOD数据、负提示或测试时自适应。
AI.result: 在Far-OOD、Near-OOD与Hard-OOD基准上，MM-Log一致优于强CLIP基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 以冻结零样本先验作为一致性锚点、与自适应分支做logit级融合，可在保留预训练判别几何的同时获得任务适配收益，是提升视觉语言模型OOD检测的简洁有效方案。

title: ThinkWise: Learning When to Think in Large Multimodal Reasoning Models via Visual and Difficulty Perception
summary: Large Multimodal Reasoning Models (LMRMs) extend large language models to heterogeneous modalities, demonstrating strong potential across a wide range of open-ended tasks. Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) has been widely adopted to improve reasoning performance in LMRMs; however, existing approaches overlook the critical role of visual perception uncertainty in guiding reasoning processes. We term this limitation Reasoning Allocation Misalignment, where the misalignment between visual perception uncertainty and reasoning depth leads to over-allocation of deep reasoning under uncertain visual grounding, resulting in unnecessarily long reasoning trajectories and degraded performance. To address this issue, we propose ThinkWise, a perception-aware RLVR framework that jointly models task difficulty and visual perception state to regulate reasoning depth. Specifically, we introduce an instance-adaptive visual perception modeling mechanism that enables context-aware calibration of perception uncertainty, leading to more accurate perception estimation. We further design a structured reward formulation that jointly considers perception, correctness, and task difficulty. In particular, an answer reward provides supervision for correctness, a perception- and difficulty-conditioned length reward adaptively regulates reasoning depth, and a perception reward encourages trajectories with stronger visual grounding. Extensive experiments on multiple multimodal reasoning benchmarks demonstrate that ThinkWise consistently improves the trade-off between accuracy and reasoning efficiency across both 3B and 7B models. These results highlight the importance of perception-aware reasoning and establish a principled framework for advancing LMRMs.

AI.tldr: 提出感知感知的RLVR框架ThinkWise，通过联合建模任务难度与视觉感知不确定性来调节推理深度，缓解视觉定位不确定时过度深度推理的问题，在3B/7B模型上同时提升准确率与推理效率。
AI.motivation: 现有LMRM的RLVR方法忽略视觉感知不确定性对推理过程的引导作用，导致"推理分配错位"（Reasoning Allocation Misalignment）：视觉定位不确定时仍过度分配深度推理，产生冗余长推理轨迹并损害性能。
AI.method: 1) 实例自适应视觉感知建模机制，实现上下文感知的感知不确定性校准，提升感知估计精度；2) 结构化奖励设计，联合考虑感知、正确性与任务难度：答案奖励监督正确性，感知与难度条件的长度奖励自适应调节推理深度，感知奖励鼓励更强视觉定位的轨迹。
AI.result: 在多个多模态推理基准上，ThinkWise在3B与7B模型上均持续改善准确率—推理效率的权衡。
AI.conclusion: 结果凸显感知感知推理的重要性，为LMRM提供了有原则性的框架。

title: SynPanZ: A Synthetic Dataset to Improve Multi-Animal Pose Estimation in Chimpanzees (Pan troglodytes)
summary: Pose estimation underpins a wide range of automated monitoring workflows in animal behaviour research. Unfortunately, endangered great apes such as chimpanzees suffer a chronic shortage of the type of hand-annotated training data that has made robust pose estimation in humans and other model organisms possible. This paper introduces SynPanZ, a synthetically generated dataset for pose estimation in great apes. Our pipeline renders multi-individual scenes from rigged, behaviourally animated chimpanzee models with randomised poses, lighting conditions, environmental contexts, and camera motion, producing animated RGB videos with per-instance 2D keypoint locations without manual labelling. To test whether synthetic augmentation improves cross-dataset generalisation, four DeepLabCut models are trained under matched settings on data sourced from DeepWild with varying real-to-synthetic augmentation ratios. Models are evaluated on ChimpACT, a visually disjoint zoo dataset. We find that augmenting the DeepWild training data with approximately three times as many synthetic frames nearly doubles instance coverage (12.34% to 22.54%) while maintaining keypoint localisation accuracy on detected individuals (PCK@0.20: 49.71% to 52.25%). Synthetic-only training fails, showing that rendered data complements rather than replaces real annotated data. This work represents a step towards reliable pose estimation for great apes.

AI.tldr: 本文提出合成数据集SynPanZ，通过程序化渲染带骨骼绑定的黑猩猩模型生成多实例视频及逐实例2D关键点标注，并用其增强DeepWild真实数据训练DeepLabCut模型。在视觉域差异较大的ChimpACT动物园数据集上，约3倍合成帧的增强使实例覆盖率从12.34%提升至22.54%，已检测个体的关键点定位精度（PCK@0.20）从49.71%提升至52.25%；纯合成训练失败，说明合成数据是对真实标注数据的补充而非替代。
AI.motivation: 濒危类人猿（如黑猩猩）在动物行为学自动监测中缺乏手标注训练数据，而人类与模式生物已有较成熟的姿态估计数据集；人工标注成本高、规模受限，因此需要探索合成数据以提升跨数据集泛化能力。
AI.method: 构建SynPanZ合成数据集：从带骨骼绑定、行为动画的黑猩猩模型渲染多个体场景，随机化姿态、光照、环境背景与相机运动，自动生成带逐实例2D关键点的RGB视频，无需人工标注。实验上采用匹配设置训练4个DeepLabCut模型，数据源为DeepWild并按不同真实:合成增强比例混合，在视觉上不相交的ChimpACT动物园数据集上评测。
AI.result: 以约3倍合成帧增强DeepWild训练数据后，实例覆盖率从12.34%升至22.54%（接近翻倍），已检测个体的关键点定位精度PCK@0.20从49.71%升至52.25%；纯合成数据训练的模型失效。
AI.conclusion: 合成数据可作为真实标注的有效补充以改善跨域泛化，但不能替代真实数据；SynPanZ为类人猿可靠姿态估计迈出了一步。

title: LogicEye: Agent Driven Multimodal Dataset for Interpretable Ophthalmic Diagnosis
summary: Clinical adoption of ophthalmic Artificial Intelligence remains limited by low interpretability and a lack of finely annotated multimodal data. Most existing datasets provide only coarse disease labels without the granular pathological findings required for differential diagnosis. We present LogicEye$^{Agent}$, a dual-pool inference and verification agent that emulates clinical reasoning by jointly verifying positive inclusion signs and negative exclusion criteria. Using LogicEye$^{Agent}$, we curate LogicEye$^{Data}$, a large-scale multimodal dataset of 804,461 fundus and OCT images paired with structured pathological reports spanning 38 diseases and 29 subtypes, with quality assured through joint verification by multimodal large language models and clinical experts. Building on this dataset, we further develop LogicEye$^{Bench}$, which incorporates a category-constrained loss for hierarchical disease recognition and report generation. Grounding coarse labels into verified visual findings effectively curtails diagnostic hallucinations and establishes a solid foundation for interpretable vision-language modeling in ophthalmology. The code is available at:https://github.com/Eden35/LogicEye-Agent-Driven-Multimodal-Dataset-for-Interpretable-Ophthalmic-Diagnosis.

AI.tldr: 提出双池推理与验证智能体LogicEye^Agent，构建大规模可解释眼科多模态数据集LogicEye^Data及基准LogicEye^Bench。
AI.motivation: 眼科AI临床应用受限于可解释性低与缺乏细粒度标注多模态数据，现有数据集仅提供粗粒度疾病标签，缺少鉴别诊断所需的病理级发现。
AI.method: 设计LogicEye^Agent双池推理验证智能体，同时验证阳性纳入征象与阴性排除标准以模拟临床推理；据此策展LogicEye^Data数据集（804,461张眼底与OCT图像，配结构化病理报告，覆盖38种疾病、29个亚型），由多模态大模型与临床专家联合验证质控；并构建LogicEye^Bench，引入类别约束损失用于层级疾病识别与报告生成。
AI.result: 通过智能体与专家联合验证获得高质量大规模多模态数据集；将粗粒度标签落地为经核验的视觉发现，有效抑制诊断幻觉。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为眼科可解释视觉-语言建模奠定数据与评测基础，代码已开源。

title: Effects of Conventional, Adaptive, and AI-Powered Upscaling on the Legibility of License Plates
summary: Small details in digital images -- a face, a street sign, a license plate -- are routinely upscaled in hopes of making them interpretable. Upscaling options now range from conventional interpolation, whose operations are spatially invariant and fully explainable, to AI-powered methods that synthesize detail potentially absent from the source. Here, we ask which of these techniques most reliably helps human readers. In two online experiments, we measured legibility of 255 US license plates ranging in resolution from 128 to 8 pixels tall, as well as their legibility after upscaling by eight different methods. Legibility of the un-upscaled plates collapsed from ceiling to floor across a narrow band of plate heights (32 to 10 pixels). Conventional upscaling techniques (bilinear, bicubic, and Lanczos interpolation) gave modest gains of about 5-9 percentage points within this range. Nearest-neighbor interpolation, however, was harmful, rendering unreadable many plates that were readable without any upscaling. Advanced methods diverged: SwinIR, an open-source AI enhancer, raised performance by up to 38 points relative to no upscaling, while an adaptive denoiser-based image prior and commercial AI upscaler tended to impair legibility. We found no strong evidence of consistent character hallucinations across methods. Decomposing the task, conventional interpolators mainly helped readers count characters, whereas SwinIR alone made the characters themselves more identifiable.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过两项在线实验，以255块分辨率128至8像素高的美国车牌为材料，系统比较8种图像放大方法对人类可读性的实际影响：常规插值小幅提升（约5-9个百分点），最近邻有害；AI方法分化明显，SwinIR最高提升38个百分点，而自适应去噪先验与商业AI放大器反而损害可读性。
AI.motivation: 数字图像中的细节（人脸、路牌、车牌）常被放大以求可读，但放大方法从完全可解释的空间不变插值到会"合成"源图像中可能不存在细节的AI方法，其选择缺乏以人类阅读者实际表现作为标准的证据。作者意在回答：哪种放大技术最可靠地帮助人类读者，并检验"AI合成细节"是否带来字符幻觉风险。
AI.method: 开展两项在线实验，测量255块美国车牌（图像高度128至8像素）的易读性，包括未放大的基线以及经8种不同方法放大后的易读性；将阅读任务分解为字符计数与字符识别两个成分，并检验各方法间是否存在一致的字符幻觉。
AI.result: 未放大车牌的可读性在32至10像素的狭窄区间内从天花板骤降至地板；双线性、双三次与Lanczos插值在该区间仅提升约5-9个百分点；最近邻插值有害，使许多原可读车牌变得不可读。高级方法表现分化：开源AI增强器SwinIR相对无放大最高提升38个百分点，而基于自适应去噪图像先验的方法与商业AI放大器倾向于损害可读性。未发现各方法间存在一致性字符幻觉的强证据。机制上，常规插值主要帮助读者数清字符数，仅SwinIR使字符本身更易辨认。
AI.conclusion: 放大方法对人类可读性的收益并非随"先进性"单调提升：常规插值仅提供有限增益，最近邻应避免使用，AI方法效果差异巨大，仅SwinIR带来实质性提升并真正改善字符辨识；先进性不等于实用性，实际可读性任务应作为评价放大方法的核心指标。

title: RAVEN-Bench: A Paired EO-IR Video QA Benchmark for Aerial Multimodal Understanding
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026 (Datasets and Benchmarks Track)
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have advanced rapidly in image and video understanding, yet their ability to reason over paired aerial electro-optical and infrared (EO-IR) videos remains poorly understood. Such video poses a harder test than standard RGB video QA: targets are often small, evidence may appear only briefly, viewpoints change with the platform, and useful cues may appear in only one stream. We introduce RAVEN-Bench (Reasoning over Aerial Videos with EO-IR aligNment), a paired EO-IR video QA benchmark for low-altitude aerial multimodal understanding. RAVEN-Bench contains 100 temporally aligned EO-IR video pairs and 1,200 human-authored four-way multiple-choice questions, each independently audited for answer keys, modality requirements, evidence intervals, and group validity. It supports EO-only, IR-only, and paired EO+IR evaluation, and uses hierarchical capability levels and structured question groups to diagnose paired-input gain beyond the stronger unimodal condition, unimodal reliance, target consistency, and evidence-chain coherence. We evaluate frontier, open-weight, and remote-sensing MLLMs, showing that aggregate accuracy can overstate evidence-supported EO-IR reasoning. RAVEN-Bench provides controlled modality conditions and group-level diagnostics for auditing whether progress on RGB video benchmarks transfers to aerial cross-spectral understanding. Code and data are available at https://github.com/yuhu990424/RAVEN-Bench and https://huggingface.co/datasets/TerraSenseAnalytics/RAVEN-Bench.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 RAVEN-Bench，一个面向低空航拍光电‑红外（EO‑IR）配对视频的多模态推理问答基准，包含100对时间对齐的EO‑IR视频与1200道人工编写四选一题目，支持单模态与配对评估，并提供分组级诊断。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态大模型在图像与RGB视频理解上进展迅速，但对航拍EO‑IR配对视频的推理能力尚不清楚；此类视频比标准RGB视频QA更难：目标小、证据短暂、视角随平台变化、关键线索可能仅出现在单一模态中。
AI.method: 构建RAVEN-Bench：100对时间对齐的EO‑IR视频、1200道人工编写四选一问题，每题独立审核答案键、模态需求、证据区间与分组有效性；支持EO-only、IR-only、EO+IR三种条件，采用分层能力等级与结构化问题组，诊断配对输入增益（相对更强单模态）、单模态依赖、目标一致性与证据链连贯性。
AI.result: 评测前沿、开源权重与遥感专用MLLM，发现总体准确率会高估有证据支撑的EO‑IR推理能力。
AI.conclusion: RAVEN-Bench 提供受控模态条件与分组级诊断，用于审计RGB视频基准上的进展能否迁移到航拍跨光谱理解；代码与数据已开源。

title: Quantum-inspired orthogonal adapters for certifiably robust medical image classification
summary: Medical image classifiers require not only high accuracy but also reliable predictions under small input perturbations. Certified robustness provides mathematical guarantees of prediction stability, but preserving these guarantees when adapting pretrained models to new tasks remains challenging. We propose a fine-tuning approach based on quantum-inspired orthogonal butterfly layers that preserves the Lipschitz bounds of pretrained certified networks. Inspired by quantum circuits of reconfigurable beam splitters, these layers preserve orthogonality by construction using only $\mathcal{O}(n\log n)$ trainable parameters. Their structured design enables efficient classical implementation and offers a path toward future quantum implementations with logarithmic circuit depth under suitable connectivity assumptions. Controlled experiments on MNIST and MedMNIST demonstrate improved certified robustness compared with conventional alternatives and, in the DermaMNIST transfer, greater resistance to the tested attacks than low-rank adaptation (LoRA). We then apply it to trichoscopic image classification for alopecia diagnosis and alopecia areata activity assessment. By adapting a certified ImageNet-pretrained network, butterfly fine-tuning achieves approximately twice the certified accuracy of conventional fine-tuning and LoRA, with comparable classification accuracy on the same backbone and data split and similar empirical resistance to the tested adversarial attacks. Larger robustness guarantees, including certificates covering certain image-processing transformations, can be obtained at the cost of reduced accuracy. These results highlight the potential of quantum-inspired butterfly layers for parameter-efficient adaptation of medical image classifiers while preserving the mathematical guarantees underlying certified robustness.

AI.tldr: 提出量子启发正交蝶形层微调方法，在保持预训练认证网络Lipschitz界的前提下实现参数高效迁移，在皮肤镜与毛发镜图像分类中认证鲁棒性约为常规微调与LoRA的两倍。
AI.motivation: 医学图像分类器不仅需高精度，还需在小扰动下可靠。认证鲁棒性可给出预测稳定性的数学保证，但将预训练认证模型适配到新任务时，这些保证往往难以保持。
AI.method: 基于可重构分束器量子电路设计灵感，采用量子启发正交蝶形层进行微调：层由结构构造保证正交性，仅需O(n log n)可训练参数，可高效经典实现，并在合适的连通性假设下具备对数深度量子实现的潜力。以认证ImageNet预训练骨干网络为基础，在MNIST、MedMNIST及毛发镜图像（脱发诊断与斑秃活动度评估）上进行对照实验。
AI.result: 在MNIST与MedMNIST上认证鲁棒性优于常规方案；DermaMNIST迁移中，对测试攻击的抵抗优于LoRA。毛发镜任务中，蝶形微调认证准确率约为常规微调与LoRA的两倍，分类准确率相当，经验对抗鲁棒性相近；可换取更大鲁棒性保证（含覆盖部分图像处理变换的证书），但精度下降。
AI.conclusion: 量子启发蝶形层适用于医学图像分类器的参数高效适配，能够在保持认证鲁棒性数学保证的同时完成迁移，具临床应用潜力。

title: AerialOcc: Unified 3D Aerial Perception without Task-Specific Head
summary: Aerial perception systems are increasingly expected to support diverse tasks, yet existing solutions remain fundamentally tied to task-specific outputs. Detection, segmentation, and other perception objectives are usually learned either by separate models or by sharing a backbone with multiple task heads, leaving the model itself unaware of the common structure underlying these tasks. We are interested in asking: can a single perception representation support different levels of understanding without being designed for any specific task? We notice that occupancy is a promising task-agnostic representation for drone perception. By modeling the spatial existence and semantics of the environment, it naturally bridges different perception granularities, from coarse scene understanding to fine-grained object localization. Therefore, we introduce AerialOcc, a unified occupancy-based perception model that enables multiple drone perception tasks from a single inference process, without maintaining task-specific prediction heads. To facilitate this direction, we construct AerialOcc-20K, a large-scale multi-class occupancy dataset for aerial environments. Extensive experiments show that AerialOcc achieves competitive performance across diverse perception tasks while preserving a unified architecture. Our findings demonstrate that occupancy can serve as a universal perception interface, offering a new perspective toward flexible and scalable visual intelligence for autonomous drones from a common 3D scene representation. Models and data are publicly available at https://github.com/guxiang2002/AerialOcc

AI.tldr: 提出 AerialOcc，一种基于占据（occupancy）的统一无人机感知模型，用单一推理过程支持多种感知任务，无需任务专用预测头，并构建 AerialOcc-20K 大规模多类航空占据数据集。
AI.motivation: 现有航空感知方案与任务特定输出强绑定：检测、分割等目标通常由独立模型学习，或共享骨干网络加多个任务头，模型本身并未意识到这些任务背后的共同结构。作者希望探究：单一感知表示能否在没有针对特定任务设计的前提下，支持不同层次的理解。
AI.method: 以占据作为任务无关（task-agnostic）表示：通过建模环境的空间存在性与语义，天然衔接从粗粒度场景理解到细粒度目标定位的不同感知粒度。据此构建 AerialOcc 统一占据感知模型，从单一推理流程输出多任务结果，不维护任务专用预测头；同时构建 AerialOcc-20K 大规模多类航空占据数据集以支撑该方向。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，AerialOcc 在保持统一架构的前提下，在多种感知任务上取得有竞争力的性能。
AI.conclusion: 占据可作为通用感知接口，为自主无人机从统一 3D 场景表示出发实现灵活、可扩展的视觉智能提供新视角。模型与数据已开源。

title: VTG-RAG: Long-Video Reasoning via Query-Adaptive Coarse-to-Fine Sampling and Temporal Graph Retrieval
summary: Long-video reasoning requires a system to localize sparse evidence over extended temporal sequences, preserve temporal structure, and generate answers despite substantial multimodal distractors. Existing video retrieval-augmented generation methods typically build indexes from uniformly sampled video segments. In long-video settings, this design readily introduces irrelevant context and is unreliable for questions with explicit temporal constraints. We propose VTG-RAG, a framework for long-video question answering that combines query-adaptive coarse-to-fine sampling with temporal graph retrieval. First, a two-stage sampling strategy selects core segments with high mean query relevance or high intra-segment relevance variance. The framework then integrates subtitles, speech transcripts, visual descriptions, entities, and relations from these segments into a temporally ordered multimodal graph. Finally, it performs temporally filtered, two-pass retrieval and reasoning across frame, text, and graph evidence spaces. A lot of experiments have proven the effectiveness of the VTG-RAG. Specifically, we evaluate the framework on Video-MME and LongVideoBench. On LongVideoBench, the reported Qwen2.5-VL-32B and 72B results improve from 48.16% to 50.56% and from 52.13% to 53.32%, respectively, with 24 answer-input frames. These correspond to gains of 2.40 and 1.19 percentage points. The ablation experiments of VTG-RAG further support that the contributions of each component are very important.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 VTG-RAG 框架，通过查询自适应的由粗到精采样与时序图检索，提升长视频问答的证据定位与推理能力。
AI.motivation: 长视频推理需在长时序中定位稀疏证据、保留时序结构并抵抗大量多模态干扰；现有视频检索增强生成方法基于均匀采样片段建索引，易引入无关上下文，对含显式时序约束的问题不可靠。
AI.method: 两阶段采样策略选取"查询相关性均值高"或"片段内相关性方差高"的核心片段；将片段的字幕、语音转写、视觉描述、实体与关系整合为时序有序的多模态图；在帧、文本、图三类证据空间上进行时序过滤的两遍检索与推理。
AI.result: 在 Video-MME 与 LongVideoBench 上验证有效性；LongVideoBench 上 Qwen2.5-VL-32B 由 48.16% 提升至 50.56%，72B 由 52.13% 提升至 53.32%，分别提升 2.40 与 1.19 个百分点（24 帧答案输入）；消融实验表明各组件贡献显著。
AI.conclusion: 查询自适应非均匀采样与时序图检索相结合，可有效抑制长视频中的无关干扰并支撑时序约束推理，模块化设计各环节均为性能增益来源。

title: TyphoonWorld: A Residual Token World Model for Probabilistic Forecasting of Typhoon Imagery
summary: A satellite forecast of a typhoon should give a low-error picture of the next two days, together with an ensemble whose members are coherent fields and whose spread responds to the storm at hand. A small direct regression network already gives the lowest squared error on held-out storms, so a generative model has to earn its cost through the part of the future that the regression smooths away. We present TyphoonWorld, a discrete-token world model that generates only that part. Conditioned on tokens of the regression forecast, the latest frames and the best-track state at forecast time, it samples residual fields lead by lead, and members add these residuals to the regression center. We compare it under one protocol with per-pixel Gaussian networks, a diffusion model of the same residuals, residuals from other storms and an unconditional token world model, on 276 forecast windows from 46 held-out storms of Digital Typhoon. TyphoonWorld matches the squared error of the regression, lowers the CRPS of the area colder than 220 K, a direct measure of deep convection, by 14 to 39% against every other ensemble, and ties its spread to forecast error as closely as the Gaussian network, with a correlation of 0.78 across windows. It uses 56% of the parameters of the unconditional world model.

AI.tldr: 提出 TyphoonWorld，一种离散token世界模型，仅生成回归预报平滑掉的残差场，在保持回归均方误差的同时显著降低深对流区CRPS并保持良好扩散-误差相关性。
AI.motivation: 台风卫星预报既需低误差的确定性预测，也需成员场相干、离散度能响应具体风暴的集合预报；小规模直接回归网络已取得最低平方误差，因此生成模型必须以"补足回归平滑掉的未来部分"来证明其代价合理性。
AI.method: 构建离散token世界模型，以回归预报token、最新帧和预报时刻最佳路径状态为条件，逐lead采样残差场；集合成员将残差加到回归中心上。在Digital Typhoon的46个留出风暴、276个预报窗口上，统一协议下与逐像素高斯网络、同残差的扩散模型、其他风暴残差和无条件token世界模型对比。
AI.result: 平方误差与回归模型持平；低于220 K区域（深对流直接度量）的CRPS较其他所有集合降低14%–39%；扩散度与预报误差的相关性达0.78，与高斯网络相当；参数量仅为无条件世界模型的56%。
AI.conclusion: 残差式离散token世界模型是台风卫星集合预报的有效折中方案：在零均方误差损失的前提下提升对流区概率预报质量，并以更低参数实现可靠的不确定性表征。

title: Is It Still There? Place-Registered Verification Makes VLMs Reliable Scene-Change Detectors
summary: A robot that returns to a space must tell which objects were added, removed or moved since its last visit, while its trajectory, viewpoints and lighting differ between the two visits. We find that multi-image vision-language models (VLMs) fail at this task mainly because they cannot find the place where an object was. A VLM recognises what each frame shows but cannot check whether an object is still at its place in the other capture. It therefore reports objects that only one capture shows and misses most removed and moved objects. We propose STILL, which reformulates change detection as object verification at a registered place. 3D geometry registers the place of each change hypothesis in the other capture, and one VLM answers, from a scene view and a local place view, whether the object is still at that place, trained with supervision of the same form. Under the official SceneDiff protocol, STILL raises the main metric obj/sc AP from 24.0 to 37.8, and from 11.6 to 20.6 on the egocentric kitchen subset without any kitchen training data. It improves F1 by more than 21 points over a VLM fine-tuned on the same annotations and adds only about 11% to the runtime.

AI.tldr: 提出 STILL，将跨次访问的场景变化检测重构为"在配准位置上的物体验证"任务，显著提升多图 VLM 的变化检测性能。
AI.motivation: 机器人重返同一空间时需判断物体被添加、移除或移动，但两次采集的轨迹、视角与光照不同。现有多图视觉语言模型（VLM）主要缺陷在于无法定位"物体原本所在的位置"：它能识别每帧内容，却无法核验物体在另一次采集的对应位置是否仍存在，导致只报告单次采集出现的物体，漏检大部分被移除和移动的物体。
AI.method: 将变化检测重构为配准位置上的物体验证：先用 3D 几何把每个变化假设的位置配准到另一次采集，再由单个 VLM 基于场景视图与局部位置视图判断物体是否仍在该处，并以同形式监督进行训练。
AI.result: 在官方 SceneDiff 协议下，主指标 obj/sc AP 从 24.0 提升至 37.8；在无任何厨房训练数据的情况下，自我中心厨房子集从 11.6 提升至 20.6；F1 较在同一标注上微调的 VLM 高出 21 点以上，运行时间仅增加约 11%。
AI.conclusion: 显式的位置配准加局部验证可有效弥补多图 VLM 在空间对应上的短板，在跨视角、跨光照的重复访问变化检测中取得大幅增益且开销可接受。

title: LiNO: Lightweight Network for Occupancy Estimation
summary: Occupancy estimation for automated vehicles is a crucial task that builds a 3D map using vehicle sensors. This map allows the vehicle to identify drivable areas and various obstacle classes. The task involves complex subtasks such as depth estimation, object classification, and segmentation to align semantic information with the 3D grid. Moreover, producing these estimations from multiple sensors demands significant computational power and memory, as high-dimensional data fusion requires complex feature extraction and processing. Consequently, most existing methods rely on large and computationally intensive architectures that are not suitable for real-time or real-world applications. We present a real-time, lightweight architecture that leverages camera and radar sensors through a residual multi-stage head. Unlike prior methods that rely on heavy camera-only blocks, our architecture employs camera-radar fusion and lightweight components. Additionally, we introduce a task-specific data augmentation strategy that enhances data diversity and improves generalisation. Our method achieves state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance, attaining 45.7 mean Intersection over Union (mIoU) on Occ3D and 41.9 Ray-level Intersection over Union (RayIoU) (41.9) on OpenOcc datasets, running at 17.2 frames per second (FPS) and using only 5.3 GB of memory, compared with 4.1 FPS and 7.7 GB for STCOcc.

AI.tldr: 提出一种实时轻量级相机-雷达融合占用栅格估计架构，通过残差多阶段头与任务特定数据增强，在Occ3D/OpenOcc上取得SOTA效率与精度平衡。
AI.motivation: 自动驾驶占用估计需融合多传感器高维数据，涉及深度估计、分类、分割等子任务并与3D栅格对齐，计算与内存开销大；现有方法多依赖重型纯相机架构，难以实时或落地。
AI.method: 轻量级实时架构，融合相机与雷达传感器，采用残差多阶段头（residual multi-stage head）替代重型纯相机模块；并引入任务特定数据增强策略提升数据多样性与泛化能力。
AI.result: Occ3D上45.7 mIoU，OpenOcc上41.9 RayIoU，达SOTA；运行17.2 FPS、内存5.3 GB，对比STCOcc的4.1 FPS与7.7 GB。
AI.conclusion: 相机-雷达融合加轻量组件可在显著降低算力与内存的同时保持SOTA精度，验证了轻量融合方案在实时占用估计中的有效性。

title: ShiftGuard: Evaluating Confidence and Feature Distance for Risk-Controlled Image Classification
summary: A classifier that is usually right still makes confident mistakes, and a deployed system needs some way to decide when to answer and when to abstain. Cheap post-hoc scores such as maximum softmax probability (MSP) and predictive entropy are the standard answer. Distances in feature space are a popular alternative, and fusing several signals into one score is a natural next step. We ask whether adding a feature distance signal to MSP and entropy improves error detection, and whether it increases the share of predictions that can be accepted at a certified error rate when only a small labelled calibration set is available. We train a CIFAR-adapted ResNet-18 from scratch on CIFAR-10 (92.92% test accuracy, one seed) and compare five reliability scores: MSP, entropy, distance to the predicted-class centroid, a logistic fusion of MSP and entropy, and a logistic fusion of all three signals. Acceptance thresholds are chosen on a held out calibration set with Clopper Pearson upper bounds, Bonferroni corrected over a prespecified family of 315 rules at 95% simultaneous confidence. Confidence based scores were best. Error AUROC was 0.9230 for MSP, 0.9233 for entropy and 0.9235 for MSP plus entropy, against 0.8814 for the three signal fusion and 0.8224 for distance alone. At a 5% risk target with 1,000 calibration images, entropy accepted 84.82% of test images with 2.05% observed error, while three signal fusion accepted 80.61% with 2.21%. With 250 calibration images, neither distance nor the three-signal fusion could certify the 5% target at all. The results come from one seed, one dataset and one architecture, with no corruption experiments, so they say nothing about distribution shift detection. Within these limits, the distance signal did not earn its added complexity.

AI.tldr: 在CIFAR-10上比较五种可靠性分数（MSP、熵、类中心距离、MSP+熵融合、三信号融合）用于选择性预测与风险受控弃权；置信度类分数最优，特征距离信号未能带来增益。
AI.motivation: 部署中的分类器需要判断何时回答、何时弃权；MSP与预测熵是标准廉价后验分数，特征空间距离是流行替代方案，将多信号融合是自然下一步。作者检验在仅有少量标注校准集时，加入特征距离信号能否改善错误检测，并提升在给定错误率下可被认证接受的预测比例。
AI.method: 从零训练CIFAR适配的ResNet-18（CIFAR-10，测试准确率92.92%，单随机种子）。比较五种分数：MSP、熵、到预测类质心的距离、MSP与熵的logistic融合、三信号logistic融合。接受阈值在独立校准集上用Clopper–Pearson上界选取，并在预设的315条规则族上做Bonferroni校正，达到95%同时置信水平。
AI.result: 置信度类分数最佳：误差AUROC为MSP 0.9230、熵0.9233、MSP+熵 0.9235，而三信号融合0.8814、单独距离0.8224。在5%风险目标、1000张校准图像下，熵接受84.82%测试样本、实测误差2.05%；三信号融合接受80.61%、误差2.21%。仅250张校准图像时，距离与三信号融合均无法认证5%目标。
AI.conclusion: 结果仅基于单种子、单数据集、单架构，且无损坏实验，因此不涉及分布漂移检测。在此限度内，特征距离信号未能在误差检测或风险受控接受率上补偿其增加的复杂度。

title: SCALE: Towards whole-slide counterfactual explanations in pathology
summary: Cancer diagnosis relies on histopathological evaluation, where tumor morphology guides disease classification and informs treatment decisions. Deep learning (DL) models excel at predicting diagnostic properties from histopathology images. Unlike typical medical images featuring small critical areas, histopathological images are textural, with relevant texture spanning the entire image; this makes it challenging to explain DL predictions by locating relevant image regions. Counterfactual explanations offer a promising alternative by asking "what changes in the image could have altered the model prediction." To achieve this, we propose SCALE, a framework for generating such counterfactual explanations for histopathological DL models. Across nine counterfactual directions spanning multiple cancer types, SCALE generates whole-slide counterfactual explanations that consistently shift predictions toward the intended target while maintaining biological feasibility. Blinded assessment by six board-certified pathologists showed higher morphological plausibility for SCALE (with a win rate of 91.7% over baselines) and promising counterfactual effectiveness (with a target consistency of 96.7%).

AI.tldr: 提出SCALE框架，为组织病理学深度学习模型生成全切片反事实解释，在九个反事实方向上成功改变模型预测并保持生物学可行性，获病理学家盲评91.7%形态学合理性胜率。
AI.motivation: 组织病理图像呈纹理性，相关特征遍布全图而非局限于小区域，导致传统"定位关键区域"的解释方法难以解释深度学习预测；反事实解释通过回答"图像何种改变会改变模型预测"提供了替代思路，但缺乏针对组织病理学的生成框架。
AI.method: 提出SCALE框架，为组织病理DL模型生成反事实解释。在覆盖多种癌症类型的九个反事实方向上，生成全切片级别的反事实解释，并使预测向指定目标类别迁移，同时约束结果保持生物学可行性。
AI.result: SCALE生成的反事实样本持续将预测推向目标类别；六位认证病理学家的盲评显示，SCALE在形态学合理性上相对基线胜率达91.7%，目标一致性达96.7%，反事实有效性良好。
AI.conclusion: SCALE证明全切片反事实解释是组织病理学DL模型可解释性的可行且符合生物学实际的方向，经专家评估具备较高的形态学合理性与反事实有效性。

title: Latent Fusion: Channel Stacking for Structure-Preserving Image Editing
summary: Instruction-based image editing models must condition on the source image, either by sequence concatenation, which appends source tokens to the target sequence (FLUX.1 Kontext), or by channel-wise concatenation, which stacks the source latent onto the noisy latent and widens the input projection (InstructPix2Pix, FLUX.1 Fill). The FLUX.1 Kontext report found channel-wise concatenation worse in initial experiments at 1K resolution with a 12B model and a large corpus. We explore channel-wise concatenation as the lower-cost option for a common production regime: structure-preserving edits that change appearance (sky, exposure, foliage, cleanup) but not layout, about 1,400 training pairs, a 4B non-distilled backbone, and 2K frames. It keeps the sequence at its original length, where sequence concatenation doubles it and roughly quadruples attention cost, and needs only single-scale classifier-free guidance (two forward passes per step instead of three). Starting from FLUX.2 Klein 4B base, we widen only the input projection and train both schemes with the same trainer, data, and hyperparameters. Channel-wise concatenation keeps the output pixel-aligned with the source; in our runs sequence concatenation, which must learn the correspondence between 10,880 target and 10,880 source tokens from fewer than 1,500 pairs, displaced structure, an observation we report without claiming a general ranking. On 29 held-out images the editor reaches 20.3 dB PSNR and 0.198 LPIPS against the human edit (unedited source: 15.0 dB), and counterfactual conditioning tests show it largely learned a global grade of the source rather than a selective edit, which we report as the open problem of this recipe. We also compare against an SD3.5-Medium editor trained with the same surgery and report the full training recipe, including failure modes. Code: https://github.com/complete-dope/LatentFusion

AI.tldr: 本文在4B非蒸馏骨干、约1,400对训练数据、2K分辨率的受控设定下，对比指令图像编辑中"通道拼接"与"序列拼接"两种源图条件化方式。结果显示通道拼接保持像素对齐、序列长度不变、注意力开销低，仅需单尺度CFG；而序列拼接在数据极少时出现结构位移。最终编辑器达20.3 dB PSNR / 0.198 LPIPS，但反事实测试表明其主要学到全局调色而非选择性编辑。
AI.motivation: FLUX.1 Kontext报告在大模型、大语料、1K分辨率下通道拼接较差，但缺乏对"低成本生产场景"（结构保持型外观编辑、小数据、小骨干、高分辨率）的系统评估。作者希望验证通道拼接在该特定regime下是否为更优选择，并量化其代价与收益。
AI.method: 以FLUX.2 Klein 4B base为起点，仅扩展输入投影层以支持通道拼接；在相同trainer、数据（约1,400对结构保持型外观编辑，天空/曝光/植被/清理）、超参与2K帧下训练两种条件化方案并对比。通道拼接保持序列长度，允许单尺度CFG（每步两次前向）；序列拼接使序列翻倍、注意力成本约四倍。另用相同改造训练SD3.5-Medium编辑器作对照，并公开完整训练配方与失败模式。
AI.result: 通道拼接输出与源图像像素对齐；序列拼接在少于1,500对数据下需从10,880目标token与10,880源token间学习对应关系，出现结构位移（作者仅作观察，不主张普遍排序）。29张留出图上，编辑器对人工编辑达20.3 dB PSNR、0.198 LPIPS（未编辑源为15.0 dB）。反事实条件测试显示模型主要学到对源图的全局调色，而非选择性编辑。
AI.conclusion: 通道拼接在低数据、高分辨率的结构保持编辑场景中是具成本效益的条件化方式，可维持像素对齐并降低注意力与采样开销；但当前配方尚未实现选择性局部编辑，全局分级偏置是待解决的开放问题。已发布代码与完整训练配方。

title: Incremental Learning of Vision-Language Models via Task Subspace Projection and Dynamic LoRA
comment: Pre-peer-review version of an article accepted for publication in the International Journal of Computer Vision (IJCV)
summary: Recent pre-trained vision-language models often encounter a Multi-Domain Task-Incremental Learning (MTIL) scenario in practice, where a set of classes of multi-modal tasks arrive incrementally. Due to privacy concerns and memory constraints, MTIL with pre-trained models encounters forgetting of knowledge from old tasks, degradation of zero-shot transfer capability, and underfitting of new-task knowledge. To overcome these challenges, previous MTIL methods attempt to learn a discriminative cross-task identification (CTI) module and an effective new-task adaptation (NTA) module. However, current CTI modules suffer from severe task confusion between seen and unseen tasks, and NTA modules cannot adaptively balance the performance and parameter cost while incorporating task-specific knowledge. To alleviate the above dilemmas, we propose an effective and efficient TSP-DLoRA method for MTIL, which consists of Task Subspace Projection (TSP) and Dynamic Low Rank Adapter (DLoRA) modules. Specifically, our TSP module includes a task identifier classifier based on task-specific subspaces and a feature projection strategy that can determine the identifier associated with samples from both seen and unseen tasks. Our DLoRA improves the knowledge adaptation from new tasks by dynamically assigning Low Rank Adapter (LoRA) across transformer layers based on the task distributions. Experimental evaluations across 11 datasets, using three performance metrics, demonstrate the effectiveness of our proposed method. Code is available at https://github.com/FerdinandZJU/TSP-DLoRA.

AI.tldr: 提出TSP-DLoRA方法解决预训练视觉-语言模型在多域任务增量学习中的遗忘、零样本迁移退化与新任务欠拟合问题，由任务子空间投影(TSP)与动态低秩适配器(DLoRA)构成，在11个数据集、3项指标上验证有效性。
AI.motivation: 预训练视觉-语言模型在实际中常面临多域任务增量学习（MTIL）场景：多模态任务的类别集合增量到达。受隐私与内存约束，此类场景存在旧任务知识遗忘、零样本迁移能力退化、新任务知识欠拟合三大问题。已有MTIL方法依赖跨任务识别（CTI）模块与新任务适配（NTA）模块，但CTI在已见/未见任务间存在严重任务混淆，NTA难以在引入任务特定知识的同时自适应平衡性能与参数开销。
AI.method: TSP-DLoRA包含两个模块：(1) Task Subspace Projection (TSP)，含基于任务特定子空间的任务标识分类器，以及一个特征投影策略，可对来自已见与未见任务的样本判定其所属标识；(2) Dynamic Low Rank Adapter (DLoRA)，依据任务分布在各Transformer层动态分配LoRA，以增强新任务知识适配。
AI.result: 在11个数据集上采用三项性能指标进行实验评估，结果验证了所提方法的有效性（摘要未给出具体数值）。
AI.conclusion: TSP与DLoRA协同缓解了已见/未见任务混淆及性能-参数开销失衡问题，为预训练模型下的MTIL提供了高效且有效的方案；代码已开源。

title: A Think Block Is Conditioning, Not a Plan
summary: Generative models increasingly write a chain of thought before drawing, and report large gains from doing so. We ask what that text contributes, by substitution rather than ablation: holding the generator, sampler and seeds fixed, we replace the think block with controlled alternatives and measure the image. Across a unified model with a think mode, a reinforcement-learned reasoning generator, and a planner driving a frozen diffusion model, the same picture emerges. Content-free prose of matched length is worth nothing or less ($-0.05$ to $-0.15$). One sentence from an unrelated 8B model, naming the subject and a few identifying details, matches the generator's own plan in three to six times fewer conditioning tokens. The value sits where the referent is in doubt: writing down a name is worth $+0.33$ when it is right and $+0.05$ when it is wrong, and where the generator already succeeds the whole effect is $-0.07 \pm 0.07$. Cutting a plan at the text encoder's window leaves 272 of 286 images byte-identical, and a plan rewritten to fit that window ties a bare identification ($+0.003 \pm 0.044$), so a plan contains nothing the identification does not already supply. Field-level interventions find only colour executed reliably, and a control writing the same sentences into the user prompt shows that limit belongs to the generator rather than to the planning channel. Two judges and two annotators replicate the central contrasts. A think block earns its keep as a specification of what to draw, not as a plan that is carried out.

AI.tldr: 通过"替换而非消融"的控制实验发现：生成模型中的think块（思维链）的价值在于"指明画什么"（对指称对象的规格说明），而非"执行一个计划"；一段无内容的等长文字毫无价值甚至有害，而一句来自无关8B模型的短句指认主体与细节即可匹敌模型自身的plan，且仅用三分之一的token。
AI.motivation: 生成模型在作图前越来越多地生成思维链文本，并报告由此带来大幅收益。作者想弄清这段文本究竟贡献了什么——是将计划真正执行，还是仅仅起到了对目标内容的规格化指认作用。为此采用"替换"而非"消融"的设计，以排除生成器、采样器和随机种子变化带来的混杂。
AI.method: 固定生成器、采样器与随机种子，把think块替换为若干受控替代文本并测量输出图像。覆盖三类系统：带think模式的统一模型、经强化学习训练的推理生成器、以及驱动冻结扩散模型的planner。设置多种对照：等长无内容散文、来自无关8B模型的单句指认、正确/错误指称的名称、截断至文本编码器窗口的plan、改写以适配窗口的plan、以及仅颜色等字段级干预，并将相同句子写入用户提示作为控制。由两名评审与两名标注者复核核心对比。
AI.result: 等长无内容散文价值为0至负（−0.05到−0.15）；来自无关8B模型的单句（命名主体及少量识别细节）以少3至6倍的conditioning token达到与自身plan相当的效果；写下正确名称价值+0.33、错误时+0.05，而在生成器本已成功的样本上整体效应仅−0.07±0.07；将plan截断至文本编码器窗口后286张图中272张逐字节相同，改写适配窗口的plan与裸识别效果相当（+0.003±0.044）；字段级干预中仅颜色被可靠执行；把相同句子写入用户提示表明该局限属于生成器而非规划通道。
AI.conclusion: think块的价值来自"对要画内容的规格说明"，而不是"被执行的计划"。计划中不含识别所不能提供的信息；其收益集中在指称对象不确定的情形。所谓"先思考再画"的收益应被理解为指认/规格化，而非规划推理。局限（如颜色以外字段执行不可靠）源于生成器本身而非规划通道。

title: Unlocking Fine-Grained Cell Representations via Soft-Interior Rim Dense-Grid Pooling in Pathology Foundation Models
summary: Fine-grained cell representations are essential for characterizing cellular heterogeneity and tissue organization in computational pathology. Pathology foundation models (PFMs) provide powerful pretrained features for transferable tissue analysis. HoVer-Net uses task-trained segmentation and typing, whereas CellViT++ averages native-grid tokens assigned to detected nuclei. However, the former requires cell-specific training; the latter ignores fractional nuclear coverage and can mix nuclear content with neighbouring tissue. Therefore, we propose SRDP, short for Soft-interior Rim Dense-grid Pooling, a training-free geometry-aware readout. We apply the frozen patch projection at half stride, interleave four offset lattices, map the cell mask to fractional coverage weights, and concatenate whole-cell pooling with two inner boundary pools. Across four datasets and six frozen encoders, SRDP improves mean balanced accuracy by 5.68 percentage points over native token averaging across 24 settings, including 11.22 points on average for CoNIC and Lizard. SRDP converts a coarse frozen PFM lattice into a mask-aligned, fine-grained cell representation without updating the encoder.

AI.tldr: 提出SRDP——一种无需训练、几何感知的细胞表征读出方法，将冻结的病理基础模型粗网格特征转化为掩码对齐的细粒度细胞表示。
AI.motivation: 现有细胞级表征方法存在缺陷：HoVer-Net需细胞专属训练；CellViT++对检测核分配的原生网格token取平均，忽略核的分数覆盖，易将核内容与邻近组织混合。
AI.method: SRDP（Soft-interior Rim Dense-grid Pooling）：对冻结的patch投影以半步长应用，交错四个偏移格点，将细胞掩码映射为分数覆盖权重，并将整细胞池化与两个内边界池化拼接；全程不更新编码器。
AI.result: 在4个数据集、6个冻结编码器共24种设置下，平均平衡准确率较原生token平均提升5.68个百分点；CoNIC与Lizard上平均提升11.22个百分点。
AI.conclusion: SRDP在免训练条件下将粗粒度的冻结PFM格点转为掩码对齐的细粒度细胞表征，显著提升下游细胞分析性能。

title: Generate, Align, and Restore: MLLM-Empowered Diffusion for Generalizable Low-light Image Enhancement
summary: Low-light image enhancement (LLIE) is essential to numerous vision applications operating under adverse illumination. Despite substantial advances, real-world nighttime enhancement remains challenging due to the scarcity of strictly aligned day-night pairs and complex degradations involving extreme darkness and heterogeneous artificial light sources, leading to fragile generalization. To overcome these challenges, we propose MrLIE (MLLM-empowered reference Low-light Image Enhancement), a novel reference-based unsupervised LLIE framework that synergizes the generative and reasoning capabilities of multimodal large language models (MLLMs) with conditional diffusion. MrLIE employs the MLLM as a high-fidelity reference synthesizer and diagnostic critic, iteratively generating, diagnosing, and correcting normal-light references directly from degraded nighttime observations. Based on this, our method governs the enhancement process through two complementary mechanisms, in which a confidence offset module rectifies spatial-geometric inconsistencies for reference reliability and a structure-anchored injection scheme harmonizes aligned reference cues, low-light structural constraints, and ControlNet additive anchoring during the denoising process. Extensive experiments on diverse benchmarks demonstrate that MrLIE achieves superior perceptual quality, natural appearance, and robust generalization.

AI.tldr: MrLIE：以多模态大模型生成参考图并结合条件扩散的无监督低光照增强框架。
AI.motivation: 真实夜间低光照增强受限于严格对齐的昼夜图像对稀缺，以及极暗、异质人工光源带来的复杂退化，导致泛化性差。
AI.method: 将MLLM作为高保真参考合成器与诊断式评判者，从退化夜景中迭代生成、诊断并修正正常光照参考；并用置信度偏移模块校正空间-几何不一致，以结构锚定注入方案在去噪中融合对齐参考线索、低光照结构约束与ControlNet加性锚定。
AI.result: 在多个基准上取得更优的感知质量、自然外观与稳健泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 融合MLLM推理生成能力与条件扩散，可在无配对监督下实现高质量真实夜间低光照增强。

title: Beyond Paired Inputs: Learning to Leverage RGB-T Cross-Modal Relations in Multimodal Large Language Models
summary: RGB and thermal infrared (TIR) sensors provide complementary observations, yet their distinct sensing characteristics make effective cross-modal coordination challenging. Although existing multimodal large language models (MLLMs) can process paired RGB-T inputs, they often fail to translate cross-modal relations into effective task-specific decisions, leaving the potential of these relations to improve task performance and robustness largely untapped. Motivated by this observation, we introduce RelMLLM, an RGB-T MLLM that explicitly learns to exploit cross-modal relations in task-specific decision making. It represents modality reliability, the cross-modal relation, and the dominant modality as a verifiable decision state. We derive task-grounded supervision for this state by comparing RGB-only, TIR-only, and paired RGB-T task outcomes. A hierarchical relation-guided reward supervises modality-specific evidence, relation-state prediction, and the final task output, while encouraging consistency across evidence, relation, and decision. We evaluate RelMLLM on natural RGB-T grounding, RGB-T visual question answering, and held-out sensor degradation. RelMLLM improves grounding accuracy and degradation robustness over its Qwen3-VL baselines while preserving performance on general RGB-T reasoning benchmarks. These results demonstrate that effectively exploiting cross-modal relations leads to more accurate and robust RGB-T decisions. Code and model weights are publicly available.

AI.tldr: 提出 RelMLLM，一个显式学习在任务决策中利用 RGB-T 跨模态关系（模态可靠性、关系、主导模态构成可验证决策状态）的 RGB-T 多模态大模型，通过任务结果对比生成监督信号与分层关系引导奖励，在定位与传感器退化鲁棒性上优于 Qwen3-VL 基线。
AI.motivation: RGB 与热红外（TIR）传感器观测互补，但成像特性差异使跨模态协同困难。现有 MLLM 虽能处理成对 RGB-T 输入，却未能将跨模态关系转化为有效的任务特定决策，导致其提升性能与鲁棒性的潜力未被充分挖掘。
AI.method: 构建 RelMLLM：将模态可靠性、跨模态关系与主导模态表示为可验证的“决策状态”；通过比较仅 RGB、仅 TIR 与 RGB-T 配对三种条件下的任务结果，推导任务锚定的状态监督；采用分层关系引导奖励，分别监督模态特异性证据、关系状态预测与最终任务输出，并约束三者一致性。
AI.result: 在自然 RGB-T 定位、RGB-T 视觉问答及留出传感器退化场景上评估；相对 Qwen3-VL 基线提升了定位精度与退化鲁棒性，同时在通用 RGB-T 推理基准上保持性能。
AI.conclusion: 有效利用跨模态关系可带来更准确、更鲁棒的 RGB-T 决策；代码与模型权重已公开。

title: Acting by Intent, Reacting by Sight: Visual Conditioned Reflexes for Real-Time VLM Agents
summary: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have shown strong capabilities as generalist agents that perceive, reason, and act in interactive environments. Yet real-time environments such as video games demand both deliberate control for exploration and split-second reactions to fast-moving hazards. Existing agents struggle to handle both: relying solely on direct VLM actions is too slow for sudden events, whereas delegating execution to fixed scripts leaves the agent blind at the moment of action, leading to frequent misfires whenever the scene shifts. Humans overcome this by pairing normal conscious control with conditioned reflexes-while the mind handles deliberate actions and shapes reflex rules, the reflex itself still relies on live vision to make the final instant decision. Emulating this mechanism, we propose ViCoR (Visual Conditioned Reflex). Alongside normal gameplay actions, the main VLM defines and updates lightweight situational guidance for recurring events, while a fast visual reflex branch (invoking the VLM in no-thinking mode) inspects live local views with motion cues to make the final sub-second action decisions. By offloading 67.8% of high-frequency reactions to the reflex branch (680 ms per check), ViCoR reduces average per-action decision latency by 2.6x (from 14.0 s to 5.4 s) and cuts token consumption by 36.9%. Across 17 diverse 2D and 3D games in the GameWorld benchmark, ViCoR achieves state-of-the-art performance, improving task success rate by +11.8% (from 52.9% to 64.7%) and average normalized progress by +13.9% (from 66.5% to 80.4%) over the strongest deliberative VLM and script baselines. In fast-paced real-time games, ViCoR refines its reflexes across episodes to boost progress by 1.67x, and even with a low-effort main planner, surpasses high-effort deliberative baselines by +8.1% at one-third of the token cost.

AI.tldr: 提出ViCoR，将VLM的审慎控制与"视觉条件反射"分支结合，在17款2D/3D游戏中以更低延迟与token消耗取得SOTA任务成功率与进度。
AI.motivation: 实时环境（如电子游戏）既需要审慎的探索控制，又需要对突发危险做出亚秒级反应。现有方案两头失衡：直接由VLM输出动作太慢，难以应对突发事件；而将执行委托给固定脚本则使智能体在动作瞬间"失明"，场景稍有变化就频繁失误。人类通过"意识控制+条件反射"解决该矛盾：心智负责审慎动作并塑造反射规则，反射本身仍依赖实时视觉做最终瞬时判断。
AI.method: ViCoR（Visual Conditioned Reflex）在主VLM正常执行游戏动作的同时，由主VLM为反复出现的事件定义并更新轻量级情境指导（situational guidance）；另设一个快速视觉反射分支，以no-thinking模式调用VLM，结合运动线索检查实时局部视图，负责做出最终的亚秒级动作决策。
AI.result: 将67.8%的高频反应卸载到反射分支（每次检查680 ms），使单动作平均决策延迟降低2.6倍（14.0 s→5.4 s），token消耗减少36.9%。在GameWorld基准的17款2D/3D游戏中达到SOTA：任务成功率+11.8%（52.9%→64.7%），平均归一化进度+13.9%（66.5%→80.4%）。在快节奏实时游戏中，反射可跨回合精炼，进度提升1.67倍；即便配用低投入主规划器，仍以约三分之一token成本超过高投入审慎基线+8.1%。
AI.conclusion: 通过模拟人类"审慎控制+条件反射"的分工，ViCoR在保持实时视觉闭环的前提下显著降低延迟与开销，并在多种游戏环境中稳定超越纯审慎VLM与脚本基线，说明分层解耦（慢规划+快反射）是实时具身/交互智能体的有效范式。

title: Scaling Channel-Adaptive Self-Supervised Learning
summary: Recent advances in self-supervised pre-training of foundation models for natural images have made them a popular choice for various visual systems and applications. Self-supervised strategies are also promising in non-RGB scientific imaging domains such as in biology, medical and satellite imagery, but their broader application is hampered by heterogeneity in channel composition and semantics between relevant datasets: two datasets may contain different numbers of channels, and these may reveal distinct aspects of an object or scene. Recent works on channel adaptive strategies report substantial advantages for those that account for variable channel compositions without sacrificing the ability to jointly encode channels; yet, how these strategies behave at scale remains unclear. We here show that, surprisingly, trained across large-scale datasets, independent-encoding of channels outperforms joint-encoding methods by a substantial margin. We validate this result along an extensive set of experiments on various datasets from cell microscopy to geospatial imagery. Our DINO BoC approach sets a new state-of-the-art across challenging benchmarks, including generalization to out-of-distribution tasks and unseen channel combinations. We open-source code and model weights for a new general-purpose feature extractor for fluorescent microscopy.

AI.tldr: 在非RGB科学成像（生物、医学、卫星）中，大规模自监督预训练时对通道进行独立编码（DINO BoC）显著优于联合编码方法，并在多项挑战性基准上刷新SOTA，同时对未见通道组合和分布外任务具有更强泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 自然图像基础模型的自监督预训练已非常成功，该范式在生物、医学、卫星等非RGB科学成像领域同样有前景；但这些领域的多通道数据在通道数量与语义上高度异质（不同数据集通道数不同、同一通道揭示的信息不同），阻碍了通用预训练。已有通道自适应策略报告了处理可变通道组合的优势，但其在大规模数据下的行为尚不清楚。
AI.method: 提出DINO BoC（Bag-of-Channels）策略：在通道自适应框架下，将多通道输入视为通道集合，采用通道独立编码而非联合编码，并结合DINO式自监督目标进行大规模预训练；同时在从细胞显微成像到地理空间影像的多个数据集上开展系统性消融与对比实验，并测试对未见通道组合和分布外任务的泛化。
AI.result: 出乎意料地，在大规模数据集上训练后，通道独立编码以显著幅度优于联合编码方法；该结论在细胞显微到地理空间影像的大量实验中被一致验证。DINO BoC在包括分布外泛化和未见通道组合在内的多项挑战性基准上达到新的SOTA，并开源了面向荧光显微成像的通用特征提取器代码与权重。
AI.conclusion: 通道异质性下的科学成像基础模型预训练中，“独立编码优于联合编码”这一反直觉结论在大规模条件下成立，为跨域、可变通道的多通道自监督预训练提供了简洁有效的通用方案与可直接使用的荧光显微特征提取器。

title: RescueVLM: Model-Agnostic Vision-Language Framework for Rescue Drone Imagery
summary: A single unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) mission over an incident site produces hundreds of images, far more than a rescue commander can review under time pressure, and human screening of destruction imagery carries a documented psychological cost. The two obvious remedies both fail in search and rescue (SAR) practice: cloud vision-language model (VLM) services are excluded because the imagery must not leave the incident network under GDPR and German civil-protection (BOS) rules, and fine-tuned specialist detectors age quickly while retraining and re-certifying them exceeds most SAR organizations resources. We present RescueVLM, an open-source, training-free and model-agnostic triage tool built on SketchVLM: a general-purpose open-weight VLM runs fully on-premise and is swapped for a newer model through a simple dropdown selection, so triage quality grows with the underlying models because all task knowledge lives in prompts and an output contract rather than in trained weights. One natural-language query over a mission folder returns a ranked shortlist with per-image justifications, editable SVG overlay annotations, and a GPS map of the hits. In a qualitative evaluation on German fire-brigade field data from three real deployments and a live fire exercise, a single query condenses an entire survey mission into a handful of annotated frames that a commander can review at a glance.

AI.tldr: 提出 RescueVLM：基于 SketchVLM 的开源、免训练、模型无关的无人机侦察图像分诊工具，在本地运行通用开放权重 VLM，通过自然语言查询将整次任务影像压缩为带理由、SVG 标注与 GPS 地图的排序短名单；在德国消防队三次真实部署与一次实弹演习数据上做了定性验证。
AI.motivation: 单次无人机任务产生数百张影像，远超救援指挥员在时间压力下的审阅能力，人工筛查破坏影像还有记录在案的心理成本。两条显然的补救路径在搜救实践中均失效：云端 VLM 因 GDPR 与德国民防（BOS）规定禁止影像离开事件内网；微调专用检测器易过时，且重训练与重新认证超出多数搜救机构资源。
AI.method: 构建于 SketchVLM 之上的免训练、模型无关分诊工具：通用开放权重 VLM 全本地部署，通过下拉选择即可替换更新模型；全部任务知识置于提示词与输出契约中而非训练权重中；对任务文件夹的单条自然语言查询返回排序短名单，附逐图理由、可编辑 SVG 叠加标注和命中点 GPS 地图。
AI.result: 在来自三次真实部署与一次实弹消防演习的德国消防队现场数据上开展定性评估，单条查询即可将整次勘察任务压缩为少数几帧标注图像，供指挥员一眼审阅。
AI.conclusion: RescueVLM 以"提示即知识"的免训练架构规避了云端合规与模型老化两大障碍，实现隐私合规、可持续升级的无人机影像分诊；当前仅为定性评估，量化性能尚待验证。

title: Conv-Reluplex: A Verification Framework For Convolution Neural Networks
comment: 6 pages, 8 figures, 5 tables. Published in SEKE 2021
summary: In recent years, machine learning has demonstrated impressive performance in many real-world tasks, especially in computer vision and natural language processing. However, to apply them in safety-critical systems one needs formal guarantees on the neural network outputs. The Reluplex tool is proposed to verify the safety of deep neural networks (DNNs), and in case the DNN fails to give a correct output, can generate adversarial examples. Since the tool can only handle DNNs, it is necessary to extend the tool to process image data. Therefore, in this paper, we propose the Conv-Reluplex framework, which is designed to verify the convolutional layer and pooling layer in convolutional neural networks (CNNs), and generate adversarial examples when classification is misguided. We conduct several experiments on MNIST to evaluate our approaches. The results show that the original CNN is improved using the adversarial examples generated by our tool, and the precision of classification can be increased significantly.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 Conv-Reluplex 框架，将原仅支持全连接 DNN 的 Reluplex 验证工具扩展到支持 CNN 的卷积层与池化层，可对图像分类网络进行安全验证并在误分类时生成对抗样本，在 MNIST 上的实验表明用其生成的对抗样本可显著提升原 CNN 的分类精度。
AI.motivation: 机器学习在视觉与自然语言处理等任务中表现优异，但应用于安全关键系统时需要神经网络输出的形式化保证。现有 Reluplex 工具可验证 DNN 安全性并能生成对抗样本，然而其只能处理全连接 DNN，无法直接处理图像数据中的卷积与池化结构，因此需要扩展以支持 CNN 验证。
AI.method: 提出 Conv-Reluplex 框架：在 Reluplex 基础上设计对 CNN 卷积层和池化层的处理与编码，从而对 CNN 进行形式化验证，并在分类结果被误导时生成对抗样本；在 MNIST 数据集上开展多组实验进行评估。
AI.result: 在 MNIST 上的实验显示，使用该工具生成的对抗样本对原 CNN 进行改进后，分类精度得到显著提升。
AI.conclusion: 将 Reluplex 从 DNN 扩展到 CNN 的 Conv-Reluplex 框架可有效支撑卷积网络的验证与对抗样本生成，且生成的对抗样本可作为数据增强手段显著提升模型分类性能。

title: From Hosted Service to Field-Owned Infrastructure: Open, Self-Hosted Real-Time Camera-Trap Alerting with Regional Open-Weight Models
summary: Cellular camera traps can alert field teams within minutes, supporting anti-poaching, threatened-species protection and human-wildlife conflict mitigation. Most systems use central servers, sending images of people and sensitive species locations outside the collecting organisation and often across national borders. We ask whether this capability can run on infrastructure owned by field organisations. Trap Tracker RT is an open-source, self-hosted application that receives images by email or locally via FTP/SFTP, classifies them with a project-specific model and sends alerts through a mail server chosen by the organisation. We evaluated DeepFaune-SSA v1.2, pairing MegaDetector v6 with a DINOv3-based classifier for 33 sub-Saharan taxa, against three open alternatives on 31,131 out-of-distribution images from Kenya, Namibia and Malawi, independent of its training data. DeepFaune-SSA achieved image-level species accuracy of 0.901 (95% CI 0.894-0.908), versus 0.530 for the global SpeciesNet classifier and 0.556 and 0.547 for YOLOv10x and YOLO26x detectors trained on the same regional data. DeepFaune-SSA had the highest recall for all 26 species evaluated. The single-stage detectors missed animals in about a quarter of images; SpeciesNet assigned species labels in only 57%, usually falling back to coarser labels otherwise. In bench tests of the fully local path, alerts were issued about 6 s after upload completion, including with slowed and interrupted uploads. The two-stage pipeline processed 19 images per minute on eight CPU threads without a graphics processor. Trap Tracker RT is used by five organisations in the United Kingdom and Kenya, including for human-elephant conflict mitigation. We discuss how data paths, rather than inference location, determine data sovereignty, the responsibilities of self-hosting and the ethics of real-time monitoring.

AI.tldr: 提出开源自托管的红外相机实时告警系统 Trap Tracker RT，并评估其项目专用分类模型 DeepFaune-SSA v1.2，在 31,131 张区域外分布图像上实现 0.901 的物种准确率，显著优于全球模型，本地推理约 6 秒内告警。
AI.motivation: 现有蜂窝相机陷阱告警系统多依赖中央服务器，会将人员图像与敏感物种位置传出采集机构甚至跨国，引发数据主权与隐私问题。作者希望验证该能力能否在野外机构自有基础设施上运行。
AI.method: 开发开源自托管应用 Trap Tracker RT，支持邮件与本地 FTP/SFTP 接收图像、项目专用模型分类、由机构自选邮件服务器推送告警；构建 DeepFaune-SSA v1.2（MegaDetector v6 检测 + 基于 DINOv3 的分类器，覆盖撒哈拉以南 33 个类群），并与 SpeciesNet、YOLOv10x、YOLO26x 在肯尼亚、纳米比亚、马拉维的 31,131 张独立分布外图像上对比；另做本地路径的告警时延与吞吐基准测试。
AI.result: DeepFaune-SSA 图像级物种准确率 0.901（95% CI 0.894–0.908），SpeciesNet 为 0.530，YOLOv10x 与 YOLO26x 分别为 0.556 和 0.547；DeepFaune-SSA 在全部 26 个评估物种上召回率最高。单阶段检测器约四分之一图像漏检动物，SpeciesNet 仅 57% 图像给出物种标签（其余多退化为粗粒度标签）。本地路径告警延迟约 6 秒，八线程无 GPU 时每分钟处理 19 张图像。系统已被英国与肯尼亚五家机构使用。
AI.conclusion: 野外机构可在自有基础设施上实现实时相机告警，两阶段项目专用模型优于全球或单阶段基线；决定数据主权的是数据路径而非推理位置，并讨论了自托管责任与实时监测的伦理问题。

title: Feature-Space Latent Forecasting for Endoscopic Surgical Video Understanding
summary: Surgical workflow assistance is inherently anticipatory: systems must reason about how procedures evolve, not just recognize the current frame. However, many prior approaches perform prediction in pixel space by synthesizing future frames, which primarily focuses on appearance fidelity rather than the semantic representations required for downstream reasoning. To address this limitation, we propose a feature-space semantic forecasting framework that models temporal dynamics directly within the representations of a frozen Vision Foundation Model (VFM). Specifically, we build a hierarchical target representation from multi-layer VFM features, replace future-frame feature tokens with learnable \texttt{[MASK]} tokens, and train a masked transformer to forecast the corresponding future latent features from observed context, thereby formulating procedural evolution as masked future feature prediction. Experiments on public laparoscopic benchmarks demonstrate consistent improvements in phase anticipation, multi-label tool presence prediction, and remaining-time estimation over RGB-based forecasting baselines, while enabling a plug-and-play representation interface for lightweight downstream heads.

AI.tldr: 提出特征空间语义预测框架，在冻结VFM的表征空间内直接预测手术流程演化，替代像素级未来帧合成。
AI.motivation: 手术工作流辅助本质上是前瞻性任务，需推理流程演化而非仅识别当前帧。已有方法在像素空间合成未来帧，偏重外观保真度，而下游推理更需要语义表征，二者不匹配。
AI.method: 基于冻结的视觉基础模型（VFM），构建多层特征组成的分层目标表征；用可学习[MASK] token替换未来帧的特征token，训练掩码Transformer从观测上下文预测对应未来潜在特征，将流程演化建模为掩码未来特征预测。
AI.result: 在公开腹腔镜基准上，相较RGB预测基线，在阶段预测、多标签器械存在预测和剩余时间估计上均取得一致提升，并为轻量下游头提供即插即用表征接口。
AI.conclusion: 在特征空间而非像素空间进行语义预测，可更有效支撑手术流程前瞻推理，并具备良好的可扩展性与下游兼容性。

title: DBHiCo: Dual-Branch Hierarchical Contrastive Learning for MRI Image Classification
summary: Automated Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) image classification provides a crucial non-invasive approach for neurological diagnosis, yet it is fundamentally challenged by inherent acquisition noise and high inter-subject structural similarity, which obscure subtle pathological variations, thereby limiting the performance of deep neural networks. While contrastive learning (CL) offers a promising mitigation strategy, existing paradigms rely on rigid binary partitions that ignore negative sample heterogeneity, and they fail to capture the cross-view structural consistency vital for fine-grained anatomical alignment. To address these barriers, we propose Dual-Branch Hierarchical Contrastive Learning (DBHiCo), a novel framework explicitly designed to collaboratively enforce structural consistency and semantic discrimination. Specifically, DBHiCo leverages a natural anatomical multi-view pair (original and skull-stripped MRI scans), processing them through a dual-branch architecture to seamlessly integrate holistic structural robustness with localized intracranial details. Crucially, we introduce a hierarchical contrastive loss that discards conventional binary constraints in favor of a margin-ranked similarity hierarchy. This mechanism explicitly orders positive and negative pairs based on their structural and semantic difficulty, thereby amplifying the fine-grained semantic discriminability of the learned representations. Extensive experiments across three diverse neurological datasets demonstrate that DBHiCo achieves state-of-the-art performance, consistently outperforming existing MRI multi-view representation learning and advanced contrastive fine-tuning methods.

AI.tldr: 提出双分支分层对比学习框架DBHiCo，利用原始与去颅骨MRI构成天然多视角对，并以margin排序的相似度分层替代刚性二元对比约束，提升MRI分类的细粒度语义判别力。
AI.motivation: MRI自动分类受采集噪声与受试者间高结构相似性困扰，细微病理变化被掩盖，限制深度网络性能。现有对比学习依赖刚性二元正负划分，忽视负样本异质性，且缺乏对细粒度解剖对齐至关重要的跨视角结构一致性建模。
AI.method: DBHiCo采用双分支架构处理解剖学多视角对（原始MRI与去颅骨MRI），融合整体结构鲁棒性与颅内局部细节；核心是分层对比损失，以margin排序的相似度层级取代传统二元约束，依据结构与语义难度对正负样本对排序，从而增强表征的细粒度语义可判别性。
AI.result: 在三个不同的神经影像数据集上取得最优性能，稳定优于现有多视角MRI表征学习方法及先进对比微调方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过自然多视角配对与分层相似度排序约束的协同设计，DBHiCo在噪声与高相似性条件下有效提升MRI分类的判别能力，为医学图像对比学习提供可推广的范式。

title: Calibrating the Uncertainty of Self-Supervised Monocular Depth without Labels
summary: Self-supervised monocular depth networks can predict a per-pixel uncertainty, which is mainly evaluated by how well it ranks pixels according to their error. Such metrics are insensitive to the magnitude of the uncertainty, so an uncertainty half as large as the actual error obtains the same score. In this paper, we investigate whether the predicted uncertainty is as large as the depth error, both on average (scale) and across confident and uncertain, near and far pixels (shape). On KITTI, the scale is miscalibrated for every uncertainty estimate we evaluate, and the error of MonoProb is nearly twice its predicted uncertainty. We propose MonoCal, which corrects both the scale and the shape without ground-truth depth. Scale calibration multiplies the uncertainty by a single constant measured from stereo pairs, requiring no retraining, and this constant closely matches the one fitted with ground truth. Since a constant cannot change the shape, we further retrain the uncertainty to predict where the depth of the network disagrees with that of a second self-supervised network. Experiments on KITTI show that MonoCal achieves better calibration across uncertainty levels and depth ranges than rescaling with ground truth, while still using a single image at inference. Code will be made publicly available.

AI.tldr: 自监督单目深度网络预测的逐像素不确定度在幅度与形状上普遍失校准，本文提出无需真值深度的校准方法MonoCal，同时修正尺度与形状。
AI.motivation: 现有不确定度评估多只衡量其对误差的排序能力（如AUSE），对幅度不敏感：不确定度即使只有实际误差的一半，也能获得相同评分。因此需要考察预测不确定度是否在均值（尺度）和跨置信/不确定、近/远像素（形状）上都与深度误差相当。
AI.method: 先在KITTI上评估多种不确定度估计的尺度与形状校准性。尺度校准：利用立体图像对测得的单个常数对不确定度整体缩放（Scale Calibration），无需重训练；由于常数无法改变形状，进一步重训练不确定度分支，使其预测主网络与第二个自监督网络深度不一致的位置（Shape Calibration）。推理时仅需单张图像。
AI.result: 在KITTI上，所评估的每种不确定度估计尺度均失校准，MonoProb的误差约为其预测不确定度的近两倍；仅由立体对拟合的常数与用真值拟合的常数高度接近。MonoCal在不同不确定度水平与深度范围内均优于用真值重缩放，取得更好的校准效果。
AI.conclusion: 单目深度不确定度校准需同时关注尺度与形状；MonoCal可在无真值深度条件下实现优于真值重缩放的校准，且保持单图像推理，代码将公开。

title: FDAM: A Frequency-Direction-Aware Multi-Task Framework for Pavement Crack Grid Localization
summary: Pavement crack grid localization remains challenging for thin and tiny cracks due to weak visual cues and background interference. Box detection often misses these cracks, while supervised semantic segmentation faces limited pixel-wise annotations and high labeling costs. In this paper, we propose a Frequency-Direction-Aware Multi-Task framework (FDAM) with box detection and grid classification branches. The core grid classification branch comprises Frequency-Domain Enhancement (FDE) and Directional Feature Refinement (DFR). FDE adaptively weights spectral bands and fuses reconstructed features with spatial features. DFR captures thin crack patterns through multi-scale strip convolutions, direction-sensitive modulation, and feature recalibration. Sparse positive cells and ambiguous local predictions motivate adaptive grid supervision. Adaptive Importance Reweighting emphasizes uncertain predictions and local label transitions, with focal supervision for all cells. Our contribution is to couple the box detection and grid classification branches through shared feature learning for pavement crack grid localization. We validate FDAM on our RoadDistress2026 dataset of thin and tiny cracks and further evaluate it on public datasets Crack500 and DeepCrack. The code is available at https://github.com/Lab-PANbin/FDAM

AI.tldr: 提出频率-方向感知多任务框架FDAM，结合框检测与网格分类分支，用于细小天候路面裂缝的网格定位。
AI.motivation: 细小裂缝视觉线索弱、背景干扰强：框检测易漏检，监督式语义分割依赖大量像素级标注、标注成本高。
AI.method: 主分支为网格分类，含频域增强FDE（自适应加权谱带并将重构特征与空间特征融合）与方向特征细化DFR（多尺度条带卷积、方向敏感调制、特征重校准）；并采用自适应网格监督，即自适应重要性重加权（聚焦不确定预测与局部标签跳变）配合全单元focal监督。两分支通过共享特征学习耦合。
AI.result: 在自建RoadDistress2026细小裂缝数据集上验证，并在公开数据集Crack500与DeepCrack上进一步评测。
AI.conclusion: 以框检测与网格分类双分支共享特征学习实现路面裂缝网格定位，缓解细裂缝漏检与像素级标注依赖问题。

title: SearchChord: Prompt Preselection and Field Recomposition for One-Step Image Editing
summary: Finding effective prompts and seeds for one-step image editors requires balancing edit fidelity, source preservation, and computational cost. To address this challenge, we explore a large collection of candidate edits, where each candidate is defined by a unique prompt-seed pair, and generate corresponding images on demand. We present SearchChord, a training-free framework that leverages a large pool of such candidates, combining text-based preselection, image verification, and latent-field recomposition. Our ablation studies across pool sizes up to 200 candidates show that a pool of 100 offers a cost-effective operating point. Compared with feeding all 100 candidates into recomposition, TextSim preselects a subset of 10 candidates. Rather than uniform averaging, we incorporate image-verifier scores to weight each candidate during recomposition. Experiments on PIE-Bench and the proposed CropWeed-EditBench reveal a trade-off: candidate selection improves target-text alignment, while recomposition better preserves unmodified source content. The oracle verifier achieves the best performance in both preservation and target-text alignment. Practical verification partially recovers semantic alignment, but recomposition still compromises edit fidelity, including in agricultural image edits. These results motivate text-first preselection and stronger verification to balance preservation, fidelity, and cost. Code and data will be made publicly available.

AI.tldr: SearchChord：面向单步图像编辑的训练-free框架，通过大规模"提示-种子"候选池、文本预选（TextSim，100→10）、图像验证与潜在场重组，在保真度、源内容保持与成本间取得平衡。
AI.motivation: 为单步图像编辑寻找有效提示与种子需同时权衡编辑保真度、源内容保持与计算成本，现有方法缺乏系统性的候选搜索与组合机制。
AI.method: 构建由唯一"提示-种子"对定义的大规模候选编辑池并按需生成图像；框架包含三部分：TextSim 基于文本相似度预选（从100个候选中选10个，替代全量送入重组）、图像验证器打分、潜在场重组（以验证器分数加权，而非均匀平均）；并进行池规模消融（至200）及PIE-Bench与自建CropWeed-EditBench上的实验。
AI.result: 池规模100为成本有效工作点；候选选择提升目标文本对齐，重组更好保持未修改源内容；oracle验证器在保持与对齐两方面最优；实际验证器可部分恢复语义对齐，但重组仍损害编辑保真度（含农业图像编辑场景）；总体呈选择—重组的权衡。
AI.conclusion: 提出"文本优先预选+更强验证"的方向，以在源内容保持、编辑保真与计算成本间取得更优平衡；代码与数据将公开。

title: Hard or Mislabeled? Failure Screens Enrich Vision Benchmarks for Label Errors
summary: Hard vision benchmarks often keep images that strong classifiers get wrong. Since a classifier is also marked wrong when the label is wrong, such failure screens may collect label errors. We measure this on ImageNet's twice-relabeled validation set with 103 classifiers. Among the 1,892 images that all 66 supervised classifiers get wrong, 61% have a wrong label, versus 11.1% overall. The fewer images a screen lets through, the more of them are mislabeled, along approximately one curve. Fit on one model family, this curve predicts the screens of two held-out model families with a mean error of 2.4 percentage points, and replays of ImageNet-D's and ImageNet-Hard's screens within 0.1 and 6.3 points. On new pools, ImageNet-V2 and CIFAR-10, enrichment at the strictest screens is stronger than the curve predicts: on ImageNet-V2, by human relabeling, 67% of the images that all 66 classifiers get wrong are mislabeled, against 46% predicted. Screens that let models choose among only some of the classes, as ImageNet-A's does (200 of 1,000), fall below the curve. By ReImageNet, 32% of ImageNet-Hard's ImageNet images have no correct label. ScreenAudit, which comprises an audit tool, a script that rebuilds corrected answer sets for the 5,464 decided ImageNet-Hard images (of 5,646) from ReImageNet's gated release, and per-image audits of 1,198 benchmark images, will be released later.
