AI.tldr: 困难视觉基准筛选出的分类器失败图像中，错误标签显著富集（ImageNet验证集上61% vs 整体11.1%），该富集程度随筛选严格度沿一条可预测曲线变化，并在新数据集上表现出更强的富集；同时ImageNet-Hard中32%图像无正确标签。
AI.motivation: 困难视觉基准通常保留强分类器判错的图像，但分类器被判错也可能源于标签本身错误，因此这类"失败筛选"可能系统性收集了标签错误，需要量化这一问题。
AI.method: 在ImageNet经两次重标注的验证集上，用103个分类器（其中66个监督分类器）衡量失败筛选中的标签错误率；将错误富集与筛选通过率的关系拟合为一条曲线，并在两个留出模型族、ImageNet-D、ImageNet-Hard屏幕以及ImageNet-V2、CIFAR-10新图像池上进行验证与人工重标注检验。
AI.result: 66个监督分类器全部判错的1,892张图像中61%标签错误，而整体仅11.1%；筛选越严格，错误标签比例越高，沿近似单一曲线变化。该曲线对留出模型族的筛选预测平均误差2.4个百分点，对ImageNet-D、ImageNet-Hard屏幕复现误差分别为0.1和6.3个百分点。在新池上富集强于预测：ImageNet-V2上被66个分类器全部判错的图像经人工重标注有67%标签错误，而预测为46%。仅允许模型在部分类别中选择的筛选（如ImageNet-A的200/1000）低于曲线。按ReImageNet，ImageNet-Hard的ImageNet图像中32%无正确标签。
AI.conclusion: 困难基准的失败筛选会显著富集标签错误，且富集程度可由筛选严格度近似预测，但该曲线在更强筛选下可能低估富集，需逐图像审计；作者将发布ScreenAudit（审计工具、基于ReImageNet门控发布重建5,464张已决ImageNet-Hard图像校正答案集的脚本，以及1,198张基准图像的逐图像审计）。

title: Detecting Small Space Objects for Space Situational Awareness with Collaborative Edge AI
summary: With the rapid growth of space activities, near-Earth space is becoming increasingly congested, leading to a higher risk of spacecraft collisions and space debris generation. Recent close-proximity encounters and collision incidents necessitate efficient and cost-effective onboard systems for space object detection (SOD) and collision avoidance. While deep learning (DL) enabled Edge AI using low-cost vision sensors on single or multiple satellites has shown promises for SOD, significant challenges remain, including limited datasets, small SOD, and the lack of comprehensive performance assessments. This paper presents a collaborative Edge AI framework for multiview SOD and systematically benchmarks DL models and fusion strategies. Results show that higher image resolution significantly improves small SOD. For multiple views, image-level fusion reduces the combined communication and inference latency by 30.13% and 32.80% on average compared with feature-level and attention-based fusion across the evaluated inter-satellite link (ISL) bandwidth. For larger view sets, feature-level and attention-based fusion achieve better detection accuracy at the cost of analysis in the sensing-communication pipeline, revealing that multiview collaboration introduces minimal latency overhead under ISL constraints when reception capacity is not exceeded. Our work provides valuable design insights for future collaborative satellite network design, supporting the emerging space situational awareness and space traffic management requirements.

AI.tldr: 本文提出面向多视角空间目标检测（SOD）的协同边缘AI框架，并系统评测不同深度学习模型与融合策略；结果显示高分辨率显著提升小目标检测，图像级融合在星间链路带宽下平均降低30.13%/32.80%的通信+推理时延，而特征级与注意力级融合在更大视角集合下精度更优。
AI.motivation: 近地空间日益拥挤，航天器碰撞与空间碎片风险上升，需要低成本、高效的星载空间目标检测与避碰系统；尽管基于低成本视觉传感器的边缘AI深度学习已显示潜力，但仍面临数据集有限、小目标检测困难以及缺乏全面性能评估等挑战。
AI.method: 构建面向多视角SOD的协同边缘AI框架，在卫星端部署深度学习模型，系统性地基准测试多种DL模型与多视角融合策略（图像级、特征级、注意力级），并在不同星间链路（ISL）带宽下评测检测精度与“感知—通信—推理”流水线时延。
AI.result: 更高图像分辨率显著改善小目标检测；多视角下，图像级融合相比特征级与注意力级融合，在所评测的ISL带宽范围内平均降低通信与推理总时延30.13%与32.80%；对于更大视角集合，特征级与注意力级融合检测精度更高，但会增加感知—通信流水线分析开销，表明在接收容量未超限时多视角协同引入的时延开销极小。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为未来协同卫星网络设计提供了有价值的设计洞见，可支撑新兴的空间态势感知与空间交通管理需求。

title: AcousticBEV: Acoustic BEV Object Localization for Intelligent Vehicles
comment: Ziang Liu and Shiming Wang have equal contributions. Shiming Wang is the project lead
summary: Modern autonomous driving and driver assistance systems rely predominantly on cameras, radars and LiDARs for environmental perception. However, these modalities face different environmental limitations, including poor illumination for cameras and adverse weather for LiDAR. Acoustic sensing, particularly using microphone arrays, could provide complementary perception capabilities for autonomous driving, but has remained largely underexplored. In this work, we design a horizontally arranged microphone array that functions as the "ears" of a vehicle, enabling localization of nearby moving vehicles in a bird's-eye view (BEV) representation that captures both their relative direction and distance. Using this array, we collect a real-world driving dataset, AcousticScenes, which contains 2,117 static and 2,863 dynamic samples with synchronized spatial acoustic signals, LiDAR point clouds and 3D bounding box annotations. Building on this dataset, we propose AcousticBEV, a learning-based method for acoustic BEV object localization, which estimates the center locations of moving traffic participants in BEV from the microphone-array signals, conditioned on the ego vehicle's own speed. Experimental results demonstrate that AcousticBEV outperforms both classical signal-processing baselines and other learning-based methods, achieving F1 scores of $47.7 \pm 1.2$% on "Easy" scenarios and $45.1 \pm 1.4$% on "Difficult" cases. Our findings demonstrate that acoustic signals from a low-cost, vehicle-mounted microphone array can localize nearby moving vehicles in both azimuth and distance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出车载水平麦克风阵列作为车辆的"耳朵"，构建了同步声学-LiDAR-3D框标注数据集AcousticScenes，并提出AcousticBEV方法，从阵列信号与自车速度条件估计邻近运动车辆在BEV中的中心位置，Easy/Difficult场景F1分别达47.7±1.2%与45.1±1.4%，优于信号处理基线与其他学习方法。
AI.motivation: 现有自动驾驶感知主要依赖相机、雷达与LiDAR，各有环境局限（相机受光照影响、LiDAR受恶劣天气影响），而基于麦克风阵列的声学感知可提供互补能力，但目前研究不足。
AI.method: 设计水平布置的车载麦克风阵列；采集真实驾驶数据集AcousticScenes（2,117静态样本、2,863动态样本，含同步空间声学信号、LiDAR点云与3D框标注）；提出学习式方法AcousticBEV，以麦克风阵列信号为输入、以自车速度为条件，回归运动交通参与者在BEV下的中心位置，并与经典信号处理基线和学习式方法对比。
AI.result: AcousticBEV在Easy场景取得47.7±1.2% F1，在Difficult场景取得45.1±1.4% F1，优于经典信号处理基线与其他学习方法。
AI.conclusion: 低成本车载麦克风阵列的声学信号能够同时估计邻近运动车辆的方位角与距离，可作为自动驾驶感知的有效互补模态。

title: LC-ISP Benchmark: Learning Advanced ISP with Live and Capture Streams
summary: High-quality paired RAW-to-sRGB datasets are essential for data-driven ISP, yet existing datasets often rely on cross-device collection, causing misalignment and failing to faithfully reflect real capture conditions. We therefore introduce LC-ISP, a large-scale benchmark built from the intrinsic gap between a camera's live preview and offline capture streams. LC-ISP contains 53.9k spatially aligned groups, each comprising live RAW/live sRGB and multi-frame fused RGB/capture sRGB, and covers day, night, indoor, outdoor, and HDR scenes. It also provides capture-stream intermediates for modular supervision. We further develop a compact two-stage baseline that uses these intermediates as auxiliary targets. Under a 2.5-GFLOP budget for 448$\times$448 RAW inputs, it outperforms the strongest single-frame baseline by over 2 dB PSNR while improving texture, denoising, and color reproduction. LC-ISP supports realistic benchmarking, the design of supervision strategies, and the development of lightweight ISP models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 LC-ISP 基准数据集，利用相机实时预览流与离线拍照流之间的内在差异构建大规模配对 RAW-to-sRGB 数据，并提供两阶段轻量 ISP 基线。
AI.motivation: 现有配对 RAW-to-sRGB 数据集多采用跨设备采集，存在空间错位问题，且难以真实反映实际拍摄条件，制约了数据驱动 ISP 的研究。
AI.method: 从相机实时预览流与离线拍照流的内在差异出发构建 LC-ISP 基准：包含 53.9k 个空间对齐的数据组，每组含实时 RAW/实时 sRGB 与多帧融合 RGB/拍照 sRGB，覆盖白天、夜间、室内、室外及 HDR 场景，并提供拍照流中间结果用于模块化监督；同时设计以这些中间结果为辅助目标的两阶段紧凑型 ISP 基线。
AI.result: 在 448×448 RAW 输入、2.5-GFLOP 算力预算下，该基线相比最强单帧基线 PSNR 提升超过 2 dB，并在纹理恢复、去噪与色彩还原方面均有改善。
AI.conclusion: LC-ISP 可支撑更贴近真实条件的基准评测、监督策略设计以及轻量级 ISP 模型的研发。

title: Different Timescales, Different Signals: Multimodal Landmark-Visibility Prediction in a Long-Term Webcam Network
comment: 18 pages, 5 figures, 4 tables. Accepted to the MM4SciReal Workshop at ACCV 2026
summary: Scenic visibility is not a single forecasting problem: planning a trip months ahead, deciding whether to go outside today, and judging whether tomorrow will be clear rely on different information. Using a year-scale multimodal archive of Mount Fuji webcams and meteorological observations, we identify a clear hierarchy across timescales. Seasonal climatology provides useful long-range guidance, webcam imagery is the strongest same-day observation (AUC 0.95), and the numerical forecast valid on the target day carries most of the day-specific signal one to three days ahead. Revealing this hierarchy requires evaluation that respects the dependence among cameras observing the same regional weather state: permissive splits substantially overstate multi-day performance, while date-grouped and forward-in-time evaluation reduce the apparent contribution of the current scene and current weather. On 6,575 camera-days, the current visual summary provides no measurable one-day gain once the target-day forecast is available. The remaining opportunity lies at shorter horizons, where the present visual representation discards cloud geometry and motion. These results recast scenic visibility prediction as a multi-timescale sensing problem rather than a single multimodal forecasting task.

AI.tldr: 该论文利用富士山一年期网络摄像头与气象观测数据，揭示景区能见度预测存在跨时间尺度的信息层级：长期靠气候平均场，当天靠摄像头图像（AUC 0.95），1–3天前靠目标日数值预报；并在尊重相机间依赖关系的评估协议下重新界定各信息源的真实贡献。
AI.motivation: 景区能见度并非单一预测问题：提前数月规划、当天是否出门、次日是否晴朗所依赖的信息各不相同。现有研究常把多模态预测当作单一任务，且评估划分过于宽松，可能高估多日预测性能与当前图像/天气的贡献，因此需要一个按时间尺度分解、且评估协议严谨的分析框架。
AI.method: 构建富士山网络摄像头与气象观测的年度尺度多模态档案；按不同预测时距（当天、1–3天、长期）比较气候学季节先验、摄像头图像表征、目标日数值预报等信号源；在6,575个相机-日样本上采用日期分组（date-grouped）与前向时间（forward-in-time）划分，对照宽松随机划分以校正同一区域天气状态下多相机观测的依赖性。
AI.result: 识别出清晰的跨时间尺度信息层级：季节气候学提供有效的长程指导；摄像头图像是最强的当日观测（AUC 0.95）；目标日有效的数值预报在1–3天前承载大部分日际信号。宽松划分显著高估多日性能；在日期分组与前向评估下，当前场景与当前天气的表观贡献下降。在6,575个相机-日上，一旦获得目标日预报，当前视觉摘要不再带来可测得的一日增益。
AI.conclusion: 景区能见度预测应被重新表述为多时间尺度的感知问题，而非单一多模态预测任务；剩余提升空间集中在更短时距，当前视觉表征丢弃了云层几何与运动信息。

title: Perceptual Weight Space Programming for Diffusion Super-Resolution
summary: Diffusion models for image super-resolution can recover scene content while producing distracting artifacts or unbalanced colors. We study whether a large language model (LLM) can improve perceptual quality by editing a small subset of existing U-Net weights without a clean reference image. The proposed framework provides the editor with architecture code, selected weights, activation summaries, and sampling previews. It permits up to 1,020 candidate trials while limiting accepted changes to three layers and fewer than 0.1\% of model parameters. The evaluation protocol uses ResShift, SinSR, and SUPIR and compares GPT-6 Astra with a specified Qwen3-VL model under matched access. Feedback metrics guide editing, while separate quality metrics and blinded human comparisons evaluate the final weights. We also report an executed color calibration experiment using real photographs and two small residual networks. This experiment demonstrates correction of a fixed color shift and reveals that an improving feedback score can accompany worse performance on unseen scenes. A separate lightweight super-resolution experiment isolates modest changes in luminance detail while preserving color. The findings motivate restricted updates and independent evaluation of perceptual weight editing.

AI.tldr: 研究大语言模型能否在无干净参考图像的情况下，通过编辑少量 U-Net 权重提升扩散超分辨率的感知质量；实验表明有限权重编辑可行，但反馈分数提升可能与真实泛化性能脱钩。
AI.motivation: 扩散模型做图像超分辨率时能恢复场景内容，但会产生干扰性伪影或色彩失衡。作者希望探究：在缺乏干净参考图像的前提下，LLM 能否通过仅编辑现有 U-Net 的极少数权重来改善感知质量。
AI.method: 提出一个受限权重编辑框架：向编辑器（LLM）提供架构代码、选定权重、激活摘要和采样预览；允许最多 1020 次候选试验，但最终仅接受 3 层、少于 0.1% 模型参数的改动。评估在 ResShift、SinSR、SUPIR 上进行，比较 GPT-6 Astra 与指定 Qwen3-VL 模型（同等访问权限）。反馈指标用于指导编辑，独立的感知质量指标与盲测人工对比用于评估最终权重。另执行色彩校准实验（真实照片+两个小型残差网络）以及一个轻量超分辨率实验。
AI.result: 色彩校准实验成功纠正了固定色偏，但揭示出反馈分数上升可能伴随在未见场景上的性能下降；轻量超分辨率实验分离出亮度细节的适度改善，同时保持色彩不变。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持对感知权重编辑采取受限更新并使用独立评估，以防反馈指标与真实泛化质量脱钩。

title: PolarGait: Constructing Complementary Views from a Single Human Sketch for Gait Recognition
summary: Existing multimodal gait recognition methods exploit complementary information by fusing heterogeneous representations. Whether useful complementarity can be constructed from a single representation before fusion remains less explored. We propose PolarGait, which constructs complementary views of Human Sketch through filtering and spatial reparameterization. Filter-Oriented Sketch Decomposition (FOSD) uses Gaussian smoothing to extract coherent structures and absolute residuals to capture local response differences. Gait-Oriented Polar Transformation (GOPT) combines silhouette-guided sketch normalization, a gait-oriented center, and lower-body-biased non-uniform angular sampling to construct a polar view complementary to the Cartesian representation. Silhouette provides auxiliary global body-shape information. Experiments on CCPG, SUSTech1K, CASIA-B, and Gait3D validate the framework. Under the single-Sketch setting, FOSD+GOPT improves the original Sketch baseline by 6.6% on CCPG and 4.6% on CASIA-B. The complete PolarGait achieves Rank-1 accuracies of 87.9%, 95.2%, 96.6%, and 86.4% on the four benchmarks, respectively. These results show that complementary gait information can be constructed within a single structured representation and integrated for robust gait recognition.

AI.tldr: PolarGait 提出在融合之前从单一表示（Human Sketch）内部构造互补视图：通过高斯平滑与绝对残差分解得到结构/局部响应两个分支，并通过轮廓引导归一化、步态导向中心与下半身偏置的非均匀角度采样构建极坐标视图，在四个基准上取得领先的 Rank-1 精度。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态步态识别依赖异构表示融合来获取互补信息，但"能否在融合前从单一表示中构造有用互补性"这一问题研究不足。
AI.method: 提出 PolarGait。1) Filter-Oriented Sketch Decomposition (FOSD)：用高斯平滑提取连贯结构，用绝对残差捕获局部响应差异。2) Gait-Oriented Polar Transformation (GOPT)：结合轮廓引导的 sketch 归一化、步态导向中心以及下半身偏置的非均匀角度采样，构造与笛卡尔表示互补的极坐标视图。3) 轮廓（Silhouette）作为全局体型信息的辅助模态。
AI.result: 在 CCPG、SUSTech1K、CASIA-B、Gait3D 上验证。单 Sketch 设定下，FOSD+GOPT 较原始 Sketch 基线在 CCPG 提升 6.6%、CASIA-B 提升 4.6%。完整 PolarGait 的 Rank-1 分别为 87.9%、95.2%、96.6%、86.4%。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，互补的步态信息可以在单一结构化表示内部构造并加以整合，从而实现鲁棒的步态识别。

title: Spread Too Thin: How Higher Resolution Dilutes a Vision Transformer's Attention, and a Training-Free Rescaling
summary: A vision transformer read at a higher resolution than it was trained at spreads each attention row over many more patches, yet every row must still hand out exactly one unit of weight. A law of softmax attention predicts that a growing crowd of bounded scores dilutes the attention on any patch or register whose score stays fixed. The same law gives a remedy that needs no training: multiply every score, the sink's included, by the ratio of the logarithms of the test and training token counts. Given sufficient margins at the training resolution, this keeps the attention on a match when one is present, and on a sink such as a register when none is, though trained models need not meet those margins. We test these predictions in public vision transformers and in controlled models read far above their training token count. Attention spreads as predicted. Registers lose their share, though production models compensate in part, and the rescaling holds the share of DINOv2's registers nearly level. Applied at test time without training, the rescaling recovers part of the lost accuracy in nearly every model, with absolute or rotary positions and with registers, and on images with native detail. The calibrated multiplier rises with the logarithmic ratio on average and varies across models. Its rise is steeper than the square-root rule used in image generators; in controlled models the log ratio is also more accurate, while in the public models the two rules' accuracy difference remains unresolved. The rescaling does not restore the attention a model learned, and why it helps, beyond countering the dilution, remains open.

AI.tldr: 论文从softmax注意力"权重总和恒为1"这一法则出发，解释ViT在测试分辨率高于训练分辨率时注意力被稀释的现象，并提出一种无需训练的 rescaling 补救：将每个分数（含sink/register）乘以测试与训练token数对数之比。
AI.motivation: ViT在高分辨率下推理时，注意力行需在远多于训练时的patch上分配固定为1的权重，导致原本被关注的匹配patch或register被稀释。作者希望用纯理论（softmax稀释律）预测这一现象，并给出免训练、测试时即插即用的修正方法。
AI.method: 理论上推导：分数有界且固定时，随token数增长注意力被稀释；据此提出将全部 logits（包括sink的）乘以 log(N_test)/log(N_train) 的缩放系数。在公开ViT（DINOv2等，含absolute/rotary位置编码与registers）及可控模型上，于远超训练token数的分辨率下检验：注意力分散度、register份额、分类准确率，并与图像生成器中常用的平方根规则对比。
AI.result: 注意力按预测分散；register份额下降，量产模型部分自我补偿，而rescaling使DINOv2的register份额近乎保持水平；免训练rescaling在几乎所有模型、两种位置编码、含register及原生细节图像上均恢复部分精度损失；校准后的乘子随对数比平均上升且因模型而异，其上升快于平方根规则；可控模型中对数比更准，公开模型上两规则差异尚无定论。
AI.conclusion: softmax稀释律能定量预测高分辨率下的注意力分散并可导出有效的免训练修正；但该rescaling并不能恢复模型原本学到的注意力，"其除抵消稀释之外为何有效"仍是开放问题。

title: Robust-GCD
summary: Generalized Category Discovery (GCD) classifies an unlabeled pool that contains both known and novel classes, given labels for the known classes only. Existing GCD methods assume that every un- labeled image is clean, but unlabeled data collected in the wild is often degraded by blur, sensor noise and compression artifacts. We formalize the setting in which an unknown fraction of the unlabeled pool is corrupted by an unknown operator as Degraded Generalized Category Discovery (D-GCD). To tackle it, we propose Robust-GCD, a framework that estimates the corruption directly from the unlabeled pool and uses the estimate to build labeled anchors for known classes and pseudo-anchors for novel classes inside the corrupted region of feature space. A trust curriculum controls how much the unlabeled pool is trusted while the anchors take hold, and a paired alignment loss keeps a clean image and its corrupted twin close in feature space. Across five datasets and multiple corruption families, Robust-GCD recovers between 43% and 96% of the All accuracy that SimGCD loses under contamination, and more than 60% on four of the five datasets, with the largest gains on the corrupted images themselves.

AI.tldr: 本文提出退化广义类别发现（D-GCD）设定及 Robust-GCD 框架，直接从无标注池中估计污染并构建干净/伪锚点，配合信任课程与成对对齐损失，在五数据集多种污染下恢复 SimGCD 因污染损失的 43%–96% 的 All 精度。
AI.motivation: 现有 GCD 方法默认无标注图像均为干净的，而野外采集的无标注数据常受模糊、传感器噪声与压缩伪影干扰，导致已知类与新颖类发现性能下降，因此需要研究无标注池中被未知比例、未知算子污染的鲁棒 GCD 问题。
AI.method: 将设定形式化为 D-GCD：无标注池中未知比例样本被未知算子污染。Robust-GCD 从无标注池直接估计污染，并据此在特征空间的受污染区域为已知类构建有标注锚点、为新颖类构建伪锚点；引入信任课程控制锚点建立过程中对无标注池的信任程度；并采用成对对齐损失使干净图像与其污染孪生样本在特征空间中靠近。
AI.result: 在五个数据集和多种污染类型上，Robust-GCD 恢复了 SimGCD 在污染下所损失 All 精度的 43%–96%，其中四个数据集上超过 60%，且增益在受污染图像本身最为显著。
AI.conclusion: Robust-GCD 能有效应对未知污染下的广义类别发现，显著缓解无标注数据退化带来的性能损失，尤其改善受污染样本的聚类与分类表现。

title: Thinking from Another Side of the Box: Spacetime Images for Computer Vision
summary: Computer vision methods for video understanding, such as object detection and tracking, inherit the way videos are captured and displayed: as successive frames processed sequentially. However, a video is an inhomogeneous 2D+time volume of pixels, named voxels, and frames are only one family of cuts through it. In this frame-based representation, static backgrounds introduce computational redundancy, and motion can only be understood across several frames. In this position paper, we study another family of cuts: spacetime images (STIs), obtained by sampling any set of pixels other than frames, for instance a line of pixels followed over time. Such images are familiar in narrow forms, from line-scan inspection and kymographs to spatiotemporal slices for motion analysis, but have received little attention as a general input representation for computer vision and are often limited to (x,t) or (y,t) cuts. We define new cuts leading to STIs in their general form, explain how to read their content, and show that a family of cuts tiles the video so that existing dense annotations transfer at no cost. We also detail how motion appears in an STI, spatially and in the frequency domain, and discuss applications such as walking pedestrians, deposited objects, and dynamic scenes. Two pilot experiments illustrate the representation. The first trains a segmentation network entirely in the spacetime domain, on transferred annotations, and performs background subtraction on CDnet 2014 close to supervised frame-based methods, without explicit temporal modeling. The second recovers the pan speed of a camera as a moving cut, identified by a simple criterion on the frequency spectrum of the resulting image, turning a temporal estimation problem into the choice of a cut. Our position is not that STIs should replace frames, but that slicing the video volume is a design variable worth studying in its own right.

AI.tldr: 论文提出将视频视为非均匀的2D+时间体素，主张以时空图像（STI）这类"切片"作为一般输入表示，并给出其定义、阅读方式、标注迁移机制与频域运动分析，通过两个初步实验验证其可行性。
AI.motivation: 现有视频理解方法继承帧序列范式，导致静态背景的计算冗余，且运动需跨多帧才能理解；STI仅在(x,t)、(y,t)等窄形式中出现，缺乏作为通用输入表示的系统研究。
AI.method: 定义一般形式的时空切片并说明如何解读其内容；证明一族切片可无缝平铺视频，使稠密标注零成本迁移；刻画运动在STI中的空间域与频域表现。开展两个试点实验：（1）完全在时空域训练分割网络，做背景减除；（2）利用频谱简单判据将相机平移速度估计转化为切片选择问题。
AI.result: 实验一在CDnet 2014上的背景减除性能接近有监督的基于帧方法，且无显式时序建模；实验二通过频谱判据成功恢复相机平移速度。
AI.conclusion: 作者不主张STI取代帧，而是强调"如何切片视频体"本身是值得独立研究的设计变量。

title: ReMoVe: Refining a Video Model's Own Motion for Coherent Human Video Generation
summary: Video generation models have become increasingly capable of synthesizing realistic human motion, yet they often lose track of the very structure that makes the motion plausible. As generated human motion becomes more complex, videos can suffer from progressive body deformation and appearance drift across frames. Existing motion-controlled methods use explicit representations to stabilize generation, but typically rely on pre-defined motion sequences as references. This raises a fundamental question: if the base generator already produces a usable coarse motion, why replace it with an external one? ReMoVe answers this question by treating the coarse output as a motion hypothesis rather than a final result. ReMoVe recovers and refines the underlying motion, then renders the refined motion as 3D mesh and transfers facial appearance onto it, thereby improving motion accuracy and identity consistency. We further derive depth from the same 3D scene and camera trajectory to impose scene-level spatial consistency beyond the mesh. By jointly conditioning video generation models on mesh and depth, ReMoVe synthesizes high-quality motion videos with controllable camera trajectories and enhanced spatio-temporal consistency. Extensive experiments demonstrate that ReMoVe improves human structural stability, appearance consistency, temporal coherence, and motion-following fidelity, while retaining the base generator's motion prior and offering accurate camera control.

AI.tldr: ReMoVe将视频生成模型的粗粒度人体运动输出视为“运动假设”而非最终结果，先从粗输出中恢复并精化运动，再渲染为3D网格并迁移面部外观，同时从同一3D场景与相机轨迹导出深度图，以网格+深度联合条件化基础生成器，实现高结构稳定性、身份一致性与相机可控的人体运动视频生成。
AI.motivation: 现有运动可控视频生成方法依赖预定义运动序列作为外部参考，而基础生成器本身已能产生可用的粗粒度运动；随着运动复杂度提升，生成视频出现渐进式人体形变与跨帧外观漂移，缺乏结构约束。作者质疑“既然基座已给出可用粗运动，何必用外部运动替换它”。
AI.method: 1) 将基座生成的粗运动当作运动假设，从中恢复并精化潜在运动；2) 将精化运动渲染为3D网格，并把面部外观迁移到网格上以保持身份；3) 从同一3D场景与相机轨迹导出深度，提供网格之外的场景级空间一致性约束；4) 以网格与深度联合条件化视频生成模型，并支持可控相机轨迹。
AI.result: 实验表明ReMoVe在人体结构稳定性、外观一致性、时序连贯性与运动跟随保真度上均有提升，同时保留基座生成器的运动先验，并提供准确的相机控制。
AI.conclusion: 以“精化而非替换”基座运动先验为思路，用网格与深度的联合条件化即可有效抑制人体形变与外观漂移，实现时空一致且相机可控的高质量人体运动视频生成。

title: What Does Hard-Negative Fine-Tuning Teach Multimodal Large Language Models? Controlled Evidence from a Compositional Benchmark
summary: Fine-tuning on hard negatives is a popular way to improve the compositional reasoning of vision-language models, but when accuracy goes up it is rarely clear what the model actually learned. We ask this question for multimodal large language models. We use CompHall, 2,860 forced-choice questions (spatial, attribute, counting and part-whole) with two graded hard negatives each, three model families (LLaVA-1.5, LLaVA-NeXT and Idefics2), and controls that such studies often lack: gray-image evaluation, three seeds, option-order tests, control arms trained on different question types, and independent benchmarks. We find four things. First, CompHall is not a pure test of vision: part-whole questions can be answered from the text alone (66-95% without the image), and per-image accuracy is unrelated to an object-hallucination probe (r = -0.05), so we see no evidence that compositional failures drive hallucination. Second, the original fine-tuning method scored mostly image-placeholder tokens and hurt both LLaVA models. With a corrected loss, fine-tuning raises accuracy on the spatial-relation questions of CV-Bench in all three families, by +3.2, +23.1 and +6.0 points (averaged over both option orders). Control arms show that the gain needs spatial training questions, and for LLaVA-NeXT about two-thirds of it appears even on relation words that were only wrong options in training. Third, the gain is not general: on CompHall itself it is significant only for LLaVA-NeXT (+6.9 points) and not detectable for Idefics2, it reaches about 3 points at most on true/false statements, and LLaVA-1.5 fine-tuned on other question types learns to answer "true" too often. Fourth, both losses raise the yes-bias of LLaVA-1.5 on POPE.

AI.tldr: 论文系统检验多模态大模型在困难负样本微调后"究竟学到了什么"，发现原始方法主要训练了图像占位符token并损害LLaVA模型；修正损失后的增益高度依赖空间训练题、可部分迁移到仅作为错误选项出现的关系词，且泛化性有限、会加剧yes偏差。
AI.motivation: 困难负样本微调被广泛用于提升视觉语言模型的组合推理能力，但准确率上升时模型实际学到了什么并不清楚；且此类研究普遍缺乏有效控制实验，结论可信度存疑。
AI.method: 构建CompHall基准（2,860道强制选择题，涵盖空间、属性、计数、整体-部分四类，每题配两个分级困难负样本）；覆盖三个模型家族（LLaVA-1.5、LLaVA-NeXT、Idefics2）；设置多重控制：灰度图像评测、三个随机种子、选项顺序测试、在其他题型上训练的对照臂、独立基准（CV-Bench、POPE、真假陈述）。
AI.result: (1) CompHall并非纯视觉测试：整体-部分题可在无图情况下达66–95%正确率，逐图准确率与物体幻觉探针无关（r=-0.05），无证据显示组合失败导致幻觉；(2) 原方法主要对图像占位符token计分并损害两个LLaVA模型；修正损失后CV-Bench空间关系题分别提升+3.2、+23.1、+6.0分，且增益需空间类训练题，LLaVA-NeXT约三分之二增益出现在仅作为错误选项的关系词上；(3) 增益不具泛化性：CompHall上仅LLaVA-NeXT显著（+6.9），Idefics2不可检测，真假陈述最多约3分，LLaVA-1.5在其他题型上微调后过度输出"true"；(4) 两种损失均提高LLaVA-1.5在POPE上的yes偏差。
AI.conclusion: 困难负样本微调带来的提升更多反映任务/词汇层面的表面学习而非真正的组合视觉推理泛化能力；原有评测与方法设计需引入严格控制，且需警惕偏差放大问题。

title: PACTHub: a large-scale structured experimental dataset for three-dimensional photoacoustic computed tomography
summary: Three-dimensional photoacoustic computed tomography (PACT) provides volumetric contrast related to optical absorption for studying tissue anatomy and dynamics. Method development requires experimental datasets that retain measured signals and acquisition context. Public resources remain limited in their combined coverage of varied specimens, volumetric acquisition modes and reusable reconstruction information. Here we present PACTHub, a large-scale structured experimental dataset comprising 1,464 acquisition groups and 99,810 photoacoustic exposures collected over nearly four years. Animal, phantom and human measurements span single-position imaging, rotational compounding, panoramic scanning and time series. A common PAdata/JSON representation links acoustic signals to detector geometry, exposure selection, signal preparation and physical reconstruction coordinates. Public reconstruction implementations, numerical volumes and maximum-intensity projections provide practical entry points for reusing the measurements. Spatial and temporal examples demonstrate how retained acquisition relationships support panoramic reconstruction and regional signal analysis. Detector and exposure subsets enable studies of angular sampling and measurement budget. Volumetric evaluation combines PSNR, SSIM and L1 with Q, a complementary measure of local-contrast agreement within reference-defined structures. By connecting measured signals to reconstruction settings and numerical outputs, PACTHub makes its experimental scale and diversity available for reuse. It provides an experimental foundation for developing and evaluating artificial intelligence (AI) methods in volumetric PACT.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PACTHub，一个包含1,464个采集组、99,810次光声曝光、历时近四年的大规模结构化三维光声计算断层成像（PACT）实验数据集，并通过统一数据表示与重建输出支持AI方法开发与评估。
AI.motivation: 三维PACT方法研发需要保留实测信号与采集上下文的实验数据集，但现有公开资源在样本类型、体成像采集模式与可复用重建信息方面的覆盖仍有限。
AI.method: 构建包含动物、体模与人体测量的数据集，覆盖单点成像、旋转复合、全景扫描与时间序列；采用统一的PAdata/JSON表示，将声学信号与探测器几何、曝光选择、信号预处理及物理重建坐标关联；提供公开重建实现、数值体数据与最大强度投影；设计检测器与曝光子集以支持角度采样与测量预算研究；结合PSNR、SSIM、L1及局部对比一致性指标Q进行体数据评估。
AI.result: 数据规模为1,464个采集组与99,810次曝光；空间与时序示例表明保留的采集关系可支撑全景重建与区域信号分析；子集实验可研究角度采样与测量预算影响；重建输出与多维评估指标为复用提供实用入口。
AI.conclusion: PACTHub将实测信号与重建设置及数值输出相连接，使其实验规模与多样性可供复用，为三维PACT中AI方法的开发与评估提供实验基础。

title: UMM-JEPA: Generative Pretraining via Masked Next-Scale Representation Prediction for Unified Multimodal Models
summary: Unified multimodal models can support both visual understanding and generation, yet generative training does not necessarily improve understanding. We argue that this limitation may arise from a mismatch between the representation targeted by generation and the perceptual representation used for understanding. Conventional generation objectives primarily optimize synthesis-oriented spaces such as discrete visual codes or generative latents. We therefore introduce UMM-JEPA, which reformulates generation as progressive prediction of continuous visual-understanding representations. The model constructs a multi-scale representation hierarchy from coarse to fine, while pixel rendering is decoupled from representation pretraining and attached only afterward. Controlled comparisons show that the representation-prediction objective accounts for most of the understanding improvement, while a data-matched control leaves the group means nearly unchanged. UMM-JEPA reaches a 16-benchmark visual mean of 51.71, against 46.36 for the understanding-only Qwen-VL baseline, and the text mean also rises. Compared with discrete-code and latent-flow generation objectives, perceptual representation prediction yields stronger and more consistent transfer to understanding. Linear probes and visual-evidence interventions further reveal richer object and spatial structure and stronger use of image-specific information. These results suggest that generation can benefit understanding when it directly supervises the perceptual representations that understanding consumes.

AI.tldr: 提出UMM-JEPA，将生成重构为对连续视觉理解表征的渐进预测，从而让生成训练真正提升多模态理解。
AI.motivation: 统一多模态模型的生成训练未必提升理解能力。作者认为根源在于生成目标所优化的表征空间（离散视觉码或生成隐空间）与理解所依赖的感知表征之间存在错配。
AI.method: UMM-JEPA将生成任务重新表述为对连续视觉理解表征的渐进式预测；构建由粗到细的多尺度表征层级；像素渲染与表征预训练解耦，仅在之后接上。并设置受控对比与数据匹配对照组进行消融分析。
AI.result: 表征预测目标贡献了大部分理解提升，数据匹配对照组的组均值几乎不变。UMM-JEPA在16个视觉基准上均值为51.71，优于仅理解的Qwen-VL基线46.36，文本均值亦提升。相较离散码与隐流生成目标，感知表征预测带来更强且更一致的迁移。线性探针与视觉证据干预显示更丰富的物体/空间结构和更强的图像特定信息利用。
AI.conclusion: 当生成直接监督理解所消费的感知表征时，生成可以促进理解；表征对齐而非合成目标空间是关键。

title: VidEngram: Agentic Long-Term Video Understanding via Structured Hierarchical Memory
comment: 10 pages, 4 figures, 4 tables. Demo video and code are linked in the paper
summary: Long-video question answering is wasteful and lossy when a multimodal model must re-encode the same video for every query: context limits force sparse sampling or truncation, and no reusable representation remains for later questions. We present VidEngram, an agentic video QA system that builds a persistent hierarchical memory once at ingest and answers later questions from that memory. VidEngram captions video and audio jointly with Qwen2.5-Omni, consolidates segment memories into episode and entity layers, and uses a text-only agentic planner with specialized retrieval tools to produce grounded answers. The web interface makes this process inspectable: users can watch memory formation, inspect retrieval traces, verify cited evidence in the video player, and explore entity relationships. On the full OmniVideoBench, VidEngram with a GPT-5-mini planner outperforms a strong single-pass Qwen2.5-Omni baseline (37.0% vs. 32.3%), with gains concentrated on longer videos where single-pass coverage becomes sparse. Because perception is paid once, subsequent queries use low-cost text-only planning.

AI.tldr: VidEngram是一个智能体式长视频问答系统：在一次录入时构建持久的分层视频记忆，后续问答基于该记忆与文本智能体规划器检索作答，在OmniVideoBench上以37.0%超过单遍Qwen2.5-Omni基线（32.3%）。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态模型对每个查询重复编码同一视频，既浪费又信息有损：上下文限制迫使稀疏采样或截断，且不保留可复用的表示供后续问题使用。
AI.method: 一次性摄入阶段用Qwen2.5-Omni联合生成视频与音频的解说（caption），将分段记忆整合为episode层与实体层，构成分层持久记忆；问答阶段由纯文本智能体规划器调用专用检索工具生成有依据的答案；并提供可检查的Web界面，支持观察记忆形成、检索轨迹、在播放器中核验引用证据及实体关系探索。
AI.result: 在完整OmniVideoBench上，采用GPT-5-mini规划器的VidEngram达37.0%，优于强单遍Qwen2.5-Omni基线的32.3%；提升集中在单遍覆盖变稀疏的长视频上。
AI.conclusion: 由于感知只付费一次，后续查询仅需低成本文本规划；将感知与推理解耦的持久分层记忆是长视频问答的有效范式，并提供可解释的检索与证据核验能力。

title: Vegetation Health Classification for Low-Data and Edge Hardware Deployment
summary: Unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) equipped with cameras are popular, viable tools for vegetation and environmental health monitoring. However, existing image classification methods are incompatible with UAV implementation for independent practitioners in remote, resource-constrained environments due to large dataset requirements, GPU hardware, inflexible retraining, and low interpretability. This paper presents a lightweight, interpretable vegetation classification algorithm operating with as few as five reference images per class, without GPUs or heavy machine learning frameworks. It uses a 2D hue-saturation histogram feature representation and Earth Mover's Distance or Quadratic Form Distance, paired with a log-likelihood probability score, to classify images into three vegetation health categories. We evaluated six systems: three custom pipelines and three established models across low-data scenarios ($n = 5, 10, 25$) and a full-data regime of 2,172 drone images from 28 South American locations. Our custom pipelines achieve competitive Top-1 accuracy (81--85\%) under low-data constraints, maintaining sub-1ms inference times that enable real-time classification and subsequently tasks such as seeding and watering. The algorithms also support incremental retraining without full model reconstruction. We validate edge feasibility by deploying the QFD variant on an ESP32 microcontroller, achieving 82.8\% accuracy with 1.01\% heap memory utilization (45kb), demonstrating that effective vegetation classification is achievable on low-cost, low-power embedded hardware without cellular connectivity.

AI.tldr: 提出轻量可解释的植被健康分类算法，仅需每类5张参考图、无需GPU，基于2D色调-饱和度直方图特征与EMD/QFD距离配对数似然评分，低数据下Top-1准确率81–85%、推理<1ms，并成功部署于ESP32（82.8%准确率，占用45kb堆内存）。
AI.motivation: 现有图像分类方法依赖大数据集、GPU硬件、僵化的重训练流程且可解释性差，难以被偏远资源受限环境中的独立从业者用于无人机植被与环境健康监测。
AI.method: 采用2D色调-饱和度（H-S）直方图作为特征表示，结合推土机距离（EMD）或二次型距离（QFD），并配对数似然概率评分，将图像分为三类植被健康状况；与3种自建流程和3种成熟模型在n=5/10/25低数据及2172张全量数据（28个南美地点）上对比评估，并将QFD变体部署到ESP32微控制器。
AI.result: 自建流程在低数据约束下取得具竞争力的Top-1准确率（81–85%），推理时间低于1ms，支持实时分类及后续播种、灌溉等任务；支持无需完整重建模型的增量重训练；ESP32部署达82.8%准确率，堆内存占用仅1.01%（45kb）。
AI.conclusion: 有效的植被分类可在低成本、低功耗、无蜂窝网络的嵌入式硬件上实现，适合资源受限条件下的无人机部署。

title: Ref-MIL: Plug-and-Play Posterior Refinement for Multiple Instance Learning in QSM-Based Brain Disease Classification
summary: Quantitative susceptibility mapping (QSM) is a novel quantitative MRI contrast for studying tissue susceptibility changes in brain disorders, including Parkinson's disease (PD) and multiple sclerosis (MS). However, small cohorts and the lack of local annotations make developing deep learning models for QSM-based diagnosis challenging. In this work, we propose PoRef-MIL, a weakly supervised multiple instance learning (MIL) framework combining iterative slice relabeling and network retraining with a plug-and-play posterior refinement module (PRM). During training, a 2D dual-branch diagnosis network and a subject-level classifier were alternately trained for five rounds. The classifier was used to update slice pseudo-labels for retraining the diagnosis network. The PRM was applied during inference to refine slice probabilities through bidirectional posterior inference and calculate entropy-derived confidence from the refined probabilities, which was then used in sliding-window scoring to obtain subject-level predictions. PoRef-MIL was evaluated on an in-house PD cohort of 287 participants and a public MS cohort of 150 participants. Compared with eight classification methods, PoRef-MIL achieved the highest mean areas under the receiver operating characteristic curve of 0.942 and 0.872, and accuracies of 0.926 and 0.833, for PD and MS classification, respectively. Ablation experiments were conducted to validate the effectiveness of iterative relabeling and PRM, and the plug-and-play feature of the proposed PRM was also evaluated using four state-of-the-art MIL models. Overall, PoRef-MIL offers a promising approach to QSM-based disease classification in small cohorts without manual slice annotations.

AI.tldr: 提出弱监督多实例学习框架PoRef-MIL，通过迭代切片重标注与即插即用后验细化模块（PRM），在无需切片级标注的小样本QSM数据上实现帕金森病与多发性硬化的高精度分类。
AI.motivation: QSM是研究帕金森病（PD）和多发性硬化（MS）等脑部疾病组织磁化率变化的定量MRI对比，但小样本队列及缺乏局部（切片级）标注使基于QSM的深度学习诊断模型难以开发。
AI.method: 将问题建模为弱监督MIL：训练中交替训练2D双分支诊断网络与受试者级分类器共五轮，由分类器更新切片伪标签以重训练诊断网络；推理时应用PRM，经双向后验推断细化切片概率，并由细化概率计算熵置信度，用于滑窗打分得到受试者级预测。
AI.result: 在287例自建PD队列与150例公开MS队列上评估，PD与MS分类的平均AUC分别达0.942和0.872，准确率分别为0.926和0.833，优于八种对比方法；消融实验验证了迭代重标注与PRM的有效性，并在四种先进MIL模型上验证了PRM的即插即用特性。
AI.conclusion: PoRef-MIL为无需人工切片标注的小队列QSM疾病分类提供了有前景的方案。

title: EviRef: Evidence-Specific Memories for Logical Anomaly Detection across Capture Conditions
summary: Logical anomalies arise when every component looks normal but their combination violates the scene rules. In practical inspection, these rules must hold under varying backgrounds, illumination, and imaging quality, with only a few dozen normal images per scene, whereas existing methods couple normality with appearance and merge different constraints into one reference. We model logical normality as decomposable constraints and propose EviRef, a training-free method that builds a separate reference memory for each family of evidence. Component prototypes built once per scene parse images under any capture condition into one label space, on which occupancy and relation constraints are verified. Semantic constraints are verified with whole-image embeddings independent of parsing, and additional evidence such as text is admitted through a task-level gate without modifying existing memories. On VID-AD, EviRef attains a mean image-level area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROC) of 92.1% (88.9% with visual evidence alone), the highest among the compared methods under each of five capture conditions, with a standard deviation of 0.5. Even with memories built from only 20 normal images per task, it surpasses all compared methods that use 50 normal images per task.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练方法EviRef，将逻辑异常检测的正性建模为可分解约束，为每类证据建立独立参考记忆，在VID-AD上取得92.1%图像级AUROC，且在每任务仅20张正常图像时仍超越使用50张的对比方法。
AI.motivation: 逻辑异常中每个部件看似正常但组合违反场景规则；实际检测需在背景、光照、成像质量变化下保持规则，且每场景仅有数十张正常图像；现有方法将正性与外观耦合，并把不同约束混入单一参考，导致泛化与可解释性不足。
AI.method: 将逻辑正性建模为可分解约束：每场景一次性构建组件原型，把任意拍摄条件下的图像解析到统一标签空间，并在其上验证占用与关系约束；语义约束用与解析无关的整图嵌入验证；文本等额外证据通过任务级门控接入而不修改已有记忆；整体为免训练、按证据族分别构建参考记忆。
AI.result: VID-AD上图像级平均AUROC 92.1%（仅视觉证据88.9%），在五种拍摄条件下均为对比方法中最高，标准差0.5；每任务仅20张正常图像构建记忆即超过使用50张的对比方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过解耦式多证据参考与免训练设计，可有效实现跨成像条件的鲁棒逻辑异常检测，并显著降低对正常样本数量的依赖。

title: DEFDVO: Deformable Deep Visual Odometry for Equirectangular Images
summary: Omnidirectional ($360^\circ$) cameras capture the full surrounding scene in every frame, providing a strong advantage for visual odometry (VO) over pinhole sensors with a limited field of view. However, their equirectangular projection (ERP) introduces latitude-dependent distortion, an artificial seam at the image border, and a sampling bias toward the poles. Existing $360^\circ$ VO methods address these challenges only partially. DEFDVO closes this gap with a patch-based deep VO method that operates directly on ERP imagery, combining spherically initialized deformable feature extraction, end-to-end seam-aware estimation, and spherical-gradient patch selection. The deformable feature extractor combines spherical geometric priors with learned sampling offsets, while seam-aware processing preserves ERP continuity, and spherical-gradient selection reduces polar sampling bias. Trained exclusively on synthetic TartanAirV2 ERP imagery, DEFDVO improves the best prior average absolute trajectory error (ATE) by $4.8\times$ (0.201 m to 0.042 m) on the TartanAirV2 evaluation set defined by 360DVO and achieves the lowest average ATE on both splits of the real-world 360DVO benchmark. Code is available at https://github.com/BurakSevsay/DEFDVO

AI.tldr: DEFDVO：一种直接在 ERP 全景图上运行的块级深度视觉里程计方法，用球形先验可变形特征提取、端到端接缝感知处理与球面梯度块选择，解决纬度畸变、图像接缝和极点采样偏置，仅用合成数据训练即在 TartanAirV2 与真实 360DVO 基准上取得显著最优轨迹精度。
AI.motivation: 360°相机单帧覆盖全场景，视野优势明显，但 ERP 投影带来三类固有缺陷：随纬度变化的畸变、图像边界处的人为接缝、以及两极区域过采样/偏置。现有 360° VO 方法仅部分处理这些问题，缺乏系统性解决方案。
AI.method: 基于块的深度 VO，直接作用于 ERP 图像，包含三个组件：(1) 球面初始化可变形特征提取——将球面几何先验与可学习采样偏移结合；(2) 接缝感知的端到端估计——保持 ERP 左右边界连续性；(3) 球面梯度块选择——缓解极点采样偏置。仅在合成 TartanAirV2 ERP 数据上训练。
AI.result: 在 360DVO 定义的 TartanAirV2 评测集上，平均绝对轨迹误差（ATE）由最优先前方法 0.201 m 降至 0.042 m，提升约 4.8×；在真实世界 360DVO 基准两个划分上均取得最低平均 ATE。
AI.conclusion: 将球面几何先验嵌入可变形采样、结合接缝感知与球面梯度块选择，可在不依赖真实训练数据的情况下有效克服 ERP 投影缺陷，使 360° 视觉里程计精度大幅超越现有方法并具备良好真实场景泛化性。

title: Role-Separated Diffusion Transformers: Global Rule Isolation and Deterministic Sampling Manifold Compression
comment: 10 pages, 5 figures, 3 tables. Github Repo: https://github.com/lz7fd/RoSeDiT
summary: We present Role-Separated Diffusion Transformers (RoSeDiT), a new diffusion transformer architecture that isolates the global rule from the image tokens. RoSeViT showed in visual reasoning that a vanilla ViT spreads a shared rule over all $L$ tokens at an entropy of order $Ld$, whereas an enforced controller route reduces it to order $d$. In class-conditional DiT and SiT, the class and the noise level are explicitly conditioned by adaLN, so a RoSeViT-style controller channel on the ViT side is insufficient to establish the full role separation. By introducing the adaLN listening mechanism, which makes adaLN compute under the controller's command, RoSeDiT brings the entropy theorem and role separation into the latent diffusion domain. Under the same SiT training and evaluation protocol at the same level of parameter count, RoSeDiT surpasses SiT at all four model scales at 400K steps, and RoSeDiT-L/2 even surpasses SiT-XL/2's 17.2 FID with 15.34 and 32% fewer parameters. RoSeDiT-XL/2 surpasses SiT-XL/2's 7M-step FID of 8.3 at 1.4M steps with 7.98, using one-fifth as many training steps. We further observe that models with the same denoising loss can have a large FID gap, which indicates a misalignment between the denoising objective and the image manifold. We formalize this phenomenon into Deterministic Sampling Manifold Compression (DSMC), a two-stage training schedule with which RoSeDiT-XL/2 surpasses SiT + REPA's 4M-step FID of 5.9 at 2.4M steps with 5.84.

AI.tldr: 提出角色分离扩散变换器RoSeDiT，通过adaLN listening机制将"全局规则-图像token角色分离"引入潜空间扩散，以更少参数和训练步数超越SiT，并提出DSMC训练策略。
AI.motivation: RoSeViT在视觉推理中表明，vanilla ViT会把共享规则散布到全部L个token上，熵为O(Ld)量级，而强制控制器路径可将其降至O(d)。但类条件DiT/SiT中类别与噪声水平已由adaLN显式条件化，仅在ViT侧添加RoSeViT式控制器通道不足以实现完整角色分离，因此需要让adaLN本身受控制器指挥。
AI.method: 引入adaLN listening机制，使adaLN在控制器指令下进行计算，从而把熵定理与角色分离带入潜扩散域；在相同SiT训练/评估协议、相同参数量下对比四个模型尺度；并观察到相同去噪损失下FID差异大，将其形式化为"确定性采样流形压缩"(DSMC)两阶段训练调度。
AI.result: 400K步时，RoSeDiT在四个尺度上均超越SiT；RoSeDiT-L/2以少32%的参数取得15.34 FID，超过SiT-XL/2的17.2；RoSeDiT-XL/2在1.4M步取得7.98 FID，超过SiT-XL/2在7M步的8.3，训练步数仅为五分之一；结合DSMC后，XL/2在2.4M步取得5.84，超过SiT+REPA在4M步的5.9。
AI.conclusion: 角色分离结构结合adaLN listening可显著提升扩散变换器的训练效率与生成质量；去噪目标与图像流形间存在错位，DSMC两阶段调度可缓解该问题。

title: Same Evidence, Different Verdicts: Delivery of CT Images and DICOM Metadata Changes VLM Quality-Control Decisions
comment: 4 pages, 2 figures, 1 table. Submitted to IEEE ISBI 2027
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) are being proposed as automated checks on clinical imaging inputs, where a scan and its DICOM metadata can disagree; a truncated CT series wrongly admitted to volumetric follow-up, such as lung-nodule growth assessment in screening, biases the measurement. A natural safeguard is to let the model judge the image before it sees the metadata. We find this backfires. On 60 NLST chest CT pairs with coverage defects whose ground truth is computed from scan geometry, a false header that Claude Haiku 5.5 resisted when shown with the image (2% of its detections overruled) overturned 91% of them when it arrived after the model's answer (Nemotron-3.5-VL 43% to 100%). With the order reversed, the image overturned 98-100% of the header's errors (Claude models): whichever source came second won. This is not generic sycophancy: a neutral "please confirm" reversed 0 of 1,072 correct refusals, and the effect persisted when the header arrived as a tool result, as in agentic pipelines. One warning sentence cut sequential reversal to at most 9%, and the pattern held on 24 real mismatched pairs. Contributions: (i) evidence that VLM input-check decisions on identical evidence depend on delivery; (ii) a testbed with exact geometric ground truth; (iii) a validation protocol for clinical VLM input checks. Code, prompts and all call logs: https://github.com/nav92061/ct-vlm-delivery-order

AI.tldr: 视觉语言模型（VLM）作为临床影像输入的自动校验器时，对完全相同的证据会因信息交付顺序不同而得出相反结论：后到的信息几乎总能推翻先前的判断。
AI.motivation: 临床CT扫描与其DICOM元数据可能不一致（如截断的CT序列被错误纳入体积随访，影响肺结节生长评估）。自然的防护措施是让模型先看图像、再看元数据以进行独立判断，作者希望验证这一"先图像后元数据"策略是否真能提升鲁棒性。
AI.method: 构建基于60对NLST胸部CT、带有覆盖缺陷且以扫描几何精确计算真值的测试床；对比两种交付顺序（图像+错误头信息 vs. 头信息后置）；设置中性确认、工具返回结果（agentic流水线）、真实失配配对（24对）等多种对照，并测试警告语句的缓解效果。
AI.result: 错误头信息与图像同时呈现时，Claude Haiku 5.5仅2%检测被推翻；但头信息后置时91%被推翻（Nemotron-3.5-VL从43%升至100%）。反转顺序后，Claude模型图像的纠错率达98–100%。该效应非泛化谄媚：中性"请确认"未推翻任何1,072次正确拒绝；仅一句警告即将顺序反转率降至≤9%，且在24对真实失配样本上模式一致。
AI.conclusion: VLM输入校验决策依赖信息交付顺序而非证据本身，构成临床部署风险。贡献为：(i) 交付方式影响判断的证据；(ii) 具备精确几何真值的测试床；(iii) 面向临床VLM输入校验的验证协议。作者认为"先图像后元数据"的防护直觉会适得其反。

title: Agri-MRAG: Parameter-Enhanced Multimodal Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Agricultural Visual Question Answering
summary: Multimodal Retrieval-Augmented Generation (MRAG) has shown promise for Agricultural Visual Question Answering (Agri-VQA), but existing methods still face challenges in retrieving relevant knowledge while avoiding redundancy and in integrating retrieved evidence beyond simple prompt concatenation. To address these issues, we propose Agri-MRAG, a multimodal retrieval-augmented framework for agricultural VQA. Specifically, we first introduce a semantic-consistency-guided clustering mechanism that combines multimodal clustering and weighted relevance scoring to select high-confidence knowledge subsets and adaptively determine the retrieval size $k$. We then design a parameterized knowledge injection strategy, where retrieved agricultural knowledge is encoded into LoRA adapters and merged into the feed-forward network (FFN) layers of the MLLM, allowing external knowledge to influence generation through parameter-level adaptation. In addition, a perplexity-guided (PPL-guided) routing mechanism is employed to switch between implicit parametric reasoning and explicit retrieval-assisted generation according to model uncertainty, balancing inference efficiency and answer reliability. For evaluation, we use PlantVillageVQA as a broad agricultural benchmark and construct PlantVQA, a region-specific forestry and fruit crop VQA dataset containing 7,514 images and 15,028 expert-verified question-answer pairs. Experiments show that Agri-MRAG achieves ROUGE-L scores of 41.21 and 46.58 on the two datasets, outperforming mRAG by 11.70 and 4.51 points, and VisRAG by 8.80 and 3.39 points, respectively.

AI.tldr: 提出Agri-MRAG多模态检索增强框架，用于农业视觉问答，通过聚类筛选知识、参数化注入与困惑度路由提升性能。
AI.motivation: 现有MRAG用于农业VQA时存在两方面不足：一是检索相关知识时难以兼顾相关性与冗余控制；二是对检索证据的整合仅停留在简单的提示拼接层面，外部知识未能深度参与生成。
AI.method: (1) 语义一致性引导的聚类机制：结合多模态聚类与加权相关性打分，筛选高置信知识子集并自适应确定检索规模k；(2) 参数化知识注入：将检索到的农业知识编码为LoRA适配器并融合进MLLM的前馈网络(FFN)层，实现参数级外部知识适配；(3) 困惑度(PPL)引导的路由机制：依据模型不确定性在隐式参数推理与显式检索辅助生成之间切换，兼顾推理效率与答案可靠性。评估上以PlantVillageVQA为通用基准，并自建区域性林果作物数据集PlantVQA（7,514图像、15,028专家核验问答对）。
AI.result: 在两数据集上ROUGE-L分别为41.21与46.58，较mRAG提升11.70与4.51分，较VisRAG提升8.80与3.39分。
AI.conclusion: Agri-MRAG通过自适应知识选择、参数级知识注入与不确定性路由，有效缓解冗余检索与浅层拼接问题，在农业VQA任务上显著优于现有MRAG基线，并贡献了新的区域性基准数据集PlantVQA。

title: StyleJudge: A Human-Validated, In-Context-Learning Vision-Language Evaluator for Artistic Style Transfer
summary: Automatic evaluation of artistic style transfer remains an open problem: existing metrics score an image pair in isolation, without seeing an example of the intended style transformation, and correlate poorly with human judgment. We introduce StyleJudge, a compact vision-language evaluator conditioned on a small set of reference source-to-stylized pairs before scoring a query pair, mirroring how a human rater calibrates to a style before judging a candidate. On a human-annotated benchmark of 878 rated pairs across 12 artistic styles (728 from 10 training/validation styles, 150 from 2 unseen styles), our efficient 0.8B-parameter StyleJudge reaches a Pearson correlation of 0.291 (Spearman 0.325) with human ratings on seen styles and 0.381 on unseen ones. On seen styles, it achieves the highest positive correlation among tested metrics: Gram-matrix style loss and CLIP similarity correlate weakly ($r=0.041$, $r=0.168$), while LPIPS (scored higher when closer to the source) correlates negatively ($r=-0.404$). We achieve this by distilling evaluation knowledge from a 72B-parameter vision-language teacher used only during training, which reaches $r=0.327$, confirming that most of its human alignment survives compact distillation. For training, we build a dataset of source-to-stylized pairs across the 12 styles via LoRA-adapted diffusion, densified with graded intermediate examples from a high-resolution image-morphing pipeline so the evaluator recognizes partial and complete stylization. On two held-out validation styles, StyleJudge reaches 28.2% exact-match agreement with its teacher's structured scores versus 1.1% for the untuned base model, with 67.8% shorter reasoning traces, and scores a pair in 39 s (median) using 2.5 GB of GPU memory on one NVIDIA T4. We release the human-rating benchmark, annotation guideline, SDXL-adapted FreeMorph code, and model weights.

AI.tldr: StyleJudge：一个以少量参考源图-风格化图对为条件的小型视觉语言评估器（0.8B），通过从72B教师模型蒸馏评估知识，在878对人工评分基准上与人类判断的相关性优于现有风格迁移指标。
AI.motivation: 现有艺术风格迁移的自动评估指标存在两个问题：一是孤立地为图像对打分，不参考目标风格变换的示例；二是与人类判断的相关性较差。作者希望模仿人类评分者先校准风格、再评判候选的方式。
AI.method: 提出StyleJudge：条件化于少量参考源图-风格化图对后再对查询对打分。仅训练时使用72B视觉语言教师模型进行知识蒸馏。训练数据由LoRA适配扩散模型在12种风格上生成源图-风格化图对，并用高分辨率图像形变流水线补充分级中间样本，使评估器能识别部分与完整风格化。在878对、12种风格的人工标注基准（728对来自10个训练/验证风格，150对来自2个未见风格）上评测。
AI.result: 0.8B的StyleJudge在已见风格上Pearson相关0.291（Spearman 0.325），未见风格上0.381，为测试指标中最高正相关；Gram矩阵风格损失r=0.041、CLIP相似度r=0.168均较弱，LPIPS（越接近源图分越高）为负相关r=-0.404。72B教师达r=0.327，表明大部分人类对齐性在紧凑蒸馏后保留。在两个留出验证风格上，与教师结构化分数精确匹配率28.2%（未调优基座1.1%），推理轨迹缩短67.8%；单对评分中位39秒，单张NVIDIA T4上占用2.5 GB显存。
AI.conclusion: 参考示例条件化+大模型蒸馏可实现紧凑、高效且更贴合人类判断的风格迁移评估器；作者开源人工评分基准、标注指南、SDXL适配的FreeMorph代码与模型权重。

title: Few-Shot Visual Concept Extraction for Steering Diffusion Transformers
summary: Image steering aims to provide fine-grained control over concepts in generated images, enabling targeted and continuous manipulation without broadly altering the generation process. Recent steering methods for diffusion models primarily focus on the text-conditioning space or rely on costly auxiliary training. Deviating from that, we here propose a novel steering approach that extracts visual concept directions directly from the image-side activations of Diffusion Transformers. Specifically, we showcase few-shot concept extraction in the activation space using a simple difference-of-means estimator over intermediate residuals. We observe (a) scene-level concepts such as lighting, weather, and style are distributed across image tokens, as well as (b) local concepts such as object colors, textures, materials, and facial attributes are concentrated in specific regions. Towards controlling both concepts, we introduce a new unified training-free framework that uses global difference-of-means for (a) distributed concepts and masked difference-of-means for (b) local concepts, preventing local signals from being diluted by global averaging. Notably, using only a handful of positive and negative prompt pairs, our method identifies and extracts reusable concept directions that can be injected at inference for continuous steering. Quantitatively, our method outperforms text-encoder steering and training-free activation-editing baselines, as well as is competitive with specialized editing models. Our results suggest that as concept directions can be applied at patch level, our method enables precise targeted and compositional steering, manipulating multiple concepts in the same image.

AI.tldr: 提出一种从Diffusion Transformer图像侧激活中提取视觉概念方向的免训练引导方法，用全局/掩码difference-of-means分别处理分布式与局部概念，实现精确、可组合的连续图像调控。
AI.motivation: 现有扩散模型引导方法主要作用于文本条件空间，或依赖昂贵的辅助训练，难以对图像概念进行细粒度、连续且精确的控制。
AI.method: 从Diffusion Transformer的图像侧激活（中间残差）中直接提取概念方向：用少量正负prompt对，通过difference-of-means估计器做少样本概念提取；对分布式场景级概念（光照、天气、风格）采用全局difference-of-means，对集中于特定区域的局部概念（物体颜色、纹理、材质、人脸属性）采用掩码difference-of-means，避免局部信号被全局平均稀释；提取的可复用方向在推理时注入，支持patch级组合调控，全程免训练。
AI.result: 在定量指标上优于文本编码器引导与免训练激活编辑基线，并与专门编辑模型相当；patch级方向注入支持同图多概念的精确组合引导。
AI.conclusion: 图像侧激活空间蕴含可线性提取的概念方向，且概念的空间分布特性（分布vs.局部）决定了应采用的估计策略；该免训练框架实现了精确、可组合、连续的图像概念控制。

title: Memorization Lives in a Few Attention Heads: Mitigating Memorization in Diffusion Models via Projection-Based Suppression
summary: Diffusion models can memorize and reproduce training samples during inference, raising serious privacy and copyright concerns. Existing inference-time mitigation methods often suppress conditional information globally, which may reduce memorization but can also harm semantic alignment and image quality. In this paper, we revisit memorization from the perspective of cross-attention heads. Through systematic analysis and targeted ablation, we find that memorization is mainly driven by a small subset of shallow-layer attention heads with abnormally strong semantic control, rather than by the entire cross-attention mechanism. Motivated by this finding, we propose Projection-based Top-k Attention Head Suppression, a targeted inference-time mitigation method. Our method first identifies the top-k attention heads most related to memorization using a semantic-control score, and then removes their condition-specific components through directional projection between conditional and unconditional representations. This design selectively weakens memorization-related features while preserving useful semantic information. Extensive experiments on different diffusion models and datasets show that our method effectively reduces memorization and achieves a better trade-off between memorization mitigation and image quality than existing approaches.

AI.tldr: 论文从交叉注意力头视角重新审视扩散模型的记忆现象，发现记忆主要由浅层少数具有异常强语义控制力的注意力头驱动，据此提出基于投影的Top-k注意力头抑制方法，在推理阶段有选择性地削弱记忆特征，实现记忆缓解与图像质量之间更优的权衡。
AI.motivation: 扩散模型在推理时会记忆并复现训练样本，带来隐私与版权风险。现有推理时缓解方法往往全局抑制条件信息，虽能降低记忆，却损害语义对齐与图像质量，缺乏对记忆产生机制的精确定位。
AI.method: 先将记忆问题归因到交叉注意力头层面，通过系统分析与针对性消融，用语义控制分数识别与记忆最相关的top-k注意力头（主要为浅层头）；再通过条件表示与无条件表示之间的方向投影，移除这些头的条件特定成分，从而选择性削弱记忆相关特征而保留有用语义信息。
AI.result: 在多种扩散模型与数据集上的大量实验表明，该方法能有效降低记忆复现，且在记忆缓解与图像质量之间取得优于现有方法的权衡。
AI.conclusion: 记忆并非均匀分布于整个交叉注意力机制，而是集中于浅层少数强语义控制头；针对这些头的定向抑制是一种高效、低损伤的推理时记忆缓解策略。

title: SplatFlow3D: Learning Scene Flow via 3D Motion Feature Splatting
summary: Considering the motion continuity and stability of 3D objects over short inter-frame intervals, introducing multi-frame settings in scene flow estimation can potentially address occlusion. In this paper, we propose a two-frame backbone, SimpleFlow3D, which integrates dense information from the image plane and sparse information from the depth dimension in a decoupling-followed-by-coupling manner by hierarchically constructing the 3D motion feature. SimpleFlow3D achieves SOTA results with minimal parameters. We also propose a weight-sharing multi-frame framework to splat the previous 3D motion feature to the current estimation process. The framework unifies the first and non-first frame inference by constructing pseudo inputs. After combining the proposed framework and backbone, the newly born multi-frame method SplatFlow3D further advances the state of the art. It achieves lower errors than the two-frame backbone, with fewer parameters than current methods. On both KITTI and Spring, SplatFlow3D ranked 1st over all published and submitted methods. Experiments show that SplatFlow3D improves occlusion handling, non-rigid motion estimation, and generalization to real-world scenes. Code is available at https://github.com/wwsource/SplatFlow3D.

AI.tldr: 提出两帧主干SimpleFlow3D与权重共享多帧框架SplatFlow3D，通过将前一帧3D运动特征splat到当前估计来缓解遮挡，在KITTI与Spring上取得第一。
AI.motivation: 利用3D物体在短帧间隔内的运动连续性与稳定性，引入多帧设置以缓解场景流估计中的遮挡问题。
AI.method: 1) SimpleFlow3D主干：以"先解耦后耦合"方式分层构建3D运动特征，融合图像平面的稠密信息与深度维度的稀疏信息；2) 权重共享多帧框架：将前一帧3D运动特征splat到当前帧估计过程，并通过构造伪输入统一首帧与非首帧推理。
AI.result: SimpleFlow3D以极少参数量达到SOTA；两者结合后的SplatFlow3D误差低于两帧主干，参数量少于现有方法，在KITTI与Spring上于所有已发表及提交方法中排名第一。
AI.conclusion: SplatFlow3D改善了遮挡处理、非刚性运动估计与真实场景泛化能力。

title: RETR: A Structure-Preserving RGB-Event Transformer for Robust 3D Lane Detection
summary: Robust 3D lane detection requires accurate metric road geometry recovery from visual inputs, yet conventional RGB-based approaches suffer from fragile lane evidence under adverse illumination, motion blur, and long-range perspective compression. Event cameras offer complementary high-temporal-resolution, high dynamic-range structural cues that are robust to these challenges, but their sparse, motion-dependent responses cannot be directly fused into consistent 3D geometry. In this paper, we present the first attempt to introduce event cameras into 3D lane detection. To enable systematic research, we first build two multimodal benchmarks with metric 3D lane annotations: DSEC-3DLD (real-world sequences) and Ev-OpenLane (large-scale simulated sequences). We further propose RETR, a structure preserving transformer that converts complementary RGB and event observations into coherent 3D lane geometry. RETR first aligns modality consistent evidence through Reciprocal Context Flow Fusion, then preserves thin and uncertain lane structures with Uncertainty Aware Structural Consolidation, and finally decodes ordered lane hypotheses using a Geometry State Decoder with proposal conditioned initialization, reference conditioned query evolution, and diversified geometric inquiry. Extensive experiments show that RETR achieves state-of-the-art performance on both benchmarks, especially showing strong improvements in challenging lighting and complex road geometry scenarios. Code and dataset will be available at https://github.com/duskswell/RETR.

AI.tldr: 首次将事件相机引入3D车道检测，构建DSEC-3DLD与Ev-OpenLane两个带度量3D车道标注的多模态基准，并提出结构保持Transformer（RETR）融合RGB与事件观测以恢复一致的3D车道几何，在两个基准上达到SOTA。
AI.motivation: 传统基于RGB的3D车道检测在逆光/光照恶劣、运动模糊和远距离透视压缩下车道证据脆弱；事件相机具备高时间分辨率、高动态范围的结构线索，但响应稀疏且依赖运动，难以直接融合为一致3D几何，因此需要专门的多模态建模与基准。
AI.method: 提出RETR结构保持Transformer：1) Reciprocal Context Flow Fusion实现模态一致证据对齐；2) Uncertainty Aware Structural Consolidation保持细薄与不确定车道结构；3) Geometry State Decoder以提案条件初始化、参考条件查询演化与多样化几何查询解码有序车道假设。
AI.result: 在两个新基准上均取得SOTA性能，在挑战性光照与复杂道路几何场景中提升尤为显著。
AI.conclusion: 事件相机可作为RGB的有效互补模态提升3D车道检测鲁棒性；所构建基准与RETR框架为事件-视觉3D感知提供系统研究基础，代码与数据集将开源。

title: dit.xpu : Taming DiT Sparse Inference on Mobile SoCs
summary: Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) enable on-device image generation and editing but incur high attention costs at high resolutions. Existing sparse attention reduces computation, yet dynamic sparsity introduces preprocessing and irregular data accesses that poorly fit mobile NPUs. We present DiT.XPU, a sparse DiT inference framework for heterogeneous mobile SoCs. DiT.XPU combines tile-aligned sparse attention with anchor-based error compensation by exploiting slowly varying dense-sparse output residuals across denoising steps. Heterogeneous XPU collaboration overlaps NPU dense attention with GPU sparse calibration, while mask-guided dataflow reduces data transfers and layout conversion by overlapping data movement with computation. Across five DiT models on two Snapdragon smartphones, DiT.XPU achieves up to 1.56x end-to-end denoising speedup over the Hexagon-NPU backend and 11.5x attention-kernel speedup over the fastest alternative, while preserving generation quality close to dense attention. Code is available at https://github.com/IF-LAB-PKU/dit.xpu.

AI.tldr: DiT.XPU：面向异构移动SoC的稀疏DiT推理框架，通过瓦片对齐稀疏注意力、锚点误差补偿与NPU-GPU异构协作，实现高分辨率DiT高效推理。
AI.motivation: Diffusion Transformers可在端侧完成图像生成与编辑，但高分辨率下注意力开销大。现有稀疏注意力虽降低计算量，却引入动态稀疏性带来的预处理开销与不规则内存访问，难以适配移动NPU。
AI.method: 提出DiT.XPU框架，包含三项设计：(1) 瓦片对齐的稀疏注意力(tile-aligned sparse attention)，配合基于锚点的误差补偿，利用去噪步间稠密-稀疏输出残差缓慢变化的特性；(2) 异构XPU协作，将NPU稠密注意力与GPU稀疏校准重叠执行；(3) 掩码引导的数据流(mask-guided dataflow)，将数据传输与计算重叠，减少数据搬运与布局转换。
AI.result: 在两个Snapdragon智能手机上针对五个DiT模型评测：端到端去噪相比Hexagon-NPU后端最高加速1.56倍；注意力kernel相比最快基线最高加速11.5倍；生成质量接近稠密注意力。
AI.conclusion: 通过硬件对齐的稀疏化与异构协同调度，DiT.XPU显著降低了移动端DiT推理延迟并保持生成质量，为移动SoC上的高效扩散Transformer推理提供了可行方案。

title: From zero-target transfer to target-site personalization: multi-source training across fall-detection models
summary: Video-based fall detection could support timely assistance when a person cannot call for help. Unfamiliar cameras and scarce local labels challenge deployment. We examine whether joint training improves cross-dataset detection and subsequent local training. We analyze 2,697 clips from eight OmniFall datasets and one AI-Hub dataset. Positive clips contain a fall or collapse transition, while negative clips do not. We hold out each dataset in turn, training on the other eight. We evaluate three vision-language models (VLMs), Qwen, LLaVA, and InternVL, and three visual baselines, CLIP-temporal, VideoMAE, and Pose-TCN. We evaluate the stored source model without target data for training or selection. For each label budget, we update a separate copy using labeled clips from the held-out target dataset. We call this target-site personalization. We compare the Source-initialized model with Target-only, which skips source training but uses identical target clips and updates. Across nine targets, source training raises mean area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROC) from frozen-model values of 0.821 to 0.912 for Qwen, 0.883 to 0.947 for LLaVA, and 0.939 to 0.962 for InternVL. With five target examples per class and 26 updates per run, 95% confidence intervals for the AUROC benefit over Target-only lie above zero for Qwen, CLIP-temporal, VideoMAE, and Pose-TCN. With full-target training, they lie above zero only for Qwen and LLaVA. Separate VLM analyses reveal threshold sensitivity and post-fall false detections. The benefit varies by model and label budget.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过在8+1个数据集间做留一交叉训练，检验视频跌倒检测中"联合训练"对跨数据集检测及后续目标站点个性化（target-site personalization）的作用，并比较三种VLM与三种视觉基线。
AI.motivation: 跌倒检测需及时救助，但部署场景面临摄像机不熟悉、本地标注稀缺的问题。作者想验证跨数据集联合训练能否提升跨域检测，并在少量目标域标注下继续增益，从而降低对本地标注的依赖。
AI.method: 构建2,697个片段（8个OmniFall数据集+1个AI-Hub数据集），正样本含跌倒/倒地转变，负样本不含。逐一留出每个数据集，用其余八个训练源模型；源模型在不接触目标域数据（训练或选型）下评测。比较三类VLM（Qwen、LLaVA、InternVL）与三类视觉基线（CLIP-temporal、VideoMAE、Pose-TCN）。对每个标注预算，用留出目标集的有标注片段更新独立副本，并与Target-only（跳过源训练、使用相同目标片段与更新）对照。
AI.result: 九个目标域上，源训练使冻结模型的平均AUROC提升：Qwen 0.821→0.912，LLaVA 0.883→0.947，InternVL 0.939→0.962。每类5个目标样本、每次运行26次更新时，Qwen、CLIP-temporal、VideoMAE、Pose-TCN相对Target-only的AUROC增益95%置信区间下界大于0；全量目标训练时仅Qwen与LLaVA仍显著。VLM专项分析发现阈值敏感性和跌倒后误检问题。
AI.conclusion: 联合源训练可显著提升跨数据集跌倒检测，并能在小标注预算下为部分模型带来额外增益，但增益依模型与标注预算而异；VLM存在阈值敏感与跌倒后误检，需针对性处理。

title: Probing Where Surprise Happens: Localized Violation-of-Expectation Evaluation of Video World Models
summary: Violation-of-expectation (VOE) benchmarks evaluate intuitive physics in video world models by testing whether physically impossible events produce greater prediction errors than matched possible events. However, conventional VOE evaluations aggregate prediction errors across space and time, making it unclear whether successful discrimination reflects model's understanding of physical violations at the locations and time where they occur. To address this limitation, we introduce localized VOE evaluation, a framework that measures prediction error differences between possible and impossible events within spatial regions and temporal intervals associated with physical violations. We compare global, temporally localized, and spatiotemporally localized evaluations of V-JEPA models pretrained on developmental egocentric videos or large-scale natural video datasets. Our results reveal that global and localized judgments can diverge in both directions: global aggregation can either obscure correct localized discrimination or produce apparent discrimination without corresponding localized evidence. During continued pretraining on developmental egocentric videos, agreement between global and localized judgments changes non-monotonically, while confidence in localized judgments increases despite modest improvements in accuracy. Together, these findings establish localized VOE evaluation as a complementary diagnostic for assessing intuitive physics in video world models and demonstrate that global prediction errors do not necessarily reflect the spatiotemporal evidence of physical violations.

AI.tldr: 提出"局部化VOE评估"框架，在物理违规所对应的时空区域与时间区间内比较可能与不可能事件的预测误差，并从全局、时间局部、时空局部三个层次评估V-JEPA模型，揭示全局聚合与局部判断可能双向背离。
AI.motivation: 传统VOE基准将预测误差在空间与时间上聚合，无法判断模型成功区分物理违规是否真的来自违规发生处与发生时；即全局判别成功可能并不对应局部证据。
AI.method: 构建局部化VOE评估框架：在与物理违规相关的空间区域和时间区间内计算可能事件与不可能事件的预测误差差；在发育型自我中心视频或大规模自然视频上预训练的V-JEPA模型上，对比全局、时间局部、时空局部三种评估设置，并分析继续预训练过程中的变化趋势。
AI.result: 全局与局部判断可双向背离：全局聚合既可能掩盖正确的局部判别，也可能在缺乏局部证据时产生表面上的判别；在发育型自我中心视频上继续预训练时，全局与局部判断的一致性呈非单调变化，而局部判断的置信度上升，尽管准确率仅小幅提升。
AI.conclusion: 局部化VOE评估可作为视频世界模型直觉物理能力的补充诊断工具；全局预测误差并不必然反映物理违规的时空证据。

title: Small Data in Long-Term Environmental Vision: Annotation Noise, Gamification, and Label-Budget Scaling
comment: 12 pages, 3 figures, 2 tables. Accepted to the LFSD-CV Workshop at ACCV 2026
summary: Long-running environmental camera networks produce abundant images but few reliable annotations. Using FujiView, a network of webcams around Mount Fuji, we study three linked questions: whether gamification affects annotation participation and agreement, how annotators disagree on ordinal visibility labels, and how label budget affects downstream classification. Across seven nonrandomized sessions with 22 labelers, gamification showed a more promising pattern for sustained participation than for labeling speed or agreement. In the closest remote-session comparison, the session recorded as gamified had longer active labeling time, while throughput and reference agreement remained similar. Annotation disagreement was substantial at fine granularity: crowd votes matched the single-annotator reference on 49.1% of exact visibility classes, versus 90.2% after grouping them into Good/Poor. In five-replicate label-budget experiments, models using 25% of the available label pool achieved held-out exact accuracy only 2.8 percentage points below the full-pool model on average. Together, these findings highlight the importance of designing reliable annotation targets, evaluating engagement mechanisms without assuming causal benefits, and using empirical scaling curves to plan labeling effort.

AI.tldr: 该论文基于富士山周边网络摄像头（FujiView）研究三个关联问题：游戏化对标注参与与一致性的影响、标注者在序数能见度标签上的分歧、以及标签预算对下游分类的影响。
AI.motivation: 长期运行的环境摄像头网络产生大量图像但缺乏可靠标注，需要理解众包标注的参与机制、标签粒度与预算效率，以设计可持续且经济的数据标注流程。
AI.method: 在7个非随机化会话、22名标注者上开展实验：(1) 比较游戏化与非游戏化会话的参与时长、吞吐量与参考一致性（含最接近的远程会话对比）；(2) 分析细粒度（精确能见度类别）与粗粒度（Good/Poor分组）下的标注分歧；(3) 进行5次重复的标签预算实验，用25%标签池与全量标签池训练并比较留出集精确准确率。
AI.result: 游戏化在持续参与上呈现更有希望的模式（游戏化会话活跃标注时间更长），但吞吐量与参考一致性相近；细粒度下众包投票与单一标注参考仅49.1%一致，分组为Good/Poor后升至90.2%；使用25%标签池的模型留出精确准确率平均仅比全量模型低2.8个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 应设计可靠的标注目标（考虑合适的标签粒度）、在评估参与机制时避免预设因果收益，并利用经验性缩放曲线来规划标注投入。

title: Where Does an On-Device Prescription Reader Lose Medications? A Frozen-Replay Study, from a 270M Language Model to a 2B Vision-Language Model
summary: On-device models let a phone read a prescription without sending the photograph anywhere, but small models fail in ways that are hard to attribute: to the camera, the OCR, the model, or the rules around it. We study a phone-based pipeline that reads a prescription photograph with PaddleOCR, extracts medications with a 270M-parameter language model, and filters the result with a deterministic backstop before showing suggestions. Replaying identical frozen inputs through each configuration, with deterministic generation verified, we compare configurations with paired document-level intervals on 49 captures of 15 synthetic prescriptions (6 typed, 9 handwritten by one writer). Production recall is 8%, and 0 of 45 on handwriting. The backstop removes no correct medication and cuts unsafe outputs from 45 to 1. On handwriting nearly all medications never reach the model in readable form; on typed sheets the model mostly picks the wrong text. We trace much of the handwriting floor to a defect in our own crop step, then replace the pipeline: rotated-box crops, a 2B-parameter vision-language model that re-reads prescription lines and extracts the medications, and per-line numeric grounding. On the same captures recall rises from 8% to 67% (paired +59 points, 95% CI +40 to +78): typed 19% to 100%, handwritten 0 to 20 of 45, with no unsafe output. Rotated crops account for most of the reading gain and the model for most of the recall gain, and the OCR confidence gate is now the main limit. The cost is 61 s per photograph against about 12 s, and about 1.9 GB of memory. An earlier claim that better OCR lowered recall does not survive the controlled comparison, and we withdraw it. All results are in-sample, from one writer and one device.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究手机端处方照片读取流水线的失效归因与改进：原流水线（PaddleOCR+270M小模型+确定性兜底）召回仅8%、手写为0；通过定位自研裁剪缺陷并替换为旋转框裁剪+2B视觉语言模型+逐行数值接地，召回升至67%且无不安全输出，代价为61秒/张与约1.9GB内存。
AI.motivation: 端侧小模型可在不发送照片的前提下读取处方，但其失败难以归因（相机、OCR、模型还是规则）。作者希望对流水线做可分解的失效定位，并检验各环节对最终召回的贡献。
AI.method: 以确定性生成验证为前提，将相同冻结输入重放到各配置，用配对文档级区间在49张拍摄、15份合成处方（6份打印、9份单书写者手写）上比较：(1) 基线 PaddleOCR + 270M 语言模型抽取 + 确定性backstop过滤；(2) 替换版：旋转框裁剪 + 2B 视觉语言模型重读处方行并抽取药物 + 逐行数值接地。
AI.result: 基线生产召回8%，手写45项中0项；backstop未删除任何正确药物，将不安全输出从45降至1。手写场景多数药物以不可读形式未达模型，打印场景模型多选错文本，且相当一部分手写下限源于自研裁剪步骤缺陷。替换后同一批拍摄召回8%→67%（配对+59点，95% CI +40~+78）：打印19%→100%，手写0→45中20项，无不安全输出；旋转裁剪贡献大部分读取增益，模型贡献大部分召回增益，OCR置信度门限成为主要瓶颈。成本61秒/张（原约12秒）、约1.9GB内存。先前“更好OCR降低召回”的结论在受控比较下不成立，予以撤回。
AI.conclusion: 端侧处方读取的主要瓶颈在图像裁剪与读取环节而非抽取模型；旋转框裁剪结合视觉语言模型可显著提升召回并保持安全。但结果均为单书写者、单设备的样本内评估，缺乏泛化证据，且延迟与内存开销明显，OCR置信度门限为当前主要限制。

title: Shared Mobile AR Without Depth Sensors from Monocular Point Maps
summary: Depth-aware augmented reality on phones needs dense geometry of the surrounding room. iPhones and iPads without LiDAR expose only sparse feature points and detected planes, and ARKit often takes tens of seconds to report the first wall. We describe a scan-free pipeline for these devices. A point-map network (MoGe-2) predicts metric geometry from each camera frame, the remaining depth shift is recovered from the camera intrinsics, and each frame's scale is aligned to views already in the map. A persistent voxel map with visibility-based expiry answers occlusion and collision queries. Co-located devices share one coordinate frame by solving yaw and floor-plane translation from sightings of each other. We evaluate the deployed system on 309 device-sessions from 19 device models without LiDAR, with 179 device-sessions from LiDAR phones in the same deployment as a reference population. A first dense depth map was recorded within 10 s in 80% of sessions, while ARKit had reported a wall plane by then in 25%. The median session scale was 0.98 against ARKit's wall planes and 1.00 against its camera translation. Scale changed by a median of 9% between nearby frames, against 0.4% with LiDAR, and depth points spread three times as widely around walls. In multi-device sessions, 69% of devices without LiDAR reached a converged shared frame, against 84% of LiDAR phones. The main remaining error is scale that changes from frame to frame.

AI.tldr: 提出一种免扫描（scan-free）流程，为无LiDAR的iPhone/iPad在AR中实时构建稠密房间几何，并实现多设备共享坐标系。
AI.motivation: 无LiDAR的iPhone/iPad在ARKit下只输出稀疏特征点与检测平面，且首次报告墙面常需数十秒，难以支撑遮挡与碰撞等稠密几何需求。
AI.method: 用点图网络MoGe-2从每帧预测度量几何，由相机内参恢复剩余深度偏移，并将每帧尺度对齐到已建图视角；以带可见性过期的持久体素地图响应遮挡与碰撞查询；同处设备通过互相观测求解偏航角与地板平面平移以统一坐标系。
AI.result: 在19种无LiDAR机型的309个会话及179个LiDAR手机会话（参照）上评测：80%会话10秒内得到首帧稠密深度图（ARKit同期仅25%报告墙面）；尺度中位数相对ARKit墙面为0.98、相对相机平移为1.00；相邻帧尺度变化中位数9%（LiDAR为0.4%），深度点绕墙面离散度约为LiDAR的3倍；多设备会话中69%无LiDAR设备达成共享坐标系（LiDAR为84%）。
AI.conclusion: 该流程可在无LiDAR设备上快速获得稠密几何并支持多设备协同，但主要残留误差为逐帧尺度不一致。

title: Not All Steps Matter: Temporally Adaptive Spectral Control for Concept Removal in Diffusion Models
summary: As text-to-image diffusion models see widespread deployment, removing unsafe or undesirable concepts without retraining has become a pressing need. Spectral methods are attractive because they are training-free and reversible, yet current variants apply the same output-value (OV) circuit intervention at every denoising step, assuming concept information is temporally uniform. This wastes intervention where concept energy is low while degrading image quality, an inefficiency that compounds across concept types. Through timestep-resolved spectral analysis, concept-specific energy is found to follow a consistent temporal hierarchy: content concepts decay fastest, object concepts are intermediate, and style concepts persist longest. This paper proposes Timestep-Adaptive Spectral Nullification (TASN), which adapts suppression strength and spectral components to the concept energy profile. Cross-attention at each timestep is decomposed into concept-aligned and concept-orthogonal components, and it is proved that when the orthogonal component is approximately stable, the collateral-minimizing schedule sets suppression proportional to concept energy. TASN implements this with a timestep-adaptive spectral subset tracking only active concept directions, strictly generalizing uniform Spectral Nullification (SN). On five red-teaming benchmarks, TASN lowers attack success rate below uniform SN while recovering the majority of its quality loss; ablations confirm gains arise from temporal targeting rather than reduced suppression, generalizing across concept categories and architectures.

AI.tldr: 本文提出时序自适应谱消除方法 TASN，依据概念能量随去噪时间步的差异化衰减规律自适应调整谱干预强度，实现免训练、可逆的不良概念移除，在降低攻击成功率的同时显著恢复图像质量。
AI.motivation: 现有谱方法（如 Spectral Nullification）在每个去噪步都施加相同的输出值（OV）电路干预，隐含假设概念信息在时间上均匀分布。这导致概念能量低的步上干预浪费、并损害图像质量，且该低效在不同概念类型上会累积。作者通过时步分辨的谱分析发现概念能量遵循稳定的时间层级：内容概念衰减最快、物体概念居中、风格概念持续最久。
AI.method: 提出 Timestep-Adaptive Spectral Nullification（TASN）：将每步的交叉注意力分解为概念对齐分量与概念正交分量；在正交分量近似稳定的前提下，证明使附带损伤最小的调度应为抑制强度与概念能量成正比。实现上采用仅跟踪活跃概念方向的时序自适应谱子集，严格泛化均匀 SN。
AI.result: 在五个红队基准上，TASN 的攻击成功率低于均匀 SN，同时恢复其大部分质量损失；消融实验表明收益来自时间定位而非抑制减弱，并可跨概念类别与模型架构泛化。
AI.conclusion: 概念信息在去噪过程中呈非均匀分布，干预应按概念能量调度；TASN 通过时序自适应的谱子集干预，兼得安全性与生成质量，为免训练、可逆的概念移除提供了有理论支撑的通用方案。

title: Exists, Valid: Calibrated Validity of Stored 3D Geometry Across Long Observation Gaps
summary: Repeated airborne LiDAR surveys are costly, while stored 3D geometry can become outdated between observations. Existing change-detection methods compare observed epochs. However, they do not quantify the validity of geometry that has not been revisited. We distinguish observation, existence and geometric validity using a probabilistic filter over five geometric transitions: persistence, modification, growth, removal and replacement. The framework learns class-specific continuous-time transition priors from interval-censored observations and combines shape residuals with LiDAR free-space evidence. Functional anchors enable prior sharing across sites with different survey frequencies. In controlled experiments with misspecified dynamics and 60% visibility, our method reduces combined error from 36.9% to 16.5% and expected calibration error (ECE) from 0.19-0.32 to 0.017. Cross-site sharing reduces ECE at two-survey sites from 0.156 to 0.029. On Urb3DCD-v2, the method achieves 9.8% combined error and 0.016 ECE, outperforming baselines at 12.6% and at least 0.070, respectively. Re-survey prioritisation improves only modestly over random selection with two observations. Code and an evaluation protocol are released at https://github.com/anwaarua/life4d.

AI.tldr: 提出一个概率滤波框架，将"观测存在/几何有效性"分离，学习5类连续时间转移先验，在未重复扫描时量化已存几何的有效性，显著降低误差与校准误差。
AI.motivation: 重复机载LiDAR扫描成本高，存储的3D几何在两次观测之间会过时；现有变化检测方法只在已观测历元间做比较，无法量化"未被重访几何"的有效性。
AI.method: 以概率滤波区分观测、存在与几何有效性，建模持久、修改、生长、移除、替换五种几何转移；从区间删失观测中学习类别的连续时间转移先验；将形状残差与LiDAR自由空间证据融合；用功能锚点（functional anchors）在不同扫描频率的场地间共享先验。
AI.result: 在动力学误设、可见度60%的受控实验中，组合误差由36.9%降至16.5%，ECE由0.19–0.32降至0.017；跨场地共享使两观测场地ECE由0.156降至0.029；Urb3DCD-v2上组合误差9.8%、ECE 0.016，优于基线12.6%与≥0.070。重扫描优先级排序较随机选择仅小幅提升。
AI.conclusion: 将几何有效性作为独立于观测的存在性问题建模可有效应对陈旧几何；跨站点先验共享对低频扫描场地尤为有益；但仅两次观测下主动重扫描的收益有限。

title: Speaking-Clock Mamba: Phoneme-Conditioned State-Space Modeling for Visual Forced Alignment
summary: Visual forced alignment (VFA) locates phoneme and word boundaries in a silent talking-face video given its transcript. Existing methods mainly enforce transcript order at the decoding stage, leaving the encoder without an explicit mechanism to anchor its temporally evolving representation to transcript progress. As a result, phoneme-specific evidence is blurred and alignment drift accumulates over long sequences. In this paper, we propose Speaking-Clock Mamba, which makes transcript progress part of the temporal recurrence. A selective state-space (Mamba) backbone is inserted between the visual frontend and the Conformer cross-attention encoder, and a Phoneme-Conditioned Selective Scan (PCSS) conditions its input-dependent step size on a supervised, structurally monotone speaking clock that estimates progress through the transcript. Since causal and bidirectional variants of this backbone make complementary errors, a training-free selector picks the more confident alignment per utterance. Experiments on LRS2 and LRS3 show consistent gains over protocol-matched baselines, and the supervised clock provides an explicit estimate of alignment progress.

AI.tldr: 提出 Speaking-Clock Mamba，将转写进度嵌入时序循环，用音素条件选择性扫描（PCSS）以监督式单调"说话时钟"控制 Mamba 步长，并用免训练选择器融合因果与双向变体，在 LRS2/LRS3 上稳定优于同协议基线。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉强制对齐（VFA）方法仅在解码阶段约束转写顺序，编码器缺乏将随时间演化的表示锚定到转写进度的显式机制，导致音素级证据模糊、长序列上对齐漂移累积。
AI.method: 在视觉前端与 Conformer 交叉注意力编码器之间插入选择性状态空间（Mamba）主干；PCSS 将输入相关的步长以监督的、结构单调的说话时钟（估计转写进度）为条件；因果与双向两种变体互补，用免训练选择器按置信度为每个话语挑选更优对齐。
AI.result: 在 LRS2 与 LRS3 上相较协议匹配的基线取得一致性提升；监督时钟可显式给出对齐进度估计。
AI.conclusion: 把转写进度纳入时序递归是对 VFA 的有效改进方向，兼顾精度提升与对齐进度的可解释估计。

title: CISyn: Human Mesh Recovery in Close Interactions with Physics-Simulated Synthetic Data
summary: 3D human mesh recovery (HMR) in close-interaction scenarios is hindered by the lack of large-scale, accurately annotated training data: real capture is expensive, and existing synthetic datasets rarely include physical contact. We introduce CISyn, a large-scale synthetic dataset purpose-built for close human-human interactions, generated via physics simulation and Blender-based rendering. By simulating collision dynamics between SMPL-X-rigged humanoids, CISyn naturally produces the contact, mutual occlusion, and pose entanglement that characterize close-interaction scenes, with no manual annotation effort. The released set provides 25,000 sequences with accurate 3D annotations. We further propose an uncertainty-aware loss that allows models to learn more effectively from the heavily occluded examples in our data. Augmenting state-of-the-art HMR training with CISyn and replacing the regression loss with our uncertainty-aware variant yields consistent improvements on close-interaction benchmarks, validating CISyn as a scalable complement to real-world data. The dataset, generation pipeline, and code are available at https://github.com/yfde/CISyn.

AI.tldr: 提出面向近距离人-人交互的三维人体网格恢复合成数据集 CISyn（基于物理仿真与 Blender 渲染，含 25,000 条序列及精确 3D 标注），并提出不确定性感知损失以更好利用重遮挡样本，在近距离交互基准上取得一致提升。
AI.motivation: 近距离交互场景下的 3D 人体网格恢复（HMR）受制于缺乏大规模、标注准确的训练数据：真实采集成本高，而现有合成数据集很少包含物理接触，因而缺乏接触、互遮挡与姿态纠缠等关键特征。
AI.method: 构建 CISyn 数据集：对 SMPL-X 绑定的人体模型进行刚体/碰撞动力学仿真，再用 Blender 渲染，从而在无需人工标注的情况下自然生成接触、互遮挡与姿态纠缠；同时提出不确定性感知损失（uncertainty-aware loss），替代原回归损失，使模型能从重遮挡样本中更有效学习。
AI.result: 将 CISyn 用于增强当前最优 HMR 模型的训练，并将回归损失替换为不确定性感知变体后，在近距离交互基准上获得一致性能提升。
AI.conclusion: CISyn 可作为真实数据的可扩展补充，验证了物理仿真合成数据在近距离交互 HMR 中的有效性；数据集、生成管线与代码已开源。

title: UnSPAD: Uncertainty-aware Single Photon Burst Photography
comment: Accepted at The Winter Conference on Applications of Computer Vision (WACV) 2027
summary: We introduce UnSPAD, an uncertainty-aware burst photography framework capable of fusing and denoising arbitrarily long sequences of binary single photon avalanche diode (SPAD) measurements.
