Unlike prior methods that require fixed burst lengths or rely on powerful generative priors, UnSPAD combines learned motion estimation with uncertainty-informed measurement fusion and denoising to produce temporally consistent, hallucination-free reconstructions. UnSPAD first forms an initial scene estimate by averaging flow-aligned binary frames. UnSPAD then uses per-pixel uncertainty maps to perform uncertainty-aware denoising; the denoiser is informed about which regions accumulated the fewest observations (and thus contain the most relative shot noise) due to motion, occlusion, or alignment errors. This two-step reconstruction pipeline helps mitigate hallucinations---outside of the structure implicitly introduced by the flow estimates, the initial scenes estimates are entirely prior-free. Experiments on real and simulated SPAD and quantum image sensor (QIS) benchmarks demonstrate state-of-the-art reconstruction quality, improved temporal consistency, and superior color fidelity relative to the state of the art.

AI.tldr: UnSPAD 是一个不确定性感知的突发摄影框架，可对任意长度的二值单光子雪崩二极管（SPAD）测量序列进行融合与去噪，无需固定突发长度和生成式先验，实现时间一致、无幻觉的重建。
AI.motivation: 现有 SPAD 重建方法要么要求固定突发长度，要么依赖强大的生成式先验，后者易引入幻觉（hallucination）内容。作者希望摆脱对生成先验的依赖，同时支持任意长度的测量序列。
AI.method: 两阶段重建流水线：(1) 用学习到的光流估计对齐二值帧后取平均，形成初始场景估计（除光流隐含的结构外完全无先验）；(2) 利用逐像素不确定性图进行不确定性感知去噪，该图指示因运动、遮挡或对齐误差导致观测数最少的区域（相对散粒噪声最大），去噪网络据此调整处理。
AI.result: 在真实与仿真的 SPAD 及量子图像传感器（QIS）基准上，重建质量达到当前最优（SOTA），并具有更好的时间一致性和更优的色彩保真度。
AI.conclusion: 将学习式运动估计与不确定性引导的测量融合、去噪相结合，可在无生成先验条件下实现无幻觉、时间一致的任意长度 SPAD 序列重建，验证了该框架的有效性。

title: FiReIQ: Field-Level Confidence Estimation with Reasoning and Image Quality in Document Extraction
summary: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have demonstrated strong performance in structured document extraction, yet their deployment in high-stakes applications requires reliable confidence estimates for individual fields. Existing uncertainty estimators often aggregate signals across an entire generation, obscuring field-specific reasoning uncertainty while overlooking visual degradations that may lead to confident extraction errors. To address these limitations, we introduce FiReIQ, a field-level confidence estimation framework that combines field-aligned reasoning signals from a single VLM generation with local and global image-quality features through quality-conditioned visual fusion. To facilitate systematic evaluation, we further introduce FiReIQ-Bench, a benchmark spanning financial receipts and legal contracts. Experiments with two reasoning VLMs show that FiReIQ consistently improves confidence discrimination, selective prediction, and probabilistic accuracy over existing estimators. These gains extend to private financial service data, where FiReIQ improves AUROC by 6.8% and coverage at 95% precision by 10.6% over an existing baseline. Together, these results highlight the potential of FiReIQ to reduce manual review while enabling more reliable document automation.

AI.tldr: 提出字段级置信度估计框架FiReIQ，融合字段对齐推理信号与质量条件化视觉特征，并构建FiReIQ-Bench基准，显著提升文档抽取的置信度判别与选择性预测性能。
AI.motivation: VLM在结构化文档抽取中表现优异，但高风险场景需对每个字段给出可靠置信度。现有不确定性估计器多将整段生成的信号聚合，掩盖了字段级推理不确定性；同时忽略图像退化，可能导致"高置信度错误抽取"。因此需一种字段级、质量感知的置信度估计方法。
AI.method: 提出FiReIQ框架：从单次VLM生成中提取字段对齐的推理信号，并通过“质量条件化视觉融合”将其与局部、全局图像质量特征结合；同时构建FiReIQ-Bench基准，覆盖金融收据与法律合同两类文档，用于系统评估。
AI.result: 在两种推理型VLM上，FiReIQ在置信度判别、选择性预测与概率准确性上均优于现有估计器；在私有金融服务数据上，AUROC相对基线提升6.8%，95%精度下的覆盖率提升10.6%。
AI.conclusion: FiReIQ可为文档自动化提供更可靠的字段级置信度，在减少人工复核的同时提升自动化可靠性，具备落地高价值文档处理场景的潜力。

title: LongCat-Video-Avatar 1.6 Technical Report
summary: Recent advances in audio-driven avatar video generation have enabled increasingly realistic synthesis, yet achieving precise lip-audio synchronization, natural, human-like motion, and visual consistency over long sequences remains challenging. We present LongCat-Video-Avatar 1.6, which builds on LongCat-Video-Avatar 1.5 to improve expressive naturalness and reduce error accumulation during extended generation, e.g., exaggerated lip movements and overly red, temporally unstable lip coloration, enhance the naturalness of facial expressions and coordinated head and body movements. These improvements are driven by a refined post-training pipeline that integrates reinforcement learning, improved classifier-free guidance strategies for DMD-based few-step distillation, long-video rollouts, and on-policy distillation. Together, these refinements improve expressive realism and enable the generation of videos exceeding 10 minutes while maintaining visual quality and temporal consistency. Arena evaluations show that LongCat-Video-Avatar 1.6 outperforms its predecessor and competing commercial audio-driven avatar models, demonstrating the effectiveness of the improved post-training pipeline.

AI.tldr: LongCat-Video-Avatar 1.6 通过在 1.5 版本基础上重构后训练流程（强化学习、DMD 少步蒸馏的 CFG 改进、长视频 rollout、on-policy 蒸馏），提升口型-音频同步与表演自然度，抑制长序列误差累积，可生成超过 10 分钟且视觉与时间一致的视频，并在 Arena 评测中超越前代与商业模型。
AI.motivation: 音频驱动数字人视频生成虽日益逼真，但仍存在三大问题：唇形与音频的精确同步、动作缺乏自然拟人感、以及长序列生成中的视觉一致性差与误差累积（如夸张唇动、唇色过红且时间不稳定）。作者旨在在 1.5 版本基础上进一步缓解这些问题。
AI.method: 提出 LongCat-Video-Avatar 1.6，核心是精炼的后训练（post-training）流水线：引入强化学习；针对基于 DMD 的少步蒸馏改进无分类器引导（CFG）策略；采用长视频 rollout；并结合 on-policy 蒸馏。多项改进协同作用以提升表现力真实感。
AI.result: Arena 评测显示，1.6 优于其前代版本及竞争的商用音频驱动数字人模型，验证了改进后训练流水线的有效性；同时可生成超过 10 分钟的视频并保持视觉质量与时间一致性。
AI.conclusion: 通过系统性的后训练流程重构而非架构改动，即可显著改善音频驱动数字人生成的表演自然度与长时序稳定性，为长时长、高一致性数字人视频生成提供了可行路径。

title: Third-Place Solution for the UCF UrbanTwin V2X-Real Track at ECCV 2026: Synthetic Point Cloud Generation and Sim-to-Real 3D Object Detection
comment: 8 pages, 1 figure, 4 tables. 3rd place, Track 7 (V2X-Real), UCF UrbanTwin Sim2Real LiDAR Challenge, 6th DriveX Workshop at ECCV 2026
summary: This report presents a complete technical solution for the UrbanTwin V2X-Real Sim2Real LiDAR Challenge, covering both synthetic point cloud generation and 3D object detection. For data generation, we adopt per-axis quantile calibration. Public V2X-Real training data are used to construct the real reference distribution, and independent one-dimensional quantile mappings are estimated for the x, y, and z axes of the base synthetic point clouds. The calibrated point clouds are then resampled using a fixed random seed and clipped to the valid spatial range, producing 50 frames with 2,000 float32 XYZ points per frame. For detection, we use a two-stage Voxel R-CNN (VoxelRCNN) detector trained with RangeLDM-enhanced synthetic point-cloud data, point clouds downsampled to 50k points per frame, and reconstructed pedestrian data. Training is performed on four NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4090 GPUs with a global batch size of 16 for 40 epochs. Final testing uses direct single-model inference with the original VoxelRCNN model. On the official evaluation server, the normalized Realism score is 0.7905 and the normalized Detection score is 0.5583, with mAP@0.5 of 0.3908, BEV mAP@0.5 of 0.4219, and mAP@0.7 of 0.1047. According to the official weighting rule, the final combined score is 0.6 x 0.5583 + 0.4 x 0.7905 = 0.6512. This report documents the complete implementation details of data construction, model training, inference, submission formatting, and official evaluation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一套完整的 V2X-Real Sim2Real LiDAR 挑战赛技术方案，涵盖合成点云生成与 3D 目标检测两部分。数据生成采用逐轴分位数校准，检测采用 Voxel R-CNN 两阶段检测器。官方测试 Realism 归一化得分 0.7905，Detection 归一化得分 0.5583（mAP@0.5=0.3908），按权重 0.6/0.4 得综合得分 0.6512。
AI.motivation: 针对 UrbanTwin V2X-Real Sim2Real LiDAR 挑战赛，需要同时解决两个子任务：一是缩小基座合成点云与真实点云之间的域差异（提升 Realism），二是在合成数据训练的模型上实现真实场景下的鲁棒 3D 目标检测（提升 Detection）。
AI.method: 数据生成：以公开 V2X-Real 训练数据构建真实参考分布，对基座合成点云的 x/y/z 三轴分别估计独立的一维分位数映射进行逐轴分位数校准，再用固定随机种子重采样并裁剪至有效空间范围，每帧输出 2000 个 float32 XYZ 点，共 50 帧。检测：采用两阶段 Voxel R-CNN，训练数据融合 RangeLDM 增强的合成点云、每帧降采样至 50k 点的点云以及重建的行人数据；4 张 RTX 4090、全局 batch size 16、训练 40 epoch；测试阶段使用原 VoxelRCNN 模型直接单模型推理。
AI.result: 官方评测服务器结果：Realism 归一化得分 0.7905，Detection 归一化得分 0.5583；mAP@0.5 = 0.3908，BEV mAP@0.5 = 0.4219，mAP@0.7 = 0.1047。
AI.conclusion: 逐轴分位数校准能有效提升合成点云的真实性得分，而融合增强数据的两阶段 Voxel R-CNN 在检测任务上取得可用精度。按官方加权规则综合得分为 0.6×0.5583 + 0.4×0.7905 = 0.6512；报告完整记录了数据构建、模型训练、推理、提交格式化与官方评测的全流程实现细节。

title: Frame First, Decode Once: Object-Centric Coordinates and Single-Pass Decoding for System-1 World Models
comment: 12 pages, 6 figures, 7 tables. Code, frozen configurations and per-seed results will be released
summary: Single-pass primitive decoders such as LocateAnything and VFlash predict all quantized coordinate tokens of a geometric primitive in one forward pass, enabling fast, System-1 visual planning. We study what matters when such a decoder serves as a System-1 world model: a fast action-conditioned predictor that ranks candidate pushes by their predicted outcome. On ManiSkill3 PushT-v1 (512 held-out test families, 8,192 rollouts) and on human demonstrations from lerobot/pusht (2,384 test windows), we compare decoders, training losses, rigid-body projections and coordinate frames, using matched checkpoints, hierarchical bootstrap confidence intervals and Holm correction. Two factors of similar size dominate. First, expressing inputs and outputs in the SE(2) frame of the object's initial pose lowers decision regret by 1.9-2.2x for each of five decoders, and the object-frame model trained on 128 families matches the world-frame model trained on 512. Second, single-pass decoding outperforms iterative decoding: in the object frame, single-pass heads reach 0.020-0.021 regret at 1.6-1.8 ms per decision, against 0.046 for 10-step DDIM diffusion and 0.059 for KV-cached autoregression at 10.3 and 12.9 ms. The choice among single-pass heads has no measurable effect on regret, and our registered hypothesis that the frame effect exceeds the decoder spread is not supported. Soft-token expectation with an end-to-end 2D Kabsch projection gives the lowest trajectory error (11.35 px on ManiSkill3, 3.78 px on lerobot/pusht), exact rigid-body consistency, and lower regret than diffusion at every budget from 4 to 50 DDIM steps, at 3-29x lower latency.

AI.tldr: 在系统1视觉规划中，对象SE(2)初始位姿坐标系比解码器选择更重要，单遍解码显著优于迭代解码。
AI.motivation: 研究单遍原始图元解码器（如LocateAnything、VFlash）作为系统1世界模型时的关键因素，即快速预测动作条件结果并对候选推挤动作排序的能力。
AI.method: 在ManiSkill3 PushT-v1（512个留出测试族、8,192次rollout）和lerobot/pusht人类演示（2,384个测试窗口）上，使用匹配检查点、分层bootstrap置信区间与Holm校正，比较解码器、训练损失、刚体投影与坐标框架；包含5种解码器的对比、单遍vs迭代解码（10步DDIM、KV缓存自回归）、以及软token期望配端到端2D Kabsch投影。
AI.result: 两个因素主导且量级相近：对象初始位姿SE(2)坐标系使决策遗憾降低1.9–2.2倍，对象系128族训练即匹配世界系512族；对象系单遍解码遗憾0.020–0.021、每决策1.6–1.8 ms，优于10步DDIM（0.046，10.3 ms）与KV缓存自回归（0.059，12.9 ms）；单遍头之间无显著差异，"坐标框架效应超过解码器差异"的预注册假设未获支持。软token期望+2D Kabsch投影轨迹误差最低（11.35 px / 3.78 px），刚体一致性精确，在4–50步DDIM各预算下遗憾均更低且延迟低3–29倍。
AI.conclusion: 坐标框架与单遍解码是系统1世界模型性能的主要驱动因素，解码器架构选择影响可忽略；软token期望配刚体投影在精度、一致性与延迟上均占优。

title: Recognizing Events Is Not Enough: Why Streaming VLMs Struggle in Compositional Instruction Triggering
summary: Recognizing individual events does not guarantee correct execution of compositional instructions in streaming video. For example, given the request "Notify me when the pot boils after someone turns on the stove and leaves the kitchen", existing models may recognize the individual events yet notify too early or miss the intended moment, failing to track how their temporal conditions are satisfied over time. To evaluate this gap, we introduce CoTriggerBench, which composes annotated video events into temporally constrained instructions and verifies notification timing and silence through executable event plans and source-event replay. To address this challenge, we propose a real-time VLM agent, TEMPI. TEMPI decomposes instructions into atomic event queries and temporal constraints, and uses Scenario Memory to continuously maintain task progress as event evidence arrives, allowing earlier observations to support subsequent decisions beyond the detector's visual window. Even when no notification is required, relevant events continue to update the scenario state. On CoTriggerBench, TEMPI achieves 44.4% instruction-level success, outperforming the strongest closed-source and fine-tuned open-source VLM baselines by 15.6 (Qwen3.8-Omni-Flash-Realtime) and 18.1 (MOSS-VL-Realtime) percentage points, respectively. To support efficient on-device streaming inference, we further optimize the streaming inference pipeline by overlapping partial visual encoding and LLM prefix prefill with frame arrival. On an 8 GB RTX 5060, our optimized detector implementation achieves a 4.90$\times$ speedup.

AI.tldr: 提出CoTriggerBench基准与实时VLM智能体TEMPI，用于评估并解决流式视频中带时序约束的组合指令触发问题。
AI.motivation: 现有模型能识别单个事件，但无法正确执行组合式指令：难以随时间追踪时序条件的满足情况，导致过早通知或错过目标时刻。
AI.method: 1) 构建CoTriggerBench：将标注视频事件组合为时序约束指令，通过可执行事件计划和源事件回放检验通知时机与静默行为；2) 提出TEMPI实时VLM智能体：将指令分解为原子事件查询与时序约束，用Scenario Memory在事件证据到达时持续维护任务进度，使早期观测在探测器视觉窗口之外仍可支撑后续决策，无通知需求时相关事件也持续更新场景状态；3) 优化流式推理流水线，将部分视觉编码与LLM前缀预填充与帧到达重叠以支持端侧推理。
AI.result: CoTriggerBench上TEMPI达到44.4%指令级成功率，分别超过最强闭源基线（Qwen3.8-Omni-Flash-Realtime）15.6个百分点、微调开源基线（MOSS-VL-Realtime）18.1个百分点；8 GB RTX 5060上优化后探测器实现4.90倍加速。
AI.conclusion: 时序约束组合指令的触发是一类独立且未被充分评估的能力；显式事件分解配合持续场景记忆可显著提升流式触发准确性，流水线重叠优化可支撑高效端侧实时推理。

title: Target-Free Autocalibration of Stereo PIV Camera Systems via Persistent-State Motion Representations
summary: Stereo Particle Image Velocimetry (PIV) recovers three-component velocity fields by triangulating tracer particles observed by synchronized cameras. It requires an accurate extrinsic calibration, which is still obtained by inserting a physical target into the flow and must be repeated whenever the rig is moved. We present a target-free method that calibrates a stereo PIV rig directly from particle image sequences. Because tracer particles are visually indistinguishable, we match motion rather than appearance: building on CUT3R, each camera stream is processed by a recurrent transformer whose persistent state accumulates particle motion over time. The state is decoded into per-camera optical flow and queried by a cross-view decoder that regresses bidirectional point correspondences, from which the relative pose is recovered with a five-point RANSAC solver. We train on a new synthetic stereo PIV dataset with ground-truth poses and evaluate on standard PIV optical flow benchmarks and on 200 real rig placements. Our model achieves lower flow error than existing PIV networks, more accurate cross-view correspondences than COTR, and higher pose accuracy than the strongest detector-matcher pipelines on both synthetic and real data, without any calibration target.

AI.tldr: 提出一种无标定板方法，直接从粒子图像序列标定双目PIV装置的外参。
AI.motivation: Stereo PIV需精确外参标定，现有方法依赖插入流场的物理标定板，装置移动后须重复标定，费时且干扰实验流场。
AI.method: 基于CUT3R，对每路相机流用循环Transformer处理，持久状态累积粒子随时间运动；解码为逐相机光流，并由跨视角解码器回归双向点对应，再用五点RANSAC求解相对位姿；构建含真值位姿的合成双目PIV数据集训练。
AI.result: 在标准PIV光流基准与200组真实装置布局上评估：光流误差低于现有PIV网络，跨视角对应精度优于COTR，位姿精度在合成与真实数据上均优于最强检测-匹配流程，且无需标定靶。
AI.conclusion: 以运动匹配替代外观匹配，可在无标定板的条件下实现高精度双目PIV外参标定，为免靶标、可快速复位的PIV测量提供可行方案。

title: AITHER: Authority-Informed Evidence Routing for Mixed-Authority Vision-Language Reasoning
summary: Reliable vision-language reasoning requires a control decision that conventional grounding methods leave implicit: which input is entitled to determine the answer? Auxiliary text may be a defeasible claim about an image, a binding task instruction, or compatible context. Correcting every image-text conflict toward the image therefore repairs false claims but overwrites valid task rules. We formalize this setting as mixed-authority vision-language reasoning and introduce AITHER, an Authority-Informed Text-Image Hierarchy for Evidence Routing. Its final policy, the Semantic-Frame Router, is a training-free black-box control layer that (i) compiles explicit task directives, (ii) recovers standardized spatial frames from metadata-scrubbed pixels, (iii) resolves the semantic polarity of remaining notes, and (iv) routes among frozen observable candidates with fail-closed semantics. This ordered decomposition converts authority arbitration from an unconstrained prompt preference into a reproducible inference program. Across 1,620 MATRIX predictions, AITHER reaches 95.1% accuracy, exceeding the strongest task-and-frame baseline by 9.1 points with a 95% record-cluster interval of 6.8-11.5 points and no harmed records. It further reaches 100.0% on 1,800 controlled FRAME predictions and 93.3% on GQA-MATRIX. The results show that explicit authority routing can simultaneously improve false-claim correction, preserve task-defined answers, and eliminate clean-context overcorrection.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"混合权威视觉-语言推理"设定，并给出免训练黑盒控制层 AITHER（语义帧路由器），按顺序分解权威仲裁流程，实现可复现的推理程序。
AI.motivation: 传统 grounding 方法隐含地假设图像在图文冲突中总是权威，因而"逢冲突即改向图像"虽能修正错误文本主张，却会覆盖合理的任务指令与兼容上下文。需要显式判定"哪种输入有权决定答案"。
AI.method: 形式化混合权威推理设定；提出 AITHER 框架，其最终策略 Semantic-Frame Router 为免训练黑盒控制层，包含四个有序步骤：(i) 编译显式任务指令；(ii) 从去除元数据的像素中恢复标准化空间帧；(iii) 判定剩余文本注释的语义极性；(iv) 在冻结的可观测候选中以 fail-closed 语义进行路由。
AI.result: MATRIX 上 1,620 条预测达 95.1% 准确率，比最强任务+帧基线高 9.1 点（95% 记录簇区间 6.8–11.5 点），无误伤记录；FRAME 1,800 条达 100.0%；GQA-MATRIX 达 93.3%。
AI.conclusion: 显式权威路由可同时提升错误主张修正、保留任务定义答案，并消除干净上下文下的过度纠正。

title: Beyond Alignment: Supervising the Generator for EEG-to-Image Reconstruction
summary: Visual brain decoding translates neural activity into human-interpretable images. While recent EEG-to-image reconstruction methods rely on aligning EEG signals with pretrained visual embeddings to condition an image generator, we empirically demonstrate that stronger cross-modal alignment do not translate into comparable gains in reconstruction quality. This indicates that improving the input condition alone is insufficient; the generative process itself requires explicit supervision. Although Representation Alignment (REPA) offers a solution by guiding diffusion transformers with pretrained vision encoder features, we find that EEG-conditioned generators struggle to follow these fixed targets. To address this mismatch, we introduce generation-derived supervision (GDS): an image-conditioned teacher that translates static image-encoder features into the internal representation space of a diffusion transformer. Our EEG-conditioned student generator closely tracks these dynamic targets during denoising, discarding the teacher at inference. Evaluated on THINGS-EEG and THINGS-MEG, our approach consistently outperforms conditioning-centric baselines, achieving state-of-the-art reconstruction fidelity.

AI.tldr: 提出生成派生监督（GDS）：以图像条件化教师网络将静态图像编码器特征映射到扩散Transformer的内部表征空间，为EEG/MEG条件生成器提供动态监督信号，在THINGS-EEG与THINGS-MEG上取得SOTA重建保真度。
AI.motivation: 现有EEG到图像重建方法主要致力于提升EEG与预训练视觉嵌入的跨模态对齐，但作者实证发现更强的对齐并不带来相应的重建质量提升，说明仅优化输入条件不足，生成过程本身需要显式监督；而直接套用REPA式的固定视觉编码器特征作为目标时，EEG条件生成器难以跟随这些静态目标，存在目标不匹配问题。
AI.method: 引入生成派生监督（GDS）：构建一个图像条件化的教师模型，将静态图像编码器特征翻译为扩散Transformer的内部表征空间，从而为目标提供与去噪过程同步变化的动态监督；EEG条件的学生生成器在去噪过程中对齐这些动态目标进行训练，推理阶段丢弃教师模型。
AI.result: 在THINGS-EEG和THINGS-MEG两个数据集上，方法稳定优于以条件优化为中心的基线，并达到当前最优的重建保真度。
AI.conclusion: 跨模态对齐并非重建质量提升的充分条件，生成过程的显式、动态监督更为关键；GDS通过将表征对齐目标适配到扩散Transformer的内部空间，有效解决了固定目标与EEG条件生成器之间的不匹配问题。

title: PALIN: Pixel-Aligned LiDAR-NIR Multimodal 3D Object Detection with Benchmark
summary: 3D object detection is critical for intelligent transportation systems. LiDAR has been widely adopted for accurate geometric measurements; however, purely geometric representations remain ambiguous under sparse observations and occlusions, while cross-sensor multimodal fusion suffers from calibration and synchronization errors. To overcome these challenges, we leverage an Ouster LiDAR to construct PALIN (Pixel-Aligned LiDAR-NIR), a large-scale intrinsically pixel-aligned multimodal dataset jointly capturing geometry and NIR intensity, comprising approximately 8,000 annotated frames from static urban intersections and diverse mobile suburban scenes. Building upon this dataset, we propose CMambaFusion, a novel fusion framework consisting of a four-directional Cross-Mamba module for bidirectional cross-modal interaction and a Gated Concat-Mamba module for joint feature refinement. Extensive experiments demonstrate that PALIN enables effective multimodal learning, and CMambaFusion achieves superior accuracy-efficiency trade-offs over both LiDAR-only and representative fusion baselines.

AI.tldr: 构建像素对齐的LiDAR-NIR多模态数据集PALIN，并提出CMambaFusion融合框架提升3D目标检测的精度-效率表现。
AI.motivation: 纯几何LiDAR表征在稀疏观测与遮挡下存在歧义，而跨传感器多模态融合受标定与同步误差影响，因此需要天然像素对齐的多模态数据与高效融合方法。
AI.method: 使用Ouster LiDAR构建PALIN数据集，同步采集几何与NIR强度，约8000帧标注，覆盖静态城市路口与多样移动郊区场景；提出CMambaFusion，包含四方向Cross-Mamba模块进行双向跨模态交互，以及Gated Concat-Mamba模块进行联合特征精炼。
AI.result: 实验表明PALIN支持有效的多模态学习，CMambaFusion相较纯LiDAR与代表性融合基线在精度与效率权衡上更优。
AI.conclusion: 像素对齐的LiDAR-NIR多模态方案可规避标定同步误差，结合基于Mamba的双向交互与门控融合，可在3D目标检测中实现更优的精度-效率折中。

title: SAR-TopoGuard: Training-Free, Speckle-Aware Topological Verification for Structure-Preserving SAR-to-Optical Translation
comment: 10 pages, 4 figures, 7 tables. Accepted manuscript of the article published in IEEE Geoscience and Remote Sensing Letters (2026). \c{opyright} 2026 IEEE. Code: https://github.com/researchworksofsomeone/SAR-TopoGuard_Repo
summary: SAR-to-optical translators often synthesize detail that the radar measurement does not support, and pixel metrics alone cannot reveal it. We propose SAR-TopoGuard, a training-free inference-time layer for frozen generators: a stochastic sampler draws K candidates (Monte Carlo dropout for GANs, seed variance for diffusion), a speckle-aware verifier ranks them by gradient-magnitude correlation with the SAR input and a hallucination-frequency index, and a SAR-guided frequency gate admits high-frequency detail only where SAR edges support it. With all five hyperparameters frozen and three training seeds, we evaluate on 500 scene-disjoint SEN1-2 test patches, 500 patches of a held-out summer scene, and 200 cross-dataset SEN12MS winter pairs. The layer improves Pix2Pix by +0.060, +0.012, and +0.077 dB PSNR and by +0.0034, +0.0057, and +0.0135 SSIM, respectively (Wilcoxon p < 1e-6), and it improves CycleGAN and CUT on all three sets (+0.013 to +0.076 dB). It raises edge precision at the cost of edge recall (edge F1 -1.3% on the test set). On the latent diffusion model COP-GEN, it adds +0.33 dB (base) and +0.16 dB (Beta) on the winter set, the only set with dual-polarization SAR. An ablation shows that the gate produces the gain for MC-dropout GANs, whose candidates are nearly identical, whereas verifier selection contributes up to +0.26 dB for diffusion, whose samples differ. The layer has zero trainable parameters and adds 0.4 ms per patch beyond the K=5 generator passes.

AI.tldr: 提出SAR-TopoGuard——一个零参数、无需训练的推理期层，用于抑制SAR-to-光学翻译中雷达测量不支持的高频细节幻觉，并在多数据集上稳定提升PSNR/SSIM。
AI.motivation: 现有SAR-to-光学翻译器常合成雷达测量无法支撑的细节（幻觉），而像素级指标无法揭示此类问题，因此需要一种能够检测并抑制无支撑细节的机制。
AI.method: 对冻结生成器施加推理期包装：随机采样器采样K个候选（GAN用MC dropout，扩散用seed方差）；散斑感知验证器按候选与SAR输入的梯度幅值相关性及幻觉频率指数排序；SAR引导的频率门仅在SAR边缘支撑处放行高频细节。全部5个超参固定，3个训练种子。
AI.result: 在500个场景不相交SEN1-2测试块、500个留出夏季场景块、200个跨数据集SEN12MS冬季对上评估：Pix2Pix分别+0.060/+0.012/+0.077 dB PSNR及+0.0034/+0.0057/+0.0135 SSIM（Wilcoxon p<1e-6）；CycleGAN与CUT在三集均提升+0.013~+0.076 dB；边缘精度升高但召回下降（测试集边缘F1 -1.3%）；COP-GEN潜扩散冬季集+0.33 dB（base）/ +0.16 dB（Beta）。
AI.conclusion: 消融表明频率门对候选近乎相同的MC-dropout GAN贡献增益，而验证器选择对样本差异大的扩散模型贡献最高+0.26 dB；该层零可训练参数，每块额外开销0.4 ms（不含K=5的生成器前向）。

title: GameWM: Toward Next-Generation Video Games with Interaction-Centric World Models
summary: For more than half a century, video games have pursued better graphics, more natural interaction, and more engaging gameplay. Generative video models (VMs) now bear on all three. Neural networks already draw most of the pixels in shipped games, and recent world models let a lightweight game engine keep the world state while a VM turns the engine's coarse proxy video into final frames. These systems, however, treat the VM as a renderer that only restyles motion the engine has already authored, which leaves most of its generative capacity unused and limits the diversity a game can offer. We present GameWM, a design for next-generation games built on a clear division of labor. The GameWM-engine keeps what must be exact: rules, state, camera, and the layout of the world, which also spares the video model from having to remember it. The GameWM-VM generates what is expensive to author by hand: the look of the world and the detail of the player's interactions. One game mechanic can then be realized in many visually and physically distinct ways, while its outcome stays exactly as the engine computed it. To realize this division of labor, we build GameWM as a complete system: a data engine centered on interactions rather than exploration, an interface through which authored character sheets, scene art, and skill descriptions enter the model, and a model family from 5B to 33B parameters with a real-time causal variant for play. Together they give every player a fresh version of the same game: each player's own character, world, and skills turn the same engine mechanics into a new experience, while every event keeps the timing and outcome the GameWM-engine computed.

AI.tldr: 提出 GameWM 游戏生成框架，将游戏引擎与视频模型分工：引擎保持规则、状态、相机与场景布局的精确性，视频模型负责生成世界外观与交互细节，实现同一机制在视觉与物理上多样而结果确定。
AI.motivation: 现有游戏+视频模型系统仅把视频模型当作渲染器，只对引擎已编排好的运动做风格化，浪费了大部分生成能力并限制了游戏多样性。作者希望重新划分引擎与生成模型的职责，释放生成模型的潜力。
AI.method: 构建完整系统：（1）以交互而非探索为中心的数据引擎；（2）允许角色卡、场景美术、技能描述等创作品进入模型的接口；（3）5B–33B 参数模型族，并含用于实时游玩因果变体。核心设计是 GameWM-engine 保持规则、状态、相机与布局，GameWM-VM 生成外观与交互细节。
AI.result: 同一游戏机制可被实现为多种视觉与物理上不同的形式，而事件时序与结果严格由引擎计算决定；每位玩家拥有自己的角色、世界与技能，从而获得同一引擎机制下的全新体验。
AI.conclusion: 通过明确引擎与视频模型的分工，GameWM 为下一代游戏提供了一种可实时运行、结果确定且高度个性化的生成式游戏范式。

title: Puzzle: One Pass Is Not Enough for Open-Vocabulary Remote Sensing Segmentation
summary: Open-vocabulary remote sensing image segmentation (OVRSIS) enables the segmentation of unseen classes without additional annotation or retraining. By analyzing the predictions of existing OVRSIS methods, we find that many misclassified patches coexist with visually similar, correctly classified patches of the same class within the same image. Unfortunately, most of these methods stop after a single inference rather than using their predictions to guide further inference. Motivated by this observation, we propose \textbf{Puzzle}, a plug-and-play iterative re-inference framework that combines prediction history with a visual-similarity prior to progressively refine patch-level attention. Puzzle employs a lightweight history-conditioned controller to regulate each patch's contribution as an information source and its reliance on visually similar patches, while an adaptive stopping rule determines when to stop. It keeps the segmentation model frozen and reuses the same controller across different models and datasets without retraining. Extensive experiments demonstrate consistent performance improvements across diverse OVRSIS models and datasets, highlighting the strong transferability of Puzzle. Moreover, Puzzle can further improve the performance of SOTA methods.

AI.tldr: 提出即插即用的迭代再推理框架 Puzzle，利用预测历史与视觉相似性先验，在模型冻结条件下逐步精化 patch 级注意力，实现开放词汇遥感图像分割的稳定提升。
AI.motivation: 现有 OVRSIS 方法单次推理即停止，未利用预测结果指导后续推断；观察发现同一图像内常同时存在同类的错分 patch 与视觉相似的正确分类 patch，说明历史预测与相似性信息可被进一步挖掘。
AI.method: Puzzle 为即插即用框架，将预测历史与视觉相似性先验结合，引入轻量级 history-conditioned controller，调节每个 patch 作为信息源的贡献及其对视觉相似 patch 的依赖，并采用自适应停止规则决定迭代终止；分割模型保持冻结，同一控制器跨模型、跨数据集复用且无需重训练。
AI.result: 在多种 OVRSIS 模型与数据集上取得一致的性能提升，表现出较强的可迁移性，并可进一步提升 SOTA 方法的性能。
AI.conclusion: 通过迭代再推理与冻结模型设计，Puzzle 以低开销方式有效改进开放词汇遥感分割，具备良好的通用性与即插即用特性。

title: Editable Video Context: Mid-Context KV-Cache Reuse for Context-Managing Video LLMs
summary: Context Language Models let a model edit its own context, while Suffix Cache Reuse makes edits to text efficient by adjusting the positions of cached keys for surviving tokens. We extend these ideas to video language models with multimodal rotary position embeddings (M-RoPE). We represent a long video as timestamped segments. After viewing a sparsely sampled version, the model selects segments for decoding at 4x the frame rate, and the remaining segments are removed from its context. Our rebuild method reuses the KV cache of surviving segments by rotating their keys with a single offset shared by the temporal, height, and width components of Qwen2.5-VL's M-RoPE. A content-hashed cache also avoids repeating vision-encoder computation for those segments. In preliminary experiments with Qwen2.5-VL-7B on synthetic needle-in-a-video-haystack questions over public-domain films, the method reduces prefill tokens and end-to-end rebuild latency relative to full recomputation while usually producing the same answer. Densifying the segment containing the answer improves accuracy when that segment is known. When the model selects segments itself, accuracy does not improve: it rarely identifies a needle that was absent from the sparse sample. We release the code, raw logs, and scripts used to reproduce the paper's results.

AI.tldr: 本文将 Context Language Models 与 Suffix Cache Reuse 扩展到采用 M-RoPE 的视频语言模型：把长视频表示为带时间戳的分段，模型在稀疏采样后挑选片段以 4 倍帧率解码，并通过单一共享偏移旋转 M-RoPE 的时间/高/宽分量以复用幸存片段的 KV cache，同时用内容哈希缓存避免重复视觉编码。初步实验显示该方法在通常给出相同答案的前提下降低了 prefill token 数与重建延迟，但模型自主选择片段时准确率未提升。
AI.motivation: 长视频输入导致 prefill 代价高；已有 Context LM 的自编辑上下文与 Suffix Cache Reuse 能高效处理文本编辑，但尚未适配视频语言模型的 M-RoPE 位置编码，需在保持位置一致性的同时复用缓存。
AI.method: 以带时间戳的分段表示长视频；先看稀疏采样版本，再由模型选择片段以 4x 帧率解码，其余片段移出上下文；rebuild 时通过对 M-RoPE 的时间、高、宽分量施加同一偏移旋转幸存片段的 key，从而复用其 KV cache；并用内容哈希缓存跳过这些片段的视觉编码器计算。
AI.result: 在 Qwen2.5-VL-7B 上，针对公共领域影片构造的合成 needle-in-a-video-haystack 问题上，相较完全重算，方法减少了 prefill token 数与端到端 rebuild 延迟，且通常输出相同答案；在已知含答案片段时对其加密可提升准确率；模型自选片段时准确率不提升，因很少识别出稀疏采样中缺席的 needle。
AI.conclusion: 验证了将上下文编辑式缓存复用于 M-RoPE 视频模型的可行性，效率收益明确但对模型自主片段选择能力提出挑战；作者开源代码、原始日志与复现脚本。

title: 3D Cell Morphology--Clinical Text Contrastive Learning with Voxel Swin Transformer and Finding Encoder Domain-Adaptation
summary: Our prior work adapted a 2D CLIP dual encoder with LoRA to a multi-source cell-microscopy corpus, reaching anomaly-scoring ROC-AUC up to 0.985. This paper advances the same contrastive-learning domain-adaptation methodology from 2D microscope images to 3D microscope volumes, pairing a 3D Swin Transformer voxel encoder (MONAI's SwinUNETR backbone) with ClinicalBERT as the finding-text encoder. We train on 3,000 single-cell 3D confocal fluorescence volumes (4 tagged organelle structures) from the Allen Institute's public hiPSC single-cell image dataset, paired with template-generated finding text, with mitotic (dividing) cells oversampled as an abnormal-like proxy class validated by ROC-AUC. Naively reusing work's freeze backbone, LoRA the attention projections recipe for the Voxel Encoder collapses voxel embeddings to near-input-invariance, since LoRA's low-rank delta cannot compensate for an otherwise-frozen, randomly initialized (not pretrained) 3D Swin backbone, even as InfoNCE loss decreases healthily. Switching the Voxel Encoder to full fine-tuning resolves this: 4-way zero-shot structure accuracy rises from 25.0% (chance) to 48.6%, and voxel anomaly-scoring ROC-AUC improves from 0.486 to a peak of 0.628 (still below the 0.70 sanity threshold), while bidirectional retrieval recall stays low (R@10 $\le$3.8%). We further introduce a nearest-neighbor diagnosis-reason retrieval evaluation, reaching 29.8% hit-rate@{1,5} at its best scale while scoring 0.0% elsewhere. The central finding of this MVP is architectural: LoRA's parameter-efficiency assumption presumes a pretrained backbone worth preserving, and breaks down when the backbone is randomly initialized.

AI.tldr: 将2D CLIP+LoRA的多源细胞显微域适配方法扩展到3D共聚焦体数据，把3D Swin（SwinUNETR）与ClinicalBERT配对做对比学习；发现随机初始化的3D骨干不能沿用"冻结骨干+LoRA"策略，改用全量微调后才获得有限但一致的性能提升。核心结论是：LoRA的参数高效假设以"存在值得保留的预训练骨干"为前提。
AI.motivation: 前期工作在2D细胞显微镜图像上用LoRA适配CLIP双编码器，异常评分ROC-AUC达0.985；本文意图验证同一对比学习域适配方法论能否从2D图像迁移到3D显微镜体数据，从而把"细胞-文本"检索与异常评分扩展到三维单细胞成像。
AI.method: 双编码器：3D Swin Transformer体素编码器（MONAI SwinUNETR骨干）+ ClinicalBERT文本编码器，以InfoNCE对齐体素与模板生成的finding文本。数据为Allen Institute公开hiPSC单细胞数据集中3,000个单细胞3D共聚焦荧光体（4类标记细胞器），以有丝分裂细胞过采样作为"类异常"代理类。对比两种适配方案：沿用前作的"冻结骨干+LoRA注意力投影"，与体素编码器全量微调；并以ROC-AUC、4类零样本结构分类、双向检索R@10及最近邻诊断-理由检索hit-rate@{1,5}评估。
AI.result: 冻结骨干+LoRA方案出现表征坍塌：体素嵌入近似对输入不变，尽管InfoNCE损失正常下降——低秩增量无法补偿一个随机初始化（未预训练）且其余部分被冻结的3D Swin骨干。改为全量微调后：4类零样本结构准确率由25.0%（随机水平）升至48.6%；体素异常评分ROC-AUC由0.486升至峰值0.628（仍低于0.70的合理性阈值）；双向检索召回仍然偏低（R@10≤3.8%）；新引入的最近邻诊断-理由检索在最优规模下hit-rate@{1,5}达29.8%，其他规模为0.0%。
AI.conclusion: 本MVP的核心发现属于架构层面：LoRA式参数高效适配隐含"骨干已预训练、值得保留"的前提，当骨干为随机初始化时该前提失效，冻结骨干+LoRA会导致嵌入坍塌，必须改为全量微调。3D版本整体性能仍显著低于2D基线（ROC-AUC未过0.70），说明从2D到3D的域适配仍存在明显差距，后续工作应以引入预训练3D骨干或更强的文本监督为关键方向。

title: Evidence-Calibrated Selective Decoding for Reliable Visual Question Answering
summary: Visual question answering systems can produce confident responses that are weakly supported by their input images. Contrastive decoding can reduce this dependence on language priors, but a fixed correction may also overturn a correct answer, while selective answering can conceal errors by reducing coverage. We develop evidence-calibrated selective decoding, a framework that separates three decisions: whether local visual evidence supports a candidate, how strongly to correct the original distribution, and whether the resulting answer should be released under a verification budget. Evidence Verification across Crops (EVC) measures visual support and disagreement; Adaptive Contrast Correction (ACC) applies a bounded modification within the backbone's plausible candidate set; Budgeted Selective Answering (BSA) calibrates an answer-admission threshold on held-out images. We provide a complete mathematical specification, bounded-perturbation analysis, and an evaluation protocol that distinguishes forced answering from selective risk. Our quantitative analysis re-examines published baselines on POPE instantiated over MSCOCO, A-OKVQA, and GQA, together with four MME subtasks. These public measurements reveal variation across backbones, tasks, and correction settings that motivates adaptive control. The proposed framework has not yet undergone model-level evaluation; its effectiveness remains a falsifiable hypothesis rather than an established empirical result.

AI.tldr: 提出证据校准选择性解码框架，将“视觉证据是否支持候选、校正强度、是否发布答案”三决策分离，并给出数学规范、有界扰动分析与评测协议；但尚未进行模型级实验。
AI.motivation: VQA系统会给出输入图像支撑薄弱的自信回答；对比解码可降低语言先验依赖，但固定校正可能推翻正确答案，而选择性作答又会以降低覆盖率掩盖错误。需要在“校正强度”与“答案发布”之间引入证据与预算约束。
AI.method: 框架含三模块：EVC（Evidence Verification across Crops）通过多裁剪测量视觉支持度与分歧；ACC（Adaptive Contrast Correction）在骨干模型合理候选集内施加有界修正；BSA（Budgeted Selective Answering）在留出图像上校准答案准入阈值。另给出完整数学规格、有界扰动分析与区分强制作答与选择性风险的评测协议。对已发表基线在 MSCOCO 上的 POPE、A-OKVQA、GQA 及四个 MME 子任务做定量再分析。
AI.result: 未报告新实验结果。对公开测量结果的再分析显示，不同骨干、任务与校正设置下存在明显差异，从而支持引入自适应控制的必要性。
AI.conclusion: 框架有效性目前仅是可证伪假设，尚待模型级实证验证；论文价值在于问题分解、理论刻画与评测协议设计。

title: InvarOrd: Self-Supervised Ordinal Knowledge Distillation with Rank-Invariant Alignment for Label-Efficient Cross-Species Hyperspectral Fish Freshness Assessment
summary: Hyperspectral models of fish freshness rarely transfer between species, and labelling a new species is slow and destructive. Freshness is also ordinal, and standard domain alignment can erase that order. We present InvarOrd, which adapts to a new species from 30 labelled cubes (5 per rank) in three stages: self-supervised spectral pretraining on unlabelled source cubes, cross-species alignment by a shrinkage covariance discrepancy computed only within matched ranks, and ordinal distillation into a compact student. The alignment term is provably invariant to the rank means, so it gives no incentive to collapse the ordinal axis. On paired salmon and cod data (800 cubes each, 16 days), a source-trained teacher reaches 1.6 to 1.9 days mean absolute error (MAE) on the other species, with quadratic weighted kappa (QWK) below zero. The 423K-parameter student, 2.54 times smaller than its teacher, attains the lowest MAE (1.476 days) and highest within 1-day accuracy (56.1%) among 14 configurations, matching the best of six ImageNet-pretrained backbones (ConvNeXt-T, 1.503 days) at 66 times fewer parameters, 1.44ms per cube on a GPU and 5s re-adaptation. InvarOrd beats target-only training by 0.29 days (p = 0.031). Among alignment objectives, rank-invariant alignment retains the most ordinal structure (embedding rank correlation 0.183, QWK 0.112), whereas global discrepancy lowers the rank correlation to 0.049 and QWK to zero at only 0.014 days higher MAE.

AI.tldr: InvarOrd通过三阶段域自适应，仅用30个标注样本即可将鱼类新鲜度模型跨物种迁移，且保持序数结构不被对齐过程破坏，得到423K参数、MAE 1.476天的小模型。
AI.motivation: 高光谱鱼类新鲜度模型跨物种迁移性差，新物种标注缓慢且具破坏性；新鲜度本质是序数变量，而标准域对齐方法会抹除序数关系（源模型跨物种QWK低于0）。
AI.method: 三阶段适配：1）在无标注源域数据上做自监督光谱预训练；2）仅在匹配等级内计算收缩协方差差异实现跨物种对齐，该对齐项可证明对等级均值不变，从而不诱导序数轴坍缩；3）序数蒸馏到紧凑学生模型。使用鲑鱼与鳕鱼配对数据（各800个数据立方，16天）。
AI.result: 源域教师跨物种MAE 1.6–1.9天、QWK<0；423K参数学生（小2.54倍）在14种配置中MAE最低（1.476天）、1天内准确率最高（56.1%），与最佳ImageNet预训练骨干ConvNeXt-T（1.503天）相当但参数少66倍，GPU单立方1.44ms、重适配5s；优于仅目标域训练0.29天（p=0.031）。等级不变对齐保留最多序数结构（嵌入秩相关0.183、QWK 0.112），全局差异对齐降至0.049与0，仅多0.014天MAE。
AI.conclusion: 序数感知的等级内对齐可在极少标注下实现高效跨物种新鲜度评估，兼顾精度、序数保真与轻量化部署。

title: Prepare Lighter and Faster for Open-Vocabulary Queries: A Query-Wise 3D Segmenter for Gaussian Splatting
summary: Open-vocabulary 3D understanding aims to localize and segment arbitrary objects beyond predefined categories. However, existing approaches based on Gaussian Splatting often rely on expensive preprocessing and lengthy training, limiting their applicability when fast and lightweight solutions are desired. We propose a lightweight, training-free framework for query-driven 3D instance segmentation on Gaussian Splatting. Instead of conventional mask-wise CLIP embeddings, we use dense pixel-level CLIP features to preserve fine-grained semantic information and enable flexible text-driven localization without relying on predefined instance proposals. Given a text query, we identify a high-quality target region in a carefully selected pivot view and propagate it across views using a video segmentor, providing consistent and comprehensive coverage of the target instance. We then lift the resulting 2D tracklets to 3D Gaussians through a novel visibility voting strategy, yielding accurate 3D segmentation masks with clean object boundaries. Extensive experiments demonstrate state-of-the-art performance on LERF-OVS, ScanNet, and ScanNet++, competitive results on 3D-OVS, and significant speedups over existing open-vocabulary 3D segmentation methods. These results highlight the effectiveness of our framework for efficient open-vocabulary 3D understanding without per-scene training.

AI.tldr: 提出一种轻量、免训练的框架，在3D高斯喷溅（Gaussian Splatting）上实现查询驱动的3D实例分割，无需逐场景训练即可高效完成开放词汇3D理解。
AI.motivation: 现有基于Gaussian Splatting的开放词汇3D方法依赖昂贵的预处理与漫长训练，难以满足快速、轻量化的应用需求。
AI.method: 用稠密像素级CLIP特征替代传统的掩码级CLIP嵌入以保留细粒度语义；对文本查询在精心选取的枢轴视图中定位高质量目标区域，借助视频分割器跨视图传播形成一致的2D轨迹；再通过新颖的可见性投票策略将2D轨迹提升至3D高斯，得到边界干净的3D分割掩码。
AI.result: 在LERF-OVS、ScanNet、ScanNet++上取得SOTA，在3D-OVS上具有竞争力，并相较现有开放词汇3D分割方法显著提速。
AI.conclusion: 该框架在无需逐场景训练的前提下实现了高效、有效的开放词汇3D理解。

title: Size-Matched Nulls Reveal What Block Ablation Measures in MambaVision
summary: Hybrid vision backbones interleave Mamba state-space mixers with self-attention, and a block's role is usually probed by removing it and measuring the damage. We test what that measurement means in MambaVision. On all 50,000 ImageNet validation images and three model sizes, every block ablation is paired with a size-matched null, the same perturbation with its channels shuffled or their signs flipped. In top-1 accuracy and in true-class rank, real and null damage are nearly indistinguishable in absolute terms: pooled over the blocks of MambaVision-T, the content effect lies within [-0.044,+0.016] percentage points (90% interval). Two attention-only controls show that the test detects content, with real ablations worse than their nulls by up to 4.2 points in DeiT-Small and 1.0 point in Swin-T. Part of MambaVision's near-equivalence reflects how little damage its blocks do (0.11--0.34 points on average, against 1.7 and 2.1). Scaled by damage, its content share is comparable to Swin-T's in accuracy, lower in rank, and far below DeiT-Small's: single-block damage in MambaVision is small and mostly positional. Ablation also hides what blocks carry together: removing all blocks of one type compounds damage to 3.7--8.4 times the sum of single effects, far more than size-matched nulls, including nulls that keep the alignment between the blocks' perturbations; for adjacent pairs, aligned nulls reproduce most of it. Freezing input-dependent selection in all Mamba mixers shows that it accounts for 20--32% of the Mamba contribution, mainly through the B and C projections. We turn these results into a protocol for causal attribution in hybrid networks.

AI.tldr: 在MambaVision上，单块消融的损伤与尺寸匹配的随机对照（null）几乎不可区分，说明常规消融无法归因内容贡献；块集体移除呈强超加性，其中选择机制贡献20–32%。
AI.motivation: 混合视觉主干（Mamba状态空间混合器+自注意力）中，常用"移除某块看损伤"来判定块的作用，但作者要检验这一测量在MambaVision里是否真的度量了内容归因。
AI.method: 在全部50,000张ImageNet验证集、三种模型规模上，将每个块消融与尺寸匹配的null（通道打乱或符号翻转）配对；以top-1准确率和真类排名为指标，并加入DeiT-Small、Swin-T注意力-only对照；按损伤幅度归一化比较内容份额；检验同类块集体移除的复合效应（含保持扰动对齐的null）；冻结Mamba混合器中的输入依赖选择。
AI.result: MambaVision-T pooled内容效应仅[-0.044,+0.016]个百分点（90%区间），real与null几乎无差别；对照中DeiT-Small最大差4.2点、Swin-T 1.0点。MambaVision单块平均损伤0.11–0.34点（对照为1.7、2.1点）；归一化后内容份额与Swin-T准确率相当、排名更低、远低于DeiT-Small。整类块移除损伤为单块和的3.7–8.4倍（远超null，仅相邻块对的align null可复现大部分）；冻结选择机制占Mamba贡献20–32%，主要经B、C投影。
AI.conclusion: 单块消融在混合主干中系统性掩盖内容归因与联合效应，作者据此提出混合网络因果归因的实验协议（配对null、损伤归一化、集体移除与对齐对照）。

title: Guided Group Featurizers (GGF): Improving Block-Sparse Featurizers with Object-Guided Learning
summary: Block-sparse featurizers (BSFs) use groups of learned directions to capture the multidimensional structure of visual concepts. However, grouping alone does not ensure that information about a concept is consolidated within a single group. We introduce Guided Group Featurizers (GGF), a novel object-guided extension that uses object annotations for initialization and training while preserving the BSF architecture. We assess whether each group's strongest response regions share an object type, part or material across images. Blinded reviews give GGF groups an average semantic coherence score of $94.1\pm0.9$%, versus $83.0\pm1.9$% for SLiCS and $65.3\pm2.2$% for supervised Vanilla BSF. GGF's consolidation advantage extends to unguided categories: one selected group per category covers $65.6\pm2.4$% of target-containing crops, versus $58.2\pm2.2$% for supervised Vanilla BSF, at approximately 5% false-positive rates for both. Across COCO and VOC, GGF also improves single-group object Capture and localization over Vanilla BSFs, SLiCS and Concept-SAE. Its groups produce more focused and reproducible object responses while supporting recognition and retaining associations under rotation, scale and brightness changes. GGF also uses fewer learned parameters than Concept-SAE and shorter recorded VOC training loops than both supervised alternatives. These findings support object guidance for organizing more interpretable BSF groups and show that response concentration extends to categories excluded from guidance.

AI.tldr: 提出 Guided Group Featurizers (GGF)，利用目标标注引导分组稀疏特征器的初始化与训练，使语义概念在单一组内高度凝聚，显著提升分组语义一致性、单组覆盖率与定位性能。
AI.motivation: 块稀疏特征器（BSF）用成组学习方向刻画视觉概念的多维结构，但仅靠分组并不能保证某概念的信息被整合进同一组内，组内语义凝聚性缺乏保障。
AI.method: 提出 GGF：在保留 BSF 架构的前提下，引入对象引导（object-guided）扩展，用目标标注进行初始化与训练；并以"每组最强响应区域在各图像间是否共享同一目标类型/部件/材质"为指标，通过盲评评估组语义一致性，同时在 COCO、VOC 上比较单组 Capture 与定位。
AI.result: GGF 组平均语义一致性 94.1±0.9%，优于 SLiCS（83.0±1.9%）与监督 Vanilla BSF（65.3±2.2%）；无引导类别上单组覆盖 65.6±2.4% 目标裁剪，Vanilla BSF 为 58.2±2.2%，假阳性率均约 5%；在 COCO/VOC 上单组目标 Capture 与定位均优于 Vanilla BSF、SLiCS 与 Concept-SAE；响应更聚焦且可复现，在旋转、尺度、亮度变化下保持关联，参数量少于 Concept-SAE，VOC 训练循环更短。
AI.conclusion: 目标引导有助于组织更具可解释性的 BSF 分组，且响应凝聚优势可外溢至未参与引导的类别。

title: CARET: Clinical Assertion-Aware Residual Calibration for Medical Image-Text Alignment
summary: Medical vision--language models align radiographs with free-text reports, but radiology language distinguishes explicit findings, negation, uncertainty, and omission. Treating these report states as interchangeable during feature adaptation can change image predictions without supporting visual evidence. We introduce CARET, a parameter-efficient image-side adaptation method that retains pretrained image and text encoders and uses paired positive and negative clinical statements to define a low-dimensional semantic correction space. A bounded residual adjusts image features along these directions, while assertion-aware supervision distinguishes explicitly present and absent findings from uncertain or unmentioned ones. At inference, the adapter requires only an image; textual references remain fixed. In zero-shot classification, CARET achieves 67.80\% accuracy on CheXpert 5$\times$200 and 65.20\% on RSNA. These scores exceed the published CLEFT-LoRA results by 1.06 and 0.27 percentage points, respectively. Comparisons to literature baselines are informative but not controlled for differences in pretraining and evaluation protocols. Ablations across eight components identify the four-state distinction and assertion objective as major contributors, with task-dependent effects for nonmention preservation and pair alignment.

AI.tldr: CARET：参数高效的图像侧适配方法，利用正负临床陈述构建低维语义校正空间，引入断言感知监督区分四类报告状态，零样本分类超过CLEFT-LoRA。
AI.motivation: 医学视觉-语言模型将影像与自由文本报告对齐，但放射学语言区分显式发现、否定、不确定与未提及等状态；在特征适配中将这些状态视为可互换，会在缺乏视觉证据支持的情况下改变图像预测。
AI.method: 保留预训练图像与文本编码器，仅做图像侧参数高效适配；用配对的正/负临床陈述定义低维语义校正空间，通过有界残差沿这些方向调整图像特征；采用断言感知监督，区分明确存在/明确不存在的发现与不确定或未提及的发现；推理时仅需图像，文本参考保持固定。
AI.result: 零样本分类在CheXpert 5×200上达67.80%准确率、RSNA上达65.20%，分别比已发表的CLEFT-LoRA高1.06和0.27个百分点；与文献基线的比较具有参考性，但未控制预训练与评测协议的差异。八组件消融显示四状态区分与断言目标为主要贡献，非提及保留与配对对齐呈任务依赖效应。
AI.conclusion: 将报告断言状态显式建模并注入图像侧适配可提升零样本分类性能，且推理时无需文本输入；但跨研究对比受协议差异限制，贡献度因组件与任务而异。

title: From Retouched Images to Paired Videos: A Synthetic Benchmark for Face Video Retouching
summary: Paired unretouched/retouched face videos are costly to produce because professional editing must remain consistent over time, while releasing identifiable face footage raises privacy, consent, and governance concerns. We present DeepVFR, an initial controlled synthetic benchmark-not a new retouching architecture-for paired face video retouching. Starting from paired synthetic DeepFRR images, Wan2.2 generates mild-motion source clips, and backend-specific face transfer constructs synchronized proxy retouching targets, followed by automatic validity screening and manual visual inspection. DeepVFR contains 1,024 pairs of 150-frame clips at 30 fps, evaluated under an identity-disjoint protocol with explicit frame correspondence; release metadata will record the construction route. Within-benchmark baselines, external checkpoints applied to DeepVFR, qualitative analysis, and a 17-participant ranking study establish reference behavior in the controlled domain. The constructed targets exhibit a substantial low-preference tail in the human study. Because both streams inherit synthetic content and the targets additionally inherit commercial-API or face-transfer artifacts, the benchmark neither replaces artist-retouched captured video nor establishes synthetic-to-real generalization. DeepVFR provides a starting point for paired supervision and controlled evaluation. Data, individual study rankings, and training logs will be made publicly available upon acceptance. Broader motion coverage and real-video validation remain future work.

AI.tldr: DeepVFR 是一个用于成对人脸视频修图（retouching）的受控合成基准，包含 1,024 对 150 帧 30fps 片段，采用身份不重叠协议与显式帧对应，提供基线、定性分析与 17 人排序研究作为参考。
AI.motivation: 真实成对的未修图/修图人脸视频制作成本高：专业编辑需长期保持一致，且发布可识别的人脸素材带来隐私、知情同意与治理风险。因此需要一个可控的合成替代基准。
AI.method: 从成对的合成 DeepFRR 图像出发，用 Wan2.2 生成轻度运动的源片段；再通过后端特定的 face transfer 构建同步的代理修图目标；随后进行自动有效性筛选与人工目视检查。最终得到 1,024 对 150 帧、30fps 的片段，并在身份不重叠协议下评估，附显式帧对应关系，发布元数据记录构建路径。
AI.result: 在基准内基线、将外部 checkpoint 应用于 DeepVFR、定性分析以及 17 名参与者的排序研究共同确立了该受控域内的参考行为；构建的目标在人类研究中呈现明显的低偏好长尾。
AI.conclusion: 由于两条流均继承合成内容、目标流还继承商业 API 或人脸迁移伪影，该基准既不能替代艺术家修图的真实视频，也不确立合成到真实的泛化能力；DeepVFR 只是成对监督与受控评估的起点，更广的运动覆盖与真实视频验证留待未来工作。

title: Detection Is Not the Finish Line: Multiscale Decoding and Constraint-Aware Global Association for Multi-Camera 3D Tracking
summary: A query-based multi-view 3D detector can transfer well to a new calibrated camera network and still produce badly fragmented tracks: on the AI City Challenge 2026 Track 1 validation set, the frozen Sparse4D detector behind the official challenge winner splits each Person identity into a median of eight fragments, and half of the gaps between fragments exceed the horizon of a causal tracker. We show that most of the remaining headroom of such a system lies after detection. Keeping the public detector frozen, we add (i) class-wise source selection between two input scales, which recovers small and distant people from a 0.75x pass while leaving large objects at the scale the detector was trained for; (ii) a geometry-to-appearance bridge that projects every 3D box into all calibrated views, matches it to 2D person detections, and aggregates robust track-level re-identification descriptors; and (iii) constraint-aware consolidation, which combines a causal short-gap stitch with offline centroid-linkage clustering under two hard constraints, temporal exclusion and metric 3D reachability, plus class-aware long-gap stitching for rigid objects. Every association stage changes object identities only. On the challenge evaluation server the system scores 62.3947 3D HOTA (DetA 57.4501, AssA 56.8131, LocA 80.1272), first on the general leaderboard snapshot of 30 October 2026 (second at the time of writing, after a competitor's detector update) and 5.63 points above our reproduction of the official winner; the constrained association stage alone contributes +3.73 HOTA through a +5.49 AssA gain at unchanged DetA. Controlled fixed-box validation studies, a constraint ablation, sensitivity curves, and a catalogue of negative results support the design.

AI.tldr: 该论文指出基于query的多视角3D检测器在冻结状态下仍会产生严重碎片化轨迹（AI City Challenge 2026 Track 1验证集上每人身份中位数为8段），并将增益空间定位在检测之后。其核心贡献是：冻结公开检测器，仅通过尺度级类别选择、几何到外观桥接（跨视角2D匹配聚合ReID描述子）与约束感知的轨迹整合（因果短间隙拼接 + 离线质心聚类，约束为时间互斥与度量3D可达性，以及刚性物体长间隙拼接）提升关联性能。结果：评测服务器3D HOTA 62.3947（DetA 57.4501、AssA 56.8131、LocA 80.1272），较官方冠军复现高5.63 HOTA，单独关联阶段贡献+3.73 HOTA（AssA +5.49，DetA不变）。
AI.motivation: 基于query的多视角3D检测器虽可迁移到新标定相机网络，但冻结检测器输出的轨迹严重碎片化：验证集上每个Person身份中位被切分为8段，且半数片段间隙超出因果跟踪器的时间视野。作者论证此类系统剩余性能上限主要位于检测之后的后处理关联环节，而非检测本身。
AI.method: (i) 类别级源选择：在两个输入尺度间按类别选择，0.75x通道恢复小而远的人，大目标保留在检测器原训练尺度；(ii) 几何—外观桥接：将每个3D框投影到所有标定视角，与2D行人检测匹配，聚合鲁棒的轨迹级ReID描述子；(iii) 约束感知整合：因果短间隙拼接与离线质心连接聚类，在时间互斥与度量3D可达性两项硬约束下运行，另对刚性物体做类别感知长间隙拼接；所有关联阶段仅改变对象身份。实验含固定框验证研究、约束消融、敏感度曲线与负结果目录。
AI.result: 在挑战评测服务器上得3D HOTA 62.3947（DetA 57.4501，AssA 56.8131，LocA 80.1272），于2026年10月30日总榜快照位列第一（撰写时因竞争方检测器更新位列第二），较官方冠军复现高5.63 HOTA；仅约束关联阶段在DetA不变下通过AssA +5.49带来+3.73 HOTA。
AI.conclusion: 在检测器冻结前提下，轨迹碎片化是主要性能瓶颈，检测后关联是高效增益来源；多阶段关联设计（尺度选择、几何—外观桥接、约束感知整合）可在不提升DetA的情况下显著提升AssA与总体HOTA，并通过消融与负结果验证各组件必要性。

title: Do VLMs Really Look at the Road? A Diagnostic Evaluation for Autonomous Driving
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) are increasingly being evaluated for autonomous driving through question-answering benchmarks, yet high benchmark accuracy does not necessarily reflect visually grounded reasoning. We present a diagnostic evaluation framework that systematically probes whether VLMs base safety-critical driving decisions on visual evidence or instead rely on language priors, answer biases, and dataset regularities. Our benchmark comprises two task categories, Adverse Weather and Junctions \& Intersections, with a nuScenes spatial reasoning extension, and evaluates open-source (general, driving, and spatial-reasoning) VLMs along four diagnostic protocols: image versus no-image evaluation, counterfactual weather sensitivity, linguistic robustness under paraphrasing and negation, and spatial reasoning. All ground-truth labels are derived programmatically from BDD100K and DriveLM annotations, enabling reproducible evaluation without manual labeling. Across all models, we find that competitive overall accuracy conceals systematic failure modes, including strong affirmation bias, limited sensitivity to counterfactual scene changes, near-chance performance on negated questions despite high paraphrase consistency, and confident driving decisions even without visual input. These results demonstrate that current open-source VLMs remain insufficiently grounded for safety-critical autonomous driving and underscore the need for diagnostic evaluation beyond aggregate accuracy.

AI.tldr: 提出诊断式评测框架，系统检验开源VLM在自动驾驶问答中是否真正基于视觉证据推理，发现高准确率掩盖了肯定偏差、反事实不敏感、否定近随机等接地失败。
AI.motivation: 现有VLM自动驾驶基准多以问答准确率为指标，但高准确率未必反映视觉接地推理；模型可能依赖语言先验、答案偏差与数据集规律，对安全关键决策构成隐患。作者因此需要区分"真接地"与"伪相关"的诊断性评测。
AI.method: 构建诊断式评测框架，含Adverse Weather与Junctions & Intersections两类任务，并扩展nuScenes空间推理；评测通用、驾驶专用与空间推理三类开源VLM；采用四项诊断协议：有图/无图对比、反事实天气敏感性、改写与否定下的语言鲁棒性、空间推理；真值由BDD100K与DriveLM标注程序化生成，无需人工标注，保证可复现。
AI.result: 所有模型均呈现"整体准确率尚可但存在系统性失效"的模式：强烈肯定偏差（affirmation bias）；对反事实场景变化敏感度低；否定问题接近随机水平，尽管改写一致性较高；无视觉输入时仍给出高置信驾驶决策。
AI.conclusion: 当前开源VLM对安全关键自动驾驶而言视觉接地不足，聚合准确率不足以作为评测依据；应推广诊断式、多协议评测以揭示失效模式。

title: WA-JEPA: Goal-Aware Predictive Feedback Action Refinement for a World-Action Model
comment: 16 pages, 5 figures, including supplementary material. Code available at https://github.com/Dovisya/WA-JEPA
summary: JEPA-based world models predict action consequences in latent space, but representative planning approaches rely on candidate-action search, requiring repeated evaluation of action sequences and incurring substantial online computational cost. Direct action generation avoids this search, yet how to leverage latent predictions to guide action generation given task goals remains a key challenge in translating learned physical dynamics into effective decisions. We introduce WA-JEPA, a world-action model that couples action generation, action-conditioned latent prediction, and goal-aware feedback. The model first generates an action proposal and predicts the resulting future scenes and proprioceptive states, then refines the proposal through two complementary feedback paths, using the task goal as a reference. Goal-discrepancy residual feedback (GDRF) uses differences between the latent representations of predicted scenes and the task goal to guide chunk-wise action refinement. Future-scene context feedback (FSCF) preserves fine-grained predicted scene representations to guide subsequent action refinement. Jointly learned from offline demonstrations, this process iteratively updates the same plan before execution, making future predictions directly participate in action generation without candidate-action search. We evaluate short-horizon goal reaching, long-horizon tasks, and full-task execution. The results show that goal-aware predictive feedback supports competitive task performance while maintaining a compact model and low online computational cost. Code is available at https://github.com/Dovisya/WA-JEPA.

AI.tldr: WA-JEPA将动作生成与动作条件隐空间预测、目标感知反馈耦合，用预测的未来场景残差迭代精修动作块，无需候选动作搜索即可生成动作。
AI.motivation: JEPA式世界模型虽能在隐空间预测动作后果，但主流规划依赖候选动作搜索，需反复评估动作序列，在线计算开销大；而直接动作生成虽免去搜索，却缺少利用隐空间预测在给定任务目标下引导动作生成的有效机制。
AI.method: 提出WA-JEPA世界-动作模型：先由动作生成器给出动作提案，并预测由此产生的未来场景与本体状态；再以任务目标为参照，通过两条互补反馈路径精修提案——目标差异残差反馈（GDRF）用预测场景与目标隐表示的差异进行块级动作精修，未来场景上下文反馈（FSCF）保留细粒度预测场景表征引导后续精修；整体由离线示教联合学习，在执行前对同一计划迭代更新。
AI.result: 在短时域目标到达、长时域任务及完整任务执行上评估，目标感知的预测反馈在保持紧凑模型与低在线计算成本的同时取得有竞争力的任务性能。
AI.conclusion: 将未来预测直接参与动作生成、以目标差异反馈替代候选动作搜索，是衔接学习到的物理动力学与有效决策的可行路径。

title: DecoEdit: Beyond Flat Control for 3D-Aware Unified Image Editing
summary: While recent advances in multimodal image editing have achieved impressive results, current frameworks remain largely confined to ``flat" 2D controls (e.g., text prompts, bounding boxes, or masks). Precise 3D-aware geometric manipulation -- such as coordinating an object's location, physical scale, and 3D orientation while strictly preserving its fine-grained identity -- remains an elusive challenge, typically suffering from severe detail degradation or requiring expensive per-instance fine-tuning. In this paper, we present DecoEdit, an all-in-one image editing framework that goes beyond flat control by seamlessly integrating 1D textual, 2D spatial, and 3D volumetric inputs under a unified architecture. First, to power this unified model, we establish a data curation pipeline and curate a large-scale dataset, namely DecoDataset, containing 1.6 million samples, encompassing diverse multi-dimensional (1D/2D/3D) tasks and their complex compositions. Furthermore, we establish a comprehensive image editing benchmark named DecoBench to systematically evaluate multi-task editing performance. Finally, to address the fundamental trade-off between complex spatial transformations and identity preservation, we propose a novel decoupled pipeline: DecoEdit factorizes the editing process by utilizing structural guidance from SAM-3D to anchor the target geometry, scale, and spatial orientation, while concurrently leveraging a detail-preservation path to lock in high-fidelity textures. Extensive experiments demonstrate that DecoEdit achieves state-of-the-art results. Notably, on the challenging 3D spatial pose and orientation control tasks, DecoEdit significantly outperforms leading closed-source models such as Seedream 5.0 in both geometric accuracy and identity consistency.

AI.tldr: 提出DecoEdit统一图像编辑框架，将1D文本、2D空间与3D体素控制整合到同一架构，配套构建1.6M样本的DecoDataset与DecoBench基准，并通过解耦式流程（SAM-3D结构引导+细节保持路径）实现3D感知几何操控下的高保真身份保持，性能超越Seedream 5.0等闭源模型。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态图像编辑框架局限于"扁平"的2D控制（文本提示、边界框、掩码），难以精确操控物体的位置、物理尺度与三维朝向，同时严格保持细粒度身份；此类3D几何操控往往导致严重细节退化，或需昂贵的逐实例微调。
AI.method: 1) 建立数据策管管线，构建含160万样本的大规模数据集DecoDataset，覆盖1D/2D/3D多维度任务及其复合组合；2) 构建综合评测基准DecoBench；3) 提出解耦编辑管线：利用SAM-3D提供的结构引导锚定目标几何、尺度与空间朝向，同时并行一条细节保持路径锁定高保真纹理。
AI.result: 大量实验表明DecoEdit取得SOTA效果；在具有挑战性的3D空间姿态与朝向控制任务上，其几何精度与身份一致性均显著优于Seedream 5.0等领先闭源模型。
AI.conclusion: 通过统一1D/2D/3D控制接口与结构-细节解耦设计，DecoEdit有效缓解了复杂空间变换与身份保持之间的固有权衡，实现了精确3D感知几何操控下的高保真编辑，并配套数据与基准推动该方向系统化研究。

title: Neural Latent Gaussian Process for 3D reconstruction of Mouse Brain Lipids
summary:
We address the problem of reconstructing continuous three-dimensional lipid profiles of the mouse brain from lipid measurements acquired only on a sparse set of two-dimensional tissue sections. Using MALDI-MSI measurements from coronal sections of two densely sampled and six sparsely sampled mouse brains, registered to the Allen Mouse Brain Common Coordinate Framework (CCF), we seek to interpolate the measured hundreds of lipid profiles across the unobserved voxels of the reference brain. We introduce a Neural Latent-Space Gaussian Process (LGP) architecture for this task and critically evaluate its ability to reconstruct spatial lipid distributions, using held-out mouse brain sections to assess generalization.
  We propose a Gaussian Process prior for the distribution of low-dimensional lipid profiles across the mouse brain (with Matérn or a Riemann manifold kernel). This allows us to encode 3D coordinates in a small number of latent 3D volumes that are then mapped to particular lipids using a multilayer perceptron (MLP). We performed an exhaustive analysis over a range of algorithms from simple linear regression, XGBoost, MLP to state of the art models such as Neural Transcriptomic Field, graph-based SPA3D for spatial omics reconstruction and DEEPSPATIAL. We additionally evaluate GPLFR as an alternative Gaussian-process-based approach.
  Across 173 measured lipids, LGP outperforms all evaluated baselines, including recent spatial-omics models and GPLFR, achieving a mean correlation of 0.613 and demonstrating the effectiveness of our approach for sparse 3D lipid interpolation.

AI.tldr: 提出神经隐空间高斯过程（LGP）模型，从稀疏二维脑切片MALDI-MSI脂质测量中重建小鼠脑连续三维脂质分布，在173种脂质上平均相关系数0.613，优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: MALDI-MSI脂质测量仅在稀疏二维切片上获得，而完整三维脂质体分布未被观测，需在参考脑（Allen CCF）未观测体素上插值重建，以获取连续三维脂质图谱。
AI.method: 对低维脂质剖面在脑内分布施加高斯过程先验（Matérn核或黎曼流形核），将三维坐标编码为少量隐三维体，再经多层感知机（MLP）映射到具体脂质；数据来自2个密集采样与6个稀疏采样小鼠脑冠状切片，配准至Allen CCF。与线性回归、XGBoost、MLP、Neural Transcriptomic Field、SPA3D、DEEPSPATIAL及GPLFR等基线做穷尽对比，并用留出切片评估泛化。
AI.result: 在173种脂质上，LGP平均相关系数达0.613，优于所有基线（含近期空间组学模型与GPLFR）。
AI.conclusion: 高斯过程先验结合隐空间映射能有效实现稀疏三维脂质插值，验证了LGP在该重建任务上的有效性。

title: Floorplan-Context-Aware Cross-Environment Human Activity Recognition from mmWave Radar Point Clouds
summary: Human activity recognition (HAR) models based on mmWave radar point clouds and trained in controlled open spaces often experience performance degradation when deployed in furnished rooms. We propose a Floorplan-Context-Aware (FCA) HAR enhancement method that augments the input with subject-furniture relative position information to improve cross-environment performance. Because existing mmWave point-cloud datasets lack registered floorplans, we introduce a pseudo-landmark augmentation strategy for training the FCA model. In cross-environment evaluation on the mm-ADL-Home dataset, FCA achieves 77.70% accuracy and 65.49% macro-F1, improving upon the point-cloud-only direct-transfer baseline by 10.73 and 10.05 percentage points, respectively, and exceeding the strongest evaluated adaptation baseline by 7.37 and 6.27 percentage points. At deployment, FCA requires only a one-time registration of furniture landmarks, with no target-domain activity annotations or model weight updates.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Floorplan-Context-Aware (FCA)的毫米波雷达点云人体活动识别增强方法，通过引入受试者—家具相对位置信息提升跨环境泛化能力，并借助伪地标增强策略解决缺乏配准平面图数据集的问题。
AI.motivation: 基于毫米波雷达点云的HAR模型多在受控开阔空间训练，部署到有家具的房间时性能显著下降；现有毫米波点云数据集缺少配准平面图，难以直接利用空间上下文信息。
AI.method: 在输入中增强受试者与家具的相对位置信息；由于缺乏配准平面图，提出伪地标增强策略用于训练FCA模型；部署阶段仅需一次性家具地标配准，无需目标域活动标注或权重更新。
AI.result: 在mm-ADL-Home数据集跨环境评估中，FCA达到77.70%准确率和65.49% macro-F1，较仅点云直接迁移基线分别提升10.73与10.05个百分点，较最强适配基线分别高出7.37与6.27个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 引入平面图上下文的空间相对位置信息可有效缓解雷达HAR模型的跨环境性能退化，且部署成本低（仅一次性地标配准），具备实际落地价值。

title: HEmIF-Bench: Benchmarking H&E-to-mIF Models BeyondVirtual-StainFidelity
summary: Hematoxylin and eosin (H&E)-to-multiplex immunofluorescence (mIF) generators predict spatial protein expression from routine histology, yet pixel-level marker reconstruction does not establish downstream utility. We present HEmIF-Bench, evaluating five frozen generators across eight datasets spanning molecular, cellular, tissue, and patient scales. HEmIF-Bench decouples internal encoder features from generated outputs, benchmarking both against the pathology foundation reference UNI2. Mirroring the clinical workflow where pathologists rely on mIF to define cell phenotypes, delineate tertiary lymphoid structures (TLSs) and germinal centers (GCs), and stratify patient risk, we evaluate external CD3 recovery, single-cell classification, dense nuclear segmentation, TLS/GC segmentation, and patient survival prediction. Across the benchmark, foundation-model-based MIPHEI-ViT leads among the generators, while non-foundation models show task-specific strengths. Comparing the two routes reveals that internal encoder features generally outperform generated outputs, and larger output marker panels do not guarantee stronger downstream utility across datasets. Moreover, neither internal encoder features nor generated outputs consistently surpass frozen UNI2. These findings show that pixel-level stain fidelity does not equate to downstream utility, and that generators trained at current paired-data scales have yet to surpass large-scale pure-H&E foundation models. With the expansion of paired translation cohorts and the advancement of foundation-based generative architectures, HEmIF-Bench establishes a definitive benchmark for tracking when H&E-to-mIF generation crosses the threshold to deliver genuine value beyond routine histology for tumor microenvironment analysis and precision oncology.

AI.tldr: HEmIF-Bench 系统评估5个冻结的H&E→mIF生成器在8个数据集上的下游效用，发现像素级染色保真度并不等同于下游价值，现有生成器尚未超越大规模纯H&E基础模型UNI2。
AI.motivation: 现有H&E→多重免疫荧光（mIF）生成器仅以像素级标志物重建为评价目标，无法证明其在下游临床任务中的实际价值，缺乏统一、以效用为导向的评测基准。
AI.method: 构建HEmIF-Bench，覆盖分子、细胞、组织、患者四个尺度共8个数据集；评测5个冻结生成器；将内部编码器特征与生成输出解耦，并均以病理基础模型UNI2为参照；模拟临床流程设置5项外部任务：CD3恢复、单细胞分类、密集细胞核分割、TLS/GC分割、患者生存预测。
AI.result: 基于基础模型的MIPHEI-ViT在生成器中整体领先，非基础模型呈任务特异性优势；内部编码器特征普遍优于生成输出；更大的输出标志物面板并不保证更强的下游效用；内部特征与生成输出均未能稳定超越冻结的UNI2。
AI.conclusion: 像素级染色保真度不等于下游效用；在当前配对数据规模下训练的生成器尚未超越大规模纯H&E基础模型。HEmIF-Bench为追踪H&E→mIF生成何时真正超越常规组织学、服务肿瘤微环境分析与精准肿瘤学提供了权威基准。

title: Beyond Vehicle-Centric Data: Scaling Autonomous Driving through Roadside-to-Vehicle Generation
summary: Training autonomous driving models requires large and diverse datasets, collected primarily by vehicles. Scaling them entails investment in fleet operation, data processing and annotation. Road infrastructure records traffic and multi-vehicle interactions, yet the viewpoint gap between roadside and onboard sensors limits its direct use for training. Here we introduce AnyR2V, a framework that transforms multimodal roadside observations into seven-camera surround-view videos for different vehicle perspectives. It aggregates sequential observations into a shared scene representation of geometry and road-user motion, then renders appearance, depth and layout conditions along target-vehicle trajectories. Supervised by spatiotemporally aligned roadside-vehicle pairs, AnyR2V generates surround-view videos guided by scene structure and road-user motion. Existing roadside 3D bounding boxes are transformed into target-vehicle coordinates and paired with generated images, allowing one traffic recording and its annotations to yield training data from multiple vehicle perspectives. We construct R2V360, a dataset of 89 real traffic sequences at an urban intersection, with aligned multimodal roadside data and onboard surround-view videos. AnyR2V outperforms six scene reconstruction methods in image fidelity and in depth and semantic agreement between generated and real onboard images. We further evaluate generated videos along other vehicles' trajectories by adding them to real training data. Adding generated frames equal to 50% of the original real training frame count improves mean average precision (mAP) by 3.3-3.4 AP-points across three 3D object detectors on the real onboard test set, relative to real-data-only baselines. These results demonstrate that roadside traffic records can provide training data from multiple vehicle perspectives, offering a new data source for autonomous driving.

AI.tldr: AnyR2V将路侧多模态观测转换为七相机环视视频，实现单次路侧记录生成多车视角训练数据，并构建R2V360数据集；生成数据可使3D检测mAP提升3.3-3.4。
AI.motivation: 自动驾驶模型需要大规模多样数据，主要靠车队采集，扩展成本高；路侧基础设施虽记录交通与多车交互，但路侧与车载视角差异限制了其直接用于训练。
AI.method: 将序列化路侧观测聚合为几何与道路使用者运动的共享场景表示，沿目标车辆轨迹渲染外观、深度与布局条件；以时空对齐的路侧-车载数据对监督，生成受场景结构与运动引导的环视视频；并将路侧3D框转换到目标车坐标系与生成图像配对；构建89条城市路口真实交通序列的R2V360数据集。
AI.result: 在图像保真度及生成与真实车载图像的深度、语义一致性上优于六种场景重建方法；将生成帧加入真实训练数据（生成帧量为真实的50%）后，三个3D检测器在真实车载测试集上mAP提升3.3-3.4 AP点。
AI.conclusion: 路侧交通记录可作为多车视角训练数据来源，为自动驾驶提供新的数据来源。

title: Fine-Grained RLAIF for Visual Safety: Learning to Zoom into Hazards for Multimodal Safety Alignment
summary: Recent multimodal safety alignment heavily relies on a text-centric paradigm, assuming risks are explicit in language or globally prominent in images. However, real-world hazards are often visually subtle or peripheral, causing existing models to fail due to their reliance on coarse, global visual representations. In this work, we study fine-grained visual safety alignment and introduce a challenging 1,200-sample benchmark across four domains, where hazards necessitate localized inspection. To address this, we propose Fine-Grained RLAIF (FGR), a reinforcement learning framework that casts image zoom-in as a learnable perception policy. FGR employs a decomposed reward design to jointly align three core safety behaviors: (i) where to look via a visual evidence reward, (ii) when to act via a tool-formatting constraint, and (iii) how to reason via visually grounded safety explanations. FGR achieves accuracy ranging from 86.71% to 93.00%, consistently outperforming strong multimodal and agent-based baselines.

AI.tldr: 提出细粒度视觉安全对齐问题：真实风险常局部细微，现有以文本为中心的对齐依赖粗粒度全局视觉表征而失效；构建1200样本四域基准并提出Fine-Grained RLAIF（FGR），将图像放大作为可学习感知策略，通过分解奖励联合对齐"看哪里、何时动作、如何推理"，准确率86.71%–93.00%，优于强多模态与智能体基线。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态安全对齐依赖"文本中心"范式，假设风险在语言中显式表达或在图像中全局显著。但现实危险往往视觉上细微或处于边角区域，模型依赖粗粒度全局视觉表征难以定位，导致识别失败，因此需研究细粒度视觉安全对齐。
AI.method: 构建覆盖四个领域、需局部细查的1200样本基准；提出Fine-Grained RLAIF（FGR）强化学习框架，将图像局部放大视为可学习的感知策略，并采用分解式奖励设计，分别通过视觉证据奖励（看哪里）、工具格式约束（何时动作）与视觉落地的安全解释（如何推理）联合对齐三类核心安全行为。
AI.result: FGR取得86.71%至93.00%的准确率，在细粒度安全基准上稳定超越强多模态基线及智能体（agent-based）基线。
AI.conclusion: 将局部放大显式建模为可学习的感知策略并结合多维度分解奖励，是缓解"文本中心"粗粒度视觉表征局限、实现细粒度视觉安全对齐的有效途径。

title: From Cloud to Edge: A Fully Local Pipeline for Pothole Risk Assessment and Driver Warning Generation
comment: 23 pages, 8 figures, 7 tables. And submitted to MDPI Sensors
summary: Vision-language models can turn road images into clear, geometry-aware pothole warnings, but current systems depend on commercial cloud services. Our earlier five-stage pipeline needed two cloud calls per scene, taking about 20 s and USD 0.105, and could not run offline. We rebuild every stage to run on a single local GPU and evaluate it with the same data, prompts, and protocol. Segmentation keeps the original Segment Anything weights but runs them in half precision with graph compilation, which makes it 2.7x faster without changing any downstream risk class; five lightweight variants could not match its masks on small road defects. Severity is graded by six ConvNeXt students distilled from 3092 cloud labels. They reach Cohen's kappa = 0.268 against human consensus at 28 ms per pothole, close to the cloud model's 0.321, within the camera setup they were trained for. A local 8-billion-parameter vision-language model writes the warnings under a grammar that admits only in-lane maneuvers. Three blind, independent raters scored these warnings safer than the cloud warnings (4.18 vs. 3.65 of 5; p = 0.001; 50 scenes) and equally clear, whereas an automated LLM judge ranked them the other way. The complete pipeline runs at 1.27 s per scene, 16x faster than the cloud system, offline and at no per-scene cost.

AI.tldr: 将原本依赖云端的多阶段路面坑洞预警流程全部重建为单块本地GPU上的离线流水线，速度提升16倍且无单场景成本，生成的警告经三名盲评员评价更安全。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉-语言坑洞预警系统依赖商业云服务：原五阶段流水线每场景需两次云调用，约20秒、0.105美元，且无法离线运行，成本、时延与部署可及性受限。
AI.method: 用相同数据、提示与协议逐阶段本地化重建：(1)分割沿用SAM原始权重，改为半精度+图编译；(2)严重程度用6个ConvNeXt学生模型从3092个云标签蒸馏，输出风险等级；(3)由本地80亿参数视觉-语言模型在仅允许车道内机动的语法约束下生成警告。评测含5个轻量分割变体对照、与云模型kappa比较、三名盲评员打分及自动LLM评审对照。
AI.result: 半精度+图编译使分割提速2.7倍且不改变下游风险类别，5个轻量变体在小路面缺陷上掩码质量不及原模型；严重度学生模型与人工共识Cohen's kappa=0.268（云模型0.321），每坑洞28 ms；警告安全性盲评4.18 vs 3.65（满分5，p=0.001，50场景），清晰度持平，但自动LLM评审给出相反排序；整条流水线1.27秒/场景。
AI.conclusion: 全本地离线流水线在保持分割与风险分级质量接近云端的同时，实现16倍加速、零单场景成本，并产出经人工盲评更安全的警告；同时揭示自动LLM评审与人类判断不一致，提示此类评测需谨慎使用。

title: ReScene: Incremental Scene Chronology from Sparse Revisits
summary: Scene chronology aims to reconstruct a scene across visits separated by hours or days, during which objects may change in position, presence or shape. Such reconstruction must retain every earlier state, yet each revisit often provides only a few images. Storing a complete model for each visit duplicates the unchanged scene, whereas updating a single shared model alters earlier states. We present ReScene, which stores each visit as an immutable compact update, so that any earlier visit can be recovered exactly by applying the stored updates in order, without retaining past images. To localise each update, ReScene attributes the disagreement between the preceding reconstruction and the new images to individual Gaussians through their compositing weights. This attribution guides the suppression of outdated Gaussians and the refinement of persistent ones, while newly visible surfaces are initialised from learned multi-view depth. We also introduce Multi-State, a benchmark of non-rigid deformation and partial material removal, including synthetic scenes with ground-truth geometry. ReScene achieves quality higher than sequential 3DGS checkpointing with 2.5--4.8$\times$ less uncompressed history storage. At comparable PSNR, it also reduces foreground depth error by 3.2$\times$ relative to sequential ChronoGS, showing that accurate rendering does not necessarily imply accurate geometry. Code and benchmark are available at https://waychin-weiqin.github.io/ReScene/.

AI.tldr: ReScene 将每次访问存为不可变的紧凑增量更新，按序应用即可精确恢复任意历史访问；配合新的 Multi-State 基准，在存储与几何精度上优于顺序 3DGS/ChronoGS。
AI.motivation: 场景随时间（小时/天）多次访问后物体位置、存在性、形状会变化，重建需保留全部历史状态。但每次重访仅有少量图像：为每次访问单独存完整模型会重复存储未变场景，而更新单一共享模型又会破坏历史状态——需在"存储冗余"与"历史一致性"之间取得平衡。
AI.method: 1) 每次访问以不可变(immutable)紧凑增量更新形式存储，按顺序应用更新即可无损恢复任意早期访问，无需保留历史图像；2) 利用高斯合成权重(compositing weights)将"前序重建与新图像之间的不一致"归因到各个高斯，用于抑制过时高斯并精化持续存在的高斯；3) 新出现表面由学习到的多视图深度初始化；4) 提出 Multi-State 基准，含非刚性形变与部分材质移除，并提供具有真值几何的合成场景。
AI.result: 质量优于顺序 3DGS checkpointing，且未压缩历史存储减少 2.5–4.8×；在相当 PSNR 下，前景深度误差相对顺序 ChronoGS 降低 3.2×，表明渲染精度高并不必然意味着几何准确。
AI.conclusion: 以"不可变增量更新+高斯级不一致归因"实现可精确回溯的场景时序重建，兼顾存储效率与几何一致性；并揭示渲染质量与几何精度可解耦，需以深度指标单独评估。

title: InterRSGaussian: Interactive Multi-view Instance Segmentation for 3D Remote Sensing Scenes
summary: Remote sensing image segmentation plays a critical role in various applications. Interactive instance segmentation, a specialized task within image segmentation, aims to generate precise segmentation results for target objects based on user input prompts. However, previous studies on interactive instance segmentation primarily focus on single-view images, limiting their ability to comprehensively understand complex 3D remote sensing scenes. In this study, we extend interactive instance segmentation from a single-view to a multi-view framework, which can also be easily converted to a 3D segmentation format, thus achieving more accurate and comprehensive 3D remote sensing scene perception across multiple views. First, we construct a multi-view interactive instance segmentation dataset for remote sensing, comprising five distinct scenes, each captured from about one hundred different views. Second, we propose InterRSGaussian, a novel instance segmentation method based on 3D Gaussians. InterRSGaussian enables users to provide point clicks on target objects from any arbitrary view and generates view-consistent instance segmentation results across all input views without requiring manual annotations. The resulting multi-view segmentation can further be projected onto 3D point clouds for 3D segmentation. To improve training efficiency and segmentation performance, we introduce a prior distillation network for initialization. Overall, this study extends traditional 2D remote sensing scene perception into a 3D multi-view framework, enabling a more comprehensive understanding of target objects in complex environments with user interactivity.

AI.tldr: 该论文将交互式实例分割从单视图扩展到多视图，构建遥感多视图交互实例分割数据集，并提出基于3D高斯的InterRSGaussian方法，实现跨视图一致的实例分割并可投影为3D点云分割。
AI.motivation: 现有交互式实例分割研究主要针对单视图图像，难以全面理解复杂的三维遥感场景；因此需要从单视图扩展到多视图框架，以获得更准确、更完整的3D遥感场景感知。
AI.method: 1）构建遥感多视图交互实例分割数据集，包含五个不同场景、每场景约一百个视角；2）提出InterRSGaussian，基于3D高斯表示，用户可在任意视角对目标对象进行点点击，无需人工标注即可在所有输入视角生成视图一致的实例分割结果，并可将结果投影到3D点云实现3D分割；3）引入先验蒸馏网络进行初始化，以提升训练效率和分割性能。
AI.result: 所提方法支持任意视角点点击交互，能够在所有输入视角生成视图一致的实例分割，并可投影到3D点云获得3D分割；先验蒸馏初始化提升了训练效率与分割性能。
AI.conclusion: 该研究将传统2D遥感场景感知扩展为3D多视图框架，在用户交互条件下实现对复杂环境中目标对象更全面的理解。

title: BlockAlign: Preference Optimization for Trajectory-Distilled Video Generation
summary: Directly aligning trajectory-distilled video generators slashes rollout costs and optimizes the deployed few-step model without teacher fine-tuning or re-distillation. However, conventional flow-matching preference objectives assume single-head local velocity supervision, mismatching the finite-interval, block-average transition interface of trajectory-distilled generators such as Parallel Decoding Distillation (PDD) and Parametric Trajectory Distillation (PTD). Naively supervising only the primary initial-subinterval velocity sub-head rather than the fused block-average velocity at block starts (DirectAlign) induces a severe training--inference mismatch that degrades quality below the unaligned baseline. We introduce BlockAlign, an interface-consistent preference optimization framework that constructs states at valid block boundaries, queries the fused block-level velocity predictor, and supervises span-normalized transition residuals-seamlessly supporting DPO-, NFT-, and rollout-style objectives while preserving the native few-step sampler. We further build a unified post-training pipeline integrating offline pairs, reward-free semi-online continuations, and online rollouts with hierarchical preference selection and objective-aware block scheduling. Experiments on multi-reference video generation across MiniMax-H3 Ref2VA and an in-house model RefVid-V4 show that BlockAlign consistently outperforms unaligned distilled models and DirectAlign in structural plausibility, reference consistency, and visual quality. Notably, our approach unlocks PDD's 5x few-step rollout speedup for 3x faster end-to-end online training, achieving statistically significant human preference gains over PDD baselines (54.0% vs. 33.3% wins/losses, or 61.8% non-tie win rate on RefVid-V4; 51.3% vs. 34.7%, or 59.7% non-tie win rate on MiniMax-H3) and up to an 82.7% win rate against DirectAlign.

AI.tldr: 本文提出BlockAlign，一个与轨迹蒸馏生成器"块平均转移接口"一致的对齐式偏好优化框架，解决直接对齐导致的训练-推理失配问题，在多种多参考视频生成模型上显著提升结构合理性、参考一致性与画质，并实现3倍加速的端到端在线训练。
AI.motivation: 轨迹蒸馏视频生成器（如PDD、PTD）以有限区间、块平均的转移接口进行少步采样，而常规flow-matching偏好目标假设单头局部速度监督，二者不匹配。若仅监督初始子区间的速度子头（DirectAlign），会产生严重的训练-推理失配，使对齐后质量甚至低于未对齐基线，因此需要与原生采样接口一致的偏好优化方法。
AI.method: BlockAlign：在合法块边界构造状态，查询融合的块级速度预测器，并对跨度归一化的转移残差进行监督，从而无缝支持DPO、NFT与rollout类目标，同时保留原生少步采样器。此外构建统一后训练流水线，整合离线成对数据、无奖励半在线续训与在线rollout，并采用分层偏好选择与目标感知的块调度。
AI.result: 在MiniMax-H3 Ref2VA与自研RefVid-V4的多参考视频生成实验中，BlockAlign在结构合理性、参考一致性与视觉质量上持续优于未对齐蒸馏模型与DirectAlign；相对DirectAlign胜率达82.7%。人类偏好评测显著优于PDD基线：RefVid-V4为54.0% vs 33.3%（非平局胜率61.8%），MiniMax-H3为51.3% vs 34.7%（非平局胜率59.7%）。
AI.conclusion: 与蒸馏生成器接口一致的偏好优化是关键；BlockAlign释放PDD的5倍少步rollout加速，带来3倍更快的端到端在线训练，并稳定取得统计显著的人类偏好提升。

title: Visual Marking as a Native Reasoning Capability for Multimodal LLMs
summary: Visual reasoning often requires maintaining intermediate spatial states that are difficult to express in text. Existing approaches either rely on external drawing tools or image generators, or encode these states in latent tokens without explicit spatial correspondence to the input image. We introduce SelfMark, which enables MLLMs to construct and use visual marks directly in their native visual feature space. By treating the visual token grid as a canvas, SelfMark establishes explicit spatial correspondence between marks and images. This is achieved through a locate-mark-read procedure, where the model identifies relevant locations, constructs task-dependent mark features, and reads the resulting visual features to guide its reasoning. We jointly train a single model on spatial planning, dense counting, high-resolution VQA, and line tracing. Across six benchmarks, SelfMark outperforms state-of-the-art MLLM-based methods specialized for individual tasks. These improvements also persist with a stronger backbone, demonstrating the effectiveness of visual marking across different model capabilities. Overall, SelfMark provides a unified approach to visual reasoning by integrating spatially grounded marks directly into the visual feature space of MLLMs.

AI.tldr: 提出SelfMark，让多模态大模型直接在原生视觉特征空间中构造并使用视觉标记，以统一方式解决需要维持中间空间状态的视觉推理任务。
AI.motivation: 视觉推理常需维护难以用文本表达的中间空间状态；现有方法或依赖外部绘图工具/图像生成器，或在隐空间token中编码这些状态但缺乏与输入图像的显式空间对应关系。
AI.method: 将视觉token网格视为画布，建立标记与图像间的显式空间对应；采用locate-mark-read流程：定位相关位置、构造任务相关的标记特征、读取生成的视觉特征以引导推理；在空间规划、密集计数、高分辨率VQA与线条追踪任务上联合训练单一模型。
AI.result: 在六个基准上，SelfMark优于针对各单项任务定制的最先进MLLM方法；更换更强骨干网络后性能提升依然保持，说明视觉标记的有效性不依赖特定模型能力。
AI.conclusion: SelfMark通过将空间落地的标记直接集成进MLLM视觉特征空间，为视觉推理提供了统一且有效的范式。

title: Defect-Aware Masked Autoencoders for Unsupervised Clustering of Steel Surface Defects
summary: Reliable recognition of steel surface defects is essential for automated quality inspection, but supervised methods require manually annotated images that are costly to produce. This creates a need for methods that can learn useful defect representations directly from unlabelled surface images.
