This work presents Defect aware MAE, a label free masked autoencoder for clustering steel surface defects. Each image is divided into 196 patches, with 147 masked and 49 processed by a Vision Transformer encoder. Texture energy based masking preferentially hides structurally informative patches, while a shallow decoder reconstructs HOG descriptors that capture local texture and edge orientation. Strong augmentation and an intermediate layer readout are used to form the final image features. Pretraining uses no class labels, bounding boxes, detection branch, or contrastive loss. On the held out NEU DET split, UMAP followed by Ward clustering achieves 98.6% Hungarian matched accuracy, 0.968 NMI, 0.967 ARI, and 0.838 silhouette score. Under an identical encoder and training schedule, it exceeds a SimCLR contrastive baseline in accuracy, NMI, ARI and silhouette scores across 5 seeds.

AI.tldr: 提出Defect-aware MAE，一种无标签掩码自编码器，用于钢材表面缺陷聚类，在NEU-DET留出划分上达到98.6%匈牙利匹配准确率。
AI.motivation: 钢表面缺陷的可靠识别对自动质检至关重要，但有监督方法依赖人工标注，成本高昂，因此需要能直接从无标签表面图像学习有效缺陷表征的方法。
AI.method: 每张图像切分为196个patch，掩码147个、仅49个输入ViT编码器；采用基于纹理能量的掩码策略优先遮蔽结构信息丰富的patch；浅层解码器重建HOG描述子以捕捉局部纹理与边缘方向；使用强增强与中间层读出形成最终图像特征；预训练不使用类别标签、边界框、检测分支或对比损失。特征经UMAP降维后用Ward聚类。
AI.result: 在NEU-DET留出划分上取得98.6%匈牙利匹配准确率、0.968 NMI、0.967 ARI、0.838轮廓系数；在相同编码器与训练计划下，5个随机种子上均优于SimCLR对比基线（准确率、NMI、ARI与轮廓系数）。
AI.conclusion: 无需任何标签的纹理引导掩码重建预训练即可获得高度可分的缺陷表征，为钢表面缺陷的无监督聚类提供了有效且低成本的方案。

title: SCoRe: Support-Calibrated Role Fusion for Training-Free Cross-Domain Few-Shot Segmentation
summary: We present SCoRe (Support-Calibrated Role fusion), a framework to utilize two complementary vision foundation model-based (VFM) segmenters for training-free cross-domain few-shot segmentation (CD-FSS). Our approach is based on the observation that current VFMs for CD-FSS possess capabilities where one model locates the correct object, while another model computes the better contour. Our approach uses: 1. a method to identify a VFM segmenter to lead Few-Shot Segmentation (FSS) task for a given concept, 2. a novel deterministic boundary correction method using bands of near- and far-pixels at the lead segmenter's predicted boundary of an object, and 3. a region correction mechanism for the other segmenter to conservatively prune components, fill holes, and bridge short gaps on the lead segmenter's predicted masks to improve accuracy. We evaluate SCoRe using RSRM and FSS-SAM3 across 3,314 matched five-shot episodes from 10 datasets. SCoRe achieves 72.738% foreground mIoU averaged across datasets, a gain of 5.210 percentage points over RSRM (paired 95% CI [4.618, 5.972]), with per-dataset gains up to 8.461 points over the strongest standalone method and the best point estimate on 7 of 10 datasets.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练跨域小样本分割框架SCoRe，融合两个视觉基础模型分割器：一个负责定位、一个负责轮廓，通过主导者选择、确定性边界校正与区域校正提升精度。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉基础模型（VFM）在跨域小样本分割中能力互补：一个能定位正确目标，另一个能给出更优轮廓，但单一模型无法兼得；且需免训练方案。
AI.method: 三项组件：(1) 为给定概念选择主导FSS任务的VFM分割器；(2) 基于主导分割器预测边界附近近/远像素带的新型确定性边界校正；(3) 由另一分割器对主导掩码做保守区域校正——剪除部件、填洞、连接短间隙。
AI.result: 在RSRM与FSS-SAM3上，跨10个数据集的3,314个匹配五样本episode评估：平均前景mIoU 72.738%，较RSRM提升5.210个百分点（配对95% CI [4.618, 5.972]），单数据集最高提升8.461点，10个数据集中7个取得最佳点估计。
AI.conclusion: 利用两个VFM分割器的互补优势并进行确定性边界与区域校正，可在免训练条件下显著提升CD-FSS性能，验证了角色分工融合范式的有效性。

title: KneeFS-Net: A Lightweight Deep Learning Model for Knee Osteoarthritis Severity Assessment with Cross-Domain External Validation
summary: Knee osteoarthritis (OA) grading from radiographs using the Kellgren-Lawrence (KL) scale requires expertise that may be scarce. We present KneeFS-Net, a lightweight ordinal grader (0.8 million parameters; 0.33 GFLOPs) combining spatial, Fourier and state-space features with landmark-guided attention. On the Osteoarthritis Initiative (OAI) test set, KneeFS-Net achieved a quadratic weighted kappa (QWK) of 0.863, mean absolute error (MAE) of 0.325 and 97.2% within-one-grade accuracy, comparable to models with 9-35-fold more parameters. We evaluated cross-population generalization on two Bangladeshi cohorts, a single-center hospital cohort and a multi-center teleradiology cohort. Without further training or adaptation, the OAI-trained model achieved QWK 0.803, MAE 0.339 and 98.2% within-one-grade accuracy on its hospital cohort, declining to QWK 0.656 and MAE 0.522 on multi-center teleradiology images. Self-supervised pretraining on 6,092 unlabeled radiographs followed by joint fine-tuning achieved QWK 0.823, MAE 0.329 and 99.7% within-one-grade accuracy in cross-validation. These findings demonstrate accurate, efficient KL grading and potential adaptation to new populations with limited annotation.

AI.tldr: KneeFS-Net 是一个仅 0.8M 参数、0.33 GFLOPs 的轻量级有序分级网络，融合空间、傅里叶与状态空间特征并引入关键点引导注意力，在 OAI 上达到 QWK 0.863，跨人群泛化经自监督预训练后可恢复至 QWK 0.823。
AI.motivation: 膝关节 KL 分级需专业经验且专家稀缺，需要准确、高效且能迁移到新人群的自动分级方法。
AI.method: 提出 KneeFS-Net：将空间特征、傅里叶域特征与状态空间特征融合，并采用关键点（landmark）引导的注意力机制；按有序回归方式建模 KL 等级。跨人群评估使用孟加拉国单中心医院队列与多中心远程放射队列；并采用 6,092 张无标注 X 线做自监督预训练后联合微调。
AI.result: OAI 测试集：QWK 0.863、MAE 0.325、±1 级内准确率 97.2%，与参数量多 9–35 倍的模型相当。零样本迁移：医院队列 QWK 0.803、MAE 0.339、98.2%；多中心远程放射队列降至 QWK 0.656、MAE 0.522。自监督预训练+联合微调交叉验证：QWK 0.823、MAE 0.329、99.7%。
AI.conclusion: 该方法实现了准确、高效的 KL 分级，并在少量标注条件下具备向新人群适配的潜力；但多中心、异质成像条件下的泛化仍有明显下降，是后续改进重点。

title: Beyond the Training Cameras: Coverage-Controlled Probes of Viewing Direction in Frozen Vision Models
summary: Vision models are trained on 2D images of a 3D world. Do their hidden features encode the direction from which the camera views a scene, and if so, in what form? We study the relative viewing direction $α$ of two objects in rendered scenes where both object centres stay at fixed pixels while the camera moves, so that perspective, shading and shadows change but the projected layout does not. In eight pretrained models, from diffusion models to self-supervised and image-text encoders, $α$ is encoded in a strikingly simple form: a single two-dimensional plane in the hidden space, shared across scenes, in which the difference between the two objects' features traces $(\cosα, \sinα)$. The plane keeps its orientation when lighting, colours, floors and object shapes change. This encoding is more than a summary of a few visible measurements: readouts fitted on one set of camera paths stay accurate at camera positions outside their range in seven of the eight models, whereas decoders of the measured object and shadow geometry, equally accurate within that range, fail there. In the diffusion transformer PixArt-$α$, the plane forms abruptly at a single block and carries direction information to later blocks, yet editing it changes the objects rather than the generated viewpoint. We also examine how this encoding carries over to scanned real objects.

AI.tldr: 视觉模型的隐特征中以一个跨场景共享的二维平面编码两物体相对视角α，该平面内两物体特征差沿(cosα, sinα)轨迹变化，且该编码超出浅层可见测量、具有外推能力。
AI.motivation: 探究在2D图像上训练的视觉模型是否以及以何种形式编码相机视角方向，即隐空间是否表征三维场景的观察方向。
AI.method: 构建渲染场景：两物体中心固定在相同像素、仅移动相机，使透视、明暗与阴影变化而投影布局不变；在8个预训练模型（扩散模型、自监督、图文编码器）中分析相对视角α的隐空间结构，并做跨相机路径的外推测试，以及在PixArt-α中定位该平面的形成层与因果编辑实验。
AI.result: α被编码为隐空间中一个跨场景共享的二维平面，两物体特征差在该平面内描绘(cosα, sinα)；该平面朝向对光照、颜色、地板与物体形状变化保持不变。单一路径拟合的读出器在8个模型中的7个可外推到训练范围外的相机位置，而同样精确的物体/阴影几何解码器则失败。PixArt-α中该平面在单一block处突变形成并将方向信息传给后续block，但编辑该平面改变的是物体而非生成视点。
AI.conclusion: 预训练视觉模型以极简的共享二维平面线性编码相对视角方向，超越可见测量而具备外推性，并在特定层骤然形成；但该编码与生成视点的因果控制解耦，且被进一步考察其在真实扫描物体上的迁移。

title: Where slide-level foundation-model classifiers fail on atypical breast lesions
summary: Whether a ductal breast lesion is called atypical hyperplasia or low-grade carcinoma in situ increasingly determines surgery. However, slide-level classifiers built on pathology foundation models (PFMs) perform worst on these lesions. Using four PFMs, cross-validation on BRACS and preregistered hypotheses, we studied where the classification of atypia fails. Because slides are labelled with their most severe lesion, only 39% of the slides with annotated atypical ductal hyperplasia (ADH) were labelled ADH. Attention ranked the lesion high but rarely first, and showing the model only the lesion helped little, whereas classifiers trained per decision with lesion-level labels improved all four atypical boundaries. ADH regions inserted into benign slides raised the probability of malignancy more than that of atypia. In a hospital with pathologist-labelled single-subtype slides and in HISTAI, benign slides were scored closer to lesions and triage specificity fell from 0.48-0.53 to 0.00-0.07 and 0.22.

AI.tldr: 该研究用四个病理基础模型（PFM）在BRACS上交叉验证并预注册假设，揭示非典型增生与低级别原位癌分类失败的根源在于"整片标注取最重病变"的标签机制及模型注意力排序，而非单纯识别能力不足；按决策边界以病灶级标签训练分类器可改善全部四个非典型增生边界。
AI.motivation: 导管型乳腺病变究竟被诊断为非典型增生还是低级别原位癌，日益直接决定手术方式，但基于病理基础模型的切片级分类器恰恰在这类病变上表现最差。作者由此追问：非典型增生分类的失败究竟出在哪一环。
AI.method: 采用四个PFM，在BRACS数据集上交叉验证并预设（预注册）假设；进行注意力排序分析、病灶单独输入实验、按决策边界以病灶级标签训练分类器、将ADH区域植入良性切片以观察恶性与非典型概率变化，并在病理医师标注单亚型切片的医院数据及HISTAI上评估分诊特异性。
AI.result: 带标注ADH切片中仅39%被标为ADH（源于整片取最重病变的标注规则）；注意力虽将病灶排位较高但极少排第一；仅展示病灶给模型帮助有限；按决策以病灶级标签训练的分类器改善了全部四个非典型增生边界；植入良性切片的ADH区域更易抬高恶性概率而非非典型概率；在单亚型医院数据与HISTAI中，良性切片评分更接近病变，分诊特异性分别从0.48–0.53降至0.00–0.07及0.22。
AI.conclusion: PFM在非典型增生上的瓶颈主要来自切片级"最重病变"标签与模型注意力定位，而非病灶识别本身；按决策边界采用病灶级标签训练可有效改善分类，但良性切片评分偏高的倾向会严重损害分诊特异性，提示需重视标注范式与校准问题。

title: Toward Planning Representations That Separate Task Structure from Visual Content
summary: Effective planning requires representations that preserve task-relevant geometry and object identity while ignoring visual variation that does not alter the task. Existing evaluations of visual generalization often change several factors simultaneously, making the source of a failure difficult to identify. We introduce a controlled evaluation of object-goal navigation (ObjectNav), the task of reaching an instance of a named object category, in procedurally generated ProcTHOR houses. Training and evaluation houses share floor plans, object locations, goals, and start states, while visual factors are changed individually or in combination. Across model-free reinforcement learning (RL), model-based RL, and agents using frozen pretrained visual representations, our results show that appearance changes impair navigation, but their effects differ sharply by factor. Surface material changes account for most of the average change in success, whereas clutter and lighting have little effect. The magnitude of a global image statistics shift does not reliably predict performance: changing only the goal object's appearance can substantially impair an end-to-end agent despite a small image-level change. We found that a model based agent that plans over frozen features from the pretrained DINOv2 image encoder achieves the highest success (0.83) under the full shift, but remains sensitive to surface appearance. Our experiments reveal an important requirement for planning representations: they must separate invariant spatial task structure from appearance.

AI.tldr: 该论文在ProcTHOR房屋中构建受控的ObjectNav视觉泛化评测，逐个改变视觉因素，发现表面材质变化是性能下降主因，且全局图像统计位移无法预测性能，DINOv2冻结特征+模型基规划者在完整位移下成功率最高(0.83)。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉泛化评测通常同时改变多个因素，难以定位失败来源；同时需要明确规划所需的表征应具备何种性质（在保留任务相关几何与物体身份的同时忽略无关视觉变化）。
AI.method: 在程序化生成的ProcTHOR房屋中设计受控ObjectNav评测：训练与评测房屋共享平面布局、物体位置、目标与起始状态，仅视觉因素单独或组合改变。对比无模型RL、模型基RL以及使用冻结预训练视觉表征的智能体，并按因素（表面材质、杂物、光照、目标物体外观、全局图像统计位移）分解影响。
AI.result: 外观变化损害导航且效应按因素差异显著：表面材质变化贡献了成功率平均变化的大部分，杂物与光照影响很小；全局图像统计位移幅度不能可靠预测性能——仅改变目标物体外观即可在图像级变化很小时显著损害端到端智能体。基于DINOv2冻结特征进行规划的模型基智能体在完整位移下成功率最高(0.83)，但仍对表面外观敏感。
AI.conclusion: 视觉泛化失败需按因素归因，图像级位移指标不可作为性能代理；规划表征的关键要求是将不变的空间任务结构与外观分离。

title: Learning Spatially Aware Audio-Visual Features from Videos with Mono Audio
summary: Comprehensive audio-visual perception requires both semantic and spatial reasoning. Existing spatial models suffer from poor generalization due to data scarcity, while semantic-only models fail to capture spatial characteristics completely. We introduce a model capable of jointly reasoning over binaural audio and vision on semantic and spatial tasks with improved generalization. To overcome the shortage in real-world data, we develop an automatic pipeline that localizes the sound source in a video, estimates its relative 3D trajectory, and renders binaural audio. We then use this to spatialize VGGSound, allowing us to train at a much larger scale. We demonstrate improved performance and generalization on spatial reasoning tasks while still remaining competitive on semantic tasks compared to semantic-only models.

AI.tldr: 提出可同时进行语义与空间推理的双耳音频-视觉联合模型；通过自动流水线定位视频声源、估计其相对3D轨迹并渲染双耳音频，将VGGSound空间化以扩大训练规模，从而在空间任务上提升性能与泛化性，语义任务保持竞争力。
AI.motivation: 全面的音视感知需兼具语义与空间推理能力。现有空间模型因真实数据稀缺而泛化差，仅语义模型又无法刻画空间特性。
AI.method: 构建自动数据流水线：在视频中定位声源、估计其相对3D轨迹、渲染双耳音频；据此将VGGSound数据集空间化，实现大规模训练；训练一个在语义与空间任务上联合推理双耳音频与视觉的模型。
AI.result: 在空间推理任务上性能与泛化性提升，同时在语义任务上与仅语义模型相比保持竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 通过自动化空间音频数据合成缓解数据稀缺，统一语义-空间建模是可行的，可在两个任务维度上兼顾性能与泛化。

title: EndoComparer: Comparative Surgical Video Question Answering with Pseudo-Siamese Visual Adaptation and Perceive-then-Compare Reasoning
summary: Purpose: Surgical training benefits from explicit comparison between cases: in patient condition, in technique and in skill proficiency. Surgical vision-language models (VLMs) offer a promising and flexible interface for this purpose. Yet current VLMs typically see one video at a time, and they often fall short when asked to compare videos. Methods: We propose EndoComparer, a VLM for comparative surgical video question answering with two components. (a) A Pseudo-Siamese Visual LoRA (PSVL) gives each video slot its own low-rank adapter over a shared frozen vision encoder, separating the two videos in the visual pathway at the cost of a single encoder pass. (b) A Perceive-then-Compare chain of thought (PtC-CoT) trains the model to first state what each video shows, then derive the answer from these statements. We further curate EndoDiffVQA, a benchmark of nearly 11K multiple-choice questions on video-pair over cholecystectomy and gastric bypass procedures, covering anatomy, tool, action and skill. Results: EndoComparer outperforms strong generalist and surgical VLMs on detecting and specifying difference between videos. Ablations show that two proposed components contribute complimentarily, and the model remains more robust under a video-swap control that exposes confusion between the two videos. Conclusion: Providing a dedicated visual reasoning path through PSVL and PtC-CoT makes cross-case comparison of surgical videos more robust for VLMs. EndoDiffVQA and EndoComparer provide a benchmark and a strong baseline for this task. Project page: https://camma-public.github.io/endocomparer

AI.tldr: 提出 EndoComparer，一种面向手术视频配对比较问答的视觉-语言模型，通过伪孪生视觉 LoRA 与"先感知后比较"思维链两条设计，并构建近 11K 题目的 EndoDiffVQA 基准，在差异检测与描述上优于通用及手术专用 VLM。
AI.motivation: 手术训练需要病例间的显式比较（患者状态、技术、技能熟练度），但现有 VLM 通常一次只处理单个视频，在比较两个视频的任务上表现不足，且缺乏针对性评测数据。
AI.method: (a) Pseudo-Siamese Visual LoRA（PSVL）：在共享冻结视觉编码器上为每个视频槽位配置独立的低秩适配器，以单次编码器前向代价在视觉通路上分离两个视频；(b) Perceive-then-Compare 思维链（PtC-CoT）：训练模型先分别陈述各视频内容，再据此推导答案；同时构建 EndoDiffVQA 基准（约 11K 道视频对多选题，覆盖胆囊切除与胃旁路手术的解剖、器械、动作、技能四个维度）。
AI.result: 在视频差异检测与具体化描述上优于强通用 VLM 与手术专用 VLM；消融实验表明两个组件贡献互补；在视频交换对照实验中模型对两视频混淆更具鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 通过 PSVL 与 PtC-CoT 提供专用视觉推理路径，使手术视频的跨病例比较更为鲁棒；EndoDiffVQA 与 EndoComparer 分别为该任务提供基准与强基线。

title: GeoReVis: Learning Selective Revision and Evidence Consolidation for Remote Sensing Segmentation
summary: Recent methods try to inspect and revise masks to mitigate referential ambiguity and localization errors caused by complex spatial relations in language-guided remote sensing segmentation. However, these solutions often lead to Revision Degradation: revising missing regions may introduce errors into previously correct ones. Even a globally better mask can omit correct regions found in inferior masks. We term this Evidence Fragmentation: correct target evidence is scattered across imperfect masks. All masks generated by the model at this time are suboptimal. We propose GeoReVis, which unifies revision guided by execution feedback, Candidate Selection, and Cross-Mask Evidence Consolidation. It learns fine-grained revision from real actions that improve segmentation when executed and learns to select a better mask through quality comparisons between actual candidates, reducing the risk of degradation during revision. The selected whole mask can still discard useful regions. GeoReVis therefore retains all candidates across rounds, partitions their spatial disagreements into composable regions, and jointly reconstructs regions conditioned on the full instruction and context. This makes complementary and fragmentary evidence reusable regardless of its source candidate's overall quality, yielding improved segmentation. We further build a data pipeline to generate fine-grained multi-round segmentation trajectories and derive supervision for revision actions, candidate selection, and region composition from the model's own outputs, extending training beyond whole-mask IoU supervision. We also propose ReVis-Eval, a benchmark protocol evaluating multi-round revision and cross-round evidence consolidation accuracy. Experiments on ReVis-Eval and 5 benchmarks for remote sensing reasoning and referring segmentation demonstrate the effectiveness of GeoReVis.

AI.tldr: 该论文针对语言引导遥感分割中的修订退化与证据碎片化问题，提出GeoReVis框架，统一执行反馈引导的修订、候选选择与跨掩码证据整合，并构建多轮轨迹数据管线与ReVis-Eval评测协议。
AI.motivation: 语言引导遥感分割中复杂空间关系导致指代歧义与定位错误，现有掩码检查与修订方法易引发Revision Degradation（修订缺失区域时破坏原本正确区域），且全局更优的掩码仍可能遗漏劣势掩码中的正确区域，即Evidence Fragmentation（正确目标证据分散于多个不完美掩码中）。
AI.method: GeoReVis包含三部分：1）从真实能提升分割的执行动作中学习细粒度修订；2）通过实际候选间的质量比较学习候选选择，降低修订退化风险；3）保留跨轮全部候选，将其空间分歧划分为可组合区域，基于完整指令与上下文联合重建区域，实现跨掩码证据整合。此外构建数据管线生成细粒度多轮分割轨迹，从模型自身输出中导出修订动作、候选选择与区域组合的监督信号，突破整体掩码IoU监督；并提出ReVis-Eval基准协议，评估多轮修订与跨轮证据整合准确率。
AI.result: 在ReVis-Eval及5个遥感推理与指代分割基准上的实验验证了GeoReVis的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 通过将修订、选择与跨掩码区域级证据组合统一，GeoReVis使互补、碎片化的证据不受其来源候选整体质量限制而被复用，从而获得更优分割性能。

title: SGIP: Learning Scene-Grounded Interaction Priors for Scene-Aware Human Motion Prediction
comment: Accepted to NeurIPS 2026. Project page: https://sgip2026.github.io
summary: Human motion prediction (HMP) aims to forecast future movement from an observed motion sequence, and recent methods have incorporated 3D scene geometry and object semantics to improve long-term plausibility. However, the destination of future motion remains ambiguous in cluttered scenes: the same observed motion can lead to different interaction targets or navigation modes. Existing methods either handle this ambiguity implicitly or rely on auxiliary signals like gaze that are hard to obtain in practice. To address this, we propose SGIP, which explicitly predicts where in the scene future motion will be grounded across both objects and open navigation regions, and uses it to condition future trajectory and full-body pose prediction. This scene-grounded interaction prior is learned via intent distillation: at training time only, a teacher model scores candidate scene regions by combining an LLM prompted with a textual description of the person's intent with geometric motion-scene features. A student model learns to reproduce these scores from only the observed motion and 3D scene, making intent and LLM unnecessary at test time. Across multiple benchmark datasets, SGIP outperforms prior scene-aware baselines on both trajectory and pose accuracy in a realistic deployment setting where neither gaze nor intent is available at inference, demonstrating the effectiveness of the proposed framework. The project page is available at https://sgip2026.github.io.

AI.tldr: 提出SGIP，显式预测未来动作在场景中（物体与可导航区域）的落点，并以其为条件预测轨迹与全身姿态；该"场景落地交互先验"通过意图蒸馏训练，测试时仅需观测动作与3D场景。
AI.motivation: 拥挤场景中未来动作的目的地具有内在歧义：同一观测动作可能对应不同交互目标或导航模式。现有方法要么隐式处理该歧义，要么依赖凝视等实际难获取的辅助信号。
AI.method: SGIP显式预测场景中未来运动的地面落点分布，覆盖物体与开放导航区域，并用其条件化后续轨迹与全身姿态预测。先验通过意图蒸馏获得：训练阶段由教师模型对候选场景区域打分，打分结合"以人物意图文本提示的LLM"与几何动作-场景特征；学生模型仅从观测动作与3D场景回归这些分数，从而在测试时无需意图与LLM。
AI.result: 在多个基准数据集上，在推理时既无凝视也无意图的真实部署设定下，SGIP在轨迹精度与姿态精度上均优于既往场景感知基线。
AI.conclusion: 显式场景落地交互先验可有效消解目的歧义，配合意图蒸馏实现"训练用意图、推理免意图"的实用化人體运动预测框架。

title: RAMP: Rethinking Multimodal Evaluation through Answer Readout Protocols
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) are often evaluated by converting model outputs into discrete answers. The conversion protocol determines which scores become predictions and can strongly influence the reported results. We introduce RAMP (Readout Aware Multimodal Protocol), a systematic framework that compares direct yes/no token logits, surface-form scores, and typed or reversed A/B interfaces under fixed model checkpoints and paired visual questions. On 500 POPE adversarial questions, typed versus bare readout changes accuracy by $-20.2$ percentage points for SmolVLM-256M, $-16.4$ for TinyLLaVA-1.1B, and $+1.8$ for Qwen2.5-VL-3B. Paired transitions reveal extensive prediction changes even when the net accuracy difference is small: 79 of 104 binary ChartQA items change correctness for SmolVLM-500M, despite a $+1.0$-point net difference. We further analyze prompt wording, candidate forms, option position, cross-task effects, and calibration. An independent offline replay reproduces 16,140 first-token decisions from saved raw scores with exact agreement. Our findings establish answer readout as a measurable component of multimodal evaluation and provide a reproducible protocol for analyzing model comparisons.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 RAMP 框架，系统比较四种答案读出（readout）方式对 MLLM 评测分数的影响，发现读出协议本身即可造成数十个百分点的准确率变化，并给出可复现的分析协议。
AI.motivation: 多模态大模型评测常把模型输出转换为离散答案，但转换协议决定了哪些分数被当作预测，可能显著影响报告结果，而这种「读出方式」此前未被系统量化，因此需要将其作为可测量的评测组件加以研究。
AI.method: 提出 RAMP（Readout Aware Multimodal Protocol）框架，在固定模型 checkpoint 与配对视觉问题的条件下，比较四类读出接口：直接 yes/no token logits、surface-form 打分、typed A/B 接口、reversed A/B 接口；在 POPE 对抗问题（500 题）与 ChartQA 二分类子集上做配对比较，并分析 prompt 措辞、候选形式、选项位置、跨任务效应与校准，另以离线回放复现首 token 决策。
AI.result: POPE 500 题上，typed 与 bare readout 的准确率差异为 SmolVLM-256M −20.2pt、TinyLLaVA-1.1B −16.4pt、Qwen2.5-VL-3B +1.8pt；配对转移显示即使净差很小，预测仍大量改变：SmolVLM-500M 在 104 道二分类 ChartQA 题中有 79 道正确性翻转，而净差仅 +1.0pt；离线回放从原始分数精确复现 16,140 次首 token 决策，完全一致。
AI.conclusion: 答案读出应被视为多模态评测中的可测量组成部分，读出协议能左右模型比较结论；RAMP 提供了可复现的协议，用于分析读出效应并支持更可靠的模型对比。

title: Competent Autonomous Driving Through Fine Tuning Vision Language Action Models with Symbolic Traffic Rules
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models offer a unified approach to perception, reasoning, and control for autonomous driving, but accurate action prediction alone does not establish compliance with traffic regulations. This paper presents a rule-guided VLA framework that incorporates symbolic traffic-rule feedback into policy optimisation. The framework combines supervised fine-tuning on expert demonstrations with reinforcement learning (RL) refinement using a reward that encourages encoded-rule compliance while penalising deviations from expert actions. Selected provisions of the United Kingdom Highway Code are formalised as executable first-order logic rules using PyReason, covering speed adaptation, following distance, and road-user priority. A frozen vision-language model extracts scene predicates, which are combined with vehicle-state information to assess the projected consequences of candidate control actions. Offline evaluation on held-out data collected in the CARLA simulator compares three group-based RL methods. The results show improvements in both action prediction accuracy and encoded-rule compliance over the supervised baseline. The best-performing variant increases the overall rule pass rate from 92.9% to 97.6%, with zero observed violations of the encoded road-user-priority check in the evaluated samples. These findings support symbolic rule feedback as a means of improving VLA policy alignment with explicit traffic-rule criteria.

AI.tldr: 提出一种规则引导的VLA框架，将《英国公路法规》符号化为一阶逻辑规则，并通过强化学习奖励反馈提升自动驾驶策略的动作预测准确率与规则合规性。
AI.motivation: VLA模型虽能统一感知、推理与控制，但准确的动作预测并不等同于符合交通法规，缺乏显式的规则合规约束。
AI.method: 在专家示范监督微调基础上，用强化学习精调；以PyReason将公路法规（速度适应、跟车距离、道路使用者优先权）形式化为可执行一阶逻辑规则；冻结VLM提取场景谓词，结合车辆状态评估候选动作的投影后果，构造兼顾规则合规与专家动作偏离的奖励；在CARLA离线数据上对比三种基于群体的RL方法。
AI.result: 相比监督基线，动作预测准确率与规则合规性均有提升；最佳变体将整体规则通过率从92.9%提高到97.6%，评估样本中未观察到编码的道路使用者优先权违规。
AI.conclusion: 符号规则反馈可有效改善VLA策略与显式交通规则标准的一致性。

title: Instructions Before Actions: Prospective and Retrospective Language Supervision for Driving Vision-Language-Action Data
summary: Driving vision-language-action (VLA) models can accept navigation instructions, yet predicting a driver's trajectory does not establish that a model follows the instruction. We study how driving-language supervision is collected and evaluated, distinguishing prospective instructions issued before an action from retrospective labels written after observing it. We develop ADVLAT-Engine to synchronize spoken instructions, road-scene video, and vehicle trajectories, and compare three navigation apps on 48 replayed routes. On 87 maneuvers announced by both Google Maps and a passenger, the passenger uses more scene-dependent language. We evaluate four open driving VLAs before and after fine-tuning on prospective navigation-app drives. Fine-tuning reduces passenger-drive trajectory error by 23-59%, but instruction effects remain inconsistent. At real intersections, counterfactual instructions reveal stronger responsiveness: fine-tuned Alpamayo~2 Super gains 31 and 18 accuracy points at 15 and 5~m, while Qwen-Drive follows alternative maneuvers more reliably with a discrete command than with a sentence. We additionally collected retrospective annotations from four people for the driving recordings and describe controlled comparisons of annotation content, timing, and downstream learning; those analyses are pending. Our findings separate maneuver prediction from instruction-following and establish a framework for comparing prospective and retrospective supervision.

AI.tldr: 论文提出ADVLAT-Engine同步语音指令、道路视频与轨迹，对比前瞻性指令与回溯性标注两种驾驶语言监督，并在四个开源驾驶VLA上检验微调后的指令跟随能力。
AI.motivation: 驾驶VLA模型能接收导航指令，但轨迹预测准确并不等于模型真正遵循指令；现有驾驶语言监督的采集与评测方式未区分"行动前发出的前瞻性指令"与"观察后书写的回溯性标签"，导致指令跟随能力被高估。
AI.method: 构建ADVLAT-Engine，实现语音指令、道路场景视频与车辆轨迹的时序同步；在48条重放路线上比较三款导航应用（含Google Maps与乘客口述）。对87个双方均播报的机动动作分析语言差异；在导航应用前瞻性驾驶数据上微调四个开源驾驶VLA；在真实路口用反事实指令测试响应性。
AI.result: 乘客口述比Google Maps使用更多依赖场景的语言。微调使乘客驾驶轨迹误差降低23–59%，但指令效应不一致；真实路口反事实测试中，微调后Alpamayo~2 Super在15 m与5 m处分别提升31和18个准确率点，Qwen-Drive在离散命令下比整句更可靠地执行替代机动。
AI.conclusion: 研究将机动预测与指令跟随明确区分，建立比较前瞻性与回溯性监督的框架；回溯性标注（四人采集）的内容、时序与下游学习对比分析尚待完成。

title: ASCG: Adaptive Spatial Classifier Guidance for Surgical Concept Suppression in Diffusion Models
comment: 9 pages, including references and supplementary material
summary: While text-to-image (T2I) diffusion models achieve remarkable quality, they risk producing harmful content. Existing safety mechanisms often rely on indiscriminate, global interventions that induce unintended semantic drift and degrade image quality. To address this, we propose Adaptive Spatial Classifier Guidance (ASCG), a necessity-driven framework that employs probabilistic monitoring to activate guidance selectively upon harm detection. By leveraging Grad-CAM for localized suppression, ASCG effectively removes harmful concepts while preserving superior semantic fidelity compared to conventional methods. Furthermore, we overcome the limitations of traditional metrics like NudeNet---which fails to assess semantic integrity---by introducing a VLM-based evaluation framework to provide a fine-grained, robust analysis of both safety and context preservation. Our results demonstrate that ASCG not only balances safety and fidelity but also exhibits remarkable plug-and-play synergy with existing frameworks to establish state-of-the-art performance.

AI.tldr: 提出自适应空间分类器引导（ASCG），一种按需触发的T2I扩散模型安全框架，结合概率监控与Grad-CAM局部抑制，在去除有害概念的同时保持语义保真度，并引入基于VLM的细粒度评测框架。
AI.motivation: 现有T2I扩散模型安全机制多采用无差别的全局干预，导致非预期语义漂移与图像质量下降；且NudeNet等传统指标无法评估语义完整性，缺乏细粒度评测手段。
AI.method: ASCG：以概率监控实现必要性驱动的选择性激活，仅在检测到危害时触发引导；利用Grad-CAM进行局部化有害概念抑制；并提出基于VLM的评测框架，对安全性与上下文保持进行细粒度分析。
AI.result: ASCG在安全性与语义保真度之间取得更优平衡，相比传统方法保持更高的语义保真度；与现有框架具备即插即用的协同能力，达到SOTA性能。
AI.conclusion: 按需、空间局部的引导策略优于全局干预，配合VLM评测可更全面衡量安全与语义保持；ASCG具备良好的可组合性与通用性。

title: CreaTrace: Video Creative Plagiarism Detection and Evidence Tracing
summary: Video creative plagiarism refers to the unauthorized reproduction of creative ideas across videos despite substantial differences in visual appearance, posing a new challenge to video copyright protection. However, existing video copy detection methods primarily focus on visual content similarity, struggling to capture abstract creative that are entangled with specific visual realizations. To address this issue, we introduce a novel task, named Video Creative Plagiarism Detection (VCPD), and propose an iterative creative evidence tracing framework, termed CreaTrace, to verify creative similarity and accurately localize the corresponding evidence segments. Specifically, we design a Multimodal Semantic Event Segmentation strategy to divide similar long videos into coherent narrative events, facilitating event-level dataset construction and retrieving similar segments. Based on these events, CreaTrace employs Coarse Creative Matching to identify candidate event pairs through narrative semantics and camera language. Then CreaTrace presents Creative Decoupling to disentangle abstract creative patterns from specific visual realizations. Meanwhile, Creative Swap Contrastive Learning is devised to enhance creative consistency through cross-realization feature swapping. Benefiting from the above designs, our CreaTrace enables accurate creative similarity detection and temporal localization, while providing interpretable evidence report. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness and robustness of CreaTrace across diverse creative plagiarism scenarios.

AI.tldr: 提出新任务"视频创意抄袭检测(VCPD)"及迭代式创意证据追踪框架CreaTrace，通过多模态语义事件分割、粗粒度创意匹配、创意解耦与创意交换对比学习，实现创意相似性判定与证据片段时序定位。
AI.motivation: 现有视频拷贝检测方法主要依赖视觉内容相似度，难以捕捉与具体视觉呈现纠缠的抽象创意；而创意抄袭恰恰表现为视觉外观差异大但创意被未授权复用，构成新的版权保护挑战。
AI.method: 1) 设计多模态语义事件分割策略，将相似长视频切分为连贯叙事事件，支撑事件级数据集构建与相似片段检索；2) 粗粒度创意匹配，利用叙事语义与镜头语言筛选候选事件对；3) 创意解耦，将抽象创意模式与具体视觉实现分离；4) 创意交换对比学习，通过跨实现特征交换增强创意一致性；整体采用迭代式创意证据追踪框架融合上述模块。
AI.result: 在多种创意抄袭场景下的大量实验表明，CreaTrace可准确完成创意相似性检测与时序定位，并提供可解释的证据报告，效果与鲁棒性均得到验证。
AI.conclusion: CreaTrace为视频创意抄袭检测提供了可行范式：以事件级语义匹配替代纯视觉相似度，并结合创意解耦与对比学习，实现可解释的创意抄袭判定与证据定位。

title: Multimodal AI in Healthcare: Review of Vision-Language Foundation Models for Real-World Medical Applications
summary: The emergence of foundation models has marked a transformative shift in AI, enabling robust generalization across diverse downstream tasks through putative zero-shot learning. Large Language Models and Vision Language Models have demonstrated strong capabilities in tasks such as image interpretation, report generation, and question answering by effectively learning from multimodal data-images paired with associated text often with minimal supervision. In the healthcare domain, this ability to align visual and textual information reduces the reliance on extensive manual annotations, as models can leverage existing clinical reports and imaging data to learn meaningful representations. This integration holds promise for improving diagnostic support, treatment planning, and overall patient care, even in data constrained settings. In this review, we provide a definitive taxonomy of the medical VLM landscape, tracing the evolution from early Contrastive Alignment and Generative MLLMs to the cutting edge frontiers of Dense Pixel Grounding, Sparse Mixture-of-Experts (MoE), and Reasoning Incentivized (RL) architectures. We critically examine the "medical bottleneck" identifying the persistent challenges of data scarcity, the "hallucination" risks in generative diagnostics, the computational strain of 3D volumetric processing, and the lack of standardized, clinically grounded evaluation metrics.

AI.tldr: 该综述对医疗视觉语言模型（VLM）领域进行系统性梳理，提出从对比对齐、生成式多模态大模型到密集像素定位、稀疏专家混合（MoE）与推理激励（RL）架构的演化分类体系，并批判性剖析医疗瓶颈问题。
AI.motivation: 基础模型通过零样本泛化能力显著降低医疗场景对大量人工标注的依赖，可借助现有临床报告与影像数据学习有意义的表征；然而医疗VLM领域缺乏统一的分类框架，且数据稀缺、生成幻觉、三维体数据处理算力开销及标准化临床评估指标缺失等挑战尚未被系统厘清。
AI.method: 文献综述与分类学构建：以多模态数据（影像—文本配对）为线索，按技术范式演进梳理医疗VLM谱系，涵盖早期对比对齐（Contrastive Alignment）、生成式多模态大语言模型（Generative MLLMs），直至密集像素定位（Dense Pixel Grounding）、稀疏混合专家（Sparse MoE）与推理激励（RL）等前沿方向；并对"医疗瓶颈"进行批判性分析。
AI.result: 形成医疗VLM领域权威性的分类体系（definitive taxonomy），明确各范式之间的演化脉络与技术边界；系统识别四类核心瓶颈：数据稀缺、生成式诊断中的幻觉风险、三维体数据处理的算力压力、以及缺乏标准化且具临床依据的评估指标。
AI.conclusion: 医疗VLM在诊断支持、治疗规划与患者照护方面具备潜力，尤其在数据受限环境中；但其落地受制于数据、幻觉、算力与评估四个维度的"医疗瓶颈"，亟需构建标准化、临床可验证的评测体系以推动该领域可靠发展。

title: Two-Stage Prompt Learning: A Unified Framework for Person ReID without Clothing Hypothesis
summary: Person re-identification (ReID) in real-world scenarios involves three clothes conditions: the same clothes (SC), changed clothes (CC), and the unknown (GEN) scenario where clothes changes are not specified. Existing methods typically train separate SC- or CC-specific models, which limits generalization across all conditions. Meanwhile, pre-trained visual-language models (VLMs) such as CLIP have shown strong generalization ability in various vision tasks, motivating recent ReID methods to incorporate textual prompts. However, to distinguish SC and CC, prior approaches rely on fixed predefined instructions, which lack learnable context embeddings in prompts and cannot effectively handle the GEN scenario. To overcome these limitations, we propose Two-Stage Prompt Learning (TSPL), a unified framework that integrates clothes-identity decoupling and scenario-aware task prompts within VLMs. In Stage 1, appearance-decomposed prompt learning disentangles clothes and identity information under frozen encoders, producing stable embeddings where clothes cues can be selectively preserved or suppressed. In Stage 2, task-aware prompt learning trains the image encoder with learnable context embeddings guided by Stage-1 representations, enabling robust adaptation across SC, CC, and GEN conditions. Extensive experiments on five benchmarks show that TSPL achieves state-of-the-art performance under all scenarios, improving mAP by up to 9.2% on LTCC (SC) and by 6.4% on VC-Clothes (GEN), respectively. The code will be released at https://github.com/YuSuen/TSPL.

AI.tldr: 提出两阶段提示学习框架TSPL，在统一视觉-语言模型中对齐SC/CC/GEN三种换衣场景的行人重识别，五个基准上全面达到SOTA。
AI.motivation: 真实场景中行人重识别包含同衣（SC）、换衣（CC）与未指定（GEN）三种服装条件，现有方法通常分别训练SC或CC专用模型，跨条件泛化差；引入CLIP等VLM的现有方法依赖固定预定义指令，缺乏可学习上下文嵌入，难以处理GEN场景。
AI.method: 两阶段统一框架：第一阶段"外观解耦提示学习"，在冻结编码器下将服装与身份信息解耦，得到可选择性保留或抑制服装线索的稳定嵌入；第二阶段"任务感知提示学习"，以第一阶段表示为引导，用可学习上下文嵌入训练图像编码器，实现SC/CC/GEN的自适应统一。
AI.result: 在五个基准上三种场景均取得SOTA：LTCC（SC）mAP最高提升9.2%，VC-Clothes（GEN）提升6.4%。
AI.conclusion: 通过将服装-身份解耦与场景感知任务提示整合进VLM，单一统一模型即可覆盖SC/CC/GEN，验证了可学习提示上下文相较固定指令的有效性；代码将开源。

title: PRISM: Primitive-Integrated Separable Modulation with Priority Visual Memory Queue for Compositional Zero-Shot Learning
summary: Compositional Zero-Shot Learning (CZSL) recognizes unseen attribute--object pairs by recombining primitives from seen compositions. Existing methods stop sharing evidence at deployment: fixed prototypes cannot exploit unlabeled test streams, while composition-wise refinement cannot propagate corrections across pairs sharing a primitive. We introduce PRISM, an online CZSL framework that extends primitive sharing to test-time adaptation. Its Hierarchical Knowledge Accumulation Module (HiKAM) factorizes prototype migration into composition-, attribute-, and object-level residual banks. A Priority Visual Memory Queue (PVMQ), initialized by Prototype Queue Initialization (PQI), grounds text updates with bounded visual evidence. The same adaptive core supports exhaustive Full PRISM and recall-calibrated Adaptive PRISM-Lite, which selects candidate budgets from held-out ranks. Comprehensive closed- and open-world experiments on UT-Zappos, MIT-States, and C-GQA demonstrate the state of the art, with Full PRISM achieving the best open-world AUC and harmonic mean on all three benchmarks and the best closed-world results on UT-Zappos and C-GQA. Fine-grained long-tail and non-stationary primitive-block evaluations reveal gains on under-supported concepts and stable adaptation under prolonged skew. Adaptive PRISM-Lite further delivers substantial efficiency gains in the full open-world space with only a small accuracy cost. PRISM thus combines primitive-shared online adaptation, multimodal grounding, and candidate-aware inference.

AI.tldr: PRISM是一个在线组合零样本学习框架，将"基元共享"扩展到测试时自适应，通过分层原型迁移与视觉记忆队列实现无标签测试流上的多模态自适应，在三个基准上取得SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有CZSL方法在部署阶段停止共享证据：固定原型无法利用无标签测试流；组合级细化无法将修正传播到共享同一基元的其他组合。
AI.method: 提出PRISM在线框架。HiKAM将原型迁移分解为组合、属性、物体三级残差库；PVMQ（由PQI初始化）以有界视觉证据对文本更新进行接地；同一自适应核心派生完整版Full PRISM与召回校准的Adaptive PRISM-Lite（基于留出排名选择候选预算）。
AI.result: 在UT-Zappos、MIT-States、C-GQA的闭世界与开世界实验中达到SOTA：Full PRISM在三个基准上均取得最佳开世界AUC与调和平均，在UT-Zappos与C-GQA上取得最佳闭世界结果；长尾与非平稳基元块评估显示对低支持概念的增益及长时间偏斜下的稳定自适应；PRISM-Lite在全开世界空间显著提效且精度损失小。
AI.conclusion: PRISM整合了基元共享的在线自适应、多模态接地与候选感知推理，有效解决部署阶段证据共享断裂问题。

title: When Does Reusing Layers Help Multimodal Embeddings?
summary: We ask whether a compact universal multimodal embedding models can produce better search embeddings by running the same layers again. Looped transformers add computation with nearly unchanged model size, making them an appealing alternative to a larger encoder. Their success in language-model reasoning and recent use for retrieval motivate the idea, but higher retrieval scores alone do not reveal what an extra pass contributes. We study eleven loop designs and training variants on three checkpoints of one vision-language architecture. Our protocol distinguishes whether a model uses its extra pass, whether its image states respond to the query, and whether those updates improve retrieval. We prove that an image placed before the query remains query-independent through repeated layers when information only travels forward. We then open a query-to-image path in three ways, including order-alternating recurrence, which places the query first on the next pass. Each path produces query-sensitive image states. For bidirectional attention and order alternation, freezing later visual updates does not lower accuracy. On all 78 datasets of the Massive Multimodal Embedding Benchmark version 2 (MMEB-V2), a standard added loop loses 0.46 points against its trained control; an intermediate generative stage changes the effect to +0.36. A model pretrained with recurrence gains +4.23 points over its own loop-removed control and benefits from query-conditioned image updates when answering visual questions or locating objects from text.

AI.tldr: 该论文系统研究循环Transformer（looped transformer）能否提升紧凑通用多模态嵌入模型的检索性能，并证明仅提升检索分数不足以说明额外一遍计算的作用；作者提出诊断协议揭示前向信息流下图像状态保持查询无关，需打通查询→图像通路（如顺序交替循环）才能获得查询敏感的图像状态。
AI.motivation: 紧凑通用多模态嵌入模型希望在几乎不增加模型规模的前提下提升检索质量。循环Transformer以重复层增加计算，是替代更大编码器的诱人方案，且其在语言推理与检索上的成功启发了这一想法。但更高的检索分数本身无法揭示额外一遍计算究竟贡献了什么，因此需要区分"是否使用了额外遍""图像状态是否响应查询""这些更新是否真正改善检索"。
AI.method: 在单一视觉-语言架构的三个checkpoint上研究11种循环设计与训练变体。设计三层诊断协议：模型是否使用额外一遍、图像状态是否对查询敏感、更新是否改善检索。理论证明：在信息仅前向传播时，置于查询之前的图像经重复层仍保持查询无关。随后以三种方式打通查询→图像通路，包括顺序交替循环（下一遍把查询放在前面）。在MMEB-V2全部78个数据集上评测，并与各自去除循环的对照模型比较。
AI.result: 三种通路均产生查询敏感的图像状态。对双向注意力和顺序交替，冻结后期视觉更新不降低准确率。在MMEB-V2全部78个数据集上：标准附加循环相比其训练对照下降0.46分；插入中间生成阶段后效应变为+0.36分；以循环预训练的模型相比自身移除循环的对照提升+4.23分，并在视觉问答、按文本定位物体时受益于查询条件化的图像更新。
AI.conclusion: 额外的循环遍数本身并不保证检索提升，关键在于是否打通查询→图像的信息通路；检索分数不能作为循环有效性的充分证据。经过恰当设计（如顺序交替循环）与循环预训练，循环Transformer能在不增大模型规模的情况下显著提升多模态嵌入性能，并使图像状态获得查询条件化的能力。

title: Input-Space versus Feature-Level Conditioning for Robust Facial Expression Recognition
summary: Facial expression recognition (FER) degrades sharply when illumination, exposure or resolution departs from the training distribution. Two remedies dominate practice: enriching the input signal, or conditioning intermediate features on an estimated image quality. The two are rarely compared under matched backbones, training budgets and condition annotations, and their cost is seldom reported. We present a controlled comparison on RAF-DB. Input-space conditioning uses four deterministic, label-free views (logarithmic stretching, inverse-logarithmic stretching, down-up resampling and identity), each processed by a shared backbone with a branch-specific BatchNorm and linear head, with the branch logits averaged. Feature-space conditioning is implemented as FiLM and Conditional BatchNorm under an identical protocol. Across six backbone architectures the input-space variant improves top-1 accuracy on every one (mean +0.94 percentage points; bootstrap interval [0.51, 1.63]; sign test p = 0.016), with a seed-controlled estimate of +0.42 percentage points on ResNet-18, whereas feature-level conditioning yields +0.10 and +0.03 percentage points. We attribute the gap to the information content of the heuristic condition label rather than to the conditioning mechanism. The gain costs 4.00x FLOPs, 4.18x latency and 3.79x training time, i.e. 0.26 percentage points per additional GFLOP, and we state an explicit rule for when the trade is worth making.

AI.tldr: 本文在匹配骨干网络、训练预算与条件标注的受控条件下，对比了"输入空间条件化"（四视图共享骨干+分支BN）与"特征空间条件化"（FiLM、Conditional BatchNorm）两种提升面部表情识别鲁棒性方案，发现前者增益显著且给出显式取舍规则。
AI.motivation: FER在光照、曝光或分辨率偏离训练分布时性能急剧下降。现有两类主流补救（丰富输入信号 vs. 基于估计图像质量对中间特征做条件化）很少在匹配条件下被公平比较，且其计算代价鲜有报告。
AI.method: 在RAF-DB上做受控对比。输入空间条件化：四个确定性、无需标签的视图（对数拉伸、反正弦拉伸、下-上重采样、恒等），各由共享骨干处理，配分支专属BatchNorm与线性头，分支logits取平均。特征空间条件化：在完全相同协议下实现FiLM与Conditional BatchNorm。覆盖六种骨干架构，采用bootstrap区间、符号检验与种子控制实验。
AI.result: 六种骨干上输入空间变体均提升top-1（平均+0.94个百分点，bootstrap区间[0.51, 1.63]，符号检验p=0.016）；ResNet-18种子控制估计为+0.42个百分点；而特征级条件化仅+0.10与+0.03个百分点。差距归因于启发式条件标签的信息含量而非条件化机制本身。代价为4.00×FLOPs、4.18×延迟、3.79×训练时间，即每额外GFLOP 0.26个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 输入空间条件化以显著计算代价换来稳定且可复现的精度增益，其优势来自条件标签的信息量；作者据此给出该权衡何时值得采用的显式规则。

title: EvoMem3D: Adaptive-Depth Temporal Representation Memory for Multi-Camera 3D Detection
summary: Modern multi-camera 3D detectors increasingly rely on large Vision Transformer (ViT) image encoders, making repeated full-depth encoding a dominant inference cost even though adjacent driving frames are highly redundant. We present EvoMem3D, an adaptive-depth temporal framework that caches the most recent full-depth detector-interface appearance representation as a read-only anchor and combines it with policy-selected partial features from the current frame. A lightweight pre-encoding controller chooses among semantic encoder exits before image processing, allocating shallow computation to stable frames and deeper computation when the visual state changes. To reuse appearance without carrying stale geometry, we decouple temporal appearance from geometric alignment: current-frame calibration defines the decoder geometry at every timestamp, while a motion-conditioned positional adapter accounts for anchor-to-current ego motion. On nuScenes, EvoMem3D achieves 61.50 NDS and 52.76 mAP while reducing end-to-end latency from 364.4 to 168.7 ms (x2.16) relative to standard dense DETR3D. With StreamPETR, it reaches 61.36 NDS and 52.55 mAP at a x1.92 speedup. Controlled studies isolate the effects of current evidence, temporal reuse, memory correction, and adaptive routing, while our audit confirms that the policy learns to distinguish semantic driving regimes.

AI.tldr: EvoMem3D：一种自适应深度的时间框架，通过缓存锚定外观表示并结合当前帧部分特征，在nuScenes上实现约2倍加速且精度不降。
AI.motivation: 现有多相机3D检测器依赖大型ViT图像编码器，逐帧全深度编码成为主要推理开销，而相邻驾驶帧高度冗余，存在利用时间冗余降低计算量的空间。
AI.method: 将最近一次全深度检测器接口外观表示缓存为只读锚点，与策略选出的当前帧部分特征融合；预编码轻量控制器在图像处理前选择语义编码器出口，稳定帧走浅层、视觉变化时走深层；解耦时间外观与几何对齐——当前帧校准定义每一时刻的解码器几何，运动条件位置适配器补偿锚点到当前帧的自车运动。
AI.result: nuScenes上达到61.50 NDS、52.76 mAP，端到端延迟从364.4 ms降至168.7 ms（x2.16，相对标准稠密DETR3D）；结合StreamPETR达到61.36 NDS、52.55 mAP，加速x1.92。消融分离了当前证据、时间复用、记忆校正与自适应路由的贡献，审计表明策略能区分语义驾驶工况。
AI.conclusion: 通过自适应深度路由与解耦的时间外观复用，可在保持检测精度的同时显著降低多相机3D检测的端到端延迟。

title: How Reliable Is Visual Token Selection? Rethinking Pruning in Multimodal LLMs
comment: Accepted to Findings of the Association for Computational Linguistics: EACL 2027
summary: Visual token pruning improves the efficiency of multimodal large language models (MLLMs) by removing redundant visual tokens, yet the reliability of existing selection signals has not been systematically examined. We analyze token selection under semantics-preserving perturbations and across representative pruning criteria, revealing two limitations. First, attention-based importance shifts non-uniformly under perturbations, so magnitude alone cannot distinguish stable evidence from unstable saliency (local instability). Second, attention- and diversity-based methods select substantially different subsets despite comparable performance, showing that useful evidence is not confined to a unique subset (global inconsistency). These findings motivate reliable token-set construction. We instantiate this perspective in CoRePruner, a training-free framework combining instruction-aware diversity with reliability-aware attention. Across image benchmarks, multiple MLLM architectures, and token budgets, CoRePruner improves performance, especially under aggressive pruning, and remains competitive on video benchmarks. Our results establish reliability as a central consideration in visual token selection.

AI.tldr: 系统分析视觉token剪枝中重要性信号的可靠性，指出局部不稳定与全局不一致两大问题，并据此提出免训练框架CoRePruner。
AI.motivation: 现有MLLM视觉token剪枝依赖注意力幅值或多样性等选择信号，但这些信号的可靠性缺乏系统检验，需要明确何种视觉证据可被稳定选择。
AI.method: 在语义保持扰动下、跨代表性剪枝准则分析token选择行为；归纳出局部不稳定（注意力重要性在扰动下非均匀漂移，幅值无法区分稳定证据与不稳定显著性）与全局不一致（注意力方法与多样性方法所选子集差异显著但性能相当）两点局限；提出CoRePruner，免训练框架，结合指令感知多样性与可靠性感知注意力构建token集合。
AI.result: 在多个图像基准、多种MLLM架构与不同token预算下，CoRePruner性能提升，激进剪枝条件下增益尤为明显；在视频基准上保持竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 可靠性应作为视觉token选择的核心考量，CoRePruner验证了以可靠token集构建为导向的剪枝设计有效。

title: Improving X-Ray Baggage Instance Segmentation with Shared Point-Based Mask Refinement
summary: Overlapping projections and complex object contours make prohibited items difficult to delineate in X-ray baggage images. This study investigates shared point-based mask refinement to improve instance segmentation within Cascade Mask R-CNN. The framework combines a ResNet-101 backbone with an attention-based feature pyramid and progressively updates uncertain mask locations, increasing mask resolution from $28 \times 28$ to $112 \times 112$. A single refinement module is shared across cascade stages and refinement levels, with transformer and multilayer perceptron (MLP) variants used to examine the role of interactions among selected points. Ten configurations were evaluated on the official PIXray split across three training seeds using the original target-instance annotations for evaluation. The transformer and MLP refiners achieved mean mask average precision (AP) of 71.79 and 72.47, respectively, compared with 70.50 for the unrefined detector, yielding gains of 1.29 and 1.97 AP points. The MLP achieved the highest mean mask AP among the evaluated configurations. Both variants also improved boundary agreement on commonly detected objects, supporting improved mask delineation, while detection diagnostics did not establish a corresponding positive gain. These findings demonstrate that shared point-based refinement can improve segmentation quality in the tested cascade architecture using existing target-mask annotations, without additional occluder supervision. Evaluation on independent X-ray datasets is needed to determine how well these improvements generalize.

AI.tldr: 在Cascade Mask R-CNN中引入跨级共享的基于点的掩码精修模块，将掩码分辨率由28×28提升至112×112，使X光行李违禁品实例分割的掩码AP从70.50提升至最高72.47（MLP变体），边界一致性亦改善。
AI.motivation: X光行李图像中存在目标投影重叠与复杂轮廓，违禁品掩码难以精确勾画，现有级联分割检测器的掩码质量不足。
AI.method: 采用ResNet-101骨干网络与基于注意力的特征金字塔，在Cascade Mask R-CNN框架内加入共享的基于点（point-based）掩码精修模块：逐步更新不确定掩码位置，将掩码分辨率从28×28提升至112×112；同一精修模块在各级联阶段与各精修层级间共享；并对比Transformer与MLP两种点间交互建模变体，共评估10种配置。
AI.result: 在PIXray官方划分上、3个训练随机种子下评估（沿用原始目标实例标注）：Transformer与MLP精修器平均掩码AP分别为71.79与72.47，未精修检测器为70.50，分别提升1.29与1.97个AP点；MLP取得最高平均掩码AP。两种变体在常检目标上的边界一致性均有改善，但检测诊断指标未显示相应正增益。
AI.conclusion: 共享的基于点精修可在该级联架构中、仅依赖现有目标掩码标注（无需额外遮挡物监督）提升分割质量；其泛化性仍需在独立X光数据集上验证。

title: Unreasonable Confidence from Simulator Misspecification: Directional Robustness on the SPEED+ Sim-to-Real Benchmark
comment: 22 pages, 5 figures, 20 tables. Extended version of a paper at the Sim2Science workshop, NeurIPS 2026. Code, per-image predictions and pre-registration record: https://github.com/lokindoo/spacecraft-pose-estimation
summary: Vision-based navigation systems for orbit must be trained almost entirely on synthetic imagery, because real labelled images of a given spacecraft in flight rarely exist. Benchmarks like SPEED+ are built for that situation: the training set comes from a simulator, and the test sets are real images of a satellite mockup under two kinds of lighting. That simulator approximates how light reflects off mylar and aluminium, and like every scientific simulator it is misspecified. Its error is radiometric, since it misses the specular highlights, hard shadows and sensor saturation common in real images. We probe the resulting synthetic-to-real gap, the central risk for such systems, with a deliberately simple monocular pose estimator. In a 2x2 study of backbone adaptation and photometric augmentation, trained on synthetic images and tested on both real hardware-in-the-loop domains, we find three things. (1) The model does not know it is failing: regions conformally calibrated to 90% on synthetic data cover only 9-15% of rotation errors on sunlamp and 21-38% on lightbox, so a wrong pose carries the confidence of a correct one. (2) Transfer is asymmetric: scaling data and features improved synthetic rotation error from 1.65 to 1.03 rad but moved the harshly lit sunlamp domain by only 0.05 rad, under twice its seed s.d., whereas adapting the backbone's last stage carried 63-83% of its extra synthetic gain to both real domains. (3) Once the backbone adapts, augmentation helps only in the direction it models: our photometric stack improved the diffusely lit lightbox domain from 1.17 to 0.99 rad on every seed but moved sunlamp no more than seed-to-seed variation, while with the backbone frozen it helped sunlamp more. Every post-review experiment was pre-registered, and the code, per-image predictions and pre-registration record are at https://github.com/lokindoo/spacecraft-pose-estimation.

AI.tldr: 该文以SPEED+基准为平台，用极简单目位姿估计器系统探查航天器位姿估计中的合成→真实域差距，发现模型在真实域严重过度自信、迁移高度不对称，且骨干自适应是迁移增益的主要来源。
AI.motivation: 真实在轨航天器标注图像几乎不存在，视觉导航系统只能依赖合成图像训练；而所用仿真器存在辐射度层面的失配（缺失镜面高光、硬阴影、传感器饱和），由此产生的合成→真实域差距（synthetic-to-real gap）是此类系统的核心风险。
AI.method: 在SPEED+上开展2×2研究（骨干网络自适应 × 光度增强），训练集为仿真图像，测试于两个真实硬件在环域（sunlamp强光域与lightbox漫射光域）；模型为刻意简化的单目位姿估计器；采用共形预测（conformal calibration）评估置信度可靠性；所有审稿后实验均预注册，并公开代码、逐图预测与预注册记录。
AI.result: (1) 模型"不知道自己正在失败"：合成数据上校准到90%覆盖率的共形区域，在sunlamp域仅覆盖9–15%的旋转误差、lightbox域覆盖21–38%，即错误位姿带有与正确位姿同等的置信度。(2) 迁移不对称：扩大数据与特征使合成旋转误差从1.65降至1.03 rad，但sunlamp域仅改善0.05 rad（不到种子标准差的2倍）；而自适应骨干末级可将其63–83%的合成增益带到两个真实域。(3) 骨干一旦自适应，光度增强只在其所建模的方向上有效：光度栈使lightbox从1.17降至0.99 rad（所有种子一致），对sunlamp的影响不超过种子间波动；骨干冻结时反而对sunlamp帮助更大。
AI.conclusion: 合成→真实域差距的核心不在合成指标提升，而在置信度失准与迁移不对称；骨干网络末级自适应是向真实域迁移增益最有效的环节，光度增强须与骨干自适应配合且其收益受限于其建模的光照类型。后续研究应重视域内校准与预注册的严谨评估范式。

title: Self-supervised learning for zebrafish embryo phenotype evaluation: Systematic comparison of algorithms, label-efficient classification, and transfer learning
summary: Zebrafish embryos are a prominent model organism for image-based phenotyping and especially suited for large-scale imaging studies, for which machine learning (ML) models can automate evaluation. However, training ML models usually requires large labeled datasets, and differences in imaging conditions often impede reuse across laboratories. Self-supervised learning (SSL) addresses both constraints by learning transferable representations from unlabeled images. Yet central aspects like the choice of algorithm remain underexplored for domain-specific applications. To close this gap, we benchmark popular SSL algorithms on the public EmbryoNet dataset, explore label-efficient learning, and test transfer to an unseen setting. Using representations from our strongest model, a ResNet50 network trained with SwAV, a simple linear classifier reaches 86.4% accuracy and a non-linear classifier 87.1%, rivaling the fully supervised EmbryoNet model (87.1%). The SwAV model decisively outperforms supervised training from scratch when labels are scarce (70.2% vs. 45.7% accuracy with 5% of labels). On a three-class problem (normal, dead, falsely cropped) with a small, previously unseen zebrafish toxicity dataset, recorded in a different setting, our model reaches 81.3% accuracy without retraining, while EmbryoNet achieves 75.9%. Overall, self-supervised models for zebrafish embryos seem to mostly facilitate label-efficiency and transfer to new settings rather than improving supervised results.

AI.tldr: 本文在斑马鱼胚胎图像数据集EmbryoNet上系统基准测试多种自监督学习（SSL）算法，考察标签高效性与跨域迁移能力。最强模型（SwAV+ResNet50）线性/非线性评估分别达86.4%/87.1%，与全监督模型（87.1%）相当；仅用5%标签时显著优于从头监督训练（70.2% vs 45.7%），在未见场景的三分类数据上免训练迁移达81.3%（EmbryoNet为75.9%）。
AI.motivation: 斑马鱼胚胎是图像表型分析的重要模式生物，适合大规模成像研究，但训练机器学习模型通常依赖大规模标注数据，且成像条件差异导致模型难以跨实验室复用。自监督学习（SSL）可从无标注图像学习可迁移表征，有望同时缓解上述两个约束，然而在领域特定应用中算法选择等关键问题仍缺乏系统研究。
AI.method: 在公开EmbryoNet数据集上基准测试主流SSL算法，评估标签高效学习能力，并测试向未见成像场景的迁移。具体以SwAV训练的ResNet50为最强表征，采用线性与非线性分类器评估，并与全监督EmbryoNet模型对比；同时在少量标签（如5%）条件下与从头监督训练对比；再将表征免重训练迁移至另一成像设置下的小规模斑马鱼毒性三分类数据集（正常、死亡、错误裁剪）。
AI.result: SwAV表征配合简单线性分类器达86.4%准确率，非线性分类器达87.1%，与全监督EmbryoNet模型（87.1%）持平；在仅5%标签条件下，SwAV以70.2%大幅领先监督从头训练的45.7%；在未见设置的三分类毒性数据上免重训练达81.3%，优于EmbryoNet的75.9%。
AI.conclusion: 面向斑马鱼胚胎的自监督模型主要价值在于提升标签效率与向新成像设置的迁移能力，而非改进有充足标注时的监督性能；SSL可作为减少标注依赖、增强跨实验室复用的有效手段。

title: Event-Guided Stereo Video Super-Resolution
summary: Stereo Video Super-Resolution (SVSR) aims to reconstruct high-resolution stereo videos by exploiting temporal cues across consecutive frames and complementary spatial cues between stereo views. However, existing methods struggle to recover high-frequency texture details under rapid motion and complex illumination, compromising reconstruction quality and stereo consistency. Event cameras provide valuable motion and texture cues with high temporal resolution and wide dynamic range, yet their potential for SVSR remains underexplored. To bridge this gap, we present the first investigation of event-guided SVSR and propose a novel framework. Specifically, we develop an Event-Guided Texture Enhancement (EGTE) module that combines bidirectional temporal feature propagation with event-guided texture refinement to restore high-frequency details in complex motion regions. Subsequently, we introduce a Cross-View Texture Interaction (CVTI) module to model cross-view spatial correspondences and aggregate cross-view complementary texture information. With this design, our method effectively integrates event-driven motion and texture information, inter-frame temporal dependencies, and cross-view spatial relationships to recover motion-affected details and maintain stereo consistency. Extensive experiments on both real-world and synthetic datasets demonstrate that our method consistently outperforms existing super-resolution methods in reconstruction quality and stereo consistency. Project Page: https://wzlwlm13.github.io/EvSVSR

AI.tldr: 首次探索事件相机引导的立体视频超分辨率(SVSR)，提出结合事件引导纹理增强与跨视角纹理交互的框架，在真实与合成数据集上优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有SVSR方法在快速运动和复杂光照下难以恢复高频纹理细节，损害重建质量与立体一致性；事件相机具备高时间分辨率与宽动态范围，可提供运动与纹理线索，但其用于SVSR的潜力尚未被充分挖掘。
AI.method: 提出事件引导SVSR框架，包含：(1) Event-Guided Texture Enhancement (EGTE)模块，融合双向时序特征传播与事件引导纹理细化，恢复复杂运动区域的高频细节；(2) Cross-View Texture Interaction (CVTI)模块，建模跨视角空间对应关系并聚合跨视角互补纹理信息。
AI.result: 在真实世界与合成数据集上的大量实验表明，该方法在重建质量和立体一致性上持续优于现有超分辨率方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过统一整合事件驱动的运动与纹理信息、帧间时序依赖以及跨视角空间关系，可有效恢复受运动影响的细节并保持立体一致性，验证了事件引导在SVSR中的有效性。

title: Learning a Task-Adaptive Low-Dimensional Semantic Space for Improved Visual Classification
summary: Semantic visual classification commonly aligns visual embeddings with semantic spaces induced by pretrained text encoders. However, such spaces are typically high-dimensional, weakly aligned with visual feature geometry, and insufficiently discriminative for downstream classification tasks. We propose TaSS, a framework for learning a task-adaptive low-dimensional semantic space that preserves semantic structure while explicitly optimizing class separability. TaSS is constructed through a parameterized geometry transformation of pretrained text embeddings that enlarges inter-class margins via distance reshaping and improves intra-class compactness through prototype-preserving semantic constraints. The resulting semantic space maintains meaningful semantic relationships while producing a discriminative geometry tailored for classification. Frozen visual encoder features are subsequently aligned to TaSS using a lightweight MLP, enabling improved discriminative learning without fine-tuning pretrained backbones. We further provide theoretical analysis showing that TaSS preserves semantic consistency while enforcing enhanced inter-class separation and controlled intra-class variance. Extensive experiments on skeleton-based human action recognition, video classification, and image classification benchmarks demonstrate consistent improvements over existing semantic alignment approaches, with gains exceeding 3 percentage points on average and up to 8.5 points on challenging datasets.

AI.tldr: 提出 TaSS 框架，通过对预训练文本嵌入做参数化几何变换，学习任务自适应的低维语义空间，在保持语义结构的同时显式优化类可分性，并用轻量 MLP 将冻结视觉特征对齐到该空间。
AI.motivation: 现有语义视觉分类依赖预训练文本编码器的语义空间，但该空间通常维度过高、与视觉特征几何结构对齐弱、对下游分类判别性不足。
AI.method: 对预训练文本嵌入施加参数化几何变换：通过距离重塑扩大类间间隔，并用原型保持的语义约束提升类内紧凑性；再用轻量 MLP 将冻结视觉编码器特征对齐至该低维语义空间，无需微调骨干。附带理论分析证明语义一致性与类间分离、类内方差可控性。
AI.result: 在骨架动作识别、视频分类和图像分类基准上一致优于现有语义对齐方法，平均提升超过 3 个百分点，困难数据集最高提升 8.5 个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 任务自适应的低维语义空间可在保留语义关系的同时形成利于分类的判别几何，且仅以轻量对齐即可获得显著判别收益，无需微调预训练骨干。

title: SmoothShift: Disrupting Visual Adversarial Attacks on LVLMs at Test Time
summary: Visual adversarial perturbations can substantially impair large vision-language models (LVLMs) despite introducing only subtle input changes. To understand how these small changes cause substantial errors, we investigate their optimization and propagation through the model, revealing two key findings. First, stronger attacks rely on finer iterative optimization, while subtle input perturbations induce representation discrepancies that are amplified layer by layer through the vision encoder and persist in the language model. Second, disrupting the alignment between within-patch input patterns and the model's computation reduces clean-adversarial representation discrepancies and substantially weakens attacks. Together, these findings suggest that adversarial effectiveness depends on both fine-grained perturbation patterns and their coupling with the model's computation. Motivated by these findings, we propose SmoothShift, a lightweight, training-free defense that combines local smoothing and spatial transformations. Smoothing weakens fine-grained perturbation patterns, while spatial transformations disrupt their alignment with the encoder's patch grid. SmoothShift requires no model updates, auxiliary networks, or additional model inference. Experiments cover three LVLM families on four datasets and robustly fine-tuned Contrastive Language-Image Pre-training (CLIP) models on eight classification datasets. Evaluations across eight attack methods and multiple perturbation budgets demonstrate improved robustness while largely preserving clean performance. SmoothShift also provides robustness gains under defense-aware attacks using mixed-gradient BPDA with EOT.

AI.tldr: 本文通过分析视觉对抗扰动在LVLM中的优化与传播机制，发现攻击有效性依赖于细粒度扰动模式及其与模型计算的耦合，据此提出无需训练的轻量防御方法SmoothShift。
AI.motivation: 视觉对抗扰动仅引入细微输入变化却能显著损害大型视觉语言模型（LVLM）。作者希望揭示这些微小变化为何导致大幅误差，并据此设计有效防御。
AI.method: 先分析扰动的优化过程与跨层传播，得出两点发现：强攻击依赖更精细的迭代优化，细微扰动引起的表征差异会在视觉编码器中逐层放大并延续到语言模型；破坏patch内输入模式与模型计算的对齐可降低干净-对抗表征差异。基于此提出SmoothShift，一种结合局部平滑与空间变换的无训练防御：平滑削弱细粒度扰动模式，空间变换破坏其与编码器patch网格的对齐。该方法无需模型更新、辅助网络或额外模型推理。
AI.result: 在4个数据集上的3个LVLM系列，以及8个分类数据集上鲁棒微调的CLIP模型上进行实验；覆盖8种攻击方法和多种扰动预算，均提升鲁棒性且基本保持干净性能；在采用混合梯度BPDA与EOT的防御感知攻击下仍有鲁棒性增益。
AI.conclusion: 对抗有效性取决于细粒度扰动模式及其与模型计算的耦合，针对性破坏这两者即可实现轻量、免训练、无需额外推理的有效防御。

title: SAGE-VQA: A Training-Free, Self-Evolving Agentic Framework with Grounded Evidence for Knowledge-Based Visual Question Answering
summary: Knowledge-based visual question answering (KB-VQA) aims to combine visual information with external knowledge to answer user questions. Existing methods face two main bottlenecks: visual perception errors can propagate into hallucinations, and generalization across scenarios remains limited. To address these issues, we propose SAGE-VQA (Self-evolving Agent framework with Grounded Evidence), a training-free agentic framework that combines evidence verification with experience evolution. Our key insight is to explore an Evidence-Driven Adaptive Reasoning (EDAR) strategy. It accurately acquires and verifies question-relevant fine-grained visual information. It also extracts and refines reusable experience to support robust reasoning across tasks. Specifically, we design a Co-verified Visual Grounding module that verifies question-relevant visual information and provides grounded evidence for subsequent reasoning. We further introduce a Self-evolving Hierarchical Memory (SHM) mechanism. SHM organizes experiences into declarative and procedural memories based on their nature. These memories can be reused in subsequent reasoning and continually refined through feedback, without updating model parameters. Experimental results show that our method outperforms competing methods based on lightweight open-source vision-language models (VLMs) as well as those based on closed-source VLMs. Moreover, our method can serve as a plug-and-play reasoning framework for existing VLMs without modifying their architectures.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练的智能体框架SAGE-VQA，通过证据验证与经验进化解决KB-VQA中的视觉幻觉传播与泛化受限问题。
AI.motivation: 现有KB-VQA方法存在两大瓶颈：视觉感知错误会传播为幻觉；跨场景泛化能力有限。
AI.method: 提出SAGE-VQA免训练智能体框架，核心为证据驱动自适应推理（EDAR）策略：设计协同验证视觉定位模块（Co-verified Visual Grounding）获取并校验与问题相关的细粒度视觉信息，为推理提供有据可依的证据；引入自进化分层记忆（SHM）机制，按性质将经验组织为陈述性与程序性记忆，可在不更新模型参数的情况下复用并通过反馈持续精炼。
AI.result: 实验表明，该方法优于基于轻量级开源VLM和闭源VLM的竞争方法；且可作为即插即用推理框架适配现有VLM，无需修改其架构。
AI.conclusion: SAGE-VQA通过证据验证与经验进化的结合，有效抑制视觉幻觉传播并提升跨任务泛化，且具备良好的通用性与可移植性。

title: Remember, Replay, Adapt: Learning from Past Experience in Online Vision-and-Language Navigation
summary: Existing feedback-based methods for online vision-and-language navigation (VLN) primarily learn from current episode outcomes, leaving previously acquired feedback underutilized. Inspired by human episodic memory, we propose R2A, an online VLN adaptation framework that continually reuses successful and failed navigation experiences for policy learning. Specifically, Success-Failure Memory (SFM) retains successful and failed navigation episodes with acquired feedback and retrieves task-relevant experiences based on incoming instructions, enabling historical feedback to guide subsequent navigation. Prior-Anchored Adaptation (PAA) learns from these experiences by reinforcing successful trajectories and suppressing failed ones relative to a frozen pretrained policy, while regularizing behavioral drift. Together, these modules enable continual feedback reuse and stable policy adaptation without source-domain data or expert supervision. Extensive experiments across three benchmarks, REVERIE, R2R, and R2R-CE, and five navigation backbones demonstrate consistent performance gains. On the REVERIE validation unseen split, R2A improves DUET's SR from 46.98% to 69.84% and SPL from 33.73% to 50.98%.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 R2A 在线视觉语言导航自适应框架，通过“成功-失败记忆”检索历史反馈经验，并结合“先验锚定自适应”在冻结预训练策略基础上强化成功、抑制失败轨迹，实现无需源域数据与专家监督的持续策略学习。
AI.motivation: 现有基于反馈的在线 VLN 方法主要只利用当前 episode 的结果进行学习，先前获得的反馈经验被浪费，未能像人类情景记忆那样持续复用。
AI.method: R2A 包含两个模块：(1) Success-Failure Memory (SFM)：保存带反馈信息的成功与失败导航 episode，并根据新指令检索任务相关经验；(2) Prior-Anchored Adaptation (PAA)：以冻结的预训练策略为参照，强化成功轨迹、抑制失败轨迹，并正则化行为漂移。
AI.result: 在 REVERIE、R2R、R2R-CE 三个基准和五种导航骨干网络上均取得一致性能提升；REVERIE 验证集 unseen 划分上，DUET 的 SR 由 46.98% 提升至 69.84%，SPL 由 33.73% 提升至 50.98%。
AI.conclusion: 通过持续复用成功与失败反馈并稳定地自适应策略，R2A 可在无源域数据、无专家监督条件下显著提升在线 VLN 性能，且具备良好的骨干泛化性。

title: HIVE-ECIA: Identity-Aware Historical Evidence Acquisition for Bandwidth-Efficient Multi-Object Tracking
summary: Panoramic multi-object tracking (MOT) requires reliable identity association across a 360° field of view, yet bandwidth-constrained operation forces a trade-off between low-resolution (LR) identity ambiguity and costly high-resolution (HR) transmission. We propose HIVE-ECIA, an identity-aware framework that selectively retrieves historical HR evidence to recover fragmented identities without modifying detection boxes or the underlying tracker. An ECIA Base-Guided query policy determines when additional HR evidence is warranted; HIVE ranks historical LR observations to select an informative retrieval timestamp; and ECIA Full integrates the retrieved HR crop through learned gated fusion and conservative identity safeguards. We further introduce DualPano-MOT, a real-world dual-fisheye panoramic evaluation dataset featuring controlled pedestrian interactions, panorama-seam challenges, and occlusions, with model-assisted, manually verified tracking annotations. On held-out QuadTrack sequences and zero-shot DualPano-MOT, HIVE-ECIA improves identity association across four MOT trackers without tracker-specific retraining. Across these trackers, identity switches decrease by up to 21.8% and 23.4%, while the largest IDF1 gains reach 3.81 and 6.74 percentage points, respectively. Under an offline JPEG-based acquisition model, our framework reduces encoded data volume by 89.2% and 79.3% relative to continuous Full-HR acquisition.

AI.tldr: 提出HIVE-ECIA框架，通过选择性检索历史高分辨率证据恢复全景多目标跟踪中的碎片化身份，并发布DualPano-MOT数据集，在不同跟踪器上降低ID切换、提升IDF1并大幅压缩带宽。
AI.motivation: 全景MOT需在360°视野内可靠关联身份，但带宽受限导致低分辨率下身份模糊与高分辨率传输高开销之间的权衡。目标是在不修改检测框与底层跟踪器的前提下降解带宽约束下的身份关联性能。
AI.method: 三部分设计：(1) ECIA Base-Guided查询策略判定何时需要额外HR证据；(2) HIVE对历史LR观测排序，选择信息量最大的检索时间戳；(3) ECIA Full通过可学习门控融合与保守身份保护机制整合检索到的HR裁剪。此外构建DualPano-MOT双鱼眼全景数据集（受控行人交互、全景接缝挑战、遮挡，模型辅助加人工校验标注）。
AI.result: 在留出QuadTrack序列与零样本DualPano-MOT上，无需跟踪器特定重训练即在四种MOT跟踪器上改善身份关联：ID切换分别最多降低21.8%与23.4%，IDF1最大提升3.81与6.74个百分点；离线JPEG采集模型下编码数据量较连续Full-HR采集分别减少89.2%与79.3%。
AI.conclusion: 按需检索历史HR证据是缓解全景MOT带宽-精度权衡的有效且跟踪器无关的插件式方案，配合新数据集可推动真实全景场景下的身份关联研究。

title: Pros4D: Modeling Evolving 4D Worlds in Latent Space for Dynamic Spatial Reasoning
summary: Dynamic spatial reasoning from monocular video enables vision-language models (VLMs) to understand how 3D environments evolve over time, supporting physical world understanding and embodied intelligence. Existing efforts primarily address observed-dynamics understanding, whereas agents in dynamic environments also require future-dynamics prediction beyond the observation boundary. Moreover, external geometric processing and textual descriptions can increase inference complexity or lose information when representing continuous dynamics. These limitations motivate a shared internal state that preserves observed dynamics and remains predictive beyond the input video. Accordingly, we present Pros4D, a framework for modeling evolving 4D worlds in latent space that unifies retrospective understanding of observed-dynamics with prospective reasoning for future-dynamics prediction. Specifically, Pros4D-Engine derives geometry-grounded supervision and constructs paired examples for both tasks, while Pros4D-Bench evaluates them across eight spatial task categories spanning dynamic cameras, objects, and scenes. At the model level, Pros4D compresses observed dynamics into latent observed states and autoregressively rolls them forward into latent future states. 4D Latent Alignment (4DLA) grounds these states through complementary visual-semantic and geometric supervision, while joint language supervision connects them to task reasoning. Experiments across benchmarks show consistent improvements over strong baselines in both capabilities.

AI.tldr: 提出Pros4D框架，在潜空间中建模演化的4D世界，统一对观测动态的回顾性理解与对未来动态的前向预测。
AI.motivation: 现有工作主要解决"已观测动态"的理解，而动态环境中的智能体还需在观测边界之外预测未来动态；此外，外部几何处理与文本描述会提升推理复杂度或在表示连续动态时丢失信息。
AI.method: 构造观测动态的潜状态并自回归前推为未来潜状态；Pros4D-Engine生成几何接地监督并构建两任务配对样本；4D潜对齐（4DLA）以视觉-语义与几何互补监督对齐状态，并联合语言监督连接任务推理；Pros4D-Bench覆盖动态相机、物体、场景等八类空间任务。
AI.result: 在多个基准上，回顾性理解与未来预测两项能力均稳定优于强基线。
AI.conclusion: 以共享内部潜状态统一观测与预测的4D动态推理，可在无需外部几何处理与文本中介的情况下保持连续动态信息并具备预测能力。

title: When Backdoors Can Be Switched Off: Suppression-Aware Backdoor Attacks on Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models map visual observations, robot states, and natural-language instructions to robotic actions, but their multimodal interfaces introduce new security risks. Existing VLA backdoor attacks primarily study trigger-based activation and stealthy action manipulation, leaving conditional suppression of malicious behavior underexplored. We investigate suppression-aware backdoors, which combine conjunctive trigger activation with instruction-conditioned suppression. We instantiate this design through three variants: Cross-Modal Trigger, combining robot-state and spatially separated visual triggers; Self-Suppressing Trigger, requiring a state trigger and a [DISRUPT] instruction token for activation, with [RESTORE] token suppressing the attack; and Multi-Trigger, additionally requiring a visual trigger while retaining suppression even when physical triggers persist. We evaluate these attacks using SmolVLA on two SO-100 manipulation datasets against four baselines: State Backdoor, BadVLA, TabVLA, and SilentDrift. Self-Suppressing and Multi-Trigger reduce Isolation Forest detection from 96--98% to 1--18% and action-space l divergence by 10--14X, achieving 63--71% attack success rates with perfect clean-task performance. Experiments with OpenVLA on LIBERO further show that the attacks transfer to a 7B-parameter policy, evading STRIP and action-distribution-shift detection. Our findings establish conditional suppression as an important dimension for evaluating backdoor threats in VLA policies.

AI.tldr: 本文研究VLA模型中的"抑制感知后门"，通过合取触发激活与指令条件抑制相结合，提出三种攻击变体（跨模态触发、自抑制触发、多触发），在SmolVLA与OpenVLA上实现高攻击成功率并显著规避检测。
AI.motivation: 现有VLA后门攻击多关注基于触发的激活与隐蔽动作操纵，对恶意行为的"条件性抑制"这一维度研究不足；VLA多模态接口引入新的安全风险，需要系统评估此类威胁。
AI.method: 提出抑制感知后门设计，将合取触发激活与指令条件抑制结合，实例化为三种变体：Cross-Modal Trigger（机器人状态+空间分离视觉触发）、Self-Suppressing Trigger（状态触发+[DISRUPT]指令token激活，[RESTORE]token抑制）、Multi-Trigger（额外要求视觉触发，物理触发持续存在时仍可抑制）。在SmolVLA上基于两个SO-100操作数据集，与State Backdoor、BadVLA、TabVLA、SilentDrift四种基线对比。
AI.result: Self-Suppressing与Multi-Trigger将Isolation Forest检测率从96–98%降至1–18%，动作空间l1散度降低10–14倍，攻击成功率达63–71%且干净任务性能完美。OpenVLA在LIBERO上的实验表明攻击可迁移至7B参数策略，并规避STRIP与动作分布偏移检测。
AI.conclusion: 条件性抑制应作为评估VLA策略后门威胁的重要维度；指令条件抑制型后门具备高隐蔽性与可迁移性，现有检测手段难以有效识别。

title: Spatiotemporal Reconstruction of Auroral Precipitations with Neural Fields
comment: Accepted to the IEEE/CVF Winter Conference on Applications of Computer Vision (WACV 2027). Camera-ready version with supplementary material. 17 pages, 15 figures
summary: Auroras provide remote optical observations of energetic electrons precipitating into the upper atmosphere, and whose energy distribution encodes key information about large scale magnetospheric processes. Recovering the underlying electron precipitation field from ground-based camera images of auroras remains a challenging inverse problem. Existing auroral tomography techniques are often limited to simplified static settings, discrete spatial and energy grids, or strong assumptions on the electron energy spectrum. We propose to model the dynamic auroral electron precipitation field via a temporally conditioned neural network. The state of the precipitation field at each frame is represented by a per-frame latent code driven by learned discrete dynamics. A shared decoder maps horizontal positions and latent states to electron energy spectra. The predicted flux is converted to multi-wavelength volume emission rates and rendered into camera images accounting for delayed emissions. We evaluate the method on synthetic dynamic auroral sequences and real multi-view auroral videos, showing that the proposed representation produces temporally coherent precipitation reconstructions and image projections consistent with the observations.

AI.tldr: 提出一种时间条件神经网络来建模动态极光电子沉降场：以逐帧潜在码经学习到的离散动力学演化，共享解码器将水平位置与潜状态映射为电子能谱，再经多波段体发射率与延迟效应渲染成相机图像，实现时间连贯的沉降场反演。
AI.motivation: 极光是高能电子沉降的远程光学观测，其能量分布编码了大尺度磁层过程信息，但从地基极光相机图像反演电子沉降场是困难的反问题；现有极光层析方法多受限于静态简化设定、离散空间与能量网格，或对电子能谱的强假设。
AI.method: 用时间条件神经网络表示动态沉降场：每帧状态由逐帧潜在码表示，并由学习到的离散动力学驱动；共享解码器将水平位置与潜状态映射为电子能量谱；预测通量转换为多波段体发射率，并在渲染中计入延迟发射效应以生成相机图像。在合成动态极光序列与真实多视角极光视频上评估。
AI.result: 在合成动态极光序列和真实多视角极光视频上，所提表示能产生时间连贯的沉降场重建，且其图像投影与观测一致。
AI.conclusion: 以连续潜空间表示与学习动力学替代离散网格与能谱强假设，可有效用于动态极光电子沉降场的反演，兼具时间连贯性与观测一致性。

title: How Far Is Too Far? Object Recognition Declines Monotonically with Semantic Distance
summary: Vision models are sensitive to object-background context, yet it remains unclear how recognition changes as the semantic distance between objects and backgrounds increases. We introduce ImageNet-OOC1k, a benchmark enabling graded control of object-background relationships along a continuous consensus visual-semantic dissimilarity axis. This formulation reveals a highly consistent monotonic decline in recognition accuracy across 35 models spanning convolutional neural networks, Vision Transformers, and vision-language models. Internal analyses of Vision Transformers reveal patterns consistent with aggregation failure, where object evidence is present at the patch level but not consolidated into the final prediction. Using this characterization as a diagnostic probe, a simple spatial re-ranking strategy recovers a subset of these errors and improves in-sample accuracy by up to 5.7 percentage points. These results establish context sensitivity as a continuous and predictable property of modern vision systems, with Vision Transformer analyses suggesting that aggregation limitations may contribute to some failure types even when object evidence remains available.

AI.tldr: 论文提出ImageNet-OOC1k基准，沿连续共识视觉-语义差异轴分级控制物体-背景关系，揭示35个模型（CNN、ViT、VLM）识别准确率呈一致的单调下降，并将该现象诊断为ViT的"聚合失败"，用空间重排序恢复部分错误。
AI.motivation: 视觉模型对物体-背景上下文敏感，但物体与背景语义距离增大时识别如何变化尚不清楚；现有研究缺乏对物体-背景关系进行连续、分级控制的基准。
AI.method: 构建ImageNet-OOC1k基准，基于共识视觉-语义不相似度构建连续轴，对物体-背景关系进行分级控制；在35个模型（CNN、ViT、VLM）上评测；对ViT进行内部表征分析以定位失败机制；据此提出简单的空间重排序（spatial re-ranking）策略作为诊断性探针。
AI.result: 35个模型上识别准确率随语义距离增加呈高度一致的单调下降；ViT内部呈现"聚合失败"模式：patch级存在物体证据但未被整合进最终预测；空间重排序恢复部分错误，样本内准确率最高提升5.7个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 上下文敏感性是现代视觉系统连续且可预测的属性；ViT分析表明，即使物体证据可用，聚合局限也可能导致部分失败类型。

title: AstroPIE-53: Towards Understanding Failure Modes of Human Pose Estimation in Space
comment: 4 pages + references, 4 figures. Published in the Proceedings of SPAICE 2026 and i-SAIRAS 2026
summary: Reliable monitoring of astronauts is essential for safety, situational awareness, and autonomous assistance in space missions. While modern computer vision enables accurate human detection and pose estimation on Earth, its robustness in space environments remains largely unquantified due to limited data availability. We present AstroPIE-53, a pilot dataset of 53 annotated astronaut videos collected from publicly available mission footage. To respect copyright restrictions, we release video identifiers, reconstruction scripts, and dense annotations rather than raw videos. The dataset includes bounding boxes, challenge classes, and human-annotated pose failure tags. We benchmark state-of-the-art person detection and pose estimation models under realistic zero-shot deployment conditions and perform the first systematic failure analysis for astronaut monitoring. Our results reveal substantial performance degradation caused by occlusions, unusual body orientations, low contrast, and microgravity motion patterns.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 AstroPIE-53，一个由 53 段公开任务影像中标注的宇航员视频组成的试点数据集，并对现有行人检测与姿态估计模型进行零样本基准评测与首次系统失效分析。
AI.motivation: 宇航员可靠监测对太空任务的安全、态势感知与自主辅助至关重要，但现有计算机视觉方法在太空环境中的鲁棒性因数据稀缺而缺乏量化评估。
AI.method: 构建 AstroPIE-53 数据集：从公开任务影像采集 53 段宇航员视频，受版权限制仅发布视频标识符、重建脚本与稠密标注（含边界框、挑战类别、人工姿态失效标签）；在真实零样本部署条件下评测先进行人检测与姿态估计模型，并进行失效分析。
AI.result: 基线模型在零样本条件下性能显著下降，主要失效诱因包括遮挡、异常身体朝向、低对比度与微重力运动模式。
AI.conclusion: 太空场景中现有视觉模型鲁棒性不足，需针对遮挡、姿态异常、成像对比度与微重力运动等域差异进行专门改进，该数据集与失效分析为后续研究提供基准。

title: GlyphAtlas: Disentangling Stroke Detail from Layout for Scene Text Synthesis
summary: Scene text synthesis requires stroke-accurate characters rendered in a specified layout, as well as visual coherence with the surrounding scene. To achieve this, existing methods commonly pre-render the target text at its intended locations to form a glyph image that jointly specifies layout and glyph structure. However, this representation ties the resolution of each glyph to its target region, limiting fine-grained stroke guidance for small, densely packed, or structurally complex text. To tackle this, we propose GlyphAtlas, a scene text synthesis framework that retains the glyph image as a spatial anchor and supplies fine-grained stroke references through a dedicated glyph atlas. The atlas renders and encodes each character or word in a separate cell, decoupling reference resolution from target-region size. We further introduce atlas-anchored attention, which lets each text region retrieve stroke detail only from its corresponding atlas cells to refine the coarse glyph structure provided by the glyph image. This coarse-to-fine conditioning simplifies stroke rendering while preserving explicit layout correspondence. We optimize GlyphAtlas with a mask-weighted flow matching objective and a timestep-weighted text perceptual loss for writing accuracy and background consistency. Random resolution augmentation of atlas cells supports adjustable atlas budgets at inference. Extensive experiments demonstrate that GlyphAtlas achieves stroke-accurate synthesis of small, dense, and structurally complex text, zero-shot transfer to languages unseen during task-specific training, and leading performance in scenes with many text regions. project page: https://fr0zencrane.github.io/project-glyphatlas/

AI.tldr: 提出GlyphAtlas框架，将字形图像作为空间锚点，另用独立字形图集（atlas）为每个字符/词单独渲染编码，实现与目标区域尺度解耦的细粒度笔画参考，并配合atlas锚定注意力与掩码加权flow matching+时间步加权文本感知损失优化。
AI.motivation: 现有场景文本合成方法预渲染字形图像以同时指定布局与字形结构，导致每个字形的分辨率被绑定到其目标区域尺寸，对小型、密集或结构复杂的文本缺乏细粒度笔画引导。
AI.method: 1) 保留字形图像作为空间锚点；2) 引入专用glyph atlas，在独立单元中渲染并编码每个字符或词，使参考分辨率与目标区域大小解耦；3) 设计atlas锚定注意力，每个文本区域仅从对应图集单元检索笔画细节，细化粗粒度字形结构，形成由粗到细的条件；4) 采用掩码加权flow matching目标与时间步加权文本感知损失优化书写准确性与背景一致性；5) 图集单元的随机分辨率增强支持推理时可调图集预算。
AI.result: 实验表明GlyphAtlas在小型、密集及结构复杂文本上实现笔画精确合成，可零样本迁移至任务特定训练中未见语言，并在含大量文本区域的场景中取得领先性能。
AI.conclusion: 通过将布局锚定（字形图像）与笔画参考（独立图集）解耦，GlyphAtlas以粗到细的条件有效提升场景文本合成的笔画精度与可扩展性，并具备跨语言泛化与多文本区域场景优势。

title: MARLIN: Multiscale And Directional Sparse Representation Learning for Imbalanced SAR Ship Classification
summary: Despite recent progress in SAR maritime monitoring, ship classification remains challenging due to limited labeled data, class imbalance, large intra-class variability, fine-grained inter-class similarity, and variations in target scale, orientation, and backscattering structure. To address these challenges, this paper proposes MARLIN, a class-frequency-aware framework with directional sparse and hierarchical multi-scale feature extraction for ship type classification in SAR images. The proposed architecture first constructs two complementary representations of each input image, where each views are processed by parallel encoder branches. Each branch begins with a directional sparse convolutional stem designed to capture elongated and orientation-dependent ship scattering patterns, followed by customized hierarchical multiscale feature extraction blocks. To improve learning under imbalanced class distributions, we introduce a class-frequency aware objective. The proposed objective combines margin-based classification with class-frequency-weighted prototype compactness and class-pair frequency weighted margin separation. This formulation shapes the embedding space by encouraging samples from the same class to form compact clusters while enforcing stronger separation for class pairs involving underrepresented ship categories.
