Extensive experiments on three complementary datasets demonstrate that in addition to being lightweight and parameter efficient, MARLIN improves both overall accuracy and class-balanced metrics, confirming its effectiveness for robust SAR ship-type classification under limited and imbalanced training conditions. The codes are available at github.com/benyaminhosseiny/marlin.

AI.tldr: MARLIN：面向SAR舰船类型分类的类别频率感知框架，结合方向稀疏卷积与层次多尺度特征提取，并用类频率加权目标函数缓解类别不平衡。
AI.motivation: SAR海上监测中，舰船分类受标注数据有限、类别不平衡、类内差异大、类间细粒度相似，以及目标尺度、朝向与后向散射结构变化等因素制约。
AI.method: 为输入图像构建两种互补表示，分别送入并行编码器分支；每分支以方向稀疏卷积stem捕获细长、朝向相关的舰船散射模式，再接定制层次多尺度特征提取模块；训练目标结合基于margin的分类损失、类频率加权原型紧致性与类对频率加权margin分离。
AI.result: 在三个互补数据集上，MARLIN在轻量、参数高效的条件下同时提升总体精度与类别均衡指标。
AI.conclusion: 该框架在有限且类别不平衡的训练条件下可实现稳健的SAR舰船类型分类，代码已开源。

title: ReactBench-AD: Do Driving VLAs and World-Action Models React to Imminent Hazards in Their Path?
summary: Vision-Language-Action models (VLAs) and World-Action Models (WAMs) have emerged in autonomous driving with the promise of strong generalization to long-tail scenarios. Although these models achieve state-of-the-art results on autonomous driving benchmarks, most existing benchmarks are dominated by nominal scenarios and therefore cannot test this promise. To test one such long-tail capability that is critical for safety, we introduce ReactBench-AD, a benchmark that measures how driving models react to objects that appear in the ego vehicle's path. Built on real NAVSIM and PhysicalAI-Autonomous-Vehicles scenes, ReactBench-AD composites a crossing pedestrian, a standing pedestrian, or a stationary car consistently across all camera views and history frames. Each edited scene thus forms an exact, pixel-level counterfactual pair with its original, which allows us to isolate the causal effect of the inserted object on the predicted trajectory. Evaluating four VLAs and two WAMs, we find that they react weakly, often barely at all. Finally, we test how easily one of the evaluated VLAs, ReCogDrive, can be taught to brake hard for imminent hazards: a short fine-tuning stage on edited scenes substantially improves its reactions, with the learned behavior generalizing to unseen objects and fully real scenes, at minimal cost to nominal driving. These results call into question the out-of-the-box long-tail capabilities of these models, but suggest that they can be a strong foundation for acquiring them with little additional training, highlighting the value of real or synthetic data that demonstrates the long-tail behaviors nominal datasets rarely contain. Code and data will be made publicly available.

AI.tldr: 提出 ReactBench-AD，通过像素级反事实配对场景测试 VLA/WAM 对路中央突现物体的反应能力，发现现有模型反应微弱，但少量微调即可显著改善并泛化。
AI.motivation: 现有自动驾驶基准以常规（nominal）场景为主，无法检验 VLA/WAM 所宣称的长尾泛化能力；而"对自车路径中突然出现物体的反应"是安全关键的长尾能力，缺乏针对性评测手段。
AI.method: 基于真实 NAVSIM 与 PhysicalAI-Autonomous-Vehicles 场景构建基准：在所有相机视角与历史帧中一致地合成穿行行人、静立行人或静止车辆，使每个编辑场景与原场景构成严格的像素级反事实对，从而隔离插入物体对预测轨迹的因果效应。评测 4 个 VLA 与 2 个 WAM，并对 ReCogDrive 进行短时微调实验。
AI.result: 6 个模型（4 VLA + 2 WAM）对插入物体反应普遍微弱、甚至几乎无反应；对 ReCogDrive 在编辑场景上短时微调后，急刹行为大幅提升，且能泛化到未见物体与完全真实场景，常规驾驶性能损失极小。
AI.conclusion: VLA/WAM 的即用型长尾能力存疑，但其可作为强基座，仅需少量训练即可习得长尾行为；凸显了含长尾行为示范的真实/合成数据的价值。

title: VisDrone-ReID: A Unified Multi-Category Object Re-Identification Benchmark
summary: Object re-identification (Re-ID) benchmarks remain predominantly confined to single-category evaluations, limiting the development of unified systems capable of operating across diverse object types. This paper presents VisDrone-ReID, a unified multi-category Re-ID benchmark derived from the VisDrone2019-MOT dataset through a principled conversion pipeline. The pipeline resolves structural incompatibilities between multi-object tracking annotations and Re-ID evaluation requirements, addressing sequence-scoped identity collision, temporal redundancy, and the absence of a principled identity-level train/test split. The resulting benchmark comprises 9,516 identities and 150,016 images across ten object categories - pedestrian, people, bicycle, car, van, truck, tricycle, awning-tricycle, bus, and motor, sourced from 80 unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) sequences captured across urban environments. A leave-one-out (LOO) evaluation protocol is adopted to provide a comprehensive assessment. Baseline experiments across four representative Re-ID models spanning CNN and transformer architectures establish the first systematic performance reference on this benchmark. Results reveal a consistent Rank-1 to mAP gap across all models, suggesting that VisDrone-ReID presents a genuine retrieval challenge beyond nearest-neighbour matching. Per-category analysis identifies pedestrian as the most challenging category and reveals that vision-language pretraining provides a measurable advantage on semantically distinctive categories. VisDrone-ReID provides a consistent platform for studying multi-category object re-identification under the scale variation, viewpoint challenges, and category diversity characteristic of real-world surveillance scenarios.

AI.tldr: 本文提出VisDrone-ReID，一个从VisDrone2019-MOT转换而来的多类别统一Re-ID基准，含10类目标、9,516个身份与150,016张图像，并给出LOO评测协议与四种基线模型的系统性能参考。
AI.motivation: 现有Re-ID基准多局限于单类别评测，难以支撑跨多类目标的统一系统研发；且MOT标注与Re-ID评测需求存在结构不兼容（序列内身份冲突、时间冗余、缺乏身份级训练/测试划分）。
AI.method: 设计原则性转换流程：解决序列范围身份碰撞、去除时间冗余、构建身份级train/test划分；数据来自80个无人机序列，覆盖10类（行人、人群、自行车、汽车、厢式货车、卡车、三轮车、带棚三轮车、公交、摩托车）；采用留一类别（LOO）评测协议；在CNN与Transformer共四种代表性模型上进行基线实验。
AI.result: 构建9,516个身份、150,016张图像的多类别基准；所有模型均呈现一致的Rank-1与mAP差距，表明任务超出最近邻匹配；逐类别分析显示行人类最具挑战性，视觉-语言预训练在语义可区分类别上有可测优势。
AI.conclusion: VisDrone-ReID为真实监控场景下的尺度变化、视角挑战与类别多样性条件下的多类别Re-ID研究提供了一致性评测平台与首个系统性能参考。

title: Words Speak Louder? Exploring the Language Shortcut of LLM-Driven Incomplete Multimodal Learning
comment: 19 pages, 7 figures, 14 tables. Project page: https://peacelwh.github.io/CoVeR/
summary: Is a face or a voice still heard once the words are known? Incomplete multimodal learning increasingly uses large language models (LLMs) as fusion engines: modality features enter as token blocks and missing modalities become placeholders. We find that LLM-driven fusion can override non-verbal evidence it can read. Contrasting its full-input prediction with counterfactual views, the same model shown one modality or no content, we identify language shortcuts. We build MR-Bench: MR-Bench-A types every test sample of four sentiment benchmarks; MR-Bench-H contains 900 human-validated clips (620 language-shortcut, LS; 280 non-verbal-shortcut, NS) from seven sources, and every model is scored on all of them. Zero-shot MLLMs solve at most 32.7% of the LS clips; adding the transcript to the muted video lowers vision-language accuracy by 46.1-53.1 points. Yet inverting a text-only model's answers solves 94.4%, so LS accuracy alone cannot establish use of non-verbal evidence. Inside the fusion LLM, fused states align increasingly with the text view late in the decoder. Counterfactual-View Reliability learning (CoVeR) trains views as unimodal judges and withholds fused supervision where they disagree. It achieves state-of-the-art results on five benchmarks without extra inference cost in accuracy mode. On MR-Bench-H, it reaches 61.7% LS and 93.6% NS accuracy; robust mode raises LS accuracy to 63.0% while lowering NS accuracy to 84.8%. Among LS clips solved without text, adding text causes errors on 30.1% with CoVeR versus 32.2% with LLM-Fusion. Project page: https://peacelwh.github.io/CoVeR/.

AI.tldr: 论文发现 LLM 驱动的多模态融合会压制模型本可读取的非语言证据（语言捷径），并提出 MR-Bench 基准与反事实视图可靠性学习（CoVeR）来度量并缓解该问题。
AI.motivation: 现有不完整多模态学习把 LLM 当作融合引擎，模态特征作为 token 块输入、缺失模态用占位符替代，但作者发现这种融合会"覆盖"模型本身能够读取的非语言证据，即模型退化为依赖语言（文本）线索。需要定量刻画并解决该语言捷径问题。
AI.method: 通过对比全输入预测与反事实视图（仅单一模态或无内容输入）识别语言捷径，并构建 MR-Bench：MR-Bench-A 对四个情感基准的每个测试样本做文本化改写；MR-Bench-H 含 900 个人工验证片段（620 语言捷径 LS、280 非语言捷径 NS），来自七个数据源。分析融合 LLM 内部表示随解码进程向文本视图对齐的现象，提出 CoVeR：将各视图训练为单模态判别器，在视图不一致处取消融合监督。
AI.result: 零样本 MLLM 在 LS 片段上最高仅 32.7%；在静音视频中加入转录文本使视觉-语言准确率下降 46.1–53.1 个点；但反转纯文本模型答案可达 94.4%，说明 LS 准确率本身不能证明使用了非语言证据。CoVeR 在五个基准上取得 SOTA 且准确率模式无额外推理开销；MR-Bench-H 上 LS 61.7%、NS 93.6%，鲁棒模式 LS 升至 63.0%、NS 降至 84.8%。对于无文本即可解出的 LS 片段，加入文本导致错误率为 30.1%（CoVeR）对 32.2%（LLM-Fusion）。
AI.conclusion: LLM 融合会造成显著的语言捷径与晚期文本对齐，仅凭语言捷径样本准确率无法评估多模态证据利用；CoVeR 通过视图级判别与分歧处取消监督，在不增加推理成本的前提下提升了非语言证据的可靠利用，并揭示准确率与鲁棒性之间的权衡。

title: VoxSAOR: Semantic-Aware Occupancy Robustification via Aleatoric Uncertainty Modeling
comment: The source code will be made publicly available at https://github.com/MengfeiD/VoxSAOR
summary: Vision-based 3D occupancy prediction provides a dense semantic representation of scenes for autonomous driving and embodied perception, yet remains vulnerable to occlusion, depth ambiguity, and projection errors that induce spatially varying reliability in voxel features. Existing methods typically map voxel representations to semantic predictions without explicitly modeling such observation-induced feature variations. To address this limitation, we propose VoxSAOR, a semantic-aware occupancy robustification framework that models aleatoric uncertainty through feature-space proxies. It first quantifies Local Semantic Consistency (LSC) to derive a voxel-wise structural stability prior and uses cross-view semantic consensus to filter unreliable semantic correspondences. Within each semantic category, spatially matched stable and ambiguous voxels form stable-to-ambiguous feature transitions, which are modeled by a class-conditional diagonal Gaussian distribution, capturing both feature displacement and dispersion. Guided by these proxy distributions, Aleatoric Regime Ensemble Learning (AREL) trains independently parameterized prediction heads using feature perturbations at progressively increasing scales, with perturbation strength modulated by structural reliability. At inference, proxy modeling and sampling are disabled, and all heads process the same observed features; their output probabilities are then averaged to produce a deterministic consensus prediction without requiring sampling. Experiments across multiple datasets and occupancy backbones demonstrate the effectiveness of VoxSAOR in improving semantic occupancy prediction, long-tail recognition, and predictive calibration. The source code will be made publicly available at https://github.com/MengfeiD/VoxSAOR.

AI.tldr: VoxSAOR 通过特征空间代理建模偶然不确定性，提升视觉3D占用预测的语义精度、长尾识别与标定质量。
AI.motivation: 基于视觉的3D占用预测受遮挡、深度歧义与投影误差影响，体素特征可靠性在空间上分布不均；现有方法直接将体素表示映射为语义预测，未显式建模这种由观测引起的特征变异。
AI.method: 1) 量化局部语义一致性（LSC）得到体素级结构稳定性先验；2) 用跨视图语义共识过滤不可靠语义对应；3) 在类内以空间匹配的稳定-歧义体素对构建“稳定到歧义”的特征迁移，并用类条件对角高斯分布建模特征位移与离散度作为代理分布；4) 提出偶然态集成学习（AREL），按结构可靠性调节扰动强度，用逐级增大的特征扰动训练独立参数化的预测头；5) 推理时关闭代理建模与采样，各头共享观测特征并平均输出概率，得到确定性共识预测。
AI.result: 在多个数据集与多种占用骨干网络上验证，VoxSAOR 在语义占用预测、长尾类别识别和预测标定三方面均取得提升；代码将于 https://github.com/MengfeiD/VoxSAOR 开源。
AI.conclusion: 以特征空间代理刻画观测诱导的偶然不确定性，并结合可靠性调制的扰动集成，可在不增加推理采样的前提下实现确定性、更鲁棒的占用预测。

title: LiveView: Real-Time Camera-Controlled Re-filming of Streaming Videos
summary: Real-time camera-controlled video re-filming aims to synthesize target views from a streaming source video under online user-specified camera trajectories. This task poses two key challenges: maintaining synchronization and content consistency across views, and achieving low-latency rendering with long-horizon stability. Existing approaches are predominantly designed for offline full-sequence processing and rely on bidirectional attention or costly depth-based geometric preprocessing, making them unsuitable for low-latency streaming scenarios. To address these limitations, we develop a teacher-to-student framework that distills a high-fidelity bidirectional re-filming teacher into a few-step causal autoregressive student. We introduce Cross-Frame Injection to interleave each incoming source frame with its synchronized target latent, thereby establishing direct cross-view correspondence and improving content consistency. To ensure stable long-horizon generation, we further propose Shared Relative RoPE, which bounds temporal indices within the pretrained range, and Cycle Streaming Tuning, which exposes the student to extended cyclic trajectories during streaming training. These designs enable low-latency online video re-filming with precise camera control and sustained spatiotemporal consistency over long streaming rollouts.

AI.tldr: 提出教师-学生蒸馏框架，将双向重拍摄教师蒸馏为少步因果自回归学生，实现低延迟、长时稳定的在线相机可控视频重拍摄。
AI.motivation: 实时相机可控视频重拍摄需在流式源视频上按在线用户指定轨迹合成目标视角，面临两大挑战：跨视角的同步与内容一致性，以及低延迟渲染与长时稳定性。现有方法多为离线全序列处理，依赖双向注意力或昂贵深度几何预处理，不适用于低延迟流式场景。
AI.method: 构建教师-学生框架，将高保真双向重拍摄教师蒸馏为少步因果自回归学生。三项关键设计：(1) Cross-Frame Injection，将每帧输入源帧与其同步的目标潜变量交错排列，建立直接跨视角对应；(2) Shared Relative RoPE，将时间索引约束在预训练范围内以保证长时稳定；(3) Cycle Streaming Tuning，在流式训练中让学生接触更长的循环轨迹。
AI.result: 实现低延迟在线视频重拍摄，具备精确相机控制，并在长时流式推演中保持持续的时空一致性。
AI.conclusion: 通过教师-学生蒸馏结合跨帧注入、共享相对RoPE与循环流式调优，可有效兼顾流式低延迟、跨视角内容一致性与长时稳定性。

title: PixelBench: Evaluating Language Models for Pixel-Art Creation
summary: Pixel art is widely used in games and digital content creation, requiring readable forms, coherent spatial relationships, and harmonious colors under limited resolution and palette constraints. Language models show growing promise in visual creation, yet their pixel art creation capabilities lack systematic evaluation. We introduce PixelBench, formalizing text-to-image generation and instruction-guided editing for pixel art and providing a benchmark for these tasks. We further present a creation environment in which language model agents invoke drawing tools through code to generate and edit pixel art. We assess the quality of generated artwork through human evaluation and employ a multimodal large language model as a judge, validating the agreement between its automated assessments and human preferences. We compare language models and configurations across diverse subjects and canvas sizes. In our experiments, GPT-6 Astra achieves both the highest average judge score and the best average human rank, highlighting the potential of general-purpose language models for pixel art creation. We release the tasks, all artworks, the human rankings, and the judge protocol.

AI.tldr: 提出PixelBench，形式化像素艺术的文生图生成与指令引导编辑任务，构建LLM智能体通过代码调用绘图工具的创作环境，并用人工评估+多模态大模型裁判（经一致性验证）系统评测语言模型的像素艺术创作能力。
AI.motivation: 像素艺术在游戏与数字内容创作中广泛使用，需在有限分辨率与调色板约束下满足可读性、连贯空间关系与色彩协调；语言模型在视觉创作上潜力渐显，但其像素艺术创作能力缺乏系统化评测。
AI.method: 1) 提出PixelBench基准，形式化文本到图像生成与指令引导编辑两类任务；2) 构建创作环境，语言模型智能体通过编写代码调用绘图工具生成与编辑像素画；3) 采用人工评估衡量作品质量，并以多模态大语言模型作为裁判，验证自动评分与人类偏好的一致性；4) 在不同题材与画布尺寸上比较多种语言模型与配置。
AI.result: GPT-6 Astra在平均裁判分数与平均人类排名上均取得最佳表现，体现通用语言模型在像素艺术创作上的潜力；裁判模型与人类偏好的一致性得到验证。发布任务、全部作品、人类排名及裁判协议。
AI.conclusion: PixelBench为语言模型的像素艺术创作提供了系统化、可复现的评测框架，并表明"代码调用工具+LLM裁判"范式可有效评估此类视觉创作；通用大模型在该任务上已展现优势。

title: Radar Panoptic Transformer: Semantic-Guided Mask Queries for Dynamic Scene Understanding
summary: Automotive radar provides long-range sensing and direct Doppler velocity measurements, but its sparse and non-uniformly sampled point clouds pose significant challenges for panoptic segmentation. Dynamic objects often yield only a few detections amid a dominant static background, providing limiting the geometric cues for separating object instances. We propose \emph{Radar Panoptic Transformer (RPT)}, an end-to-end point-based network that incorporates radar-adaptive feature extraction with semantic-guided mask prediction. Its backbone aggregates pose-aligned temporal context through grouped vector attention and learns per-point neighborhood radii conditioned on range, azimuth, and radar cross section (RCS). Point-wise semantic predictions initialize queries at likely foreground detections and guide masked cross-attention through query-point class agreement, producing instance masks without geometric clustering. An auxiliary RCS-consistency loss matches instance-level statistics between predicted and annotated instances. RPT achieves state-of-the-art performance on RadarScenes with $71.6\%$ mIoU and $82.2\%$ PQ. We further evaluate RPT on MAN TruckScenes, where it outperforms the evaluated baselines in a long-range, full-surround radar setting with sensing ranges up to $230\,\mathrm{m}$. RPT achieves real-time end-to-end inference at $31$\,Hz on RadarScenes, exceeding the sensor frame rate.

AI.tldr: 提出Radar Panoptic Transformer (RPT)，一种端到端点云全景分割网络，在RadarScenes上达到71.6% mIoU和82.2% PQ，并实现31Hz实时推理。
AI.motivation: 车载毫米波雷达具备长距离感知与直接多普勒测速能力，但其点云稀疏且非均匀采样；动态目标检测点极少而静态背景主导，几何线索受限，难以区分目标实例，给全景分割带来显著挑战。
AI.method: RPT为点式端到端网络，包含雷达自适应特征提取与语义引导的掩码预测。主干通过分组向量注意力聚合位姿对齐的时序上下文，并依据距离、方位角与雷达截面积(RCS)学习逐点邻域半径；逐点语义预测在潜在前景检测处初始化查询，并通过查询-点类别一致性引导掩码交叉注意力，无需几何聚类即可生成实例掩码；另引入RCS一致性损失，对齐预测与标注实例的实例级统计量。
AI.result: 在RadarScenes上取得最先进性能：71.6% mIoU、82.2% PQ；在MAN TruckScenes的长距全向雷达场景（探测距离达230m）中优于所评估基线；在RadarScenes上实现31Hz实时端到端推理，超过传感器帧率。
AI.conclusion: RPT通过雷达自适应特征提取与语义引导掩码预测有效应对稀疏非均匀雷达点云的全景分割难题，兼具精度与实时性，并在长距全向场景中展现良好泛化能力。

title: Lesion-Aware Explainable AI for Diabetic Retinopathy Grading from Fundus Images
comment: 12 pages, 6 figures, 9 tables. Truong Thinh Nguyen and Hai Phong Nguyen contributed equally. Corresponding author: Truong Thinh Nguyen
summary: Post-hoc explanations of deep-learning models for diabetic retinopathy (DR) grading are difficult to trust because different attribution methods highlight different retinal regions for the same image, and a visually plausible heatmap does not show that the highlighted pixels drive the prediction. We propose the Consensus-Calibrated Explanation Map (CCEM), which fuses Grad-CAM++, Ada-SISE, and SmoothGrad Integrated Gradients (SG-IG) using image-specific weights derived from annotation-free reliability cues: deletion sensitivity, inter-method agreement, compactness, retinal containment, and peak structure. CCEM explains a frozen ordinal grader, an EfficientNet-B7 with CBAM and a scalar regression head, pre-trained on EyePACS 2015 in Stage 1 and fine-tuned on APTOS 2019 in Stage 2 with quadratic weighted kappa (QWK)-optimized thresholds; it reaches a QWK of 0.920 on the hidden Kaggle test set and 0.559 on the external MAPLES-DR cohort. Explanations are evaluated on MAPLES-DR, 198 MESSIDOR images with expert pixel-level lesion annotations that are never used for training, threshold fitting, or fusion. On the 193 images with annotated lesions, CCEM obtains the highest Soft Pointing Game score (69.61%; 95% CI 63.7-75.3), defined as the ratio of the strongest lesion-supported saliency to the global map maximum rather than a lesion detection rate, together with the lowest deletion AUC (0.570) and the best deletion-insertion balance (0.115); each gain is significant against the strongest single explainer on paired tests. Annotation-free, per-image reliability weighting therefore turns three disagreeing explainers into one map whose peak evidence is more lesion-supported and more faithful to the model than that of any single explainer.

AI.tldr: 提出共识校准解释图（CCEM），用无需标注的可靠性线索为 Grad-CAM++、Ada-SISE、SG-IG 三种归因方法生成逐图权重并融合，得到比任何单一解释器更忠实、更贴合病灶的显著图。
AI.motivation: 糖尿病视网膜病变（DR）分级模型的事后解释难以信任：同一图像下不同归因方法高亮不同视网膜区域，且视觉上合理的热图并不能证明被高亮像素真正驱动了预测。
AI.method: 构建 CCEM，基于五类无需标注的可靠性线索（删除敏感度、方法间一致性、紧凑性、视网膜内包含度、峰值结构）为 Grad-CAM++、Ada-SISE、SG-IG 计算图像级权重并融合。被解释模型为冻结的序数分级器：EfficientNet-B7 + CBAM + 标量回归头，先在 EyePACS 2015 预训练，再在 APTOS 2019 微调并以 QWK 优化阈值。解释评估使用 MAPLES-DR（198 张 MESSIDOR 图像及专家像素级病灶标注），标注完全不参与训练、阈值拟合与融合。
AI.result: 模型在隐藏 Kaggle 测试集 QWK 为 0.920，外部 MAPLES-DR 队列为 0.559。在 193 张有病灶标注的图像上，CCEM 取得最高 Soft Pointing Game 分数 69.61%（95% CI 63.7–75.3），该指标定义为最强病灶支撑显著度与全局图最大值的比值；同时具有最低删除 AUC（0.570）和最佳删除-插入平衡（0.115）；各项增益在配对检验下均显著优于最强单一解释器。
AI.conclusion: 无需标注的逐图可靠性加权可将三种互相分歧的解释器融合为单一显著图，其峰值证据更具病灶支撑性且对模型更忠实。

title: PathLoop: Self-Evolving Multi-Agent Reasoning for Evidence-Grounded Whole-Slide Image Analysis
summary: Analyzing whole-slide images (WSIs) requires combining evidence across tissue regions and spatial scales. Multi-agent systems offer a promising approach to this task. However, existing systems make limited use of molecular evidence, often select visually prominent but less representative regions while overlooking global context, and struggle to reuse experience from previous cases. To address these challenges, we present PathLoop, a self-evolving multi-agent framework that integrates omics data for evidence-grounded WSI analysis. Specifically, PathLoop coordinates visual and omics interpreters across slide, patch, and pixel levels, using molecular signals to guide region selection and combining local tissue details with global slide features. A judgment agent then checks the consistency of the collected evidence against Pathology-Wiki, a knowledge base built from 48 entries across 24 organ systems, and triggers re-examination when the evidence is inconsistent. To reuse past experience, a four-level memory stores reasoning trajectories, practical tips, skills, and tools to guide future cases, forming a loop of evidence collection, review, and memory update. We evaluate PathLoop on four TCGA cohorts with biomarker prediction, survival prediction, and subtype classification. The results demonstrate the effectiveness of PathLoop across these tasks and support its use for evidence-grounded WSI analysis.

AI.tldr: PathLoop是一个自进化的多智能体框架，融合组学数据实现循证式全切片图像（WSI）分析，通过四级记忆复用历史经验。
AI.motivation: 现有WSI多智能体系统对分子证据利用有限，易选择视觉显著但代表性不足的区域而忽视全局上下文，且难以复用既往病例经验。
AI.method: PathLoop在切片、图块、像素三个层级协调视觉与组学解释器，用分子信号引导区域选择，结合局部组织细节与全局切片特征；判断智能体依据Pathology-Wiki（涵盖24个器官系统48条目）校验证据一致性，不一致时触发重新检查；四级记忆存储推理轨迹、实用技巧、技能与工具，形成证据采集—审查—记忆更新的闭环。
AI.result: 在四个TCGA队列上针对生物标志物预测、生存预测与亚型分类任务评估，结果验证了PathLoop在上述任务中的有效性。
AI.conclusion: PathLoop支持循证式WSI分析，可作为融合组学证据的多智能体解决方案。

title: Ocular Recognition: Interoperability, Multi-Resolution, and Spectrum Challenges
comment: Paper submitted to IEEE journal in revision process. Abstract reduces to 1920 characteres
summary:
Ocular recognition is typically developed under controlled acquisition conditions, limiting its use in semi-controlled and on-the-move scenarios. A key obstacle is the lack of representative data spanning real-world capture conditions. At a border checkpoint, for example, images may range from low-resolution visible-light periocular crops (RGB) to high-resolution near-infrared iris images (NIR). Using this heterogeneous evidence raises three questions: whether resolution-specific processing improves recognition, how to compare templates from different processing routes, and how to allocate training data across resolution specialists.
  We investigate resolution-specific processing and parameter sharing using three AdaFace-based architecture families: fixed-resolution specialists; Independent Backbones with Shared Heads (IBSH); and models with resolution-specific front-ends for 40x40, 80x80, and 160x160 inputs, followed by a shared identity trunk and embedding projection. We evaluate each architecture with route-specific training subsets and with a full-pool strategy, in which every specialist uses the complete selected training set.
  Results reveal a trade-off among same-resolution specialization, cross-resolution interoperability, and common-route re-extraction. Route-specific training produces distinct performance profiles across routes, whereas full-pool training makes route performance more uniform and primarily benefits the 160x160 route. Thus, adding training data does not improve all resolution routes equally.

AI.tldr: 研究在真实半受控场景（如边检）下跨分辨率眼部识别，比较固定分辨率专家、共享头独立骨干（IBSH）和分辨率特定前端+共享主干三类AdaFace架构，并对比按路径训练与全池训练策略，揭示同分辨率专精、跨分辨率互操作与公共路径重提取之间的权衡。
AI.motivation: 眼部识别多在受控采集条件下开发，难以用于半受控与移动场景；核心障碍是缺乏覆盖真实采集条件（从低分辨率RGB periocular裁片到高分辨率NIR虹膜图）的代表性数据。需要回答三个问题：分辨率特定处理是否提升识别、如何比较不同处理路径的模板、如何在各分辨率专家间分配训练数据。
AI.method: 基于AdaFace设计三类架构族：固定分辨率专家；共享头独立骨干（IBSH）；以及针对40x40、80x80、160x160输入的resolution-specific前端+共享身份主干与嵌入投影。每类架构分别用路径特定训练子集和全池策略（每个专家使用完整选定训练集）评估。
AI.result: 结果呈现同分辨率专精、跨分辨率互操作与公共路径重提取之间的权衡。路径特定训练在不同路径上产生差异化性能轮廓；全池训练使各路径性能更均匀，且主要惠及160x160路径。增加训练数据并不能同等地提升所有分辨率路径。
AI.conclusion: 分辨率特定处理与训练数据分配需在专精性、跨分辨率互操作性和重提取代价之间折中；全池训练有利于性能均衡但对高分辨率路径收益最大，提示数据扩增的收益依分辨率路径而异。

title: DoF-Query Transformer for Adaptive Fusion of Egocentric Vision and Forearm HD-sEMG in Continuous Hand Kinematics
summary: Continuous and accurate estimation of human hand kinematics is important not only for intuitive human-machine interaction, but also for capturing fine-grained human manipulation demonstrations that can provide action supervision for embodied-intelligence datasets and dexterous robot learning. However, individual sensing modalities may be insufficient for reliable estimation under varying operating conditions. We present a finger-unencumbered multimodal framework for continuous regression of 20 hand joint angles from egocentric RGB images and 128-channel forearm high-density surface electromyography (HD-sEMG). The framework combines a Vision Transformer-based visual encoder, a Transformer-based EMG encoder, and a degree of freedom (DoF) query Transformer fusion decoder. To account for the varying informativeness of visual and EMG cues across joint DoFs and input conditions, the decoder assigns a separate learnable query to each DoF, enabling DoF-specific and context-adaptive fusion of the two modalities. The framework was evaluated on synchronized multimodal data from 10 participants. Averaged across participants, the proposed fusion model achieved a mean coefficient of determination ($R^2$) of $0.88$ and a mean absolute error (MAE) of $2.80^\circ$, compared with $0.82$ and $3.21^\circ$ for the vision-only model and $0.68$ and $5.13^\circ$ for the EMG-only model. It also outperformed the evaluated representative unimodal baselines and alternative fusion designs. DoF-wise analyses showed larger fusion gains for visually ambiguous joints and viewing conditions, while synthetic visual occlusion demonstrated greater robustness than vision-only estimation. These results highlight the complementary value of egocentric vision and forearm HD-sEMG for capturing fine-grained human hand kinematics, with potential applications in human demonstration acquisition and dexterous robot learning.

AI.tldr: 提出一种融合第一人称RGB与128通道前臂高密度表面肌电的多模态框架，对20个手部关节角进行连续回归；以DoF查询Transformer做逐自由度自适应融合，平均R²=0.88、MAE=2.80°。
AI.motivation: 连续、准确的手部运动学估计既服务于自然人机交互，也可为具身智能数据集与灵巧操作学习提供细粒度动作监督。但单一传感模态在多变工况下可靠性不足：视觉存在遮挡与视角歧义，肌电在跨个体/姿态变化下信息不稳定，因此需要多模态互补。
AI.method: 采用手指无束缚（不佩戴指部传感器）的多模态框架：ViT视觉编码器处理第一人称RGB，Transformer编码器处理128通道前臂HD-sEMG，并设计自由度查询Transformer融合解码器。为应对视觉与肌电线索在不同关节DoF及输入条件下的信息量差异，解码器为每个DoF分配独立可学习query，实现DoF特定且上下文自适应的融合。
AI.result: 在10名被试的同步多模态数据上，融合模型平均R²=0.88、MAE=2.80°，优于纯视觉（0.82 / 3.21°）与纯肌电（0.68 / 5.13°），也优于代表性单模态基线与替代融合设计。逐DoF分析显示视觉歧义关节与观测条件下的融合增益更大；合成视觉遮挡实验表明鲁棒性优于纯视觉估计。
AI.conclusion: 第一人称视觉与前臂HD-sEMG在捕捉细粒度手部运动学上具有互补价值，可用于人体示范采集与灵巧机器人学习。局限在于被试规模较小（10人），尚未体现跨个体泛化验证。

title: Aerial Person Detection under Edge Constraints: Held-Out Evaluation and Edge-Ground Verification
comment: 14 pages, 1 figure, 8 tables. Code, truth registers and result files: https://github.com/numberz-ai/aerial-person-detector
summary: A search drone sees a missing person as a few pixels, carries a small computer, and shares a narrow radio link. We study person detection under those limits; the primary evaluations were declared before they ran, and later analyses are marked exploratory. In an exploratory comparison, holding out recording blocks inferred from thermal frame identifiers cut recall at a fixed false-alarm target from 32.7% to 12.3%. With nothing tuned on test blocks, a 46,000-parameter detector gated by a contrast cue finds 10.4% of people against 5.7% for the same network applied everywhere. A standard detector, YOLO11n, trained under the same folds finds 54.5% at a similar false-alarm rate for about eleven times the arithmetic, and on our 4K field footage at 117 m has a walking person among its top 16 detections in up to 92% of frames against 74% for our board. Run alone, YOLO11n's thresholds set at one location overshot their false-alarm target 1.7 to 3.4 times at new locations, and its best configuration at altitude cost 4 to 24 standard passes per frame. Re-scoring its 16 best crops (154 KB per frame) with an 842,000-parameter ground model, thresholds frozen on a validation location, raised recall from 44.9% to 53.7% against the same 16 crops with YOLO's own scores; in a post hoc paired analysis over 15 test locations the gain was +8.8 points [+2.4, +12.5]. Pooled false detections fell from 0.86 to 0.64 per frame, but that paired change was not distinguishable from zero. Coverage of a still person in earth tones was very low for both detectors in the clips we flew.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究搜索无人机在极小目标、机载算力与窄带宽限制下的人员检测，并以预注册为主、探索性分析为辅给出量化结果与取舍。
AI.motivation: 搜索无人机场景中，目标仅占几个像素、机载计算资源有限、无线电链路带宽狭窄，需要评估在此类约束下人员检测的真实性能与评测可靠性。
AI.method: 主要评估在运行前预先声明，后续分析标注为探索性；采用按从热成像帧标识推断的录制块进行留出评估；构建46,000参数、以对比度线索门控的轻量检测器；与YOLO11n在相同折上对比；用842,000参数地面模型对YOLO前16个候选裁剪（154 KB/帧）重打分，阈值在验证地点冻结；并做15个测试地点的配对事后分析。
AI.result: 留出录制块使固定虚警目标下召回从32.7%降至12.3%；未在测试块调参时，门控网络召回10.4%，全域应用为5.7%；YOLO11n约11倍算力下召回54.5%，117 m 4K实拍中行人进入前16检测的比例最高92%（本方案74%）；阈值跨地点超虚警目标1.7–3.4倍，最优配置每帧多耗4–24次标准前向；重打分使召回44.9%→53.7%，配对增益+8.8点[+2.4,+12.5]；池化虚警0.86→0.64/帧但差异不显著；土色调静止人员覆盖率两者均极低。
AI.conclusion: 在机载算力与带宽约束下，轻量门控检测器虽极省算力，但绝对召回远低于标准检测器；YOLO类模型跨地点阈值泛化差、算力代价高，可通过轻量地面重打分显著提升召回而虚警下降不显著；对低对比度静止人员两者均表现很差，是该任务的关键失效模式。

title: Geo2Gcode: From 3D Geometry to CNC Programs through Structured Machining Primitives
summary: Turning a 3D shape into a Computer Numerical Control (CNC) program is still largely manual. For every part, a machinist chooses setups, tools, step-downs, and toolpath patterns. We present Geo2Gcode, which converts a target mesh directly into standard G-code through structured machining primitives. Each primitive couples an indexed machining direction, a closed per-view reconstruction of the target, and explicit tool-radius, layer-height, and clearing-pattern parameters, and compiles deterministically into layerwise toolpaths via signed-distance queries. Most of the fidelity comes from this compiler. A lightweight selector trained with a voxel stock simulator fills in primitive parameters without per-part manual settings, approaching the finest fixed setting at about a quarter of its toolpath length. In simulation on ABC parts, Geo2Gcode reaches roughing fidelity comparable to an expert-tuned commercial CAM setup with a moderately longer toolpath, and clearly improves on a default CAM configuration. Generated programs run in a commercial G-code simulator, and one part is machined on a physical CNC mill. These results demonstrate that roughing programs can be generated directly from geometry without per-part CAM tuning.

AI.tldr: 提出 Geo2Gcode，将三维网格经由"结构化加工图元"直接编译为标准 G-code，实现无需逐件 CAM 调参的粗加工刀路自动生成。
AI.motivation: 三维形状到 CNC 程序的转换仍高度依赖人工：机加工人员需为每个零件手工选择装夹方案、刀具、分层深度与刀路模式，效率低且经验依赖强。
AI.method: 以"加工图元"为核心单元：每个图元耦合一个带索引的加工方向、目标在该视角下的封闭重建，以及显式的刀具半径、层高与清料模式参数；图元通过有符号距离场查询确定性地编译为逐层刀路，保真度主要来自该编译器。另用体素毛坯模拟器训练轻量级选择器，自动填充图元参数，免去逐件手工设定。
AI.result: 选择器在约四分之一刀路长度下接近最优固定设置的精度；在 ABC 零件仿真中，粗加工保真度与专家调优的商业 CAM 配置相当（刀路略长），并明显优于默认 CAM 配置；生成程序可在商业 G-code 模拟器中运行，且有一个零件在实际 CNC 铣床上完成加工。
AI.conclusion: 粗加工程序可直接由几何生成，无需逐零件 CAM 调优，验证了几何到 G-code 端到端生成路径的可行性。

title: Latent World Modeling for Point-Cloud Video Pretraining
summary: Masked modeling is the dominant self-supervised paradigm for point-cloud videos. However, it leaks the information it is meant to predict, whether it reconstructs masked points as in MAE-style methods or predicts their latent features. Because point-cloud tokens are anchored at points sampled from each frame, querying a target at its own position reveals where its geometry has moved, in reconstruction and latent prediction alike. For latent predictors, random spatio-temporal masks introduce a further shortcut, as visible frames on both sides of each target allow interpolation rather than forecasting. The pretext task thus reduces to completion. Once the target positions are withheld, a masked latent predictor performs only slightly better than copying the last frame. To remove this leakage, we propose PointWM, a latent world model that turns completion into forecasting by predicting the features and geometry of future frames from strictly earlier context. Each target is queried only with its last-seen position and timestamp, while a latent action learned without annotations is meant to capture the part of the future that the past leaves undetermined. On HOI4D action segmentation with a P4Transformer backbone, PointWM improves F1@50 over training from scratch by 24.9 offline and 29.1 under strictly causal inference. These results show the promise of latent world models as a leakage-free pretraining paradigm for point-cloud videos.Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/InitalZ/PointWM.

AI.tldr: PointWM将点云视频的掩码建模从"补全"改造为"预测"，通过仅用最后观测位置查询目标特征与几何，消除位置泄漏与时空插值捷径，形成无泄漏的潜在世界模型预训练范式。
AI.motivation: 现有掩码建模范式（MAE式重建或潜在特征预测）存在信息泄漏：点云token锚定在采样点上，直接在其自身位置查询目标即可暴露几何位移；随机时空掩码还使目标两侧可见帧允许插值而非外推，使预训练任务退化为补全。一旦扣留目标位置，掩码潜在预测器仅略优于复制上一帧。
AI.method: 提出PointWM潜在世界模型：严格以更早的上下文预测未来帧的特征与几何。目标仅用其最后观测位置与时间戳进行查询；并引入无需标注学习到的潜在动作（latent action），用于刻画过去无法确定的那部分未来。
AI.result: 在HOI4D动作分割任务、P4Transformer骨干上，F1@50相比从零训练提升24.9（离线）与29.1（严格因果推理）。
AI.conclusion: 实验表明潜在世界模型可作为点云视频无泄漏预训练的有效范式。

title: See the Lives of Stars in a Handful of Light
summary: Galaxies evolve over hundreds of millions of years, and no telescope has ever watched one move. Cosmological simulations make this evolution visible as a sequence of multi-view images, inviting the question of whether a galaxy can be recovered in four dimensions from its images. This setting defeats existing dynamic scene methods, since millions of stars span only a few pixels each, faint populations blend into diffuse light, and free deformations reproduce the images without obeying gravity. We present Cosmos4D, which rests on two components. Gravitational 4D Gaussian Splatting represents each star as a self-luminous Gaussian whose motion is integrated through a gravitational potential and a low-dimensional force field shared by all stars. Luminosity-stratified dynamics give bright stars individual orbits supervised across image scales and carry faint populations with a velocity field estimated from optical flow. We further build a 4D dataset of eight galaxies from four cosmological simulations, on which Cosmos4D outperforms dynamic Gaussian baselines in both photometric quality and physical accuracy. With these advancements, we glimpse eight hundred million years of a galaxy's life in ninety-six frames.

AI.tldr: 提出 Cosmos4D，用引力 4D 高斯泼溅从多视角图像重建星系四维演化，并构建八个星系的 4D 数据集。
AI.motivation: 星系演化历时数亿年，无望远镜可直接观测；宇宙学模拟虽以多视角图像序列呈现该演化，但现有动态场景方法难以从图像重建四维星系：数百万恒星每颗仅占几个像素、暗弱星族混入弥散光、自由形变可在不遵守引力的情况下拟合图像。
AI.method: Cosmos4D 含两部分：1) 引力 4D 高斯泼溅，将每颗恒星表示为自发光高斯，其运动在引力势与所有恒星共享的低维力场中积分；2) 光度分层动力学，亮星获得跨图像尺度监督的个体轨道，暗弱星族由光流估计的速度场驱动。
AI.result: 构建了来自四个宇宙学模拟、包含八个星系的 4D 数据集；Cosmos4D 在光度质量与物理准确性上均优于动态高斯基线。
AI.conclusion: 以 96 帧呈现星系约八亿年的生命历程，实现物理一致的星系四维重建。

title: FastGRN: Few-Step Generative Refinement Networks
summary: Generative Refinement Networks (GRN) generate an image by repeatedly re-predicting and refining every token of a discrete latent. They reach high fidelity, but need dozens of Markov steps. We therefore train few-step GRNs on the distribution of their own samples. We use its own uniform-state corruption to perform distribution matching on discrete tokens, which lets a discrete generator learn by backpropagation, and we pair noise with samples in the manner of rectified flow. We find that the steps of a few-step GRN do not carry the same amount of information or the same repair load. We therefore exploit its discrete refinement during training and build few-step GRNs in three parts. Oversampling samples the student with more steps than it was trained for and refines its judge on these samples. Non-uniform sampling trains only the last step and hands it most of the information at sampling time. Refinement confidence keeping holds on to the tokens the student is already sure of. We train a fast class-conditional generator on ImageNet 256 and, with the same method, a 2B text-to-image model. On ImageNet 256, the 3-step FastGRN beats the FID of GRN. On a 2B binary-token text-to-image GRN, a 4-step student also nearly matches the GenEval of GRN-T2I 2B.

AI.tldr: 提出少步生成精炼网络(FastGRN)，通过对自身采样分布做离散token分布匹配和整流流式噪声-样本配对，并用三种精炼技巧，把需数十步马尔可夫采样的GRN压缩到3–4步且保持或超越质量。
AI.motivation: GRN逐token反复预测与精炼离散潜变量，保真度高但需数十个马尔可夫步，采样代价大；需要训练少步版本，同时发现少步GRN中各步的信息量与修复负担并不相同，故需针对性设计。
AI.method: 在自身样本分布上训练少步GRN：利用其uniform-state corruption在离散token上做分布匹配，使离散生成器可反向传播学习；按rectified flow方式将噪声与样本配对。训练分三部分：(1) Oversampling：给学生更多步数采样并精炼其判别器；(2) Non-uniform sampling：只训练最后一步并在采样时赋予其主要信息；(3) Refinement confidence keeping：保留学生已确信的token。
AI.result: 在ImageNet 256上，3步FastGRN的FID优于原GRN；在同一方法训练的2B二值token文本到图像GRN上，4步学生的GenEval几乎匹配GRN-T2I 2B。
AI.conclusion: 少步GRN可通过对自身样本的离散分布匹配与分步差异化训练实现大幅步数压缩，且在小步数下保持甚至提升生成质量，方法可扩展至2B级文生图模型。

title: VISTA: A Framework for Vision-Informed Semantic Traffic Awareness
comment: 8 pages, 4 figures, Accepted for publication in IEEE Internet of Things Magazine, 2026
summary: The Internet of Things (IoT) is transforming intelligent transportation systems by connecting roadside cameras, edge computing units, vehicles, and traffic infrastructure into a shared sensing and decision-making ecosystem. However, transmitting raw traffic video over vehicle-to-everything (V2X) links is bandwidth-intensive, while deploying large multimodal models directly on resource-constrained vehicles is often impractical. To address these limitations, this article proposes VISTA (Vision-Informed Semantic Traffic Awareness), a multimodal vision-language edge-intelligence framework that combines predictive video representation learning with lightweight language-based reasoning to provide communication-efficient traffic situational awareness. In the proposed architecture, roadside surveillance units employ the Video Joint Embedding Predictive Architecture (V-JEPA) and an attentive-pooler module to convert traffic video clips into compact future-scene embeddings. These embeddings are transmitted through V2X links to vehicle-mounted systems, where a TinyLlama small language model, enhanced with a custom visual adapter, interprets the embeddings alongside natural-language (NL) traffic queries. VISTA enables vehicles to obtain interpretable traffic information, reason about upcoming scene dynamics, and identify potential collision risks without receiving raw video streams. Experimental results in a digital-twin urban traffic environment show that VISTA achieves 97.77% accuracy and an 89% F1 score for future collision prediction while reducing the communication payload by several orders of magnitude compared with raw RGB video transmission. These results demonstrate the feasibility of embedding-based multimodal intelligence for low-latency, communication-efficient, and safety-oriented IoT-enabled transportation systems.

AI.tldr: 提出VISTA框架：路侧用V-JEPA+注意力池化将交通视频编码为紧凑未来场景嵌入并经V2X传输，车载端由带视觉适配器的TinyLlama结合自然语言查询解读嵌入，实现通信高效的交通态势感知与碰撞预测。
AI.motivation: IoT与V2X场景下，直接传输原始交通视频占用带宽过大，而在资源受限车辆上直接部署大型多模态模型不现实，需要一种兼顾通信效率与车载可部署性的多模态智能方案。
AI.method: 路侧监控单元采用视频联合嵌入预测架构V-JEPA配合attentive-pooler模块，把视频片段转为紧凑的未来场景嵌入；嵌入经V2X链路传至车载系统，由视觉适配器增强的TinyLlama小型语言模型结合自然语言交通查询进行解读与推理。
AI.result: 在数字孪生城市交通环境中，未来碰撞预测准确率97.77%、F1为89%，通信载荷相比原始RGB视频传输降低数个数量级。
AI.conclusion: 验证了基于嵌入的多模态智能在低时延、通信高效且面向安全的IoT交通系统中具备可行性，车辆无需接收原始视频即可获得可解释的态势信息与风险识别能力。

title: LEDGE: Separating Critic and Editor Failures in Text-to-Image Self-Correction
summary: Text-to-image (T2I) self-correction combines a vision-language model (VLM) critic that diagnoses errors and proposes instructions with an image editor that executes them. End-to-end evaluation obscures whether failures arise from incorrect diagnoses or an editor unable to execute valid instructions. We introduce LEDGE (Learning Error Diagnosis in Generation and Editing), a framework that separates these bottlenecks. LEDGE compiles oracle edit instructions from GenEval while holding the generated images and the editor fixed, isolating the editor's correction capability from the critic's diagnostic accuracy. On Stable Diffusion 3.5 Large, oracle instructions raise GenEval from 72.0% to 81.2%, versus 74.1% for the baseline VLM critic. Yet 435 of 644 failed images remain unrepaired, exposing a substantial editor gap. We also use oracle labels from disjoint training prompts to supervise the critic. Oracle supervision raises exact diagnosis from 33.3% (the same VLM with our structured output, untrained) to 70.8%. With the same editor, the resulting critic improves GenEval from 42.2% (uncorrected) to 59.4% on Stable Diffusion 1.5, against 50.9% for the baseline critic, and from 72.0% to 76.0% on Stable Diffusion 3.5 Large, despite training only on Stable Diffusion 1.5. Improvements transfer to unseen object classes, a second editor, and independent T2I-CompBench judges and prompts. A small human evaluation confirms the ranking in estimated net corrections but suggests a smaller gain than detector-based evaluation. LEDGE thus distinguishes two limits of self-correction: knowing what to fix and being able to fix it.

AI.tldr: 提出LEDGE框架，解耦T2I自纠正中的"诊断"与"执行"瓶颈：用oracle指令隔离编辑器能力，用oracle标签监督critic提升诊断准确率，证明二者是两类独立限制。
AI.motivation: 端到端评估T2I自纠正难以区分失败源自VLM critic的错误诊断，还是编辑器无法执行正确指令，导致改进方向不明确。
AI.method: 从GenEval编译oracle编辑指令，固定生成图像与编辑器，单独测量编辑器的纠正上限；再用来自不相交训练prompt的oracle标签监督critic（配合结构化输出），分离诊断能力。
AI.result: SD 3.5 Large上oracle指令将GenEval从72.0%提至81.2%（基线critic仅74.1%），但644张失败图中435张仍无法修复，暴露显著editor gap；oracle监督将精确诊断率从33.3%提至70.8%。同一编辑器下，新critic在SD 1.5上由42.2%升至59.4%（基线50.9%），SD 3.5 Large上由72.0%升至76.0%（仅用SD 1.5训练），并迁移至未见类别、第二编辑器及T2I-CompBench；人工评估确认排序但增益小于检测器评估。
AI.conclusion: 自纠正存在"知道改什么"与"能改得动"两个独立上限，需分别针对critic诊断精度与编辑器执行能力优化。

title: DominoBench: Evaluating Multi-Step Physical Reasoning from Still Images
comment: DominoBench dataset, evaluation harnesses, and benchmarks available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/emilioferrara/DominoBench
summary: Can a vision-language model look at a picture of a chain reaction and tell what will happen? Recent multimodal models describe scenes fluently and solve textbook physics problems, which suggests they should also predict how a scene of ramps, ledges, pendulums, seesaws and dominoes plays out once a ball is pushed. We tested this claim on 30 models from 10 families and reached a clear conclusion: unaided, no model predicts the outcome reliably. We built DominoBench, a benchmark of still images of 2D rigid-body scenes whose outcome a physics simulator computes. It holds 854 items in 427 minimal pairs, in which a change of one to three grid steps in one quantity decides whether one person survives, and every item comes with a four-rung hint ladder ending in the exact calculation that decides the outcome. Unaided, frontier models from Anthropic, Google and OpenAI are right about the person whose fate flips in at most 72% of items and answer both twins of a pair correctly in at most 34%. Pointing at the deciding step helps little, and exact geometry given as text barely helps, yet once the deciding calculation and the quantities it needs, including speeds that a still image cannot show, are written out, the same models reach 82-92% on the deciding person, while small open-weight models stay near chance. Physical prediction from a still image therefore fails at the quantitative step: the strongest models use the deciding quantity when they are given it, but do not produce it on their own. For models that plan or act in the physical world, a fluent account of a scene is thus no evidence of a correct prediction: such models must find and compute the deciding quantity unprompted, and DominoBench tests whether they do.

AI.tldr: 提出DominoBench基准（854个2D刚体场景图像、427个最小对比对、四级提示阶梯），系统评测30个模型后发现：无人辅助时视觉语言模型无法可靠预测静止图像的物理结局，瓶颈在"定量步骤"——模型能用给定决定量推理，却不能自行产生该量。
AI.motivation: 多模态模型能流畅描述场景、解答教科书物理题，看似应能预测斜坡、摆、多米诺等场景在推球后的演化结果，但这一能力是否真实存在缺乏严格检验；需要构建可控、可量化、区分"语言流畅"与"物理预测"的评测。
AI.method: 构建DominoBench：静止图像形式呈现2D刚体场景，结局由物理模拟器计算；含854个条目（427个最小对比对，单量改变1–3个网格步即翻转"某人是否存活"的结局），每条目配四级提示阶梯，终点为决定结局的精确计算。评测10个模型家族共30个模型（含Anthropic、Google、OpenAI前沿模型与小参数开放权重模型），逐级增加提示信息量。
AI.result: 无辅助时，前沿模型预测"结局翻转者"正确率≤72%，成对两题同时正确≤34%；指向决定步骤帮助有限，以文本给出精确几何也收效甚微；而当写出决定计算及其所需量（含静止图像无法呈现的速度）后，同批模型升至82–92%，小开放权重模型仍接近随机。
AI.conclusion: 静止图像的物理预测失败于定量环节：最强模型在被告知决定量时会使用它，却无法自发产生它。因此流畅的场景描述不能作为正确物理预测的证据；需在物理世界规划或行动的模型必须无提示地定位并计算决定量，DominoBench即为检验该能力的基准。

title: Signs of Wear: Evaluating Intelligent Speed Assistance Under Synthetic Adverse Conditions
summary: Intelligent Speed Assistance (ISA) systems rely on cameras to recognize speed-limit signs, yet existing benchmarks underrepresent the weathered, dirty, and overgrown signs commonly encountered on rural roads. We use generative image editing to introduce different forms of wear into real street-level images of speed-limit signs. The resulting ISA-Wear dataset contains paired original and edited images. Guided by text instructions, a multimodal image-editing model adds snow, rust, vegetation, faded paint, or mud to the speed-limit sign in a street-level frame at three severity levels. Where appropriate, the surrounding scene is adapted as well, and the viewpoint is kept. Every edited frame has an unedited counterpart, and we only evaluate frames whose original is recognized correctly, so any failure can be attributed to the wear. Since the model alters the sign's geometry in 21\% of the edits, all edits are filtered by a geometric check and a manual review. Severity is measured as the LPIPS distance between the original and the edited sign plate. On 716 worn frames, we find that in detect-then-read pipelines, wear breaks detection before it breaks reading. The detector finds only 62\% of the worn signs, even though it finds every one of them in the original frames. Missed detections account for 78--87\% of failed reads, a pattern that a zero-shot detector shares. Given the annotated sign box, as in the crop-based benchmarks, a classifier still reads 78\% of the worn signs, but only 56\% when it has to rely on the detector

AI.tldr: 提出 ISA-Wear 数据集：用生成式图像编辑给真实街景限速标志添加积雪、锈蚀、植被遮挡、褪色、泥污五类磨损（三级严重度，保留视角与原图配对），并以 LPIPS 量化严重度；在 716 张磨损帧上发现"检测先于识读失效"——检测器仅检出 62% 磨损标志而原图全检出，漏检占识读失败的 78–87%。
AI.motivation: 现有 ISA（智能限速辅助）评测基准对乡村道路常见的风化、脏污、植被遮挡限速标志覆盖不足，导致系统在真实退化条件下的鲁棒性被高估；且缺少能在控制变量下归因失效来源（检测 vs. 识读）的对照数据。
AI.method: 以文本指令引导多模态图像编辑模型，在真实街景帧中对限速标志施加雪、锈、植被、褪色漆面、泥污五类磨损，每类三档严重度，适度调整周边场景并保持视角不变；生成成对的原图/编辑图。仅评测原图被正确识别的帧，使失败可归因于磨损。用几何检查加人工复核过滤 21% 几何被改变的编辑；以原图与编辑标志牌之间的 LPIPS 距离度量严重度。在 detect-then-read 流水线与 crop-based（给定标注框）分类器两种设置下评测。
AI.result: 716 张磨损帧上，磨损先破坏检测再破坏识读：检测器仅检出 62% 磨损标志（原图为 100%），漏检占识读失败的 78–87%，零样本检测器呈现相同模式；给定标注框时分类器仍能识读 78%，仅依赖检测器输出时降至 56%。
AI.conclusion: 磨损对 ISA 的主要瓶颈在检测阶段而非识读阶段；现有 crop-based 基准高估了系统鲁棒性，评测应覆盖检测-识读全链路并纳入退化标志；生成式编辑配对数据可作为可控、可归因的鲁棒性评测手段。

title: Trait Collapse in Text-to-Image Generation: Evaluating and Mitigating Personality Inconsistency in Visual Storytelling
comment: EMNLP 2026 Main Conference Paper. 26 pages, 5 figures
summary: In visual storytelling, a believable character must not only look consistent across scenes but also \textit{behave} in ways that reflect their personality. Current text-to-image (T2I) models preserve visual appearance effectively, yet consistently fail to maintain personality-relevant behavior---a failure we term \textit{trait collapse}. We show that conventional metrics (CLIP Score, DINO similarity) are blind to this failure, and that abstract personality descriptors and scene-level emotion labels do not produce consistent improvements over neutral prompts across models. To systematically diagnose trait collapse, we introduce \textbf{ViStoryBench-Personality}, a story-level benchmark combining an expert-validated Visual Cues Lexicon (Fleiss' $κ= 0.757$) with a six-dimensional metric suite covering personality alignment, cross-scene stability, and behavioral coherence. Evaluating seven T2I systems, we confirm a persistent semantic gap between abstract trait labels and visual evidence, and find that visual identity consistency does not imply personality consistency. To bridge this gap, we propose \textbf{Trait-Behavior-Visual (TBV)}, a training-free prompting framework that decomposes personality traits into renderable visual constraints. TBV improves Personality Alignment Score by up to $+22.1\%$, with larger gains in models with stronger language-conditioning capacity.

AI.tldr: 论文指出T2I模型存在"特质崩塌"(trait collapse)问题：外观一致但人格行为不一致，且现有指标对此盲视。作者提出故事级基准ViStoryBench-Personality进行系统诊断，并提出免训练提示框架TBV，将人格特质分解为可渲染的视觉约束，使人格对齐分数最高提升22.1%。
AI.motivation: 视觉叙事中，可信角色不仅需跨场景外观一致，还需行为体现人格。当前T2I模型虽能良好保持视觉外观，却系统性无法维持与人格相关的行为，且CLIP Score、DINO相似度等常规指标无法检测该失败；抽象人格描述词与场景级情绪标签相对中性提示也无稳定改进。因此需系统诊断该"特质崩塌"现象并加以缓解。
AI.method: 1) 定义并揭示trait collapse，验证常规指标失察及抽象特质/情绪标签的无效性；2) 构建故事级基准ViStoryBench-Personality，含专家验证的视觉线索词库（Fleiss' κ=0.757）与六维指标套件，覆盖人格对齐、跨场景稳定性与行为连贯性，评估7个T2I系统；3) 提出免训练提示框架TBV（Trait-Behavior-Visual），将人格特质分解为可渲染的视觉约束。
AI.result: 在7个T2I系统上确认抽象特质标签与视觉证据之间存在持续语义鸿沟，且视觉身份一致性并不意味着人格一致性。TBV将Personality Alignment Score最高提升22.1%，在语言条件能力更强的模型中增益更大。
AI.conclusion: T2I的视觉一致性并不蕴含人格一致性，需以故事级、行为导向的基准进行诊断；通过将抽象特质显式分解为可渲染视觉线索的免训练提示策略，可有效缓解trait collapse，且效果随模型语言条件能力增强而提升。

title: FinVision: Multimodal AI for Visualizing Financial Narratives
summary: Financial narratives contain rich information about firms' performance and business conditions. Conventional text analysis often summarizes this information into numerical representations, which may not fully preserve the dynamic structure described in the narrative. In this study, we develop FinVision, a domain-specific multimodal generative model that translates financial narratives into visual representations of contemporaneous market dynamics. Using 87,940 paired observations of Management Discussion and Analysis (MD&A) disclosures and stock price charts, FinVision learns the average relationship between a firm's narrative account of a fiscal year and its stock-price dynamics over the same period. Given an MD&A alone, the trained model generates a text-implied stock chart, extending financial text analysis beyond numerical representations toward text-to-visual generation. We validate FinVision in two ways. First, held-out tests show that the model generates stock-chart representations that closely resemble observed charts and outperform direct LLM prompting, general-purpose text-to-image models, and the same architecture without financial-domain adaptation. Second, we examine the economic validity of the generated representations by comparing text-implied and observed stock charts. The resulting discrepancy is systematically associated with weaker investor responses around subsequent 10-K filings and with worse subsequent market and operating outcomes. Overall, our findings show how domain-adapted multimodal generative AI can create a new visual representation of financial text and provide an additional modality for studying business communication.

AI.tldr: 本文提出领域特定的多模态生成模型FinVision，将MD&A文本翻译为同期股价走势的可视化图表，实现从"文本→数值"到"文本→视觉"的金融文本分析范式扩展。
AI.motivation: 传统文本分析将财务叙述压缩为数值表征，可能丢失叙述中所描述的动态结构信息；因此需要一种能保留并呈现这种动态性的新表征形式。
AI.method: 构建FinVision多模态生成模型，使用87,940对MD&A披露与对应股价图表的配对观测进行金融领域适配训练，学习企业年度叙述与其同期股价动态之间的平均映射；仅输入MD&A即可生成"文本隐含股价图"。
AI.result: 留出测试中，生成的股价图表表征与真实图表高度相似，并优于直接LLM提示、通用文生图模型及未做金融领域适配的同架构模型；文本隐含图与真实图的差异与后续10-K披露窗口内投资者反应更弱、以及更差的市场与经营表现系统性相关。
AI.conclusion: 领域适配的多模态生成式AI可为财务文本创造新的视觉表征，为研究企业沟通提供额外模态。

title: Illusion of Explainability: A Sanity Check for Spectral Band Attribution in Satellite Time-Series Crop Classification
comment: Accepted at the 4th Computer Vision for Earth Observation (CV4EO) Workshop at WACV 2027
summary: Attribution methods are commonly validated through convergence across methods and consistency with domain knowledge, yet neither criterion establishes whether identified features are necessary for a task. This limitation is particularly relevant in multispectral remote sensing, where overlapping spectral information makes individual bands potentially substitutable. We investigate this gap in crop-type classification using GradientSHAP, Shapley sampling, and Occlusion on a U-TAE segmentation model trained on Sentinel-2 time series from the PASTIS benchmark. All three methods identify vegetation-sensitive spectral regions consistent with domain knowledge, while Shapley and Occlusion exhibit strong ordering sensitivity in deletion and insertion tests. However, these properties do not reliably predict retraining performance. Aggregate attribution consensus masks substantial per-class disagreement, with pairwise mean Spearman correlations ranging from 0.09 to 0.79. Models retrained from scratch using the five lowest-ranked bands perform comparably to or better than those using the five highest-ranked bands. Furthermore, attribution rankings from an independently trained model with identical configuration and seed identify a different top-five subset that yields better retraining performance. Analysis of all 252 five-band subsets reveals consistently low effective dimensionality (1.35 to 2.62), suggesting substantial spectral redundancy. These findings demonstrate that plausible and apparently faithful attribution rankings do not necessarily identify task-relevant bands for improved retrained performance, highlighting the limitations of band-level feature attribution in spectrally redundant input spaces.

AI.tldr: 该论文检验了在光谱冗余的多光谱遥感场景中，波段级归因方法所识别的"重要特征"是否真正对任务必要，发现归因排名与重训练性能无可靠关联。
AI.motivation: 归因方法通常仅通过方法间收敛性和与领域知识的一致性来验证，但这两条标准都无法确认所识别特征对任务是否必要。多光谱遥感中波段间信息高度重叠、单个波段可被替代，这一问题尤为突出，因此需要考察归因排名能否用于筛选真正有任务价值的波段。
AI.method: 在PASTIS基准的Sentinel-2时序数据上训练U-TAE分割模型进行作物类型分类；采用GradientSHAP、Shapley采样与Occlusion三种归因方法，结合删除/插入测试、类间Spearman相关分析、按归因排名取最高与最低五个波段进行从头重训练，并对全部252个五波段子集做有效维度分析。
AI.result: 三种方法均识别出与领域知识一致的植被敏感光谱区，Shapley与Occlusion在删除/插入测试中表现出强排序敏感性，但这些性质并不能可靠预测重训练性能。聚合归因掩盖了显著的类间分歧，成对平均Spearman相关仅0.09–0.79。用排名最低五个波段重训练的模型性能与用排名最高五个波段相当甚至更优；同配置同种子的独立模型给出不同的前五波段子集且重训练效果更好。全部252个子集的有效维度仅1.35–2.62，表明存在显著光谱冗余。
AI.conclusion: 看似合理且表观忠实的归因排名，并不必然识别出能提升重训练性能的任务相关波段，揭示了在光谱冗余输入空间中波段级特征归因的固有局限，提示不应将归因结果直接作为波段选择依据。

title: AGPF: Dynamic Source Selection for Feature Pyramid Fusion
summary:
Feature pyramids provide dense predictors with features at several spatial resolutions. However, it remains largely unexplored which pyramid levels each output location should aggregate information from. We investigate this question by allowing each output location to attend to features from every pyramid level and measuring how attention is distributed across scales. Surprisingly, locations on the finest output grid allocate approximately 75\% of their attention to features two levels coarser, rather than to the current or adjacent levels. Even on the same output grid, the balance shifts toward coarser features as object size increases.
  These observations motivate Asymmetric Global Pyramid Fusion (AGPF), a neck that preserves the original output grids while allowing each location to dynamically select its contextual sources across scales. Each location interacts with a multiscale memory whose features are aligned in image coordinates, enabling flexible cross-scale aggregation without altering prediction resolutions. Compared with FPN, AGPF improves all 19 object detection and all seven instance segmentation configurations evaluated on COCO. A single fusion block improves Cascade Mask R-CNN by 1.7 box AP and 2.3 mask AP, and the gains consistently transfer to semantic and panoptic segmentation.

AI.tldr: 论文通过让每个输出位置对全部金字塔层级做注意力并统计注意力分布，发现最细网格位置约75%注意力分配给比自身粗两级的特征，且物体越大越偏向粗特征；据此提出保留原始输出网格的不对称全局金字塔融合（AGPF），在COCO上全部19种检测与7种实例分割配置均有提升。
AI.motivation: 特征金字塔以多空间分辨率特征提供密集预测，但每个输出位置应从哪些金字塔层级聚合信息，此前基本未被系统研究。作者希望先量化这一跨尺度注意力分布规律，再据此设计更好的融合结构。
AI.method: 先做诊断实验：允许每个输出位置对每个金字塔层级特征做注意力，测量注意力在各尺度上的分布；基于观察提出AGPF——一种neck，保持原始输出网格不变，每个位置与图像坐标对齐的多尺度memory交互，从而在不改变预测分辨率的前提下动态选择跨尺度上下文来源。
AI.result: 最细输出网格上的位置将约75%注意力分配给比自身粗两级的特征，而非当前或相邻层级；同一输出网格上，随物体尺寸增大，平衡向粗特征偏移。相比FPN，AGPF在COCO的19种检测与7种实例分割配置上全部提升；单个融合块使Cascade Mask R-CNN提升1.7 box AP和2.3 mask AP，增益并可迁移至语义与全景分割。
AI.conclusion: 跨尺度聚合不应局限于相邻层级；让位置自适应地访问图像坐标对齐的多尺度memory、同时保留原输出网格，是一种通用且有效的金字塔融合范式。

title: The Flip Test: Video World Models Fail to Learn the World State
summary: Video world models promise to predict the future of a scene from its present. Do current models keep this promise? We probe this question counterfactually. When a small change to the present flips the future, such as a box resting a few millimeters before or past a table edge, a model that tracks the state of the world must flip its prediction too. We build FlipTest, a three-level hierarchy of increasingly strict tests over 1,680 initial frames from 10 simulated and 15 real-world tasks. At the base, visual minimal pairs, two nearly identical frames whose true futures differ, test whether predictions change across the boundary; matched controls go further and test whether they change only where the future does; and dense sweeps, the strictest level, locate exactly where they change. All 11 video world models we evaluate fall short. The best averages 18.3% pair accuracy over real and simulated scenes, below the 25% of random guessing. Models flip as often on steps that leave the future unchanged as on steps that change it, and their response stays flat across the sweeps. On the same frames, a vision-language model is selective and traces a near S-shaped curve near the boundary, and a coding agent that measures the image comes close to the true boundary. This implies that the deciding information is in the frame, and video models just miss it. We therefore urge the community to rethink world modeling as pure video prediction. Next-frame prediction must do more than draw plausible pixels; it must also identify the causal states that control future dynamics.

AI.tldr: 提出FlipTest三层反事实测试框架（视觉最小对、匹配对照、稠密扫描），在10个仿真与15个真实任务的1680帧上评估11个视频世界模型，全部失败：最佳模型配对准确率仅18.3%，低于随机猜测的25%，说明视频世界模型未能捕捉控制未来动态的因果状态。
AI.motivation: 视频世界模型的核心承诺是"由现在预测未来"。若当前帧发生微小改变而未来随之翻转（如盒子在桌沿前几毫米或越过边缘），真正跟踪世界状态的模型必须同步翻转预测。作者希望以反事实方式直接检验这一承诺是否成立，并揭示纯下一帧视频预测范式的根本局限。
AI.method: 构建FlipTest：基于10个仿真任务与15个真实任务共1680帧初始帧，设计由松到严的三级层级测试——(1) 视觉最小对：两张近乎相同但真实未来不同的帧，检验预测是否跨边界发生变化；(2) 匹配对照：进一步检验预测是否只在未来变化处变化；(3) 稠密扫描：最严格级别，精确定位预测发生翻转的确切位置。另在相同帧上对比视觉语言模型与测量图像的编码智能体的表现作为参照。
AI.result: 评估的11个视频世界模型全部不达标：最佳模型在真实与仿真场景上的配对准确率平均仅18.3%，低于随机猜测的25%。模型在"不改变未来"的扰动步与"改变未来"的扰动步上翻转频率相当，且响应在稠密扫描中保持平坦，缺乏选择性。相比之下，视觉语言模型表现出选择性并在边界附近呈现近S形曲线，测量图像的编码智能体则接近真实边界。
AI.conclusion: 判别性信息已存在于帧中，视频世界模型只是未能利用。作者据此呼吁社区重新审视"世界建模即纯视频预测"的范式：下一帧预测不应只生成看似合理的像素，还必须识别控制未来动态的因果状态。

title: SemLite-GS: Semantic-Selective Parallel Gaussian Splatting for Lightweight Building Reconstruction from UAV Oblique Imagery
summary: Lightweight 3D building models support urban spatial analysis, but their production often requires dense scene reconstruction, building extraction, and mesh simplification. Although 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) is more efficient than conventional multi-view stereo, existing large-scale methods lack semantic selection and parallel instance-level training. We present SemLite-GS, a building-centric framework that reconstructs lightweight building meshes from large-scale UAV oblique imagery. First, an orthographic reference map establishes globally consistent building identities, which are propagated to oblique views to form camera-instance pairs and regions of interest. Second, semantic-selective parallel PGSR training jointly processes multiple pairs within relevant image regions while updating only target Gaussians; contextual Gaussians remain fixed to preserve visibility. Third, architectural planes extracted from rendered depth, opacity, and normal maps guide signed distance field optimization, producing meshes with adaptive polygon allocation and well-defined structural boundaries. Experiments on multiple large-scale UAV datasets demonstrate that our SemLite-GS substantially reduces building reconstruction time compared with representative full-scene 3DGS methods. With comparable polygon budgets, SemLite-GS achieves superior preservation of dominant planar structures and sharp architectural transitions compared with conventional dense reconstruction followed by mesh decimation. The source code is available at https://github.com/IRIS-LAB-whu/SemLite-GS.

AI.tldr: SemLite-GS 是一个面向建筑的单体化框架，可从大规模无人机倾斜影像重建轻量建筑网格，通过语义选择性并行 PGSR 训练与建筑平面引导的 SDF 优化，显著缩短重建时间并在相同面片预算下更好保留主导平面结构与建筑棱线。
AI.motivation: 轻量 3D 建筑模型对城市空间分析很重要，但传统流程依赖稠密场景重建、建筑提取与网格简化。3DGS 虽比多视图立体更高效，但现有大规模方法缺乏语义选择能力，也无法进行实例级并行训练。
AI.method: 1) 用正射参考图建立全局一致的建筑身份，并传播到倾斜视图，形成相机-实例对与感兴趣区域；2) 语义选择性并行 PGSR 训练，在相关图像区域内同时处理多对，仅更新目标高斯，上下文高斯保持固定以维持可见性；3) 从渲染的深度、不透明度与法向图提取建筑平面，引导符号距离场优化，实现自适应多边形分配与清晰结构边界。
AI.result: 在多个大规模无人机数据集上，相比代表性全场景 3DGS 方法大幅降低建筑重建时间；在相当面片预算下，相比"稠密重建+网格简化"流程，对主导平面结构的保持与锐利建筑过渡的表现更优。
AI.conclusion: 语义选择+实例级并行训练+平面引导 SDF 优化的组合，能够高效产出轻量、结构规整的建筑网格，适用于大规模城市级建筑重建。

title: Drift-Conditioned Structural Replay for Continual Cardiac Ultrasound Segmentation
summary: Conventional experience replay typically applies fixed preservation constraints to historical exemplars, overlooking variations in how learned representations, predictions, and anatomical structures change during sequential training. To address this limitation, we propose Drift-Conditioned Structural Replay Loss (DCSRL), an exemplar-adaptive supervision mechanism that regulates anatomical preservation according to source-referenced knowledge drift. DCSRL operates within a reliability-guided replay framework that selects informative historical exemplars using anatomical content and boundary characteristics while adaptively regulating replay during training. For each retained exemplar, DCSRL constructs a frozen source-task reference signature and subsequently measures changes in feature representations, class probabilities, boundary responses, and predicted anatomical structures. These complementary drift measurements are aggregated and normalized to generate bounded, exemplar-specific coefficients that dynamically adjust boundary and structural replay losses without modifying the underlying memory-selection policy. We evaluate DCSRL under sequential learning across CAMUS, CardiacNet, and EchoNet-Dynamic, comparing its performance with regularization-, distillation-, and replay-based continual-learning approaches. Experimental findings indicate that DCSRL improves overall final segmentation performance and anatomical boundary preservation, particularly under heterogeneous imaging conditions, although trade-offs remain in knowledge transfer across tasks. These findings suggest that source-referenced multidimensional drift conditioning offers a promising direction for adaptive anatomical knowledge preservation in continual cardiac ultrasound segmentation.

AI.tldr: 提出漂移条件结构回放损失（DCSRL），依据源任务参考下的多维知识漂移自适应调节解剖结构回放监督强度，用于连续心脏超声分割。
AI.motivation: 传统经验回放对历史样本采用固定保留约束，忽略了顺序训练中表征、预测与解剖结构变化程度的差异，导致回放监督强度与实际遗忘/漂移程度不匹配。
AI.method: 在可靠性引导的回放框架中，基于解剖内容与边界特征筛选信息量高的历史样本；对每个保留样本构建冻结的源任务参考签名，度量特征表征、类别概率、边界响应与预测解剖结构的变化，聚合并归一化为有界的样本级系数，动态调节边界与结构回放损失，且不改变记忆选择策略。
AI.result: 在CAMUS、CardiacNet、EchoNet-Dynamic上进行顺序学习评估，与正则化、蒸馏与回放类持续学习方法对比；最终分割性能与解剖边界保持整体提升，在异构成像条件下尤为明显，但任务间知识迁移仍存在权衡。
AI.conclusion: 源参考的多维漂移条件化为连续心脏超声分割中的自适应解剖知识保持提供了有前景的方向。

title: SEAT: Sign-Type Evidence-Audited Transport for Multi-Label Tongue Diagnosis
summary: Automated tongue-sign recognition can improve the consistency of non-invasive examinations that otherwise rely on subjective visual judgment. A single tongue image often exhibits multiple coexisting signs characterized by heterogeneous evidence, including localized morphology, global chromaticity, and inter-label dependence. However, existing methods typically rely on shared representations and uniform multi-label heads, making it difficult to verify whether predictions stem from clinically relevant evidence rather than spurious visual correlations. We propose SEAT, an evidence-audited framework that matches distinct evidence types with dedicated prediction and evaluation mechanisms. Built on frozen DINOv2 patch features, SEAT couples mask-guided sign-specific attention for localized morphology, a semi-relaxed optimal transport pathway over LAB/HSV color prototypes to enhance pale-tongue recognition, and a co-occurrence-aware transport regularizer to shape the batch-level predicted label marginal. These components are evaluated through audits matched to their evidence types. On the TongueDx benchmark, SEAT achieves a mean macro-F1 of 72.59 with a standard deviation of 1.04 across six random seeds, with a six-model ensemble reaching 74.15. The ensemble outperforms a backbone-matched baseline and a larger, domain-specialized vision-language model by 8.06 and 2.99 percentage points, respectively. Our results demonstrate that aligning dedicated prediction pathways and audits with sign-specific characteristics improves multi-label accuracy while offering more targeted evidential grounding than uniform post-hoc spatial explanations. Code is available at https://github.com/NEU-TCM-Lab/Sign-type-Evidence-Audited-Transport.

AI.tldr: 提出SEAT框架，将舌象多标签识别中异质证据（局部形态、全局色度、标签共现）与专用预测及审计机制对齐，在TongueDx上取得72.59（±1.04）宏F1，集成达74.15。
AI.motivation: 自动舌象识别可提升无创检查一致性。单张舌图常并存多种征象，证据异质（局部形态、全局色度、标签依赖），而现有方法依赖共享表征与统一多标签头，难以验证预测是否源于临床相关证据而非虚假视觉相关。
AI.method: 基于冻结DINOv2 patch特征，SEAT包含三部分：掩码引导的征象特异性注意力（针对局部形态）；在LAB/HSV颜色原型上的半松弛最优传输通路（增强淡白舌识别）；共现感知的传输正则化项（约束批次级预测标签边际）。各组件配置与其证据类型匹配的审计评估。
AI.result: TongueDx基准上，6个随机种子平均宏F1为72.59，标准差1.04；六模型集成达74.15，分别超过骨干匹配基线与更大的领域专用视觉语言模型8.06和2.99个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 将专用预测通路与审计机制对齐征象特异性特征，可在提升多标签准确率的同时提供比统一事后空间解释更具针对性的证据支撑。

title: Event-based object detection under adverse lighting and motion: lessons for construction sites
summary: Vision-based monitoring on construction sites fails at night, at dawn and dusk, in tunnels and under floodlights, when conventional RGB cameras under- or over-expose. Event cameras record per-pixel brightness changes with microsecond latency and over 120 dB of dynamic range, but their benefit for site-relevant object detection has not been quantified on real data. We compare three recent event-based detectors (SMamba, SATE and EvRT-DETR) with an RGB detector trained on the same data, using the pixel-aligned PEOD dataset. On low-light frames (70% of the test set) the best event detector reaches 27.2 AP against 21.3 AP for RGB, and a training-free late fusion of both sensors is the best option in every lighting condition (33.3 AP). An object-level analysis of 53,091 objects shows that brightness has little effect on event detectors, whereas fast motion matters: above 20 pixels per frame RGB finds 11-19% of medium-size objects and EvRT-DETR 39-60%. Activation patching locates the damage caused by losing events at the 1/16-resolution features, with small objects depending on the finest scale, and shows that event detectors fail when few signal events meet added noise. A model-agnostic pruning study keeps about 95% of accuracy with 60% of the input but halves small-object recall. On rendered construction sites, used zero-shot, dimming the floodlights drops RGB to near zero while the event detector keeps most of its AP50. We close with camera-placement guidance for construction sites.

AI.tldr: 在像素对齐的PEOD数据集上，事件相机检测器（SMamba、SATE、EvRT-DETR）在弱光下显著优于RGB（27.2 AP vs 21.3 AP），无需训练的后期融合在各光照条件下均为最优（33.3 AP）；事件检测器对亮度不敏感但受快速运动与事件稀疏/噪声影响，并给出工地相机布设建议。
AI.motivation: 工地视觉监控在夜间、晨昏、隧道与泛光灯下因RGB相机过曝/欠曝而失效。事件相机具有微秒级延迟与超过120 dB动态范围，但其对工地相关目标检测的实际收益尚未在真实数据上量化。
AI.method: 在像素对齐的PEOD数据集上，将三种近期事件检测器（SMamba、SATE、EvRT-DETR）与同数据训练的RGB检测器对比；采用免训练后期融合；对53,091个目标做对象级分析（亮度、每帧20像素以上快速运动）；用activation patching定位丢失事件造成的损伤（1/16分辨率特征、小目标依赖最细尺度）；做模型无关的剪枝研究；并在渲染工地上零样本测试泛光灯调暗场景。
AI.result: 弱光帧（占测试集70%）上最佳事件检测器27.2 AP，RGB为21.3 AP；后期融合在每种光照下最优（33.3 AP）。亮度对事件检测器影响很小；快速运动下RGB对中等目标召回11–19%，EvRT-DETR为39–60%。剪枝保留60%输入可维持约95%精度但小目标召回减半。渲染工地上调暗泛光灯使RGB降至近零，事件检测器保持大部分AP50。
AI.conclusion: 事件相机在极端光照与快速运动场景下对工地目标检测具实质优势，RGB与事件的免训练融合为稳健首选；事件检测器失效源于1/16尺度特征与信号事件稀疏、噪声干扰，小目标尤依赖最细尺度，论文据此给出工地相机布设指导。

title: TIVS: Mapping the Sensitivity Landscape of Visual Token Transformations in MLLMs
summary: Recent efforts to improve the efficiency of multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have explored visual token pruning, quantization, and feature compression. However, the properties that determine whether transformed visual tokens remain usable by a frozen decoder are not well characterized. We introduce \textbf{TIVS (Token Identity Versus Statistics)}, a training-free intervention framework that separately studies sequence permutation, token retention, numerical precision, and statistical replacement under controlled conditions. On 192 POPE questions, three token permutations change TinyLLaVA accuracy by only $-0.17$ percentage points on average, while changing 4.69\% of individual predictions. Diagonal and rank-64 Gaussian replacements decrease accuracy by 25.0 and 28.1 points on the same subset. Further experiments with exact moment constraints, quantization error, token retention, and additional visual tasks reveal how strongly the effects depend on the original feature values and the evaluation setting. These findings provide an empirical basis for assessing visual token transformations in frozen MLLMs and designing more reliable multimodal interfaces.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练干预框架TIVS，在受控条件下分别考察视觉token的序列置换、保留、数值精度与统计替换对冻结解码器的影响，发现序列顺序影响极小、而特征值统计结构至关重要。
AI.motivation: 现有MLLM效率研究（视觉token剪枝、量化、特征压缩）缺乏对"变换后的视觉token是否仍可被冻结解码器使用"这一性质的系统刻画，作者希望分离并量化不同变换维度的独立作用。
AI.method: TIVS为非训练干预框架，在TinyLLaVA等冻结MLLM上分别操纵：token序列置换、token保留率、数值精度（量化误差）、统计替换（对角替换、秩64高斯替换、精确矩约束替换），在192道POPE问题上评测精度与逐样本预测变化。
AI.result: 三种token置换使TinyLLaVA平均精度仅变化-0.17个百分点，但改变了4.69%的个体预测；对角替换与秩64高斯替换在同一子集上分别使精度下降25.0与28.1个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 变换效果强烈依赖原始特征值与评测设置，为冻结MLLM中视觉token变换的评估及更可靠多模态接口设计提供实证依据。

title: Example-Based Spatial Guidance for Training-Free Concept Erasure in Diffusion Models
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026 (poster). 51 pages, including references, checklist, and appendix
summary: Text-to-image (T2I) diffusion models often synthesize policy-violating content, necessitating robust safeguards and rigorous evaluation frameworks. However, current approaches remain largely monolithic in both execution and evaluation, limited to coarse-grained categorization within broad unsafe concepts. Such approaches fail to account for the specific constituent factors of a violation, resulting in weak learning signals and allowing model collapse to bypass safety checks. To overcome these limitations, we propose Example-Based Spatial Guidance (EBSG), a training-free method that utilizes user-editable exemplar packs to provide granular spatial guidance for precise concept steering. Unlike existing methods that coarsely steer the entire image away from a broad concept, EBSG decomposes these categories into specific sub-concepts via exemplar text-image pairs, providing explicit, localized steering signals for more robust safety control. Furthermore, we introduce a vision language model (VLM)-based evaluation protocol that provides a fine-grained assessment, avoiding the pitfall of conventional binary evaluators that permit model collapse to bypass safety checks. Empirically, EBSG achieves state-of-the-art erasure performance across diverse safety datasets and concept categories, spanning four nudity benchmarks, seven I2P harmful-concept slices, and four MJA metaphor categories, while supporting multi-concept removal and transferring to a modern backbone, SD3.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练的Example-Based Spatial Guidance (EBSG)，借可编辑示例包对概念做细粒度空间引导以擦除违规内容，并配套VLM细粒度评估协议，在多个安全数据集上取得SOTA擦除效果。
AI.motivation: 现有T2I扩散模型的防护与评估过于"单体化"：执行与评估都停留在宽泛不安全概念的粗粒度分类上，未刻画违规内容的构成因素，导致学习信号弱、易被模型坍缩绕过安全检查。
AI.method: EBSG为免训练方法，将宽泛类别通过示例图文对分解为具体子概念，用用户可编辑的示例包提供显式、局部的空间引导信号实现精确概念操控；同时提出基于VLM的评估协议，给出细粒度评判而非二元判定。
AI.result: 在四个nudity基准、七个I2P有害概念切片、四个MJA隐喻类别上达到SOTA擦除性能，并支持多概念同时移除及迁移至SD3骨干。
AI.conclusion: 细粒度的空间级概念分解与评估能显著提升T2I安全控制的鲁棒性，且免训练、可扩展、可迁移。

title: PerturbJEPA: Joint-Embedding Predictive Learning of Cellular Perturbation Responses
summary: Identifying the drug and dose that produced a cellular response requires preserving treatment effects within each cellular background. A joint-embedding predictor can match its targets while ignoring the intervention if its encoder preserves differences across backgrounds but erases differences between treated and control populations within each one. We call this failure interventional contrast collapse. PerturbJEPA encodes the difference in mean gene expression between treated and control populations as an effect vector. It aligns the displacement between their latent centroids with this vector and regularizes the vectors to preserve variation across population pairs. We show that the measured displacements cannot all coincide within a batch when effect-vector variation exceeds the root-mean-square alignment error. Trained with separate drug and dose ranking objectives, the model predicts candidate responses from a common control population and matches them to the observed response without cell pairing or expression reconstruction. We evaluate 3,592 Tahoe-100M queries on held-out combinations of known interventions and cellular backgrounds, each with over 700 drug-dose candidates in a fixed, background-specific catalog. PerturbJEPA achieves 91.46% macro joint drug-dose Recall@1, exceeding STATE by 3.40 percentage points (95% drug-cluster bootstrap interval of 1.72 to 5.07 points). Controlled diagnostics show that treatment-control differences can shrink even when representations remain globally dispersed. With the drug ranking objective fixed, adding effect-vector regularization to alignment raises joint Recall@1 from 18.57% to 87.47%.

AI.tldr: PerturbJEPA通过将扰动效应编码为均值差异向量并做对齐与正则化，避免"干预对比坍缩"，在Tahoe-100M上实现91.46%的联合药-剂量Recall@1。
AI.motivation: 识别产生细胞响应的药物与剂量需在每个细胞背景内保留处理效应；但联合嵌入预测器可能仅匹配目标而"擦除"背景内处理组与对照组的差异，作者称之为干预对比坍缩（interventional contrast collapse），需专门机制防止该失效。
AI.method: PerturbJEPA将处理组与对照组平均基因表达之差编码为效应向量，对齐两组潜在质心的位移与该向量，并对向量施加正则以保留群体对之间的变异；理论上证明当效应向量变异超过RMS对齐误差时，批内位移不可能全部重合；训练使用独立的药物与剂量排序目标，从共同对照群体预测候选响应并与观测响应匹配，无需细胞配对或表达重建。
AI.result: 在3,592个Tahoe-100M查询（未见过的干预-背景组合，每例700+药物-剂量候选）上，取得91.46%宏平均联合药-剂量Recall@1，较STATE提升3.40个百分点（95% bootstrap区间1.72–5.07）；诊断显示表示全局分散时处理-对照差异仍可能收缩。
AI.conclusion:
固定药物排序目标下，在仅对齐基础上加入效应向量正则可将联合Recall@1从18.57%提升至87.47%，表明效应向量对齐+正则化是防止干预对比坍缩、实现可靠药-剂量识别
的关键。

title: AFRNet: Adaptive Frequency Redistribution Network for Image Deraining
summary: Image deraining aims to recover rain-free images from rain-degraded observations. Recent frequency-aware deraining methods have demonstrated promising performance by removing rain artifacts in the spectral domain. However, since rain artifacts and background textures often appear in several correlated subbands, prior frequency-domain deraining models still enhance frequency subbands separately. Such band-wise processing limits information exchange across subbands. Without context from other subbands, rain and clean content that appear together in one subband cannot be separated. This leads to either residual rain streaks or over-smoothing of fine details. To address this limitation, we propose AFRNet, an Adaptive Frequency Redistribution Network for image deraining. First, we introduce an Adaptive Frequency Recombination Module (AFRM) that performs cross-band modulation among wavelet subbands, enabling information interaction and adaptive recombination of degraded frequency components. We then develop a Subband Compensation Block (SCB) that compensates for decoder subband degradation by leveraging encoder subband features through inter-subband attention in the wavelet domain, alleviating detail loss during reconstruction. Extensive experiments demonstrate that AFRNet achieves competitive performance and consistent results across diverse deraining benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 提出自适应频率重分配网络AFRNet，通过跨子带调制与子带补偿解决频域去雨中子带独立处理导致的信息隔离问题。
AI.motivation: 现有频率感知去雨方法在频谱域去除雨痕，但雨痕与背景纹理常共存于多个相关子带，而既有模型对子带独立增强，限制跨子带信息交互；缺乏其他子带上下文时，同一子带内共存的雨与干净内容无法分离，导致残留雨痕或细节过度平滑。
AI.method: 1) 自适应频率重组模块（AFRM）：在小波子带间进行跨带调制，实现信息交互与退化频率分量的自适应重组；2) 子带补偿块（SCB）：在小波域通过子带间注意力，利用编码器子带特征补偿解码器子带退化，缓解重建中的细节丢失。
AI.result: 大量实验表明AFRNet在多个去雨基准上取得有竞争力的性能，且结果一致稳定。
AI.conclusion: 跨子带信息交互是提升频域去雨性能的关键，AFRNet通过频率重组与编码器—解码器子带补偿有效兼顾雨痕去除与细节保真。

title: What the Averages Hide: Monocular Metric Depth Models Still Fail in Everyday Scenes, Mostly on Scale
summary: Zero-shot monocular metric depth models are evaluated by averaging metric and scale-aligned scores across datasets. Averages cannot show how many images still have severely wrong metric depth, whether depth is under- or overestimated, or whether different models fail on the same images. We propose an evaluation built on per-image results: the failure rate (metric $δ_1$ < 0.5); scale-aligned metrics for structure, and the bias, dispersion and absolute error of the alignment scale for scale; and a cross-model comparison that separates shared from model-specific failures. We apply it to 11 recent architectures with and without ground-truth intrinsics (18 model evaluations) on the 7 everyday-scene benchmarks (4,406 images) used by MoGe-2. Metric depth estimation is not solved in everyday scenes, and the remaining difficulty is mainly scale: the best of the 18 evaluations still has a failure rate of 7.7% (datasets weighted equally); pooled over all failures, 78.8% have intact structure, and after scale correction 98.3% no longer fail. Images failed by at least 6 architectures make up 7.3% of the data, concentrated on HAMMER and DIODE; even when selected only by architectures of other families, they hold 34% to 40% of the error of the top 6 models, against 14% to 18% for as many random images from the same datasets. Adding objects reduces the scale error of most models; ground-truth intrinsics and, in most families, larger models reduce the failures but do not remove them. We recommend reporting failure rates, structure and scale separately, and results stratified by how many models fail. We will release the code, the per-image results with shared-failure labels, and two diagnostic sets built from TUM RGB-D.

AI.tldr: 该文提出基于逐图结果的零样本单目度量深度评测框架，将失败率、结构与尺度分开报告，并区分跨模型的共享失败与模型特有失败，揭示日常场景中度量深度的主要困难在尺度而非结构。
AI.motivation: 现有评测仅对度量和尺度对齐后的分数跨数据集取平均，掩盖了三类关键信息：仍存在严重度量错误（度量化δ1<0.5）的图像比例、误差是低估还是高估、以及不同模型是否在同一批图像上失败。平均值无法支撑细致的失效诊断。
AI.method: 构建逐图指标体系：(1) 失败率（度量δ1<0.5）；(2) 尺度对齐下的结构指标；(3) 尺度维度上的偏置、离散度与对齐尺度的绝对误差；(4) 跨模型对比，将失败划分为共享失败与模型特有失败。实验覆盖11种近期架构、有无真值内参两种设定（共18个模型评测），在MoGe-2所用的7个日常场景基准（4,406张图像）上评测；并补充目标存在与否、内参、模型规模等消融，以及基于TUM RGB-D的两个诊断集。
AI.result: 日常场景的度量深度仍未解决，残余困难主要来自尺度：18个评测中最优者失败率仍为7.7%（数据集等权）；全部失败样本中78.8%结构完好，经尺度校正后98.3%不再失败。至少被6个架构共同失败的图像占7.3%，集中于HAMMER与DIODE；仅用其他家族架构筛选出的这些图像，仍占前6名模型34%–40%的误差，而同等数量随机图像的对应比例为14%–18%。加入目标可降低多数模型的尺度误差；真值内参与多数家族中更大的模型能降低但不能消除失败。
AI.conclusion: 建议评测分别报告失败率、结构与尺度三项指标，并按"被多少模型失败"进行分层统计。将发布代码、带共享失败标签的逐图结果，以及基于TUM RGB-D构建的两个诊断集。

title: What Matters for Cross-Modal Alignment
summary: The Platonic Representation Hypothesis posits that models trained on different modalities converge toward a shared representation. Related work aligns frozen image and text encoders on natural images without paired data. We test zero-pair alignment on five datasets across four modalities: natural images, environmental audio, chest radiographs, and 3D computed tomography (CT). It succeeds only on COCO and fails on the other four. We analyze the failures and find that alignment must first locate the subspace where the modalities co-vary and then orient the mapping within it. Consistent with previous studies, medical imaging is the hardest case: its shared subspace carries the smallest fraction of the variance. When this fraction is small, alignment needs image-text pairs, and random-matrix theory predicts how many pairs are needed. These findings motivate LightAlign: a few pairs let a ridge regression between two frozen encoders locate and orient the mapping simultaneously, and a classifier fitted only on report text then predicts findings from the mapped images.
