On 3D CT, LightAlign surpasses models trained end to end on image-report pairs without finding-level labels: with only 200 pairs, LightAlign outperforms CT-CLIP on CT-RATE (0.754 vs. 0.733 AUROC), and with only 100 CT-RATE pairs, it does so on RAD-ChestCT, an out-of-distribution dataset from a different hospital. On CheXpert, it reaches 0.862 mean AUROC with only about 5% as many pairs as models trained on MIMIC-CXR.

AI.tldr: 该文检验"零配对对齐"的适用边界，发现仅在COCO成功，并在医学影像上失败；据此提出LightAlign，用少量图像-报告配对做岭回归完成子空间定位与定向，在3D CT上以极少配对超越端到端模型。
AI.motivation: Platonic Representation Hypothesis认为不同模态模型会收敛到共享表征，已有工作可在无配对数据下对齐冻结的图像与文本编码器。但这一零配对对齐是否普遍成立、在何种模态上失效、失效原因何在，尚不清楚。
AI.method: 在自然图像、环境音频、胸片、3D CT四模态五个数据集上测试零配对对齐；分析失败原因，指出对齐需先定位模态共同变化的子空间、再在该子空间内定向映射，并用随机矩阵理论预测所需配对数量。据此提出LightAlign：以少量配对在冻结编码器间做岭回归，同时完成定位与定向，再用仅基于报告文本训练的判别器从映射后的图像预测所见。
AI.result: 零配对对齐仅在COCO成功，其余四个数据集均失败；医学影像最难，其共享子空间方差占比最小。LightAlign在3D CT上：仅200对时CT-RATE AUROC 0.754 vs. CT-CLIP 0.733；仅用100对CT-RATE数据即在异院分布外数据RAD-ChestCT上超越CT-CLIP；CheXpert上以约为MIMIC-CXR训练模型5%的配对量达到0.862平均AUROC，且无需finding级标签。
AI.conclusion: 零配对跨模态对齐并非普适，其可行性取决于共享子空间方差占比；占比低时须借助少量配对。LightAlign以极低配对成本在医学多模态任务上取得优于端到端训练的效果，为数据稀缺场景提供高效对齐范式。

title: Room for Supervision: Training-Free Dataset Distillation for Object Detection
summary: Dataset distillation (DD) reduces storage and training costs by compressing large datasets into small collections. Most existing methods focus on image classification, where each image typically has a single category label. In contrast, object detection requires accurate category and bounding box annotations for multiple objects, together with visual content consistent with those annotations. Existing detection distillation pipelines rely on learned models and can alter the spatial relationships between objects and their backgrounds. We introduce GRASP, which packs dense native supervision into limited pixels without network training or inference. GRASP jointly searches over image selections and spatial layouts using convex allocation subproblems that penalize insufficient object resolution, excessive image compression, and padding that source context cannot fill. During composition, each selected image is cropped around all annotated objects and expanded into surrounding context without reducing object scale. The resized regions are then combined into distilled images, preserving the spatial layout within each region and retaining all original class labels and bounding box annotations. We evaluate GRASP on MS COCO and PASCAL VOC with compression ratios ranging from 0.25\% to 2\%. GRASP constructs the 1\% MS COCO dataset in under two minutes. Under a common training protocol using hard labels, GRASP achieves the state of the art with both CNN and ViT backbones. Code is available at https://github.com/tade1s/GRASP

AI.tldr: GRASP：一种无需模型训练的检测数据集蒸馏方法，通过联合搜索图像选择与空间布局，将密集原生监督打包进有限像素，在MS COCO与VOC上以0.25%–2%压缩率取得SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有数据集蒸馏多面向图像分类（单标签），而目标检测需同时保留多目标的类别与边界框标注及与之一致的视觉内容。已有检测蒸馏流程依赖已训练模型进行合成，且可能改变目标与背景间的空间关系。
AI.method: GRASP不做网络训练或推理。它将图像选择与空间布局联合建模，用凸分配子问题求解，惩罚目标分辨率不足、过度压缩以及源上下文无法填充的留白。合成时对每张选中图像围绕全部标注目标裁剪并向外扩展上下文而不缩小目标尺度，再将缩放后的区域拼合为蒸馏图像，保持区域内部空间布局并完整保留原始类别与边界框标注。
AI.result: 在MS COCO与PASCAL VOC、0.25%–2%压缩率下评估；构建1% MS COCO数据集耗时不到两分钟；在硬标签通用训练协议下，CNN与ViT骨干均达到SOTA。
AI.conclusion: 无需模型参与的原生监督打包式检测数据集蒸馏可高效生成高质量蒸馏集，兼顾标注完整性与空间布局，并在多骨干上优于现有方法。

title: Counterfactual Feature Steering for Adjacency-Preserving Identity Unlearning
summary: Identity unlearning in text-to-image diffusion models is increasingly important for privacy, safety, and ethical deployment, as it aims to remove the model's ability to generate specific individuals. In this work, we study identity unlearning with \emph{adjacency preservation}, where the goal is to remove a target individual's identity while preserving related non-target identities. We propose Counterfactual Feature Steering (CFS), a method requiring one-time SAE training that performs bounded inference-time concept editing in the latent space of a sparse autoencoder attached to the text encoder. CFS derives a target direction by contrasting forget and retain distributions, then applies a per-token projection proportional to each token's current alignment with this direction, yielding counterfactual representations that suppress the target while limiting collateral damage. To evaluate adjacency preservation, we introduce the Adjacency-Weighted Unlearning Score (AWUS), which measures the tradeoff between target erasure and collateral damage, and extend it to face-specific identity similarity using ArcFace. Across 4,000 prompts derived from Celeb-100, spanning 100 celebrity identities, CFS achieves the strongest evaluated tradeoff between identity erasure of target identities and preservation of adjacent and generic concepts, while remaining stable across intervention strengths where other steering-based methods degrade. Independent ArcFace evaluation and a 10,000-caption COCO study further examine identity and general preservation. Quantitative nudity-suppression benchmarks and qualitative artistic-style examples provide evidence of transfer beyond identities on SD~1.4.

AI.tldr: 本文提出反事实特征引导（CFS），在文本编码器所附稀疏自编码器的潜空间中做有界推理期概念编辑，实现带邻接保持的身份遗忘，并用邻接加权遗忘分数（AWUS）衡量擦除目标与附带损伤的权衡。
AI.motivation: 文本到图像扩散模型中的身份遗忘对隐私、安全与伦理部署日益重要，但现有方法在移除目标个体身份时往往损害相邻的非目标身份（附带损伤），缺乏对"邻接保持"的显式建模与评估。
AI.method: CFS 仅需一次性训练 SAE，推理时在文本编码器所附稀疏自编码器的潜空间中做有界的概念编辑：通过对比遗忘分布与保留分布导出目标方向，再按每个 token 当前与该方向的对齐程度施加逐 token 投影，得到反事实表示，从而抑制目标并限制附带损伤。评估上提出 AWUS 指标（目标擦除与附带损伤的权衡），并用 ArcFace 扩展至人脸身份相似度。
AI.result: 在 Celeb-100 派生的 4,000 条提示（100 位名人身份）上，CFS 在目标身份擦除与相邻/通用概念保持之间取得最优被测权衡，且在不同干预强度下保持稳定，而其他引导类方法会退化；独立的 ArcFace 评估与 10,000 条 COCO 标题研究进一步检验身份与通用保持；定量裸露抑制基准与定性艺术风格示例显示其在 SD 1.4 上可迁移至身份之外。
AI.conclusion: CFS 通过推理期有界潜空间编辑实现了兼顾邻接保持的身份遗忘，AWUS 提供了可量化的权衡评估，并在身份擦除、通用能力保持及跨概念迁移上均表现良好。

title: From Joint Risk to Decision Invariance: Decision-Preserving Regularization for Exemplar-Free Class-Incremental Learning
summary: Exemplar-free continual learning seeks to minimize joint risk over all seen tasks, yet historical data are unavailable for direct optimization. We observe that, for classification, preserving the model's decisions on previously learned classes helps retain old knowledge. This motivates Decision-Preserving Regularization (DPR). Penalizing changes in all pairwise old-class logit margins reduces algebraically to a centered relative-logit penalty. We further apply spectral whitening to remove the classifier's spectral scale bias. Because the global classifier supplies the decision constraints for the next stage, it must remain calibrated across all seen classes despite the drift of stored old-class statistics during representation updates. We therefore fit a closed-form affine map from paired current-task features to transport old-class Gaussian means and covariances into the updated feature space, then calibrate the global classifier using these distributions and current-task features. Across CIFAR-100, Tiny-ImageNet, ImageNet-Subset, and ImageNet-1K under cold-start protocols, comparisons with state-of-the-art methods show that DPR achieves higher accuracy in most settings while remaining highly efficient. Code is available at https://github.com/bnufw/dpr.

AI.tldr: 提出决策保持正则化（DPR）：通过惩罚旧类成对logit margin变化（等价于中心化相对logit惩罚）并结合谱白化，配合闭式仿射映射迁移旧类高斯统计以校准全局分类器，实现高效无样本持续学习。
AI.motivation: 无样本持续学习无法直接访问历史数据来优化全局联合风险；观察到对分类而言，保持模型对已学类的决策不变有助于保留旧知识，且分类器需在表示漂移下仍对全部已见类保持校准。
AI.method: 1) 决策保持正则化：惩罚所有旧类成对logit margin的变化，代数上化简为中心化相对logit惩罚；2) 谱白化消除分类器的谱尺度偏差；3) 用当前任务配对特征拟合闭式仿射映射，将旧类高斯均值与协方差迁移到更新后的特征空间；4) 基于这些分布与当前任务特征校准全局分类器。
AI.result: 在CIFAR-100、Tiny-ImageNet、ImageNet-Subset与ImageNet-1K的冷启动协议下，与SOTA方法相比，DPR在多数设置取得更高准确率且保持高效。
AI.conclusion: 决策保持是保留旧知识的有效途径，DPR以低开销实现较强性能；代码见 https://github.com/bnufw/dpr。

title: PanDWM: Panoramic 4D Driving World Models
summary: Driving world models usually generate videos from six pinhole cameras with separate optical centres and small overlaps, and must learn to keep these views consistent. We present PanDWM, which stitches them into one $360^\circ$ panoramic band. Camera boundaries then fall inside one image, so keeping the views consistent means keeping the image continuous, and each pixel still records its camera ray. Conditioned on layouts, a causal student generates the band window by window in four steps; it is distilled from a causal teacher and trained on its own rollouts. A feed-forward decoder lifts each frame along these rays into 3D Gaussians, and static Gaussians from neighbouring frames complete them into 4D scenes. On nuScenes, scored in one stitched $360^\circ$ view, PanDWM has lower FID and FVD than the multi-camera baselines at $8$-$46\times$ their speed, and keeps its 50-step teacher's FID while lowering FVD by 22-25%.

AI.tldr: PanDWM将六路相机视图拼接为单张360°全景带，使跨视图一致性转化为图像连续性问题，并以四步因果蒸馏学生模型、沿相机射线的高斯解码与4D场景补全实现高效驾驶世界模型。
AI.motivation: 现有驾驶世界模型需从六个独立光心、重叠很小的针孔相机生成视频，并额外学习维持视图间一致性；相机边界导致一致性约束困难。
AI.method: 将六视图拼接为一条360°全景带，相机边界落入同一图像内部；在布局条件下，由因果教师蒸馏得到因果学生，按窗口分四步生成整条带，并在自身rollout上训练；前馈解码器沿每像素相机射线将每帧提升为3D高斯，并用相邻帧的静态高斯补全为4D场景。
AI.result: 在nuScenes上以单一拼接360°视图评测，PanDWM的FID与FVD低于多相机基线，速度快8–46倍；保持50步教师的FID并将FVD降低22–25%。
AI.conclusion: 全景带表述把多视图一致性简化为图像连续性，配合四步因果蒸馏与射线高斯重建，可在显著提速的同时提升生成质量，为高效一致的驾驶世界模型提供可行范式。

title: Passable for Whom? Few-Shot Personal Calibration of Sidewalk Accessibility Perception
summary: Whether a sidewalk is passable depends on who is trying to pass: people who use the same mobility aid disagree about the same image, so one label per scene, or per aid, is wrong for many of them. We introduce few-shot personal accessibility perception: from K answers of a person never seen before, predict their judgment of sidewalk scenes never seen before. PassCal separates a shared description of the scene from the person's interpretation of it. The description comes from the internal state of a frozen vision-language model (VLM) and from barrier type, severity and context properties predicted by a detector trained on 14.9k public audits; the interpretation, a calibration of the person's response style and a weighting of the properties, is fit from their answers. On 8,883 judgments in which each of 135 verified mobility-aid users rated the same 50 sidewalk scenes, with people and scenes both held out, eight answers lower the Brier score from 0.550 to 0.479. The same VLM prompted with those answers reaches 0.562, and the same calibration without the scene 0.521. Conformal risk control turns predictions into passable, blocked or "depends on you" statements with a bounded expected rate of wrong statements over people; at 5%, eight answers raise the share of decisive scenes from 27% to 42%. Audit-supervised properties improve all sixteen vision and VLM encoders we test and outperform attributes from a sidewalk navigation VLM.

AI.tldr: 提出少样本个性化无障碍感知任务：仅凭一个人未曾见过的K个回答，预测其对未见过人行道场景的可通行判断；PassCal将"共享场景描述"与"个人解释"分离建模，8个回答使Brier分数从0.550降至0.479，并用保形风险控制输出"可通行/受阻/视人而定"三种带风险上界的判断。
AI.motivation: 同一人行道是否可通行取决于谁在使用：使用同一助行器的人对同一张图像判断并不一致，因此"每场景一个标签"或"每助行器一个标签"的标注范式对许多人都是错误的，需要建模个体层面的感知差异。
AI.method: 定义少样本个性化无障碍感知任务（K-shot，人物与场景双重留出）。PassCal将判断分解为：(1) 共享场景描述——来自冻结VLM的内部状态 + 由14.9k公开审计数据训练检测器预测的障碍类型、严重度与情境属性；(2) 个人解释——从该人回答中拟合的响应风格校准与属性权重。采用保形风险控制将预测转化为可通行/受阻/"视人而定"三类陈述，并对跨人群的错误陈述期望率给出上界。
AI.result: 在135名经核实的助行器用户对同一50个场景给出的8,883条判断上（人物与场景均留出），8个回答使Brier分数由0.550降至0.479；同样VLM直接提示达0.562，无场景信息的同等校准为0.521。在5%风险水平下，8个回答将可给出决定性判断的场景比例从27%提升到42%。审计监督属性对全部16个视觉/VLM编码器均有提升，并优于人行道导航VLM的属性。
AI.conclusion: 无障碍判断本质上是因人而异的，应与场景描述解耦并少样本个性化；审计数据监督的属性是有效且通用的场景表征，结合保形风险控制可实现有风险保证、且更具决定性的个性化可通行性预测。

title: A Threshold-Free Visual-Semantic Matching Metric for Evaluating Consistency in Subject-Driven Image Generation
summary: In subject-driven text-to-image generation, quantitatively evaluating localized visual consistency across varying poses and environments remains a major challenge. Existing metrics either rely on global image embeddings (CLIP, DINO) and Vision-Language Models (VLMs) that pool spatial representations and miss fine-grained textural artifacts, or depend on scalar threshold-gated dense metrics such as Visual-Semantic Matching (VSM) that suffer from point-alignment dropouts, severe threshold sensitivity, and score instability. To overcome these limitations, we propose TF-VSM, a fully continuous, threshold-free visual-consistency metric paired with an extended feature-disentanglement retraining schedule for dual-branch ResNet feature-aggregation networks. Rather than enforcing rigid binary cutoffs $(T_s,T_v)$, TF-VSM weights every object point by a non-linear semantic match confidence $w_j=ReLU(\hat{s}_j)^2$ and continuously integrates visual similarity over all consistency levels $r\in[0,1]$, yielding a closed-form confidence-weighted score without any hand-tuned hyperparameters. On a controlled 100-pair benchmark with ground-truth inpainting oracles, TF-VSM attains Pearson $0.638$ and Spearman $0.674$ oracle correlation, improving over the pretrained VSM baseline ($0.454/0.589$) by $+0.171/+0.116$ after retraining, and drastically outperforming CLIP ($-0.052/-0.004$), DINO ($0.087/0.121$), and VLMs ($0.096/0.003$). Six diagnostic ablations confirm that smooth confidence weighting is the right mechanism, that hard semantic gating is brittle (dropping to $0.533$ Pearson at $T_s{=}0.8$), and that the threshold-free metric is essentially invariant to the training-time loss balance $α$ that the thresholded metric still depends on.

AI.tldr: 提出TF-VSM，一种全连续、无阈值的视觉一致性度量，通过对语义匹配置信度加权连续积分视觉相似度，获得闭式评分且无手调超参，并配合特征解耦重训练策略，在100对基准上显著优于VSM、CLIP、DINO和VLM。
AI.motivation: 主体驱动文生图生成中，跨姿态与环境的局部视觉一致性难以定量评估。现有度量要么依赖全局图像嵌入（CLIP、DINO）和VLM，空间表征被池化而丢失细粒度纹理瑕疵；要么依赖标量阈值门控的稠密度量（如VSM），存在点对齐丢失、阈值敏感和评分不稳定问题。
AI.method: 提出TF-VSM：对每个物体点以非线性语义匹配置信度 w_j=ReLU(ŝ_j)² 加权，并在所有一致性水平 r∈[0,1] 上连续积分视觉相似度，得到无需人工阈值的闭式置信加权分数；同时为双分支ResNet特征聚合网络设计扩展的特征解耦重训练方案。
AI.result: 在含真值修复oracle的100对受控基准上，TF-VSM取得Pearson 0.638、Spearman 0.674的oracle相关性，重训练后较预训练VSM基线（0.454/0.589）提升+0.171/+0.116，并大幅优于CLIP（-0.052/-0.004）、DINO（0.087/0.121）和VLM（0.096/0.003）。六项诊断消融表明：平滑置信加权是正确机制；硬语义门控脆弱（T_s=0.8时Pearson降至0.533）；无阈值度量对训练损失平衡α基本不变，而阈值度量仍依赖之。
AI.conclusion: TF-VSM以连续置信加权替代二元阈值门控，消除了点对齐丢失与阈值敏感性，实现了稳定、无需调参的局部视觉一致性度量，并通过消融验证了机制有效性与鲁棒性。

title: Trading Parameters for Accuracy in MambaVision for Chest Radiograph Classification
comment: 10 pages, 4 figures, 9 tables. Submitted to an IEEE journal
summary: MambaVision, a hybrid state-space and attention backbone, places most of its parameters in its widest, fourth stage. We quantified what that stage contributes to multi-label chest radiograph classification. The fourth stage was replaced with lighter single-scan state-space blocks adapted from Spatial-Mamba, with multi-scale dilated depthwise convolutions applied to the scan output; the first three stages were retained. Tiny, Small, and Base models were evaluated across nine dataset-scale combinations drawn from two source cohorts: the National Institutes of Health ChestX-ray14 archive (full ChestMNIST and a high-resolution subset) and Indiana University Open-i. At the Tiny scale, replacement reduced parameter count by 35.7% and increased graphics processing unit throughput by 19.3%; the savings came from the stage's dense projections, not from removing quadratic attention. Without distillation, the mean area under the receiver operating characteristic curve on ChestMNIST was 0.004 lower than the baseline (95% bootstrap confidence interval, 0.002 to 0.006), and 0.003 to 0.006 lower across all nine combinations. Knowledge distillation from an unreplaced teacher narrowed the gap to the undistilled baseline to 0.001-0.002 and met the equivalence criterion on ChestMNIST, but distilling the baseline with the same recipe improved it by 0.001-0.003, so a gap of 0.002-0.005 persisted under symmetric training. At the Base scale, the unreplaced Small model was both smaller and more accurate. Fourth-stage replacement is a useful trade-off only for Tiny and Small models. These measurements let developers of chest radiograph screening tools weigh model size and speed against a quantified loss of diagnostic discrimination.

AI.tldr: 该研究将MambaVision最宽的第四阶段替换为基于Spatial-Mamba的轻量单扫描状态空间块（扫描输出加多尺度空洞深度可分离卷积），量化其对多标签胸片分类的性能影响。
AI.motivation: MambaVision把大部分参数放在最宽的第四阶段，但该阶段对多标签胸片分类的实际贡献尚不清楚，需要量化以指导模型规模与速度的取舍。
AI.method: 保留前三阶段，将第四阶段替换为单扫描SSM块并对扫描输出施加多尺度空洞深度可分离卷积；在ChestX-ray14（完整ChestMNIST与高分辨率子集）和Indiana Open-i共九个数据集-尺度组合上评测Tiny/Small/Base，并比较无蒸馏与知识蒸馏结果。
AI.result: Tiny规模下参数量减少35.7%、GPU吞吐提升19.3%（节省来自稠密投影而非去除二次注意力）；无蒸馏时ChestMNIST平均AUROC低0.004（95% bootstrap CI 0.002–0.006），九个组合均低0.003–0.006。蒸馏将差距缩小至0.001–0.002并通过ChestMNIST等效性判据，但对称训练下仍存在0.002–0.005差距。Base规模下未替换的Small模型更小且更准。
AI.conclusion: 第四阶段替换仅在Tiny和Small模型上是有利权衡；该量化结果可帮助胸片筛查工具开发者在模型大小、速度与诊断判别力损失之间做出权衡。

title: acuSimNet: Multi-View Self-Occlusion-Awared Visibility Learning for Cranio-Cervical Acupuncture Points
summary: The localization of acupuncture points (acupoints) in Traditional Chinese Medicine (TCM) presents unique challenges since they are defined by abstract principles rather than distinct anatomical landmarks. Existing approaches are typically constrained to single view or rely on indirect calculations of relative positions with respect to other landmarks, thereby overlooking human anatomical variations. Furthermore, acupoint visibility assessment, which determins whether points are occluded by human itself, hair, clothing, or other objects, has received limited attention in practical applications. Acupoint localization itself does not require 3D reconstruction, but inferring their occlusion relationships with anatomical surfaces does, which adds computational cost and limits real-time inference. In this work, we introduce acuSimNet, an efficient hierarchical multi-task learning architecture for multi-view, self-occlusion-aware visibility prediction of acupoints, achieving 99.97% accuracy on the validation set. Our approach also addresses the challenges of high-dimensional classification (174 acupoints in cervicocranial region), negative convergence issues for visible acupoints, and inter-task scheduling optimization, resulting in substantially accelerated convergence. We improved the training efficiency from the exisiting methods of 3000 epochs to achieve 99% validation accuracy, to our optimized framework achieving 90% accuracy in 39 epochs and 99% accuracy in 86 epochs. This architecture overcomes the limitations of existing methods, could enable practical applications in acupoints detection and visualization, advancing the automation of TCM.

AI.tldr: 提出acuSimNet——一种高效的分层多任务学习架构，实现多视角、自遮挡感知的腧穴可见性预测，验证集准确率达99.97%。
AI.motivation: 腧穴由抽象原则而非明确解剖标志定义，定位困难；现有方法局限于单视角或依赖相对其他标志点的间接位置推算，忽视人体解剖差异；腧穴可见性（是否被自身、毛发、衣物遮挡）评估在实际应用中关注不足。腧穴定位本身不需三维重建，但推断其与解剖表面的遮挡关系需要，增加计算成本并限制实时推理。
AI.method: 提出acuSimNet分层多任务学习架构，支持多视角与自遮挡感知的可见性预测；针对颈颅区174个腧穴的高维分类问题、可见腧穴的负收敛问题及任务间调度优化进行设计，加速收敛。
AI.result: 验证集准确率99.97%；训练效率显著提升，原有方法需3000个epoch才达99%验证准确率，而优化框架39个epoch达90%、86个epoch达99%。
AI.conclusion: 该架构克服了现有方法的局限，可支撑腧穴检测与可视化的实际应用，推动中医自动化发展。

title: Glance, then Select: Evidence-Tempered Visual Token Selection for Extremely Compressed Multimodal LLMs
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) encode a high-resolution image into thousands of visual tokens, which dominate the cost of the prefill stage. Visual token reduction removes most of these tokens, but two problems remain at extreme budgets. The vision encoder still processes every patch of the image, and the few surviving tokens often miss the small regions that hold the answer. In this paper, we propose Glance-ETD, a two-stage token reduction framework guided by a lightweight question-conditioned scorer. In the first stage, a glance encoder views the image at low resolution and re-encodes only the question-relevant regions at native resolution. In the second stage, Evidence-Tempered Diversity (ETD) selects the final tokens by combining diversity with the evidence predicted by the scorer, so that the kept tokens cover the scene and retain the answer. A single-rollout self-distillation recipe trains the MLLM with the glance encoder. With only 5% of the visual tokens, Glance-ETD retains 91.6% of the full-token performance of Qwen3.5-4B across fourteen benchmarks and outperforms the strongest prior method, LT-OPD, by 17.3 points and the same training recipe with DivPrune by 6.0. It also speeds up the time to first token on 4K images by 3.1x and generalizes to three other MLLMs and to high-resolution document benchmarks, with the largest gains on text-rich tasks.

AI.tldr: Glance-ETD 是一个两阶段视觉 token 削减框架，借助轻量的问题条件评分器，在仅保留 5% 视觉 token 的情况下保持 Qwen3.5-4B 全 token 性能的 91.6%，并显著优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: MLLM 将高分辨率图像编码为数千个视觉 token，主导 prefill 成本；现有视觉 token 削减在极端预算下存在两个问题：视觉编码器仍需处理每个图像 patch，且保留下来的少量 token 往往遗漏承载答案的小区域。
AI.method: 提出两阶段框架：第一阶段由 glance 编码器以低分辨率快速浏览图像，仅对问题相关区域以原生分辨率重新编码；第二阶段采用 Evidence-Tempered Diversity（ETD），结合多样性与评分器预测的证据来挑选最终 token，使保留 token 既覆盖场景又保留答案；并用单次 rollout 的自蒸馏配方训练 MLLM 与 glance 编码器。
AI.result: 仅用 5% 视觉 token，在十四个基准上保留 Qwen3.5-4B 全 token 性能的 91.6%，比最强先前方法 LT-OPD 高 17.3 分，比采用相同训练配方的 DivPrune 高 6.0 分；4K 图像首 token 时间加速 3.1 倍；可泛化至另外三个 MLLM 及高分辨率文档基准，在文本密集任务上增益最大。
AI.conclusion: Glance-ETD 通过“低分辨率浏览 + 相关区域重编码 + 证据与多样性联合选择”的两阶段设计，在极端 token 预算下兼顾覆盖性与答案证据，实现了效率与精度的良好平衡。

title: Morphology-Decoupled Segmentation for Multiple Tunnel Defects Under Complex Environments
summary: Automated tunnel-lining inspection must segment different defect geometries: cracks are thin, elongated, and connectivity-sensitive, whereas leakage, lining falling off, and segment damage are spatially extensive and context-dependent. Existing approaches generally apply a common decoder across defect classes or introduce boundary, topology, and directional mechanisms as isolated enhancements. This paper introduces Morphology-Decoupled Segmentation (MDS), in which defect morphology becomes the organising principle for feature routing, decoding, and interaction. A supervised routing module partitions multiscale encoder features into complementary linear and areal streams. The linear stream employs Deformable Strip Attention with image-conditioned direction hypotheses to preserve crack continuity without assuming fixed horizontal or vertical orientations, while the areal stream combines Pyramid Pooling with feature-pyramid fusion to capture diffuse boundaries and regional context. The representations are coupled through gated cross-morphology attention, allowing complementary information exchange while retaining morphology-specific features. A resolution-adaptive tiling and probability-blending pipeline preserves fine defects across variable-resolution imagery. MDS achieves 81.17% mIoU on the internal validation set and improves foreground image-level recognition over a backbone-matched SegDINO model, primarily for areal defects. Controlled ablations demonstrate the complementary contributions of routing supervision and cross-stream interaction while revealing a trade-off between areal-class performance and crack specialisation. The submitted model achieved 67.55% mIoU on an organiser-controlled hidden test, and the team placed second. Selective dynamic INT8 quantisation reduced model storage by 2.83 times with negligible accuracy loss.

AI.tldr: 提出形态解耦分割框架MDS，将缺陷形态作为特征路由、解码与交互的组织原则，分线性（裂缝）与面状（渗漏、掉块、管片损伤）双流处理，内部验证81.17% mIoU，隐藏测试67.55% mIoU获第二名。
AI.motivation: 隧道衬砌自动检测需同时分割形态迥异的缺陷：裂缝细长且依赖连通性，渗漏、掉块、管片损伤则空间广泛且依赖上下文。现有方法对各类缺陷共用同一解码器，或把边界、拓扑、方向机制作为孤立增强，难以兼顾两类形态。
AI.method: 以缺陷形态为组织原则：监督式路由模块将多尺度编码特征划分为线性流与面状流；线性流采用可变形条带注意力（Deformable Strip Attention）并结合图像条件化的方向假设以保持裂缝连续且不预设固定方向；面状流结合金字塔池化与特征金字塔融合以捕捉弥散边界与区域上下文；两流通过门控跨形态注意力耦合，在交换互补信息的同时保留形态特异性特征；辅以分辨率自适应切块与概率融合流程以保留变分辨率影像中的细小缺陷。
AI.result: 内部验证集达81.17% mIoU；相比骨干匹配的SegDINO，前景图像级识别提升，主要体现在面状缺陷；消融实验验证路由监督与跨流交互的互补贡献，同时揭示面状类别性能与裂缝专精之间的权衡。组织方隐藏测试67.55% mIoU，队伍获第二名。选择性动态INT8量化将模型存储压缩2.83倍，精度损失可忽略。
AI.conclusion: 按形态解耦的双流架构配合跨形态交互，能有效兼顾细长裂缝与面状缺陷的分割需求，并在竞赛场景与部署效率（量化压缩）上具备实用价值；代价是面状类与裂缝类的性能存在此消彼长的权衡。

title: Pointillist Maize: 3D Reconstruction of Field-Grown Maize Using RGB UAV Imagery
comment: 26 pages, 8 figures, submitted to Frontiers in Plant Science
summary: Three-dimensional reconstruction can extend field phenotyping to individual maize organs, but thin, flexible, occluding structures and plant movement complicate reconstruction. We evaluated whether consumer-grade UAV RGB video processed with Structure from Motion and multi-view stereo could recover recognizable field-grown maize structures, and examined the effects of acquisition trajectories and frame sampling. COLMAP reconstructions preserved recognizable leaves, stems, tassel branches, ears, silks, and brace roots. For an equal-frame comparison, we reconstructed one plant from two sets of 295 frames from the same video: a single orbit sampled at 5 frames/second and three orbits at different altitudes (ribbon skirt) sampled at 2 frames/second. After ground removal, the reconstructions contained 520,601 and 375,318 points, respectively. The single orbit yielded greater point concentration within plant structures and fewer visible gaps, while the ribbon skirt yielded fewer scattered points and slightly lower proportions of isolated points. In densely planted nursery rows, visible voids occupied 17.57% of the rendered scene with one orbit at 1 frame/second, decreasing to 5.07% with additional serpentine passes and 2.68% when the original orbit was sampled at 3 frames/second. Additional observations also increased point dispersion associated with plant movement. A curlicue trajectory tested in a different field in 2024 produced distinguishable individual plants without visible duplicated structures, although substantial voids remained, mainly on the soil surface. These results demonstrate the feasibility of recovering recognizable maize organs from consumer UAV imagery and reveal trade-offs between acquisition strategies, reconstruction completeness, and point dispersion. Independent geometric validation is still needed before quantitative phenotyping.

AI.tldr: 消费级无人机RGB视频经COLMAP（SfM+MVS）三维重建可复原田间玉米可辨认的叶、茎、雄穗分枝、雌穗、花丝与气生根，但"薄、软、遮挡"结构以及植株摆动带来完整性与点云弥散之间的权衡，仍需独立几何验证才能定量表型。
AI.motivation: 三维重建可将田间表型分析拓展到单器官尺度，但玉米叶片等细薄柔性且相互遮挡的器官、以及风致植株运动，使重建困难；同时不确定消费级无人机视频能否胜任，以及采集轨迹与抽帧策略如何影响结果。
AI.method: 用消费级无人机RGB视频，经COLMAP的结构光式流程（Structure from Motion + 多视立体MVS）重建田间玉米；在地面去除后比较等帧数（各295帧）的两种采集策略：单轨道5帧/秒 vs 三高度轨道"ribbon skirt"2帧/秒；在密植苗行中比较单轨道1帧/秒、增加蛇形航线、原轨道3帧/秒的渲染空洞率；2024年在另一田块测试"curlicue"曲线轨迹。以点数、点云聚集度、孤立点比例与渲染空洞占比等指标评价。
AI.result: 等帧比较中两种重建分别含520,601与375,318点；单轨道点更集中于植株结构、可见空缺更少，ribbon skirt散射点更少、孤立点比例略低。密植苗行中可见空洞由单轨道1帧/秒的17.57%降至增加蛇形航线的5.07%，再降至3帧/秒的2.68%；增加观测同时增大植株运动引起的点云弥散。curlicue轨迹可分辨单株且无明显重影结构，但土壤表面仍有较大空洞。
AI.conclusion: 消费级无人机影像可重建出可辨认的玉米器官，验证了可行性，并揭示采集策略在重建完整性与点云弥散间的权衡；用于定量表型前仍需独立的几何精度验证。

title: Beyond Seeing: Fine-Grained Preference Validation and Severity-Aware Alignment for Mitigating Visual Hallucinations in Vision-Language Models
comment: 9 pages, 2 figures, 6 tables. Includes a 4-page supplementary appendix with experimental details, equations, prompt templates, and additional comparisons
summary: Large vision-language models can produce fluent responses containing objects, attributes, or relations unsupported by the image. We study an implemented alignment pipeline that normalizes released fine-grained hallucination supervision, validates chosen-rejected preference pairs with vision-language judges, repairs rejected chosen responses, and trains LLaVA adapters with standard or severity-aware direct preference optimization. The study uses 16,143 normalized feedback records and 8,386 released preference pairs, comparing direct training with zero-shot and two-shot judged severity-margin variants. The zero-shot variant reduces Object HalBench CHAIRs from 53.00 to 36.00 and CHAIRi from 15.72 to 10.41. Across aligned models, AMBER-Hal decreases from 35.90 to 25.10-26.90, accompanied by reduced visual coverage. In contrast, the base model retains the highest valid POPE adversarial F1, 84.18 versus 83.87-83.91 after alignment. These results support benchmark-dependent reductions in generative hallucination rather than uniform superiority of severity-aware alignment. We distinguish implemented pipeline components from the preference paths used in the reported experiments and discuss the limits of attributing gains to judging, repair, or the training objective individually.

AI.tldr: 论文研究细粒度幻觉监督下的视觉语言模型对齐管线，通过视觉语言裁判校验、修复与严重度感知DPO训练LLaVA适配器，在Object HalBench与AMBER上将幻觉显著降低，但POPE对抗F1略有下降，表明幻觉抑制具有基准依赖性而非一致优越。
AI.motivation: 大型视觉语言模型会产生包含图像不支持的对象、属性或关系的流畅幻觉；需要考察基于偏好优化的对齐管线能否缓解细粒度幻觉，并厘清裁判、修复与训练目标各自的作用边界。
AI.method: 构建对齐管线：规范化已发布的细粒度幻觉监督数据（16,143条规范化反馈记录、8,386个偏好对），用视觉语言裁判校验chosen-rejected偏好对，修复被拒的chosen回复，再以标准或严重度感知的DPO训练LLaVA适配器；对比直接训练、零样本与两样本裁判严重度边际三种变体。
AI.result: 零样本变体将Object HalBench的CHAIRs从53.00降至36.00，CHAIRi从15.72降至10.41；对齐模型AMBER-Hal从35.90降至25.10–26.90，但视觉覆盖度同步下降；基座模型POPE对抗F1最高（84.18），对齐后为83.87–83.91。
AI.conclusion: 对齐带来的生成式幻觉下降依赖基准，严重度感知对齐并不具备一致优越性；论文区分了已实现管线组件与实际实验所用偏好路径，并指出将增益单独归因于裁判、修复或训练目标存在局限。

title: Training-Free Anonymization of Driving Data with Promptable Segmentation and 3D Human Mesh Recovery
summary: Camera recordings for autonomous driving contain faces and license plates that should be anonymized before labeling, sharing, or training. Dedicated detectors can miss small plates and faces behind vehicle glass. We present FM-Anonymize, a training-free anonymization pipeline that combines promptable segmentation, 3D human mesh recovery, and generative replacement. SAM 3 locates people, faces, and vehicles and searches zoomed vehicle crops for plates, occupants, and windows. SAM 3D Body assesses face visibility from head orientation and projects head regions for blurring. Optional diffusion inpainting replaces eligible blurred heads with synthetic faces, guided by estimated pose and keypoints. On PP4AV, the blur pipeline protects 97.8% of faces and 95.5% of plates, the highest privacy recall of all compared methods at their default settings. On our recordings, where the localization thresholds were set, it protects 97.1% of faces and 93.4% of plates, compared with 93.7%/73.0% for UrbanAnonymizer, 42.7%/40.7% for EgoBlur, and 96.6% of faces for deface. Synthetic replacement raises full-body keypoint average precision over blurring from 54.1% to 79.6% on our recordings and from 39.9% to 68.3% on PP4AV. Code and configurations are available on https://github.com/max-a-ai/FM-Anonymize

AI.tldr: FM-Anonymize 是一个无需训练的人脸与车牌匿名化流水线，结合可提示分割（SAM 3）、3D 人体网格恢复（SAM 3D Body）与生成式替换，在 PP4AV 上人脸/车牌隐私召回率达 97.8%/95.5%，优于 UrbanAnonymizer、EgoBlur 与 deface。
AI.motivation: 自动驾驶相机录像在标注、共享与训练前需对人脸与车牌匿名化；专用检测器易漏检小车牌及车窗玻璃后的人脸，导致隐私泄露。
AI.method: 训练-free 流水线：SAM 3 定位行人、人脸与车辆，并对车辆裁剪图放大搜索车牌、乘员与车窗；SAM 3D Body 依据头部朝向判断人脸可见性并投影头部区域进行模糊；可选扩散修复在姿态与关键点引导下将可模糊头部替换为合成人脸。
AI.result: PP4AV 上模糊流水线保护 97.8% 人脸与 95.5% 车牌，为默认设置下隐私召回最高；自采集数据上为 97.1%/93.4%，对比 UrbanAnonymizer 93.7%/73.0%、EgoBlur 42.7%/40.7%、deface 96.6% 人脸；合成替换使全身关键点 AP 在自采集数据由 54.1% 升至 79.6%，PP4AV 由 39.9% 升至 68.3%。
AI.conclusion: 免训练的多模型组合方案在隐私保护召回上超越现有方法，且合成人脸替换可显著缓解模糊对下游关键点检测性能的损害；代码与配置已开源。

title: Structure-Guided Multi-Granularity Spatiotemporal Transformer for Efficient Monocular 3D Human Pose Estimation
summary: Existing multi-granularity methods for monocular 3D human pose estimation emphasize spatial joint features while underusing skeletal structure, including global connectivity and temporal continuity. Moreover, modeling entire frame sequences incurs high computational costs. We propose a Structure-Aware Multi-Granularity Spatiotemporal Transformer that integrates structural priors across spatial and temporal representations for accurate and efficient pose estimation. A three-level feature extractor captures human topology at the joint, bone, and limb levels. Gated Adaptive Spatial Attention (GASA) embeds structural constraints into spatial attention, while Multi-Granularity Feature Enhancement (MGFE) uses hierarchical pooling and fusion to strengthen local details and global semantics. Temporal Segment Fusion (TSF) aligns temporal contexts across granularities to capture both short- and long-range motion patterns. Hierarchical Cross-Attention (HCA) promotes spatiotemporal interaction between granularities, and Keyframe Attention (KFA) selects informative motion segments to reduce redundancy and computational cost. Experiments demonstrate improved accuracy and efficiency over conventional Transformer-based approaches, highlighting the effectiveness of structure-aware multi-granularity modeling for monocular 3D human pose estimation.

AI.tldr: 提出结构感知的多粒度时空Transformer，将骨骼结构先验融入空间与时间表征，并通过关键帧注意力降低冗余计算，实现高精度、高效率的单目3D人体姿态估计。
AI.motivation: 现有单目3D人体姿态估计的多粒度方法侧重空间关节点特征，对骨骼结构（全局连通性与时间连续性）利用不足；同时建模整段视频帧序列计算开销高。
AI.method: 三级特征提取器在关节、骨骼、肢体三个层级刻画人体拓扑；门控自适应空间注意力（GASA）将结构约束嵌入空间注意力；多粒度特征增强（MGFE）通过分层池化与融合强化局部细节与全局语义；时间片段融合（TSF）跨粒度对齐时间上下文以捕捉短程与长程运动模式；层次交叉注意力（HCA）促进粒度间时空交互；关键帧注意力（KFA）筛选信息量大的运动片段以减少冗余与计算量。
AI.result: 实验表明，相较传统Transformer方法，在精度与效率上均有提升。
AI.conclusion: 结构感知的多粒度建模对单目3D人体姿态估计有效，可在保证精度的同时提升计算效率。

title: PoCoAttn: Position-Content Collaborative Sparse Attention for Fast and High-Fidelity Video Generation
comment: 21 pages, 15 figures, 13 tables. Project page: https://ecoai-group.github.io/pocoattn
summary: Video diffusion transformers rely on 3D full attention over tens of thousands of spatiotemporal tokens, and its quadratic cost dominates inference latency. Sparse attention reduces this cost, but existing methods face a dilemma: static methods apply predefined masks and cannot capture input-dependent attention, whereas dynamic methods reconstruct the sparse mask repeatedly, paying online to rediscover positional structure that is largely stable across inputs. To this end, we propose PoCoAttn, a training-free sparse attention framework that separates input-stable from input-dependent attention and resolves the former offline and the latter online. PoCoAttn features: (1) A relative-offset analysis of 3D query-key pairs, which shows that video attention decomposes into an input-stable positional prior that carries most of the attention mass and a small content-dependent residual. (2) A position-content collaborative sparse attention mechanism, which retrieves positional keys from offline-calibrated tables, selects content keys online with a head-adaptive ratio between the two sources, and compensates for the discarded keys to approximate full attention. (3) A step-adaptive budget allocation algorithm, which models how early-step sparse attention errors are amplified along the denoising trajectory and derives the optimal sparsity budget per step. Extensive experiments across four video diffusion models and three tasks show that PoCoAttn consistently achieves a better speed-fidelity Pareto frontier than state-of-the-art (SOTA) methods, improving PSNR by 1.9 to 5.0 dB over baselines and delivering up to 4.1$\times$ attention and 2.0$\times$ denoising speedups over dense FlashAttention-3 attention.

AI.tldr: PoCoAttn 是一种免训练稀疏注意力框架，将视频扩散 Transformer 的注意力分解为输入稳定的位置先验与内容相关残差，前者离线建表、后者在线选择，并配合步自适应预算分配，在多模型多任务上取得更好的速度-保真度帕累托前沿。
AI.motivation: 视频扩散 Transformer 需对数万时空 token 做 3D 全注意力，二次复杂度主导推理延迟。现有稀疏注意力陷入两难：静态方法用预定义掩码，无法捕捉输入相关的注意力；动态方法则需反复重建稀疏掩码，在线重复发现跨输入基本稳定的位置结构，造成冗余开销。
AI.method: (1) 对 3D query-key 对做相对偏移分析，发现视频注意力可分解为承载大部分注意力质量的输入稳定位置先验与较小的内容相关残差；(2) 位置-内容协同稀疏注意力：位置键从离线校准表中检索，内容键在线选择，二者间采用头自适应比例，并对被丢弃键进行补偿以逼近全注意力；(3) 步自适应预算分配：建模早期步稀疏注意力误差沿去噪轨迹的放大效应，推导每步最优稀疏预算。
AI.result: 在四个视频扩散模型、三类任务上，PoCoAttn 始终取得优于 SOTA 的速度-保真度帕累托前沿，PSNR 较基线提升 1.9–5.0 dB；相比稠密 FlashAttention-3，注意力加速最高 4.1×、去噪加速最高 2.0×。
AI.conclusion: 将注意力中"输入稳定"与"输入相关"两部分解耦——前者离线解决、后者在线解决——是提升视频扩散稀疏注意力效率的有效范式；免训练、即插即用，并具备实证的加速与保真度双重收益。

title: CiGS: Conduction in Gaussian Splats for Interior Temperature Field from Thermal Images
summary: We present a method for inferring the interior temperature distribution of a solid object from registered multi-view visible-spectrum and thermal images, even when the thermal views cover only part of its surface. We formulate steady-state heat conduction as a Laplace boundary value problem and solve it with a direct boundary integral equation discretized over a point cloud: a Gaussian reconstruction of the visible-spectrum images supplies the boundary geometry, and the thermal images supply the boundary data. We do not build surface or volume meshes at any stage in our method. Instead, we sample collocation points from rendered depth without the pixels at depth discontinuities, and use a density subtraction that keeps the interior evaluation accurate up to the surface. The whole chain is differentiable, and we use it to recover the pose and depth of heating pipes, insulation defects, and the shape of cracks from thermal images. We validate our method through experiments on boundary value problems with Dirichlet-only and mixed Dirichlet and Robin boundaries, using synthetic and real captured data on scenes with challenging topology. These experiments show that our method matches analytical solutions and has better accuracy than FEM solvers.

AI.tldr: 提出一种无需网格、基于点云的边界积分方法，从多视角可见光与部分覆盖的热像推断固态物体内部稳态温度场，并整条链路可微，可用于反演加热管道位姿/深度、保温缺陷与裂纹形状。
AI.motivation: 热像通常只能覆盖物体部分表面，且传统体/面网格方法（如FEM）在复杂拓扑场景下建模与求解成本高、精度受限；目标是仅凭可见光几何与稀疏热观测重建完整内部温度分布。
AI.method: 将稳态热传导表述为Laplace边值问题，用直接边界积分方程在点云上离散求解；由可见光谱图像的高斯重建提供边界几何，热像提供边界数据；全程不构建面网格或体网格；从渲染深度中采样配点并剔除深度不连续处像素，采用密度扣除（density subtraction）使靠近表面的内部评估仍保持精度；整个流程可微，支持以热像为监督反演管道位姿与深度、裂纹形状。
AI.result: 在仅Dirichlet与Dirichlet–Robin混合边界条件的两类边值问题上，用合成与真实采集数据、含挑战性拓扑的场景验证：结果与解析解一致，且精度优于FEM求解器。
AI.conclusion: 点云上的可微边界积分框架可在无网格条件下从部分热观测准确推断内部温度场，并统一支撑几何/位姿反演，精度与解析解吻合、优于FEM。

title: Consistency-Aware Map Generation at Multiple Zoom Levels Using Aerial Image
summary: The multi-level tiled map service is widely used and serves as a kind of digital infrastructure. These map tiles are usually rendered from vector data, whose update needs to walk or drive with professional equipment to check every points of interest. This leads to inconvenience and expensive cost in timely updating maps. Compared with vector data, aerial images are much easier and cheaper to obtain. In this paper, we propose a novel multi-level map generation framework that can automatically generate accurate and consistent maps with multiple zoom levels from aerial images. It consists of a level-aware map generator and a consistency-aware map generator. The level-aware map generator is able to generate accurate initial maps with realistic details for each zoom level. The consistency-aware map generator regards initial maps at each zoom level as a sequence and builds the connection between them, so as to guarantee content consistency between maps at different zoom levels. Furthermore, we collect a large-scale high-quality dataset called Multi-Level Map (MLM) for map generation at multiple zoom levels. Experiments on our MLM dataset show that our method outperforms previous state-of-the-art map generation methods on both comprehensive quantitative metrics and perceptual quality.

AI.tldr: 提出一种从航空影像自动生成多层级、高一致性地图瓦片的新框架，并构建MLM数据集；在定量指标与感知质量上优于现有最优方法。
AI.motivation: 多层级瓦片地图是数字基础设施，但其矢量底图更新需专业设备实地逐个核查兴趣点，成本高、时效差；航空影像获取更易更廉价，因此希望直接从航空影像自动生成多缩放层级的准确且一致的地图。
AI.method: 框架包含两个模块：层级感知地图生成器（level-aware map generator），为每个缩放层级生成细节真实、准确的初始地图；一致性感知地图生成器（consistency-aware map generator），将各层初始地图视为序列并建模层间关联，以保证不同缩放层级间的内容一致性。同时构建大规模高质量多层级地图数据集MLM。
AI.result: 在MLM数据集上的实验表明，该方法在综合定量指标与感知质量两方面均优于先前的最先进地图生成方法。
AI.conclusion: 以航空影像为输入的层级感知+一致性感知生成框架可自动产出多层级精确一致的地图，为低成本、及时的地图更新提供可行途径。

title: UrbanTwin Sim2Real LiDAR Challenge 2026: Site-Calibrated Synthetic Data and Multi-Detector Fusion for Roadside 3D Detection
summary: This report summarizes the work submitted by team arnav007 (submission ID 1054222) for the UrbanTwin Sim2Real LiDAR Challenge (V2X-Real track) at the IEEE BigData Cup 2026. The primary objective is to train 3D detectors for vehicles, pedestrians, and trucks using only synthetic roadside LiDAR data, and to generate synthetic scans that are realistic enough to be indistinguishable from real ones. A CARLA based pipeline is developed and calibrated to the fixed sensor site, accurately modeling the range image, including no-return beams, based on unlabelled real development scans. A combined inference detector, using multiple 3D detectors (VoxelNeXt, PV-RCNN, and SECOND) trained exclusively on synthetic data, is also proposed. Each scan is aligned to the synthetic ground plane and processed through the detectors at multiple ground heights. The resulting bounding boxes are fused using bird's-eye view (BEV) clustering, followed by class-specific post-processing to refine heading, box size, and filter low-confidence detections. The final submission achieved a combined score of 0.8947. The ablation study shows that per-scan ground leveling more than doubled the real-scan mAP, while fusing boxes across different heights and models further improved performance.

AI.tldr: 该报告为IEEE BigData Cup 2026 UrbanTwin Sim2Real LiDAR Challenge（V2X-Real赛道）team arnav007的参赛方案总结：仅用合成路侧LiDAR数据训练车辆/行人/卡车3D检测器并生成高逼真合成扫描；最终综合得分0.8947。
AI.motivation: 目标是解决合成到真实（Sim2Real）域差距：在无真实标注、仅有未标注真实扫描的条件下，仅依赖合成路侧LiDAR数据训练3D检测器并生成难以区分真假的合成扫描。
AI.method: (1) 基于CARLA的合成管线，利用未标注真实开发扫描标定至固定传感器站点，精确建模距离图像含no-return光束；(2) 仅用合成数据训练VoxelNeXt、PV-RCNN、SECOND三个3D检测器并做联合推理；(3) 每帧扫描对齐至合成地平面并在多个地面高度下推理；(4) BEV聚类融合候选框，再做类别特定后处理（修正朝向、框尺寸、过滤低置信度）。
AI.result: 最终提交综合得分0.8947；消融实验表明逐帧地平面校平使真实扫描mAP提升一倍以上，跨高度与跨模型框融合进一步提升性能。
AI.conclusion: 精确的传感器站点标定与逐帧地平面校平是缓解Sim2Real域差距的关键，多模型、多高度的BEV融合可有效提升真实路侧LiDAR检测性能。

title: ReVision: Selective Intrinsic Reasoning for Tool-Augmented, Reasoning-Intensive VQA
summary: External tools substantially expand what multimodal large language models (MLLMs) can retrieve and compute on reasoning-intensive visual questions, and aggregate accuracy typically improves when tools are available. Our empirical study across six VQA benchmarks shows that aggregate accuracy gains under tool access can coexist with answer reversals: questions answered correctly without tools but incorrectly with tools. Trajectory analysis reveals substantially shorter reasoning turns under tool access, suggesting a shift from intrinsic visual reasoning toward reliance on external outputs. We propose ReVision, a training-free test-time method that registers intrinsic reconsideration as an optional action alongside search and code execution. When invoked, a separate tool-free multimodal call re-examines the original image, integrates accumulated evidence, and returns a revised analysis. The MLLM chooses if and when to use it, without fixed reflection stages or paired rollouts. ReVision improves over standard tool use on all six benchmarks (1.28--7.51\%) and outperforms Dual-Rollout Combine on five, with reasoning-token use comparable to standard tool use.

AI.tldr: 该论文发现MLLM在可用外部工具时聚合准确率提升，但存在"答案反转"现象，并提出无训练的测试时方法ReVision，让模型自主调用不带工具的内在重审。
AI.motivation: 外部工具虽提升MLLM在推理密集型视觉问题上的聚合准确率，但作者通过六个VQA基准的实证研究发现：工具可用时会出现"答案反转"——即无工具时答对、有工具时反而答错；轨迹分析显示工具接入下推理轮次显著缩短，说明模型从内在视觉推理转向依赖外部输出，需要一种机制恢复内在再思考。
AI.method: 提出ReVision，一种无需训练的测试时方法：将"内在重审"注册为与搜索、代码执行并列的可选动作；当模型调用时，触发一次独立的无工具多模态调用，重新审视原始图像、整合已积累的证据并返回修正后的分析；由MLLM自主决定是否及何时使用，无需固定反思阶段或成对rollout。
AI.result: 在全部六个基准上优于标准工具使用（1.28–7.51%），在五个基准上优于Dual-Rollout Combine，且推理token消耗与标准工具使用相当。
AI.conclusion: 工具增益与个体层面的可靠性下降可并存；将无工具的内在重审作为可选动作交由模型自主调度，可在不增加显著推理开销的前提下缓解对工具输出的过度依赖并提升准确率。

title: CLIFT: Contrastive LiDAR Instance Features for 3D Pedestrian Tracking
summary: A social robot has to keep track of the people around it over time to plan its motion, a task handled by 3D multi-object tracking. For the LiDAR modality, trackers usually sit on top of a detector and link its detections across frames with a separate motion model or re-identification network. We instead show how a 3D LiDAR detector itself can be turned into a tracker by adding an instance-level contrastive objective on its intermediate voxel features. Each embedding is read from the voxels inside a detected box, and boxes are matched across frames by cosine similarity and the Hungarian algorithm, without a motion model. The detector backbone is fine-tuned together with this objective, which learns identity-aware features while leaving detection accuracy essen- tially intact. Because the method uses only the voxel features that Li- DAR detectors already produce, it is backbone-agnostic. On the JRDB 3D tracking leaderboard our LiDAR-only tracker ranks first on HOTA (38.58) and IDF1 (37.99), 13.04 and 9.30 points above the next pub- lished method, and second on MOTA and OSPA. Code is available at https://hermak56.github.io/CLIFT/.

AI.tldr: 用实例级对比目标赋予LiDAR检测器身份感知体素特征，使检测器自身成为无需运动模型的3D多目标跟踪器，在JRDB榜单HOTA/IDF1排名第一。
AI.motivation: 现有3D LiDAR多目标跟踪通常采用"检测器+独立运动模型/重识别网络"的两阶段范式，结构冗余且依赖跨帧运动建模。
AI.method: 在LiDAR检测器中间层体素特征上引入实例级对比学习目标，将检测框内体素嵌入作为实例表示；检测器骨干与该目标联合微调，学习身份感知特征；跨帧以余弦相似度+匈牙利算法匹配检测框，无需运动模型，且与骨干网络无关。
AI.result: JRDB 3D跟踪榜单上，纯LiDAR跟踪器HOTA达38.58、IDF1达37.99，分别领先次优已发表方法13.04和9.30分，MOTA与OSPA位列第二；同时检测精度基本不受影响。
AI.conclusion: 通过对比学习即可将检测器直接转化为跟踪器，无需额外运动模型或重识别网络，方法简洁、轻量且具备骨干通用性。

title: RAGE: Residual-Adaptive Gating for Flow-Based Image Editing
summary: Recent inversion-free, flow-based image editing methods evolve the source image toward the target via a differential velocity field. We observe that this velocity field does not explicitly account for which regions should be preserved, leading to unintended drift in non-editing regions. To address this, we formulate source fidelity control as a stochastic optimal control problem in which a selective fidelity term on the editing residual is enforced along the editing trajectory. Solving this problem and approximating its solution yields the Residual Gating Principle: each latent component is pulled back toward the source with a gain that decays exponentially with the local residual magnitude, so that small deviations are suppressed while large, semantically meaningful edits pass through unimpeded. The proposed method, RAGE, requires only one lightweight gated interpolation per sampling step, involves no mask estimation, attention maps, retraining, or architecture-specific modifications, and is applied on top of FlowEdit-based editors. On PIE-Bench, RAGE achieves the best overall rank among 17 methods and substantially improves background preservation on both Stable Diffusion 3 and FLUX backbones while maintaining competitive editing quality.

AI.tldr: 提出RAGE，将源保真控制建模为随机最优控制问题，得到"残差门控原理"：按残差幅度指数衰减的增益把隐变量拉回源图，小偏差被抑制、大编辑放行，无需掩码/注意力图/重训练，在PIE-Bench上17种方法中综合排名第一并显著提升背景保持。
AI.motivation: 无反转、基于流的图像编辑方法（如FlowEdit）通过微分速度场将源图向目标演化，但该速度场未显式区分应被保留的区域，导致非编辑区域出现非预期漂移。作者希望在不引入掩码估计、注意力图、重训练或架构改动的前提下控制源保真度。
AI.method: 将源保真控制形式化为随机最优控制问题，在编辑轨迹上对编辑残差施加选择性保真项；求解并近似其解，导出残差门控原理（Residual Gating Principle）：每个隐分量的回拉增益随局部残差幅度指数衰减。据此实现RAGE，每步采样仅需一次轻量门控插值，叠加于FlowEdit类编辑器之上。
AI.result: 在PIE-Bench上，RAGE在17种方法中取得最佳综合排名；在Stable Diffusion 3与FLUX两种骨干网络上均显著提升背景保持，同时编辑质量保持竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 源保真控制可由残差幅度的指数门控自然实现，简单且通用：RAGE以极低开销解决无反转流式编辑中的非编辑区漂移问题，具备良好的骨干网络可迁移性。

title: Beyond Token Stacking: Multi-scale Visual Modulation and Adaptive Fused-feature Calibration for MLLMs
summary: Current Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have advanced rapidly and follow two main paradigms: one involves concatenating visual and textual tokens for input into Large Language Model (LLM), while the other injects visual knowledge into Feed-Forward Networks (FFNs) of the LLM. However, the former introduces a large number of redundant visual tokens, substantially increasing computational overhead. The latter reduces sequence length but removes images from the input stage entirely, which may hinder the activation of image-related knowledge. Moreover, naively injecting visual knowledge into the FFNs could induce activation distribution shifts due to cross-modal semantic discrepancies. To address these challenges, we develop Beyond Token Stacking (BTS), a novel visual enhancement framework for MLLMs. Specifically, we propose a Multi-scale Visual Modulation (MVM) mechanism that injects multi-scale visual information at the input stage via modulation without increasing the token sequence length. Furthermore, we develop an Adaptive Fused-feature Calibration (AFC) module that performs per-channel affine calibration to decouple visual injection from distribution alignment in the FFN layers, improving multimodal fusion stability while preserving language priors. Experiments show that our approach achieves state-of-the-art performance.

AI.tldr: 提出Beyond Token Stacking（BTS）视觉增强框架，通过多尺度视觉调制（MVM）在输入阶段以调制方式注入多尺度视觉信息而不增加token序列长度，并用自适应融合特征校准（AFC）在FFN层做逐通道仿射校准以解耦视觉注入与分布对齐，实现SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 现有MLLM两大范式各有缺陷：①视觉与文本token拼接输入LLM，引入大量冗余视觉token，计算开销大；②将视觉知识注入LLM的FFN，虽缩短序列长度，但图像完全从输入阶段移除，可能阻碍图像相关知识的激活；且朴素注入视觉知识会因跨模态语义差异导致激活分布偏移。
AI.method: 提出BTS视觉增强框架：(1) 多尺度视觉调制（MVM）机制，在输入阶段通过调制注入多尺度视觉信息，不增加token序列长度；(2) 自适应融合特征校准（AFC）模块，在FFN层进行逐通道仿射校准，将视觉注入与分布对齐解耦，在保留语言先验的同时提升多模态融合稳定性。
AI.result: 实验表明该方法取得了state-of-the-art性能。
AI.conclusion: BTS兼顾输入阶段的视觉知识激活与计算效率，并通过分布校准缓解跨模态语义差异带来的激活偏移，为MLLM视觉增强提供了一种不依赖token堆叠的有效方案。

title: DRaGAN: Dynamic Graph Attention Network for Multi-Radar Point Cloud Encoding in Automotive Radar Perception
comment: Accepted to 2027 IEEE/SICE International Symposium on System Integration (SII)
summary: Radar represents a key modality for weather-robust perception. Unlike optical sensors such as camera and LiDAR, radar can penetrate fog, rain and snow due to its longer wavelength, and recent hardware advances have steadily improved its spatial resolution, thus making it increasingly relevant for autonomous systems. While processing raw radar data requires substantial memory computation, most existing work has focused on preprocessed point-cloud data similar to LiDAR. However, the sparse radar points and sensor-relative anisotropy make LiDAR-oriented encoders suboptimal. To address this problem, we present DRaGAN, a dynamic graph attention network for multi-radar point clouds. DRaGAN introduces a sensor-relative Fourier encoding of angle and range to capture fixed-aperture radar characteristics, gated short- and long-range hub nodes along each sensor's line of sight for efficient local-global message passing, and attention-guided dynamic rewiring that prunes weak edges and adds a bounded number of latent connections restricted to two-hop neighborhoods. This reduces the number of processed edges in deeper layers while preserving representation quality. On TruckScenes, DRaGAN improves test NDS by 10.10 points over the evaluated RadarGNN baseline and reduces the reported model FLOP count by 63.7%. This trade-off includes an increase in model latency from 40 to 53.16 ms and in trainable parameters from 1.2M to 1.7M on the evaluated implementations. Code and pretrained models are available at https://github.com/chr-is-tof/DRaGAN.

AI.tldr: 提出DRaGAN——面向多雷达点云的动态图注意力网络，通过传感器相对傅里叶编码、门控短/长程枢纽节点消息传递与注意力引导动态重连，在TruckScenes上较RadarGNN基线测试NDS提升10.10点、FLOPs降低63.7%，代价是时延由40 ms增至53.16 ms、参数量由1.2M增至1.7M。
AI.motivation: 雷达具备穿透雾、雨、雪的鲁棒感知能力，硬件分辨率持续提升，对自动驾驶日益重要。但原始雷达数据处理内存与计算开销大，现有工作多沿用面向LiDAR的点云编码器；而雷达点云稀疏且存在传感器相对的各向异性，使LiDAR导向的编码器并非最优。
AI.method: 构建动态图注意力网络DRaGAN：1）引入角度与距离的传感器相对傅里叶编码，刻画固定孔径雷达特性；2）沿各传感器视线设置门控的短程与长程枢纽节点，实现高效的局部—全局消息传递；3）注意力引导的动态重连，剪除弱边并在两跳邻域内添加有界数量的隐连接，从而在深层减少处理边数同时保持表示质量。
AI.result: 在TruckScenes数据集上，测试NDS较所评估的RadarGNN基线提升10.10点，报告的模型FLOPs降低63.7%；同时模型时延由40 ms升至53.16 ms，可训练参数由1.2M增至1.7M（基于所评估实现）。
AI.conclusion: DRaGAN通过传感器相对编码与动态图重连机制，在显著提升雷达点云检测精度（NDS）的同时大幅降低计算量（FLOPs），但以适度增加的时延与参数量为代价，为多雷达感知提供了面向雷达特性设计的专用图网络方案；代码与预训练模型已开源。

title: Region-VAD: Video Anomaly Localization and Detection via Region Selection
comment: This paper has been accepted in the RWS workshop at WACV 2027
summary: Anomalies are local events, yet weakly supervised video anomaly detection scores them globally. Most methods pool an entire frame into a single vector, rank frames by that vector, and derive a location afterwards as a saliency map of the score. Full-frame pooling mixes the anomaly with its background, so a detector can reach competitive benchmark scores from scene context without being able to show where in the scene the anomaly occurs. We introduce Region-VAD, which first selects a region and then detects the anomaly from that region alone. Region-VAD selects an explicit rectangle over the tokens of a frozen foundation model and scores anomalousness only from the tokens inside the box, through attention pooling followed by a standard temporal head. The rectangle is not learned, it is the box in which the frozen tokens change most between consecutive segments, in all four feature projections of the encoder, and it is found by exhaustive search over the rectangles of the token grid. Only the pooling and the temporal head are trained, from video-level labels without boxes, masks or frame-level annotations, and no trained component reads a token outside the selected region. Experiments on five datasets, with one localizer configuration shared by all datasets and backbones, show that Region-VAD achieves state-of-the-art anomaly localization on UCF-Crime and MSAD at competitive detection performance.

AI.tldr: Region-VAD：先在冻结基础模型token网格上搜索矩形区域，再仅用该区域内的token做异常打分，实现弱监督视频异常检测中的"先定位后打分"，在UCF-Crime与MSAD上取得SOTA定位性能。
AI.motivation: 现有弱监督视频异常检测方法将整帧池化为单一向量并据此排序打分，再事后以显著性图反推位置。全帧池化会把异常与背景混合，导致检测器仅凭场景上下文即可取得有竞争力的基准分数，却无法说明异常发生在场景何处。
AI.method: 在冻结基础模型的token网格上显式选择矩形区域：矩形不通过学习获得，而是在编码器四个特征投影下，于token网格上穷举搜索相邻片段间变化最大的矩形框；随后对框内token做注意力池化，再接入标准时序头得到异常分数。仅训练池化与时序头，监督来自视频级标签，不使用框、掩码或帧级标注，且没有任何可训练组件读取所选区域之外的token。
AI.result: 在五个数据集上，采用同一套定位器配置（跨所有数据集与骨干网络共享），Region-VAD在UCF-Crime和MSAD上取得SOTA异常定位性能，同时保持有竞争力的检测性能。
AI.conclusion: 将"先选区、后打分"的范式引入弱监督VAD，可在无框标注条件下解耦异常证据与背景上下文，从而兼顾检测与定位；单一配置的跨数据集泛化性表明该显式区域选择机制具有良好通用性。

title: How to Explain your Unexplainable Video Anomaly Detector
comment: This paper has been accepted at the RWS workshop WACV 2027
summary: Weakly-supervised Video Anomaly Detection (VAD) models assign anomaly scores from high-dimensional features, and their predictions remain unexplained. Saliency maps show where a model looks but not what it relies on, and the descriptions produced by Vision-Language Models (VLMs) are generated by branches that the anomaly score never reads. To address this faithfulness gap, we propose \textbf{Explain The Unexplainable (ETU)}, a classifier-agnostic framework that audits frozen VAD models through counterfactual interventions in their feature space. ETU maps video features to a discrete dependency graph of agents, actions and outcomes ($A_r \to A_a \to A_o$), regenerates the features by graph-conditioned diffusion with selected nodes of the graph masked, and measures the change in the score of a frozen detector; one set of interventions is applied unchanged to every detector. The generator is trained only to reconstruct the input features, so it cannot learn the contrast it is asked to measure, and we validate the audit with experiments that test every alternative explanation of its results, from the cost of regeneration to random deletions of matched size. On UCF-Crime features obtained from a CLIP encoder, we show that substituting the scene semantics results in the largest drop for most detectors, and that removing the outcome chain of the graph ($Δ_{rel}$) changes the anomaly score of all six audited detectors far more than removing the same number of random nodes, even though the random deletion perturbs the features about as much. We show that this targeted behavior comes from the divergence objective of the graph embedding. Without it, the two interventions become indistinguishable, and with a divergence objective in the generator as well, the score change of the detector follows the displacement of the reconstruction rather than the semantics that were removed.

AI.tldr: 提出ETU框架，通过特征空间中的反事实干预审计冻结的弱监督视频异常检测模型，用依赖图(A_r→A_a→A_o)+图条件扩散重建特征，揭示检测器依赖场景语义与结果链而非随机扰动。
AI.motivation: 弱监督VAD从高维特征打分，预测缺乏解释；显著性图只显示"看哪里"不显示"依赖什么"，VLM文本描述来自异常分数从不读取的分支，存在faithfulness gap。
AI.method: 分类器无关框架：将视频特征映射为agent/action/outcome离散依赖图，用图条件扩散在被掩码的图节点下重新生成特征，测量冻结检测器分数变化；同一组干预对全部检测器一致应用；生成器仅训练重建特征以保证无法学到所测对比。
AI.result: UCF-Crime+CLIP特征上，替换场景语义对多数检测器造成最大分数下降；移除结果链(Δ_rel)使六个审计检测器的分数变化远大于等量随机节点删除，尽管随机删除对特征扰动相当；该定向行为源自图嵌入的散度目标，去掉后两种干预不可区分，在生成器中加入散度目标则分数变化跟随重建位移而非被移除语义。
AI.conclusion: 检测器的异常判定依赖图结构语义而非特征位移幅度；图嵌入的散度目标可实现忠实、可审计的因果解释，且该校验排除了重建代价、随机删除等替代解释。

title: IGRecon4D: Dynamic-Object-Aware Feed-Forward Reconstruction of Driving Scenes
summary: Feed-forward 4D driving-scene reconstruction enables efficient modeling of dynamic autonomous-driving scenes, but current methods suffer from two complementary failure modes: semantic leakage of traffic participants into the static representation and geometric drift of Gaussian locations across viewpoints. We propose \textbf{IGRecon4D}, a feed-forward dynamic scene reconstruction framework that addresses these failures with training-time instance-prior distillation and LiDAR-anchored Gaussian positioning. Specifically, an instance-level semantic branch provides a potentially dynamic participant prior, which is distilled into dynamic-mask learning through the Instance-Dynamic Consistency Constraint to encourage high-recall localization of traffic-participant regions prone to dynamic-static leakage. In parallel, sparse LiDAR measurements guide dense depth estimation, and the resulting depths are back-projected to anchor Gaussian positions for improved multi-view geometric consistency. Experiments on the Waymo Open Dataset and zero-shot evaluation on nuScenes demonstrate improved full-image reconstruction on the main benchmark and stronger traffic-participant-region reconstruction under cross-dataset evaluation.

AI.tldr: 提出前馈式动态驾驶场景重建框架IGRecon4D，通过训练期实例先验蒸馏与LiDAR锚定高斯定位，缓解动态目标语义泄漏到静态表示与多视角高斯位置漂移两类问题。
AI.motivation: 现有前馈4D驾驶场景重建存在两类互补失效：交通参与者语义泄漏进静态表示（动静分离不清），以及高斯位置跨视角几何漂移。
AI.method: 1) 实例级语义分支提供潜在动态参与者先验，经Instance-Dynamic Consistency Constraint蒸馏到动态掩码学习，提升易泄漏区域的高召回定位；2) 稀疏LiDAR引导稠密深度估计，反投影深度以锚定高斯位置，提升多视角几何一致性。
AI.result: 在Waymo Open Dataset主基准上整图重建提升；在nuScenes零样本跨数据集评估中，交通参与者区域重建质量更强。
AI.conclusion: 实例先验蒸馏与LiDAR锚定定位可有效抑制动静语义泄漏与几何漂移，且具备跨数据集泛化能力。

title: CivilBench: Benchmarking Vision-Language Models for Multimodal Information Integration in Civil Engineering
summary: Artificial intelligence (AI), particularly large language models (LLMs) and vision-language models (VLMs), is increasingly applied in civil and structural engineering for disaster assessment, structural analysis, and engineering decision support. However, the extent to which current VLMs possess the reasoning capabilities required for reliable engineering judgments remains unclear. In this work, we introduce CivilBench, a comprehensive benchmark for evaluating VLMs in civil engineering and disaster-related scenarios. CivilBench covers three major task families: Sequential Reasoning, Image-based Structural Understanding, and Open-world Understanding, encompassing numerical reasoning, structural damage assessment, risk inference, causal analysis, and repair planning. The benchmark is constructed through a systematic pipeline of domain-specific data collection, engineering-oriented captioning, expert annotation, question design, and quality verification. Evaluation of representative state-of-the-art VLMs reveals substantial limitations in domain-specific reasoning, with Sequential Reasoning emerging as a major bottleneck, particularly when models must infer numerical relationships from sparse structured observations. Further experiments show that numerical priors and external knowledge can alleviate these limitations, although their effectiveness depends on the model's ability to reliably interpret and use the available evidence. CivilBench provides a capability-oriented testbed for identifying reasoning limitations and evaluating progress toward reliable AI-assisted engineering decision-making. The benchmark will be publicly available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/traceuryuan/CivilBench.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CivilBench，一个面向土木与结构工程及灾害场景的视觉语言模型（VLM）综合评测基准，揭示当前先进VLM在领域推理上的显著不足。
AI.motivation: LLM与VLM正被广泛用于灾害评估、结构分析与工程决策支持，但现有VLM是否具备可靠工程判断所需的推理能力尚不明确，缺少系统化的评估工具。
AI.method: 构建CivilBench基准，涵盖三大任务族：序贯推理、基于图像的结构理解、开放世界理解，涉及数值推理、结构损伤评估、风险推断、因果分析与修复规划；采用"领域数据收集—工程化描述生成—专家标注—问题设计—质量校验"的系统化流水线构建，并对代表性SOTA VLM进行评测，附加数值先验与外部知识注入实验。
AI.result: 当前先进VLM在领域特定推理上存在明显局限；序贯推理为最主要瓶颈，尤其当模型需从稀疏结构化观测中推断数值关系时；数值先验与外部知识可缓解部分局限，但其效果取决于模型可靠解读并利用现有证据的能力。
AI.conclusion: CivilBench提供了以能力为导向的测试平台，用于识别推理短板并追踪面向可靠AI辅助工程决策的研究进展；基准将公开于Hugging Face。

title: Beyond Family Labels: A Taxonomic Ornstein-Uhlenbeck Prior for Avian 3D Shape Recovery
summary: Recovering 3D pose and shape of birds from single images is bottlenecked by the long tail of avian diversity: out of ~10,000 species, only a few dozen have 3D-labeled training data, and in-the-wild test sets routinely contain species never seen at training. Generalizing across clades is therefore a central problem. The current state of the art, AniMer+, mitigates it with a family-level contrastive loss that conveys only a binary same-family indicator per pair and discards the continuous structure of the species tree. We propose a taxonomic Ornstein-Uhlenbeck prior on the shape code of the AVES parametric bird mesh model: a multivariate Gaussian whose covariance decays exponentially with Linnaean rank distance, with a learnable selection strength and noise scale. The prior generalizes family contrastive into a continuous, generative form, exposing the graded cross- and within-family similarity that a binary indicator cannot, and brings continuous comparative phylogenetics in as a biology-grounded inductive bias for the long tail. Our method improves over AniMer+ on both metrics of the unseen-species CowBird benchmark and on CtrlAVES3D, while remaining comparable on seen-species CUB. A permutation ablation isolates taxonomic structure from generic Gaussian smoothing, and a rank-granularity ablation identifies cross-order distinctions (the structure beyond a family-vs-not indicator) as the dominant source of the unseen-species gain.

AI.tldr: 该文提出在AVES参数化鸟类网格模型的形状码上施加分类学Ornstein-Uhlenbeck先验，以连续协方差结构替代AniMer+的二元同科对比损失，从而提升单图鸟类3D姿态与形状估计的跨类群泛化。
AI.motivation: 鸟类约1万种中仅数十种有3D标注训练数据，野外测试集常含训练未见物种，长尾与跨进化支泛化是核心难题；现有SOTA AniMer+仅用家族级对比损失提供二元同科指示，丢弃了物种树的连续结构信息。
AI.method: 在AVES参数化鸟类网格的形状码上构建分类学Ornstein-Uhlenbeck先验：以Linnaean阶元距离指数衰减的协方差构造多元高斯，选择强度与噪声尺度均可学习；该先验将家族对比推广为连续生成式形式，显式表达跨科与科内的分级相似性，作为基于生物学的归纳偏置引入比较系统发育学信息。
AI.result: 在未见物种基准CowBird的两项指标及CtrlAVES3D上均优于AniMer+，在已见物种CUB上表现相当；置换消融区分了分类学结构与通用高斯平滑的作用，阶元粒度消融表明跨目差异（超越同科/非同科指示的结构）是未见物种性能提升的主要来源。
AI.conclusion: 以连续系统发育先验替代二元对比损失可有效缓解鸟类3D重建的长尾泛化瓶颈，且增益主要来自更细阶元（跨目）的分类学结构信息。

title: MovieRoll: A Systematic Framework for Rolling Out Long-Form Videos
summary: Streaming video generation must sustain quality beyond the training horizon while handling self-generated history and growing cache costs. To address these challenges, we present MovieRoll, a base-to-distilled framework that connects streaming fine-tuning, long-rollout distillation, and long-horizon inference. We first establish a robust multi-step base through Window-wise Teacher Forcing (WinTF), which jointly denoises chunks at progressive noise levels with bidirectional attention within each window and causal access to preceding history. To retain historical context efficiently, hierarchical KV-cache compression (HieraKV) exploits layer-wise attention patterns, retaining full history in shallow layers and sink--recent history in deeper layers. This reduces cache memory by up to 78% while improving generation quality. Building on this base, cumulative long tuning with distribution matching distillation (CuLT-DMD) holds parameters fixed throughout each long self-rollout and averages local gradients before updating. Each update therefore combines supervision across temporal positions while retaining only one local computation graph, enabling efficient long-rollout training of a few-step generator. To extend generation beyond the training horizon, KV recomputation bounds context for both models, while guidance annealing (AnnealCFG) reduces guidance toward the clean endpoint to stabilize MovieRoll-Base. Complementing these modeling advances, FBCA attention and PS-VAE decoding support efficient training and streaming output. On HeliosBench, MovieRoll-Base remains competitive at 30s after training on videos of up to 15s, and MovieRoll-Distilled achieves the highest total scores among the compared methods across single- and multi-event evaluations up to 60s, combining sustained naturalness with active motion.

AI.tldr: 提出MovieRoll基座-蒸馏框架，结合流式微调、长rollout蒸馏与长时域推理，实现超越训练时长的流式视频生成。
AI.motivation: 流式视频生成需在训练时域之外保持质量，同时处理自生成历史与不断增长的缓存开销。
AI.method: 1) Window-wise Teacher Forcing (WinTF)：在渐进噪声水平联合去噪chunk，窗口内双向注意力、对历史因果访问，建立多步基座；2) HieraKV：按层注意力模式分层压缩KV缓存，浅层保留完整历史、深层保留sink-recent历史；3) CuLT-DMD：每次长自rollout中固定参数，平均局部梯度后更新，仅保留单个计算图；4) KV重计算限定上下文 + 引导退火AnnealCFG稳定基座；辅以FBCA注意力与PS-VAE解码支持高效训练与流式输出。
AI.result: HieraKV减少缓存最多78%且提升质量；MovieRoll-Base仅在≤15s视频训练，在HeliosBench 30s仍具竞争力；MovieRoll-Distilled在至60s的单/多事件评测中总分最高，兼具持续自然性与活跃运动。
AI.conclusion: 基座-蒸馏一体化设计可有效延长流式视频生成长度，兼顾质量、运动性与缓存效率。

title: VA-Assembly: View-Aligned Score Guidance for Training-Free 3D Part Assembly
summary: Image-to-3D foundation models have improved 3D reconstruction, but typically produce monolithic representations without explicit part-level structure. Part-aware generation and learning-based assembly methods often require part-level supervision, category-specific priors, or paired part-layout training data. We instead consider a practical but underexplored setting in which independently prepared or generated 3D parts have no predefined inter-part relationships, shared coordinate frames, or consistent scales, and must be assembled into a reference-consistent object from a single image. We present VA-Assembly, a training-free framework for 3D part assembly through part-level transformation estimation using view-aligned diffusion guidance. Given a reference image and fixed 3D part geometries, VA-Assembly optimizes each part's translation, rotation, and scale. We condition a frozen view-conditioned diffusion model on same-view renderings of a reference-derived monolithic 3D representation, producing score gradients geometrically aligned with the part configuration. This guidance provides multi-view structural cues under large initial misalignment. By repurposing pretrained visual-structural priors as transformation-level supervision, VA-Assembly requires no annotated part layouts, predefined part taxonomies, category-specific assembly training, or bounding-box-based layout initialization. Experiments compare VA-Assembly with geometric registration and compositional layout baselines using each baseline's supported transformation components, showing improved part-wise transformation estimation. Ablation studies show that view-aligned conditioning, rather than diffusion guidance alone, is critical for reliable transformation gradients. Updating only part transformations preserves explicit component separability and supports component-level editing, replacement, and reconfiguration.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练框架 VA-Assembly，利用视角对齐的扩散引导估计各3D部件的平移、旋转与尺度，在无部件级监督、无共享坐标系/尺度的条件下从单张参考图装配独立部件。
AI.motivation: 现有图像到3D基础模型输出整体化表示、缺乏显式部件结构；部件感知生成与学习式装配依赖部件级监督、类别先验或成对部件-布局训练数据。论文关注一个实用但少被研究的设定：独立准备或生成的3D部件之间无预定义相互关系、无共享坐标系、尺度不一致，需要仅凭单张图像装配成与参考一致的对象。
AI.method: VA-Assembly 为免训练框架，输入参考图与固定几何的3D部件，优化每个部件的平移、旋转、尺度。核心是以参考图导出的整体化3D表示在同一视角下的渲染作为条件，驱动冻结的视角条件扩散模型，产生与部件构型几何对齐的分数梯度，从而在大初始错位下提供多视图结构线索。方法将预训练视觉-结构先验复用为变换级监督，无需标注部件布局、预定义部件分类体系、类别特定装配训练或基于边界框的布局初始化。
AI.result: 与几何配准、组合式布局基线（按其支持的变换分量比较）相比，VA-Assembly 在部件级变换估计上取得提升；消融表明视角对齐的条件化（而非单独的扩散引导）是获得可靠变换梯度的关键；仅更新部件变换保持了显式部件可分性，支持部件级编辑、替换与重构。
AI.conclusion: VA-Assembly 证明可将预训练扩散模型的视觉-结构先验用作部件级变换监督，实现未标定、免训练的3D部件装配，并保留显式部件结构以便下游操作。

title: Deep Learning for Satellite-Based Mountain Hazard Screening: A Retrospective Failure Analysis on the 2021 Chamoli Rock-Ice Avalanche
summary: The approach utilizes 10 bands from Sentinel-2 imagery, along with terrain information, in a deep learning pipeline to classify potential hazard sources in any given mountainous region. The performance of our model has been evaluated against the data collected during the rock-ice avalanche event in the Chamoli region in the Indian Himalayas on 7th February 2021. U-Net performs segmentation of the detected land surface in the satellite image, detects changes in the identify candidate hazard zones, and then the following steps are performed to calculate the potential energy using the Monte Carlo sampling for steepest descent (D8) flow paths, finding the exposed structures in the downstream locations, and ranking the zones depending on the risk score. In comparison to the simple spectral rule, our approach achieved the higher macro F1 score of 0.648 (as compared to 0.519). But the F1 score in case of rock and soil was low, being in the range of 0.3s. In case of optical change detection in winter, it's only that northeast-facing slope which couldn't be detected, as it was under 73% of shade prior to the incident. The parameters have been set for this particular scene alone and not independently; hence, this is a retrospective test, and this test locates a failure which has occurred earlier. The primary contribution of this paper is locating the pipeline leak.

AI.tldr: 提出融合Sentinel-2十波段与地形信息的深度学习管线，用于山区潜在灾害源分类，并在2021年2月7日印度喜马拉雅Chamoli岩冰雪崩事件数据上验证。
AI.motivation: 山区潜在灾害源识别困难，需借助卫星遥感与深度学习实现自动化分类与风险排序，以减少下游承灾体的暴露风险。
AI.method: 以Sentinel-2十波段加地形信息为输入，采用U-Net对地表分割并检测变化以识别候选灾害区；随后基于蒙特卡洛采样沿D8最陡下降流路计算势能，识别下游暴露结构，并按风险评分对区域排序；与简单光谱规则方法对比。
AI.result: 宏观F1为0.648，优于简单光谱规则的0.519；但岩石与土壤类别F1偏低，约0.3量级；冬季光学变化检测中仅东北朝向坡面未被检出，因其在事件前处于73%阴影下。
AI.conclusion: 参数仅针对该单一场景设定、非独立标定，属回溯性测试，仅能定位已发生过的失效；论文主要贡献在于揭示并定位管线中的漏检环节。

title: ScoutCache: Efficient Few-Step Autoregressive Video Diffusion via Conditional Readout and Selective Caching
summary: Few-step autoregressive video diffusion enables efficient long video generation, but inference still incurs substantial computational costs from repeated denoising and KV cache operations. Existing acceleration methods reduce parts of this overhead, while historical KV reading and cache construction remain costly across video chunks. To address these challenges, we propose ScoutCache, a training-free framework that jointly optimizes denoising, historical KV reading, and cache construction. We observe that shallow feature changes provide useful information for estimating clean latent updates, while historical KV dependence varies across Transformer layers and attention heads but remains relatively stable across video chunks. Based on these observations, we develop Conditional Denoising Readout (CDR) to estimate intermediate denoising updates from shallow feature changes and known noise variations. We further introduce Output Risk Guided Historical KV Reading (ORHR) to allocate historical reading budgets based on attention output perturbations, and Content and Coverage Guided Sparse Cache Construction (CCSC) to reduce cache construction costs by selecting informative spatial tokens while maintaining spatial coverage. Extensive experiments on Self-Forcing and LongLive using VBench and MovieGen demonstrate that ScoutCache achieves up to 2.28$\times$ and 1.86$\times$ speedups, respectively, while consistently improving generation quality without modifying pretrained model parameters.

AI.tldr: ScoutCache：一种免训练框架，联合优化去噪、历史KV读取与缓存构建，在长视频自回归扩散上实现最高2.28×/1.86×加速且提升画质。
AI.motivation: 少步自回归视频扩散虽支持高效长视频生成，但推理中重复去噪与KV缓存操作代价高昂；现有加速方法仅降低部分开销，跨视频块的历史KV读取与缓存构建依然昂贵。观察到浅层特征变化可用于估计干净潜变量更新，且历史KV依赖在层与注意力头间有差异但在视频块间相对稳定。
AI.method: 提出免训练框架ScoutCache，含三部分：条件去噪读出（CDR），由浅层特征变化与已知噪声变化估计中间去噪更新；输出风险引导的历史KV读取（ORHR），按注意力输出扰动分配历史读取预算；内容与覆盖引导的稀疏缓存构建（CCSC），选取信息量高的空间token并保持空间覆盖以降低缓存构建成本。
AI.result: 在Self-Forcing与LongLive上基于VBench和MovieGen的广泛实验表明，分别取得最高2.28×和1.86×加速，同时持续提升生成质量，且不修改预训练模型参数。
AI.conclusion: 通过联合优化去噪、历史KV读取与缓存构建，ScoutCache在免训练条件下实现显著加速与质量提升，验证了基于浅层特征与风险引导的稀疏化策略在长视频生成推理中的有效性。

title: vividRGB: Various visual cue detection in RGB photographs with forced focused attention
comment: 32 pages including supplementary material; 6 numbered figures and a graphical summary
summary: Natural photographs contain dense, overlapping structures that can be weakly expressed in feature maps from whole-image vision encoders. We introduce forced focused attention (FFA) and its Python implementation, vividRGB. FFA is an encoder-agnostic inference-time procedure that applies a frozen encoder to enlarged, overlapping local crops, averages inverse-aligned reflections, and reconstructs a feature field in source coordinates. We evaluate 50 high-resolution photographs from grassland vegetation, fungal networks, airborne forests, coral reefs, and phytoplankton microscopy, using DINOv3 ViT-B/16. Across the five domains, FFA at 5% or 10% focus produces higher mean RGB-edge boundary F1 than direct DINOv3 encoding and automatic SAM3 masks. Domain means range from 0.244 to 0.596 for FFA, versus 0.028-0.076 for direct DINOv3 and 0.020-0.090 for SAM3. Qualitative feature maps also show finer appearance structure. These results concern RGB-edge preservation rather than verified species, traits, or biological segmentation. Narrower focus generally improves boundary preservation, while extraction time and GPU energy use increase sharply and gains diminish at finer settings. FFA may be useful for relatively small, high-resolution ecological image collections where dense visual cues matter. The alpha release vividRGB 0.1.0 and versioned research resources support reproducible cue inspection.

AI.tldr: 论文提出FFA（forced focused attention）及其Python实现vividRGB：一种与编码器无关的推理期方法，通过对放大、重叠的局部裁剪应用冻结编码器，平均逆对齐后的反射并重建源坐标下的特征场，以保留自然影像中密集重叠结构的细节。
AI.motivation: 自然照片包含密集、重叠的结构，而整图视觉编码器（如DINOv3）的特征图对这些结构表达较弱，导致细粒度外观线索丢失。
AI.method: FFA为编码器无关的推理期流程：将输入图像切分为放大、重叠的局部裁剪，分别输入冻结编码器，对反射变换的结果做逆对齐后平均，再在源坐标中重建特征场；实现为Python包vividRGB 0.1.0，并提供带版本的研究资源。实验使用DINOv3 ViT-B/16，覆盖草地植被、真菌网络、空中森林、珊瑚礁与浮游植物显微五类共50张高分辨率照片，评价指标为RGB边缘边界F1。
AI.result: 在5%或10%聚焦设置下，FFA的平均RGB边缘边界F1各域均值为0.244–0.596，显著高于直接DINOv3编码（0.028–0.076）与自动SAM3掩码（0.020–0.090）；定性特征图亦呈现更精细的外观结构。但该结果仅反映RGB边缘保持，不代表物种、性状或生物分割的验证；聚焦越窄边界保持一般越好，同时提取时间与GPU能耗急剧上升，收益在更细设置下递减。
AI.conclusion: FFA适用于规模较小、分辨率较高且依赖密集视觉线索的生态影像集合，可在推理期以低成本集成方式增强特征细节；vividRGB alpha版本支持可复现的线索检查，但需权衡计算与能耗开销，且其结论限于RGB边缘层面。

title: Palmprint Decomposer: Interpretable and Editable Factorization via Synthetic Learning and Instance-Wise Refinement
summary: Palmprint recognition and synthesis methods focus on extracting discriminative textures or generating images with varied textures and appearances. However, they do not generally provide an explicit image-level representation that separates palmprint texture from its underlying base appearance for independent analysis or controlled editing. We introduce Palmprint Decomposer, an interpretable framework that represents a palmprint through independently editable factors and reconstructs the image through a multiplicative composition model. A color map and a light map characterize the base appearance, while a structure map and a global texture strength parameter describe texture modulation. However, accurate reconstruction alone does not guarantee separation of palmprint texture from base appearance, as fine palmprint textures may leak into the estimated base appearance. To mitigate this ambiguity, we train the decomposer exclusively on synthetic data with direct factor supervision, using asymmetric decoding paths and decomposition constraints to suppress texture leakage. Instance-Wise Refinement further improves real-image reconstruction by directly optimizing the predicted factors for each input without relying on the trained network. Experiments across seven datasets demonstrate high reconstruction fidelity, with the extracted structure maps generally achieving verification performance comparable to the original images. Compared with existing methods, our approach achieves better factor separation while preserving more discriminative palmprint texture information.

AI.tldr: 提出可解释的掌纹分解框架 Palmprint Decomposer，用四个可独立编辑的因子（颜色图、光照图、结构图、全局纹理强度）经乘性合成重建掌纹图像，并通过合成数据监督、非对称解码与分解约束抑制纹理泄漏。
AI.motivation: 现有掌纹识别与合成方法只关注提取判别性纹理或生成多样外观图像，缺乏显式的图像级表示来分离掌纹纹理与底层基础外观，因而无法对二者独立分析或受控编辑。
AI.method: 采用乘性组合模型：颜色图与光照图刻画基础外观，结构图与全局纹理强度参数描述纹理调制；仅在带直接因子监督的合成数据上训练，配合非对称解码路径与分解约束抑制细纹理泄漏到基础外观；并用 Instance-Wise Refinement 直接优化单张输入的预测因子以提升真实图像重建。
AI.result: 在七个数据集上取得高重建保真度，提取的结构图在验证任务上性能总体与原图相当；相较现有方法，因子分离更优且保留更多判别性掌纹纹理信息。
AI.conclusion: 显式因子分解可同时实现高保真重建与纹理—外观分离，但仅靠重建精度不足以保证分离性，需依赖合成监督与分解约束；该框架为掌纹的独立分析与受控编辑提供了可解释基础。

title: Can Image Generators Hold a Scene Together When Space Is Broken Apart?
summary: Image generators are good at drawing scenes in which things that belong together appear next to each other. In almost every image they generate, and in almost every benchmark used to evaluate these images, "belonging to the same whole" and "adjacent to each other" go together. Therefore, we cannot know whether the model truly grasps the scene as a whole, or simply makes each part connect with its adjacent parts. We propose GJBench to disentangle the two. It requires the model to draw a scene as a scattered jigsaw puzzle: an image is cut into interlocking pieces, then moved apart and rotated. Thus, the spatial plausibility of the scene exists only in how these pieces collectively point to a whole. The model may have a reference image, a target layout, both, or neither. We separately evaluate three requirements: whether the scene is broken down into a specified number of separate pieces, whether the pieces interlock, and whether the pieces can reconstruct the reference scene. While every open and closed model we evaluated could draw these scenes well as a whole, none could keep them together as scattered puzzle pieces, and the three requirements categorized failures into different patterns. The models draw separate pieces but miscount them in different ways, and unless their outlines are provided, the pieces rarely interlock, and their content does not reconstruct the reference image. We also found that the target layout helps the puzzle pieces fit together, while the reference image improves neither their count nor their fit. These findings show that keeping a scene continuous across space that the canvas no longer shows remains an open problem for image generators.

AI.tldr: 论文提出GJBench基准，将"整体场景理解"与"局部相邻拼接"解耦，要求模型把场景画成散落且旋转的拼图碎片，发现所有开放与闭源模型均无法胜任。
AI.motivation: 现有图像生成基准中"属于同一整体"与"彼此相邻"总是同时出现，因此无法判断模型是真正把握了场景整体，还是仅将各部分与相邻部分连接起来。为区分这两种能力，需要一个将二者解耦的评测任务。
AI.method: 提出GJBench：把图像切成相互咬合的拼图块，再将其分离并旋转，使场景的空间合理性只体现在碎片共同指向的完整场景上。设置参考图像、目标布局、两者兼有或均无四种条件，并分别评估三项要求——是否拆分为指定数量的独立碎片、碎片是否咬合、碎片能否重建参考场景。
AI.result: 所有被评测的开放与闭源模型都能把场景画好，但都无法将其保持为散落的拼图碎片；三项要求将失败归类为不同模式：模型能画出独立碎片但计数方式各异，除非提供轮廓否则碎片很少咬合，且其内容无法重建参考图像。目标布局有助于碎片咬合，而参考图像对碎片计数与咬合均无改善。
AI.conclusion: 在画布不再呈现的空间中保持场景的连续性，仍是图像生成器尚未解决的开放问题；GJBench为解耦"整体理解"与"相邻拼接"提供了有效评测框架。

title: Multi-Rate Flow Matching for Point Cloud Upsampling
summary: Flow-matching point-cloud upsamplers refine sparse inputs into dense point clouds by integrating a learned velocity field with a fixed temporal discretization. However, local reconstruction requirements vary substantially across a shape, while a shared solver budget applies the same temporal resolution everywhere. We propose Multi-Rate Flow Matching (MRFM), a patch-adaptive framework that selects an integration budget for each local patch at inference time while keeping the learned velocity field frozen. MRFM relaxes the discrete budget into a continuous variable, optimizes it online through differentiable soft rollouts using an input-derived geometric fidelity objective, and projects the result back to a discrete budget for the final solver rollout. Experiments on PU1K and PUGAN show strong reconstruction quality, while matched-budget permutation and multi-factor analyses demonstrate that the benefit depends on patch-specific allocation rather than on the step distribution alone. MRFM is accuracy-oriented and intentionally uses additional test-time optimization to obtain more suitable local temporal resolutions.

AI.tldr: 提出多速率流匹配（MRFM），在推理时为每个局部patch自适应选择积分预算，实现点云上采样。
