AI.motivation: 流匹配点云上采样器使用固定时间离散化，对整个形状施加统一的时间分辨率；但局部重建需求在形状各处差异显著，共享求解预算不合理。
AI.method: MRFM是一种patch自适应框架，在推理时冻结已学习的速度场，为每个局部patch选择积分预算。将离散预算松弛为连续变量，通过可微soft rollout并基于输入导出的几何保真度目标进行在线优化，最后投影回离散预算用于最终求解器rollout。
AI.result: 在PU1K和PUGAN上取得强重建质量；匹配预算的置换实验与多因素分析表明，收益来自patch特定分配而非单纯的步数分布。
AI.conclusion: MRFM以精度为导向，有意使用额外测试时优化来获得更合适的局部时间分辨率。

title: MVSTF: Multi-View Spatio-Temporal Fusion for LiDAR-Based Moving Object Segmentation
summary: Autonomous mobile robots confront significant chal lenges in recognizing the motion properties of objects in dy namic environments. However, existing methods are hindered by limitations such as boundary ambiguity, occlusion, viewpoint constraints, and training complexity. In this paper, we propose an innovative end-to-end Multi-View Spatio-Temporal Fusion network, named MVSTF, which utilizes sequential point clouds to generate multi-view images and feature differences, and designs a multi-branch network to extract spatio-temporal and dimen sional features in parallel, and realizes high-precision moving object segmentation. First, sequential point clouds are utilized to generate multi-view images and feature differences. Then, an end-to-end multi-branch network including Dual Down-sampling Blocks (DDB), Spatial Attention Blocks (SAB), Multi-Kernel Convolutional Neural Network blocks (MKCNN), Dual Feature Fusion Blocks (DFFB), and the Point Fusion (PF) module, is designed to extract motion features from feature differences and geometric and semantic features from multi-view images. Finally, an auxiliary semantic head is introduced to further improve the algorithm's robustness and the model's interpretability. This work is validated on the SemanticKITTI and KITTI-Road bench marks, achieving state-of-the-art results on the SemanticKITTI MOS validation set and the KITTI-Road validation set, and competitive results on the hidden SemanticKITTI-MOS test set. The code is available at https://github.com/ZhouJJ111/MVSTF.

AI.tldr: 本文提出端到端的MVSTF网络，利用序列点云生成多视角图像与特征差异，通过多分支网络并行提取时空与维度特征，实现高精度运动目标分割，在SemanticKITTI与KITTI-Road上取得领先结果。
AI.motivation: 自主移动机器人在动态环境中识别物体运动属性面临挑战，现有方法受限于边界模糊、遮挡、视角约束及训练复杂度高等问题。
AI.method: 先用序列点云生成多视角图像和特征差异；再构建含双下采样块(DDB)、空间注意力块(SAB)、多核卷积块(MKCNN)、双特征融合块(DFFB)与点融合(PF)模块的端到端多分支网络，从特征差异中提取运动特征、从多视角图像中提取几何与语义特征；最后引入辅助语义头提升鲁棒性与可解释性。
AI.result: 在SemanticKITTI MOS验证集与KITTI-Road验证集取得state-of-the-art结果，在隐藏的SemanticKITTI-MOS测试集上取得有竞争力的结果。
AI.conclusion: MVSTF通过多视角时空融合有效缓解边界模糊、遮挡与视角约束问题，实现高精度运动目标分割，代码已开源。

title: How VLMs Plan What's Next
summary: When a vision-language model describes an image, it names one object at a time and it rarely repeats itself, yet how the model plans this order is far from obvious. We characterize the mechanism a VLM uses to decide where to look before it looks. The mechanism has four main parts. First, binding heads match the relevant text tokens against the image and resolve them into pointers to the matched image region. Second, the same binding heads bind each written answer to the region it came from, and the model turns it into a progress signal: a cursor, the position in the image up to which the list has been written. Third, a select step chooses the nearest unwritten region after the cursor, or stops. Finally, gaze heads execute the chosen pointer and return a concept of what is drawn there, which language heads and the late MLPs turn into a word in the language of the question. We validate each part of this mechanism through causal patching in Qwen3-VL models on a synthetic visual retrieval task, and test our mechanisms against alternative hypotheses. We further show that the mechanism holds across input formats, natural photographs, and languages, and that its binding, relay, and gaze heads appear at every model size from 2B to 32B. This work allows us to investigate how a VLM turns a question and an image into a sequence of answers, layer by layer and token by token. More broadly, it opens a way to study how models plan over complex multi-step tasks with long rollouts. Our project is available at https://plan.baulab.info/

AI.tldr: 该论文揭示了视觉语言模型在描述图像前如何规划"看哪里"的机制：由绑定头、进度游标、选择步骤与注视头组成四段式流水线，并通过因果干预验证其跨格式、跨语种、跨模型规模（2B–32B）的普适性。
AI.motivation: VLM在描述图像时逐个命名物体且很少重复，但其如何规划这一输出顺序（即"看之前先决定看哪里"）的内部机制尚不清楚。作者希望逐层、逐token地解析这一多步规划过程，并为进一步研究模型在长程多步任务中的规划能力提供方法。
AI.method: 通过机制可解释性分析提出四部分机制：(1) binding heads 将相关文本token与图像匹配并解析为指向图像区域的指针；(2) 同一绑定头将已生成的答案绑定回其来源区域，形成进度信号——游标（cursor），即列表已写到图像中的哪个位置；(3) select步骤选取游标之后最近的未书写区域，或选择停止；(4) gaze heads 执行所选指针并返回该处概念，再由语言头与后段MLP转为问题语言中的词。使用合成视觉检索任务，在Qwen3-VL上通过因果patching逐部件验证，并与替代假设对比。
AI.result: 因果patching验证了各部件的作用；该机制在不同输入格式、自然照片与多语言下均成立；binding、relay与gaze头在2B至32B各模型规模中均出现。
AI.conclusion: VLM将问题与图像转化为答案序列的过程可被分解为可定位的注意力头与计算步骤，从而支持逐层、逐token的机制研究，并为理解模型在复杂多步任务与长rollout中的规划提供途径。

title: Wildfire-SSR: Geolocation-Aware Multimodal Fusion for Structure-Level Wildfire Risk Assessment
summary: Structure-level wildfire vulnerability assessment is critical for reducing losses in wildland-urban interface communities, yet existing methods often fail to combine parcel-scale ignition pathways with community-scale geographic coverage. This study introduces Wildfire-SSR (Satellite and Street-view for wildfire Risk), a geolocation-aware multimodal framework that integrates macro-scale satellite context with micro-scale street-view evidence. A Vision-Language Model extracts wildfire-relevant building and site attributes from pre-event street-view panoramas and converts them into structured semantic text. These features are spatially aligned with satellite imagery through a decoupled cross-attention fusion decoder, while a frozen satellite-pretrained DINOv3 encoder captures overhead visual context. Alternative geolocation embedding strategies are evaluated to anchor text-derived features within each satellite patch. The framework is tested on approximately 37,000 structures affected by the 2025 Eaton and Palisades fires in Los Angeles, using wildfire risk labels derived from relative post-event damage patterns to better represent inherent structural vulnerability. Rotary Positional Embedding provides the strongest spatial grounding, achieving a building localization F1 score of 0.6735 and a harmonic mean F1 score of 0.2476 for five-class pixel-level risk classification, outperforming unimodal baselines and an unanchored multimodal configuration. The model also shows a conservative bias in higher-risk classes, reducing severe-risk underestimation, and completes end-to-end assessment of the study area in 37 minutes on a single GPU. Wildfire-SSR reframes cross-view fusion as localized semantic alignment and provides a scalable tool for mitigation prioritization, resilience planning, and insurance-oriented wildfire risk assessment.

AI.tldr: 提出Wildfire-SSR多模态框架，融合卫星宏观上下文与街景微观证据，通过解耦交叉注意力对齐并评估地理位置嵌入策略，在2025年洛杉矶Eaton与Palisades火灾约3.7万栋建筑上实现建筑级野火脆弱性评估。
AI.motivation: 现有建筑尺度的野火脆弱性评估方法难以同时兼顾地块级点火路径（微观）与社区级地理覆盖（宏观），即单一视角数据无法兼具细粒度属性与广域空间上下文。
AI.method: 1) 用视觉语言模型从灾前街景全景图中提取野火相关的建筑与场地属性，转为结构化语义文本；2) 用冻结的卫星预训练DINOv3编码器提取俯视视觉上下文；3) 通过解耦交叉注意力融合解码器实现文本特征与卫星影像的空间对齐；4) 比较多种地理位置嵌入策略以锚定文本派生特征；5) 以灾后相对损毁模式推导的野火风险标签作为内在脆弱性监督。
AI.result: 旋转位置编码（RoPE）空间锚定效果最佳：建筑定位F1为0.6735，五类像素级风险分类调和平均F1为0.2476，优于单模态基线与未锚定多模态配置；模型对高风险类别呈保守偏置，降低严重风险低估；单GPU端到端评估研究区耗时37分钟。
AI.conclusion: Wildfire-SSR将跨视角融合重构为局部化语义对齐，为减灾优先级排序、韧性规划与保险导向的野火风险评估提供可扩展工具。

title: LynnReal-Hand: Unlocking World Interaction with Hand Control
summary: Interactive video world models enable exploration through text and camera controls, yet direct object interaction requires finer control. Hands provide a natural interface, but translating continuous hand movements into coherent visual responses remains challenging because of complex hand-object dynamics and demanding real-time computation. To address these challenges, we introduce LynnReal-Hand, a hand-controlled video world model that unifies precise interaction modeling with efficient streaming generation. We curate 100K interaction clips spanning diverse real and synthetic environments and develop hand-aware supervision to improve fine-grained hand motions and object interactions. Building on this foundation, we learn a causal flow map for few-step generation and introduce region-aware score distillation that combines complementary video and image priors to refine interaction dynamics and visual appearance. To further reduce inference latency, we propose Ultra-Fast-VAE, a compact video decoder that preserves high reconstruction fidelity with substantially lower computational cost. Extensive evaluations on HandBench demonstrate superior hand-following accuracy and visual quality compared with existing approaches. Our full-sequence model achieves an FVD of 181.67 and a MANO Dice score of 93.02, while the three-step causal model maintains a MANO Dice score of 92.49. For real-time interaction, 540p streaming on a single H200 reaches 18.03 FPS with 741ms latency and an optimized peak GPU memory footprint of only 34.89GB. We will release the datasets, model weights, and the full training and inference code to support research on hand-controlled video world models.

AI.tldr: LynnReal-Hand：手控视频世界模型，融合精细交互建模与高效流式生成，540p 单卡 H200 达 18.03 FPS、741ms 延迟。
AI.motivation: 现有交互式视频世界模型仅支持文本与相机控制，直接物体交互需要更细粒度控制；手是自然接口，但连续手部动作到连贯视觉响应的映射受复杂手-物动力学与实时算力约束。
AI.method: 构建 100K 真实与合成交互片段数据集并设计手感知监督；学习因果 flow map 实现少步生成；提出区域感知分数蒸馏，融合视频与图像先验优化交互动态与外观；提出紧凑视频解码器 Ultra-Fast-VAE 降低计算开销。
AI.result: HandBench 上全序列模型 FVD 181.67、MANO Dice 93.02；三步因果模型 MANO Dice 92.49；540p 流式生成单 H200 达 18.03 FPS、741ms 延迟、峰值显存 34.89GB。
AI.conclusion: 实现了高精度手跟随与实时流式生成的统一，显著优于现有方法；将开源数据、权重与训练推理代码。

title: Balanced Twin Weight Factorization for Efficient MLLMs
summary: Weight Factorization (WF) methods aim to reduce a model's latency, memory, or both. These typically decompose a pretrained model into two or more factors that approximate the original model weights with fewer parameters and floating point operations (FLOPs). However, translating fewer FLOPs into reduced latency is challenging for WF methods in practice due to overhead introduced by replacing a single large weight matrix with multiple smaller ones. To address this, we propose Balanced Twin Weight Factorization (BTWF), which uses the unique structure of factorized models to simultaneously lower latency and increase learning capacity. Specifically, BTWF operates in the shared basis WF setting, where two or more layers are decomposed into a shared basis matrix and a layer-specific mixing matrix. If these shared layers have the same input (i.e., are twins), then we need only perform this shared forward pass once, reducing inference time. However, twin layers are often of varying sizes, and methods from prior work tend to favor the larger layer. In contrast, our approach boosts performance by combining Factor Component Balancing (FCB), which ensures every shared member is well represented in the selected factors, with Block Contribution Balancing (BCB), which considers downstream model effects. Further, we also show that an overparameterized BTWF, where some layer's factors result in higher FLOPs than the original during training, can boost task performance without additional resources at test time. Experiments on six models over nine benchmarks show BTWF obtains a 2-6% gain over the state-of-the-art without expensive finetuning (1-3.5% gain with it) at comparable computational costs.

AI.tldr: 提出 Balanced Twin Weight Factorization (BTWF)，利用共享基分解下同输入“孪生层”只做一次共享前向以降低延迟，并通过 FCB/BCB 与过参数化训练提升性能。
AI.motivation: 权重分解(WF)虽能减少参数量与FLOPs，但因用多个小矩阵替换单个大矩阵带来额外开销，难以真正转化为延迟下降；同时共享基分解中尺寸不一的孪生层常偏向大层，导致小层表示不足。
AI.method: 在 shared basis WF 设定下，将两个或多个层分解为共享基矩阵与层专属混合矩阵；对输入相同的孪生层只执行一次共享前向pass以降低推理时间。并引入 Factor Component Balancing (FCB) 保证每个共享成员在选定因子中得到充分表示，Block Contribution Balancing (BCB) 考虑下游模块影响；还展示训练期允许某些层因子FLOPs高于原模型的过参数化 BTWF，在不增加测试开销下提升任务性能。
AI.result: 在九个基准、六个模型上，BTWF 在相当计算成本下较 SOTA 取得 2-6% 提升（无需昂贵微调），若进行微调则提升 1-3.5%。
AI.conclusion: BTWF 通过复用孪生层的共享前向同时实现延迟下降与学习容量提升，配合 FCB/BCB 平衡各共享层贡献，并在训练期过参数化中获益而不增加测试成本。

title: Out of Sight, Into Memory: Compact Visual Latents Retain Local Evidence in Ultra-High-Resolution Remote Sensing
summary: Question answering over ultra-high-resolution (UHR) remote sensing scenes poses a tension for multimodal large language models: global overviews obscure small objects and local attributes, whereas detailed crops consume substantial context. Compressing inspected crops into short sequences of continuous visual latents offers a compact memory once crop tokens are discarded, yet diagnostic studies on natural images find that models often ignore latent content, leaving unclear whether compact latents can retain fine-grained targets lost in downsampled UHR remote sensing scenes. To isolate evidence retention from region selection, we encode high-resolution crops into latent memory tokens for frozen backbones and evaluate both their predictive utility and content dependence. Across two generations of Qwen-VL on LRS-GRO, a 64-token memory achieves 7.6- to 9.9-fold compression of retained crop tokens and improves accuracy by 2.5 to 4.8 percentage points over the downsampled global image alone, recovering most of the high-resolution crop gain with consistent behavior on XLRS-Bench. Substituting memory from another image or another region of the same scene reduces accuracy by 5.8 to 7.4 percentage points and yields lower accuracy than removing memory altogether, demonstrating that predictions depend on the encoded regional evidence. Restoring the source crop within the same model reduces the accuracy loss caused by zeroing or removing memory. These findings establish that compact visual latents retain useful local evidence in UHR remote sensing and identify evidence availability as a key factor governing their contribution.

AI.tldr: 将高分辨率裁剪编码为64个连续潜在记忆token，可在冻结Qwen-VL骨干上实现7.6–9.9倍压缩，并将UHR遥感问答准确率提升2.5–4.8个百分点，且模型确实依赖所编码的区域证据。
AI.motivation: UHR遥感场景下全图降采样会丢失小目标与局部属性，而逐块裁剪又消耗大量上下文；已有关于自然图像的诊断研究指出模型常忽略压缩潜在内容，因此"紧凑潜在能否保留UHR场景中丢失的细粒度证据"尚不明确。作者有意将"证据保留"与"区域选择"解耦研究。
AI.method: 把高分辨率裁剪编码为潜在记忆token，在冻结骨干上分别评估其预测效用与内容依赖性。以LRS-GRO为主，XLRS-Bench验证；使用两代Qwen-VL；通过三种干预检验依赖：(1) 用其他图像或其他区域替换记忆；(2) 移除/置零记忆；(3) 在同一模型内恢复源裁剪。
AI.result: 64-token记忆对保留裁剪token实现7.6–9.9倍压缩；相比仅用降采样全图，准确率提升2.5–4.8个百分点，可恢复大部分高分辨率裁剪带来的增益，XLRS-Bench上行为一致。替换记忆使准确率下降5.8–7.4个百分点，且低于完全移除记忆；恢复源裁剪可缓解置零/移除记忆造成的损失。
AI.conclusion: 紧凑视觉潜在在UHR遥感中能保留有用的局部证据，并表明"证据可得性"是决定其贡献的关键因素；该结论对依赖潜在记忆的多模态UHR推理设计具指导意义。

title: Flexible Multi-Stack Super-Resolution of Clinical Brain MRI Using Hetero-Orientation Variational Encoding: Expert Reader Evaluation in a Nigerian Cohort
summary: High-resolution brain MRI is important for neuroradiological assessment, yet routine clinical protocols often rely on fast, anisotropic 2D acquisitions, particularly in resource-constrained settings. These acquisitions may differ in orientation, alignment and anatomical coverage, resulting in partially overlapping image stacks. Existing learning-based super-resolution methods typically rely on single, under-constrained inputs or fixed multi-stack configurations with idealised acquisition geometry. We introduce MS-HVED, a sequence-agnostic framework for flexible multi-stack brain MRI super-resolution. Available axial, coronal and sagittal stacks are independently encoded into multi-scale Gaussian posteriors and fused using a field-of-view-aware Product-of-Gaussians formulation that limits contributions from unsupported regions. Physics-informed domain randomisation simulates heterogeneous clinical acquisition conditions, including obliqueness, partial coverage and imaging artefacts. MS-HVED achieved competitive or superior reconstruction fidelity across synthetic benchmarks and improved downstream tissue segmentation relative to low-resolution inputs. To assess generalisation beyond the training cohorts, we performed external clinical validation on 30 routine brain MRI examinations from a Nigerian cohort, representing an under-represented population in medical imaging research. These examinations formed the largest component of a blinded reader study involving 44 real cases and seven expert neuroradiologists. In the Nigerian cohort, MS-HVED was preferred over the supervised baseline for overall image quality in 187 of 210 paired assessments. Across all clinical cohorts, MS-HVED achieved higher overall-quality scores with all available inputs (5.93 vs. 4.49, p<.001), with the preference persisting when axial or coronal inputs were omitted (p<.001). Code at github.com/cai4cai/ms-hved

AI.tldr: 提出序列无关的多堆栈脑MRI超分辨框架MS-HVED，通过多尺度高斯后验编码与视野感知的高斯乘积融合，结合物理信息域随机化，在合成基准和外部临床盲评中优于监督基线。
AI.motivation: 常规临床脑MRI多为快速各向异性2D采集（资源受限场景尤甚），不同堆栈在方向、配准和覆盖范围上不一致，形成部分重叠；现有学习方法依赖单一欠约束输入或固定多堆栈配置及理想化采集几何，难以适配真实临床的异质采集。
AI.method: MS-HVED：序列无关框架。对可用的轴位、冠状位、矢状位堆栈独立编码为多尺度高斯后验；采用视野感知的Product-of-Gaussians公式融合，抑制无支撑区域的贡献；并用物理信息域随机化模拟倾斜、部分覆盖与成像伪影等异质采集条件。
AI.result: 合成基准上重建保真度具竞争力或更优，并改善下游组织分割；外部临床验证纳入尼日利亚队列30例常规脑MRI（盲评研究44例真实病例中最大组成部分，7名专家神经放射科医师）：该队列中210次配对评估有187次偏好MS-HVED；全部临床队列总体质量评分5.93 vs 4.49（p<.001），省略轴位或冠状位输入时优势仍显著（p<.001）。
AI.conclusion: MS-HVED可灵活整合任意可用堆栈并适应真实临床采集异质性，重建质量与下游任务表现优于监督基线，且在代表性不足人群中具备泛化性。

title: Bring Back Language to Actions: Restoring VLM capabilities in VLA Models via Parameter Merging
summary: Vision-Language-Action models (VLAs) are obtained by fine-tuning pre-trained Vision-Language Models (VLMs) on robot demonstration data, enabling action prediction from visual observations and language instructions. However, this fine-tuning induces catastrophic forgetting, substantially degrading the semantic and visual grounding capabilities of the original VLM. We address this by merging the parameters of a VLM and its VLA derivative without retraining either model. Concretely, we extract the task vector (the difference between VLA and VLM weights) and decompose it via Singular Value Decomposition. For each component, we learn a scalar mixing coefficient controlling how much of the VLA adaptation is retained, optimised to jointly preserve action prediction and vision-language capabilities. Experiments show that our merged model performs well on both axes simultaneously, consistently outperforming established merging baselines.

AI.tldr: 通过分解任务向量并学习标量混合系数，将VLM与其VLA衍生模型做参数合并，同时保留动作预测与视觉语言能力，避免灾难性遗忘。
AI.motivation: VLA模型由预训练VLM在机器人演示数据上微调得到，但微调会引发灾难性遗忘，显著削弱原VLM的语义与视觉grounding能力。
AI.method: 无需重训练任一模型：提取任务向量（VLA与VLM权重之差），用奇异值分解（SVD）分解该向量；对每个分量学习一个标量混合系数，控制VLA适配的保留程度，并以同时保持动作预测与视觉语言能力为目标进行联合优化。
AI.result: 合并后模型在两个维度上同时表现良好，一致优于既有模型合并基线。
AI.conclusion: 基于SVD的任务向量分解加系数学习的模型合并策略，可有效缓解VLA微调带来的灾难性遗忘，实现动作能力与视觉语言能力的兼顾。

title: STARS: Stage-Adaptive Responsibility Separation for Shadow Removal in Remote Sensing Images
summary: Shadows are a ubiquitous radiative attenuation phenomenon in remote sensing images and can severely affect high-resolution remote sensing interpretation tasks. In shadow removal, although introducing a mask prior provides explicit positional information for the restoration network, it also causes non-shadow regions to be modulated by the shadow prior, producing a systematic brightness shift; notably, this phenomenon is independent of whether the mask is accurate. In remote sensing images, non-shadow regions usually occupy a larger proportion, so a small shift over these regions incurs a much higher cost on whole-image metrics than an equal gain in shadow regions. Adopting a task-decoupling perspective, we therefore decompose shadow removal into two tasks, shadow-region restoration and non-shadow-region identity, within a cascaded architecture, and handle them sequentially. Based on this insight, we propose STARS, a cascaded shadow removal framework that separates regional responsibilities across stages. The method retains the advantages of the shadow mask while resolving the degradation of non-shadow regions, without requiring a complex parallel dual-branch structure. Meanwhile, to introduce large-model prior knowledge into remote sensing tasks, we further design a Feature Selection and Fusion Adapter (FSFA). We conduct extensive experiments on three benchmark datasets, UAV-SC+, ISTD+ and WSRD+ 2026, demonstrating the superiority of STARS. The framework shows that decoupling regional responsibilities can resolve the intrinsic contradiction of mask priors, providing a new direction for image restoration with region heterogeneity.

AI.tldr: 论文提出级联式阴影去除框架 STARS，通过任务解耦将阴影去除分解为阴影区域复原与非阴影区域恒等两项任务，并设计特征选择与融合适配器（FSFA）引入大模型先验。
AI.motivation: 遥感影像中阴影掩码先验虽提供显式位置信息，却会使非阴影区域被阴影先验调制而产生系统性亮度偏移，且该现象与掩码是否准确无关；由于非阴影区域占比更大，微小偏移在全图指标上的代价远高于阴影区域同等收益。
AI.method: 从任务解耦视角出发，将阴影去除拆分为阴影区域复原与非阴影区域恒等两个子任务，在级联架构中顺序处理，按阶段分离区域职责，从而保留掩码优势、缓解非阴影区域退化，且无需复杂的并行双分支结构；同时设计特征选择与融合适配器（FSFA），将大模型先验知识引入遥感任务。
AI.result: 在 UAV-SC+、ISTD+ 与 WSRD+ 2026 三个基准数据集上开展大量实验，验证了 STARS 的优越性能。
AI.conclusion: 区域职责解耦可化解掩码先验的内在矛盾，为存在区域异质性的图像复原任务提供了新方向。

title: Attention U-Net Cellular Automata for Multi-Class Land Use and Land Cover Change Simulation in Lucknow, India: Evaluation Against Null and Classical Baselines
summary: Convolutional networks are often used to learn the transition rules of land-use cellular automata (CA), yet their predictions are seldom compared with a null model that predicts no change. We built AttentionUNet-CA, which reads a 32 x 32 neighbourhood of land-cover states with four drivers (elevation, distance to major roads, distance to the central business district (CBD) and population density) and predicts the state of each cell ten years later. We tested it on Lucknow, India, with GLC_FCS30D land cover for 1990, 2000, 2010 and 2020, a 30 m series mapped consistently over time, and compared its built-up class with GHSL and ESA WorldCover. AttentionUNet-CA was trained on 1990-2010, selected on held-out spatial blocks and evaluated once on 2010-2020, with three seeds. Baselines were the null model, a random-forest CA (RF-CA) and a U-Net CA without attention; each network was trained with and without class weights. Only 8.1% of the study area changed in the test decade, so no model matched the overall agreement of the null model (91.9%). On change, measured by the figure of merit, the class-weighted networks scored highest (U-Net CA 22.0 +/- 1.2%, AttentionUNet-CA 21.0 +/- 1.4%), ahead of RF-CA (20.3%), but by margins comparable to seed-to-seed variation; the networks estimated the amount of change better than RF-CA. The attention gates did not improve accuracy. Population density and distance to the CBD were the most useful drivers. Projected to 2030, built-up land grows by 22-35%, mostly at the city edge.

AI.tldr: 构建 AttentionUNet-CA 预测土地利用变化，但强调仅有 8.1% 图斑发生变化时，所有模型均无法超越"无变化"零模型的总精度(91.9%)，注意力门未带来增益。
AI.motivation: CA 研究中常用卷积网络学习转换规则，却很少与"预测无变化"的零模型（null model）作基线比较；同时注意力机制是否真正提升精度缺乏严格验证。作者希望以稳健的评估框架检验 CNN-CA 的真实增益。
AI.method: 构建 AttentionUNet-CA：输入 32×32 邻域土地覆盖状态 + 4 个驱动因子（高程、距主干道距离、距 CBD 距离、人口密度），预测 10 年后每个像元状态。以印度勒克瑙为研究区，用 GLC_FCS30D 1990/2000/2010/2020 年 30 m 一致时序数据（建成区类别与 GHSL、ESA WorldCover 交叉核对）。1990–2010 训练、空间分块验证选取、2010–2020 单次测试，3 个随机种子。基线：零模型、RF-CA、无注意力 U-Net CA，各网络均设带/不带类别权重两种。
AI.result: 测试期仅 8.1% 区域发生变化。总精度上无模型达到零模型的 91.9%。变化检测的品质因子(FoM)：带类别权重网络最高(U-Net CA 22.0±1.2%，AttentionUNet-CA 21.0±1.4%)，优于 RF-CA(20.3%)，但差距与种子间波动相当；网络对变化量的估计优于 RF-CA。注意力门未提升精度。人口密度与距 CBD 距离为最有用的驱动因子。
AI.conclusion: 在类别高度不平衡（变化占比小）的情形下，零模型的总精度难以被深度学习 CA 超越，注意力机制亦无实质收益；应以 FoM 等变化敏感指标评价，并报告随机种子方差。2030 年情景预测建成区增长 22–35%，主要发生在城市边缘。

title: An Efficient Training Paradigm for Image Restoration via Improved Fréchet Loss
summary: Diffusion-based image restoration achieves strong perceptual quality but typically relies on iterative sampling, leading to slow inference. Existing single-step methods often use diffusion distillation or adversarial training, complicating optimization. To simplify training, we propose FDIR, a framework for training single-pass generative restoration models through regression-style supervised optimization using directly computable objectives. To realize this paradigm, FDIR employs the Fréchet distance to match the feature distributions of restored and real images in frozen representation spaces, providing explicit distribution-level supervision. To better accommodate image restoration, we incorporate local patch features to capture fine-grained restoration discrepancies. Moreover, we introduce instance-adaptive statistics by combining the feature moments of each SR-HQ pair with synchronized historical statistics, allowing distribution matching to incorporate input-specific correspondence while retaining distribution-level context. FDIR optimizes only the LoRA parameters of the restoration backbone. Experiments demonstrate strong perceptual restoration quality and efficient training, suggesting a simpler paradigm for generative image restoration.

AI.tldr: FDIR：一种通过回归式监督优化的单步生成式图像复原框架，利用冻结特征空间中的Fréchet距离匹配特征分布，仅训练LoRA参数，实现强感知质量与高效训练。
AI.motivation: 扩散式图像复原感知质量好但需迭代采样、推理慢；现有单步方法依赖扩散蒸馏或对抗训练，优化复杂。目标是简化训练，用可直接计算的回归式监督目标训练单步生成式复原模型。
AI.method: 提出FDIR框架：(1) 在冻结表示空间用Fréchet距离匹配复原图与真实图的特征分布，提供显式分布级监督；(2) 引入局部patch特征以捕捉细粒度复原差异；(3) 提出实例自适应统计量，将每个SR-HQ对的特征矩与同步的历史统计量结合，使分布匹配既含输入特定对应关系又保留分布级上下文；(4) 仅优化复原骨干的LoRA参数。
AI.result: 实验显示具备强感知复原质量和高效训练，性能优于/可比于现有方法。
AI.conclusion: FDIR表明以回归式可直接计算目标训练单步生成式复原模型是可行且更简单的范式，为生成式图像复原提供了简化训练路径。

title: Correspondence-Free Camera Pose Estimation by Matching Moments
comment: 65 pages, including references and appendices; under review
summary: The blind perspective-$n$-point (PnP) problem is to estimate the pose of a calibrated camera from 2D and 3D point sets with unknown correspondences. We show that, for complete, noiseless observations, fourteen permutation-invariant image moments up to order four identify a fixed camera pose for almost every 3D point set containing at least twenty points. Our learning-free method, MomentPnP, matches these moments between the observed 2D points and the projected 3D points to initialize a camera pose without correspondences and refines the pose and correspondence weights using expectation--maximization. Across the test sets of three benchmarks, our method reduces median rotation error by $5$--$170\times$ relative to the best learned baseline, both with and without outliers. We recover accurate poses even with as many outliers as inliers. On dense ETH3D scans, pose accuracy improves as the point sets grow, even as individual correspondences become harder to resolve.

AI.tldr: 提出无需对应关系的盲PnP方法MomentPnP：用不超过四阶的14个置换不变图像矩唯一确定相机位姿，学习-free地匹配矩初始化位姿，再用EM联合精化位姿与对应权重，在三个基准上中位旋转误差比最佳学习基线低5–170倍，且在异常值比例与内点相当时仍能恢复准确位姿。
AI.motivation: 解决盲（无已知2D-3D对应关系）透视n点问题的位姿估计，并希望摆脱对学习式方法的依赖，获得对异常值稳健、随点集规模增长而提升精度的方案。
AI.method: 理论上证明：对完整无噪观测，14个至四阶的置换不变图像矩可在几乎任意（至少20点）3D点集上识别固定相机位姿。方法上先用观测2D点与投影3D点之间的矩匹配获得无对应的初始位姿，再以期望最大化（EM）迭代精化位姿与对应权重；全过程无需学习。
AI.result: 在三个基准测试集上，无论是否含异常值，中位旋转误差均比最佳学习基线降低5–170倍；异常值数量与内点相当时仍能恢复准确位姿；在稠密ETH3D扫描上，点集增大反而提升位姿精度，即便单点对应更难分辨。
AI.conclusion: 高阶置换不变矩足以在无对应条件下约束相机位姿，配合矩匹配初始化与EM精化可构成无需学习、鲁棒的盲PnP求解器，并随点密度增加而受益。

title: EEGProbe: Do Vision-Language Models Really Understand EEG? A Benchmark for Signal-Grounded EEG Signals Evaluation
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) have shown strong multimodal capabilities across scientific and biomedical domains, yet their ability to understand electroencephalography (EEG) signals remains unclear. We introduce EEGProbe, a signal-grounded benchmark for evaluating whether general-purpose VLMs can extract and reason from minimally processed, channel-wise EEG without task-specific feature engineering or EEG-specific adaptation. EEGProbe contains 620 EEG-centered questions across 13 subtasks and three capability categories: EEG Signal Classification, EEG Cross-modal Alignment, and EEG Neurophysiological Reasoning. To reduce shortcut-based answering, EEGProbe preserves the temporal structure of the recordings where possible, minimizes benchmark-induced processing, and applies signal-necessity testing followed by expert verification. We evaluate 11 representative open- and closed-source VLMs under a unified zero-shot protocol. The strongest model, GPT-5.6 Sol, achieves an overall score of only 41.63\%, with cross-modal EEG alignment emerging as a major bottleneck. We further examine model behavior from a neurophysiological perspective and analyze how temporal, spectral, spatial, and physiological EEG structure relates to model successes and failures. Inference-time neurophysiological guidance can reshape model predictions by helping models recognize the neurophysiological patterns present in the input and connect them with relevant neurological knowledge, narrowing the gap between general multimodal competence and EEG understanding. EEGProbe provides a testbed for current VLMs and a basis for developing future multimodal models that can interpret EEG evidence more reliably. The EEGProbe benchmark will be publicly available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/2122ZHU/EEGProbe.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 EEGProbe，一个面向通用视觉语言模型（VLM）的脑电信号理解基准，用 620 道、13 个子任务、3 类能力的题目，在零样本统一协议下检验模型能否直接从最小处理的逐通道 EEG 中提取并推理信息，结果显示最强模型总体得分仅 41.63%。
AI.motivation: VLM 在科学与生物医学多模态任务中表现强劲，但其对 EEG 信号的理解能力尚不明确；现有评测往往依赖任务特定特征工程或 EEG 专用适配，难以判断通用模型是否真正具备信号层面的读取与推理能力，也容易产生捷径式作答。
AI.method: 构建 EEGProbe 基准：620 个以 EEG 为中心的问题，覆盖 13 个子任务与三类能力（EEG 信号分类、EEG 跨模态对齐、EEG 神经生理推理）。为抑制捷径，尽可能保留记录的时间结构、最小化基准引入的预处理，并采用"信号必要性检验"加专家核验；在统一零样本协议下评测 11 个代表性开源与闭源 VLM，并从时间、频谱、空间与生理结构角度分析成败原因，另考察推理时神经生理引导的作用。
AI.result: 最强模型 GPT-5.6 Sol 总体得分仅 41.63%，其中跨模态 EEG 对齐是主要瓶颈；时间、频谱、空间与生理结构特征与模型成功/失败模式相关；推理时的神经生理引导可改变模型预测，帮助其识别输入中的神经生理模式并关联相关神经学知识，缩小通用多模态能力与 EEG 理解之间的差距。
AI.conclusion: 通用 VLM 尚不具备可靠的 EEG 理解能力，跨模态对齐尤为薄弱；EEGProbe 既为现有模型提供测试平台，也为发展能更可靠解读 EEG 证据的未来多模态模型奠定基础，基准将公开于 Hugging Face。

title: Fix, Don't Retake: Physics-Simulated Training for Correcting Patient Positioning Errors in Dental Panoramic Radiographs
summary: Patient-positioning errors can distort panoramic radiographs and lead to repeat examinations. This study investigated artificial intelligence for correcting these errors in existing images. A physics-based simulator generated paired correctly positioned and mispositioned panoramics from cone-beam computed tomography volumes, with controlled individual and combined positioning errors. Five approaches were compared: U-Net, pix2pix, conditional diffusion, an error-conditioned model, and a mixture of error-specific specialists. Evaluation used image similarity and geometric metrics across three test sets. All approaches improved mean image similarity and reduced geometric errors, with U-Net and the two error-aware approaches outperforming pix2pix and conditional diffusion.

AI.tldr: 该研究利用物理模拟器构建配对的正位/错位全景片数据集，对比五种AI方法对已有图像进行定位误差校正，结果表明各方法均能提升相似度并降低几何误差，U-Net与两种误差感知方法优于pix2pix和条件扩散模型。
AI.motivation: 患者定位误差会使全景X线片产生形变并导致重复检查，本研究旨在探讨用人工智能对既有图像中的定位误差进行校正，以避免重拍。
AI.method: 基于物理的模拟器从锥形束CT（CBCT）体数据生成配对的"正确定位—错位"全景图像，并可控地引入单一及组合定位误差；比较五种方法：U-Net、pix2pix、条件扩散模型、误差条件模型、以及按误差类型分设的专家模型混合（mixture of error-specialists）；在三个测试集上以图像相似度与几何指标评估。
AI.result: 所有方法均改善了平均图像相似度并降低了几何误差；U-Net与两种误差感知方法（误差条件模型与专家混合）表现优于pix2pix和条件扩散模型。
AI.conclusion: AI方法可对已采集全景片中的定位误差进行事后校正；误差感知建模与U-Net类架构效果更佳，为减少重复检查提供了可行途径。

title: A Study on Performance Enhancement of a Webcam-Based Real-Time Eye-Tracking System
summary: This study proposes a real-time gaze-tracking system that uses a standard RGB webcam to estimate screen coordinates. The system combines ETH-XGaze-based gaze estimation with nine-point calibration and polynomial ridge regression. To reduce errors caused by changes in head position, it also applies a conditional residual correction derived from head and pose features extracted with RTMPose. Whether this correction is used depends on the reliability of the detected features and the characteristics of the calibration data. In a preliminary experiment, one participant completed trials at 12 screen targets. The resulting mean screen-coordinate error was 204.24 pixels, which was 35.83% lower than that of xgaze-js and 57.69% lower than that of gaze_tracker. The system produced valid gaze estimates for all 12 targets. These preliminary findings demonstrate the feasibility of combining user-specific calibration with conditional pose-based correction for webcam gaze tracking. Because the evaluation involved only one participant, further experiments with more participants and a wider range of postures are required.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于普通RGB网络摄像头的实时视线追踪系统：以ETH-XGaze模型为基础，结合九点标定与多项式岭回归，并利用RTMPose提取的头部姿态特征进行条件性残差校正；单名被试初步实验中12个目标的平均屏幕坐标误差为204.24像素，较xgaze-js降低35.83%、较gaze_tracker降低57.69%。
AI.motivation: 普通网络摄像头视线追踪成本低、易部署，但精度不足，且头部位置变化会显著引入误差，因此需要在不依赖专用硬件的条件下提升精度与鲁棒性。
AI.method: 采用ETH-XGaze注视估计模型作为基础，叠加九点标定的多项式岭回归进行用户特定映射；再用RTMPose提取头部与姿态特征，据此构造残差校正项；是否启用该校正由检测特征可靠性与标定数据特性共同决定。
AI.result: 单被试、12个屏幕目标的初步实验中，平均屏幕坐标误差204.24像素，分别较xgaze-js低35.83%、较gaze_tracker低57.69%，且12个目标均输出有效估计。
AI.conclusion: 初步结果验证了“用户特定标定+条件性姿态残差校正”用于网络摄像头视线追踪的可行性；但样本仅一人，需扩大被试规模并覆盖更多姿态以进一步验证。

title: Oriented Semi-DETR for Semi-Supervised Aerial Object Detection
summary: Semi-supervised object detection has recently been extended to DETR, where oriented boxes introduce an ambiguity that does not arise for axis-aligned boxes: the map from parameters to rectangles is two-to-one, since $(c_x,c_y,w,h,θ)$ and $(c_x,c_y,h,w,θ+π/2)$ denote the same rotated rectangle. Losses and matching costs are computed from the parameters, so two boxes that coincide in space can be far apart in the metric that drives training. A correctly localized student box is then penalized by the regression loss, and the inflated matching cost leads the Gaussian mixture model (GMM) filter to discard it. We propose Oriented Semi-DETR, which removes this ambiguity wherever a pseudo box enters training. Swap-aligned Target Selection regresses towards the encoding closer to the student prediction. A Swap-invariant Reliability Cost minimizes over the two encodings inside the matching cost, so the filter decides on geometry alone. Swap-aware Pseudo-label Denoising starts denoising earlier, ramps its loss weight linearly, and weights each query by the teacher score and encoding margin. All three are parameter-free and require no additional forward pass. Across all label ratios of DOTA-v2.0, Oriented Semi-DETR outperforms DETR-based supervised and semi-supervised baselines, with the largest gains at the strict IoU threshold.

AI.tldr: 该论文指出现有 Oriented Semi-DETR 中存在旋转框参数编码的"二对一"歧义（(cx,cy,w,h,θ) 与 (cx,cy,h,w,θ+π/2) 表示同一框），并提出 Oriented Semi-DETR 及三个参数无关模块来消除歧义，在 DOTA-v2.0 所有标注比例上超越监督与半监督 DETR 基线。
AI.motivation: 半监督目标检测已扩展到 DETR，但引入旋转框后出现轴对齐框不存在的歧义：参数到矩形的映射是二对一的。由于损失与匹配代价基于参数计算，空间上重合的两个框在训练度量下可能相距很远，导致定位正确的学生框被回归损失惩罚，且膨胀的匹配代价使 GMM 过滤器将其丢弃。
AI.method: 提出三个无参数、无需额外前向的模块：1) Swap-aligned Target Selection——向与学生预测更接近的编码进行回归；2) Swap-invariant Reliability Cost——在匹配代价内对两种编码取最小值，使过滤器仅依据几何做判断；3) Swap-aware Pseudo-label Denoising——提前开始去噪、线性递增损失权重，并按教师分数与编码 margin 对每个 query 加权。
AI.result: 在 DOTA-v2.0 的所有标注比例下，Oriented Semi-DETR 均优于基于 DETR 的监督与半监督基线，且在严格 IoU 阈值下提升最大。
AI.conclusion: 通过在伪框进入训练的各个环节消除旋转框参数编码歧义，可显著提升基于 DETR 的旋转目标半监督检测性能，且所提模块不引入额外参数与计算开销。

title: Source-Free Domain Adaptation for Multi-Label Image Classification: A Framework, Baselines, and Benchmark
summary: Source-free domain adaptation (SFDA) adapts a model trained on a labelled source domain to an unlabelled target domain without access to the source data. Almost the entire SFDA literature assumes mutually exclusive classes, yet many deployed settings are multi-label. This paper formulates SFDA for multi-label classification and establishes the first benchmark for it: five adaptation tasks over six datasets spanning remote sensing, natural, clipart-style and driving imagery, with four single-label SFDA methods extended to provide the first baselines and a published multi-label method run alongside them, over three seeds. The benchmark shows that extending a single-label method is unreliable rather than merely suboptimal: half of the extended baselines fail to improve on the unadapted source model at all, and on two of the five tasks none of them does. The failures are not incidental. Nearest-centroid pseudo-labelling, softmax-based confidence, the diversity term of information maximization and confidence-weighted prototype construction each rely on mutual exclusivity, and each fails differently without it, so replacing the softmax with per-class sigmoids is a valid but insufficient extension. Multi-label Prototype Alignment with Contrastive Teaching (MPACT) is proposed in response, a mean-teacher framework whose objective, prototype construction and alignment term are each reconsidered for overlapping label sets. It attains the best average on every reported metric and is the only method that improves on the unadapted source model on all five tasks. The analysis further introduces a prototype-agreement diagnostic separating feature-space alignment from self-reinforcing agreement with the classifier, and reports a negative result for confidence-based pseudo-label filtering.

AI.tldr: 该文首次提出多标签源自由域适应（SFDA）问题与基准，指出单标签SFDA方法直接扩展不可靠，并提出MPACT方法。
AI.motivation: 现有SFDA文献几乎都假设类别互斥（单标签），而许多实际部署场景是多标签分类，缺乏相应问题定义与基准。
AI.method: 构建首个多标签SFDA基准：6个数据集（遥感、自然、clipart、驾驶图像）、5个适应任务、4个单标签SFDA方法扩展基线+1个已发表多标签方法、3个随机种子。分析各组件对互斥性的依赖。提出MPACT——基于mean-teacher框架，重新设计目标函数、原型构建与对齐项以适配重叠标签集，并引入原型一致性诊断，区分特征空间对齐与分类器自强化一致，报告置信度伪标签过滤的负结果。
AI.result: 一半扩展基线无法超过未适应源模型，五个任务中有两个任务所有基线均无提升；MPACT在所有指标上取得最佳平均，且是唯一在全部五个任务上均优于源模型的方法。
AI.conclusion: 单标签方法仅换用逐类sigmoid属有效但不充分的扩展；多标签SFDA需重新设计伪标签、置信度、多样性与原型机制，MPACT提供了可行方向。

title: State-Message Interaction Adapter for Cross-Domain Few-Shot Segmentation
comment: 17 pages, 9 figures, 7 tables, including the appendix
summary: Cross-domain few-shot segmentation adapts natural-image pretrained encoders to medical or industrial domains from a few pixel-annotated support masks. Within frozen DINOv3, intermediate per-head attention messages already carry target-background distinctions that baseline final-layer similarities and predictions do not consistently reflect. We propose the State-Message Interaction Adapter (SMIA) to learn how per-head messages should update each receiving token representation while keeping pretrained attention and FFN parameters frozen. Inserted right after per-head aggregation, SMIA conditions the transformation of each head's aggregated output (message) on each patch's pre-attention feature (state), allowing similar contextual messages to produce distinct or opposing updates depending on the receiving position. Because scarce support masks cover only limited state-message combinations, a shared low-rank bilinear map confines the learned interactions to low-dimensional state, message, and output subspaces. Added before each adapted block's frozen FFN, these updates yield adapted features that are refined by frozen FFNs and deeper blocks for linear readout. With only 0.51M trainable parameters and single-pass, support-free inference, SMIA achieves six-dataset mean mIoUs of 77.40% at 5 shots and 80.99% at 10 shots across 20 medical and industrial tasks, surpassing the strongest prior methods by +3.61 and +3.93 percentage points. In controlled 10-shot comparisons across three benchmarks on the same DINOv3 backbone, SMIA also outperforms parameter-matched AdaptFormer, LoRA, and ParaX with a better precision-recall balance.

AI.tldr: 提出State-Message Interaction Adapter（SMIA），在冻结DINOv3中按“接收位置状态”条件化各头注意消息的更新，用共享低秩双线性映射解决支持掩码稀疏问题，仅0.51M可训练参数即实现跨域少样本分割SOTA。
AI.motivation: 跨域少样本分割需将自然图像预训练编码器迁移到医学/工业域，仅靠少量像素级支持掩码。作者观察到冻结DINOv3中间层的逐头注意力消息已含目标—背景判别信息，而基线使用的末层相似度与预测未稳定反映该信息；现有适配方法（AdaptFormer、LoRA、ParaX）未利用“消息—接收状态”交互，且支持掩码覆盖的状态—消息组合极少易过拟合。
AI.method: SMIA插在逐头聚合之后：以每个patch的pre-attention特征为state，条件化该头聚合输出（message）的变换，使相同上下文消息因接收位置不同产生不同甚至相反的更新；预训练注意力与FFN参数全冻结。为应对支持掩码稀疏，采用共享低秩双线性映射，将交互约束在低维state/message/output子空间。更新置于每个适配块的冻结FFN之前，再由冻结FFN与更深块精炼以供线性读出；推理为单次前向、无需支持集。
AI.result: 0.51M可训练参数下，六数据集平均mIoU在20个医学与工业任务上达77.40%（5-shot）、80.99%（10-shot），分别超过最强先前方法+3.61与+3.93个百分点。在同一DINOv3骨干的三基准10-shot受控对比中优于参数匹配的AdaptFormer、LoRA与ParaX，且精确率—召回率平衡更佳。
AI.conclusion: 显式建模“状态—消息”交互是跨域少样本分割中高效利用冻结基础模型注意力消息的有效途径；低秩双线性参数化在极低参数预算下兼顾表达力与抗过拟合，且单次、免支持推理具实用价值。

title: Digits in Notation Are Not Numbers: A Scoring Pitfall in PDF-to-Markdown Conversion of Japanese Technical Documents (Preliminary Evaluation)
summary: Converting PDFs to Markdown is now routine preprocessing for search and language models, yet scoring the numbers in the output is easy to get wrong. We evaluate MinerU, a plain-text OCR baseline (NDLOCR-Lite), and a deterministic post-processing pipeline (anchor insertion, footnote reordering, fixes of look-alike characters in fixed contexts, gated formula repair using two independent OCR partners, and heading reconstruction) on 48 public Japanese pages (three documents), text-layer and rasterized. Our pre-specified number-and-unit F1 favored the OCR baseline (0.575 vs 0.397), and a disagreement check between the two engines seemed to flag about half of the converter's number errors (54.6%). Both were artifacts. The scorer counted digits in the converter's notation (image-link paths, HTML attributes), which plain text lacks. With the notation removed (a post-hoc check), the F1 scores tie (0.575 vs 0.594), and the check flags only 13% of number errors, because most errors are misses that both engines share. What remains: the OCR baseline has a lower body character error rate (0.012 vs 0.053 rasterized). The pipeline raises extra-number recall at page level (+0.145; the document-level interval touches 0), mostly by restoring page numbers, but lowers heading-level agreement (0.133 to 0.061) and leaves spurious formulas unchanged; its formula repair never fires. A pre-specified precision gate for its flags (0.80, human-judged) is met at 0.929, yet the post-processing hypothesis fails on its improvement items. We recommend scoring numbers after removing notation and checking critical figures against the source. By the pre-specified criteria, the study stays a technical report.

AI.tldr: 该研究对 MinerU、普通文本 OCR 基线（NDLOCR-Lite）及一条确定性后处理流水线在 48 页日文公开文档上做评测，发现预设的数字-单位 F1 与双引擎差异检查均为评分工件（含记法噪声），去记法后 F1 打平（0.575 vs 0.594），后处理假设在其改进项上不成立，故按预设标准仅作为技术报告。
AI.motivation: PDF→Markdown 已成为检索与语言模型的标准预处理，但对其输出中"数字"的评测极易出错；作者希望检验一个确定性后处理流水线能否在 OCR/转换基线之上提升数字、公式与标题质量，并审视常用评测指标本身的可靠性。
AI.method: 在 48 页日文公开文档（3 篇，含文本层与栅格化两条版本）上对比 MinerU、纯文本 OCR 基线 NDLOCR-Lite 和确定性后处理管线（锚点插入、脚注重排、固定上下文中形近字修正、由两个独立 OCR 伙伴把关的公式修复、标题重建）。预设指标为数字-单位 F1、双引擎差异检查、正文 CER、多余数字召回、标题级一致率、公式修复触发情况，以及人工判定的标志精确率门槛 0.80；另做事后检查，剥离图像链接路径与 HTML 属性等记法后再计分。
AI.result: 预设数字-单位 F1 偏向 OCR 基线（0.575 vs 0.397），差异检查显示可标记约 54.6% 的转换器数字错误；但两者均为伪象——评分器把转换器记法中的数字计入。去记法后 F1 基本持平（0.575 vs 0.594），差异检查仅能标记 13% 的数字错误，因多数错误为两引擎共有的漏检。OCR 基线正文 CER 更低（栅格化 0.012 vs 0.053）。管线将页级多余数字召回提升 +0.145（文档级置信区间触及 0），主要来自页码复原，但标题级一致率从 0.133 降至 0.061，伪公式未减少，公式修复从未触发。标志精确率达 0.929，超过 0.80 门槛。
AI.conclusion: 后处理假设在其预设的改进项上未获支持，研究按预设标准仅作为技术报告。建议：评测数字前先剥离输出记法（如图像链接、HTML 属性），关键数字须回源核对；双引擎差异检查不能替代对共享漏检的评估。

title: EviBridge: Encoding Predictive Visual Evidence for Proactive Interaction
summary: Tool-handover interaction calls for preparation before a response is warranted. The model waits until interaction cues appear, then prepares while assessing whether the accumulating evidence supports a response or calls for cancellation. We introduce EviBridge, a framework that integrates predictive visual representations into a vision-language interaction model for joint state and tool prediction. A trainable evidence interface maps features from a frozen V-JEPA 2 encoder into the language decoder alongside native visual inputs, preserving their temporal context and using only observations available at each decision time. The framework has two instantiations. EviBridge-E distinguishes recent from historical evidence and encodes the timing and spatial location of each observation. EviBridge-I preserves the temporal order of pooled V-JEPA 2 features and interaction turns and generates dedicated interaction tokens. We evaluate on FuGIBench, a streaming-video benchmark for preparation, response, and cancellation in tool-handover assistance. The best-performing variants of EviBridge-E and EviBridge-I achieve Overall scores of 0.6448 and 0.5892, compared with 0.2178 and 0.5327 for their respective task-adapted native baselines. These gains span target handovers, long waits, and cancelled requests, demonstrating the value of predictive visual evidence for interaction decisions.

AI.tldr: EviBridge 将冻结的 V-JEPA 2 预测性视觉表征经可训练证据接口注入视觉-语言交互模型的解码器，实现流式视频中的状态与工具联合预测，在 FuGIBench 上显著优于原生基线。
AI.motivation: 工具递接交互需要在响应前先行准备：模型需等待交互线索出现，在准备的同时评估累积证据是否支持响应或需要取消。现有视觉-语言模型缺乏利用预测性视觉证据支持此类时序交互决策的能力。
AI.method: 提出 EviBridge 框架，将预测性视觉表征集成进视觉-语言交互模型以联合预测交互状态与工具。核心是可训练的证据接口，把冻结 V-JEPA 2 编码器特征连同原生视觉输入映射到语言解码器，保留时间上下文且仅使用各决策时刻可见的观测。两种实例化：EviBridge-E 区分近期与历史证据，并编码每次观测的时序与空间位置；EviBridge-I 保留池化 V-JEPA 2 特征与交互轮次的时间顺序，生成专用交互 token。
AI.result: 在流式视频基准 FuGIBench（涵盖准备、响应、取消）上，EviBridge-E 与 EviBridge-I 最佳变体 Overall 得分分别为 0.6448 和 0.5892，对应任务适配原生基线为 0.2178 和 0.5327。增益覆盖目标递接、长时间等待与取消请求场景。
AI.conclusion: 预测性视觉证据对交互决策具有明确价值；通过轻量可训练接口复用冻结自监督视频表征，可在不微调编码器的前提下大幅提升流式工具递接交互的准备、响应与取消判断性能。

title: Seen but Unsaid: Locating and Repairing Cross-Image Comparison in Vision-Language Models
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) often fail to match a point or an object across two images, even when the answer can be decoded from their own hidden states. We trace this failure from the visual tokens to the answer letter, in Qwen3-VL (2B-32B), InternVL3.5-8B, and Gemma-3-12B, on synthetic shape matching, same-instance point correspondence (HPatches), and semantic correspondence (SPair-71k), and find two distinct failure points, a small set of attention heads that carries the comparison, and a repair that touches 0.02% of the parameters. Two failure points: exact copies are compared but not read out. An answer-position probe exceeds the calibrated output by 15 to 25 points in every family, for nameable and unnameable shapes alike, and steering along the probe's direction moves no more answers than random directions. Semantic correspondences are present in the visual tokens but never reach the answer. One pathway: redistributing the cross-image attention of 16-32 heads, with its mass preserved, removes 17-22 points of synthetic and 15-32 points of HPatches accuracy, against at most 7 for random or attention-matched heads. A lever that training finds on its own: training only these heads' query and key projections raises SPair-71k accuracy by 28.3 points (Qwen3-VL-8B) and 25.1 points (InternVL3.5-8B), beats both layer-matched and attention-matched heads, and transfers to HPatches and BLINK. An unconstrained all-layer adapter routes 21-51% of its gain through the attention of the same heads, against at most 7% for random heads, and does so by changing what they read (83-86% of the effect) rather than their weights. Every decision rule was frozen before its run, and every reported number is recomputed by independent verification scripts.

AI.tldr: VLMs在跨图匹配任务中失败，可定位为两个失效点（精确副本未被读出、语义对应未传递到答案字母），并由16-32个attention heads承担比较功能；仅训练这些head的Q/K投影即可大幅提升匹配精度。
AI.motivation: 视觉语言模型常在跨两张图像匹配点或物体时失败，即使答案可从其隐藏状态解码出来。作者希望从视觉token到答案字母追踪该失败的来源，定位具体失效环节，并寻找最小干预的修复方式。
AI.method: 在Qwen3-VL（2B-32B）、InternVL3.5-8B、Gemma-3-12B上，围绕合成形状匹配、同实例点对应（HPatches）与语义对应（SPair-71k）三类任务进行逐层追踪；使用answer-position probe、probe方向steering、cross-image attention重分配（保持总质量）、仅训练特定heads的query/key投影，以及无约束全层adapter的增益归因分析。所有决策规则在运行前冻结，数字由独立验证脚本重算。
AI.result: 失败点一：精确副本被比较但未被读出——answer-position probe在各模型族上比校准输出高15-25点（可命名与不可命名形状均如此），而沿probe方向steering的答案改变量不超过随机方向。失败点二：语义对应存在于视觉token中但未到达答案。重分配16-32个heads的跨图注意力使合成任务精度下降17-22点、HPatches下降15-32点，随机或注意力匹配heads至多7点。仅训练这些heads的Q/K投影：SPair-71k上Qwen3-VL-8B提升28.3点、InternVL3.5-8B提升25.1点，优于层匹配与注意力匹配heads，并可迁移至HPatches与BLINK。无约束全层adapter有21-51%的增益经由同一批heads的注意力，随机heads至多7%，且83-86%来自改变其读取内容而非权重。
AI.conclusion: VLM跨图匹配失败可归因于“读不出”与“传不到”两个明确瓶颈，并集中于一小撮可识别的attention heads；对这些heads的Q/K投影做极轻量训练（约0.02%参数）即可获得显著且可迁移的性能提升，训练本身也会自发找到这一杠杆。

title: DuoFlow: Towards Synchronized Speech and Motion Generation with Fine-Grained Control
summary: An embodied speaker's expressiveness depends not only on what is said, but also on how the voice sounds and how the body moves. However, existing joint speech-motion generation models are largely driven implicitly by transcript semantics or intermediate speech representations, offering little explicit control over motion hierarchy, body parts, or vocal style. To bridge this gap, we construct MotionSpeech, a structured benchmark for controllable joint speech-motion generation that includes transcripts, voice-style descriptions, and motion conditions at two hierarchical levels. Building on this benchmark, we propose DuoFlow, a dual-stream latent flow transformer that jointly denoises speech and motion under a shared noise level and a unified second-based temporal coordinate. Modality-specific residual connectors inject structured conditions into the corresponding streams, layer-wise bidirectional cross-modal attention coordinates their generation, and a monotonic phoneme pathway combines normalized progress anchors with CTC supervision to strengthen speech temporal modeling. DuoFlow provides a unified interface for fine-grained motion and vocal-style control and demonstrates the ability to synthesize high-quality, synchronized, and instruction-consistent speech-motion sequences.

AI.tldr: 论文提出MotionSpeech基准与DuoFlow双流潜空间流匹配Transformer，实现可控的联合语音-动作生成。
AI.motivation: 现有联合语音-动作生成模型主要依赖转录文本语义或中间语音表征隐式驱动，缺乏对动作层级、身体部位和声音风格的显式控制。
AI.method: 构建MotionSpeech基准（含转录文本、声音风格描述及两级层次动作条件）；提出DuoFlow：双流潜空间流匹配Transformer，在共享噪声水平与统一秒级时间坐标下联合去噪语音与动作；模态特定残差连接器注入结构化条件，逐层双向跨模态注意力协调生成，单调音素通路结合归一化进度锚点与CTC监督强化语音时序建模。
AI.result: 提供细粒度动作与声音风格控制的统一接口，能够合成高质量、同步且与指令一致的语音-动作序列。
AI.conclusion: 显式结构化条件与双流协同建模可有效提升联合语音-动作生成的可控性与一致性。

title: VideoNexus: Video Perception Beyond the Reasoning Context
summary: Understanding long videos requires locating evidence, resolving visual details, and integrating observations into an answer. Even when relevant evidence is present, performing these operations within long, dense visual sequences burdens both perception and reasoning. Video agents enable selective inspection, but returning frames to the planner still accumulates visual information in its reasoning context. Delegating perception reduces this burden, yet sparse sampling can miss decisive details, and per-frame descriptions can preserve context growth. We introduce VideoNexus, a training-free framework that separates detailed video perception from evidence-driven planning and reasoning. The planner controls where to inspect, what to resolve, and how densely to sample. Perception sub-agents process native audio-video in independent contexts and return compact, temporally grounded evidence for iterative search and verification. Using Gemini 3.8 Flash for both planning and perception, VideoNexus achieves 88.6% accuracy on full LVBench, exceeding same-backbone static ingestion and built-in agentic processing by 3.6 and 1.1 points, respectively, at 44% of the latter's measured API cost. A paired LVBench subset ablation shows lower planner input and higher accuracy. With Kimi K3 as the shared backbone, VideoNexus improves over the official Video-GAIA ReAct harness by 8.5 points in our evaluation. These results support compact evidence exchange for combining detailed observation with efficient planning and reasoning.

AI.tldr: VideoNexus：无需训练的视频智能体框架，将细节感知与证据驱动的规划推理分离，子智能体独立上下文处理原生音视频并返回紧凑、时间定位的证据，在 LVBench 上以 88.6% 准确率、44% 成本优于同骨干基线。
AI.motivation: 长视频问答需定位证据、解析视觉细节并整合观察，但长而密集的视觉序列给感知与推理带来双重负担。视频智能体虽可选择性检查，但将帧回传规划器会持续堆积视觉信息；委派感知虽减负，却可能因稀疏采样漏掉关键细节，或因逐帧描述导致上下文膨胀。
AI.method: 提出 VideoNexus，一个 training-free 框架：规划器决定何处检查、解析什么、采样密度；感知子智能体在独立上下文中处理原生音视频，仅回传紧凑且带时间定位的证据，支持迭代式搜索与验证，从而形成"细节感知—紧凑证据交换—规划推理"的解耦架构。
AI.result: 规划与感知均用 Gemini 3.8 Flash 时，完整 LVBench 达 88.6%，较同骨干静态摄入与内置智能体处理分别高 3.6 与 1.1 个百分点，且 API 成本仅为后者的 44%；配对子集消融显示规划器输入更少而准确率更高。以 Kimi K3 为共享骨干时，较官方 Video-GAIA ReAct 框架提升 8.5 个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 紧凑证据交换机制可有效结合细粒度观察与高效规划推理，验证了感知—推理解耦设计在长视频理解中的有效性与成本优势。

title: WeVisForensics: Self-Evolving Agent for Omni AI-Generated Video Detection
summary: Recent advances in video generation call for reliable detection grounded in explicit forensic evidence. However, current methods primarily depend on single-pass chain-of-thought reasoning that overlooks brief or localized artifacts, or on predefined multi-agent workflows that offer limited flexibility in selecting relevant inspections. Even with adaptive investigation, optimizing the investigation policy alone does not directly improve the forensic capabilities of fixed experts. We introduce WeVisForensics, an agentic framework in which a main investigator agent coordinates a self-evolving library of forensic inspector sub-agents spanning visual and audio cues. The investigator learns which artifact type to examine, over which window, and when to conclude, and these interactions provide shared feedback for both levels of agents. Our dual-timescale policy optimization strategy, DTPO, closes this loop through fast reinforcement learning of the investigator and slower refinement of the inspectors, guided by annotated artifact intervals, to report subtle artifacts they once dismissed. Furthermore, we curate ForenCue-30K, combining role-specific forensic annotations and interaction trajectories to supervise individual inspections and their coordination, with an accompanying reinforcement-learning pool. Experiments show that WeVisForensics averages 95.2% detection accuracy across in-domain, out-of-domain and agentic benchmarks, 9.0% above the strongest prior detector, while grounding its verdicts in localized evidence.

AI.tldr: WeVisForensics：主调查智能体协调自进化取证检查员子智能体库，配合双时间尺度策略优化DTPO，实现可与定位证据对应的视频伪造检测，平均准确率95.2%。
AI.motivation: 视频生成技术进步要求检测具备显式取证证据支撑；现有方法要么依赖单次链式思维推理而忽略短暂/局部伪迹，要么依赖预定义多智能体工作流、检查选择缺乏灵活性；且仅优化调查策略无法直接提升固定专家的取证能力。
AI.method: 提出智能体框架WeVisForensics：主调查智能体调度一个覆盖视觉与音频线索、可自我进化的取证检查员子智能体库，学习检查何种伪迹类型、在何时间窗口检查、何时终止；交互反馈同时用于两层智能体的共享学习。提出双时间尺度策略优化DTPO：对调查员做快速强化学习，对检查员做较慢的精修，并以带标注的伪迹区间为引导。构建ForenCue-30K数据集，含角色特定取证标注与交互轨迹，用于监督单次检查与协同，并附带强化学习池。
AI.result: 在域内、域外及智能体基准上平均检测准确率95.2%，较最强先前检测器提升9.0%，且判定结论可定位到局部证据。
AI.conclusion: 双层协同的智能体取证框架结合双时间尺度优化，可同时提升调查策略与专家能力，实现证据可定位的高精度视频伪造检测。

title: ALIVE: Making Streaming Video Models Interactive
summary: Streaming video LLMs can continuously observe the world, yet often handle user requests in isolation. We introduce ALIVE, an interactive streaming video model supporting proactive monitoring, streaming task coordination, and feedback-seeking interaction. We construct ALIVE-SFT-288K and ALIVE-RL-3K for two-stage training. Contrastive supervised fine-tuning teaches when and how to respond, while reinforcement learning with Behavior-Aligned Credit Assignment (BACA) combines trajectory-level and local advantages to refine decisions, responses, and silence across multi-turn interactions. We also introduce FSI-Bench to evaluate feedback seeking and subsequent task completion. ALIVE achieves the highest overall scores among the compared models on four public benchmarks and FSI-Bench, demonstrating strong streaming understanding and interactive capabilities.

AI.tldr: 提出交互式流式视频模型 ALIVE，支持主动监控、流式任务协调与反馈寻求交互，通过两阶段训练与 BACA 强化学习优化"何时回应/如何回应/何时沉默"，并构建 FSI-Bench 评测。
AI.motivation: 流式视频 LLM 能持续观测世界，但通常对用户请求进行孤立处理，缺乏主动监控、多任务协调与主动寻求反馈的能力，难以支撑真实的多轮交互场景。
AI.method: 两阶段训练：构建 ALIVE-SFT-288K 与 ALIVE-RL-3K 数据；对比式监督微调学习响应时机与方式；强化学习引入行为对齐信用分配（BACA），融合轨迹级与局部优势，精化多轮交互中的决策、回复与沉默；同时构建 FSI-Bench 评测反馈寻求与后续任务完成。
AI.result: 在四个公开基准与 FSI-Bench 上，ALIVE 在对比模型中取得最高综合得分，展现出较强的流式理解与交互能力。
AI.conclusion: 将流式视频理解建模为持续交互过程，并以对比式 SFT 加信用分配强化学习联合优化响应策略，可有效提升主动性与交互质量；FSI-Bench 为反馈寻求类能力提供了专门评测。

title: Symmetry Detection with Patch Embedding Models by Means of a Scalar Product Transform
summary: We present a transformation of vector embeddings representing image patches into scores for point reflection symmetry at the crossing points of patches. The transformation is heavily inspired by the Gradient Product Transform, but it uses the vector embeddings instead of the grayscale gradients. We therefore call it the "Scalar Product Transform" (SPT). Unlike deep learning models for symmetry detection, the method does not require a specific training step tailored for symmetry detection, but it works with arbitrary pre-trained patch embedding models. We have tested the method with DINOv3 and Franca. In our tests, the method outperformed the Gradient Product Transform and was even better than EquiSym, a convolutional neural network specifically designed and trained for symmetry detection. Although the runtime of the SPT is greater than that of EquiSym, the SPT has the advantage that it directly yields a bounding box for the symmetric region.

AI.tldr: 将图像patch的向量嵌入转换为patch交叉点处的点对称分数（Scalar Product Transform, SPT），无需专门训练即可完成对称检测。
AI.motivation: 受Gradient Product Transform启发，用patch向量嵌入替代灰度梯度，利用任意预训练patch嵌入模型（DINOv3、Franca）实现无需对称专用训练的对称检测。
AI.method: 提出SPT变换：把表示图像patch的向量嵌入映射为patch交叉点处的点反射对称得分，结构上类比Gradient Product Transform但以嵌入向量代替灰度梯度，可与任意预训练patch嵌入模型配合使用。
AI.result: 在测试中SPT优于Gradient Product Transform，并超过专为对称检测设计和训练的卷积网络EquiSym；缺点是运行时间高于EquiSym。
AI.conclusion: SPT是一种免训练的对称检测方法，检测精度优于基线及专用网络，且能直接给出对称区域的边界框，代价是计算开销较大。

title: VIVID: A Visual Harness for Agentic Video Editing
summary: Video editing requires agents to make editing decisions grounded in audiovisual observations and precise temporal localization, and to evaluate their effects in rendered outputs. General-purpose coding agents possess strong comprehension, reasoning, and code execution capabilities, while media interaction and evidence management mechanisms tailored to video tasks can further unlock their editing potential. We introduce VIVID, a visual harness that supports multiple native coding agents in video post-production without additional model training. VIVID provides tools for on-demand video inspection, audio analysis, and transcription, and preserves observations alongside their corresponding media versions and temporal coordinates. Agents can actively retrieve these observations as they reason, perform edits using their native coding and shell tools, and inspect rendered outputs to guide subsequent revisions. On AgenticVBench, comprising 100 tasks across Assembly, Repair, Sequencing, and Repurpose, Codex with VIVID achieves an average score of 58.6%, an improvement of 20.2 percentage points over native Codex. The same harness also integrates with Claude Code and OpenCode, achieving average scores of 55.1% and 37.1%, respectively, both substantially exceeding their native baselines. These results highlight VIVID's potential as a reusable visual harness for extending the capabilities of general-purpose coding agents to video editing.

AI.tldr: VIVID 是一个无需额外训练的"视觉挂具"（visual harness），为通用编程智能体提供视频检查、音频分析与转录工具，并将观察结果与其媒体版本和时间坐标绑定管理，从而把编程智能体的能力扩展到视频后期编辑任务上。
AI.motivation: 视频编辑要求智能体基于视听观察做出编辑决策、进行精确时间定位，并在渲染输出上评估效果；通用编程智能体本身具备较强的理解、推理与代码执行能力，但缺乏面向视频任务的媒体交互与证据管理机制，其编辑潜力未被充分释放。
AI.method: 提出 VIVID：1）提供按需视频检查、音频分析与转录工具；2）保存观察结果及其对应的媒体版本与时间坐标，支持智能体在推理过程中主动检索这些观察；3）智能体使用其原生编程与 shell 工具执行编辑，并检查渲染输出以指导后续修改；4）支持多种原生编程智能体（Codex、Claude Code、OpenCode），不进行额外模型训练。
AI.result: 在包含 Assembly、Repair、Sequencing、Repurpose 四类共 100 个任务的 AgenticVBench 上，Codex+VIVID 平均得分 58.6%，较原生 Codex 提升 20.2 个百分点；同一挂具接入 Claude Code 与 OpenCode 后分别达到 55.1% 与 37.1%，均显著超过各自的原生基线。
AI.conclusion: VIVID 可作为可复用的视觉挂具，将通用编程智能体的能力有效扩展到视频编辑领域，并具备跨智能体的通用性。

title: Event-Triggered Visual Perception for Real-Time Harvest Outcome Estimation in Mechanical Blueberry Harvesting
summary: Mechanical blueberry harvesting requires a balance between removing ripe fruit and avoiding premature removal of unripe berries that could remain on the bush for a later harvest. However, operators generally lack real-time information about the maturity composition of the fruit being collected. This study develops an event-triggered machine-vision system that measures the maturity of harvested blueberries directly on the harvester. When a filled crate is moved by the machine, an RGB image is automatically captured and analysed using a three-class detector that identifies ripe, semi-ripe, and unripe berries. The system operates locally on the existing CPU-only industrial computer and therefore requires neither continuous image processing nor dedicated GPU hardware. During field testing, 79 crate images containing 48,634 visible blueberries in manually verified reference annotations were evaluated. The vision system estimated an overall ripe-fruit fraction of 90.22%, compared with 90.97% determined manually. Per-image ripe-fruit estimates showed a mean absolute error of 0.935 percentage points and a Pearson correlation of r=0.967. Maturity estimates remained similar between the two sides of the harvester for which the light conditions varied despite poorer absolute counting performance under direct sunlight. All field events were processed within the available 14 s per-side crate interval. The proposed approach provides a practical means of quantifying one component of harvest selectivity while the machine is operating. Such information could support operator decision-making and, when combined with measurements of fruit recovery and losses, contribute to future feedback-based control of mechanical harvesting.

AI.tldr: 提出一种事件触发的机载机器视觉系统，在蓝莓收获机装满一箱时自动拍摄RGB图像，用三分类检测器（成熟/半熟/未熟）估算果箱中的成熟度构成；系统在现有纯CPU工业计算机上本地运行，田间79箱图像（48,634颗可见浆果）评估显示成熟果比例估计90.22%（人工为90.97%），逐箱平均绝对误差0.935个百分点，r=0.967，且全部事件在14 s的单侧装箱间隔内完成。
AI.motivation: 机械采收需要在"摘取成熟果"与"避免过早摘下可留待后续采收的未熟果"之间取得平衡，但操作者通常无法实时获知正在采收果实的成熟度构成，缺乏选择性采收的量化依据。
AI.method: 构建事件触发式机载视觉：果箱被机器移动装满时自动触发RGB拍照，由三分类检测器识别成熟、半熟、未熟浆果；算法在既有仅含CPU的工业计算机上本地部署，仅对离散触发事件处理，不进行连续视频处理，也不需要GPU。
AI.result: 田间79幅果箱图像、48,634颗可见浆果（人工核验标注）上，系统估计总体成熟果比例90.22%，人工为90.97%；逐箱成熟果比例估计平均绝对误差0.935个百分点，Pearson相关r=0.967；两侧光照条件不同但成熟度估计相近，尽管直射阳光下绝对计数性能较差；所有田间事件均在每侧14 s装箱间隔内处理完毕。
AI.conclusion: 该方法为机器作业中量化采收选择性提供了一个实用手段，可支持操作者决策；若与果实回收率及损失测量相结合，有望用于未来机械采收的反馈式控制。

title: Portrait Fitness as a Pretext: Probing Implicit Demographic Bias in VLMs
summary: We audit face-related bias in VLMs using BALPORTRAITS, a new balanced dataset of 9,000 fictional portraits across ethnicity, gender, and age segments. Sixteen VLMs estimate portrait fitness scores for occupations, brands, activities, and banking or insurance products within an advertising-casting framework designed to avoid direct inference of protected attributes. Item-level estimations are aggregated with scenario-specific prestige scores to compare rankings across demographic groups. While the magnitude and direction of these biases vary across scenarios, model families, and demographic dimensions, with age, ethnicity, and gender contributing differently depending on the task, we find demographic dispersion across all evaluated models, with a majority of pairwise segment differences reaching statistical significance. This study introduces a controlled protocol to assess implicit face-related associations and demonstrates that single-scenario or single-attribute audits are insufficient.

AI.tldr: 提出BALPORTRAITS数据集与广告选角协议，审计16个VLM在族裔、性别、年龄维度上的面部相关偏见，发现偏见普遍存在且具场景依赖性。
AI.motivation: 现有VLM面部偏见审计常受限于数据不平衡、直接推断受保护属性、或仅考察单一场景/单一属性，难以系统刻画隐式关联。
AI.method: 构建含9,000张虚构肖像、在族裔/性别/年龄上均衡的BALPORTRAITS；采用广告选角框架，让16个VLM为职业、品牌、活动及银行保险产品输出肖像适配度评分（避免直接推断受保护属性）；将条目级评分与场景特定声望分聚合，比较不同人口群体的排名。
AI.result: 偏见的方向与幅度随场景、模型家族和人口维度而异，年龄、族裔、性别在不同任务中贡献不同；所有被测模型均表现出人口统计学离散度，多数两两组间差异达统计显著。
AI.conclusion: 该研究提供了评估隐式面部关联的受控协议，并证明单场景或单属性审计不足以揭示VLM面部偏见。

title: Exploring the link between predictive uncertainty and the sim-to-real gap in deep learning models utilizing synthetic data
summary: Today, state-of-the-art methods for quality control (QC) are based on Machine Vision, combining deep learning (DL) models with camera-based inspection. Yet, the integration of such solutions in industrial applications is often impeded by data sparsity and trust in model reliability. While synthetic data offers a promising approach to generate the necessary data with perfect annotations, it poses risks related to performance degradation due to the possible occurrence of the sim-to-real gap. This study conducts experiments using the ensemble method to estimate the predictive uncertainty of DL models trained on synthetic data. The results show that predictive uncertainty increases under the sim-to-real domain shift. However, the observed performance drop is dominated by a systematic sim-to-real bias rather than by ensemble disagreement.These findings contribute to the effective utilization of synthetic data in industrial settings while highlighting the importance of risk assessment for the deployment of DL solutions for QC tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文用集成方法估计在合成数据上训练的深度学习质检模型的预测不确定性，发现sim-to-real域偏移会使预测不确定性上升，但性能下降主要由系统性sim-to-real偏差而非集成分歧导致。
AI.motivation: 机器视觉+深度学习的质检方案在工业落地时受限于数据稀疏与对模型可靠性的信任不足；合成数据可提供带完美标注的数据，但存在sim-to-real gap带来的性能退化风险。
AI.method: 采用集成（ensemble）方法，对在合成数据上训练的DL质检模型进行预测不确定性估计，并考察域偏移下的不确定性变化。
AI.result: 实验表明，在sim-to-real域偏移下预测不确定性增大；然而观察到的性能下降主要由系统性的sim-to-real偏差主导，而非集成模型间的分歧。
AI.conclusion: 研究有助于在工业场景中有效利用合成数据，并强调在部署质检DL方案时进行风险评估的重要性。

title: PhaseCLIP: Phase-Aware Frequency-Domain Adaptation of Vision-Language Models for Few-Shot Remote-Sensing Classification
comment: 23 pages, 7 figures, 5 tables. Code will be released at https://github.com/miralab-ai/PhaseCLIP upon publication
summary: Remote-sensing (RS) image scene classification aims to assign a semantic category to an overhead image, and in practice must often do so from only a handful of labelled examples, since annotation requires expert interpretation and the resulting labels transfer poorly across sensors and regions. Recent progress has come from adapting vision-language models (VLMs) such as CLIP, through learned prompts or feature adapters. Although effective, these methods construct their representation entirely in the spatial domain. RS scenes are dominated by periodic texture and regular geometry, which the Fourier spectrum describes compactly through an amplitude component, carrying texture and contrast statistics, and a phase component, carrying spatial structure. Existing frequency-domain adaptation of VLMs either exploits amplitude alone or does not separate amplitude from phase, leaving the structural component unused. In this article, we propose PhaseCLIP, which inserts phase-capable spectral modules and a feature-gating module into a frozen CLIP visual encoder and trains only 1.30% of its parameters. Because the amplitude and phase pathways share an identical parameter layout, a single weight set is learned on phase and transferred exactly to amplitude, giving a two-stage scheme that adds no parameters. Experiments on five public RS datasets, EuroSAT, PatternNet, UC Merced, LSRS and RSSCN7, against eight baselines under a matched protocol, show that PhaseCLIP attains 84.28% mean accuracy and is the best method in 23 of 30 dataset-by-shot cells, with phase contributing 1.93 points overall and 4.36 points on the most difficult dataset. Because the modules act on the spectrum of image patches and transformer tokens and leave the text encoder untouched, the approach can be extended to other RS sensors and tasks, and to other domains in which class evidence lies in spatial structure.

AI.tldr: 提出PhaseCLIP，在冻结CLIP视觉编码器中插入相位可用频谱模块与特征门控模块，仅训练1.30%参数，并通过幅度-相位共享参数的"两阶段"设计让相位权重无缝迁移到幅度，实现遥感少样本场景分类。
AI.motivation: 遥感场景分类常面临标注样本极少、标签跨传感器与区域迁移性差的问题；现有VLM（如CLIP）适配方法（提示学习、特征适配器）完全在空域构建表示，而遥感场景以周期性纹理和规则几何为主，傅里叶谱可紧凑描述。已有频域适配要么仅用幅度、要么不分离幅度与相位，导致承载空间结构的相位分量未被利用。
AI.method: 在冻结的CLIP视觉编码器中引入相位可用的频谱模块与特征门控模块，仅微调1.30%参数；幅度与相位通路采用完全相同的参数布局，因此单一权重集在相位上学习后可精确迁移至幅度，形成不增加参数的"两阶段"训练方案；模块作用于图像块与Transformer token的频谱，文本编码器保持不变。
AI.result: 在EuroSAT、PatternNet、UC Merced、LSRS、RSSCN7五个公开数据集、统一协议下对比八个基线，PhaseCLIP取得84.28%平均精度，在30个"数据集×shot"组合中23个最优；相位分量整体贡献1.93个点，在最难数据集上贡献4.36个点。
AI.conclusion: 相位信息对遥感少样本场景分类具有显著增益，且频谱模块与编码器解耦、文本端不改动，方法可扩展至其他遥感传感器与任务，以及类别证据蕴含于空间结构的其他领域。

title: Sparse Attention for Visual Generation: Toward Algorithm-System Co-Design
summary: Rapid advances in image and video generation have enabled high-fidelity synthesis at higher resolutions and longer durations, making the quadratic cost of dense self-attention a major bottleneck as visual token sequences grow. Sparse attention seeks to preserve generation quality at lower computational cost by retaining informative query-key interactions and omitting less consequential ones, with end-to-end gains depending on the cost of constructing sparse support and the efficiency with which the system maps the resulting workload to hardware. We survey sparse attention for visual generation through a 4+1+3 analytical framework that links algorithmic design to system implementation. The framework examines how static and dynamic methods use source information and the evidence derived from it to decide which interactions to retain and at what granularity, while accounting for the roles of reuse in reducing repeated computation and correction in compensating for omitted contributions. We relate these algorithmic choices to their implementation on hardware through the framework's three system dimensions of data organization, execution, and dataflow. We summarize common evaluation metrics and discuss open challenges and research directions, providing researchers and practitioners with a reference for the joint design of sparse attention algorithms and systems.

AI.tldr: 本文综述视觉生成中的稀疏注意力，提出"4+1+3"分析框架，将算法设计与系统实现相连接。
AI.motivation: 图像与视频生成迈向更高分辨率与更长时长，视觉token序列急剧增长，密集自注意力的二次复杂度成为主要瓶颈；稀疏注意力需在降低计算成本的同时保持生成质量，其端到端收益取决于稀疏支撑集构建开销与工作负载映射到硬件的效率。
AI.method: 提出4+1+3分析框架：4个算法维度考察静态与动态方法如何利用来源信息及其证据来决定保留哪些query-key交互及保留粒度；+1涵盖复用（减少重复计算）与校正（补偿被省略贡献）的作用；3个系统维度为数据组织、执行与数据流，用于将算法选择对应到硬件实现。
AI.result: 系统梳理了算法设计与系统实现之间的对应关系，总结了常用评价指标，并讨论了开放挑战与研究方向。
AI.conclusion: 为稀疏注意力算法与系统的协同设计提供参考框架，服务研究者与工程实践者。

title: FAVR: Flow-Aware Visual Residual Alignment for Vision-Language-Action Policies
comment: 10 pages, 5 figures. Equal contribution: Qixuan Wu and Xiaole Yang. Corresponding authors: Yuguang Yang and Baochang Zhang
summary: Pretrained video representations provide rich temporal information for robotic manipulation, yet effectively integrating them into existing vision-language-action (VLA) policies remains challenging. We present Flow-Aware Visual Residual Alignment (FAVR), a lightweight framework for flow-aware visual conditioning of frozen VLA policies. FAVR maintains a compact temporal visual state through linear Test-Time Training (TTT) and retrieves action-conditioned visual features throughout flow-based action generation. By exploiting the affine structure of the frozen action head, we explicitly characterize how injected visual features influence predicted action velocities and formulate flow-aware channel selection as a box-constrained optimization problem. We develop a FISTA-based solver for joint gate optimization and derive an efficient closed-form approximation through diagonalization and rescaling. With only 1.74-2.19M trainable parameters and 5,000 adaptation steps, FAVR improves pretrained VLA policies across benchmarks. On RoboTwin 2.0, FAVR improves LingBot-VLA from 87.12% to 90.04% under clean conditions and from 86.88% to 89.38% under randomized conditions. A controlled ablation on five RoboTwin tasks further shows that flow-aware gating increases average success from 72.0% with a gate shared across flow steps to 82.0%, demonstrating the benefit of adapting visual conditioning throughout action generation.

AI.tldr: FAVR 是一个轻量框架，将预训练视频表示以"流感知"方式注入冻结的 VLA 策略，仅 1.74–2.19M 可训练参数即可显著提升操作成功率。
AI.motivation: 预训练视频表示蕴含丰富时序信息，但难以有效融入现有 VLA 策略；现有做法可能需要大改策略或高训练成本，因此需要一种轻量、即插即用的视觉条件化方案。
AI.method: 通过线性 Test-Time Training（TTT）维护紧凑的时序视觉状态；在基于流的动作生成全过程中检索动作条件视觉特征；利用冻结动作头的仿射结构解析注入视觉特征对预测动作速度的影响，将流感知通道选择建模为箱约束优化问题，提出 FISTA 求解器做联合门控优化，并通过对角化与重缩放得到高效闭式近似。
AI.result: 仅 1.74–2.19M 可训练参数、5,000 步适配，即在多个基准上提升预训练 VLA。RoboTwin 2.0 上 LingBot-VLA 干净条件 87.12%→90.04%，随机化条件 86.88%→89.38%；五个 RoboTwin 任务的受控消融显示，流感知门控使平均成功率由共享门控的 72.0% 提升至 82.0%。
AI.conclusion: 在动作生成的不同流步上自适应地调节视觉条件优于跨步共享门控，验证了"贯穿整个流生成过程注入视觉信息"的价值；该框架以极小参数开销实现对冻结 VLA 策略的有效增强。

title: SciWorldBench: Do Video World Models Really Understand Scientific Experiments?
comment: Preprint. Benchmark paper with paired scientific experiments for evaluating video world models. 8 pages of main text, 16 pages including figures and references
summary: While the ability of video generation models to accurately depict scientific phenomena has received growing attention, determining whether these models genuinely understand the underlying principles remains a critical challenge. Existing benchmarks typically evaluate video samples in isolation, making it difficult to expose models that simply fit superficial visual priors. In scientific experiments, a small change in one condition produces a markedly different outcome even when the rest of the setup remains fixed. Capitalizing on this sensitivity, we introduce SciWorldBench, a benchmark comprising paired scientific experiments. Each pair varies a single condition in an otherwise fixed setup, yielding two mutually exclusive expected outcomes. Each generation prompt specifies the condition but omits the expected outcome. We evaluate ten text-and-image-to-video (TI2V) models using an independent vision-language model (VLM) that assesses each video without access to the condition text or the label identifying the correct outcome. A pair is scored as correct only when both videos depict their respective scientifically correct outcomes. Across all ten models, we find that the two videos in an experimental pair frequently depict the same outcome even though the conditions require different results. This recurring failure suggests that current video world models struggle to apply the underlying scientific principles reliably during generation. We will publicly release the benchmark dataset and open-source the evaluation code.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 SciWorldBench，一个由成对科学实验视频构成的基准，通过单变量对照设计暴露视频生成模型是否真正理解科学原理，发现十个 TI2V 模型普遍出现"同对变同结果"的失败模式。
AI.motivation: 现有视频生成基准通常对单个视频样本孤立评估，难以区分模型是真正掌握科学规律，还是仅拟合表层视觉先验。科学实验的特性在于：其余条件固定时，单一条件的微小改变会导致显著不同的结果，这种"条件敏感性"可用来检验模型的因果/机制理解能力。
AI.method: 构建 SciWorldBench：每个样本对为成对科学实验，仅改变一个条件，其余设置固定，对应两个互斥的正确结果。提示词只描述条件、不给预期结果。用独立的视觉语言模型（VLM）作为评判器，评判时无法获得条件文本与正确标签，避免信息泄漏。只有当一对视频各自呈现其对应的科学正确结果时，该对才记为正确。
AI.result: 在十个文本+图像到视频（TI2V）模型上评测，普遍观察到同一实验对中的两段视频呈现出相同结果，尽管其条件要求不同结果。此类反复失败表明，当前视频世界模型在生成过程中难以可靠地应用底层科学原理。
AI.conclusion: 成对、单变量干预式的评测设计能有效揭示视频生成模型对科学原理理解的不足，孤立样本评估不足以暴露此类问题；作者将公开基准数据集与评测代码。

title: ProSE: Probing Reconstruction Error for Semantic-guided Expert Skipping in MoE-MLLMs
summary: Mixture-of-Experts Multimodal Large Language Models (MoE-MLLMs) offer scalable inference through sparse expert activation, yet substantial computational redundancy remains among the activated experts. Existing expert skipping methods typically calibrate thresholds based on target skipping ratios or final-output divergence, overlooking the accumulation of skipping-induced error across layers and the varying semantic importance of individual tokens. To address that, we propose ProSE, a training-free, semantic-guided expert skipping framework that probes layer-wise reconstruction error to promote representation consistency compared with default activation. Specifically, we construct query-aware semantic masks to identify salient visual tokens and progressively calibrate modality-specific skipping thresholds for each MoE layer. By minimizing masked reconstruction error under a given budget, ProSE maintains semantic consistency after skipping and allows adaptive expert allocation under limited activation budgets. Extensive experiments on 9 benchmarks demonstrate consistent improvements on average over existing expert skipping methods, particularly under aggressive skipping settings. ProSE maintains over 96\% performance on KimiVL-A3B-Inst with 83\% expert skipping and accelerates prefilling by $1.7\times$.

AI.tldr: ProSE：一种免训练、语义引导的MoE-MLLM专家跳过框架，通过逐层重建误差探测与查询感知语义掩码渐进校准各MoE层的模态专属跳过阈值，在有限激活预算下保持语义一致性并实现自适应专家分配。
AI.motivation: MoE-MLLM虽通过稀疏专家激活实现可扩展推理，但被激活专家间仍存在大量计算冗余。现有专家跳过方法多以目标跳过率或最终输出差异来标定阈值，忽视了跳过误差在层间的累积以及单个token语义重要性的差异。
AI.method: 提出免训练的语义引导专家跳过框架ProSE：1）探测逐层重建误差以促进与默认激活的表示一致性；2）构建查询感知语义掩码识别显著视觉token；3）逐层渐进校准模态专属跳过阈值；4）在给定预算下最小化掩码重建误差。
AI.result: 在9个基准上相较现有专家跳过方法取得一致的性能提升，激进跳过设置下优势尤为明显；在KimiVL-A3B-Inst上实现83%专家跳过仍保持96%以上性能，prefill阶段加速1.7倍。
AI.conclusion: 以语义一致性为核心的逐层重建误差引导策略，优于基于跳过率或输出差异的阈值标定，可在严格激活预算下实现稳健的自适应专家分配。

title: A2A-UAV: A Multimodal Air-to-Air Dataset for UAV Detection and Identification
summary: The rapid growth of unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) in low-altitude airspace increases the risk of unauthorized intrusions, making reliable detection and identification of non-cooperative UAVs essential for low-altitude airspace safety. However, the existing public UAV datasets are mostly acquired from fixed ground-based viewpoints and are limited to imaging or radio-frequency (RF) observations, which restricts the sensing coverage and deployment flexibility. To address this gap, we present A2A-UAV, a multimodal air-to-air dataset for UAV detection and identification. Specifically, 15 target UAVs of 13 commercial models were recorded at three outdoor sites under daytime and nighttime conditions by using a UAV-mounted platform equipped with an RGB-thermal gimbal camera, a panoramic camera, an RF spectrum analyzer, and a millimeter-wave radar. The dataset contains 105,294 time-aligned samples of RGB, panoramic, thermal, and RF time-frequency images and radar point clouds. Moreover, all 209,539 bounding boxes of the predominantly small UAV targets were manually annotated and cross-checked. Therefore, A2A-UAV provides a valuable resource for air-to-air UAV detection, identification, and multimodal fusion in low-altitude airspace.

AI.tldr: 本文提出A2A-UAV，一个面向无人机检测与识别的多模态空对空数据集，由搭载RGB-热成像云台相机、全景相机、RF频谱仪和毫米波雷达的无人机平台在三个户外场景的昼夜条件下采集13个商用型号共15架目标无人机，含105,294个时间对齐样本与209,539个手工标注并经交叉核验的边界框。
AI.motivation: 低空空域中无人机快速增长带来非法入侵风险，非合作无人机的可靠检测与识别对空域安全至关重要；而现有公开无人机数据集多为固定地面视角，且局限于成像或射频单一观测，限制了感知覆盖范围与部署灵活性。
AI.method: 构建空对空多模态采集平台：无人机搭载RGB-热成像云台相机、全景相机、RF频谱分析仪与毫米波雷达，在三个户外站点于白天与夜间采集15架目标无人机（13个商用型号），获得RGB、全景、热成像、RF时频图像与雷达点云五类时间对齐数据，并对以小型目标为主的全部边界框进行人工标注与交叉核验。
AI.result: 数据集包含105,294个时间对齐的多模态样本，以及209,539个手工标注并交叉校验的边界框，覆盖昼夜条件与多种传感器模态。
AI.conclusion: A2A-UAV为空对空无人机检测、识别及多模态融合研究提供了有价值的资源，弥补了现有数据集在视角与模态覆盖上的不足。

title: PLECTA: Overlap-aware instance segmentation of dense strand networks from binary masks
summary: Many materials and tissues, including carbon-nanotube sheets, collagen and paper, comprise overlapping strands whose arrangement influences their effective properties. Measuring this geometry from micrographs requires individual strands to be traced through crossings and signal gaps, which merge distinct strands or split one strand into disconnected fragments. We present PLECTA (from Latin plecta, a braid), a deterministic method that segments individual strands using only a binary image whose foreground pixels mark strand centrelines. At each junction, PLECTA selects which strand segments continue into one another while allowing segments to terminate. It formulates this decision as an exact maximum-weight partial-matching problem, with an explicit penalty for unpaired segments and no restriction on the number of segments entering a junction. The output permits crossing pixels to belong to multiple strands. On synthetic scenes, PLECTA resolved strand identities more accurately than three released alternatives at every density tested. The same ranking held on an independently published generator run at its own settings. A separate stage uses the corresponding greyscale micrograph to estimate which strand lies on top at each crossing. The complete workflow is demonstrated on scanning electron micrographs of carbon nanotube sheets, from raw images to individual strand instances with estimated crossing order, without manual annotations for training or as pipeline inputs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PLECTA，一种确定性的单股丝线分割方法：仅输入标记丝线中心线的二值图像，在每个交叉点以带"未配对惩罚"的精确最大权部分匹配问题决定哪些片段相互延续，允许片段终止、交叉像素可属于多条丝线，并可结合灰度图估计交叉处上下叠放关系。
AI.motivation: 碳纳米管薄膜、胶原蛋白、纸张等材料由相互交叠的丝状体构成，其排列几何决定有效性质。从显微图像测量该几何需要让单根丝线穿越交叉点和信号缺失处被正确追踪，但现有方法会把不同丝线合并或将一根丝线切成互不连通的碎片。
