AI.method: PLECTA（拉丁语plecta，意为编织）采用确定性算法，输入仅为前景像素标示丝线中心线的二值图像。在每个连接点处，它将"哪些片段应彼此续接"的判定构造为精确的最大权部分匹配问题：对未配对的片段施加显式惩罚，且不限制进入同一连接点的片段数量；输出允许交叉像素同时归属多条丝线。另一独立阶段利用对应灰度显微图估计每个交叉点处哪条丝线位于上层。
AI.result: 在合成场景上，PLECTA在所有测试密度下分辨丝线身份的准确率均高于三种已发布的对比方法；在按其自身设置运行的独立公开生成器上，排序结果保持一致。完整流程在碳纳米管薄膜的扫描电镜图像上得到演示，可从原始图像直接输出带有交叉顺序估计的单根丝线实例，无需人工标注用于训练或作为流程输入。
AI.conclusion: PLECTA为交叠丝状结构提供了一种无需训练、确定性的丝线分割与交叉顺序估计流程，在合成与独立生成器测试中优于现有方法，并可直接应用于真实显微图像。

title: QuantileGS: Quantile-Based Conformal Bounds on RGB Rendering Errors for Novel View Synthesis with 3D Gaussian Splatting
summary: Uncertainty quantification for novel view synthesis with 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) assesses rendering reliability at unseen viewpoints. This reliability depends on the discrepancy between rendered and true colors, which cannot be measured without ground-truth images. We therefore quantify uncertainty in this unknown discrepancy through upper bounds on per-pixel RGB mean absolute error. However, learned bounds may underestimate these errors and overstate rendering reliability, motivating calibration to a prescribed coverage level. In this paper, we propose QuantileGS, a post-hoc framework that combines learned rendering-error quantiles with scale-normalized conformal calibration to produce spatially adaptive error bounds. The framework comprises three phases. Phase 1, Rendering-Error Computation, measures RGB mean absolute error between observed images and predictions from a frozen 3DGS model. Phase 2, Ordered Gaussian Quantile Fields, learns two scalar attributes per Gaussian to predict lower and upper rendering-error quantiles. Phase 3, Scale-Normalized Conformal Calibration, calibrates the upper prediction on held-out images, using the quantile gap to scale the correction. Under the stated assumptions, the resulting bounds provide finite-sample marginal coverage. At a nominal coverage level of 90%, calibration raises mean empirical test coverage from 69.6% to 89.6% on LLFF and from 80.1% to 92.1% on Mip-NeRF 360. On LF, coverage remains conservative at 96.3% before and 96.4% after calibration. Applications to active view selection, Gaussian pruning, and RGB-D simultaneous localization and mapping illustrate how these bounds inform downstream decisions.

AI.tldr: QuantileGS是一个事后框架，结合可学习的渲染误差分位数与尺度归一化保形校准，为3DGS新视角合成输出具有有限样本边缘覆盖保证的空间自适应逐像素RGB误差上界。
AI.motivation: 新视角合成的可靠性取决于渲染颜色与真实颜色的差异，但无真值图像时无法直接测量。用上界量化该未知差异时，学习得到的界可能低估误差、过分高估渲染可靠性，因此需要校准到指定覆盖水平。
AI.method: 三阶段后处理框架：(1) 渲染误差计算——在冻结的3DGS模型上计算观测图像与预测图像间的RGB平均绝对误差；(2) 有序高斯分位场——为每个高斯学习两个标量属性以预测渲染误差的下、上分位数；(3) 尺度归一化保形校准——在留出图像上校准上界预测，利用分位间隔缩放修正量，在给定假设下提供有限样本边缘覆盖。
AI.result: 名义覆盖90%时，校准将平均经验测试覆盖率在LLFF上从69.6%提升至89.6%，在Mip-NeRF 360上从80.1%提升至92.1%；LF上校准前为保守的96.3%，校准后为96.4%。
AI.conclusion: 所提误差上界可为主动视角选择、高斯剪枝与RGB-D SLAM等下游决策提供可靠的逐像素不确定性信息。

title: Model-based neural network for global floodplains analysis
summary: We address the super-resolution of multispectral remote sensing imagery for long-term floodplain monitoring, enhancing Landsat acquisitions towards Sentinel-2 resolution. Exploiting the period during which both missions observed the same areas, we build DLhasa-L2S , to our knowledge the first paired dataset dedicated to multispectral super-resolution for river analysis. It covers the Lhasa River (Tibet), whose strong anthropogenic changes and diverse hydromorphological profiles make it an ideal study area. We developed two model-based neural networks: a forward-backward (FB) plug-and-play scheme and an unfolded FB scheme. We compared them against learned neural networks baselines (SwinIR, RDN) on synthetic data, on real scenes, and through a statistical test over the whole real paired Landsat-Sentinel dataset. The unfolded network achieves the highest PSNR and SSIM on the real RGB components with fast inference, offering the best trade-off between accuracy and computational cost. For NDWI-based water segmentation, its performance shows no statistically significant difference from that of the best methods.

AI.tldr: 构建首个多光谱超分辨率配对数据集DLhasa-L2S，并提出两种基于模型的网络（FB plug-and-play与展开式FB），实现Landsat向Sentinel-2分辨率的多光谱超分辨，用于长期洪泛区监测。
AI.motivation: 长期洪泛区监测需要高时空一致性的遥感影像，但Landsat与Sentinel-2分辨率不匹配；现有超分辨率工作缺乏针对河流分析的多光谱配对数据集，且方法多依赖纯学习式网络，缺少模型驱动与物理先验的融合。
AI.method: 利用两任务同期观测同一区域的时间窗口构建DLhasa-L2S配对数据集（拉萨河，西藏）；设计前向-后向（FB）plug-and-play方案与展开式FB（unfolded）两种模型驱动神经网络，并与SwinIR、RDN等学习式基线在合成数据、真实场景及全量真实配对数据统计检验下对比。
AI.result: 展开式网络在真实RGB分量上取得最高PSNR与SSIM，推理速度快，在精度与计算成本间取得最佳折衷；在基于NDWI的水体分割任务上，其性能与最优方法无统计显著差异。
AI.conclusion: 模型驱动的展开式FB网络是多光谱遥感超分辨的高效方案，DLhasa-L2S数据集为河流分析提供了可复用基准；成果支持Landsat-Sentinel-2融合的长期洪泛区监测。

title: VAE Rhythm: Temporal Decoding Traces for AI-Generated Video Detection
summary: Visible artifacts are an unreliable cue for detecting generated videos, because newer generators learn to remove them. We instead detect a trace left by the generation pipeline itself. Most video generators decode latents with a 3D causal VAE that groups consecutive frames in time, so the fidelity of generated frames rises and falls periodically with their position in a group. We call this periodic trace VAE Rhythm. Real videos are captured frame by frame and do not have it. To reveal it without training, we propose a phase scan. The scan reconstructs a clip with an off-the-shelf VAE from successive start offsets and measures the periodicity of the reconstruction error across these offsets. We find VAE Rhythm in most of the 39 variants of 31 generators we test, including the closed-source Sora, Kling 3.0 and Seedance 2.0. We use the rhythm as a zero-shot score, as a plug-in for existing detectors and as a data engine that pairs real videos with their VAE reconstructions to train our detector CaDet. On DF26, the training-free rhythm score outperforms all 15 retrained baselines, and as a plug-in it improves all 19 tested detectors by 6.7% to 23.7% AUROC. CaDet achieves the best AUROC on AIGVDBench, DF26 and three 2026 closed-source models, and its variant trained without any generated video still exceeds 90% on AIGVDBench.

AI.tldr: 论文提出生成视频管线自身留下的周期性痕迹"VAE Rhythm"：3D因果VAE按组编码连续帧导致重建保真度随组内位置周期性波动，真实视频无此现象。据此设计免训练"相位扫描"检测法，并构建CaDet检测器，在多个基准与闭源模型上取得最优AUROC。
AI.motivation: 可见伪影不可靠：新生成器会学习消除伪影，因此需要寻找生成管线固有、难以去除的痕迹作为检测依据。
AI.method: 发现大多数视频生成器用3D因果VAE将连续帧分组解码，使帧保真度随组内位置周期性起伏（VAE Rhythm）。免训练检测采用相位扫描：用现成VAE从不同起始偏移重建片段，测量重建误差跨偏移的周期性。该痕迹可作为零样本分数、作为现有检测器的即插即用模块，或作为数据引擎配对真实视频与其VAE重建来训练检测器CaDet。
AI.result: 在31个生成器的39个变体（含Sora、Kling 3.0、Seedance 2.0）中多数发现VAE Rhythm；DF26上免训练rhythm分数优于全部15个重训练基线；作为插件使19个检测器AUROC提升6.7%–23.7%；CaDet在AIGVDBench、DF26及三个2026闭源模型上取得最佳AUROC，且不使用任何生成视频训练的变体在AIGVDBench仍超90%。
AI.conclusion: 利用生成管线固有的VAE组解码周期性痕迹，可实现对生成视频的鲁棒、免训练且易集成的检测，并对最新闭源生成器有效。

title: Vision-Language Model-Based Phase-OTDR Event Classification
summary: Phase-sensitive optical time-domain reflectometry (Phase-OTDR) enables distributed vibration sensing, but reliable event classification has traditionally relied on fully supervised models that require extensive annotated data. This study examines the adaptability of a Vision-Language Model (VLM) for Phase-OTDR event recognition through few-shot learning. Raw samples are converted into Short-Time Fourier Transform (STFT) dB-magnitude spectrogram mosaics, color-mapped and resized to RGB images, and processed by a Contrastive Language-Image Pre-training (CLIP) image encoder; few-shot adaptation optimizes only the Tip-Adapter-F cache keys, leaving both encoders unchanged. Under a leakage-controlled protocol (train-side support/validation pool of 512 images per class, fixed held-out test of 120 per class, no test-set access during selection, 20 distinct support-sampling trials), the selected configuration (the ViT-L-14 Vision Transformer encoder with OpenAI weights, 128 shots per class) reaches 96.81 +/- 0.42% accuracy and a macro-averaged F1 score of 96.79 +/- 0.42% on the held-out test set; a label-efficient 16-shot setting, that is, 96 labeled support images at adaptation time across the six classes, already attains 90.17 +/- 0.81%. Tip-Adapter-F clearly outperforms both zero-shot CLIP and the standard training-free Tip-Adapter, and prompt and backbone analyses show that performance is stable across Vision Transformer encoders and insensitive to prompt wording at the selected operating point. Overall, CLIP visual features carry a transferable structure that a lightweight support cache turns into a label-efficient Phase-OTDR event classifier. The code and the corresponding image dataset are made publicly available on GitHub to support further research: https://github.com/miralab-ai/vlm-phase-otdr.

AI.tldr: 本文提出将Phase-OTDR振动信号经STFT转为RGB时频谱图，利用CLIP视觉编码器结合Tip-Adapter-F少样本适配，实现标签高效的事件分类，128-shot达96.81%准确率，16-shot仍有90.17%。
AI.motivation: 传统Phase-OTDR事件分类依赖全监督模型且需大量标注数据，标注成本高；作者希望验证视觉-语言模型在少样本条件下对Phase-OTDR事件识别的可迁移性与标签效率。
AI.method: 原始信号经STFT得到dB幅度谱，彩色映射并缩放为RGB图像；用冻结的CLIP图像编码器（ViT-L-14，OpenAI权重）提取特征，仅优化Tip-Adapter-F的缓存键，两个编码器均不微调。采用防泄漏协议：每类512张的训练侧支持/验证池、每类120张固定留出测试集、选择过程不接触测试集、20次不同支持采样试验。
AI.result: 最优配置（ViT-L-14 + 128 shots/类）在留出测试集上达96.81±0.42%准确率、宏平均F1为96.79±0.42%；16-shot（六类共96张标注支持图）即达90.17±0.81%。Tip-Adapter-F显著优于zero-shot CLIP与训练无关的Tip-Adapter；提示词与骨干分析表明性能在多种ViT编码器上稳定，且在选定工作点对提示词措辞不敏感。
AI.conclusion: CLIP视觉特征蕴含可迁移结构，配合轻量支持缓存即可构建标签高效的Phase-OTDR事件分类器；代码与图像数据集已在GitHub公开以支持后续研究。

title: Interpretable deep concepts of organoid morphology
summary: Image-based classification of organoid morphologies can indicate drug response, viability, or successful differentiation. In recent work, learned representations outperform handcrafted features as the basis for downstream classifiers. However, their black-box nature hides the morphological cues a classifier relies on. Based on the foundation models DINOv3 (general-purpose) and ViTAMIn-O (organoid-specific), we train sparse autoencoders (SAEs) to learn interpretable concepts related to distinct organoid morphologies. We annotate concepts with spatial labels (organoid, organoid wall, background) and compute their dataset specificity and task relevance across five tasks. The spatial labels of DINOv3 concepts yield coarse organoid segmentations on out-of-domain datasets. Filtering concepts by spatial label in the DINOv3-SAE improves downstream AUROC for three of the five tasks. Qualitative analysis of the most relevant concepts further reveals a confounding factor introduced by our preprocessing in one task. Through such insights, interpretable concepts could help improve the reliability of classifiers and guide the future development of organoid representation models. The trained SAEs will be made available upon publication.

AI.tldr: 该论文在DINOv3（通用）与ViTAMIn-O（类器官专用）两个基础模型上训练稀疏自编码器（SAE），学习与不同类器官形态相关的可解释概念，并用空间标签、数据集特异性和任务相关性加以评估。
AI.motivation: 基于图像的类器官形态分类可指示药物响应、存活率或分化成功与否；学习到的表示优于手工特征，但其黑箱性质掩盖了分类器所依赖的形态线索，缺乏可解释性。
AI.method: 以DINOv3和ViTAMIn-O为底座训练SAE提取稀疏概念；为概念标注空间标签（类器官、类器官壁、背景）；在五个任务上计算概念的数据集特异性与任务相关性；按空间标签过滤概念后评估下游AUROC；并对最相关概念做定性分析。
AI.result: DINOv3概念的空间标签可在域外数据集上产生粗略的类器官分割；在DINOv3-SAE中按空间标签过滤概念，使五个任务中的三个下游AUROC提升；定性分析揭示出某一任务中由预处理引入的混淆因素。
AI.conclusion: 可解释概念有助于提升分类器可靠性，并可指导未来类器官表示模型的发展；训练好的SAE将在论文发表后公开。

title: QASK-Edit: Adaptive Sparse Attention Across Queries and Key Sources for Efficient Video Editing
summary: Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) have achieved strong performance in generation based video editing, but suffer from high inference latency due to the long token sequences formed by conditioning inputs and generated videos. Although training-free sparse attention reduces this cost, existing methods typically apply a fixed retention ratio or a single threshold shared across all tokens. In this work, we view video editing as conditional generation and identify a key insight: attention demand varies significantly both across different key sources (e.g., source videos, reference images, audio, text, and generated videos) and across queries within each source. Motivated by this, we propose QASK-Edit (Query-Adaptive Sparsity over Key Sources for Video Editing), a training-free sparse attention framework that allocates computation independently for each query and key source. Specifically, for each query, QASK-Edit considers both the attention mass and approximation risk of each block. It then evaluates candidate routing thresholds against each key source's risk budget, choosing exact computation or approximations to dynamically adjust sparsity for each query. Extensive experiments on three video editing models demonstrate that QASK-Edit achieves up to $1.46\times$ end-to-end speedup over dense attention pipeline while preserving both editing quality and unedited region fidelity. Furthermore, QASK-Edit generalizes directly to Reference-to-Video generation, delivering up to $1.36\times$ speedup while maintaining generation quality.

AI.tldr: QASK-Edit：面向视频编辑的训练无关稀疏注意力框架，按查询与键来源分别分配注意力计算，实现最高1.46倍端到端加速且保持编辑质量与未编辑区域保真。
AI.motivation: DiT 视频编辑因条件输入与生成视频形成长 token 序列而推理延迟高。现有训练无关稀疏注意力采用固定保留比例或全局单一阈值，忽略了注意力需求在不同键来源（源视频、参考图、音频、文本、生成视频）之间以及同一来源内不同查询之间的显著差异。
AI.method: 将视频编辑视为条件生成；对每个查询、每个键来源独立分配计算。对每个查询同时考虑各 token 块的注意力质量（attention mass）与近似风险（approximation risk），并以每个键来源的风险预算评估候选路由阈值，从而逐查询动态选择精确计算或近似计算以自适应调整稀疏度；全流程训练无关。
AI.result: 在三个视频编辑模型上，相比稠密注意力流水线实现最高1.46倍端到端加速，同时保持编辑质量与未编辑区域保真度；可直接泛化到 Reference-to-Video 生成，最高1.36倍加速并保持生成质量。
AI.conclusion: 注意力稀疏度应按查询与键来源细粒度分配，而非全局统一设定；该方法无需训练即可显著降低 DiT 视频编辑与参考图生视频的推理延迟，且不牺牲质量。

title: BLIP-Live: Balancing Timeliness & Firing Precision in Proactive Streaming Video Agents
summary: Streaming video understanding is becoming increasingly important for real-world interactive systems. Such systems must be proactive for natural and useful human interaction: they should respond as soon as sufficient evidence becomes available while avoiding premature, redundant, or incorrect responses. We present BLIP-Live, a framework unifying data, metrics, harness, and training around a shared formulation of proactivity as effective causal response decisions balancing the two competing objectives of responding vs silence. First, we construct BLIP-Live-780K dataset containing human annotations of proactive response content and timing, which defines this desired behavior. We then propose PAUC-F, a metric to effectively measure our desired proactive behavior. PAUC-F combines existing response timeliness metrics with firing precision to reward early useful responses without rewarding excessive firing. With our desired behavior defined and measurable, we finally investigate model-agnostic inference harnesses that draw out proactive streaming capabilities of offline vision language models (VLMs), together with training pipelines that learn to further improve their proactive responsiveness. Across both settings, we find that combinations of sliding visual windows, online interaction memory, and structured response outputs consistently yield strongest proactive performance. Our experiments result in two models, with our BLIP-Live-Qwen model achieving state-of-the-art performance across four proactive streaming benchmarks, with gains up to 44% over baselines and outperforming multiple closed API models. Our code and data will be released publicly.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 BLIP-Live 框架，将流式视频理解中的"主动性"统一形式化为在"响应 vs 沉默"两目标间权衡的有效因果响应决策，并围绕该形式化构建数据集、指标、推理框架与训练流程。
AI.motivation: 真实交互系统需具备主动性：证据充分即响应，同时避免过早、冗余或错误响应。但现有工作缺乏对"期望主动行为"的统一数据定义、可测指标与配套训练范式。
AI.method: 1) 构建 BLIP-Live-780K 数据集，含人工标注的主动响应内容与时机；2) 提出 PAUC-F 指标，将响应及时性指标与触发精度（firing precision）结合，奖励早期有用响应而惩罚过度触发；3) 研究模型无关的推理框架（sliding visual windows、online interaction memory、structured response outputs）并设计训练流程以提升离线 VLM 的主动流式能力。
AI.result: 在推理框架与训练两种设置下，滑动视觉窗口、在线交互记忆与结构化输出的组合均取得最强主动性能；产出 BLIP-Live-Qwen，在四个主动流式基准上达 SOTA，较基线最高提升 44%，并优于多个闭源 API 模型。
AI.conclusion: 通过统一定义、数据、指标与训练，可有效赋予离线 VLM 主动流式理解能力；代码与数据将公开。

title: Lost in the Hallway: Benchmarking Persistent Spatial Memory Across Revisits
summary: Persistent spatial understanding is essential for embodied agents to operate reliably in environments they repeatedly encounter. It requires recognizing revisited places despite viewpoint changes, distinguishing them from similar-looking rooms, and updating memories as environments change. Yet existing evaluations often leave physical place identity across separated visits implicit. We introduce ReSpaceBench, a benchmark comprising 3,244 questions across 590 synthetic and real-home scenes, organized into 9 tasks spanning room association, persistent state tracking, and downstream reasoning. Controlled walkthroughs define visits by physical room entry and deliberately include same-type room distractors and cross-session object changes. Our evaluation of 32 models and 3 agentic video-understanding frameworks reveals substantial limitations: the strongest evaluated zero-shot model achieves 50.5% overall accuracy and 52.2% on a 450-question subset, compared with 90.1% for human annotators. The evaluated agentic frameworks offer no overall improvement over direct inference with the same base model. Analysis of agent execution traces reveals evidence omissions and incorrect cross-visit room associations as major failure modes, suggesting that iterative evidence seeking alone does not ensure consistent spatial memory. Further analyses expose a gap between recognizing familiar rooms and identifying the correct visited room, while annotation-guided sampling highlights the importance of preserving intervening visits and transitions. We also provide RS-30K, a separate training dataset from synthetic sources with no template, scene, route, or video overlap with the benchmark. Fine-tuning Qwen3-VL-8B raises overall accuracy from 35.5% to 60.4%, with the largest gains in association and improvements extending to real-life scenes.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 ReSpaceBench 基准，用 590 个场景、3244 道题、9 类任务评测具身智能体的持久空间理解能力，发现 32 个模型与 3 个 agentic 框架均显著落后于人类，并提供 RS-30K 训练集显著提升 Qwen3-VL-8B 表现。
AI.motivation: 具身智能体需在反复进入的环境中可靠工作：要能在视角变化下识别重访地点、区分相似房间、并随环境变化更新记忆。但现有评测通常把跨次访问的物理地点同一性（place identity）留作隐含前提，未显式考察。
AI.method: 构建 ReSpaceBench：涵盖 590 个合成与真实家庭场景、9 项任务（房间关联、持久状态追踪、下游推理）、3244 道问题；以受控走查将"一次访问"定义为进入物理房间，并有意加入同类型房间干扰项与跨会话物体变化。评测 32 个模型与 3 个 agentic 视频理解框架，并结合执行轨迹分析失败模式、标注引导采样分析。另构建无模板/场景/路线/视频重叠的 RS-30K 合成训练集用于微调。
AI.result: 最强的零样本模型整体准确率 50.5%（450 题子集 52.2%），人类标注者为 90.1%；agentic 框架相对同底座直接推理无整体提升。主要失败模式为证据遗漏与跨访问房间关联错误。揭示"认出熟悉房间"与"定位正确访问过的房间"之间存在差距；保留中间访问与过渡片段很重要。微调 Qwen3-VL-8B 使整体准确率从 35.5% 升至 60.4%，关联任务增益最大并迁移到真实场景。
AI.conclusion: 现有模型与 agentic 流程在持久空间理解上仍远逊人类，单纯迭代式证据搜寻不足以保证一致的空间记忆；显式的 place identity 评测与针对性训练数据（RS-30K）能有效缓解该缺口，且具备向真实场景泛化的潜力。

title: Quality and Similarity Indicators for Video-Based Heart Rate and Respiratory Rate Fusion: A Controlled Evaluation
comment: 15 pages, 7 figures, 4 tables; with 14 pages supplementary material included
summary: Camera-based heart rate (HR) and respiratory rate (RR) estimates vary in reliability from window to window, and a common remedy is to fuse several extraction methods with weights from reference-free signal quality indicators. However, few studies test whether these indicators identify the most accurate method in each window or outperform simpler fusion. We evaluate 11 quality indicators and 8 inter-method similarity measures for fusing 7 HR and 10 RR extractors on four public datasets (75 test subjects). Filters, indicator directions, weighting parameters and a learned ridge baseline are selected on a separate five-subject set before testing. Fusion is compared with equal averaging, a constant typical-rate predictor, the best single method selected in advance and in hindsight, and a per-window oracle with a permutation-based null, using subject-level bootstrap confidence intervals. For HR, quality-weighted fusion reduced mean absolute error by 10.9% [5.2, 18.4] relative to averaging and by 15.6% [8.1, 23.1] relative to the method selected in advance, and was statistically indistinguishable from the best method selected in hindsight. Weighting methods by their agreement did not improve on averaging. For RR, the indicators could not identify the more accurate estimates: sharpened quality weighting increased error (-2.6% [-4.8, -0.8]), fused estimates were uncorrelated with the reference (r <= 0.22), and averaging was less accurate than the typical-rate predictor (-3.1% [-6.1, -0.4]). With a second respiratory reference, apparent RR gains reflected estimates moving toward its typical rate. Quality-guided fusion is worthwhile for video HR; for RR, 30-s windows improved estimates but not fusion.

AI.tldr: 该研究系统评估了11种质量指标与8种方法间相似度度量，用于融合7种心率(HR)与10种呼吸率(RR)提取器；结果显示质量加权融合对视频HR有效（相对平均降低MAE 10.9%），但对RR无效，指标无法识别窗口内更准确的估计。
AI.motivation: 基于摄像头的HR与RR估计在不同时间窗之间可靠性波动大，常见补救方法是用参考无关的信号质量指标为多种提取方法赋权融合，但鲜有研究检验这些指标是否真能在每个窗口识别最准确的方法，或是否优于更简单的融合策略。
AI.method: 在四个公开数据集（75名受试者）上，评估11种质量指标与8种方法间相似度度量，融合7种HR和10种RR提取器；滤波器、指标方向、加权参数及学习式岭回归基线在独立5人数据集上选定后再测试；将融合结果与等权平均、恒定典型速率预测器、事先与事后选出的最佳单一方法、以及带置换零分布的逐窗oracle比较，并使用受试者级bootstrap置信区间。
AI.result: HR：质量加权融合相对平均降低MAE 10.9% [5.2, 18.4]，相对事先选定的最佳方法降低15.6% [8.1, 23.1]，与事后最佳方法在统计上无差异；基于方法间一致性的加权未优于平均。RR：指标无法识别更准确的估计，锐化质量加权反而增大误差（-2.6% [-4.8, -0.8]），融合估计与参考值不相关（r ≤ 0.22），平均融合不如典型速率预测器（-3.1% [-6.1, -0.4]）；使用第二个呼吸参考时，表观RR增益仅反映估计向该参考典型速率靠拢。
AI.conclusion: 质量引导融合对视频HR有价值；对RR而言，30秒窗口能改善估计但无益于融合，参考无关质量指标不足以支撑RR的多方法融合。

title: MetricHand: Geometry-Aware Flow Matching for 4D Hand Reconstruction in Metric World Space
summary: Egocentric hand motion provides physical motion supervision for dexterous manipulation and vision-language-action pretraining. Reliable use of this supervision requires accurate and temporally coherent 4D hand reconstruction in metric world space. Existing methods typically lift framewise estimates produced under weak perspective into world coordinates. By ignoring joint-dependent depth variation at close range, this approximation couples errors in translation, orientation, and articulation that persist after world lifting and worsen under occlusion. We present MetricHand, a geometry-aware flow matching framework for 4D hand reconstruction in metric world space. MetricHand encodes depth priors from hand-object interaction regions into joint-associated representations that preserve local spatial structure and metric scale. Fused with visual features, this geometry guides coarse metric estimation and conditions every step of temporal generation. The model jointly recovers world-space translation, global orientation, MANO articulation, and shape, while structural priors and temporal context support estimation under partial occlusion. MetricHand reduces camera-space MPJPE by 49.3% and 52.9%, absolute world-space MPJPE by 28.7% and 21.7%, and wrist localization error by 48.5% and 37.9% relative to HaWoR, respectively. World-space acceleration error decreases by 44.2% and 64.3%, demonstrating improved temporal fidelity alongside more accurate absolute localization.

AI.tldr: MetricHand 是一个几何感知的 flow matching 框架，在度量世界坐标中实现精确且时间连贯的 4D 手部重建，为第一视角手部运动提供可靠监督。
AI.motivation: 第一视角手部运动为灵巧操作与视觉-语言-动作预训练提供物理监督，但需要精确、时间一致的度量世界空间 4D 手部重建。现有方法将弱透视下的逐帧估计提升到世界坐标，忽略了近距离下关节相关的深度变化，导致平移、朝向与关节化误差相互耦合，且在世界提升后仍然存在，并在遮挡时恶化。
AI.method: 提出 MetricHand：(1) 从手-物交互区域提取深度先验，编码为保持局部空间结构与度量尺度的关节关联表示；(2) 与视觉特征融合，指导粗粒度度量估计，并作为时间生成的每一步条件；(3) 联合恢复世界空间平移、全局朝向、MANO 关节化参数与形状；(4) 借助结构先验与时间上下文支持部分遮挡下的估计。
AI.result: 相对 HaWoR，相机空间 MPJPE 降低 49.3% 和 52.9%，绝对世界空间 MPJPE 降低 28.7% 和 21.7%，腕部定位误差降低 48.5% 和 37.9%；世界空间加速度误差降低 44.2% 和 64.3%，在提升绝对定位精度的同时改善了时间保真度。
AI.conclusion: 通过几何感知的深度先验与 flow matching 时间生成，MetricHand 有效解耦平移、朝向与关节化误差，在度量世界空间实现更精确、更连贯的 4D 手部重建，适用于第一视角运动监督。

title: POKE: Probe Offline, Keep Efficiently for Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Visual token pruning reduces the inference cost of Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models, but attention-based scores do not directly measure a token's effect on the predicted action. We define action sensitivity as the magnitude of the first-order action change when a token is replaced by its camera's mean token and estimate it for all tokens with a single backward pass. Computing it online is costly: scoring on the full (unpruned) graph needs an extra forward pass at every control step. Scoring on the pruned forward pass is cheaper but causes scoring-graph lock-in: removed tokens lose their direct paths through later layers and tend to receive lower scores, making those locations less likely to return. On replayed observations, even with a random conditioning mask, pruned-graph scoring re-selects 59% of the mask's tokens, versus 6% expected by chance; attention histories show a similar bias. POKE (Probe Offline, Keep Efficiently) computes full-graph action sensitivities offline and distills them into a student with under 0.3M parameters. At inference, the student scores the current observation without backpropagation or previous masks, and score-guided diversity selection retains the tokens. Keeping 32 of 512 visual tokens on LIBERO, POKE achieves 95.2% success on OpenVLA-OFT and 90.8% on $π_{0.5}$ at $1.85\times$ and $1.26\times$ speedups, outperforming attention-, diversity-, and distillation-based pruners, with larger margins on LIBERO-Plus.

AI.tldr: POKE 将全图动作敏感性离线计算并蒸馏到轻量学生网络，在推理时无需反向传播即可打分并保留视觉 token，在 LIBERO 上以 1.26–1.85 倍加速保持 90.8%–95.2% 成功率。
AI.motivation: 注意力分数并不直接衡量 token 对预测动作的影响；而基于动作敏感性在线打分代价高：全图打分需每步额外前向，剪枝图上打分则导致“打分图锁定”——被移除 token 失去后续层的直接通路而得分更低，难以回归（随机 mask 下仍重选 59% 的原 mask token，远高于 6% 的随机期望）。
AI.method: 定义动作敏感性为将某 token 替换为该相机均值 token 时一阶动作变化的幅度，并用单次反向传播估计全部 token；POKE（Probe Offline, Keep Efficiently）离线在全图上计算敏感度并蒸馏至参数量不足 0.3M 的学生网络；推理时学生网络无需反传、不依赖历史 mask 即为当前观测打分，再用分数引导的多样性选择保留 token。
AI.result: 在 LIBERO 上从 512 个视觉 token 中保留 32 个，OpenVLA-OFT 达 95.2% 成功率（1.85× 加速），π_{0.5} 达 90.8%（1.26× 加速），优于基于注意力、多样性和蒸馏的剪枝方法，在 LIBERO-Plus 上优势更大。
AI.conclusion: 离线学习动作敏感性并配合分数引导的多样性选择，可规避在线打分的开销与打分图锁定偏差，实现高效且高保真的 VLA 视觉 token 剪枝。

title: MedJev: A System One Vision-Language Decision Model for Fast and Effective Medical Image Understanding
summary: Medical image understanding with vision-language models (VLMs) typically relies on autoregressively generating reasoning and answer tokens. These unnecessary tokens make the inference cost scale with the response length and force the answer to be parsed from free-form text, incurring avoidable latency and decision errors. To this end, we introduce \textsc{MedJev}, a \emph{system one} vision-language decision model that maps medical images, questions, and candidate answers directly to decisions in a single multimodal forward pass, without any autoregressive generation process. For fast inference, \textsc{MedJev} removes the upper language layers and the generative output pathway, while keeping the full vision pathway and all visual tokens. On this shortened backbone, a decision head scores each candidate by pretrained query--key matching and refines the scores with a lightweight multilayer perceptron (MLP) residual, coupling the pretrained matching structure with task-specific nonlinear discrimination. Built on Qwen3.5-4B, \textsc{MedJev}-4B improves both accuracy and speed over the original model on each of four medical image classification and visual question answering benchmarks, with an absolute accuracy gain of \textbf{7.93\%} and a \textbf{6.04$\times$} end-to-end speedup. Further comparison with 20 cutting-edge models shows that \textsc{MedJev}-4B achieves state-of-the-art performance and inference speed among 4B--9B general and medical VLMs, indicating that direct multimodal decision making is an effective route to fast and effective medical image understanding.

AI.tldr: MedJev：去掉自回归生成，用单次多模态前向直接输出决策的医疗视觉语言"系统1"模型，兼顾准确率与速度。
AI.motivation: 现有医疗图像VLM依赖自回归生成推理与答案token，导致推理成本随回答长度增长、需从自由文本中解析答案，带来可避免的延迟与决策错误。
AI.method: 构建单次前向决策模型：移除上层语言层与生成式输出通路，保留完整视觉通路与全部视觉token；在缩短的骨干上加入决策头，先用预训练query–key匹配对候选答案打分，再用轻量MLP残差精化分数，融合预训练匹配结构与任务特定非线性判别。基于Qwen3.5-4B实现MedJev-4B。
AI.result: 在四个医疗图像分类与VQA基准上，相对原模型准确率与速度均提升，绝对准确率增益7.93%，端到端加速6.04倍；与20个前沿模型对比，在4B–9B通用与医疗VLM中达到SOTA精度与推理速度。
AI.conclusion: 直接多模态决策是通往快速、有效医疗图像理解的有效路径。

title: LiDSeg: Linear DehazeFormer Guidance for Efficient Semantic Segmentation in Adverse Weather Conditions
summary: Robust semantic segmentation in adverse weather is essential for safety-critical autonomous systems. Existing restore-then-segment pipelines introduce latency and prioritize pixel-level restoration over semantic discriminability, while domain adaptation methods often face representation bottlenecks and computational complexity. We introduce LiDSeg, a framework that uses reconstruction-informed guidance to improve segmentation under adverse weather. During training, a lightweight guidance encoder is jointly optimized with the segmentation branch using segmentation and auxiliary reconstruction objectives. At inference, the reconstruction decoder is discarded, while the guidance encoder is retained to extract weather-robust features. A lightweight gated fusion module integrates these features into the segmentation branch, preserving clear-weather accuracy while improving adverse-weather robustness. On Foggy Cityscapes, LiDSeg limits the clear-to-dense-fog mIoU degradation to 2.5-2.8 percentage points, reducing the baseline performance drop by more than fivefold. On the official ACDC test server, LiDSeg-PIDNet achieves 75.07% pooled all-condition mIoU, comparable to supervised HRNet-W48 at 75.0%, while remaining substantially smaller. The gains generalize zero-shot to Foggy Driving and Foggy Zurich without training on real-fog images. LiDSeg adds only 1.9-3.1M parameters across several models, with total model sizes of 5.2-39.5M parameters and no inference-time reconstruction overhead. It delivers real-time inference on the NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin. Code: https://github.com/yobsanb/LiDSeg

AI.tldr: LiDSeg 通过"重建引导"的轻量编码器在训练时联合优化分割与辅助重建目标，推理时丢弃重建解码器、仅保留引导编码器并用门控融合注入分割分支，从而在恶劣天气下提升语义分割鲁棒性且不增加推理开销。
AI.motivation: 恶劣天气下的鲁棒语义分割对安全关键自动驾驶系统至关重要。现有"先复原再分割"流程存在延迟，且以像素级复原而非语义可判别性为目标；域自适应方法则常受表征瓶颈与计算复杂度限制。
AI.method: 训练阶段：轻量引导编码器与分割分支联合优化，使用分割损失与辅助重建损失。推理阶段：丢弃重建解码器，保留引导编码器提取天气鲁棒特征；通过轻量门控融合模块将这些特征整合进分割分支，在保持晴好天气精度的同时提升恶劣天气鲁棒性。
AI.result: Foggy Cityscapes 上，晴→浓雾 mIoU 退化被限制在 2.5–2.8 个百分点，较基线性能下降幅度缩小五倍以上。ACDC 官方测试服务器上 LiDSeg-PIDNet 取得 75.07% 全条件池化 mIoU，与监督式 HRNet-W48（75.0%）相当但模型显著更小。无需真实雾图训练即可零样本泛化到 Foggy Driving 与 Foggy Zurich。多模型下仅增加 1.9–3.1M 参数，总规模 5.2–39.5M；推理时无重建开销，在 NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin 上实现实时推理。
AI.conclusion: 以重建作为训练期辅助引导、推理期去除重建路径的设计，可在极低参数与零额外推理成本下显著提升恶劣天气分割鲁棒性并保持晴好天气精度，具备跨数据集零样本泛化与边缘设备实时部署能力。

title: When Is the Expensive Method Worth It? A Content-Driven Analysis of Classical Bayer Demosaicing
summary: Demosaicing reconstructs a full-colour image from a single-sensor colour-filter-array (CFA) mosaic, where only one colour is measured per pixel. Classical methods make different assumptions about images, from simple averaging to directional edge-aware interpolation, and the directional methods cost markedly more compute. We ask a practical question that a per-image quality ranking does not answer: for a given image, is the expensive directional method worth its cost? Using a controlled simulate-reconstruct pipeline on 80 benchmark images from four public datasets (Kodak, McMaster, BSD100, Urban100), six classical methods, and image-content descriptors fixed before any results were seen, we show that the quality gain of the edge-aware method (Menon 2007) over the best cheap linear method is not constant. It ranges from $-6.6$ to $+6.8$ dB, and on 31% of images it is zero or negative, meaning a cheap method matches or beats the expensive one. The gain is also predictable from content: it correlates with mean image saturation at $r=-0.86$ ($p<10^{-6}$). We then build an interpretable depth-2 decision tree that recommends the best cheap method from image descriptors, beating an always-pick-the-most-common baseline by 20.0 percentage points under leave-one-image-out validation. The analysis uses no deep learning, and every step can be inspected.

AI.tldr: 本文研究经典去马赛克方法中"昂贵的方向性方法是否值得其成本"这一实际问题，发现边缘感知方法相对最佳廉价线性方法的增益在-6.6至+6.8 dB间变化，31%图像上增益为零或负，且增益可由图像平均饱和度预测（r=-0.86），并据此构建可解释决策树推荐最佳廉价方法。
AI.motivation: 经典去马赛克方法从简单平均到方向性边缘感知插值，后者计算成本显著更高。逐图像质量排序无法回答"对给定图像，昂贵方向性方法是否值得其成本"这一实际决策问题，作者希望量化该增益的可变性与可预测性。
AI.method: 在Kodak、McMaster、BSD100、Urban100四个公开数据集的80张基准图像上建立受控的"仿真—重建"流水线，比较六种经典方法；图像内容描述子在看到任何结果前预先固定，避免事后挑选；据此分析增益分布、与描述子的相关性，并训练深度为2的可解释决策树，采用留一图像交叉验证。
AI.result: 边缘感知方法（Menon 2007）相对最佳廉价线性方法的增益范围为-6.6至+6.8 dB，31%的图像上增益为零或负；增益与平均图像饱和度相关达r=-0.86（p<10^-6）；深度-2决策树在留一图像验证下比"总是选最常见方法"的基线高20.0个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 方向性方法的收益因图像而异且可预测，廉价方法常已足够；基于图像描述子的简单可解释决策树能有效指导方法选择。整个分析不使用深度学习，每一步均可审查，兼具实用性与可复现性。

title: MedicalDPO: Multi-Objective Direct Preference Optimization for CT to PET Translation
summary: CT-to-PET synthesis estimates functional PET images from anatomical CT scans for auxiliary analysis, representation pretraining, and missing-modality completion. Brownian Bridge diffusion models can produce multiple PET candidates of different quality under the same CT condition, exposing an intra-condition quality hierarchy. Candidate quality spans complementary spatial, structural, and intensity dimensions, while DPO-only fine-tuning may compromise absolute synthesis fidelity. We propose MedicalDPO which converts this hierarchy into preference supervision automatically constructed from paired CT-PET training data. Multiple candidates are ranked across the three fidelity dimensions, and strict cross-metric verification retains preferred-rejected pairs with consistent quality separation. Relative denoising-error preference optimization is jointly trained with the original Brownian Bridge objective to anchor the pretrained CT-to-PET mapping, while condition-balanced multi-pair rotation distributes preference supervision across CT conditions. Experiments on BBDM and CPDM show improvements across LPIPS, MAE, SSIM, and PSNR. Further analyses demonstrate metric complementarity and clear pair separation, while ablations show that the original training objective prevents the substantial degradation caused by DPO-only fine-tuning.

AI.tldr: 提出MedicalDPO，将布朗桥扩散模型同条件下多候选PET的"质量层级"自动转化为偏好监督，结合原始布朗桥目标联合训练，提升CT-to-PET合成保真度。
AI.motivation: CT-to-PET合成可用于辅助分析、表征预训练与缺失模态补全。布朗桥扩散在相同CT条件下可生成质量不同的多个PET候选，形成条件内质量层级；但仅用DPO微调可能损害绝对合成保真度，因此需要既利用层级偏好又不破坏预训练映射的方法。
AI.method: 从配对CT-PET训练数据自动构造偏好监督：按空间、结构、强度三个保真度维度对多候选排序，并用严格的跨指标一致性验证筛选出质量分离一致的preferred-rejected对；采用相对去噪误差的偏好优化，并与原始布朗桥目标联合训练以锚定预训练CT-to-PET映射；引入条件均衡的多对轮换，使偏好监督分散到各CT条件。
AI.result: 在BBDM与CPDM上实验，LPIPS、MAE、SSIM、PSNR均有提升；分析表明各指标具有互补性且偏好对分离明显；消融显示原始训练目标可避免仅DPO微调造成的大幅性能退化。
AI.conclusion: 将扩散模型的多候选质量层级转化为自动偏好监督并与原目标联合优化，可在保持绝对合成保真度的同时有效提升CT-to-PET合成质量。

title: ViRA: Toward Ultra-High-Resolution Visual Agents via Cross-Input Relative Policy Optimization
summary: Visual agents answer questions about ultra-high-resolution photos by zooming into the relevant regions. However, existing agents often answer from common sense instead of reading the evidence. Reinforcement learning (RL) on the final answer cannot correct this, because a guess earns the same reward as reading. We propose Cross-Input Relative Policy Optimization (CrossRPO), which trains agents on contrast sets. A contrast set asks one question about several versions of an image that differ only in a small region with the evidence and have different answers, so only reading the evidence solves the whole set. CrossRPO rewards solving the whole set, and we prove that it does not reinforce a set answered from common sense. We build contrast sets for training (ViRA-Train) and evaluation (ViRA-Bench) by editing one small object in images of 21 to 120 megapixels, and we photograph further sets with real changes (ViRA-Bench-Real) to exclude editing traces. We train two Visual Reasoning Agents, ViRA-9B and ViRA-27B, with CrossRPO on only about 3,500 items of ViRA-Train each. CrossRPO achieves 63.3% set accuracy on ViRA-Bench at the maximum resolution, against 59.3% for GRPO. ViRA-9B is the most accurate open model of its size on all benchmarks, and ViRA-27B outperforms Claude Haiku 5.5 and GPT-6-Luna, both at their highest thinking level, on most benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 提出CrossRPO，通过对"对比集"(contrast set)整体求解进行强化学习，迫使视觉智能体真正读取超高分辨率图像中的证据而非凭常识作答，训练出ViRA-9B/27B并在ViRA-Bench上取得领先表现。
AI.motivation: 现有超高分辨率图像视觉智能体常凭常识直接作答而不去放大读取证据区域；仅对最终答案做RL无法纠正，因为"猜对"与"读对"获得相同奖励。
AI.method: 构建对比集：同一问题对应多张仅在含证据的小区域有差异、答案不同的图像版本，只有读取证据才能解出整组。提出Cross-Input Relative Policy Optimization (CrossRPO)，以"解出整组"为奖励，并从理论上证明其不会强化凭常识作答的集合。通过编辑21–120MP图像中的小物体构建ViRA-Train与ViRA-Bench，并实拍真实变化的ViRA-Bench-Real以排除编辑痕迹；各用约3,500条数据训练ViRA-9B与ViRA-27B。
AI.result: 在最高分辨率下，CrossRPO在ViRA-Bench上集合准确率63.3%，优于GRPO的59.3%；ViRA-9B在同类规模开源模型中所有基准上最准；ViRA-27B在多数基准上超过Claude Haiku 5.5与GPT-6-Luna的最高思考水平。
AI.conclusion: 对比集+整组奖励的RL范式可有效抑制常识性作答、促使模型真正进行证据读取，且数据效率高（约3,500条），为超高分辨率视觉推理智能体提供了新的训练与评测体系。

title: FaceJev: Direct Visual Decisions for Face Forgery Detection
summary: Face forgery detection methods often perform well on seen manipulations but generalize poorly to unseen ones. Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) can recognize facial parts and assess their visual plausibility. Existing MLLM-based methods typically express these judgments through textual explanations, but seldom treat individual part decisions as explicit learning targets. We present FaceJev, an MLLM-based method for face forgery detection through direct visual decisions. Following the Jev formulation, FaceJev answers eight independent questions about facial parts using a shared image encoding and reads anomaly probabilities from the native answer logits. A face is classified as forged if any part is predicted to be abnormal, directly linking the detection result to the part decisions. We construct PartForensics, a dataset of approximately 160k images with binary anomaly targets for the eight facial parts, to supervise these decisions. We further propose FS-GRPO, which optimizes each part decision through an exact reward comparison with its alternative, using both detection and part rewards. FaceJev outperforms the strongest baseline by 7.25 percentage points on unseen manipulations. Extensive ablation studies validate our design choices and the effectiveness of the main components.

AI.tldr: FaceJev 提出一种基于多模态大模型的人脸伪造检测方法：将八个面部部位各作为一个独立二分类问题（Jev 形式），从原生答案 logits 读取异常概率，只要任一部位异常即判为伪造，并构建 PartForensics 数据集与 FS-GRPO 强化学习目标来监督部位决策。
AI.motivation: 现有人脸伪造检测在已见篡改类型上表现良好，但对未见操纵泛化差；基于 MLLM 的方法多以文本解释表达部位判断，却很少把部位级决策当作显式学习目标。
AI.method: FaceJev：共享一次图像编码，对八个面部部位分别回答独立问题，并从原生答案 logits 读取异常概率；检测规则为“任一部位异常即伪造”。数据侧构建 PartForensics（约 16 万张图像，含八个部位的二元异常标签）。训练侧提出 FS-GRPO，对每个部位决策与其备选答案做精确奖励比较，结合检测奖励与部位奖励进行优化。
AI.result: 在未见操纵类型上，FaceJev 比最强基线高 7.25 个百分点；大量消融实验验证了设计选择及各主要模块的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 将部位级判断作为显式监督目标、并与检测结果直接耦合，可显著提升 MLLM 人脸伪造检测的跨操纵泛化能力。

title: Reference Forcing: Long Video Generation with Region-Guided Drift Correction
summary: Long video generation should keep the subject and background consistent while supporting rich, natural motion. However, autoregressive models are often distilled with distribution matching distillation (DMD) over short windows, which does not train them to keep this consistency over long ranges. As a result, the subject and background can drift over time. Methods that manage the key-value (KV) cache retain or retrieve history to reduce drift. Yet this history may itself have drifted. We propose Reference Forcing, which uses the initial frames as an appearance reference. We first build a teacher that uses attention masks to force each region of a new frame to attend to the same region in the initial frames. The teacher finds these regions with off-the-shelf segmentation models. We then distill this behavior into a separate attention path of the student, which needs no external models at inference. We further introduce value correction, which corrects drifted values in the KV cache toward the matching values of drift-free initial frames. Experiments show that Reference Forcing achieves state-of-the-art subject and background consistency among long-video methods on different base models, and its advantage grows with video length. Ablations show both components are needed to gain consistency without losing motion. More visualizations and code are available at https://zhaosheng-thu.github.io/reference-force/

AI.tldr: 提出 Reference Forcing：以初始帧为外观参考，通过教师蒸馏+KV缓存值校正，提升长视频生成的主体与背景一致性。
AI.motivation: 自回归长视频模型通常在短窗口上做分布匹配蒸馏（DMD），未被训练去维持长程一致性，导致主体与背景随时间漂移；现有基于 KV cache 的保留/检索历史方法，其历史本身也已漂移。
AI.method: 1）以初始帧为外观参考；2）构建教师模型，用注意力掩码强制新帧的每个区域关注初始帧中的同一区域，区域由现成分割模型获得；3）将该行为蒸馏到学生模型的独立注意力路径，推理时无需外部模型；4）引入 value correction，将 KV cache 中漂移的 value 向无漂移初始帧的对应 value 校正。
AI.result: 在多个基础模型上，于长视频方法中取得最优的主体与背景一致性，且优势随视频长度增加而扩大；消融表明两个组件缺一不可——共同作用才能在不损失运动性的前提下提升一致性。
AI.conclusion: 以初始帧为锚点的参考注意力蒸馏与 KV value 校正，是缓解自回归长视频外观漂移的有效方案，且推理无额外开销。

title: Power Line Detection in Point Clouds with Point-SAM and RANSAC
summary: This article deals with the problem of detecting the position of power lines in airborne laser scanning point clouds. We address both the problem of segmenting power lines from background like ground and vegetation and of identifying individual lines. For segmentation we compare a rule-based approach with one based on transfer learning (Point-SAM). For individual line detection, we derive the mathematical formulas for RANSAC applied to 3D catenaries and compare it with a non-parametric method (TriplClust). All methods are evaluated on a newly created dataset "PowLiDFR", which we make publicly available. The samples have been taken from the French project LiDAR HD and cover a variety of terrain layouts and point cloud resolutions. On this dataset, an unsupervised transfer learning outperformed a mere rule-based segmentation, and for individual power line detection, RANSAC was better in following the shape of catenaries than the non-parametric algorithm.

AI.tldr: 该文研究机载激光扫描点云中电力线的定位问题，涵盖电力线分割与单根电力线识别两个子任务，并在新公开数据集PowLiDFR上对比多种方法。
AI.motivation: 电力线在机载LiDAR点云中提取困难：需从地面、植被等背景中分割出电力线，并进一步区分单根导线；现有规则方法与参数化/非参数化方法缺乏在多样地形与分辨率下的系统比较。
AI.method: 分割任务对比规则化方法与基于迁移学习的方法（Point-SAM）；单根线检测则推导了应用于三维悬链线的RANSAC数学公式，并与非参数方法TriplClust比较；所有方法在新构建的PowLiDFR数据集上评估，样本取自法国LiDAR HD项目。
AI.result: 在PowLiDFR数据集上，无监督迁移学习的分割效果优于纯规则化方法；单根电力线检测中，RANSAC比非参数算法更好地贴合悬链线形状。
AI.conclusion: 迁移学习分割与基于三维悬链线模型的RANSAC在电力线检测中更具优势，且公开的PowLiDFR数据集为后续研究提供了覆盖多地形与多分辨率的基准。

title: The Mask Is Not the Object: Volumetric Supervision for 3D Gaussian Segmentation
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. Project page: https://jhxcho.github.io/voda/
summary: 3D Gaussian Splatting enables object-level operations on Gaussian primitives, yet existing segmentation methods are largely trained and evaluated through rendered views. This mismatch can produce accurate rendered masks from incomplete 3D selections since alpha-blended feature supervision concentrates learning on dominant contributors while leaving occluded or low-contribution Gaussians weakly supervised. We propose VODA, a plug-and-play supervision objective that exploits local depth structure to group per-pixel contributors and directly supervises all Gaussians in selected depth clusters, bypassing contribution-weighted gradient delivery. To evaluate volumetric completeness, we introduce Removal-3D, a synthetic object-removal benchmark, and the Removal Depth Error (RDE), a metric comparing predicted and ground-truth depth changes. Across four rendering-based baselines, VODA consistently improves volumetric segmentation on Removal-3D while maintaining or improving performance on LERF and ScanNet. Further analysis shows that VODA recovers lower-contribution Gaussians, while simple gradient reweighting and spatial propagation fail to reproduce comparable gains.

AI.tldr: 现有3D高斯分割在渲染视图上训练评估，导致体素选择不完整；本文提出VODA以深度结构分组直接监督所有高斯，并引入Removal-3D基准与RDE指标。
AI.motivation: 现有3D Gaussian Splatting分割方法多在渲染视图上训练与评测，而alpha混合的特征监督会把学习集中在主导贡献的高斯上，被遮挡或低贡献高斯监督微弱，因此即便是准确渲染掩码也可能来自不完整的3D选择，存在训练/评测目标与真实体素分割需求之间的错配。
AI.method: VODA是一种即插即用的监督目标：利用局部深度结构将逐像素贡献者分组为深度簇，直接监督所选深度簇内的全部高斯，绕过按贡献加权的梯度传递路径。同时构建合成物体移除基准Removal-3D，并提出移除深度误差（RDE）指标，通过比较预测与真值的深度变化来衡量体素完整性。
AI.result: 在四个基于渲染的基线方法上，VODA在Removal-3D上一致提升体素分割性能，并在LERF与ScanNet上保持或提升表现。进一步分析表明VODA能恢复低贡献高斯，而简单的梯度重加权与空间传播无法获得可比增益。
AI.conclusion: 渲染视图监督不足以反映体素级分割完整性，直接对深度簇内全部高斯施加监督是更有效的方案；VODA可作为通用监督目标集成到现有方法中，配合Removal-3D与RDE为体素完整性提供了可量化评测手段。

title: [CLS] and [EOS] Tokens are not Enough for CLIP-based Class-Incremental Learning
comment: Accepted to TMM. Code is available at: https://github.com/LAMDA-CL/PACE
summary: Class-Incremental Learning (CIL) aims to empower models to continuously acquire new knowledge while mitigating catastrophic forgetting. With the advent of vision-language models like CLIP, leveraging their cross-modal alignment capabilities to address CIL challenges has emerged as a dominant paradigm. Existing methods leverage CLIP's global representations (i.e., the visual [CLS] token and the textual [EOS] token) for cross-modal alignment. While achieving effective classification, they overlook the rich patch-level visual features and token-level textual semantics inherent in CLIP. For example, the [CLS] token aggregates local information to capture the general concept of "cat", while the patch-level details retain specific localized features essential for recognition, such as the tail, fur, and face. We propose PACE (PAtch-token Cross-modal Enhancement) to uncover the long-neglected local representations within CLIP. First, based on the global representations like [CLS] token and [EOS] token, we identify the top-k most crucial visual patches and textual tokens. Subsequently, to better utilize the extracted key local features, we design a cross-modal fusion module. This module leverages local textual semantics to refine visual representations, while augmenting textual semantics with local visual features. As the fusion module is shared across all tasks, directly fine-tuning it on new tasks would interfere with the knowledge learned from previous tasks, leading to catastrophic forgetting. To alleviate this, we employ a projection-based update strategy to effectively preserve the critical parameter space of previous tasks during the adaptation to new tasks. Extensive experiments demonstrate that PACE significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods across multiple CIL benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 提出PACE方法，挖掘CLIP中长期被忽视的patch级视觉与token级文本局部表示，通过跨模态融合与投影式更新策略提升类增量学习性能。
AI.motivation: 现有基于CLIP的类增量学习（CIL）方法仅利用全局表示（视觉[CLS]token与文本[EOS]token）做跨模态对齐，忽略了CLIP中丰富的patch级视觉特征与token级文本语义，而这些局部细节对细粒度识别至关重要。
AI.method: 1）基于[CLS]与[EOS]全局表示，选出top-k最关键的视觉patch与文本token；2）设计跨模态融合模块，用局部文本语义精炼视觉表示，同时用局部视觉特征增强文本语义；3）针对共享融合模块在微调时的灾难性遗忘，采用基于投影的更新策略，在适应新任务时保护旧任务的关键参数子空间。
AI.result: 在多个CIL基准上，PACE显著优于现有最先进方法。
AI.conclusion: 充分挖掘CLIP的局部跨模态表示并结合参数保护式更新，可有效缓解遗忘并提升类增量学习性能，为CLIP-based CIL提供新范式。

title: Body of Evidence: Triangulating 3D Human Pose with Geometry-Conditioned Depth
summary: Even in multi-camera setups, occlusions can leave individual body joints with only a single usable 2D observation. Such an observation defines a viewing ray but leaves the joint's depth undetermined. We introduce Body of Evidence (BoE), a multi-view 3D human pose estimator that predicts per-camera joint depths alongside 2D joint locations. To reduce monocular depth ambiguity, we propose geometry-conditioned depth prediction, which combines image features with previously reconstructed 3D body geometry as contextual depth cues. We further introduce learnable depth-aware triangulation (LDAT), which augments differentiable algebraic triangulation with predicted depth constraints, enabling reconstruction even from a single contributing camera while preserving the benefits of geometric triangulation when multiple views are available. The reconstructed 3D poses subsequently guide depth prediction in the next iteration, allowing depth estimates and 3D geometry to progressively refine each other. Experiments on CMU Panoptic demonstrate state-of-the-art in-domain performance and superior average performance across evaluated camera subsets and unseen camera arrangements. BoE is particularly effective under sparse camera coverage, outperforming the previous state of the art by 10.6 AP25 points in the challenging three-camera setting.

AI.tldr: 提出Body of Evidence (BoE)多视角3D人体姿态估计器，通过预测各相机关节深度并结合几何条件深度预测与可学习深度感知三角化，解决单视角观测下深度不确定问题。
AI.motivation: 多相机场景下遮挡常导致某些关节仅有一个可用2D观测，该观测只定义一条视线，深度无法确定，传统三角化失效。
AI.method: 1) 在预测2D关节位置的同时预测每个相机下的关节深度；2) 几何条件深度预测：将图像特征与已重建的3D人体几何结合作为上下文深度线索以缓解单目深度歧义；3) 可学习深度感知三角化(LDAT)：在可微代数三角化中加入预测深度约束，使单相机也能重建，同时多视角时保留几何三角化优势；4) 迭代式互相精化：重建的3D姿态指导下一轮深度预测。
AI.result: CMU Panoptic上取得同域最优性能，在各相机子集与未见相机布局上平均性能更优；稀疏相机覆盖下尤佳，三相机设置较此前SOTA提升10.6 AP25。
AI.conclusion: 将深度预测与几何三角化结合并迭代互相精化，可有效应对遮挡与稀疏视角下的深度歧义，显著提升多视角3D人体姿态估计鲁棒性。

title: A Seismic Foundation Model for Dense Feature Extraction
summary: Deep-learning-based seismic interpretation is constrained by scarce high-quality annotations, and most existing models are trained separately for individual tasks. We present SeisDFE, a 7B-parameter seismic foundation model for dense feature extraction, pretrained on 5.34 million 2D images derived from more than 500 seismic volumes. A three-stage pretraining strategy, combining discriminative self-supervised learning, Gram feature anchoring, and multi-resolution adaptation, improves feature discriminability while preserving spatial coherence. With its encoder frozen, SeisDFE supports seismic facies classification, salt detection, fault detection, and relative geologic time estimation. It outperforms existing seismic foundation models on all four tasks and a natural-image-pretrained model on all but fault detection, with the largest gains under scarce supervision: using only two annotated sections of the F3 dataset, it improves whole-volume mIoU by 12-19 percentage points over the baselines. The learned features remain effective with task-specific decoders and extend to synthetic-to-field transfer and sparse 3D geobody interpretation. These results show that large-scale seismic pretraining organizes geological information into dense representations that are directly reusable across interpretation tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SeisDFE，一个7B参数的地震基础模型，用于稠密特征提取，在534万张2D地震图像上预训练，冻结编码器即可支撑四类解释任务并取得领先性能。
AI.motivation: 深度学习地震解释受限于高质量标注稀缺，且现有模型多为单任务分别训练，缺乏可复用的通用稠密表征。
AI.method: 从500余个地震数据体构建534万张2D图像进行预训练；采用三阶段预训练策略：判别式自监督学习、Gram特征锚定、多分辨率适配，以提升特征判别力并保持空间连贯性；冻结编码器后接任务特定解码器。
AI.result: 在岩相分类、盐丘检测、断层检测、相对地质时间估计四项任务上均优于现有地震基础模型；除断层检测外均优于自然图像预训练模型；在F3数据仅用两个标注剖面的稀缺监督下，全数据体mIoU提升12–19个百分点；并支持合成到实际数据迁移与稀疏3D地质体解释。
AI.conclusion: 大规模地震预训练可将地质信息组织为可直接跨任务复用的稠密表征，显著缓解标注稀缺问题。

title: Video-as-Experience: Learning Computer Use via Audio-Visual Understanding
summary: Multimodal large language models (LLMs) have enabled capable computer-use agents that perceive graphical user interfaces, reason over instructions, and execute actions. However, existing approaches to learning from video demonstrations typically convert videos into screenshot-based action trajectories, rather than directly leveraging their rich audio-visual information. We introduce VEX (Video as EXperience), a framework that uses audio-visual understanding to unify learning from external demonstrations and reflecting on an agent's own behavior. Following a watch-act-rewatch paradigm, the agent extracts procedural guidance from tutorial videos containing visual demonstrations and spoken explanations, executes tasks, and verifies its progress by rewatching its execution as video. We instantiate VEX with video-SALMONN-VEX, a 9B-scale audio-visual computer-use agent built on the video-SALMONN 2 architecture with a Qwen3.5-9B backbone. We further introduce Action-Grounded Guide Optimization (AGGO), a reinforcement learning method that optimizes video-derived guidance for downstream action prediction, and augment AgentNet, OSWorld, and CUA-Gym with over 24K real-world tutorial videos. Experiments on OSWorld and a complementary subset of CUA-Gym demonstrate consistent improvements, with video-SALMONN-VEX achieving a 22% relative increase in task success over its Qwen3.5 backbone on OSWorld. Moreover, its generated guidance improves Gemini-3.5-flash by 10% relatively on OSWorld. These results highlight the potential of audio-visual understanding as a unified interface for procedural learning and self-verification in computer-use agents.

AI.tldr: VEX：让计算机使用智能体以音视频为统一接口，通过"观看—执行—重看"范式从教程视频学习并自我验证。
AI.motivation: 现有从视频示范学习的方法通常把视频转成基于截图的动作轨迹，丢弃了丰富的音频（讲解）与视觉信息，未能直接利用音视频理解。
AI.method: 提出 VEX 框架，采用 watch-act-rewatch 范式：从含视觉演示与口头讲解的教程视频中提取过程性引导，执行任务后再将自己的执行过程作为视频重看来验证进度。实例化为 video-SALMONN-VEX（基于 video-SALMONN 2、Qwen3.5-9B 骨干的 9B 规模音视频智能体），并提出动作锚定引导优化（AGGO）强化学习方法，使视频导出的引导适配下游动作预测；同时为 AgentNet、OSWorld、CUA-Gym 增补 2.4 万余条真实教程视频。
AI.result: 在 OSWorld 及 CUA-Gym 补充子集上取得一致提升；video-SALMONN-VEX 在 OSWorld 上任务成功率相对其 Qwen3.5 骨干提升 22%；其生成的引导使 Gemini-3.5-flash 在 OSWorld 上相对提升 10%。
AI.conclusion: 音视频理解可作为计算机使用智能体中过程性学习与自我验证的统一接口，具有显著潜力。

title: TRR: A Thermal Interaction Engine for Robot Simulation and RGBT Data Generation
summary: A robot's actions change the thermal conditions of its next interaction: heat retained after release, carried with objects or stored beneath the surface can change a later contact's outcome despite similar current temperatures. Training trajectories must capture how these effects connect earlier actions to later observations and task outcomes. We present TRR, a \emph{Thermal Robot Renderer} that attaches spatial and depth-resolved thermal state to both contact partners, updates local heat exchange through contact, transport and separation, and generates synchronized RGB--thermal (RGBT) observations and event-local task checks on one execution clock. Controlled interventions show why retained heat, spatial transport and internal storage matter for subsequent contact outcomes. From the same state, TRR produces a paired six-task benchmark of 2,224 static--dynamic pairs, that is, 4,448 trajectories with synchronized dual-view observations, states and actions. Visible thermal history raises safe contact-site selection from 75.0\% to 91.7\% on a dedicated learning corpus, and training on dynamic histories raises simulated transfer completion by 50 percentage points under a new heating procedure with shared feedback execution. We demonstrate RGBT observation adapters on MuJoCo and Isaac Sim, report an engineering inventory of ten prepared robot configurations and six demonstrated camera viewpoints, and describe a developer workflow that carries an existing robot scene to exported RGBT records. The benchmark, the workflow and the platform resources described in Section 6 form the first items of a planned public release. Demonstrations and resource updates are available on the project page.

AI.tldr: 提出热力机器人渲染器TRR，将深度分辨的时空热状态附加到接触双方，模拟接触、运输、分离中的局部热交换并同步生成RGBT观察与任务检查，构建2,224对静/动态轨迹基准，验证热历史对接触位点选择与迁移完成的显著提升。
AI.motivation: 机器人动作会改变后续交互的热条件：释放后的余热、随物体携带的热量、表层以下的储热都会影响后续接触结果，即使当前温度相似。训练轨迹需刻画早期动作与后续观察及任务结果之间的这种因果联系，而现有仿真/数据缺乏可同步的热历史建模。
AI.method: TRR为接触双方附加空间与深度分辨的热状态；通过接触、运输与分离过程更新局部热交换；在统一执行时钟上同步生成RGBT观测与事件级任务检查；通过受控干预实验验证余热、空间运输与内部储热的作用；基于同一状态生成含2,224个静态-动态配对（4,448条轨迹）的六任务基准，含双视角观测、状态与动作；并在MuJoCo与Isaac Sim上实现RGBT观测适配器。
AI.result: 可见热历史使安全接触位点选择率由75.0%提升至91.7%；在共享反馈执行的新加热流程下，动态历史训练使模拟迁移完成率提升50个百分点；给出10种机器人构型与6个相机视角的工程清单及开发者工作流。
AI.conclusion: 热历史的可观测性与动态建模对接触决策与策略迁移至关重要，TRR提供了可复现的RGBT基准、工作流与平台资源，作为计划公开发布的首批内容。

title: ThermoSight: From Appearance to Internal Thermofluid Fields via Physics-Guided Neural Reconstruction
summary: Most neural reconstruction methods focus on reproducing scene appearance, yet inferring physical states from visual observations is essential for machine understanding of the physical world. Reconstructing the internal temperature and soot fields of radiating thermofluids such as flames is challenging yet essential for improving energy efficiency and assessing heat exposure and fire spread. In flames, temperature and soot concentration jointly govern visible emission, and soot self-absorption alters the light that reaches each camera. With limited views, changes in the two fields can offset one another in the recorded RGB images, making temperature and soot difficult to disentangle. ThermoSight, a physics-guided neural framework for scientific imaging, jointly reconstructs continuous three-dimensional temperature and soot volume fraction fields from limited calibrated flame images without field-level ground truth during optimization. A differentiable spectral model links these fields to measured RGB through thermal emission, self-absorption, and calibrated camera responses. Temperature-dependent emission spectra and wavelength-dependent attenuation constrain shared fields across RGB channels, reducing temperature-soot ambiguity. Chromaticity consistency, observation-derived spatial constraints, and soot regularization complement intensity fitting. In a synthetic ablation, wavelength-resolved attenuation reduces temperature RMSE in the hot, sooty region from 234 to 112 K relative to a three-channel approximation, with nearly identical RGB PSNR (65.23 vs. 65.24 dB). Measured data yield coherent fields and competitive RGB reconstructions. These results demonstrate that physics-guided neural fields recover interpretable internal physical quantities beyond visually consistent appearance.

AI.tldr: 提出ThermoSight，一个物理引导的神经框架，仅用有限标定火焰图像联合重建三维温度场与碳烟体积分数场，通过可微分光谱模型（热发射、自吸收、相机响应）缓解温度-碳烟歧义。
AI.motivation: 现有神经重建方法多关注复现场景外观，但机器理解物理世界需要从视觉观测推断物理状态。火焰内部温度与碳烟场对能效、热暴露与火蔓延评估至关重要；而二者共同决定可见辐射、碳烟自吸收改变到达相机的光，有限视角下两场变化在RGB中可相互抵消，难以解耦，且无场级真值。
AI.method: ThermoSight：以可微分光谱模型将温度与碳烟体积分数场经热发射、自吸收与标定相机响应映射到RGB；利用温度相关发射谱与波长相关衰减跨RGB通道约束共享场，降低歧义；辅以色度一致性、观测导出的空间约束与碳烟正则化进行强度拟合。
AI.result: 合成消融中，波长分辨衰减相较三通道近似将高温高碳烟区温度RMSE由234 K降至112 K，RGB PSNR几乎不变（65.23 vs 65.24 dB）；实测数据得到连贯场与有竞争力的RGB重建。
AI.conclusion: 物理引导神经场可恢复超越视觉一致外观的可解释内部物理量。

title: Déjà-Events: Multi-view 3D Geometry with Event Cameras via Sparsity-Aware Adaptive Gating
summary: Event cameras keep capturing structure where conventional cameras blur or saturate, which makes them attractive for 3D perception in fast or poorly lit scenes. Event datasets with dense 3D ground truth, however, are far smaller and less diverse than the image collections behind feed-forward 3D reconstruction models. We present Déjà-Events, an event-only model that predicts depth, camera pose and pointmaps from multiple views in a single forward pass. Rather than relying on scarce 3D labels, we distil it from Déjà View, a feed-forward RGB model that refines its tokens by repeatedly applying one shared transformer block. On paired RGB and event recordings, the event student learns to reproduce the frozen teacher's final tokens, which requires no depth or pose ground truth and trains only about 1% of its parameters. Because events are dense at edges and moving texture but nearly absent in textureless regions, we further introduce sparsity-aware adaptive gating, which adapts the shared block's gates to events and adjusts them per patch by event density, so that accuracy holds as refinement steps are added. Trained only on simulated data, Déjà-Events achieves the lowest pointmap error among the event-based methods we evaluate, on EventScape and zero-shot on the real MVSEC and DSEC datasets. On DSEC it halves the error of the strongest baseline (0.15 vs. 0.30 AbsRel) with about a tenth of its parameters. It also has the lowest depth error on EventScape and DSEC and the lowest trajectory error on EventScape.

AI.tldr: 提出仅事件相机的Déjà-Events模型，单次前向预测多视角深度、位姿与点图，通过从RGB教师模型Déjà View蒸馏（无需3D真值，仅训1%参数），并引入稀疏感知自适应门控，在EventScape及零样本MVSEC/DSEC上取得最低点图误差。
AI.motivation: 事件相机在快速或低光场景中不易模糊/饱和，适合3D感知，但带稠密3D真值的事件数据集规模与多样性远小于支撑前馈3D重建模型的图像集合，故需绕开稀缺3D标签。
AI.method: 事件专用模型Déjà-Events，多视角单次前向预测深度、位姿与点图；采用知识蒸馏，在配对RGB/事件录制上让学生复现冻结教师Déjà View（重复应用共享transformer块细化token）的最终token，无需深度或位姿真值，仅训练约1%参数；针对事件在边缘密集、无纹理区稀疏的特性，引入稀疏感知自适应门控，将共享块的门控适配事件并按patch依事件密度调整，使增加细化步数时精度保持。
AI.result: 仅在仿真数据训练，在EventScape及零样本MVSEC、DSEC上点图误差为所评估事件方法中最低；DSEC上AbsRel 0.15 vs 最强基线0.30，误差减半且参数量约为其十分之一；EventScape与DSEC深度误差最低，EventScape轨迹误差最低。
AI.conclusion: 通过从RGB前馈模型蒸馏token表示并结合稀疏感知门控，可在无3D标签、仅仿真训练条件下获得强泛化的事件式3D重建，参数量与误差均显著优于基线。

title: AnachroBench: Evaluating Historical Consistency in Large Vision-Language Models
summary: Existing Large Vision-Language Model benchmarks primarily evaluate visual understanding in general everyday scenarios, leaving historical consistency with a specified era and country largely underexplored. To address this gap, we propose AnachroBench, a controlled discriminative benchmark for evaluating historical consistency in visual scenes. It contains 1,600 image pairs from eight countries spanning the late 19th to the early 20th century, each pairing an original historical image with an anachronistic version containing a seamlessly inserted modern object. AnachroBench evaluates three aspects: Inserted Object Perception, which tests whether models detect the inserted modern object; Era-Country Consistency, which assesses whether the scene is consistent with the specified era and country; and Conditional Era-Country Consistency, which measures consistency judgments only when the inserted object is correctly perceived. A false consistency judgment occurs when a model perceives the modern object but still judges the scene as historically consistent. Overall, AnachroBench reveals a gap between inserted object perception and era-country consistency judgments, providing a targeted evaluation of this behavior.

AI.tldr: 提出 AnachroBench，一个受控的判别式基准，用于评测大型视觉语言模型在指定时代与国家下的历史一致性判断能力。
AI.motivation: 现有 LVLM 基准主要评测日常场景的视觉理解，对"与特定时代和国家保持一致"的历史一致性几乎未加探索，存在评测空白。
AI.method: 构建包含 8 个国家、横跨 19 世纪末至 20 世纪初的 1,600 对图像；每对由一张原始历史图像与一张无缝插入现代物体的"时代错置"版本图像组成。设置三项子任务：插入物体感知（模型能否检测出插入的现代物体）、时代-国家一致性（判断场景是否与指定时代和国家一致）、条件时代-国家一致性（仅在插入物体被正确感知时才评估一致性判断），并以"感知到现代物体却仍判定历史一致"作为错误一致性判断。
AI.result: AnachroBench 揭示了插入物体感知能力与时代-国家一致性判断之间存在明显差距，为这一行为提供了针对性评测。
AI.conclusion: AnachroBench 以受控判别式设计填补了历史一致性评测的空白，可作为诊断 LVLM 时代-国家常识与视觉感知脱节问题的专用基准。

title: FM-Recon: Exploring Foundation Model Features for Accelerated Cardiac Cine MRI Reconstruction
summary: Foundation models have demonstrated strong feature extraction capabilities across various medical imaging tasks, yet their potential for MRI reconstruction remains largely unexplored, particularly within unrolled reconstruction networks and under artifact-corrupted inputs. In this work, we explore whether and how features from pretrained foundation models can benefit accelerated cardiac cine MRI reconstruction. To this end, we propose FM-Recon, a framework that refines and integrates extracted features from frozen image encoder of foundation models into an unrolled reconstruction network. Through extensive experiments on the CMRxRecon2023 dataset, we systematically evaluate foundation model features across different reconstruction settings. Our results show that foundation models can extract informative representations from artifact-corrupted inputs and improve reconstruction performance, particularly at moderate acceleration factors. These findings demonstrate the potential of foundation model features for accelerated MRI reconstruction and provide insights into their effective integration into unrolled reconstruction networks.

AI.tldr: 提出FM-Recon框架，将冻结的基础模型图像编码器特征提炼并融入展开式重建网络，用于加速心脏电影MRI重建，并在CMRxRecon2023上系统评估其有效性。
AI.motivation: 基础模型在多种医学影像任务中已展现强特征提取能力，但其在MRI重建中的潜力尚未充分探索，尤其是如何融入展开式重建网络、以及在含伪影输入下的表现。
AI.method: FM-Recon：从冻结的基础模型图像编码器提取特征，经提炼后集成到展开式（unrolled）重建网络中；在CMRxRecon2023数据集上针对不同重建设置系统评估基础模型特征的作用。
AI.result: 基础模型能够从伪影污染的输入中提取有信息量的表征并提升重建性能，且在中等加速倍数下改善尤为明显。
AI.conclusion: 基础模型特征对加速MRI重建具有潜力，并为其在展开式重建网络中的有效集成提供了经验性洞见。

title: GRAZE: Text-Free Grasp Synthesis for Unseen Objects from Human Gaze
summary: Text-conditioned hand-object interaction (HOI) generation provides intuitive semantic control, but language is an indirect way to specify where an interaction should occur on an object. Naming the part to grasp requires object-specific words, and naming the approach side requires a reference frame that a prompt lacks. We propose GRAZE (GRAsp from gaZE), which generates hand-object grasp motion from recorded gaze instead of object and part names. Its Geometry-Aware Gaze Encoding (GeoGaze) maps gaze rays to cues on object geometry, and cross-attention conditions a diffusion Transformer on these cues. We also introduce HOT3D-Grasp, a grasp-centered benchmark with object-disjoint folds built on HOT3D recordings. On unseen objects, GRAZE grasps the target part more often than the strongest text-conditioned baseline (49.3% vs. 43.6%), achieves the highest grasp success (66.3% vs. 46.6%), and transfers without fine-tuning to GazeHOI (45.3% vs. 33.8%). Gaze conveys the approach side: when gaze is rotated around the object, the approach turns with it in 59.1% of cases, against 20.5% for a text model retrained with clock words. On the same backbone, a text prompt names parts better, but gaze adds the approach side. Given both, GRAZE keeps the prompt's part accuracy and follows gaze.

AI.tldr: GRAZE 用记录的视线（gaze）替代物体/部件名称作为条件，生成抓取动作；其几何感知视线编码将视线射线映射为物体几何上的线索，经交叉注意力注入扩散 Transformer，在未见物体上抓取目标部件率 49.3%（文本最强基线 43.6%）、抓取成功率 66.3%（46.6%），并可零微调迁移到 GazeHOI（45.3% vs 33.8%）。
AI.motivation: 文本条件是间接的空间指定方式：点名要抓的部件需要物体专有词汇，指定接近方向则缺少提示词所能提供的参考坐标系。因此需要一种更直接、更直观地表达"抓哪里、从哪边接近"的交互条件。
AI.method: 提出 GRAZE（GRAsp from gaZE）：以记录视线为条件的抓取运动生成。核心为 Geometry-Aware Gaze Encoding（GeoGaze），将视线射线映射为物体几何上的线索，并通过 cross-attention 将扩散 Transformer 条件化于这些线索。同时构建 HOT3D-Grasp 基准，基于 HOT3D 录制、采用物体互斥（object-disjoint）划分，面向抓取任务设计。
AI.result: 未见物体上，抓取目标部件频率 49.3% vs 文本基线 43.6%；抓取成功率 66.3% vs 46.6%；零微调迁移至 GazeHOI 达 45.3% vs 33.8%。视线绕物体旋转时，接近方向随之改变的比例为 59.1%，而用时钟词重训的文本模型仅 20.5%。同骨干下文本提示更擅长指定部件，视线则补足接近方向；两者同时给出时，GRAZE 保持提示词的部件准确率并遵循视线。
AI.conclusion: 视线是文本在空间指代上的有效补充条件：它天然编码接近方向，且与文本提示在部件指代上互补；二者结合可在保持部件精度的同时获得方向可控性，并具备跨数据集迁移能力。

title: MORE: Merge Once, Route Early for Training-Free Multi-Subject Composition from Large LoRA Pools
summary: Public hubs offer many personalized LoRAs per text-to-image backbone, yet composing two of them in one image remains fragile. In FLUX, keeping a pool of $K=10$ or $20$ subject LoRAs loaded makes their deltas interfere, and even loading only the two requested LoRAs keeps both subjects in fewer than 4% of images: one subject vanishes, the two fuse, or the image splits into a collage. We present MORE (Merge Once, Route Early), a training-free two-stage pipeline for FLUX. Merge once: the whole pool is folded into a single fixed-rank adapter by the subspace-regression router of SSR-Merge, made reliable by ridge, rank and calibration choices, and factored exactly into a shared part and per-subject parts. Route early: during the first 30% of the denoising steps each subject's part is gated to its layout region; a decaying soft attention bias ties every region to its own subject tokens, and a cyclic swap guidance extrapolates away from the prediction with the subjects' regions permuted, which counteracts region homogenization. On held-out seeds, MORE keeps both subjects in 94.2% ($K=10$) and 78.3% ($K=20$) of images, against 50.8% / 35.8% for FreeFuse and 25.0% / 24.2% for LoRAShop, and reaches an ImageReward of 1.32 (best baseline 0.07), while all $K$ subjects stay in one adapter. With layouts inferred automatically it still keeps both subjects in 70.0% / 55.0% of images.

AI.tldr: MORE 是一种免训练的两阶段 FLUX 多 LoRA 组合流水线：先将整个 LoRA 池一次性合并为单一固定秩适配器（SSR-Merge），再在去噪前 30% 步内按布局区域对每个主体做早期路由门控，从而在同一图像中同时保留两个主体。
AI.motivation: 公共 Hub 上针对同一文生图主干存在大量个性化 LoRA，但在一张图中组合两个 LoRA 极为脆弱：在 FLUX 中加载 K=10/20 个主体 LoRA 时其 delta 相互干扰，即便只加载所需两个 LoRA，两主体同时出现的图像也不足 4%，表现为主体消失、融合或拼贴化。
AI.method: 两阶段、免训练。① Merge once：用 SSR-Merge 的子空间回归路由器把整个 LoRA 池折叠为单个固定秩适配器，通过岭回归、秩与校准选择提升可靠性，并精确分解为共享部分与逐主体部分。② Route early：在去噪前 30% 步内将每个主体部分门控到其布局区域；用衰减软注意力偏置把每个区域绑定到对应主体 token；并用循环交换引导（区域置换后外推）抑制区域同质化。
AI.result: 在留出种子上，MORE 使两主体同时保留率达 94.2%（K=10）与 78.3%（K=20），对比 FreeFuse 的 50.8%/35.8%、LoRAShop 的 25.0%/24.2%；ImageReward 达 1.32（最佳基线 0.07），且全部 K 个主体仍驻留于单一适配器。布局自动推断时仍达 70.0%/55.0%。
AI.conclusion: 将"合并一次 + 早期路由"结合，可在单一适配器内以显著优势解决 FLUX 多 LoRA 组合的主体保持问题，且无需训练、支持大池规模与自动布局推断。

title: What Makes a Good Move? Learning to Act from Experience in Visual Worlds
summary: Learning visual policies requires turning interaction experience into guidance for individual decisions. Trajectory outcomes obscure action quality, while unguided exploration can revisit familiar situations. We present \textsc{LightAct}, an experience-learning framework that connects skill-guided exploration with policy internalization. Interaction segments are summarized into experience entries and consolidated into a game-specific skill that guides root collection toward broader state coverage. At each root, candidate actions are compared through short rollouts under a shared frozen policy. Environment-reported score gains are averaged across continuations and normalized into relative action rewards, producing reusable supervision for reinforcement learning. Policy training uses a compact dataset of just 1,024 decision roots collected in a single source game and paired with their action rewards. Across 170 GameWorld tasks spanning 34 games, \textsc{LightAct} improves overall progress by 23.6, 29.2, and 13.0 percentage points at the 2B, 4B, and 9B scales, respectively, with our strongest model competitive with reported proprietary-model results. Ablations show broader root-state coverage with skill guidance and consistent gains across three policy optimizers. Case studies show how rollouts distinguish actions with identical immediate gains.

AI.tldr: LightAct 是一个经验学习框架，将技能引导的探索与策略内化相结合：用短 rollout 在共享冻结策略下比较根节点候选动作，生成可复用的相对动作奖励监督，仅用单游戏 1024 个决策根的数据即可显著提升多游戏视觉策略表现。
AI.motivation: 轨迹级别的结果信号掩盖了单个动作的质量，难以直接作为决策监督；而无引导的探索又容易反复访问已熟悉的状态。因此需要一种既能扩大状态覆盖、又能为单步决策提供可靠监督的经验学习方法。
AI.method: 1) 将交互片段总结为经验条目，并整合为游戏专用技能，引导根状态收集以扩大状态覆盖；2) 在每个根节点，对候选动作在共享冻结策略下做短 rollout 比较；3) 将环境报告的分差在多个续接上取平均并归一化为相对动作奖励；4) 用该奖励作为可复用监督进行强化学习策略训练；训练数据仅为单一源游戏中采集的 1024 个决策根及其动作奖励。
AI.result: 在覆盖 34 个游戏的 170 个 GameWorld 任务上，LightAct 在 2B、4B、9B 规模分别将整体进度提升 23.6、29.2、13.0 个百分点，最强模型与已报道的专有模型结果相当。消融实验表明技能引导带来更广的根状态覆盖，且在三种策略优化器上均取得一致增益。案例分析显示 rollout 能区分即时收益相同的不同动作。
AI.conclusion: 以技能引导探索收集高质量决策根、并以短 rollout 估计相对动作奖励，是一种数据高效且跨游戏迁移有效的视觉策略学习范式；其性能提升主要来源于状态覆盖扩展与细粒度动作监督。

title: Dataset Distillation for Handwritten Text Recognition: An Empirical Study
summary: Dataset distillation (DD) replaces large training datasets with smaller synthetic ones to reduce computational costs. While traditionally used for classification, we present, to our knowledge, the first DD study for line-level handwritten text recognition (HTR). Unlike classification tasks, which use discrete labels, HTR employs unaligned sequences from a virtually infinite output space as labels. To adapt classification-based DD methods to this scenario, we define text pseudo-classes by clustering transcriptions based on character n-grams. We adapt gradient matching (GM), distribution matching (DM) and trajectory matching (MTT) to a Convolutional Recurrent Neural Network (CRNN) trained with Connectionist Temporal Classification (CTC). In this process, synthetic line images are generated by optimising only the pixels of real starting lines (either randomly chosen or selected as text medoids), while keeping their original transcriptions fixed. Across four datasets (IAM, George Washington, READ\,2016, LAM) and three budgets (1--10\,\% of the training lines), no distilled set outperforms its real initialisation lines. Random lines prove better than medoids, and further optimisation only degrades recognition. Methodologically, DM lowers its objective without benefit, while GM and MTT barely move theirs. We turn these findings into guidelines for evaluating data compression in HTR.

AI.tldr: 首个面向行级手写文本识别（HTR）的数据集蒸馏研究：以字符 n-gram 聚类转录构建"文本伪类"，将 GM/DM/MTT 迁移到 CTC-CRNN；在 4 个数据集、3 种预算下，所有蒸馏集均未超过其真实初始化行，随机行优于 medoid，进一步优化反而降低识别率。
AI.motivation: 数据集蒸馏（DD）可降低训练成本，但此前主要针对分类任务。HTR 的标签是非对齐序列、输出空间近乎无限，与离散标签分类本质不同，因此需要验证分类 DD 方法能否迁移到行级 HTR，并明确其失效边界。
AI.method: 基于转录本的字符 n-gram 聚类定义文本伪类，使分类式 DD 可用；将梯度匹配（GM）、分布匹配（DM）、轨迹匹配（MTT）适配到以 CTC 训练的 CRNN；合成行图像仅优化真实起始行（随机选取或文本 medoid）的像素，转录保持固定。
AI.result: 在 IAM、George Washington、READ 2016、LAM 四个数据集及 1%–10% 训练行预算下，无任何蒸馏集优于其真实初始化行；随机行优于 medoid；额外优化仅导致识别性能下降。机制上，DM 目标值下降但无收益，GM 与 MTT 目标几乎不动。
AI.conclusion: 分类式 DD 不能直接有效迁移到行级 HTR；作者据此提出 HTR 数据压缩评估的准则，强调以真实行初始化作为基线、避免"目标下降即有效"的误判。

title: ReAccess: Look Once, Stay Focused with Efficient Test Time Memory
summary: Despite recent advances, vision-language models (VLMs) still struggle with fine-grained visual understanding, often failing to effectively utilize critical evidence already encoded in their visual representations. Existing approaches address this limitation through repeated visual processing or explicit reasoning, introducing substantial computational overhead. In this paper, we propose ReAccess, a lightweight framework that preserves and reuses question-relevant visual evidence through compact associative memory. Constructed during a single visual prefill, the memory supports progressive evidence retrieval that steers both attention queries and hidden representations, enabling effective visual grounding without repeated image encoding or explicit reasoning traces. Extensive experiments demonstrate consistent improvements in both general visual understanding and fine-grained perception, while achieving substantially faster inference than existing reasoning-intensive approaches, demonstrating a promising path to efficient multimodal reasoning.

AI.tldr: ReAccess是一个轻量框架，通过紧凑的联想记忆在单次视觉预填充中保留并复用与问题相关的视觉证据，实现渐进式证据检索以引导注意力查询和隐藏表示，从而在不重复编码图像或生成显式推理轨迹的情况下提升细粒度视觉理解，并显著加快推理速度。
AI.motivation: 视觉语言模型（VLM）在细粒度视觉理解上仍存在不足，常无法有效利用其视觉表示中已编码的关键证据；现有方法依赖重复视觉处理或显式推理，带来显著的计算开销。
AI.method: 提出ReAccess轻量框架：在单次视觉预填充阶段构建紧凑的联想记忆，用于保存与问题相关的视觉证据；通过渐进式证据检索来引导注意力查询（attention queries）与隐藏表示（hidden representations），实现有效视觉定位，且无需重复图像编码或显式推理轨迹。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，在通用视觉理解与细粒度感知任务上均取得一致性提升，同时推理速度显著快于现有的推理密集型方法。
AI.conclusion: ReAccess为高效多模态推理提供了一条有前景的路径，兼顾细粒度视觉理解的性能与推理效率。

title: Certified, Not Explained: Exact Token Erasure in Gated Vision State Space Models
summary: Vision models built on Mamba are often explained through their selective step size Delta, on the assumption that a token the scan does not admit cannot influence the prediction. We test that in a concept bottleneck model for lung-nodule malignancy built on a single gated, bidirectional selective state-space block. The answer becomes an interpretability framework: a guarantee, a procedure that checks it, and a pre-registered audit of what it explains. For a fixed gate pattern, masking the input of the causal convolution of the block and giving closed tokens zero weight at readout makes the concept and task logits exactly invariant to the closed tokens. Gating Delta is neither necessary nor sufficient. On LIDC-IDRI, a path-by-path knockout over 15 cross-validated models agrees with this in every run: the largest logit change is exactly 0 whenever the conditions hold and between 4.1 and 6.7 when they do not. The gated model reaches a pooled out-of-fold AUROC of 0.8425 +/- 0.0085, level with an ungated Mamba bottleneck (0.8428). The guarantee belongs to the masked model, not to the gate as an explanation. Post-hoc rankers, which inherit the guarantee on this model, order tokens better than the gate. Gate maps from a model trained on permuted labels are as close to the real maps as two real-label seeds are to each other. Under retraining, the tokens of the gate carry more task information than random tokens and, on shifted crops, more than central ones, but no more than the tokens chosen by hidden attention. We therefore read the gate as a certified support set produced by mask supervision. Splitting the Oracle Impurity Score into own-concept and cross-concept parts reveals differences the aggregate score misses. Partitioning the readout reduced leakage slightly under an earlier recipe, and the final model sits at, rather than below, the level implied by correlations among the true concepts.

AI.tldr: 本文检验了视觉Mamba中"选择性步长Δ的门控解释"这一常见假设，提出一个可证明的可解释性框架（保证、检验程序、预注册审计），在肺结节恶性概念瓶颈模型上证明：在固定门控模式下，对因果卷积输入掩码并对被关闭token在读出时置零，可使概念与任务logits对关闭token严格不变；门控Δ既不必要也不充分。
AI.motivation: 视觉Mamba常被用选择性步长Δ来解释，隐含假设"扫描未接纳的token不影响预测"。作者要检验这一假设，并回答门控到底解释了模型什么。
AI.method: 构建基于单个门控双向选择性状态空间块的概念瓶颈模型（肺结节恶性，LIDC-IDRI）。用形式化保证+检验程序+预注册审计：对因果卷积输入掩码、关闭token读出置零、固定门控模式；对15个交叉验证模型做逐路径敲除（path-by-path knockout）；与无门控Mamba瓶颈对比；考察事后排序器、置换标签门控图、重训练下token信息量、Oracle Impurity Score分解及读出分区。
AI.result: 逐路径敲除在所有运行中与理论一致：条件满足时最大logit变化恰为0，否则为4.1–6.7。门控模型pooled out-of-fold AUROC 0.8425±0.0085，与无门控（0.8428）持平。事后排序器在本模型上继承该保证且排序优于门控。置换标签训练出的门控图与真实图的接近程度，与两个真实标签种子之间相当。重训练下门控token信息量高于随机token、在偏移裁剪上高于中心token，但不高于隐藏注意力所选token。Oracle Impurity Score分拆后揭示出聚合分数遗漏的差异；读出分区在早期配方下略微降低泄漏，最终模型处于而非低于真实概念相关性所隐含的水平。
AI.conclusion: 保证归属于掩码模型而非门控本身；门控不应被当作解释，而应读作由掩码监督产生的"认证支持集"。可解释性应被审计而非默认接受。

title: Efficient Multi-View Generation with Iterative Global-Local Proxy Attention
comment: 10 pages, 6 figures, 5 tables. Supplementary material is available as an ancillary file
summary: Generating consistent multi-view RGB images and normal maps from a single input image provides complementary appearance and geometric cues for 3D reconstruction. However, maintaining cross-view consistency requires information exchange across viewpoints, and dense cross-view attention becomes computationally expensive as the number of views and spatial resolution increase. In this paper, we propose Global-Local Proxy Attention (GLPA) to reduce cross-view communication costs while preserving fine-grained within-view processing. Specifically, GLPA retains full-resolution interactions within each view and uses compact global proxies for cross-view communication. To further leverage the exchanged information, GLPA incorporates iterative proxy refinement, which rebuilds the proxies from updated features and reuses the same attention parameters for subsequent interactions within a single denoising step. We evaluate GLPA on two structurally different diffusion backbones, FLUX and Stable Diffusion. Experiments on FLUX show that GLPA achieves a $2.65\times$ speedup in attention computation per denoising step over dense attention, while improving reconstruction IoU from 0.6849 to 0.7019 and reducing NVS LPIPS from 0.086 to 0.076. Results on Stable Diffusion further demonstrate the effectiveness of GLPA, with a $1.80\times$ attention speedup and improvements across all five quality metrics.

AI.tldr: 提出全局-局部代理注意力（GLPA），用紧凑全局代理替代稠密跨视图注意力，在保持视图内全分辨率处理的同时显著降低多视图生成的计算成本并提升重建质量。
AI.motivation: 从单图生成多视图RGB与法线图可为3D重建提供外观与几何互补线索，但跨视图一致性需视图间信息交换，而稠密跨视图注意力的开销随视图数与分辨率增长迅速膨胀。
AI.method: GLPA在各视图内部保留全分辨率交互，跨视图通信仅通过紧凑的全局代理完成；并引入迭代代理精化，在单次去噪步内由更新后的特征重建代理并复用同一套注意力参数进行后续交互。在FLUX与Stable Diffusion两种扩散骨干上评估。
AI.result: FLUX上每去噪步注意力计算取得2.65×加速，重建IoU由0.6849提升至0.7019，NVS LPIPS由0.086降至0.076；Stable Diffusion上注意力加速1.80×，五项质量指标全部提升。
AI.conclusion: 以代理式跨视图通信替代稠密注意力，可在大幅降低计算量的同时改善多视图生成的一致性与3D重建质量，且方法对不同扩散骨干具有通用性。

title: Isolating Perception for Multi-View Planning under Occlusion-Induced Partial Observability
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) are beginning to saturate visual planning benchmarks, yet they fail to resolve depth ambiguity and degrade sharply with problem size under occlusion-induced partial observability (PO). We introduce BW-PO based on the Blocksworld domain, a controlled benchmark that reduces existing VLM planners and formalizers to near-zero performance, and propose VLM-as-perceiver, a paradigm that narrows the VLM's role to local perception while delegating cross-view evidence reconciliation and plan generation to external solvers. Across model-specific challenging subsets of BW-PO, this raises plan success from 1% to 97% for Gemma-4-31B, 0% to 95% for Qwen3.5-122B-A10B, and 3% to 84% for Gemini-3.1-Pro. Isolating perception in this way separates two bottlenecks that are otherwise entangled: reconciliation under depth ambiguity, and completeness of visual extraction under scene density.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 BW-PO 基准（基于 Blocksworld，含遮挡导致的深度歧义与部分可观测），使现有 VLM 规划器几乎失效；并提出 VLM-as-perceiver 范式，将 VLM 限定为局部感知，跨视角证据调和与规划交给外部求解器，使规划成功率从 1%→97%（Gemma-4-31B）、0%→95%（Qwen3.5-122B-A10B）、3%→84%（Gemini-3.1-Pro）。
AI.motivation: VLM 在视觉规划基准上趋于饱和，但遇到遮挡引起深度歧义与部分可观测（PO）时性能骤降，且随问题规模增大而迅速退化。现有评估将"感知"与"规划/推理"耦合，无法定位瓶颈所在。
