AI.method: 基于 Blocksworld 构建受控基准 BW-PO，引入遮挡导致的深度歧义与部分可观测性；提出 VLM-as-perceiver 范式：VLM 仅负责局部视角的视觉抽取，跨视角证据调和与计划生成交由外部求解器完成；并在模型特定的困难子集上做对照评估。
AI.result: 现有 VLM 规划器与形式化器在 BW-PO 上性能接近零；采用 VLM-as-perceiver 后，困难子集的规划成功率分别由 1% 提升至 97%（Gemma-4-31B）、0% 至 95%（Qwen3.5-122B-A10B）、3% 至 84%（Gemini-3.1-Pro）。
AI.conclusion: 将感知与推理解耦可分离原本纠缠的两个瓶颈：深度歧义下的证据调和，以及高场景密度下视觉抽取的完备性；说明端到端 VLM 规划失败主要源于感知与跨视角整合能力不足，而非规划本身。

title: When Do Histology Foundation Models Need Geometric Test-Time Augmentation?
summary: Test-time augmentation (TTA) aggregates model predictions across multiple transformed views of an input during inference. Because histology images lack a canonical orientation, $D_4$ TTA---pooling across the 8 rotations and reflections of a square---is a standard default in computational pathology. However, the rise of self-supervised histology foundation models (FMs) with inherent rotational invariance calls its continued utility into question. We benchmark 9 histology FMs and 6 general-purpose models across four patch-level and two whole-slide image (WSI) datasets. We find that $D_4$ TTA remains a reliable post hoc improvement, but benefits diminish from $+1.98$ percentage points (pp) for general-purpose backbones to $+0.50$ pp for histology FMs on TCGA-UT, and shrink further for the largest models. To eliminate computational overhead, our experiments demonstrate that entropy routing---applying TTA selectively to uncertain predictions---recovers most of the gain while augmenting only ${\sim}13\%$ of samples. Finally, we show that patch-level TTA improvements do not transfer to slide-level multiple instance learning (MIL). Code: https://github.com/lars-chen/histology-tta

AI.tldr: 该论文系统性评估D4测试时增强（TTA）在病理基础模型上的价值：D4 TTA仍是可靠的事后提升手段，但对自监督病理基础模型增益递减；熵路由可选择性应用TTA以在约13%样本上恢复大部分收益；斑块级TTA提升无法迁移到切片级MIL。
AI.motivation: 组织学图像缺乏规范朝向，D4 TTA（8种旋转/反射视图聚合）是计算病理学的默认做法。然而具备固有旋转不变性的自监督病理基础模型（FMs）大量出现，使D4 TTA是否仍有必要成为疑问，作者因而对其持续效用进行基准检验。
AI.method: 在4个斑块级数据集和2个全切片图像（WSI）数据集上，基准测试9个病理基础模型与6个通用模型；比较D4 TTA的增益幅度与模型类型/规模的关系；提出"熵路由"（entropy routing）策略，仅对预测不确定性高的样本施加TTA；并检验斑块级TTA增益向切片级多示例学习（MIL）的迁移性。
AI.result: D4 TTA仍是可靠的事后改进，但增益从通用骨干的+1.98个百分点（pp）降至TCGA-UT上病理FMs的+0.50 pp，且模型越大增益越小。熵路由仅对约13%样本施加TTA即可恢复大部分增益，同时消除计算开销。斑块级TTA改进不能迁移到切片级MIL。
AI.conclusion: D4 TTA对病理基础模型的边际价值下降，建议用熵路由按需应用以降低计算成本；斑块级TTA结论不可外推到WSI/MIL场景，需分别评估。

title: Criterion-Activated Preference Synthesis: Attribution-Preserving Preference Data from Explicit Standards
summary: Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) is notoriously sensitive to attribution ambiguity: when chosen and rejected responses differ along multiple entangled dimensions, the model cannot identify which behavior the preference label teaches. We propose Criterion-Activated Preference Synthesis (CAPS), a criterion-first framework that turns explicit quality standards into attribution-verified preference pairs. CAPS synthesizes contexts and responses from a target criterion, then applies dual-signal scoring: a rubric-bound judge measures criterion compliance, while a blind general judge measures holistic quality. Two filters close the attribution loop: the Empirical Activation Test (EAT) keeps criterion-context pairs where satisfying the criterion improves blind quality, and the Attribution Ratio (AR) keeps pairs whose quality gap is dominated by the target criterion. Instantiated with general rubrics, medical rubrics, and Chinese legal statutes, CAPS shows strong data efficiency and domain transfer. With 20k general synthetic pairs, it outperforms 35k human-annotated HelpSteer3 pairs on IFEval, IFBench, AlpacaEval, and Creative Writing v3. In domain settings, CAPS improves HealthBench with 2k medical pairs and improves Qwen3-8B/14B by +4.9 to +6.6 points on legal benchmarks using only public statutes, without human preference labels. We additionally construct the CAPS-Legal preference dataset.

AI.tldr: CAPS：以显式质量标准为先、通过双重信号打分与两道过滤（EAT、AR）合成“归因可验证”的偏好数据，缓解DPO的归因歧义，在通用与领域任务上以更少数据超越人工偏好数据。
AI.motivation: DPO对“归因歧义”高度敏感：当chosen与rejected响应在多个纠缠维度上同时存在差异时，模型无法判断偏好标签究竟在教哪种行为，导致偏好信号被混淆、训练效率低。
AI.method: 提出Criterion-Activated Preference Synthesis（CAPS），一个“标准优先”框架：1）围绕目标标准合成上下文与响应；2）双信号打分——由绑定评分细则（rubric）的评判器度量标准符合度，由盲测的通用评判器度量整体质量；3）双重过滤闭合归因环路：Empirical Activation Test（EAT）保留“满足该标准确实提升盲测整体质量”的标准-上下文对，Attribution Ratio（AR）保留质量差距主要由目标标准主导的样本对。以通用rubric、医学rubric、中国法律条文三种实例化实现。
AI.result: 20k通用合成偏好对在IFEval、IFBench、AlpacaEval与Creative Writing v3上超过35k人工标注的HelpSteer3数据；领域设置下，2k医学偏好对提升HealthBench；仅用公开法律条文，在无人工偏好标签情况下使Qwen3-8B/14B在法律基准上提升+4.9至+6.6分。此外构建了CAPS-Legal偏好数据集。
AI.conclusion: 显式标准驱动、归因可验证的偏好数据合成能显著提升DPO的数据效率与领域迁移能力，可在少量合成数据下替代大规模人工偏好标注，并具备跨领域（通用、医学、法律）的可实例化性。

title: Multimodal Fusion: A Review of Breast Cancer Advanced and Traditional Modalities
summary: Purpose: Multimodal medical imaging fusion (MMIF) is an increasingly important approach to breast cancer detection (BCD), as different imaging modalities rely on different physical principles and provide complementary information. No single modality can capture all the structural, functional, and biological information needed for accurate diagnosis and characterization. Methods: This review examines more than 15 imaging modalities used in breast cancer detection, including conventional techniques such as mammography, ultrasound, and magnetic resonance imaging (MRI), as well as emerging approaches such as thermal imaging, photoacoustic imaging, microwave imaging, and multimodal microscopy. Results: Mammography, ultrasound, and MRI remain among the most widely used modalities, providing complementary structural and functional information. Recent AI advances have enabled fusion at the data, feature, and decision levels, with applications in detection, classification, segmentation, prognosis, and personalized cancer management. Multimodal approaches increasingly combine imaging data with clinical, histopathological, and genomic information. However, important challenges remain, including limited availability of large and diverse multimodal datasets, variations in imaging protocols, missing modalities, limited external validation, and the need for interpretable and clinically reliable AI models. Conclusion: MMIF offers promising opportunities to improve breast cancer detection and characterization by combining complementary imaging and non-imaging information. Future research should prioritize robust fusion strategies, standardized and diverse datasets, multicenter validation, explainable and privacy-preserving AI, and the integration of imaging with clinical and molecular data to facilitate reliable translation into clinical practice.

AI.tldr: 该综述系统梳理了乳腺癌检测中15种以上成像模态及其多模态融合（MMIF）方法，指出数据级、特征级与决策级AI融合在检测、分类、分割、预后等任务中的应用前景，并强调数据稀缺、协议差异、模态缺失与可解释性等挑战。
AI.motivation: 单一成像模态受限于不同物理原理，无法同时刻画结构性、功能性与生物学信息，因此需要多模态医学影像融合（MMIF）以获取互补信息，提升乳腺癌检测与表征的准确性。
AI.method: 文献综述：考察超过15种乳腺癌成像模态，涵盖乳腺X线、超声、MRI等常规技术与热成像、光声成像、微波成像、多模态显微等新兴技术，并归纳数据级、特征级、决策级三类AI融合策略，以及影像与临床、组织病理、基因组信息的联合建模。
AI.result: 常规三模态提供互补的结构与功能信息；AI融合已用于检测、分类、分割、预后与个体化管理；多模态方法日益整合影像与非影像数据。主要瓶颈包括大规模多样化数据集匮乏、成像协议差异、模态缺失、外部验证不足以及AI模型可解释性与临床可靠性不足。
AI.conclusion: MMIF在提升乳腺癌检测与表征方面潜力显著；未来应聚焦稳健融合策略、标准化多样化数据集、多中心验证、可解释与隐私保护AI，以及影像-临床-分子数据整合，以推动临床转化。

title: Winning the Leaderboard, Losing the Distribution: Diagnosing and Mitigating Acoustic Narrowing in Low-Resource ASR
comment: 29 pages, 12 figures. Code, per-utterance outputs and fact ledger: https://github.com/RsGoksel/acoustic-narrowing
summary: For a low-resource language, one public leaderboard is often the only shared measure of progress, so optimizing toward it means optimizing toward a test distribution. Our low-rank fine-tune of whisper-large-v3-turbo ranked first on MediaSpeech, Common Voice 17 and a five-set Turkish community board, at 9.02% word error on MediaSpeech against 11.93% for the best baseline. On its private split it lost to unmodified whisper-large-v3. We treat that split as an alarm, not evidence; the main finding does not depend on it. On a twenty-condition FLEURS-TR benchmark built independently of our model selection, the unmodified base beats every fine-tune in every condition, and all five deficits clear zero under paired bootstrap. We call this acoustic narrowing: fine-tuning contracts the acoustic range a model serves well. The central finding is methodological: our in-house proxy for detecting narrowing concealed it instead, ranking the narrowed fine-tune above the sturdier base. Model selection needs a proxy from an independently produced distribution; more of the same source will not do. A rebuilt pipeline reduces the narrowing: a larger mixture with disclosed provenance, a higher-capacity base, and base-referenced selection with trajectory averaging. It wins three same-provenance axes and draws level on FLEURS-TR, 8.16% against 8.26%, interval spanning zero. Parity holds under a second inference stack and a full epoch, decoder fixed. The recovery is one trajectory, a demonstration rather than a validated recipe. In Kazakh the inversion reappears on corpora we did not build. With matched trainable-parameter shares, fine-tuning raised out-of-pool error by 2.23 points for an attention encoder-decoder and lowered it by 3.46 for a CTC encoder-only model, across three seeds each. Narrowing thus depends on the system adapted. We release TurkSpeak Bench, a robustness-first Turkish ASR leaderboard.

AI.tldr: 低资源语言ASR微调会"声学收窄"，且同源代理榜单掩盖该问题；需采用异源代理做模型选择。
AI.motivation: 低资源语言常只有一个公开榜单作为唯一共享进度度量，优化该榜单即等于优化测试分布，存在过拟合测试分布的风险，作者由此审视微调与模型选择的有效性。
AI.method: 对 whisper-large-v3-turbo 做低秩微调，在 MediaSpeech、Common Voice 17 及土耳其社区榜单上评测；构建独立于模型选择的 20 条件 FLEURS-TR 基准，用配对 bootstrap 检验；重建流水线（更大且来源公开的数据混合、更高容量基座、基座参照选择+轨迹平均）；在 Kazakh 上以匹配可训练参数比例对比 attention 编码器-解码器与 CTC 编码器-仅两种架构，各三随机种子。
AI.result: 微调模型在 MediaSpeech 达 9.02% WER（最佳基线 11.93%），但私有划分上输给未修改的 whisper-large-v3；FLEURS-TR 上未修改基座在全部 20 条件下均优于各微调模型，五项差距的配对 bootstrap 区间均不含零；同源代理榜单反而把收窄后的模型排得更高；重建流水线在同源三轴上取胜、FLEURS-TR 打平（8.16% vs 8.26%，区间跨零），并在另一推理栈与整轮训练下保持一致；Kazakh 上微调使 attention 模型池外误差升 2.23 点，CTC 模型降 3.46 点。
AI.conclusion: 核心结论为方法学层面：检测"声学收窄"需来自独立产生分布的代理，同源数据加量无济于事；收窄程度取决于被适配的系统；重建流水线仅为单条轨迹的示例而非经验证的配方；发布 TurkSpeak Bench 稳健性优先的土耳其语 ASR 榜单。

title: CondRelBench: A Mixed-Domain Benchmark for Condition-Scoped Relation Understanding
comment: 37 pages, 2 figures, 28 tables. Code and data are available online
summary: Relation extraction systems often identify what a relation is, but not the condition under which it holds. This can collapse condition-bound claims into unsupported generalizations, a failure we call relation overgeneralization. We introduce CondRelBench, a mixed-domain benchmark for evaluating condition-scoped relation understanding. Each claim is represented as (E1, R, E2 | C), where C is the condition licensing the relation. Using 3,000 synthetic paragraphs, 200 PubMed full-text papers, and 695 Reddit posts, we construct five probe variants per tuple that preserve, replace, remove, or contradict the condition, or contradict the relation itself. Models classify each probe as Supported, Not Supported, or Not Enough Evidence. We also introduce Overgeneralization Rate (OGR) and Scope Preservation Score (SPS) to measure false support for altered claims and consistency across probe families. Across prompted LLMs, fine-tuned LLMs, and encoder models, we find that Accuracy and Macro F1 often hide scope failures. Models frequently support the original scoped claim but fail when its condition is removed or altered. Domain-specific encoders achieve the strongest scope preservation, while instruction-tuned LLMs often show higher overgeneralization. Synthetic supervision helps but does not close the gap to real-world PubMed and Reddit performance.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"关系过度泛化"(relation overgeneralization)问题:关系抽取系统常只识别关系是什么,而忽略关系成立的条件。为此构建CondRelBench基准,将论断表示为(E1, R, E2 | C),并为每个元组生成保留/替换/删除/否定条件、以及否定关系的五种探针变体,引入OGR与SPS两个指标。结果显示常规Accuracy/Macro F1掩盖了范围(scope)失效问题,领域专用编码器范围保持能力最强,指令微调LLM过度泛化更严重。
AI.motivation: 现有关系抽取系统通常只判断关系是否成立(what a relation is),而不建模关系成立的条件(under which condition it holds)。这会把"条件约束下的论断"错误地当作无条件普适结论,即关系过度泛化,造成不支持的泛化性主张。现有评测缺乏针对条件范围(condition scope)的系统性评估手段。
AI.method: 构建混合域基准CondRelBench:每个论断表示为(E1, R, E2 | C),C为许可该关系的条件。数据来源包括3,000个合成段落、200篇PubMed全文论文、695条Reddit帖子。每个元组构造5种探针变体:保留条件、替换条件、删除条件、与条件矛盾、与关系本身矛盾。模型需将每个探针分类为Supported / Not Supported / Not Enough Evidence。提出两个指标:Overgeneralization Rate (OGR)衡量对被篡改论断的虚假支持率,Scope Preservation Score (SPS)衡量跨探针族的一致性。评测覆盖提示式LLM、微调LLM和编码器模型。
AI.result: Accuracy与Macro F1常掩盖范围失效;模型往往能支持原始的带条件论断,但在条件被删除或替换时失败;领域专用编码器在范围保持上表现最佳,而指令微调LLM往往过度泛化率更高;合成数据监督虽有帮助,但未能弥合与真实PubMed、Reddit场景性能之间的差距。
AI.conclusion: 关系理解需从"关系是什么"扩展到"在何条件下成立";传统分类指标不足以评估条件范围能力,需用OGR/SPS等专门指标。领域专精模型在范围保持上占优,指令微调模型存在过度泛化风险,合成监督难以替代真实域数据。CondRelBench为条件范围化关系理解提供了系统评测框架。

title: The Judge Is Not Impartial: Self-Preference in Medical LLM Evaluation
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to evaluate model-generated medical content, creating a potential circularity: an LLM judge may favor outputs generated by the same model independently of clinical quality. To characterize LLM judge self-preference in medical settings, we measured same-model affinity in single-turn specialist question answering and multi-turn standardized-patient encounters. We evaluated eight models, two from OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, and Qwen, on 620 real point of care questions from clinicians (Real-POCQi). The same eight models also generated and judged 200 standardized patient-clinician scenarios (MedSP1000) up to 8 visible turns. In total, our analysis spans 13,760 LLM judgments. We define three complementary measures of self-preference. Answer Rank Bias, our primary measure, compared the rank assigned to a fixed response by its own-model judge with its average rank from outside judges. Answer Score Bias made the analogous comparison using rubric scores. Own-Answer Win Rate measured how often a judge ranked its own model's response above a competitor. Higher values across all these measures indicate greater degrees of self-preference. In Real-POCQi, pooled Answer Rank Bias was $+1.22$ positions, and all eight judges favored their own answers. Self-preference persisted both with and without a grading rubric. Revealing generator identities modestly weakened self-preference by an average of $-0.094$ positions. In MedSP1000, pooled Answer Rank Bias ranged from $+0.53$ to $+0.62$ positions, with no clear difference by conversation length ($p=0.17$). LLM judges systematically favored responses generated by their own models across multiple formats. Clinical AI deployments should exercise increased vigilance including multiple evaluation measures and judge panels spanning differing model families when deploying LLM-as-a-judge systems.

AI.tldr: 该研究系统量化了医学场景下LLM评审的"自我偏好"：八个模型在单轮专业问答与多轮标准化病人对话中均偏向自生成答案，Answer Rank Bias分别达+1.22与+0.53~+0.62位次。
AI.motivation: LLM日益被用于评估模型生成的医学内容，可能产生循环性问题：同一模型既生成又评判时，评审可能偏好自身输出而偏离临床质量本身，故需在医学情境中刻画这种自我偏好。
AI.method: 选取OpenAI、Anthropic、Google、Qwen各两个共八个模型；在620道真实临床即时问题(Real-POCQi)单轮问答及200个标准化医患情境(MedSP1000，最多8个可见轮次)上共获得13,760次LLM评判。定义三项互补指标：Answer Rank Bias(核心指标，自身评审给予的排名与外部评审平均排名之差)、Answer Score Bias(基于评分细则的分数差)、Own-Answer Win Rate(自模型回答胜过竞争者的频率)，并检验评分细则与生成者身份披露的影响。
AI.result: Real-POCQi中合并Answer Rank Bias为+1.22位，八个评审全部偏好自身答案；有无评分细则时自我偏好均持续存在；披露生成者身份仅小幅削弱(−0.094位)。MedSP1000中合并Answer Rank Bias为+0.53~+0.62位，且不随对话长度变化(p=0.17)。
AI.conclusion: LLM评审在多种任务格式下系统性偏好同源模型输出，说明应提高临床AI部署中的警惕，采用多维度评估指标并组建跨模型家族的评审小组，以缓解LLM-as-a-judge的自我偏好偏差。

title: Enhanced English-Sanskrit Translation using Multilingual NMT Approach
summary: Neural Machine Translation (NMT) is a widely accepted technique of automatic translation tasks of Natural Language Processing. However, NMT requires a sufficient amount of parallel corpora to attain a reasonable translation quality. In this work, we have considered a low-resource English-Sanskrit pair for English-to-Sanskrit and Sanskrit-to-English translation. We have performed a comparative analysis by exploring bilingual and multilingual approaches using LSTM-based Sequence-to-Sequence, and fine-tuning a pretrained model IndicTrans in a multilingual NMT approach. To investigate multilingual transfer learning, we additionally construct multilingual translation settings by incorporating Hindi along with English and Sanskrit using language-tagged data. Experimental results demonstrate that IndicTrans-based multilingual models outperform baseline results in terms of automatic evaluation metrics such as BLEU and ChrF for both directions of translation.

AI.tldr: 本文针对低资源英梵（English-Sanskrit）双向翻译，比较了基于LSTM的Seq2Seq双语/多语方法与微调预训练模型IndicTrans的多语方法，并通过引入印地语构建带语言标记的多语数据实现迁移学习；实验表明IndicTrans多语模型在BLEU与ChrF上均优于基线。
AI.motivation: NMT虽广泛用于自动翻译，但需要充足的平行语料才能达到合理质量；英语-梵语属低资源语言对，亟需探索如何在语料稀缺条件下提升双向翻译性能。
AI.method: 以英语-梵语为研究对象，构建双语与多语两种设置：一方面采用LSTM-based Sequence-to-Sequence进行双语和多语建模，另一方面在多语NMT框架下微调预训练模型IndicTrans；为研究多语迁移学习，额外将印地语与英语、梵语组合，并使用语言标记（language-tagged）数据构造多语翻译设置。
AI.result: 在英→梵与梵→英两个翻译方向上，基于IndicTrans的多语模型在BLEU和ChrF等自动评价指标上均优于基线结果。
AI.conclusion: 对低资源英梵翻译而言，借助预训练多语模型（IndicTrans）并结合语言标记的多语数据（含印地语）进行微调，比LSTM-Seq2Seq基线更有效，体现了多语迁移学习在低资源场景下的优势。

title: Profiling Hallucinations in Frontier LLMs for Entity Linking to Medical Ontologies
comment: The 8th Workshop on Clinical Natural Language Processing at LREC 2026
summary: The integration of Large Language Models (LLMs) into healthcare promises to revolutionize clinical documentation and interoperability, yet reliability remains a concern. This study presents a comprehensive analysis of hallucinations by frontier LLMs tasked with mapping clinical text to SNOMED CT. Through rigorous experimentation, we identify a critical reliability gap: LLMs hallucinate medical codes at a rate that currently renders them unsuitable for autonomous clinical coding applications. Paradoxically, constraining models to use ground-truth mention spans exacerbates, rather than mitigates, these hallucinations. We further contribute a taxonomy of hallucination types--including deprecated codes and cross-ontology errors--and demonstrate that general-purpose LLMs significantly underperform compared to specialized zero-shot entity linking approaches. These findings underscore the need for robust verification mechanisms before clinical deployment.

AI.tldr: 该研究系统评估前沿LLM将临床文本映射到SNOMED CT时的幻觉问题，发现其幻觉率过高，目前不适合自主临床编码，且限制模型使用真实mention span反而加剧幻觉。
AI.motivation: LLM融入医疗有望革新临床文档与互操作性，但其可靠性存疑，尤其缺乏对临床编码任务中幻觉行为的系统性分析。
AI.method: 以临床文本到SNOMED CT概念映射为任务，对前沿LLM开展严谨实验，对比通用LLM与专用零样本实体链接方法，并构建幻觉类型分类体系（含废弃编码、跨本体错误等）。
AI.result: LLM以当前水平幻觉生成医疗编码，无法用于自主临床编码；提供真实mention span约束后幻觉反而加重；通用LLM显著劣于专用零样本实体链接方法。
AI.conclusion: 临床部署前亟需稳健的验证机制，通用LLM不足以替代专用实体链接方案。

title: Whose Side Are You On? Measuring Stance at Scale for Reddit Discourse Analysis During the Israel-Gaza War
summary: Large-scale discourse analysis often requires stance labels, yet for many high-salience political events such labels are unavailable at the comment level. We introduce and validate a comment-level stance measurement instrument that assigns Pro-Israel, Pro-Palestinian, or Undefined stance using Reddit comment text. The instrument is calibrated from a small, manually annotated gold-standard dataset and scaled through large language model-assisted labeling, achieving weighted-$F_{1}=0.88$ against held-out human annotations. To enable corpus-scale measurement, we operationalize the instrument as a lightweight classifier based on DistilBERT embeddings and an RBF SVM, which achieves weighted-$F_{1}=0.7935$ on the original gold-standard set. Applying this instrument, we measure the stance of approximately 2.7 million Reddit comments posted between 2023 and 2025 during the Israel-Gaza war. We demonstrate what this measurement enables by analyzing stance-conditioned asymmetries in sentiment, toxicity, and emotional framing across political affiliations. This work shows how validated, low-cost stance measurement can support large-scale descriptive analysis of polarized discourse, without relying on network structure or prior labeled corpora.

AI.tldr: 提出并验证了一种评论级立场测量工具，用LLM辅助标注+DistilBERT/RBF-SVM轻量分类器，对2023–2025年约270万条Reddit评论进行立场测量，并据此分析情感、毒性与情绪框架的立场条件性不对称。
AI.motivation: 大规模话语分析需要立场标签，但许多高关注度政治事件的评论级立场标签缺失；现有方法依赖网络结构或已有标注语料，成本高、难以规模化。
AI.method: 以小型人工标注金标准集校准测量工具，将评论标注为Pro-Israel、Pro-Palestinian或Undefined；通过大语言模型辅助标注扩展数据；再以DistilBERT嵌入+RBF SVM实现轻量分类器用于语料级测量。
AI.result: LLM辅助标注相对留出人工标注达到加权F1=0.88；轻量分类器在金标准集上加权F1=0.7935；应用于2023–2025年约270万条Reddit评论，展示情感、毒性和情绪框架的立场条件性不对称。
AI.conclusion: 经校验的低成本立场测量可在不依赖网络结构和预先标注语料的情况下，支撑极化话语的大规模描述性分析。

title: Mapping the Afterlife of Future Work Statements in NLP Research
summary: Future work statements are one of the few places in scientific papers where authors explicitly describe what they think should happen next. We study what happens to such statements after publication. We construct a dataset of 72,070 future work items extracted from 23,113 ACL Anthology papers published between 1979 and 2025, categorize them by type, retrieve candidate follow-up papers through citation-based and content-based search, and use LLM-based judgments to assess whether later papers pursue the proposed directions. Using this resource, we analyze patterns across time, venues, categories, themes, and authors. We find that many items are later addressed, often within a few years, with clear differences across types and themes and a largely community-driven pattern. Our results suggest that future work statements provide useful evidence for studying how research directions develop in NLP. To support further research, we release our dataset at: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.20385239.

AI.tldr: 该文构建了72,070条未来工作条目数据集，追踪其被后续论文落实的情况，发现许多提议在数年内被实现，且呈社区驱动模式。
AI.motivation: 未来工作陈述是作者明确表达后续研究方向的少数位置，但其发布后是否被真正跟进缺乏系统研究。
AI.method: 从1979–2025年ACL Anthology的23,113篇论文中抽取72,070条未来工作条目并按类型分类；通过基于引用与基于内容的检索获取候选后续论文，再用LLM判断其是否沿该方向推进；据此分析时间、会议/期刊、类别、主题与作者维度的模式。
AI.result: 大量未来工作条目在数年内被后续研究涉及，不同类别与主题间差异明显，整体呈现社区驱动的特征。
AI.conclusion: 未来工作陈述可作为研究NLP研究方向演化的有效证据，数据集已公开以支持后续研究。

title: Wrong with Confidence: Measuring Hallucination, Overconfidence and Identity-Conditioned Behaviour in Large Language Models
comment: 10 pages, 2 figures. Data and code are included as ancillary files
summary: Large language models answer underspecified questions readily, and accuracy-only evaluation rewards guessing over abstaining. Observational studies link query underspecification to hallucination, but they cannot separate the effect of missing information from item difficulty, and they rarely ask what the model tells the user. We report a pre-registered, paired behavioural study of five open-weight models (Gemma 3 27B, Gemma 4 31B, gpt-oss-120b, Qwen3-Next-80B-A3B and Nemotron 3 Super). Each of 142 factual questions was posed in a fully specified form and in a referentially underspecified form with the same answer key, and three probes measured identity-conditioned behaviour. Two raters scored 5,620 responses under a fixed rubric; effects were estimated with mixed-effects models. Without the referent, the models sought clarification on 33.7% of prompts and answered the rest. Among attempted answers, the error rate rose from 39.1% to 52.0% (mixed-effects odds ratio 4.12, 95% CI 2.76-6.14), and specialist-domain questions failed more often than general ones in every model. Unelicited verbal uncertainty did not track this risk: 75.3% of wrong answers carried no hedge, wrong answers to underspecified prompts were hedged no more often than wrong answers to clear prompts (27.3% vs 22.3%), and hedging separated correct from incorrect answers only weakly (AUROC 0.56). Gendered pronouns followed occupational stereotypes whenever a model committed to one; any stated user identity lengthened answers by about 45% relative to an anonymous user; claimed expertise did not reduce safety caveats. The models either ask or answer as if the question were well posed, and the wording of a guess does not reveal that it is one. Evaluations should score clarification as a distinct outcome and check label validity as well as rater agreement.

AI.tldr: 一项预注册配对行为研究（5个开放权重模型、142题、5,620条评分回答）表明：指称不明确时模型仅33.7%寻求澄清，其余照答且错误率由39.1%升至52.0%（OR=4.12）；未受激发的语言不确定性无法反映该风险（75.3%的错误回答毫无模糊限定，AUROC仅0.56），提示评测应将"澄清"作为独立结果类别。
AI.motivation: 仅以准确性为导向的评测会奖励"猜测"而非"弃答"，而观察性研究虽把查询欠明确与幻觉相联系，却无法将"信息缺失"的效应与"题目难度"分离，也极少考察模型对用户说了什么。因此需要一个预注册、配对设计来因果性地隔离指称不明确的影响，并检验模型自发表述的不确定性是否对应该风险。
AI.method: 预注册配对行为研究：选取5个开放权重模型（Gemma 3 27B、Gemma 4 31B、gpt-oss-120b、Qwen3-Next-80B-A3B、Nemotron 3 Super）；142个事实性问题各有"完全明确"与"指称不明确"两种版本，答案键相同；三个探针测量身份条件化行为；两名评分者按固定评分细则对5,620条回答评分；效应用混合效应模型估计。
AI.result: 无指称时模型仅在33.7%的提示上寻求澄清。对实际作答部分，错误率从39.1%升至52.0%（混合效应OR=4.12，95% CI 2.76–6.14），且所有模型中专业领域问题比一般问题更易失败。自发语言不确定性未追踪该风险：75.3%的错误回答不含任何模糊限定；不明确提示的错误回答被模糊限定的比例并不高于明确提示（27.3% vs 22.3%），模糊限定区分对错的效力也很弱（AUROC 0.56）。一旦模型作出承诺，性别代词即随职业刻板印象；任何明示的用户身份使回答长度较匿名用户增加约45%；自称专家并未减少安全提示。
AI.conclusion: 模型要么提问、要么把问题当作表述良好来作答，而猜测的措辞并不能暴露其为猜测。评测应把"寻求澄清"作为独立结果类别单独计分，并且除评分者一致性外还应检验标签效度。

title: A Systematic Study of Cross-Token Transfer for Data-Efficient Non-Verbal Text-to-Speech
summary: Non-verbal vocalizations (NVs), such as laughter and breath, carry affective cues that words alone do not convey. Yet NV data remains scarce because speech annotation pipelines often omit or normalize these events. Existing work has improved NV text-to-speech through model design and data curation, but whether one NV token can help a model learn another has received little systematic study. We investigate this cross-token transferability in a controlled CosyVoice 2 setup. We first trace a laughter-only scaling curve, then hold laughter at 200 or 1,600 examples while adding breath, sigh, cough, lip-smack, or neutral speech. With only 200 laughter examples, adding 3,200 cough examples raises end-to-end laughter F1 from 0.170 to 0.529, surpassing the 0.495 obtained from 1,600 laughter examples alone. At the 1,600-example anchor, cough reaches 0.695, nearly matching 6,400 laughter examples (0.697). Waveform-level Whisper-D scoring and a semantic-token transcriber show consistent trends. Cross-token transfer therefore offers a complementary route to low-resource NV generation.

AI.tldr: 研究非语言发声（NV）之间的跨token迁移性：在CosyVoice 2受控设置下发现，加入咳嗽样本可显著提升笑声生成性能，甚至超越同量笑声数据。
AI.motivation: 笑声、呼吸等非语言发声承载词语无法传达的情感线索，但相关数据稀缺——语音标注流程常忽略或归一化这些事件。已有工作通过模型设计与数据整理改进NV的TTS，但"一种NV token能否帮助模型学习另一种NV"缺乏系统研究。
AI.method: 在受控的CosyVoice 2框架中研究跨token迁移性：先绘制仅用笑声的缩放曲线；随后将笑声固定为200或1600条，分别加入呼吸、叹息、咳嗽、咂嘴或中性语音数据。
AI.result: 仅200条笑声时，加入3200条咳嗽使端到端笑声F1由0.170升至0.529，超过1600条纯笑声的0.495；在1600条锚点上，咳嗽达0.695，接近6400条纯笑声的0.697。波形级Whisper-D评分与语义token转写器呈现一致趋势。
AI.conclusion: 跨token迁移为低资源NV生成提供了补充路径。

title: Low-Latency LLM-Based Streaming Multi-Talker ASR with Verifiable Rewards
summary: LLM-based architectures offer strong generalization and instruction-following capabilities for streaming automatic speech recognition (ASR), but multi-talker use introduces coupled transcription, attribution, and latency challenges. Our wearable setting requires real-time transcription of a conversation between a near-field device wearer and a far-field partner. Because partial hypotheses are rendered on persistent sides of a dialogue UI, speaker roles cannot be permuted and each speaker tag must precede its turn. These sparse tags are weakly optimized by supervised fine-tuning (SFT), while committing to a leading tag can delay the text that follows. We therefore post-train a streaming LLM-based ASR model with reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR), combining a fixed-role Speaker-Attributed WER (SA-WER) grader with a turn-level onset-delay reward. On an eight-direction multi-talker cohort, SA-WER RL reduces SA-WER from $20.51\%$ for SFT to $13.14\%$. Adding the delay objective reduces onset $p50$ by $65\%$ (from $0.918\,\text{s}$ to $0.320\,\text{s}$) and $p90$ by $44\%$ (from $1.389\,\text{s}$ to $0.780\,\text{s}$) relative to SA-WER-only RL, while achieving $12.70\%$ SA-WER. These results demonstrate that fixed-role recognition quality and streaming responsiveness can be improved jointly.

AI.tldr: 该文提出用可验证奖励强化学习（RLVR）对基于LLM的流式ASR进行后训练，联合优化固定角色说话人归属性WER与轮次起始延迟，在可穿戴多说话人场景下同时提升识别质量与流式响应速度。
AI.motivation: 可穿戴设备需实时转写近场佩戴者与远场对话者之间的交谈，由于对话UI两侧固定归属，说话人角色不可置换，且每个说话人标签必须前置；这类稀疏标签在SFT中优化不足，而强制先输出标签又会延后后续文本，导致转写、归属与延迟三重耦合难题。
AI.method: 对流式LLM-based ASR模型进行强化学习后训练（RLVR），奖励由两部分构成：固定角色的Speaker-Attributed WER（SA-WER）评分器，以及轮次级起始延迟奖励（onset-delay reward）。
AI.result: 在八方向多说话人测试集上，SA-WER强化学习将SA-WER从SFT的20.51%降至13.14%；叠加延迟目标后，相对仅SA-WER RL，起始延迟p50降低65%（0.918s→0.320s）、p90降低44%（1.389s→0.780s），同时SA-WER达到12.70%。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明固定角色识别质量与流式响应性可被联合提升，RLVR是缓解稀疏标签监督与标签前置延迟问题的有效手段。

title: Latency, Speech Recognition and Turn-Taking in Voice Agents for Spanish Phone Negotiation: An Externally Measured Comparison of Pipecat, LiveKit and GPT-Live
comment: 12 pages, 6 figures, 11 tables. Code and data: https://github.com/AILabFr8tech/voice-negotiation-agents (archived at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.24211550)
summary: A voice agent that negotiates by phone must answer quickly, understand spoken amounts and cope with a caller who talks over it. We compared three architectures for such an agent, negotiating freight rates in Spanish: two cascades (speech recognition, language model and speech synthesis) orchestrated by Pipecat and by LiveKit Agents, and GPT-Live, an OpenAI speech model that listens and speaks without separate stages. A program played the carrier with the same 47 recordings of one speaker for all agents, without the telephone network, in 77 calls per architecture over five negotiation scenarios, and measured latency on the listener's side with a validated instrument. Median latency to the content response was 2,616.0 ms (Pipecat), 3,090.0 ms (LiveKit) and 2,444.8 ms (GPT-Live); the confidence interval of GPT-Live's 171.2 ms advantage over Pipecat includes zero. According to its own timestamps, GPT-Live began to answer 800 ms after the end of the line, close to the 0.8 s published by OpenAI; most of the remaining wait, about 1,367 ms and nearly constant, is the audio's round trip through OpenAI's service. A tool call added 0.9-1.1 s in every architecture, more than any difference between them, and the frameworks' self-reported latency fell short of the listener's wait by 9% (Pipecat) and 22% (LiveKit). Word error rates were low (6.03, 4.93 and 1.47%), but the error on amounts was 13.01% and 12.61% in the cascades, against 2.86% in GPT-Live. With default settings, Pipecat and LiveKit stopped at almost every backchannel and often took it as the carrier's answer: an "ok" spoken over the agent ended in a registered agreement in 3 of 15 Pipecat calls, 2 of 15 LiveKit calls and no GPT-Live call (descriptive counts, not tested). Latency should therefore be measured on the listener's side, and a cascade needs safeguards for spoken amounts and backchannels.

AI.tldr: 在西班牙语运费谈判语音代理中，三种架构（Pipecat、LiveKit 级联与 GPT-Live 端到端）的听众侧中位延迟分别为 2616.0、3090.0、2444.8 ms，差异不显著；真正影响体验的是工具调用开销（+0.9–1.1 s）与级联在金额识别和插话处理上的缺陷。
AI.motivation: 电话谈判场景要求语音代理快速应答、准确理解口头金额，并能应对听者插话（backchannel）。现有比较多依赖框架自报指标，缺乏在听众侧可测量、可复现的架构对比，因此需要一个统一实验来量化三种架构的真实等待时间与鲁棒性差异。
AI.method: 构建西班牙语运费费率谈判代理，比较三种架构：Pipecat 与 LiveKit Agents 编排的两套级联（ASR+LLM+TTS），以及 OpenAI 的无分段语音模型 GPT-Live。由一个程序扮演承运方，对全部代理回放同一说话人的 47 段录音，不经过电话网络；每种架构在五个谈判场景下各进行 77 通通话，并用经验证的量测仪器在听众侧测量延迟；同时统计词错误率、金额错误率与插话（"ok"）被误判为答复的比例。
AI.result: 内容响应中位延迟为 2616.0 ms（Pipecat）、3090.0 ms（LiveKit）、2444.8 ms（GPT-Live）；GPT-Live 相对 Pipecat 的 171.2 ms 优势置信区间包含零。按自身时间戳，GPT-Live 在句末后 800 ms 开始应答，接近 OpenAI 公布的 0.8 s；其余约 1367 ms 几乎恒定为经 OpenAI 服务的音频往返。工具调用在各架构中增加 0.9–1.1 s，超过架构间差异。框架自报延迟比听众实际等待分别低 9%（Pipecat）与 22%（LiveKit）。词错误率为 6.03%、4.93%、1.47%；金额错误率为 13.01%、12.61%（级联）对 2.86%（GPT-Live）。默认设置下，Pipecat 与 LiveKit 几乎在每个 backchannel 处停顿，并常误当作承运方答复："ok" 导致的误登记协议在 Pipecat 为 3/15、LiveKit 为 2/15、GPT-Live 为 0（描述性计数，未做检验）。
AI.conclusion: 延迟应在听众侧测量，而非采信框架自报；端到端语音模型在金额识别与插话处理上明显占优，而级联架构必须为口头金额与 backchannel 增设防护机制；工具调用是延迟的主要可控来源，优先于架构选型。

title: The Geometry of Conceptors in Neural-Activation Spaces
summary: Conceptors represent concepts as graded collections of directions in neural-activation space rather than as single vectors. We develop a geometric account of how these representations depend on the contrast used to define a concept: opposing values in bipolar fitting, or presence and absence in unipolar fitting. We derive an exact decomposition of a centered pooled conceptor into an average pole filter, a mean-separation update, and a covariance-shape update. Experiments across five language models on sentiment, political leaning and stance, and depression expression show that both updates improve reconstruction of held-out contrasts. Additional directions preserve variation beyond the mean-difference line, and changing the comparator changes the benefit of these directions. Shape, size, and overlap each show up downstream: in amplification experiments, bipolar fits raise evidence for both poles more consistently than unipolar fits; conceptor size (the quota) correlates positively with layerwise probe performance; and cross-concept overlap quantifies interference under subspace removal, linking shared directions to Boolean composition. In an additional generation evaluation, conceptor filters achieve higher target-expression win rates against an unsteered reference than three mean-based controls. Together, these findings explain how fitting choices shape conceptor geometry and support bipolar fitting when the objective is to amplify both opposing poles.

AI.tldr: 该论文从几何角度分析conceptor表示如何依赖对比定义（双极的对立值 vs 单极的存在/缺失），给出中心化池化conceptor的精确分解为平均极滤波器、均值分离更新和协方差形状更新，并在五个语言模型上验证这些成分对下游效果的影响。
AI.motivation: 现有conceptor将概念表示为神经激活空间中的方向集合，但缺乏对"对比如何定义概念"（双极vs单极拟合）如何影响表示几何的系统说明，因此需要建立几何理论来解释拟合选择如何塑造conceptor几何及其下游效应。
AI.method: 推导中心化池化conceptor的精确分解：平均极滤波器 + 均值分离更新 + 协方差形状更新；在五个语言模型上针对情感、政治倾向与立场、抑郁表达等概念进行实验，比较双极与单极拟合，并进行放大实验、逐层探针实验、子空间移除干扰实验及生成评估（对比三种均值基线）。
AI.result: 两种更新均提升留出对比的重构；额外方向保留均值差线之外的变异，且更换比较器会改变这些方向的收益；双极拟合比单极拟合更一致地提升对立两极的证据；conceptor规模（配额）与逐层探针性能正相关；跨概念重叠可量化子空间移除下的干扰并联系布尔组合；生成评估中conceptor滤波器相对未引导参照的目标表达胜率高于三种均值基线。
AI.conclusion: 拟合选择系统性地塑造conceptor几何（形状、规模、重叠），并影响放大、探针性能、干扰与生成等下游表现；当目标是同时放大对立两极时，应优先采用双极拟合。

title: GPBam: A Retrieval-Aware German Public Law Exam Benchmark
comment: Extended version of a paper accepted at the 39th International Conference on Legal Knowledge and Information Systems (JURIX 2026). 43 pages, 4 figures, 12 tables
summary: Legal reasoning in civil-law systems is not rule-lookup: the German state examination asks for a structured opinion (Gutachten) that names the governing norms, applies them to the facts, and argues to a conclusion. We introduce GPBam (German Public Law Bar-style Exam), 81 public-law examination cases with reference solutions, paired with a recitation task over 200 statutory provisions. Drawn from state examination preparation, the cases are broad and rarely repeat, and are not publicly available - we find no evidence of exact-solution memorisation in the models we evaluate, and keeping them private limits contamination. Because each reference solution's cited norms form a retrieval gold set over the very instances the essays are graded on, GPBam scores retrieval and long-form generation jointly, which makes it a benchmark for legal retrieval as well as for legal writing and lets us ask how much retrieval quality a legal opinion actually needs. Across 32 open-weight and proprietary models evaluated without retrieval, scores span 4.81-76.42 out of 100. Supplying the law helps modestly: across seven models and eight retrieval configurations, retrieval performance varies nearly threefold and buys at most 4.1 essay points, and nothing significant for three of the seven, while an oracle with 91% gold-norm recall improves scores by 2-6 points. Essay quality strongly tracks prior knowledge: verbatim statute recall, measured in a separate task, correlates at $ρ= 0.92$ over 32 models.

AI.tldr: 论文提出GPBam基准，含81个德国公法考试案例及参考答案，并配套200条法条的背诵任务；在无检索条件下评估32个模型，得分4.81–76.42分；检索对写作提升有限（最多4.1分，7个模型中3个不显著），论文质量主要由先验知识决定（法条背诵与得分的相关系数ρ=0.92）。
AI.motivation: 民法法系的法律推理并非规则检索，而是结构化的Gutachten文书写作；现有基准缺乏对检索与长文生成联合评估、且难度高、不易重复的私密案例集，因此需要一个能同时衡量法律检索与法律写作、并考察"检索质量对法律意见究竟有多必要"的基准。
AI.method: 构建GPBam：81个德国公法国家考试案例（带参考答案，来源为备考材料，案例面广、重复少、非公开以防污染），并配对200条法条的背诵任务。参考答案引用的法条构成针对同一评分实例的检索金标准集，从而可联合评估检索与长文生成。实验：32个开源与专有模型在无检索条件下评估；7个模型×8种检索配置；oracle检索（91%金标准法条召回）；另设独立法条逐字背诵任务并与论文得分做相关分析。
AI.result: 无检索时得分跨度4.81–76.42/100；未发现精确答案记忆证据。检索性能在不同配置间相差近三倍，但对论文得分最多仅提升4.1分，7个模型中3个提升不显著；oracle检索（91%金标准法条召回）仅提升2–6分。法条逐字背诵能力与论文质量高度相关（32模型上ρ=0.92）。
AI.conclusion: 法律意见生成质量主要由模型的先验法律知识决定，而非检索供给；单纯补入法条收益有限。GPBam可作为法律检索与法律写作的联合基准，并支持"高质量法律文书需要多少检索"这一问题的量化研究。

title: Can decision models extract clinical data from cancer pathology reports? An evaluation of accuracy, calibration, and failure modes
summary: Decision models are a new class of language model that, instead of generating text, choose one option per question from a fixed list and return a probability for every option. They have not yet been evaluated on clinical text. We evaluated two open-weights decision models, Nimble 9B and Tev1 4B, for extracting 25 fields from 1,113 oral cavity cancer pathology reports from a single centre, against a prospectively maintained clinical database. We compared them with two generative models: Qwen3.5 9B, run locally, and GLM-5.3-flash, run through a cloud API. Tev1 reached a mean field accuracy of 0.917 (95% CI 0.913 to 0.920), the same as Qwen3.5 9B (0.918; p = 0.26), and was four times faster (15 s against 61 s per report). Nimble reached 0.862 and GLM-5.3-flash 0.986. Both decision models matched GLM-5.3-flash on simple dichotomous categories. They were weak on measurements binned into categories, on fields whose correct answer was not reported, and on some complex decisions (e.g. involved margins). We found that the main cause of the inferior performance of Nimble's came from asking 25 questions in one request: with two questions per request, its accuracy improved. Pooled over fields, the returned probabilities were well calibrated (expected calibration error 0.022 and 0.026), but they did not flag systematic errors within single fields. A simulated strategy of sending answers with a probability below 0.94 to GLM-5.3-flash raised Tev1's accuracy to 0.982, with 38% of answers escalated. Decision models can extract explicitly stated findings from pathology reports quickly on local hardware and return useful probabilities. They should be validated in the configuration in which they will be used, restricted to the fields in which they are reliable, and combined with other methods for numeric values.

AI.tldr: 本文首次在临床文本上评估"决策模型"（每问题从固定选项中选择并输出概率）。Tev1 4B 的平均字段准确率为 0.917，与本地生成模型 Qwen3.5 9B 相当但快约4倍；Nimble 9B 为 0.862，云端 GLM-5.3-flash 达 0.986。概率整体校准良好（ECE 0.022/0.026），低置信度回退策略可将 Tev1 提升至 0.982。
AI.motivation: 决策模型作为不生成文本、仅从固定选项中选择并返回概率的新类语言模型，尚未在临床文本上被评估。作者希望检验其在口腔癌病理报告结构化信息抽取中的可用性、速度与概率可靠性，并与生成式模型对比。
AI.method: 从单一中心 1,113 份口腔癌病理报告中抽取 25 个字段，以维护良好的临床数据库为金标准。评估两个开源决策模型（Nimble 9B、Tev1 4B），并与本地 Qwen3.5 9B 及云端 API GLM-5.3-flash 对比；分析字段准确率、耗时、概率校准（ECE）及请求配置（25 题 vs 2 题/请求）的影响，并模拟基于阈值 0.94 的低置信度升级至 GLM-5.3-flash 的策略。
AI.result: Tev1 平均字段准确率 0.917（95% CI 0.913–0.920），与 Qwen3.5 9B（0.918，p=0.26）相当，速度约快 4 倍（15 s vs 61 s/报告）；Nimble 0.862，GLM-5.3-flash 0.986。决策模型在简单二分类上与 GLM-5.3-flash 持平，但在分箱测量值、正确答案未报告字段及复杂判断（如切缘受累）上较弱。Nimble 性能不佳主因是单请求 25 题，改为每请求 2 题后准确率提升。合并字段的返回概率校准良好（ECE 0.022 与 0.026），但无法标识单字段内的系统性误差。阈值 0.94 升级策略将 Tev1 准确率提升至 0.982，升级比例为 38%。
AI.conclusion: 决策模型可在本地硬件上快速抽取病理报告中明确陈述的发现，并返回有用的概率。应在实际使用配置下验证，限定于可靠字段，并对数值型字段结合其他方法；低置信度回退可显著提升整体准确率。

title: Bridging the Terminology Gap: A Data-Centric Alignment Framework for Multilingual Translation in Cross-Border Corporation
summary: As globalization accelerates the demand for seamless cross-border enterprise collaboration, multilingual translation remains bottlenecked by insufficient domain-specific terminology, rigid terminology translation, weak instruction-following capabilities, and high inference latency in long-instruction scenarios. To overcome these barriers, we propose Bridging the Terminology Gap (BTG), a data-centric framework. First, BTG mines cross-lingual term alignments from domain documents and leverages LLMs to synthesize terminology-rich parallel corpora. Second, a hybrid filtering strategy combining heuristics and XCOMET scoring ensures high data fidelity. Third, a two-stage training paradigm employs supervised fine-tuning (SFT) for targeted terminology injection, followed by reinforcement learning (RL) to refine output preferences, effectively balancing domain knowledge integration with model reliability. Extensive offline evaluations (e.g., XCOMET, GEMBA, Acc@T) and online human assessments demonstrate significant improvements in terminology accuracy and instruction-following capabilities, validating the effectiveness of our framework, which is now deployed on our cross-border collaboration platform.

AI.tldr: 提出数据中心框架BTG，通过跨语言术语对齐挖掘、术语丰富平行语料合成、混合过滤与SFT+RL两阶段训练，显著提升跨语言企业翻译的术语准确性和指令遵循能力，并已上线部署。
AI.motivation: 全球化下跨边境企业协作需求增长，但多语言翻译受限于领域术语不足、术语翻译僵化、指令遵循能力弱以及长指令场景推理时延高四大瓶颈。
AI.method: BTG为数据中心框架：1）从领域文档挖掘跨语言术语对齐，并利用LLM合成术语密集的平行语料；2）采用启发式规则与XCOMET打分相结合的混合过滤策略保证数据保真度；3）两阶段训练：先SFT做定向术语注入，再用强化学习优化输出偏好，以平衡领域知识融入与模型可靠性。
AI.result: 离线评测（XCOMET、GEMBA、Acc@T指标）与在线人工评估均显示术语准确性和指令遵循能力显著提升，验证框架有效性。
AI.conclusion: BTG能够有效弥合领域术语鸿沟，兼顾翻译质量与模型可靠性，并已在作者的跨境协作平台实现落地部署。

title: Machine interpreting competitiveness: a discourse-sensitive comparison of meaning and target-language quality in English-Chinese simultaneous interpreting
comment: 88 pages, 4 figures, 5 tables. Includes Supplementary Information (40 pages)
summary: Machine interpreting (MI), or AI-enabled speech translation, is increasingly visible in professional and public-facing communication, yet its performance relative to human simultaneous interpreters remains insufficiently understood. Existing studies are often limited by a single discourse mode and evaluation frameworks that are not well aligned with interpreting as a discourse-level communicative activity. The present study compares five commercial MI systems with 26 human interpreters (14 professionals, 12 advanced students) on English-to-Chinese simultaneous interpreting across planned and unplanned discourse, focusing on meaning and target-language quality. In these materials, MI performance differed sharply between the two discourse modes. In the planned formal speech, the strongest system became highly competitive on meaning, entering the upper human range, and a second system also performed strongly. In the extemporaneous interview, however, no MI system approached the stronger human tiers. Code-level analysis further shows that similar overall scores often masked different error profiles. Human interpreters were more likely to preserve the broader communicative trajectory through selective omission, restructuring, and contextual inference, whereas even the best MI systems were more vulnerable to semantic distortion, discourse-tracking failures, and context-insensitive interpretation. On target-language quality, the human advantage proved more stable than on meaning. Unintelligible or nonsensical output and disfluency carryover emerge as particularly salient weaknesses in machine performance, especially in spontaneous discourse. Overall, the findings are consistent with a discourse-sensitive account of where MI appears competitive, where it remains limited, and why these distinctions matter for interpreting practice, interpreter education, and future MI development.

AI.tldr: 该研究在英译中同传任务中比较了5个商业机器口译系统与26名人类译员（14名职业、12名进阶学生），发现在计划性正式演讲中最佳机器系统在意义维度已进入人类高水平区间，但在即兴访谈中无一机器系统接近较强人类层次，且人类在语言质量上的优势更稳定。
AI.motivation: 机器口译在职业与公共传播中日益常见，但其相对人类同传的表现尚不清楚；既有研究多局限于单一话语模式，且评价框架未充分契合口译作为话语层面交际活动的本质，因此需要跨话语模式、以意义与语言质量为维度的系统比较。
AI.method: 选取5个商业机器口译系统与26名人类译员（14名职业译员、12名进阶学生），在英译中同传任务中，于计划性话语与即兴话语两种模式下进行比较，评价聚焦意义与目标语质量，并进行码级（code-level）错误类型分析。
AI.result: 机器表现随话语模式差异显著：正式演讲中最强系统意义得分进入人类高水平区间，另一系统亦表现良好；即兴访谈中无系统接近较强人类层次。总体分数相近常掩盖不同错误画像：人类更善于通过选择性省略、重组与语境推断保持整体交际脉络，机器更易出现语义扭曲、话语追踪失败与语境不敏感的解读。语言质量上人类优势更稳定，不可理解/无意义输出与不流畅迁移是机器尤为突出的弱点，在即兴话语中尤甚。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果支持一种"话语敏感"的解释框架，界定了机器口译具有竞争力与仍受限的边界及其原因，对口译实践、译员教育与未来机器口译开发具有启示意义。

title: StaleBench: Isolating Stale Retrieval in Agent Memory, and Pricing the Fix
comment: Accepted to Findings of EACL 2027. 39 pages, 3 figures. Code and data: https://github.com/thenexuslab/stalebench-release
summary: An agent that stores facts over time eventually stores several versions of the same fact. Asked a value-agnostic question - "which team does X play for now?" - a similarity retriever cannot prefer the current version, because every version matches the entity the query names. StaleBench isolates this stale-retrieval failure on 892 real updating facts, with currency labels from the source (Wikidata validity years via TempLAMA), never from a retrieval score. Our central result is that retrieval metrics can rank memory policies backwards: a retention policy and its retain-everything control return the identical statement at rank 1 for every test query, yet differ by 29.5 and 65.6 points in reader accuracy on two readers when no date is shown. Contamination@5, the metric we add, ranks them correctly where current@1 and current@5 do not. Withdrawing the lexical anchor that statements carry costs deployed keying mechanisms tens of points of freshness; entity resolution on both the write path and the query recovers most of the loss. Three deployed systems (Mem0, Graphiti, LangMem) and a reimplemented ERASE each handle supersession differently, and no single scoring convention describes all four. We release the data, a frozen evaluator, and reference baselines.

AI.tldr: 论文提出StaleBench基准，隔离记忆系统中"陈旧检索"失效问题（892条真实更新事实），指出检索指标可能将记忆策略排序颠倒，并新增Contamination@5指标以正确排序，同时分析实体消解对时效性的关键作用。
AI.motivation: 代理长期存储事实时会累积同一事实的多个版本。对于与取值无关的查询（如"X现在效力哪支球队？"），相似度检索器无法偏好最新版本，因为每个版本都与查询所指实体匹配，导致陈旧检索失败。现有检索指标缺乏对"当前性"的正确度量。
AI.method: 构建StaleBench：892条真实更新事实，时效标签来自数据源（Wikidata有效性年份，经TempLAMA），而非检索分数。对比不同记忆保留策略与其"全保留"控制组；提出新指标Contamination@5，并与current@1、current@5对比；消融语句的词汇锚点，评估实体消解（写入路径与查询端）的作用；对比Mem0、Graphiti、LangMem三个已部署系统与重实现的ERASE。
AI.result: 检索指标可将记忆策略排序颠倒：某保留策略与其全保留控制组在每个测试查询的rank-1上返回完全相同语句，但在不显示日期时，两个reader上的准确率相差29.5和65.6个百分点。Contamination@5在current@1与current@5失效处能正确排序。移除语句词汇锚点会使已部署键控机制损失数十个百分点的时效性；在写入路径与查询端都进行实体消解可挽回大部分损失。四个系统对supersession（新旧覆盖）处理各异，无单一评分惯例可描述全部。
AI.conclusion: 现有检索指标不足以衡量记忆系统时效性，需引入Contamination@5等污染感知指标；实体消解是维持时效性的关键机制；发布数据、冻结评估器与参考基线以支持后续研究。

title: Do Rule-Based Tools Help LLMs Translate Endangered Uralic Languages in the Prompt or over MCP?
comment: Accepted at the 11th International Workshop on Computational Linguistics for Uralic Languages (IWCLUL 2026), Munich. 9 pages plus appendices, 1 figure, 10 tables. Data and all model outputs: https://huggingface.co/datasets/Aragoner/UralicMCPBench
summary: Komi-Zyrian, Moksha, Erzya and Udmurt have mature rule-based resources, among them finite-state analysers, constraint grammars and bilingual dictionaries, which language models do not use. We ask whether giving a model access to these resources improves machine translation from the four languages into English, and whether it matters how the access is provided: as analyses computed in advance and written into the prompt, or as tools that the model calls itself through the Model Context Protocol (MCP). We evaluate manually: an expert linguist read every English output of the strongest model under three conditions, 816 sentences in all, accepted or rejected each one, and named the main error in every rejected translation. With the analyses in the prompt, the number of accepted translations rises from 13 to 43 out of 272; with the tools attached it rises to 55. The gain comes from the bilingual dictionary. For Udmurt, whose dictionary has no English side, the prompt-based condition brings no gain at all, while for the other three languages an English gloss reaches the prompt for 74 to 80% of the source words. Tool calling is also much harder to get working than prompt injection. Of 31 open-weight models, 14 never call a tool, 11 of them because they cannot produce a usable call, and half of the calls that are made name a language the toolkit does not support. We release the data set, every model output and all tool-call logs.

AI.tldr: 本文评估将成熟规则资源（有限状态分析器、约束语法、双语词典）以两种方式接入大模型——预先计算分析写入提示，或通过MCP让模型自行调用工具——是否改善四种乌拉尔语系语言到英语的机器翻译。
AI.motivation: Komi-Zyrian、Moksha、Erzya、Udmurt 已有成熟的规则型资源，但语言模型并未利用这些资源；作者希望检验引入这些资源能否提升低资源语言的翻译质量，并比较不同接入方式的影响。
AI.method: 人工评测：由专家语言学家对最强模型在三种条件下产出的全部816个英语译文逐句判定接受或拒绝，并标注主要错误类型；对比基线、提示注入（预计算分析）与MCP工具调用两种条件；并统计31个开放权重模型的工具调用能力。
AI.result: 提示注入使272句中被接受译文由13句升至43句，接入工具后升至55句；增益主要来自双语词典。Udmurt 词典缺少英语侧，提示条件下无任何增益；其余三语74%–80%的源词可获得英语释义。工具调用远比提示注入难以奏效：31个模型中14个从不调用工具（其中11个无法产生可用调用），已发出的调用中约一半指定了工具包不支持的语言。
AI.conclusion: 规则资源确可提升翻译质量，但增益取决于词典覆盖度，且以工具调用方式接入的实际可行性受模型能力严重限制；作者公开数据集、全部模型输出与工具调用日志。

title: What Transfers Across Cuneiform? Script-Level Substrate and Language-Specific Regularities via Segmentation and Representation
summary: Cuneiform recorded typologically unrelated languages for more than three millennia, raising a natural question: which of its statistical regularities are properties of the shared writing system, and which belong to individual languages? We answer this with two probe pairs targeting the same script-versus-language decomposition. The first compares two unsupervised, dictionary-free segmentation methods: transitional probability (TP), grounded in infant statistical-learning research, and Morfessor. To our knowledge, this is the first systematic evaluation of dictionary-free segmentation on cuneiform; the only prior published baseline relies on a hand-built dictionary (Max-Match, F1 = 0.74). Both our methods reach F1 > 0.97 within language (Morfessor reaches F1 > 0.99 on Akkadian and Sumerian), exceeding MaxMatch by more than 23 F1 points, but diverge sharply in cross-language transfer: TP holds F1 > 0.95 across all six language pairs, while Morfessor collapses to F1 = 0.27 from the 13K-token Elamite source. A learning curve and a Hittite stress test (34.7% foreign-script logograms, where TP drops 35 points and Morfessor only 8) further isolate the two underlying mechanisms. The second probe pair extends the same decomposition to representations: concatenating Unicode and Latin features improves classification in 11 of 12 morphosyntactic tasks (p < 0.01). We release CUNEI-TOOLS and a three-language benchmark.

AI.tldr: 本文通过两组"文字系统 vs 语言"对探测实验，区分楔形文字统计规律中属于共享书写系统的部分与属于个别语言的部分：第一组比较无词典无监督分词方法（TP 与 Morfessor）在语言内与跨语言迁移的表现，第二组检验 Unicode 与拉丁特征的联合表示对形态句法任务的增益。
AI.motivation: 楔形文字在三千余年间记录类型学上互不相关的多种语言，因此一个自然的问题是：其统计规律中哪些来自共享的书写系统，哪些属于具体语言。此前唯一公开的分词基线依赖手工构建词典（Max-Match，F1=0.74），缺乏无词典方法的系统评估。
AI.method: 设计两组针对同一"文字—语言"分解的探测对。(1) 分词探测：对比基于婴儿统计学习研究的转移概率（TP）与 Morfessor 两种无监督、无词典方法；辅以学习曲线和含34.7%外文文字语素的赫梯语压力测试。(2) 表示探测：将 Unicode 特征与拉丁转写特征拼接，在12项形态句法任务上分类。
AI.result: 语言内两种方法均达 F1>0.97（Morfessor 在阿卡德语与苏美尔语上>0.99），比 Max-Match 高出23个 F1 点以上；跨语言迁移上二者分化显著——TP 在全部六组语言对上保持 F1>0.95，Morfessor 从13K token 的埃兰语源迁移时跌至 F1=0.27。赫梯压力测试中 TP 下降35点而 Morfessor 仅降8点。表示探测中，特征拼接在12项任务中的11项上带来提升（p<0.01）。
AI.conclusion: 两种分词机制可被剥离：TP 更捕捉跨语言共享的文字系统规律，Morfessor 更依赖语言特定的形态模式。表示层面同样支持 Unicode 与拉丁特征互补。作者发布 CUNEI-TOOLS 与一个三语言基准。

title: SurveyWeave: An Agentic Framework for Automated Survey Generation
summary: Surveys help researchers keep up with fast-moving fields, but they take weeks to months to write. Automated survey generation (AutoSurvey) can alleviate this situation, but it is challenging to draw on hundreds to thousands of precisely scoped papers, choose among many valid structures, and stay faithful to its sources while offering insights. We present SurveyWeave, an agentic architecture that decomposes the problem into four tasks coordinated by three agents, each reviewing others' work and conducting revisions based on feedback. We also introduce WeaveEval, a five-dimension evaluation grounded in prior surveys. A comprehensive comparison shows that SurveyWeave outperforms Codex by 8 points and the strongest AutoSurvey baseline by 6 points.

AI.tldr: 提出智能体架构SurveyWeave，通过三个智能体协同完成四类子任务并相互评审修订，实现自动化综述生成；同时提出五维度评测体系WeaveEval。综合评测中SurveyWeave比Codex高8分，比最强AutoSurvey基线高6分。
AI.motivation: 综述撰写耗时数周至数月，难以跟上快速发展的领域。自动综述生成（AutoSurvey）面临三大挑战：需从数百至数千篇范围精确的论文中取材、在多种合理组织结构中取舍、在提供洞见的同时保持对来源的忠实度。
AI.method: 提出SurveyWeave：一个智能体架构，将问题分解为四个子任务，由三个智能体协调执行，每个智能体评审他人产出并依据反馈进行修订。同时提出WeaveEval，一个基于既有综述归纳的五维度评测框架。
AI.result: 综合对比实验显示，SurveyWeave较Codex高8分，较最强AutoSurvey基线高6分。
AI.conclusion: 多智能体分工、互评与迭代修订的架构能有效提升自动综述生成质量，配套的多维评测可对生成综述进行较全面的衡量。

title: When Does Label-Free Deconfounding of Document Embeddings Work?
summary: Document embeddings encode spurious attributes that can distort semantic comparisons; yet supervised erasure requires metadata that is often unavailable. We systematically investigate label-free deconfounding across corpora and embedding models. Our results show that label-free methods improve semantic utility over unprocessed embeddings, while simple geometric approaches recover much of the supervised benefit, sometimes matching metadata-supervised erasure in linear confounder recoverability and semantic utility. We identify two distinct causes of ineffective erasure: poor proxy-confounder alignment and insufficient intervention coverage. Crucially, confounder recoverability and semantic utility are distinct dimensions of deconfounding success: utility can improve despite residual confounder information, while stronger suppression does not necessarily improve utility. Moreover, reduced linear recoverability can coexist with substantial nonlinear recoverability. Together, these findings distinguish confounder discovery from intervention effectiveness and highlight the importance of evaluating nuisance suppression alongside semantic preservation.

AI.tldr: 该文系统研究无标签去混淆（label-free deconfounding），发现简单几何方法可恢复大部分监督去混淆收益，并揭示去混淆失败的两种成因（代理混淆对齐差、干预覆盖不足），强调混淆可恢复性与语义效用是两个独立评价维度。
AI.motivation: 文档嵌入会编码虚假属性，扭曲语义比较；而监督式擦除依赖往往不可得的元数据，因此需要在无标签条件下系统考察去混淆方法的有效性与评价方式。
AI.method: 跨语料、跨嵌入模型系统比较无标签去混淆方法与未处理嵌入、元数据监督擦除；采用简单几何方法作为基线与替代方案，并从线性/非线性混淆可恢复性与语义效用两方面评估。
AI.result: 无标签方法在语义效用上优于未处理嵌入；简单几何方法可恢复监督方法的大部分收益，在线性混淆可恢复性与语义效用上有时与监督擦除相当。识别出两类失效原因：代理混淆对齐不佳与干预覆盖不足。还发现效用可在残留混淆信息下提升，更强抑制未必提升效用；线性可恢复性下降可与显著非线性可恢复性并存。
AI.conclusion: 应区分"混淆发现"与"干预有效性"；评价去混淆需同时衡量干扰抑制与语义保持，单纯以混淆可恢复性下降作为成功标准并不充分。

title: On Representational and Functional Alignment of Training Data Attribution Methods for Language Models
summary: Existing approaches to training data attribution derive influence estimates from different sources of information, including gradients, model-internal states, and surface-level similarity. However, comparisons between attribution methods remain incomplete, often relying on indirect evaluations through downstream task performance. In this work, we introduce a framework for directly comparing methods along three dimensions: functional alignment, which measures correlation between full attribution vectors; representational alignment, which captures structural similarity of the representations underlying attribution; and cross-method predictability, which evaluates agreement on local pairwise ranking decisions. We observe strong representational and moderate functional alignment within paradigms. Alignment across paradigms is low and task-dependent, yet stable across models. Our results suggest that the similar downstream performance observed across paradigms in prior work can be attributed to agreement on the relative importance of documents, rather than to agreement on rankings of the full training data.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个直接比较训练数据归因（TDA）方法的统一框架，从功能对齐、表示对齐和跨方法可预测性三个维度评估不同归因方法的一致性，发现同一范式内对齐较强而跨范式对齐低且依赖任务，并指出下游性能的相似性源于对文档相对重要性的共识而非完整排序的一致。
AI.motivation: 现有TDA方法分别基于梯度、模型内部状态和表层相似度等不同信息源进行归因，但方法间比较多依赖下游任务表现的间接评估，缺乏对归因结果本身一致性的直接、系统比较。
AI.method: 构建三维度比较框架：（1）功能对齐，衡量完整归因向量间的相关性；（2）表示对齐，刻画归因背后表示的结构相似性；（3）跨方法可预测性，评估在局部成对排序决策上的一致性。
AI.result: 同一范式内表现出强表示对齐与中等功能对齐；跨范式对齐较低且依赖具体任务，但在不同模型间保持稳定。
AI.conclusion: 先前工作中观察到的跨范式相似下游性能，可归因于各方法在文档相对重要性上的一致，而非对完整训练数据排序的一致。

title: The novelty exposed: ablation, reproducibility and transparency in 40 technical reports of open-weight large language models (LLMs)
comment: Empirical study with an original dataset: 40 LLM technical reports coded by two independent model coders with script-verified quotes, plus a code-level comparison of open-weight architectures in Hugging Face transformers. 20 pages, 2 figures, 2 tables. Data, coding protocol and scripts in the ancillary files
summary: In 2025 alone, 48 new large language model (LLM) architectures were added to the Hugging Face transformers library, and many of them arrive with a technical report that presents the model as new. What is actually new in these models, and is it tested? We put this question to LLM technical reports. We look at three things: what the reference code shows about how new open-weight architectures differ from earlier ones; what 40 randomly sampled technical reports claim as new and whether they support it with ablation studies; and what they disclose for reproducibility and transparency. In the library, 39 of the 48 architectures added in 2025 take at least two of their three core blocks from another model, most often Llama, although part of this reflects how the library writes code. In the reports, 19 of 73 architectural or training novelty claims come with a controlled with/without comparison; 4 of 40 reports state more than one training run; 8 rerun the models they compare against under one setup; and 1 discloses data mixture, token count, and compute together. We also looked for known components given new names: none of five candidate cases hid its origin, though we did not study model names. We propose seven reporting rules for LLM release reports and apply them to two reports. We do not judge model quality, and an untested claim may still be true.

AI.tldr: 对2025年新增的48个开源权重LLM架构及40份技术报告进行审计，发现多数架构复用已有核心模块、新颖性主张普遍缺乏对照实验、可复现性披露严重不足，并据此提出七条报告规范。
AI.motivation: 2025年Hugging Face transformers库新增48个LLM架构，其技术报告多宣称模型"全新"，但"新在何处、是否经过检验"缺乏系统核查，本文旨在量化这一新颖性宣称与证据之间的差距。
AI.method: 三条证据链：(1) 分析参考代码，考察48个新架构与早期架构在三类核心模块上的差异；(2) 随机抽样40份技术报告，统计其架构/训练新颖性主张及是否配有消融式"有/无"对照；(3) 评估可复现性与透明度披露（训练运行次数、基线是否同设置重跑、数据混合/词元数/算力是否同时公开）。另设5个候选案例排查"旧组件换新名"，但因未研究方法名，该部分仅作补充。
AI.result: 48个架构中39个至少有两个核心模块取自其他模型（以Llama最常见），部分源于库的代码写法；73条新颖性主张中仅19条附带受控对照；40份报告中仅4份报告超过一次训练运行、8份在同一设置下重跑基线、1份同时披露数据混合与词元数与算力；5个换名候选案例均未隐瞒来源。
AI.conclusion: 当前LLM技术报告的新颖性主张与实证支撑之间存在显著落差，可复现性披露薄弱。作者提出七条LLM发布报告规范并示范应用于两份报告；研究不评价模型质量，未经检验的主张未必为假。

title: Decision 1.0: Towards Open Decision Foundation Models
summary: Intelligent software needs reusable judgments inside its control flow: selecting an action, testing a condition, or assessing evidence against a rubric. We present Decision 1.0, an open-weight family that turns textual state and runtime-defined questions into typed probability distributions. Its Choice, Noul, and Score interface lets applications specify outcomes at inference time and compose predictions into agents and workflows. Each question produces its candidate distribution without autoregressive text generation. Six models cover bidirectional encoder and causal decoder architectures, including a workflow specialist. Training draws on verifiable tasks, natural-language annotations, and workflow adaptation. On a common decision benchmark, Lux-9B achieves 84.17\% on explicit decisions and 91.25\% on inference, with a weighted overall score of 77.22\%. Results also expose gaps in composition, transfer, and probability calibration. Released weights and inference code provide a basis for developing decision models as reusable components of software.

AI.tldr: 提出 Decision 1.0 开放权重模型家族，将文本状态与运行时定义的问句映射为带类型的概率分布，通过 Choice/Noul/Score 接口在推理时指定结果类别，无需自回归生成。
AI.motivation: 智能软件的控制流中需要可复用的判断（选动作、测条件、按评分标准评估证据），而现有生成式模型以自由文本生成为主，难以直接提供可组合、可在推理时定义结果的判断组件。
AI.method: 构建含 6 个模型的家族，覆盖双向编码器与因果解码器架构，并含一个工作流专家；每个问题直接输出候选分布而不做自回归生成；训练数据来自可验证任务、自然语言标注与工作流适配。
AI.result: 在统一决策基准上，Lux-9B 显式决策达 84.17%，推理类达 91.25%，加权总分 77.22%；同时暴露了组合、迁移与概率校准方面的不足。
AI.conclusion: 开放权重与推理代码可将决策模型作为软件中的可复用组件来开发，但仍需在组合性、迁移性和校准上改进。

title: EmoTrace: Recursive Trace-Factorized Generation for Emotional Support Conversation
summary: Fundamental to effective emotional support is the iterative interpersonal dynamic wherein a supporter intervention continuously shapes the psychological trajectory of the seeker. While contemporary models capture variables at the turn level, including transient emotions and discrete strategies, they inherently treat these factors as isolated events. By retaining strictly literal dialogue histories while discarding the underlying decision logic, such architectures remain fundamentally incapable of sustaining coherent extended support. Here we introduce EmoTrace, a recursive method utilizing trace factorization to preserve explicit decision continuity throughout interactions spanning multiple turns. Departing from others, our approach formulates each conversational turn as a structured interaction increment encapsulating the evolving state of the seeker, the selected strategy, the affect of the supporter, and the ultimate textual realization. Accumulated sequentially, this trajectory of increments functions as an explicit structural trace informing subsequent interventions. Optimization of this factorized generation is achieved through two complementary mechanisms. Specifically, a value guidance mechanism aligns discrete factor selection with interaction values over an extended horizon, whereas a trace conditioning mechanism refines textual realization contingent upon the fixed strategic trace. Empirical evaluations across standard benchmarks demonstrate that EmoTrace yields substantial improvements in both strategic planning and response generation. Crucially, rollouts spanning multiple turns reveal that these retained structural traces confer compounding benefits over extended dialogues, establishing a robust mechanism for sustained affective alignment in human-machine interaction.

AI.tldr: EmoTrace是一种递归式情感支持对话方法，通过"轨迹分解"将每轮对话编码为结构化的交互增量（寻求者状态、策略、支持者情感、文本实现），并沿多轮累积形成显式结构轨迹来指导后续干预。
AI.motivation: 情感支持本质是支持者干预持续塑造寻求者心理轨迹的迭代人际动态。现有模型虽能刻画轮级变量（瞬时情绪、离散策略），却将其视为孤立事件，只保留字面对话历史而丢弃底层决策逻辑，因而无法维持连贯的长程支持。
AI.method: 提出递归方法EmoTrace，用轨迹分解（trace factorization）保留多轮交互中的显式决策连续性：将每轮对话形式化为结构化交互增量，依次累积为结构轨迹。生成优化包含两个互补机制——价值引导机制（沿扩展时域将离散因子选择与交互价值对齐）与轨迹条件机制（在固定策略轨迹下精炼文本实现）。
AI.result: 在标准基准上的实证评估显示，EmoTrace在策略规划与回复生成两方面均有显著提升；多轮rollout实验表明，保留的结构轨迹在长对话中带来累积收益。
AI.conclusion: 显式结构轨迹为长程人机交互中的持续情感对齐提供了稳健机制，验证了决策连续性建模对情感支持对话的价值。

title: Interpretability-Guided Auditing for Clinical Language Models for Discharge Prediction
summary: Clinical natural language processing (NLP) models for hospital discharge prediction are vulnerable to explicit discharge-related lexical cues in clinical notes, even when note timestamps are temporally filtered. These cues may act as proxies for future outcomes, leading models to rely on shortcut-like signals rather than clinically meaningful evidence. We propose AuditBERT-Discharge, a lightweight framework that reframes interpretability as a training-time auditing mechanism. Token-level SHAP attributions from an initial BioClinicalBERT model are used to identify highly attributed discharge-related tokens, which are subsequently masked in the training corpus before model retraining. We evaluate the framework on a retrospective cohort of elective spine surgery encounters from a single academic medical center. Qualitative attribution analysis and preliminary evaluation suggest that SHAP-guided auditing reduces reliance on explicit discharge-proxy language and yields more conservative, better-calibrated predictions, although improvements in discrimination are not uniform. These findings demonstrate the potential of interpretability-guided auditing as a practical strategy for identifying and constraining shortcut-like lexical dependencies in temporally sensitive clinical NLP tasks.

AI.tldr: 临床出院预测NLP模型易受病历中显式出院相关词汇的捷径信号影响；本文提出AuditBERT-Discharge，用SHAP归因在训练时识别并掩蔽这些token后再训练，从而降低对代理词汇的依赖并改善校准性。
AI.motivation: 临床出院预测模型即使做了时间戳过滤，仍会利用病历文本中显式的出院相关词汇作为未来结果的代理（捷径信号），而非依赖临床上有意义的证据，导致预测不可靠。
AI.method: 将可解释性重构为训练期审计机制：先用BioClinicalBERT获取token级SHAP归因，定位高归因的出院相关token，在训练语料中掩蔽这些token后重新训练模型。在单一学术医疗中心的选择性脊柱手术回顾性队列上评估。
AI.result: 定性归因分析与初步评估显示，SHAP引导的审计减少了模型对显式出院代理语言的依赖，预测更保守且校准更好，但区分度（discrimination）的改善并不一致。
AI.conclusion: 可解释性引导的审计是识别与约束时间敏感临床NLP任务中捷径式词汇依赖的可行策略，具有实际应用潜力。

title: Evaluating the Robustness of Fact-Checking LLMs on Multilingual Evidence
comment: 13 pages, 16 figures Accepted at COLM Sci-FM 2026
summary: Automated fact-checking benchmarks typically pair claims with clean, curated evidence in high-resource languages, but real-world evidence is often incomplete, misleading, or written in a language where models are weaker. We evaluate the robustness of fact-checking LLMs for different languages. Building on EuroVerdict, we construct gold evidence sets for 190 claims in each of English, German, Greek, and Romanian, then apply four corruption strategies at two severity levels. We test LLMs on a set of claims, providing them with evidence from the sets above. A rubric-based LLM-as-a-judge scores reasoning quality. Verdict accuracy proves highly sensitive to both factors: Misleading edit cut Llama 3.1 8B's English accuracy from 80.00% to 16.84%, and losses widen as language resource level decreases. Machine-translating Greek and Romanian claims into English recovers much, but not all, of the low-resource gap. Judge scores decline more slowly than accuracy, suggesting that automated reasoning evaluation underestimates degradation. These results caution against deploying LLM fact-checkers on noisy multilingual evidence, and we release our evidence datasets and evaluation code to support future work.

AI.tldr: 本文评估了事实核查LLM在多语言和含噪证据下的鲁棒性：基于EuroVerdict构建四种语言的黄金证据集，施加两类扰动并用LLM-as-a-judge评分，发现判定准确率对语言资源水平和证据质量高度敏感，且评委分数掩盖了性能退化。
AI.motivation: 现有自动化事实核查基准多采用高资源语言中干净、人工整理的证据，而现实证据常不完整、具误导性或属于模型能力较弱的语言。因此需要系统检验事实核查LLM在不同语言与噪声证据下的鲁棒性。
AI.method: 基于EuroVerdict，为英语、德语、希腊语、罗马尼亚语各190条声明构建黄金证据集，并在两个严重程度上施加四种证据破坏策略；将上述证据提供给多个LLM进行判定，同时用基于评分量规的LLM-as-a-judge模型评估推理质量。
AI.result: 判定准确率对语言资源水平和证据质量高度敏感：误导性编辑使Llama 3.1 8B的英语准确率从80.00%降至16.84%，且语言资源越低损失越大。将希腊语和罗马尼亚语声明机器翻译成英语可恢复大部分但非全部的低资源差距。评委分数下降幅度小于准确率，说明自动化推理评估低估了性能退化。
AI.conclusion: 结果警示不应在含噪的多语言证据上部署LLM事实核查器，作者公开证据数据集与评估代码以支持后续研究。

title: RGFC: Registry Grounded Function Calling with stage-decomposed evaluation
comment: 39 pages, 17 figures, 17 tables. Contains link to a dataset hosted on huggingface
summary: Tool-calling evaluations often report whether the final call matches a reference answer, but this single outcome merges different failures: choosing a function outside the available registry, violating the selected schema, or filling arguments with values not supported by the user request. These failures matter more when models must choose from larger tool registries. We introduce RFCD, a registry-scaled function-calling benchmark built from BFCL, Glaive Function Calling v2, and Tool-Call-Data, with standardized JSON-schema registries ranging from 5 to 3,000 functions. We also introduce TAAG, a deterministic stage-decomposed evaluator for registry conformance, structural completeness, and argument grounding. Across six locally served sub-4B models, three data sources, and four feedback modes, registry scale is the dominant source of degradation: single-pass TAAG pass rate drops sharply from small to large registries on all sources. Repeated feedback improves some grounding metrics but adds substantial token cost and does not consistently improve end-to-end F1. Requirement-level TAAG-R feedback gives modest gains over stage-only TAAG-S feedback, which indicates that TAAG signals are useful for analysis and correction probes but do not solve registry scaling by themselves. RFCD and TAAG provide an evaluation resource for measuring where tool-calling systems fail as registries grow.

AI.tldr: 提出RFCD基准与TAAG评估器，将工具调用失败分解为注册表一致性、结构完整性与参数接地，发现注册表规模是小模型工具调用性能退化主因。
AI.motivation: 现有工具调用评测多以"最终调用是否匹配参考答案"单一指标判定，混淆了不同失败类型（选用注册表外函数、违反schema、参数缺乏用户请求支持）；且当可选工具注册表变大时，这些失败更突出，却被单一结局指标掩盖。
AI.method: 构建RFCD基准：融合BFCL、Glaive Function Calling v2与Tool-Call-Data三个数据源，采用标准化JSON-schema注册表，规模从5到3,000个函数。设计TAAG确定性分阶段评估器，分别评测注册表一致性、结构完整性与参数接地。实验覆盖6个本地部署的4B以下小模型、3个数据源与4种反馈模式（含TAAG-S分阶段反馈与TAAG-R需求级反馈）。
AI.result: 注册表规模是性能退化的主导因素：单轮TAAG通过率在三个数据源上均随注册表增大而急剧下降。重复反馈可改善部分接地指标，但显著增加token开销且不能稳定提升端到端F1。需求级TAAG-R反馈相对仅分阶段的TAAG-S反馈仅有小幅提升。
AI.conclusion: TAAG细粒度信号适合用于分析与纠错探针，但无法单凭自身解决注册表扩展带来问题；RFCD与TAAG为衡量工具调用系统在注册表增长中的失败位置提供了评测资源。

title: When Helpful Agents Cause Financial Harm: Evaluating LLM Agent Safety in Executable Economic Worlds
comment: Accepted (Oral) at EMNLP 2026 Workshop on Financial NLP (FinNLP)
summary: As LLM agents become increasingly capable of making consequential economic decisions, their safety under economic pressures remains poorly understood. We introduce EconSafeBench, the first benchmark for systematically evaluating the safety of LLM agents in executable economic environments. EconSafeBench contains 828 cases across five economic scenarios and four categories of safety violations. A key design is the matched evaluation of three sources of safety pressure, including explicit user requests, pressure from other actors, and pressure arising from the agent's own pursuit of a performance objective. We further evaluate safety at both static and dynamic scales through 30-period interactions with persistent memory and matched controls. Across eight LLMs, all evaluated models exhibit safety violations on the static benchmark, with overall violation rates ranging from 8.5% to 40.6%. We further find that violations can occur even without an explicit unsafe request, and that initially compliant agents may begin to violate as performance pressure increases over time. These findings highlight the need for stronger safety alignment and rigorous evaluation before LLM agents are deployed in high-stakes economic environments.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 EconSafeBench——首个在可执行经济环境中系统评估 LLM 智能体安全性的基准，覆盖 5 类经济场景、4 类安全违规、共 828 个用例，并设计静态与动态（30 期持续交互+持久记忆）双尺度评估。
AI.motivation: LLM 智能体日益具备做出有经济后果决策的能力，但其在经济压力下的安全性尚缺乏系统认识，部署前缺少严谨的评估手段。
AI.method: 构建 EconSafeBench：828 个可执行经济环境用例，覆盖 5 类经济场景与 4 类安全违规；核心设计为三类安全压力的匹配评估（用户显式请求、其他行动者施压、智能体自身追求绩效目标带来的压力）；在静态基准与动态 30 期持续记忆交互（含匹配对照）两个尺度上评估 8 个 LLM。
AI.result: 8 个模型在静态基准上均出现安全违规，总体违规率为 8.5%–40.6%；违规可在缺乏显式不安全请求时发生；初始合规的智能体在绩效压力随时间累积后可能出现违规。
AI.conclusion: 现有模型在经济环境中普遍存在安全隐患，需在将 LLM 智能体部署于高风险经济场景之前加强安全对齐并开展严格评估。

title: Syntactic Complexity Convergence in Dialogue: Analysis of the Phenomenon and Application to LLM Detection
summary: We revisit the under-explored phenomenon of syntactic complexity convergence in dialogue. Extending prior topic-level analyses to full conversations, we examine five human-human datasets and a set of human-LLM dialogues. We integrate and evaluate a multidimensional set of syntactic complexity metrics to quantify structural variation in dialogue. Our analyses reveal robust syntactic complexity convergence across human-human datasets, especially in task-oriented interactions, and statistical tests confirm that these effects are not due to chance. In contrast, human-LLM dialogues show no significant convergence under individual metrics; however, linear-CKA uncovers a distinct cross-metric convergence pattern. Motivated by these differences, we use syntactic complexity as a feature for detecting LLM-involved dialogue, achieving 96\% accuracy. Our classification results demonstrate its potential without relying on likelihood-based signals such as surprisal, which require a language model as the estimator.

AI.tldr: 本文重新审视对话中的句法复杂度趋同现象，将分析从话题层面扩展到完整对话，在5个人-人数据集与人-LLM对话上评估多维句法复杂度指标。结果显示人-人对话存在稳健的句法复杂度趋同（尤其任务型交互），而人-LLM对话在单一指标上无显著趋同，但呈跨指标趋同模式；据此将句法复杂度用作检测LLM参与对话的特征，准确率达96%。
AI.motivation: 先前关于对话中句法复杂度趋同的研究多局限于话题层面，缺乏对完整对话的系统考察；同时人-LLM交互中该类结构对齐行为尚不清楚，且现有LLM文本检测方法依赖surprisal等需语言模型作为估计器的似然信号。
AI.method: 整合并评估一组多维句法复杂度指标以量化对话中的结构变异；在5个人-人数据集与一组人-LLM对话上进行对比分析，并用统计检验验证趋同效应的显著性；采用linear-CKA揭示跨指标趋同模式；进而将句法复杂度作为特征构建LLM参与对话的检测分类器。
AI.result: 人-人数据集上（尤其任务导向交互）呈现稳健的句法复杂度趋同，统计检验确认非随机；人-LLM对话在单个指标下无显著趋同，但linear-CKA显示存在独特的跨指标趋同模式；基于句法复杂度的分类器检测LLM参与对话达到96%准确率，且不依赖surprisal等似然信号。
AI.conclusion: 句法复杂度趋同是人-人对话的稳健结构特征，而在人-LLM对话中表现为跨指标层面的差异模式；该特征可作为高效、无需语言模型估计器的LLM参与对话检测信号，为对话结构对齐研究与LLM文本检测提供了新视角。

title: Theoretical Foundations of Computational Islamic Jurisprudence (Fiqh)
summary: This paper presents the theoretical foundations and a comprehensive formal system for Computational Islamic Jurisprudence (Fiqh). We begin by establishing six foundational principles that distinguish computational Fiqh from conventional natural language processing and general theological formalization. These principles define Islamic jurisprudence as a normative deductive science operating on empirically grounded facts, necessitating a dual inductive-deductive methodology, and requiring a logical foundation specifically engineered for Fiqh rather than adopted from existing formalisms. Based on these principles, we construct a three-layer stratified computational language, $\mathcal{F} = D \circ A \circ G$, consisting of: (1) an Arabic Morphological/Grammatical Grounding Engine that transforms fully vocalized Classical Arabic into language-independent Grounded Action Structures (GAS); (2) the Arabic Reified Action Calculus (ARAC) that normalizes these structures into canonical logical representations; and (3) a function-free Horn-clause Datalog engine for executable legal deduction. Furthermore, we introduce a bridging methodology (Algorithm $Ω$) that dynamically generates a Fiqh-Categorized Attribute Grammar from inductively extracted Horn clauses via an Ontological Meta-Map ($\mathcal{M}_{onto}$), seamlessly connecting the inductive extraction of legal rules to their deductive application. The paper rigorously proves the system's semantic correctness, representational completeness, termination, and decidability. Crucially, by leveraging morphosyntactic inflection markers ($δ$ modes) as structural constraints, we prove the strict unambiguity of the proposed grammar, achieving deterministic $O(n)$ linear parsing complexity. This work provides a mathematically verifiable, epistemologically grounded, and computationally tractable foundation for automated Islamic jurisprudence.

AI.tldr: 本文为"计算伊斯兰教法学"提出理论基础与完整形式系统：基于六项基础原则，构建三层分层计算语言 F = D∘A∘G（阿拉伯语形态/语法接地引擎→阿拉伯语具体化行为演算 ARAC→无函数 Horn 子句 Datalog 引擎），并以算法 Ω 与本体元映射 M_onto 桥接归纳提取与演绎适用，证明语义正确性、表示完备性、终止性与可判定性，且利用形态句法屈折标记（δ 模式）证明文法严格无歧义、确定性 O(n) 线性解析。
AI.motivation: 现有 NLP 与一般神学形式化方法不适配教法学的规范性演绎本质；需为其建立专门设计的逻辑基础，弥合教法规则从归纳提取到演绎适用的鸿沟，并提供数学可验证、计算可处理的基础。
AI.method: 先确立六项区分性原则（规范性演绎科学、经验事实接地、归纳-演绎双重方法论、专为教法学设计的逻辑基础等）；再构造三层分层语言 F = D∘A∘G：G 为形态/语法接地引擎，将全标音古典阿拉伯语转为语言无关的 Grounded Action Structures（GAS）；A 为 Arabic Reified Action Calculus（ARAC），将 GAS 规范化为规范逻辑表示；D 为无函数 Horn 子句 Datalog 执行引擎。另提出算法 Ω，经本体元映射 M_onto 从归纳提取的 Horn 子句动态生成"教法分类属性文法"，桥接归纳与演绎。
AI.result: 严格证明了系统的语义正确性、表示完备性、终止性与可判定性；以形态句法屈折标记（δ 模式）作为结构约束，证明所提文法的严格无歧义性，并获得确定性 O(n) 线性解析复杂度。
AI.conclusion: 为自动化伊斯兰教法学提供了数学可验证、认识论上有据、计算上可处理的基础框架，确立分层形式化+归纳-演绎桥接的方法论范式。

title: Human vs Machine Translation Detection: A Cross-Model, Cross-Domain, and Low-Resource Analysis
comment: 20 pages, 6 figures, 12 tables. Accepted at the Conference on Language Modeling (COLM) 2026. Code: https://github.com/Yabsera-Haile/Human-vs-Machine-Translation-Detection-Codebase
summary: The growing reliance on web-crawled corpora for training large language models introduces a critical challenge: machine-translated (MT) content is often treated as human translation (HT), potentially degrading data quality and propagating synthetic artifacts, especially in low-resource settings. In this work, we study MT-HT detectability across high-resource (English, Spanish) and low-resource (Swahili, Afrikaans) languages using both decoder-only LLMs in zero-shot and few-shot settings, and fine-tuned multilingual encoders trained at the sentence level and on token-chunked inputs. We find that decoder-only models provide limited discrimination overall and exhibit a consistent class-asymmetric failure mode: they recognize human-written text reliably (high HT recall) but rarely flag fluent machine output (low MT recall). Encoder-based classifiers achieve high accuracy when evaluated on data generated by the same MT systems and translators used during training in a legislative domain, but their MT recall drops sharply on unseen translators and on unseen domains such as low-resource conversational text and medical content. To address this limitation, we evaluate models on longer inputs by chunking text into segments of up to 300 tokens, which substantially improves generalization, suggesting that sentence-level signals are insufficient for robust detection. Finally, we analyze the relationship between translation quality and detectability using COMET and BLEURT, showing that lower-quality MT is more easily identified, while high-quality MT remains difficult to distinguish from HT. Our results highlight the importance of input granularity, translator generalization, and translation quality in building robust MT detection systems across domains and languages.

AI.tldr: 研究机器翻译(MT)与人工翻译(HT)的可检测性：解码器LLM判别力有限且呈类别非对称失败，编码器分类器跨译者/跨领域泛化差，长片段(≤300 token)输入可显著提升泛化。
AI.motivation: 网络爬取语料中MT内容常被误当作HT，损害训练数据质量并传播合成痕迹，在低资源场景尤为严重；因此需系统评估MT-HT检测在高/低资源语言、跨译者与跨领域条件下的鲁棒性。
AI.method: 覆盖高资源(英、西)与低资源(斯瓦希里、南非荷兰语)语言；对比零样本/少样本解码器LLM与在句级及token分块输入上微调的多语言编码器；将文本切分为最长300 token的片段以测试输入粒度影响；并用COMET、BLEURT分析翻译质量与可检测性的关系。
AI.result: 解码器LLM整体判别力有限，呈类别非对称失败：HT召回高而MT召回低；编码器分类器在同MT系统、同译者、立法域数据上准确率高，但在未见译者、低资源会话文本与医学领域上MT召回骤降；分块长输入显著改善泛化；低质量MT更易识别，高质量MT难以与HT区分。
AI.conclusion: 构建鲁棒的MT检测系统需重视输入粒度、译者泛化与翻译质量三要素；句级信号不足以支撑跨领域、跨语言的可靠检测。

title: The Vocabulary Tax: Safely Trimming Unused Tokens from LLMs for On-Device Use
summary: Open large language models (LLMs) and speech models ship vocabularies of up to 262k tokens, and every user downloads the tables those tokens index (the input embedding, an untied output head and, in recent on-device models, per-layer embeddings), whatever languages they need. We call the bytes in rows a deployment never uses the vocabulary tax and measure it, without downloading weights, for 1,244 generative and speech-recognition models on the Hugging Face Hub. For a Thai and English deployment it is a median 4.4% of model bytes below 0.5B parameters and 2.1% above 8B, and 1.93 GB in Gemma 4 E2B: it falls hardest on the small models that edge devices run. Keeping only the rows of the deployment's writing systems is exact. Keeping the tokens seen in the user's own text removes much more, a median 29.0% below 0.5B, but the usual way of doing it breaks BPE tokenizers: it drops the intermediate tokens that merges build on, so new text is split differently 1.9 times as often as the standard check reports. We repair this with merge closure, at a cost of 5.9% more rows, and add a trim certificate: a Good-Turing estimate, from the trimming text alone, of how much new text the trimmed tokenizer will split differently (correlation 0.996 over 300 settings in 22 languages) and of how much more text a target needs. Without test data our method never exceeds a 2% target, while prior keep rules checked on test data exceed it in 9-13 of 44 settings. On six models of 270M to 3B parameters in 11 languages, trimmed models keep their predictions: where the certificate passes, a median 89.7% of rows is removed and bits per character rise by at most 2.0%. The census, the trimming and the certificate are released as an open Python package, and the per-model tax for 41 languages as an open dataset.

AI.tldr: 论文提出并量化"词表税"（部署中从未使用的词表行所占字节），对Hugging Face上1,244个生成与语音模型测量；发现仅保留部署所需文字系统的行是精确无损的，而按用户文本裁剪更激进但会破坏BPE分词，作者用merge closure修复并给出基于Good-Turing的裁剪证书。
AI.motivation: 开源LLM与语音模型词表可达262k token，用户下载全部embedding/输出头等表，但部署只用少数语言的行，造成"词表税"，且对端侧小模型负担最重。
