AI.method: 无需下载权重即可测量1,244个模型的词表税；提出仅保留部署文字系统行的精确裁剪；针对基于用户文本的激进裁剪，用merge closure修复被破坏的BPE中间合并token（代价为多5.9%行），并引入trim certificate：仅用裁剪文本的Good-Turing估计预测分词偏移比例及目标所需文本量。
AI.result: 泰英部署下中位4.4%（<0.5B）、2.1%（>8B），Gemma 4 E2B达1.93GB；按用户文本裁剪中位29.0%（<0.5B）；未修复方法新文本切分差异被低估1.9倍；证书与实测相关系数0.996（22语言300设置）；无测试数据时从不超2%目标，而旧规则在44设置中9-13个超限；6个模型（270M-3B，11语言）证书通过时中位移除89.7%行，bits per char最多升2.0%。
AI.conclusion: 词表税可被精确或近似地大幅削减且保持预测质量；merge closure与trim certificate使裁剪可控可验证。释放开源Python包、普查结果及41语言逐模型税数据集。

title: Grounding Language Models in Speech Does Not Fix "AI Flavor": Calibrated LLM Judges, Goodhart Traps, and a Preference-Tuning Fix
comment: 11 pages, 2 tables. Code and data: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.24237533
summary:
Chinese outputs of large language models carry a perceptible "AI flavor": formulaic sentence frames, stacked written-register connectives, repetition loops, and layout leakage. A popular hypothesis blames text-only training for the missing inner-speech layer of human writing; injecting speech or prosody signals should therefore reduce it. We test it with controlled interventions on a 0.6B model; all three fail: (i) phoneme-interleaved continued pretraining yields no spokenness gain under text-matched controls while raising repetition (+0.13 [+0.03, +0.23]); (ii) prosody-plan conditional generation reaches an adherence of only 0.257 against a pre-registered 0.50 gate; (iii) a rule-based reward built on TTS prosody-feature distance is imperceptible in double-blind evaluation by both humans (8/16) and a calibrated LLM judge (9/16).
  A root cause is evaluation: single-rater blind evaluation at n~20 only detects extreme (>=85%) preferences. We therefore build a calibrated LLM-judge protocol: the judge passes catch trials on known-answer pairs (16/16; single-text 22/24, same-topic pairs 24/24, versus 0.75 for the human rater), then annotates with two independent judges under A/B swapping, counting disagreement as a tie. Using the judge's agree labels directly as DPO pairs (no reward model), we obtain the first positive result: held-out blind win rate 0.833 [0.699, 0.972], repetition 0.114 to 0.000, unchanged MMLU. We further identify a Goodhart channel: the judge's length preference transduces into output-length collapse via pairwise DPO (median 75 chars vs a 300-char prompt); an SFT-anchor repairs it (w is a style knob: w=0.1 preserves gains, w=0.3 does not). Scaling preference data from 89 to 240 pairs yields no additional judge-visible gain. We release RA-Eval v0.1: a three-layer Chinese AI-flavor evaluation framework with 382 judge-annotated preference pairs.

AI.tldr: 论文系统检验并否证了"引入语音/韵律信号可降低中文大模型"AI味""的假设，转而指出评测方法才是关键瓶颈；通过构建校准的LLM-judge协议（A/B交换+双评+tie计分），首次获得正向结果（盲测胜率0.833，重复率降至0，MMLU不变），并揭示judge长度偏好经pairwise DPO传导导致的Goodhart通道及SFT-anchor修复方案，同时发布中文AI味三层评测框架RA-Eval v0.1（382对judge标注偏好数据）。
AI.motivation: 中文LLM输出存在可感知的"AI味"（套路化句式、堆叠书面语连接词、复读循环、版面泄漏）。流行假说认为这是纯文本训练缺失人类写作的"内部言语层"所致，故注入语音/韵律信号应当缓解。作者既检验该假说，也质疑当前评测（单人盲评、n≈20）能否支撑结论。
AI.method: 在0.6B模型上做三项受控干预：(i) 音素交错式继续预训练（text-matched对照）；(ii) 韵律规划条件生成（预注册0.50 adherence门槛）；(iii) 基于TTS韵律特征距离的规则奖励。评测侧构建校准LLM-judge协议：先过catch trials，再用两名独立judge在A/B交换下标注、分歧计为平局；以agree标签直接作DPO对（无奖励模型），并加SFT-anchor调节风格权重w。
AI.result: 三项干预全部失败：音素交错无口语度增益且复读+0.13[+0.03,+0.23]；韵律服从率仅0.257<0.50；规则奖励在双盲下人类8/16、校准judge 9/16均不可感知。judge校准后：catch trials 16/16（单文本22/24、同题对24/24；人类评分者0.75）。judge agree标签DPO：留出盲测胜率0.833[0.699,0.972]，复读0.114→0.000，MMLU不变。发现Goodhart通道：judge长度偏好经pairwise DPO引发输出长度坍缩（中位75字符 vs 300字符提示），SFT-anchor可修复（w=0.1保留增益，w=0.3不行）。偏好数据89→240对无额外judge可见增益。
AI.conclusion: "缺内部言语层"假说未获支持；真正瓶颈在评测灵敏度——n≈20单人盲评只能识别≥85%的极端偏好。校准judge + 直接作DPO标签是可行且有效的路径，但需警惕judge偏好（如长度）被优化过程放大为Goodhart效应，需SFT-anchor等约束。发布RA-Eval v0.1三层中文AI味评测框架与382对标注数据。

title: NYUAD at ImageEval Shared Tasks: A Multimodal LLM for Audio-Visual Question Answering and Hallucination Detection in English and Modern Standard Arabic
summary: The increasing adoption of multimodal large language models (MLLMs) has enabled more natural interaction with visual and spoken information, creating new opportunities for intelligent audio-visual question answering (AVQA) and hallucination detection systems. AVQA extends traditional visual question answering by requiring models to jointly understand an input image and a spoken question to generate accurate, context-aware responses. Despite recent advances, AVQA and hallucination detection tasks remain challenging for modern standard Arabic (MSA) due to the limited availability of multimodal datasets and the need to reason across Arabic speech and text modalities alongside visual inputs. In this paper, we present an MLLM-based framework for AVQA that takes an image and a spoken question as input and generates answers. In addition, we utilized this framework to detect hallucination in text-image pairs. The proposed approach is evaluated on the ImageEval 2026 Task (Ayn-VQA) benchmark, which focuses on culturally grounded Arabic AVQA. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed framework effectively understands spoken queries, grounds their responses in the visual content, and produces accurate answers. The results underscore the capacity and limitations of different LLM architectures for both English and MSA and under various conditions.

AI.tldr: 面向现代标准阿拉伯语（MSA）的视听问答（AVQA），本文提出一个多模态大模型框架，输入图像与语音提问并生成答案，同时用于文本-图像对的幻觉检测，在ImageEval 2026 Ayn-VQA基准上取得良好效果并揭示不同LLM架构的能力与局限。
AI.motivation: MSA场景下多模态数据集稀缺，且需跨阿拉伯语语音、文本与视觉进行联合推理，导致AVQA与文化相关的幻觉检测仍具挑战性；现有MLLM在此类任务上的能力与局限尚不清晰。
AI.method: 构建基于MLLM的统一框架：接收图像与语音问题作为输入并直接生成回答；复用同一框架进行文本-图像对幻觉检测；在聚焦文化语境的ImageEval 2026 Task（Ayn-VQA）基准上评测，并对比多种LLM架构在英语与MSA及不同条件下的表现。
AI.result: 实验表明该框架能有效理解语音查询、将回答锚定于视觉内容并生成准确答案；对比结果揭示了不同LLM架构在英语与MSA、多种条件下的性能差异与瓶颈。
AI.conclusion: 所提MLLM框架在MSA视听问答与幻觉检测上具备可行性与有效性，同时明确指出了架构层面的能力边界，为阿拉伯语多模态研究提供了基线参考。

title: Justification of Emotional Appeal in Computational Argumentation
summary: Emotional appeals (EAs) are often treated as fallacious in computational argumentation, yet they may be justified when warranted by the context. We introduce the task of predicting EA justification and present the first human-annotated dataset for this task, covering 1,176 argument--context pairs. Grounded in philosophical literature, our framework evaluates EA justification along logical and emotional dimensions. Human annotations show that justification criteria form a shared latent judgment space, with evidential proportionality and normative acceptability most strongly associated with overall justification. We further find that EAs without logical support are not always judged fully unjustified, and stronger EAs are not necessarily judged less justified. Finally, LLM experiments show that EA justification prediction remains challenging.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"情感诉求正当性预测"新任务，发布首个含1,176个论证—语境对的人工标注数据集，从逻辑与情感双维度构建评估框架，并揭示正当性判断的共享潜在空间及大模型在该任务上的不足。
AI.motivation: 计算论辩研究中情感诉求（EAs）常被简单视为谬误，但语境合理时可被正当化；现有工作缺乏对"正当性"这一情境依赖判断的系统刻画与数据支撑。
AI.method: 基于哲学文献提出逻辑维度与情感维度的正当性评估框架，构建并人工标注1,176个论证—语境对；通过标注分析检验判断标准是否构成共享潜在判断空间，并开展LLM基线实验。
AI.result: 标注表明正当性标准形成共享潜在判断空间，其中"证据相称性"与"规范可接受性"与整体正当性关联最强；无逻辑支持的情感诉求并非总被判定完全不正当，情感强度更高的诉求也未必被评为更不正当；LLM的正当性预测仍具挑战性。
AI.conclusion: 情感诉求的正当性是可预测且需语境建模的任务，单一逻辑或强度视角不足；该数据集与框架为细粒度论辩评价及LLM论辩能力研究提供基准。

title: Between the Lines: Multi-turn Contextual Investment Advice Detection
summary: As large language models (LLMs) increasingly power financial conversational assistants, detecting investment advice in natural language has become a critical regulatory and safety challenge. Unlike explicit single-turn recommendations, investment advice often emerges implicitly and progressively over multi-turn conversations, shaped by user intent, delivery style, and contextual buildup. We introduce the first comprehensive framework for detecting both sequential and contextual investment advice in dialogue settings. Central to our approach is a modular, top-down synthetic data generation pipeline that systematically spans a taxonomy of advisory trajectories using an axis-bucket-descriptor schema. We simulate both benign and high-risk conversations across diverse user personas, financial instruments, and risk tiers, and evaluate detection capabilities using LLM-as-a-Judge with entropy-based uncertainty diagnostics. Our results show that contextual advisory detection remains substantially more challenging than sequential cases, even under few-shot prompting with tailored demonstrations. This work lays the foundation for scalable guardrail development in high-stakes, compliance-sensitive domains, where advisory risk is often subtle, distributed, and perception-dependent.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出首个面向对话场景的投资建议检测框架，可同时识别顺序式与上下文式投资建议，核心是基于维度-桶-描述符（axis-bucket-descriptor）模式的自上而下模块化合成数据生成流程，并采用LLM-as-a-Judge配合基于熵的不确定性诊断进行评估。
AI.motivation: LLM驱动的金融对话助手日益普及，使自然语言中的投资建议检测成为关键监管与安全挑战。与显式单轮推荐不同，投资建议往往在多轮对话中隐式、渐进地浮现，受用户意图、表达风格与上下文累积共同塑造，现有方法难以覆盖。
AI.method: 构建模块化、自上而下的合成数据生成流水线，通过axis-bucket-descriptor模式系统覆盖建议轨迹分类体系；模拟跨多样用户画像、金融工具与风险等级的良性及高风险对话；以LLM-as-a-Judge进行评估，并引入基于熵的不确定性诊断。
AI.result: 上下文式建议检测显著难于顺序式情形，即便采用少样本提示并配以定制演示亦如此。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为高风险、合规敏感领域（建议风险通常隐晦、分布分散且依赖感知）的可扩展防护机制（guardrail）开发奠定基础。

title: Endogenous Preferences as Vulnerability Signals: Discovering Universal Adversarial Triggers for LLM Utility Degradation
summary: Deployed large language models must remain useful when untrusted text enters their prompt context. Adversarial prompting and red-teaming methods typically define the failures they seek through task labels, harmful targets, judge feedback, or downstream utility scores. We ask whether a frozen model's clean behavior can reveal a reusable context vulnerability when its task-level form is unknown, and downstream task feedback is withheld. To study this question, EndoUT uses a Siamese-style design that compares the same frozen victim on clean and span-modified versions of each unlabeled instruction. Without a task-level target, the clean pass supplies the victim's preferred response-onset token as an instruction-conditioned reference; Endogenous Preference Disruption (EPD) measures how insertion weakens that preference. An auxiliary generator supplies bounded-span proposals; EPD guides its update and ranks the pool without access to downstream information. The highest-scoring victim-specific span is fixed before evaluation and reused unchanged across all held-out inputs. Across four instruction-tuned models and nine benchmarks, fixed triggers reduce benign-task utility by 40.2 percentage points on average, with negative mean change on every benchmark and greater average degradation than every evaluated baseline under the reported protocols. Matched protocol ablations show stronger transfer for source-side selection followed by fixed reuse than for null-context fixed reuse or per-input generation. Transfer recurs across proposers with proposal-dependent strength; output-level analyses identify victim-specific associations between trigger families and downstream failure patterns. Thus, clean behavior can expose context vulnerabilities that transfer across inputs yet manifest through structured, victim-specific patterns of utility degradation. The code and data will be released upon acceptance.

AI.tldr: EndoUT 无需任务标签与下游反馈，仅利用冻结模型在干净输入上的偏好起始 token 作为参考，通过"内源偏好扰动"(EPD) 分数挖掘固定触发片段，该片段在九个基准上平均降低良性任务效用 40.2 个百分点。
AI.motivation: 现有对抗提示与红队方法通常依赖任务标签、有害目标、评判反馈或下游效用分数来定义失败。作者提出疑问：当任务级形态未知且下游反馈被隐藏时，冻结模型的"干净行为"本身能否揭示可复用的上下文脆弱性。
AI.method: 采用 Siamese 式设计，对同一冻结受害模型比较未标注指令的干净版本与片段修改版本。以干净前向得到的"偏好响应起始 token"作为指令条件参考，定义 EPD 度量插入片段对该偏好的削弱程度；辅助生成器提出有界片段候选，EPD 既指导其更新又用于候选池排序，全程不使用下游信息。得分最高的受害模型专属片段在评估前固定，并在所有留出输入上原样复用。
AI.result: 在四个指令微调模型与九个基准上，固定触发器平均使良性任务效用下降 40.2 个百分点，所有基准的平均变化均为负，且在报告协议下退化幅度高于所有对比基线。匹配协议消融显示：源侧选择+固定复用 的迁移性强于 空上下文固定复用 与 逐输入生成。迁移在多个候选生成器间复现且强度依赖提议质量；输出级分析揭示触发家族与下游失败模式之间存在受害模型专属关联。
AI.conclusion: 干净行为可暴露能够跨输入迁移的上下文脆弱性，但其表现是通过结构化的、模型专属的效用退化模式实现的；提示评估与防御需考虑此类源侧固定触发。

title: Where Language Models Fail Like Aphasic Patients and Where They Don't
comment: 15 pages, 9 figures, 1 table. Supplementary information included (15 figures, 7 tables). A companion analysis comparing model scale and attention design within a single inference implementation is in preparation and will be reported in a subsequent version
summary: The computational architecture of human word production -- whether semantic-lexical retrieval and phonological encoding constitute dissociable processing stages -- has been debated for decades using hand-designed models with small vocabularies. We introduce computational architectural dissociation: using known architectural properties of vision-language models (VLMs) to derive falsifiable predictions about which patient error types should and should not align with model errors under perturbation. Because VLMs perform picture naming through learned semantic competition over full vocabularies but lack phonological encoding entirely, perturbation-induced errors should match patient patterns for semantic-stage categories but not phonological ones. Testing LLaVA 1.6 (Vicuna-13B) against 88 patients with aphasia across 175 Philadelphia Naming Test items (~37 million naming attempts, 50 perturbation seeds), we find that six of eight error categories show significant item-level alignment (Spearman $ρ$ = 0.32-0.50, all p < 0.001) while the two phonological categories -- formal errors and abstruse neologisms -- show no alignment ($ρ$ = 0.110 and 0.084, both n.s.), confirming the predicted dissociation. Spectral analysis of the output probabilities places each error type at a distinct position in a six-dimensional space, giving a mechanistic interpretability tool. The dissociation is layer-specific (peaking at L22, 55% depth), severity-independent, and stable across seeds (split-half r > 0.998). Weight perturbation of four additional 7B VLMs spanning the tested architectural combinations produced correct-rate alignment of comparable magnitude ($ρ$ = 0.21-0.27). Whether the per-category dissociation itself depends on scale or on attention design requires a comparison within a single inference implementation, which is reported separately.

AI.tldr: 该文提出"计算架构分离"范式，利用视觉语言模型（VLM）缺乏语音编码的已知架构特性来推导可证伪预测：扰动诱导的模型错误应与失语症患者的语义阶段错误类型对齐，而与语音阶段错误类型不对齐。基于LLaVA 1.6对88名失语症患者、175个PNT项目的约3700万次命名尝试进行检验，六类语义相关错误显著对齐，两类语音错误（形式错误、晦涩新词）不对齐，证实了预测的分离。
AI.motivation: 人类词汇产生的计算架构——语义-词汇提取与语音编码是否为可分离加工阶段——数十年来仅靠小词汇量手工模型争论不休，缺乏可证伪的定量检验手段。
AI.method: 引入"计算架构分离"方法：依据VLM的架构性质（通过全词汇表上的学习式语义竞争完成图片命名、但完全缺失语音编码）推导关于哪些患者错误类型应对齐的预测。用LLaVA 1.6（Vicuna-13B）对88名失语症患者在175个费城命名测验项目上进行扰动实验（约3700万次命名尝试、50个扰动种子），比较项目级错误模式；并对输出概率做谱分析、层级分析、严重度与种子稳定性检验，另对四个7B VLM做权重扰动。
AI.result: 八类错误中六类显示显著的项目级对齐（Spearman ρ = 0.32–0.50，p < 0.001）；两类语音类错误——形式错误与晦涩新词——无对齐（ρ = 0.110 与 0.084，均不显著）。谱分析将各错误类型置于六维空间中的不同位置，提供机制可解释性工具。分离效应具有层级特异性（峰值在L22，55%深度）、与严重度无关、跨种子稳定（分半信度 r > 0.998）。四个7B VLM的权重扰动产生量级相当的正确率对齐（ρ = 0.21–0.27）。
AI.conclusion: 结果与"语义-词汇提取和语音编码为可分离阶段"的架构假设一致，表明VLM可作为研究人类词汇产生计算架构的定量探针。逐类别分离是否依赖模型规模或注意力设计，需在单一推理实现内比较，另文报告。

title: OmniTag-LLM: Multilingual Multitask Speech Tagging
summary: Multimodal LLMs promise to replace the traditional cascade of specialist speech models with a single system that, from one audio clip, jointly transcribes and labels emotion, gender, language, and named entities. Yet most benchmarks still score these tasks in isolation, and largely in English. We introduce OmniTag-Bench, a five-language benchmark (en/de/es/fr/it) and training recipe for joint understanding: one audio clip in, one JSON object out (transcript, emotion, gender, LID, token-level NER). We evaluate ten open multimodal LLMs and a LoRA fine-tuned Qwen3-Omni on a unified prompt and scorer. Beyond aggregate scores, OmniTag-Bench reveals a systematic failure mode: several strong models often transcribe or translate non-English speech into English, inflating multilingual WER. Fine-tuning improves the base model on NER, emotion, and WER while nearly doubling accuracy on independent human-labeled emotion corpora, suggesting transferable gains beyond pseudo-label imitation. The fine-tuned model also generalizes to unseen but related languages, transferring to held-out Dutch. We release prompts, the scorer, and the labeling pipeline.

AI.tldr: 论文提出OmniTag-Bench——一个五种语言（英/德/西/法/意）的联合音频理解基准与训练方案，要求单段音频一次性输出包含转写、情感、性别、语种识别与词级NER的JSON；在统一提示与评分器下评测十个开源多模态LLM及LoRA微调的Qwen3-Omni，并揭示强模型将非英语语音转写/翻译为英语导致多语WER虚高的系统性失效模式。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态LLM宣称可用单一系统取代专业语音模型级联，实现单段音频上的转写与情感、性别、语种、命名实体联合标注；但现有基准多以孤立任务、且基本以英语为评测对象，无法反映真实联合理解能力。
AI.method: 构建OmniTag-Bench五语基准与训练配方，任务定义为“一段音频进、一个JSON出”（transcript、emotion、gender、LID、token级NER）；统一prompt与统一scorer评测十个开源多模态LLM，并对Qwen3-Omni进行LoRA微调对比。
AI.result: 聚合分数之外发现系统性失效：多个强模型将非英语语音转写或翻译为英语，抬高多语WER；微调在NER、情感与WER上均优于基座模型，在独立人工标注情感语料上准确率近乎翻倍，说明增益并非仅模仿伪标签；微调模型还能泛化到未见的荷兰语。
AI.conclusion: 联合标注应以端到端统一评估而非孤立任务打分，且需警惕语言错配造成的指标偏差；LoRA微调可带来可迁移的跨任务、跨语言收益。作者开源prompts、scorer与标注流水线。

title: Read, Route, Patch: Robust Test-Time Evolution for LLM Agents
summary: Large Language Model (LLM)-based agents can improve long- horizon interactive decision-making through test-time evolu- tion, yet existing methods face three information bottlenecks: memory retrieval overemphasizes textual similarity, candi- date harnesses are often behaviorally redundant, and whole- harness rewriting may overwrite useful evidence or introduce cross-component inconsistency. We introduce Trident, which improves experience utilization, behavioral exploration, and harness evolution through boundary-aware memory reading, diversity-aware candidate routing, and order-aware insertion- based updating, respectively. We evaluate Trident on five benchmarks spanning text games, web interaction, and cod- ing tasks. Across qwen-32B, mistral-small-3.2-24B, and gpt- oss-20B, Trident achieves the best average performance and consistently outperforms non-learning, memory-based, reflection-based, and automated prompt optimization base- lines. Compared with the strongest baseline, APEX, Trident yields relative average gains of 30.7%, 30.8%, and 38.3% on the three backbones, respectively. Ablation and sensitivity stud- ies further show that the three designs provide complementary gains and remain robust to parameter variations.

AI.tldr: 提出 Trident，针对 LLM 智能体在长程交互决策中测试时进化（test-time evolution）的三类信息瓶颈，分别引入边界感知记忆读取、多样性感知候选路由与顺序感知插入式更新，在五个基准与三个骨干模型上取得最优平均性能。
AI.motivation: 现有基于 LLM 智能体的测试时进化方法存在三个信息瓶颈：记忆检索过度依赖文本相似度；候选 harness 之间存在行为冗余；整体式 harness 重写可能覆盖有用证据或造成组件间不一致。
AI.method: Trident 采用三项设计分别改进经验利用、行为探索与 harness 进化：边界感知记忆读取（boundary-aware memory reading）、多样性感知候选路由（diversity-aware candidate routing）、顺序感知的插入式更新（order-aware insertion-based updating）。
AI.result: 在文本游戏、网页交互与代码任务共五个基准上，于 qwen-32B、mistral-small-3.2-24B、gpt-oss-20B 三个骨干上取得最佳平均性能，稳定优于非学习、基于记忆、基于反思及自动提示优化类基线；相较最强基线 APEX，三个骨干上平均相对提升分别为 30.7%、30.8%、38.3%。消融与敏感性实验表明三项设计提供互补增益且对参数变化稳健。
AI.conclusion: 通过针对记忆读取、候选路由与 harness 更新的结构化改进，可有效缓解测试时进化中的信息瓶颈，提升 LLM 智能体的长程决策表现，且各模块贡献互补、鲁棒性良好。

title: Do Probing and Steering Favor the Same Directions Within and Across Language Models?
comment: Accepted at the Workshop on Unifying Representations in Neural Models (UniReps) co-located with NeurIPS 2026.(arXiv preprint)
summary:
A direction in a language model's hidden state can be used to probe whether a concept is present or to steer the model toward it. Although probe directions are often reused for steering, the direction that best detects a concept need not be the one that best changes it. We study this distinction in three instruction-tuned models from different families. We construct a one-parameter family of directions ranging from a covariance-adjusted discriminant to the mean difference, and evaluate probing and additive steering, which adds the direction to the hidden state, along the family at a fixed side effect. For truthfulness and sentiment, in every model, the best probe is not the best steering direction: steering consistently favors directions closer to the mean difference. This separation holds across 59 of 60 layer-model-concept combinations in a layer sweep, with matched probe and steering texts in all six model-concept combinations, and under a rotation-based steering operator. The exact steering optimum is less stable: for sentiment, an intermediate direction produces a 27-56% stronger steering effect than the mean difference, but this gain shrinks or disappears with matched texts and depends on the layer and the operator.
  The two roles also transfer differently across models. A probe transferred by a linear map fitted on neutral text retains 81-91% of the target model's above-chance probing performance, while the transferred mean difference retains less of its steering effect in 11 of 12 model pairs. This is a consistent tendency, although our predefined criteria classify only three pairs, and nine remain inconclusive. Finally, as an application on PopQA, steering toward "unknown" increases abstention by 18-44 percentage points on uncertain errors, versus 2-5 on confident errors, while rarely correcting errors in cases where a correct answer is reachable.

AI.tldr: 在三个指令微调模型中，探测概念最优的方向与转向（steering）最优的方向并不一致：转向一致偏好更接近均值差的方向；该分离在59/60个层-模型-概念组合中成立。同时探测与转向的跨模型迁移行为不同，并在PopQA上展示了"转向未知"可显著提高不确定错误的弃答率。
AI.motivation: 隐藏状态中的方向既可用来探测概念是否存在，也可用来转向模型行为。实践中常直接把探测方向复用于转向，但探测最优的方向未必是改变行为最优的方向；作者意图系统刻画"探测"与"转向"两种角色的区别，以及这种区别在跨模型迁移中的表现。
AI.method: 构造一个单参数方向族，从协方差校正的判别方向连续过渡到均值差方向；在固定副作用条件下，沿该族评估探测与加性转向。实验覆盖三个不同家族的指令微调模型、真值性与情感两类概念、逐层扫描、以及匹配探测/转向文本的设定，并采用基于旋转的转向算子做稳健性检验。跨模型部分用在中性文本上拟合的线性映射迁移探测方向，并比较均值差方向的转向效果迁移比例。应用实验在PopQA上向"未知"方向转向。
AI.result: 在所有模型中，最佳探测方向都不是最佳转向方向，转向一致偏好接近均值差的方向；该分离在60个层-模型-概念组合中59个成立，匹配文本的六种组合及旋转算子下均稳健。转向的精确最优不稳定：情感概念上中间方向比均值差转向效果强27-56%，但匹配文本后增益缩小或消失，且依赖层与算子。迁移方面，经线性映射迁移的探测方向保留目标模型超随机探测性能的81-91%；而迁移的均值差在12对模型中有11对转向效果保留更少（一致倾向，但按预设标准仅3对可判定，9对不确定）。PopQA上转向"未知"使不确定错误的弃答率提升18-44个百分点，而自信错误仅2-5个百分点，且在有可正确答案时很少纠正错误。
AI.conclusion: 探测与转向是可分离的两种功能：复用探测方向进行转向次优，转向应优先选用接近均值差的方向；两者在跨模型迁移中表现不同，探测方向更易迁移。作者据此建议区分方向选择的目标，并指出转向"未知"可用于提升不确定情形下的弃答，但对自信错误和可纠正错误作用有限。

title: Text Speeding Itself Up: Recency and Restraint in Session-Local Drafting
summary: Speculative decoding lets a cheap draft model propose tokens that a large language model verifies in a single forward pass. When the verifier keeps a KV cache, verification is cheap and drafting must be nearly free. Session-local drafters, which predict from the prompt and the text generated so far, meet that bar without training. We compare a recency-weighted, backing-off, confidence-gated session memory against prompt lookup decoding in its reference form, which copies from the earliest earlier match, and in a variant that copies from the most recent one, with paired per-prompt bootstrap intervals throughout. On general, medical, and legal text with a Mistral-7B verifier, recency accounts for the speed: most-recent lookup gains up to 0.09 in speedup over earliest-match lookup on 500-token generations, and session memory's weighting and backoff add nothing measurable on top, at 30 to 40 times the drafting cost. Energy tells a different story. On medical and legal text, unselective drafters are 14% faster than plain decoding yet use as much energy per token, while drafters that abstain on weak evidence save 3 to 4 joules per 100 tokens; a three-token minimum match length on prompt lookup matches the confidence-gated session memory. Outputs are token-identical to greedy decoding in 94% of generations, with every divergence at a numerical near-tie. Under a repetition penalty, long-generation speedups shrink from 1.4-1.7x to 1.1-1.2x, but recency still helps and the length floor is the only drafter that saves energy in both domains.

AI.tldr: 在Mistral-7B上比较会话记忆式草稿器与prompt lookup解码：速度收益主要来自"最近匹配"而非记忆加权/回退，能量收益来自"弱证据时弃权"，三token最小匹配长度即可媲美置信门控会话记忆。
AI.motivation: 投机解码要求草稿近乎免费，无训练的会话局部草稿器（依据prompt与已生成文本预测）满足该要求。但此前缺乏对"记忆加权/回退/置信门控"与简单prompt lookup之间的严格对照，也缺乏对速度、能耗与输出保真度的联合评估。
AI.method: 以带KV cache的Mistral-7B为验证器，在通用、医疗、法律三类文本上做配对比较（逐prompt bootstrap置信区间）。对象：①近期加权、回退、置信门控的会话记忆；②prompt lookup参考形式（从最早匹配处复制）；③变体（从最近匹配处复制）。评估指标：加速比、每token能耗、与贪心解码的token一致性，并测试重复惩罚与长生成设定。
AI.result: 500 token生成下，最近匹配lookup比最早匹配最多提升0.09加速比；会话记忆的加权与回退无可测增益，草稿成本却高30–40倍。医疗/法律文本上，无选择草稿器比普通解码快14%但每token能耗相同；弱证据弃权者每100 token省3–4焦耳；prompt lookup的三token最小匹配长度与置信门控会话记忆相当。94%生成与贪心解码逐token一致，分歧均出现在数值近似并列处。重复惩罚下长生成加速比由1.4–1.7x降至1.1–1.2x，最近匹配仍有效，长度下限是唯一在两个领域都省能的草稿器。
AI.conclusion: 复杂会话记忆的机制收益有限，"近期性"才是速度来源，"选择性弃权"才是能耗来源，简单的最小匹配长度即可实现；投机解码的能耗评估不可由加速比替代，且输出保真度在数值近似并列处存在必然风险。

title: From Facts to Personas: Interpretable Role Unlearning in LLMs via Mixture-of-Experts
summary: LLMs are widely adopted in multi-role dialogue and persona simulation. However, their strong ability to imitate role-specific linguistic and behavioral patterns can introduce privacy risks, reinforce social biases, and lead to unsafe or uncontrollable outputs. To address these issues, we introduce the Role-playing Unlearning task, which aims to selectively forget the style and knowledge associated with target roles while preserving the language ability and behaviors of the remaining roles. Unlike prior unlearning tasks that focus solely on removing factual information, our task additionally requires forgetting persona-specific characteristics, making the control over model generation more fine-grained. We propose RoleMoE, a Mixture-of-Experts framework that maps different roles to more independent expert subspaces, improving role separation and structural interpretability. To further distinguish role-specific features, RoleMoE incorporates two complementary losses: a specialization loss that drives roles to adopt distinct expert distributions, and a disentanglement loss that encourages experts to develop distinct capability subspaces. This decomposed structure enables role unlearning to focus selectively on target-role experts. We finally propose RoleBench-Unlearn for evaluation, and experiments on multiple backbone LLMs show that RoleMoE enables precise and controllable role forgetting, while better preserving the linguistic quality, knowledge, and persona consistency of non-target roles. All code and datasets are publicly available at: https://github.com/mbzuai-nlp/ROLEMOE.

AI.tldr: 论文提出“角色扮演遗忘”新任务，并设计基于混合专家(MoE)的RoleMoE框架，实现细粒度、可控的目标角色遗忘，同时保持其余角色的语言能力与人格一致性。
AI.motivation: LLM在多角色对话与人格模拟中被广泛使用，但其强大的角色语言与行为模仿能力带来隐私泄露、社会偏见强化、输出不可控等风险。先前遗忘任务仅删除事实信息，无法覆盖角色特有风格与人格特征，控制粒度不足。
AI.method: 提出RoleMoE：Mixture-of-Experts框架，将不同角色映射到更独立的专家子空间以提升角色分离度与结构可解释性；引入两种互补损失——专业化损失(促使角色采用差异化专家分布)与解耦损失(促使专家形成不同能力子空间)；该分解结构使遗忘可选择性作用于目标角色专家。同时构建评测基准RoleBench-Unlearn。
AI.result: 在多个骨干LLM上的实验表明，RoleMoE实现精确且可控的角色遗忘，同时更好地保持非目标角色的语言质量、知识与人格一致性。代码与数据集已开源。
AI.conclusion: 将角色遗忘从事实层面扩展到角色风格与知识层面，通过专家子空间分解提供可解释、细粒度的遗忘机制，为LLM角色可控性提供新范式与评测基准。

title: B-OPSD: On-Policy Self-Distillation with Self-Generated Problem Briefs
summary: On-Policy Self-Distillation (OPSD) has recently attracted interest because it provides dense teacher guidance without a separate, often larger teacher model. However, OPSD conditions its teacher on ground-truth solutions, which limits its use when such solutions are unavailable. We propose On-Policy Self-Distillation with Self-Generated Problem Briefs (B-OPSD). Using a prompt template, the initial model or a saved student checkpoint generates a problem brief from the question alone. The prompt asks for relevant principles, applicability conditions, and likely pitfalls, but not a final answer or a complete solution. A frozen teacher uses the brief as privileged context to guide the current student's on-policy rollouts through token-level distribution matching. B-OPSD uses no ground-truth solutions during training. Results on AIME 2024, AIME 2025, and HMMT 2025 show that both B-OPSD variants achieve higher average accuracy than OPSD at each of three Qwen3 model sizes. Code is available at https://github.com/ZevineXu/B-OPSD

AI.tldr: 提出 B-OPSD，用模型自生成的问题简述（problem brief）替代真实解答作为教师模型的特权上下文，实现无需标准答案的在策略自蒸馏。
AI.motivation: 现有 On-Policy Self-Distillation（OPSD）依赖以 ground-truth 解答作为教师条件的特权信息，当不存在标准答案时无法使用，限制了其适用场景。
AI.method: 用提示模板让初始模型或已保存的学生检查点仅凭题目生成 problem brief，要求包含相关原理、适用条件与潜在陷阱，但不给出最终答案或完整解法；冻结教师模型以该 brief 作为特权上下文，通过 token 级分布匹配指导当前学生的在策略 rollout。训练全程不使用真实解答。
AI.result: 在 AIME 2024、AIME 2025 与 HMMT 2025 上，两种 B-OPSD 变体在三个 Qwen3 模型规模下平均准确率均高于 OPSD。
AI.conclusion: 自生成的问题简述可有效替代真实解答作为教师特权信息，在无标准答案条件下仍能提供稠密教师监督并优于依赖 ground-truth 的 OPSD。

title: Omni-Workspace: Benchmarking Omni-Modal AI Assistants on Multimodal Workspace Tasks
summary: Omni-modal agents are expected to move beyond multimodal understanding toward completing complex tasks in realistic multimodal environments. In these settings, information is distributed across heterogeneous files and modalities, with cross-file and cross-modal dependencies requiring agents to continually coordinate perception, reasoning, and tool use as newly gathered evidence informs subsequent actions. However, existing omni-modal benchmarks primarily focus on multimodal perception and understanding, leaving complex task completion through sustained interaction with multimodal workspaces underexplored. We introduce Omni-Workspace, a benchmark comprising 380 deep-research-style tasks across four multimodal workspace types and two difficulty levels. These tasks require agents to inspect and process workspace files, retrieve external information when needed, integrate evidence across files and modalities, and produce artifacts satisfying explicit requirements. Evaluating 18 representative models reveals limitations in long-horizon multimodal workspace execution, with the best model scoring only 65.93 on average. Further analysis identifies multimodal context inflation and task-state drift as recurring challenges. Motivated by these findings, we further propose OmniFocus, a lightweight approach combining multimodal working-memory management with explicit task-state tracking to improve performance and efficiency. Omni-Workspace advances the evaluation and development of omni-modal agents toward autonomous completion of complex tasks in multimodal workspaces.

AI.tldr: 提出 Omni-Workspace 基准（380 个深度研究式任务，覆盖四类多模态工作区、两个难度等级），揭示现有全模态智能体在长程多模态工作区执行上的不足（最佳模型仅 65.93），并据此提出轻量方法 OmniFocus。
AI.motivation: 现有全模态基准主要评测多模态感知与理解，缺乏对"在多模态工作区中持续交互、跨文件跨模态整合证据并完成任务"的评测；真实场景中信息分布于异构文件与模态，存在跨文件、跨模态依赖，要求智能体持续协调感知、推理与工具使用。
AI.method: 构建 Omni-Workspace 基准：380 个深度研究式任务，覆盖 4 类多模态工作区、2 个难度等级；任务要求检查并处理工作区文件、按需检索外部信息、跨文件与跨模态整合证据、产出满足显式要求的交付物。评测 18 个代表性模型并做进一步分析。基于分析发现提出 OmniFocus：将多模态工作记忆管理与显式任务状态跟踪相结合的轻量方案。
AI.result: 18 个代表性模型整体表现有限，最佳模型平均分仅 65.93，表明长程多模态工作区执行能力不足；分析识别出两类反复出现的挑战：多模态上下文膨胀（multimodal context inflation）与任务状态漂移（task-state drift）。OmniFocus 在性能与效率上均有提升。
AI.conclusion: Omni-Workspace 填补了多模态工作区复杂任务完成的评测空白，并为全模态智能体走向多模态工作区中自主完成任务提供了评测与改进基础。

title: Personalized Language Models for One-to-Many Private Communications
summary: We study relationship-specific continual reply prediction for one-to-many private communication: a system predicts an author's reply to a recurring contact and updates its personalization state when the actual reply becomes available. We propose TRACE (Temporal Relationship-Aware Communication Evolution), which uses author-level lexical habits, contact-specific wording, and temporal expression estimates to guide a frozen language model, with a feedback-driven policy controlling revision. On 216 test emails from eight Enron users, all four main TRACE configurations achieve higher mean BLEU, ROUGE-L, and BERTScore and lower mean Reply Style MSE than Base LLM and Base RAG. Component ablations show mixed effects and do not establish statistically reliable improvements in Reply Style MSE after multiple-comparison correction. More accurate state forecasts and larger revision budgets do not consistently improve reply-level metrics. These exploratory findings expose the challenge of turning evolving relationship-specific expression estimates into useful generation guidance.

AI.tldr: TRACE模型利用作者词汇习惯、联系人特定措辞和时间表达估计引导冻结语言模型，并借助反馈驱动的修订策略实现关系特定的连续回复预测；在8位Enron用户216封测试邮件上四个主要配置均优于Base LLM与Base RAG，但组件消融效果不一，细化状态预测与更大修订预算未带来稳定增益。
AI.motivation: 一对多私有通信中，作者对固定联系人的回复具有关系特定性且随时间演化，通用语言模型缺乏对具体收件人关系与表达习惯的建模，需要随实际回复到来持续更新的个性化机制。
AI.method: 提出TRACE框架：结合作者级词汇习惯、联系人特有条件与时间表达估计作为信号引导冻结的LLM生成；采用反馈驱动策略控制迭代修订；在Enron数据集8位用户的216封测试邮件上，与Base LLM、Base RAG比较BLEU、ROUGE-L、BERTScore与Reply Style MSE，并进行组件消融与多重比较校正。
AI.result: 四个主要TRACE配置在平均BLEU、ROUGE-L、BERTScore上更高、Reply Style MSE更低；但组件消融呈混合效应，多重比较校正后Reply Style MSE改进不具统计可靠性；更准确的状态预测与更大修订预算并未稳定提升回复级指标。
AI.conclusion: 探索性结果表明，将演化的关系特定表达估计转化为有效的生成引导仍具挑战性；当前证据不足以确立稳健的组件贡献与显著性改进，需进一步研究估计到生成的可落地机制。

title: EEGHyena2: Fixation-Inspired Joint Lexical-Grammatical Conditional Random Field for Interpretable EEG-to-Text Decoding
summary: A sentence is built from words that carry lexical meaning and grammatical roles, and brain activity during reading reflects both. Current EEG-to-text decoders, however, let a large language model (LLM) propose and order the words, so fluent output can reflect the LLM's prior more than the recorded EEG. In this study, we asked whether fixation-linked EEG carries lexical and grammatical evidence during natural reading and how a decoder can use such evidence. Fixation-related potential analyses showed that content and function words differ reliably in group-averaged EEG but only weakly in single words. We therefore propose EEGHyena2, a structured decoder in which a bidirectional encoder inspired by StripedHyena 2 feeds a semantic head that ranks a fixed lexicon and a part-of-speech (POS) head that predicts grammatical categories; a joint word-POS conditional random field (CRF) scores a restricted candidate lattice, and a frozen Llama-2 scores the candidates in context. On two natural-reading corpora, ZuCo and ROAMM, it matched the state-of-the-art method on BLEU-1 (21.4 vs 21.3), exceeded it on ROUGE-1 F1 (23.3 vs 20.3), lowered the character error rate on ROAMM (75.3% vs 84.7%) and decoded each recording about 3-10 times faster than LLM candidate search. The CRF learned transitions that mirror English syntax, and the encoder drew local context from its convolutions and distant context from attention. Decoders can thus pool weak word-level EEG evidence across the sentence through explicit lexical and grammatical structure, with the language model adjudicating among candidates rather than generating them, which lowers decoding cost and keeps decisions inspectable.

AI.tldr: 该文检验注视相关EEG是否携带词汇与语法证据，并提出结构化解码器EEGHyena2：用语义头排序固定词表、用词性头预测语法类别，经联合词-词性CRF在受限候选格上打分，再由冻结的Llama-2在上下文中裁决候选，从而让语言模型"评判"而非"生成"文本。
AI.motivation: 现有EEG-to-text解码器由大语言模型（LLM）提出并排序词语，流畅输出可能更多反映LLM先验而非真实EEG，导致解码结果与脑信号关联不明确；作者希望明确注视相关EEG在自然阅读中是否携带词汇与语法证据，并让解码器显式利用这些证据。
AI.method: 先做注视相关电位（FRP）分析，比较实词与虚词在群体平均EEG与单词级EEG上的差异；再提出EEGHyena2：受StripedHyena 2启发的双向编码器，接语义头（对固定词表排序）与词性头（预测语法类别），联合词-POS条件随机场（CRF）对受限候选格打分，最后由冻结的Llama-2对候选做上下文打分。
AI.result: 在ZuCo与ROAMM两个自然阅读语料上：BLEU-1与SOTA持平（21.4 vs 21.3），ROUGE-1 F1更优（23.3 vs 20.3），ROAMM上字符错误率降低（75.3% vs 84.7%），单条记录解码速度比LLM候选搜索快约3–10倍；CRF学到的转移模式符合英语句法，编码器通过卷积获取局部上下文、通过注意力获取远距离上下文。
AI.conclusion: 解码器可通过显式的词汇与语法结构，将句子内微弱的词级EEG证据汇聚起来；语言模型只用于在候选间裁决而非生成候选，既降低解码成本又使决策过程可检视。

title: Attribute or Abstain: Evaluating Evidence-Grounded Retrieval on the Low-Resource African Business Web
summary: Retrieval-augmented systems that research companies are judged by how much they find, yet in markets where public evidence is sparse, a confident answer without support costs more than no answer. We introduce AfriBizClaims, a benchmark of 150 company-research queries across six African markets in English, French and Portuguese, including queries about fictitious companies that a correct system must decline. Each claim a system makes is judged against the page it cites by an AI judge, checked against a second AI judge from another model family and against two human annotators, and abstentions are scored against answerability labels. We compare BM25 over a pooled corpus, standard web retrieval-augmented generation, and a multi-step agent pipeline (Konexium V1), all using the same language model. The two simple baselines are well attributed: 98% of their judged claims are supported by the page they cite, and they decline every field of every fictitious company. Counting claims about a company other than the one asked about as errors, the agent pipeline's per-query precision is 68%, and it never answers a question about a named company correctly: it substitutes other firms, including for 5 of the 24 fictitious names, and it is the least stable between runs and the most expensive. In the pipeline we evaluated, more steps between the query and the evidence did not buy more grounded answers. We will release the queries, system outputs, labels and short evidence excerpts.

AI.tldr: AfriBizClaims基准（150条企业调研查询，6个非洲市场、英/法/葡三语，含虚构公司必须拒答）对比BM25、标准RAG与多步智能体流水线Konexium V1，发现简单基线归因良好（98%论断有页面支撑、虚构公司全拒答），而多步智能体逐查询精度仅68%、对具名公司从无正确回答且最贵最不稳定——更多步骤未带来更有依据的答案。
AI.motivation: 在公共证据稀少的市场中，"无依据的自信回答"代价高于"不作答"，而检索增强系统常以"找到多少"为评价标准，忽视论断是否有据与是否该拒答。作者希望构建一个评测基准，考察系统在多语言、低资源市场中的归因质量、拒答能力与对目标公司的忠实度。
AI.method: 构建AfriBizClaims基准：150条企业调研查询，覆盖6个非洲市场、英语/法语/葡萄牙语，含虚构公司查询（正确系统必须拒答）。每条论断与其引用页面逐条对照：由AI评审判定，并用另一模型家族的AI评审与两名人工标注者交叉核验；弃答按可回答性标签计分。对比BM25（池化语料）、标准网页RAG、多步智能体流水线（Konexium V1），三者使用同一语言模型。
AI.result: 两个简单基线归因质量高：被判定的论断中98%得到其引用页面支撑，且对每家虚构公司的每个字段均拒答。将"关于其他公司的论断"计为错误后，智能体流水线逐查询精度为68%，且对具名公司从未正确作答——会替换为其他公司（24个虚构名称中有5个被误答），同时在多次运行间最不稳定、成本最高。
AI.conclusion: 在所评估的流水线中，查询与证据之间增加步骤并未换来更有依据的答案；低资源市场中简单基线在归因与拒答上更可靠。作者将公开查询、系统输出、标签及简短证据片段。

title: NoLBERT-Calls: Reading Earnings Calls Without Hindsight
summary: Language models are now a standard tool for measuring what managers say on earnings calls, but the encoders behind these measures were usually pretrained on text from the same years a backtest covers. Holding out a test period does not remove that hindsight, because it sits in the features. We adapt NoLBERT, an encoder pretrained only on text published between 1976 and 1995, to earnings calls without letting it read anything dated after 31 December 2023. The calls supply the training signal themselves: every analyst question is followed by management's answer, and the model learns to pick that answer out from the other answers of the same call. We test on every US call from January 2025 to October 2026 (20,323 calls, 254,575 questions) and make every modeling choice on calls from 2024. The adapted model, NoLBERT-Calls-2023, ranks the true answer first for 78.0% of questions (95% interval 77.8-78.2; chance 8.0%), against 26.3% before adaptation. It is 1.0 point ahead of a call-adapted ChronoBERT, 3.4 points ahead of a call-adapted FinBERT, and 18.7 and 19.8 points ahead of the best off-the-shelf retriever and BM25. A year-by-year test over 2013-2026 finds no look-ahead premium: relative to a model adapted only through 2012, the released model does no better on the years it was trained on than on years it never saw. The price of the cutoff is compute: under one shared 150-minute recipe NoLBERT adapts least well of four encoders, and its lead comes from a longer, staged adaptation of about 13 GPU-hours.

AI.tldr: 提出 NoLBERT-Calls-2023：以仅预训练于 1976–1995 年文本的 NoLBERT 为基础，在严格截止 2023-12-31 的财报电话会议数据上，利用"问题—答案"配对信号自监督适配，实现无前视偏误的会议文本编码器，并在 2025–2026 年全量美股电话会议上前 1 命中率达 78.0%。
AI.motivation: 现有衡量管理层在财报电话会议中措辞的语言模型，其encoder通常在与回测期相同的年份文本上预训练，导致"后见之明"嵌入特征之中；仅留出测试期无法消除这一前视偏差。作者希望构建一个完全不接触测试期之后文本的编码器，以提供干净、可复现的测量工具。
AI.method: 以仅用 1976–1995 年出版文本预训练的 NoLBERT 为起点，在日期不晚于 2023-12-31 的电话会议语料上适配；训练信号来自对话结构本身——每个分析师问题需从同一场会议的其他答案中检索出对应的管理层回答（对比式检索目标）；所有建模选择仅基于 2024 年会议；测试集为 2025-01 至 2026-10 的全部 20,323 场美股会议、254,575 个问答对。另设 2012 年截止对照组做逐年检验。
AI.result: 适配后模型对 78.0% 的问题将真实答案排在第一（95% 区间 77.8–78.2；随机基线 8.0%），适配前仅 26.3%。较适配版 ChronoBERT 高 1.0 点，较适配版 FinBERT 高 3.4 点，较最佳现成检索器与 BM25 分别高 18.7 和 19.8 点。2013–2026 逐年检验未发现前视溢价：相对仅适配到 2012 年的模型，发布模型在训练年份与未见年份表现无差异。代价是算力：在统一的 150 分钟配方下 NoLBERT 适配效果最差，其领先来自约 13 GPU 小时的分阶段长时适配。
AI.conclusion: 通过"古早预训练 + 严格日期截止 + 对话自监督适配"，可在不引入后见之明的前提下获得显著优于同期预训练模型与通用检索器的会议语言表征；前视偏差可通过日期截断与逐年对照检验加以排除。其局限在于适配计算成本高、对训练配方敏感。

title: EfficientSkill: Learning Skills for Token-Efficient Multi-Turn Agents
summary: Reflective skill optimizers improve multi-turn LLM agents by revising instructions from failed and successful rollouts, yet accumulating edge-case rules bloats prompts, inflates token use, and pushes agents into long, error-prone loops. We introduce EfficientSkill, a two-step framework that first discovers a reliable skill without token penalties, and then warm-starts accuracy-guarded pruning from that skill to compress instructions, bound agent turns, and offload reusable code into workspace utilities with zero implementation prompt cost. Across four frontier, mid-tier, and open-weight models on MATH-500, ALFWorld, and SpreadsheetBench, EfficientSkill cuts output tokens over unconstrained EvoSkill on 11 of 12 configurations (by up to 80%) while raising mean accuracy on every benchmark, including +14.3 and +17.5 percentage-point gains on SpreadsheetBench with Gemini 3.8 Flash and Grok 4.1 Fast by replacing stalled loops with compact workflows. By shrinking both generated tokens and replayed history, EfficientSkill lowers total token usage and serving cost across every evaluated configuration, with or without full-prefix KV caching.

AI.tldr: EfficientSkill是一个两步框架：先在不产生token开销的前提下发现可靠技能，再以该技能热启动"准确率守卫的剪枝"，压缩指令、约束agent轮数并把可复用代码转为workspace工具。在4个模型×3个基准的12个配置中，11个配置输出token下降（最高降80%），且所有基准平均准确率提升（SpreadsheetBench上最高+17.5pp）。
AI.motivation: 反思式技能优化器通过失败/成功rollout修订指令来改进多轮LLM agent，但边缘案例规则不断累积导致prompt膨胀、token开销上升，并使agent陷入冗长易错的循环。
AI.method: 两步框架：第一步在无token惩罚约束下发现可靠技能（warm-start的优质初始技能）；第二步从该技能热启动准确率守卫的剪枝（accuracy-guarded pruning），压缩指令、限制agent轮数，并将可复用代码卸载为workspace工具，且实现阶段零prompt成本。
AI.result: 在MATH-500、ALFWorld、SpreadsheetBench上，覆盖前沿、中端与开源权重共4个模型：相对无约束EvoSkill，12个配置中11个输出token下降（最多80%），所有基准平均准确率均提升；Gemini 3.8 Flash与Grok 4.1 Fast在SpreadsheetBench上分别提升14.3和17.5个百分点，主要来自以紧凑工作流替代停滞循环。同时缩减生成token与重放历史，在全部配置下降低总token用量与服务成本，无论是否启用全前缀KV缓存。
AI.conclusion: 通过"先发现技能、再守卫式剪枝"的解耦设计，EfficientSkill在提升准确率的同时显著压缩token与成本，说明技能积累的关键在于精简与结构化解耦，而非规则堆叠。

title: A Dataset for Misogyny Detection in Polish Social Media: Transferability of Hateful Speech Detection from General to Specific Types of Hate
summary: Harmful language detection is commonly evaluated on broadly defined hate speech and toxicity benchmarks, yet it remains unclear whether models that successfully detect harmful language in general can transfer this capability to more specific forms of hate. We investigate this problem for misogyny detection in Polish, an area for which dedicated resources remain scarce. We introduce a new dataset of Polish social media comments annotated for misogyny, gender-directed hateful speech. Using this resource, we first assess the reliability of LLM-assisted annotation and then evaluate general-to-specific transfer by comparing models trained on general harmful language data, safety-specialized models, and models fine-tuned directly for misogyny detection. Our results show that strong performance on general harmful language detection does not transfer uniformly to misogyny; safety-specialized models demonstrate substantially stronger generalization ability. The study contributes a new Polish resource for gender-directed harmful language and demonstrates that the scope and granularity of prior safety training are important factors in transferring harmful language detection from general to specific forms of hate.

AI.tldr: 该文构建波兰语厌女言论数据集，检验通用有害语言检测能否迁移到特定仇恨形式，发现强通用性能并不能均匀迁移，安全专用模型泛化更强。
AI.motivation: 有害语言检测多在宽泛的仇恨言论/毒性基准上评测，但模型在通用有害语言上的成功是否能迁移到更具体的仇恨形式（如厌女）尚不清楚；同时波兰语厌女检测的专用资源稀缺。
AI.method: 构建一个新的波兰语社交媒体评论数据集，按厌女（针对性别的仇恨言论）标注；先用该资源评估LLM辅助标注的可靠性，再通过比较三类模型考察“通用到特定”的迁移：基于通用有害语言数据训练的模型、安全专用模型、直接针对厌女检测微调的模型。
AI.result: 通用有害语言检测上的强性能并不能均匀迁移到厌女检测；安全专用模型表现出显著更强的泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 研究贡献了一个面向性别指向有害语言的波兰语新资源，并表明既有安全训练的范围与粒度是影响有害语言检测从通用仇恨向特定仇恨形式迁移的重要因素。

title: Jailbreak LLMs with Linguistic Style as a Hidden Attack Surface
summary: We show that linguistic style is a systematic and previously overlooked attack surface for LLM safety. Across a diverse taxonomy of styles and multiple state-of-the-art models, stylistic rewrites of identical harmful goals produce order-of-magnitude differences in Attack Success Rate (ASR), with some styles achieving up to 80\% ASR while others remain below 6\%. To exploit this vulnerability, we introduce a lightweight single-pass attack framework that combines a style-conditioned generator with a BERT-based style selector, achieving performance competitive with substantially more expensive multi-turn optimization methods. To understand why style affects safety behavior, we conduct mechanistic analysis on LLaMA-3.1-8B and find that stylistic rewrites disrupt refusal representations while preserving recoverable harmful intent, suggesting a distributed failure mode rather than a single refusal mechanism. Motivated by this finding, we develop a style-aware Direct Preference Optimization defense that reduces ASR from 86\% to 19.5\% while largely preserving utility. Together, our results establish linguistic style as a critical factor in adversarial robustness and provide both mechanistic insight and a practical defense.

AI.tldr: 语言风格是LLM安全中被忽视的系统性攻击面：相同有害目标经不同风格改写可致ASR相差数量级；作者提出轻量单次攻击框架、进行机制分析，并提出风格感知DPO防御将ASR从86%降至19.5%。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM安全研究多关注语义层面的对抗改写，而语言风格这一维度未被视为独立、系统性的攻击面，其影响幅度与内在机制均缺乏量化与解释。
AI.method: 构建多样化的风格分类体系，对相同有害目标做风格化改写并在多个SOTA模型上测ASR；提出由风格条件生成器与BERT风格选择器组成的单次攻击框架；在LLaMA-3.1-8B上做机制分析（拒绝表征与有害意图的可恢复性）；据此设计风格感知的DPO防御。
AI.result: 风格显著影响ASR：部分风格ASR高达80%，另一些低于6%，差异达数量级；单次攻击框架性能可与昂贵的多轮优化方法竞争；机制分析显示风格改写给拒绝表征带来扰动，但有害意图仍可恢复，呈分布式失效模式；风格感知DPO将ASR从86%降至19.5%，且基本保持模型效用。
AI.conclusion: 语言风格是影响对抗鲁棒性的关键因素，论文同时提供了机制解释与可落地的防御方案，提示安全对齐需将风格纳入考量。

title: Beyond Controllability: Speaker Diversity in Instruction-Guided Text-to-Speech
summary: Instruction-guided text-to-speech (ITTS) lets users specify voice properties in natural language. Applications from conversational AI character voices to synthetic training data for downstream speech models depend on the system producing many distinct voices when the same broad category is requested repeatedly. No prior work audits whether ITTS outputs are in fact diverse, either compared to real speech or across attribute values. We evaluate seven open-source ITTS systems using speaker embeddings whose representational capacity we independently validate. Every system produces speaker distributions markedly narrower than real speech. Furthermore, female prompts produce less diverse voice pools than male prompts across most systems. In contrast, accent and emotion prompts barely alter speaker diversity in most systems, but reveal a strong controllability bias toward North American English and neutral speech. These results show that diversity and controllability capture complementary weaknesses, neither of which alone is sufficient to evaluate ITTS. Our code and data are available at https://github.com/dlion168/ITTS-Speaker-Diversity.

AI.tldr: 该论文首次系统审计指令引导TTS（ITTS）输出说话人多样性，发现七个开源系统生成的音色分布均显著窄于真实语音，且女性提示的多样性低于男性提示，重音/情感提示几乎不改变多样性却暴露强烈的可控性偏差（偏向北美英语和中性语音），表明多样性与可控性构成互补的评估维度。
AI.motivation: ITTS应用于对话式AI角色音色、下游语音模型合成训练数据等场景时，需在重复请求同一大类时产出大量不同音色；但此前没有工作审计ITTS输出是否真正多样（相对于真实语音或跨属性取值）。
AI.method: 评估七个开源ITTS系统，采用说话人嵌入，并独立验证该嵌入的表征能力；通过对比不同属性提示（性别、重音、情感）下的说话人分布与真实语音分布，量化多样性与可控性。
AI.result: 所有系统的说话人分布都明显窄于真实语音；在多数系统中，女性提示产生的音色池多样性低于男性提示；重音与情感提示在多数系统中几乎不改变说话人多样性，但显示出对北美英语和中性语音的强烈可控性偏差。
AI.conclusion: 多样性与可控性揭示了ITTS互补的弱点，单靠任一维度都不足以评估ITTS；代码与数据已公开。

title: MarineSparkLM-4B: A Lightweight Language Model for Marine and Offshore Engineering Built by Parameter-Efficient Adaptation
summary: Marine and offshore engineering text is spread across preprints, open-access journals, encyclopedias and institutional documents, and the amount of it is small by pretraining standards. We ask how far a lightweight language model for marine and offshore engineering can be taken with parameter-efficient adaptation on a single workstation-class device. Starting from the 4-billion-parameter OceanGPT-basic-4B-Instruct, we train two independent LoRA adapters, each updating 33.0 million of 4.06 billion parameters (0.81%). Training took 4 hours 40 minutes for the first adapter and 10 minutes for the second on one NVIDIA DGX Spark. The first adapter is trained by next-token prediction on a 61.6-million-token corpus covering ten engineering themes. The corpus was built from 13,879 source documents, of which 7,069 were retained after deduplication and a two-tier keyword filter that removes cross-domain lexical collisions. Its validation loss falls from 2.082 to 1.976 over 1,500 steps. Direct testing showed that this adapter could still drift off topic on a retrieval-grounded ballast-water prompt, so we trained a second adapter on 2,295 question-answer pairs (114 hand-written and 2,181 generated by the base model from corpus passages) with the loss restricted to answer tokens. On 20 held-out prompts scored by hand for accuracy, topicality and specificity (maximum 120), the plain base model, the continuation adapter, the instruction adapter and the instruction adapter with retrieval scored 42, 56, 84 and 88. Absolute accuracy stays low (14 of 40 without retrieval and 20 of 40 with it). We report the full pipeline, two negative results (a reverted keyword fix and an instruction run that overfit within 100 steps), and the limits of the evaluation, which uses one small prompt set, no inter-rater agreement measure and model-generated reference answers.

AI.tldr: 在单台工作站级设备上用LoRA对OceanGPT-basic-4B-Instruct做参数高效适配，构建海洋与近海工程领域轻量语言模型，并报告完整流程、负结果与评测局限。
AI.motivation: 海洋与近海工程文本分散于预印本、开放获取期刊、百科与机构文档，规模远低于预训练标准量级；作者想探究轻量领域模型在单台工作站级设备上通过参数高效适配能达到何种程度。
AI.method: 以40亿参数OceanGPT-basic-4B-Instruct为基座，训练两个独立LoRA适配器，各更新3300万/40.6亿参数（0.81%）。第一个适配器用下一词预测在6160万token语料（覆盖十个工程主题，源自13,879份文档，去重及两级关键词过滤后保留7,069份）上训练；因检索增强的压载水提示仍会跑题，第二个适配器用2,295条问答对（114条手写+2,181条由基座模型基于语料段落生成）训练，损失仅计答案token。训练在单台NVIDIA DGX Spark上完成，分别耗时4小时40分和10分钟。
AI.result: 第一个适配器验证损失在1,500步内由2.082降至1.976。20条留出提示按准确性、主题相关性、具体性人工打分（满分120）：原始基座、续写适配器、指令适配器、指令适配器+检索分别为42、56、84、88。绝对准确率仍偏低（无检索14/40，有检索20/40）。
AI.conclusion: 报告了完整流程、两项负结果（被回退的关键词修复、100步内过拟合的指令训练）及评测局限（提示集小、无评分者间一致性度量、参考答案由模型生成），说明该路线可行但评测证据有限。

title: Non-Deterministic Finite Automata for Telugu Letters and Visualizations for Metrical Poetry
summary: Syllabic weight is central to Telugu metrical poetry. Syllabically, every letter (aksharam token) is either light (laghuvu) or heavy (guruvu). Poets classify it using a set of pre-defined rules. This paper formalizes aksharam token, the atomic unit of syllabic classification, as a non-deterministic finite automaton (NFA) with the regular expression$\colon$ $(A_h+A_d+A_p)(ε+V_s)+A_m+H^+G(ε+H+V_s+V_v)$, where $ε$ denotes a null string, $A$ denotes a vowel (achchu), comprising hrasvam ($A_h$), deergham ($A_d$), plutham ($A_p$), and miscellaneous ($A_m$), $H$ a pure consonant (pollu\_hallu), $G$ a vowel diacritic (gunintha\_chihnam), $V_s$ the sunna (anusvara), and $V_v$ the visarga, the latter two being nasal and aspirated sounds respectively. We then present automata diagrams and regular expressions for (i) a necessary condition satisfied by every light letter, and (ii) a sufficient condition for a letter to be heavy. Finally, we propose graphical visualizations for the 9 Telugu poem types.

AI.tldr: 本文将泰卢固语诗歌的音节分类原子单位 aksharam 形式化为正则表达式与 NFA，给出轻音节的必要条件与重音节的充分条件，并对9种诗型作图形化可视化。
AI.motivation: 泰卢固语格律诗的核心在于音节轻重（laghuvu/guruvu）判定，传统上依赖诗人依据经验规则分类，缺乏显式、可计算的形式化定义，难以支撑自动化分析与教学。
AI.method: 把 aksharam 这一原子单位建模为非确定性有限自动机（NFA），对应正则表达式 (Ah+Ad+Ap)(ε+Vs)+Am+H⁺G(ε+H+Vs+Vv)，其中 ε 为空串，A 为元音（含 hrasvam、deergham、plutham 及杂类），H 为纯辅音 pollu_hallu，G 为元音变音符 gunintha_chihnam，Vs 为anusvara、Vv 为 visarga；随后给出自动机状态图与正则表达式，分别刻画每个轻字母的必要条件与字母为重的充分条件。
AI.result: 建立了可形式化表达的轻/重音节判别条件（轻音节必要条件、重音节充分条件），并以自动机图与正则表达式呈现；同时对9种泰卢固诗型提出了图形可视化方案。
AI.conclusion: 有限自动机方法可为泰卢固语音节权重判定提供严格、可实现的表述，并利于诗型结构的可视化与后续计算处理。

title: Beyond Binary Audits: Does Guideline Grounding Mitigate Decision-Space Framing in LLM Opioid Prescribing?
summary: Audits of LLMs for bias in opioid prescribing have largely relied on binary treatment decisions, a signal that current models have saturated. We introduce Q-Pain++, a full-factorial stress test that holds clinical content fixed while independently varying clinical risk factors and the granularity of the available dosage options. Adding an intermediate dosage option to otherwise unchanged vignettes substantially lowers agreement with expert-annotated dosages for most models, while demographic differences in dosage decisions remain small in all but one configuration once clinical risk factors are added. Grounding models in perioperative guidelines through retrieval reduces this framing effect on average but does not eliminate it, and one model's treatment decisions change when the retrieved passages are reordered. These results suggest that audits should vary the answer format, not only patient identity. We will release our codebase as well as Guideline-RAG-associated resources on GitHub (https://github.com/su-boussard-lab/llm-guideline-grounding-opioids).

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Q-Pain++，通过全因子压力测试在保持临床内容不变的前提下独立改变临床风险因素与可用剂量选项的粒度，发现增加一个中间剂量选项会显著降低多数模型与专家标注剂量的–致性（框架效应），而人口统计学差异在加入临床风险因素后大多很小；检索增强指南可平均上缓解但不能消除该效应，且存在检索段落顺序敏感性。
AI.motivation: 现有针对 LLM 阿片类处方偏见的审计多依赖二元治疗决策，而该信号在当前模型中已趋于饱和，难以揭示模型行为差异；因此需要能更敏感地暴露模型决策偏差与不稳定性的审计设计。
AI.method: 提出 Q-Pain++ 全因子压力测试：固定临床内容，独立操控两类因素——临床风险因素与可用剂量选项的粒度（如是否加入中间剂量）；同时以围手术期指南检索增强（Guideline-RAG）对模型进行 grounding，并检验检索段落重排对决策的影响。
AI.result: 在原本不变的病历中加入一个中间剂量选项后，多数模型与专家标注剂量的–致性显著下降；加入临床风险因素后，除一种配置外，剂量决策中的人口统计学差异均较小；检索增强平均上减弱该框架效应但未消除，且有一个模型的治疗决策随检索段落顺序改变而变化。
AI.conclusion: 剂量决策对答案格式（选项粒度）高度敏感，说明审计不应只改变患者身份，还应系统改变答案格式；同时检索增强并非稳健性保障。作者将开源代码库及 Guideline-RAG 相关资源。

title: All the Pieces Matter! A Six-stage Analysis of an Underground Fraud Ecosystem on Dread
summary: Cyber-enabled fraud is a dominant global threat that causes severe financial loss, identity theft, and widespread psychological harm. This illicit economy relies on a highly specialized underground ecosystem where distinct actors exchange technical tools, operational techniques, and laundering channels. This research presents a case study of one such live fraud ecosystem from the perspective of a cohesive six-stage value chain spanning from preparation to monetization: Capability, Data Acquisition, Technique Sharing, Identity Forgery, Execution, and Extraction. Analyzing 67,976 posts and 305,048 comments from nine communities on the Tor-based darknet forum Dread, we map user trajectories, content distribution, and the adoption of generative AI. Our findings show that structural cohesion within the ecosystem is maintained by a thin layer of `bridgers' who generate the majority of all content. Against a degree-preserving null model, three knowledge-building upstream stages of the value chain form a tightly coupled cluster, whereas the remaining three operational downstream stages resolve into highly specialized populations with small personnel overlap. Finally, we demonstrate that generative AI is being rapidly but unevenly absorbed across the value chain; the technology saturates knowledge-building communities while operational stages remain largely untouched. By quantifying criminal specialization and structural integration, our network-based approach provides a framework for targeted, high-impact law enforcement interventions.

AI.tldr: 该文以Tor暗网论坛Dread中九个社区、67,976条帖子和305,048条评论为数据，从"六阶段价值链"视角刻画一个活跃网络诈骗地下生态系统的结构分工与生成式AI渗透情况。研究发现生态系统凝聚力依赖极少数"桥接者"，上游知识型阶段紧密耦合、下游操作型阶段高度专门化，生成式AI在上游知识社区迅速饱和而在下游操作阶段基本未被采用，为精准执法干预提供网络分析框架。
AI.motivation: 网络诈骗构成全球性威胁，造成严重经济损失、身份盗用与心理伤害，其背后是高度专业化的地下生态系统，不同行为者交换技术工具、操作手法与洗钱渠道。然而现有研究缺乏对该生态系统内部结构分工、人员流动与新技术（尤其是生成式AI）采纳情况的系统量化，难以支撑有针对性的执法干预。
AI.method: 案例研究：选取Tor暗网论坛Dread上九个社区，采集67,976条帖子与305,048条评论。构建覆盖"准备—变现"的六阶段价值链框架（Capability、Data Acquisition、Technique Sharing、Identity Forgery、Execution、Extraction），映射用户轨迹与内容分布，度量生成式AI的采纳情况；并采用保度零模型（degree-preserving null model）作为对照，检验各阶段社区间的耦合程度与人员重叠。
AI.result: 生态系统结构凝聚力由极少数"桥接者"（bridgers）维持，其贡献了大部分内容。相对保度零模型，价值链上游三个知识建构阶段形成紧密耦合的集群，而下游三个操作阶段分化为高度专门化的人群，人员重叠很小。生成式AI被迅速但不均衡地吸纳：在知识建构类社区中趋于饱和，而在操作阶段基本未被触及。
AI.conclusion: 该研究通过量化犯罪专业化程度与结构整合水平，揭示了网络诈骗地下经济"薄桥接层维系整体、上下游分工分化、AI采纳不均衡"的组织规律。所提出的基于网络的分析框架可支持有针对性、高影响的执法干预，例如聚焦桥接者与上游知识枢纽。

title: Skill Transfer: Adapting Agent Skills from Strong to Weak Agents
summary: Agent skills are modular bundles of instructions, code, and resources that an agent loads on demand, increasingly authored and validated on frontier models and shared as an open standard. The same skill behaves differently across models: a strong model turns it into a large performance gain, while a weak model realizes little of that gain and sometimes does worse than with no skill at all. Cost and resource constraints, however, often restrict real deployments to exactly these weaker agents. We hypothesize that the strong model silently supplies procedural steps the skill leaves implicit, which the weak model omits, and formalize closing this gap as \emph{Skill Transfer}: holding the skill's capability ceiling and the model's parameters fixed, we adapt the skill so a specific weak agent can execute it well. Our method abstracts strong and weak trajectories into typed execution structures, localizes their structural divergence with a graph edit distance (GED), and repairs the skill through an iterative diagnoser-patcher loop. Across three benchmarks and two model families, Skill Transfer raises pass rate over the unmodified skill significantly and well over other skill-evolution baselines. The adapted skill also improves the strong agent it was never adapted for, and transfers out of distribution to a structurally related, unseen task. Code is available at https://github.com/Yifan-Lan/Skill-Transfer

AI.tldr: 提出 Skill Transfer：在不改变技能能力上限与模型参数的前提下，通过类型化执行结构抽象与图编辑距离定位强弱模型轨迹结构差异，并用诊断器-修补器迭代循环修补技能，使弱模型能有效执行同一技能。
AI.motivation: Agent Skills 作为开放标准在强模型上验证与创作，但同一技能在不同模型上表现差异巨大：强模型获得大幅性能提升，弱模型收益甚微甚至不如无技能；而成本与资源约束又常使实际部署只能使用弱模型。作者假设强模型会隐式补全技能中未写明的过程性步骤，弱模型则遗漏这些步骤，因此需要把这一差距形式化为 Skill Transfer 问题并加以闭合。
AI.method: 固定技能能力上限与模型参数，仅适配技能本身。方法分三步：(1) 将强、弱模型的执行轨迹抽象为类型化执行结构（typed execution structures）；(2) 用图编辑距离（GED）定位两者结构上的分歧点；(3) 通过迭代的诊断器-修补器（diagnoser-patcher）循环修复技能。在三个基准、两个模型家族上评估，并与多种技能演化基线对比。
AI.result: Skill Transfer 显著提升通过率，优于未修改技能，并明显优于其他技能演化基线；适配后的技能对从未针对其适配的强模型也有提升，且能分布外迁移到结构相关但未见过的任务。
AI.conclusion: 弱模型执行技能的瓶颈主要在于技能中被隐式省略的过程性步骤，而非能力上限；通过结构级诊断与修补即可实现跨模型的技能迁移，并具有向强模型回溢与分布外泛化的正向外溢效应。

title: Assisting Patients with Reliable Information Gathering: A Guide to Building Efficient QA Systems for Medical Use
summary: The application of question-answering (QA) systems in the medical domain has rapidly advanced, significantly improving patients' access to reliable health-related information. However, current approaches face notable challenges, including the difficulty in obtaining large-scale and unbiased medical datasets, significant privacy concerns, and inefficiencies due to manual dataset annotation. To address these issues, This study introduce a novel methodology leveraging publicly accessible online health forums to systematically build an unbiased, privacy-conscious QA dataset, and it employs Topic-guided Semantic Modeling (TGSM) for automated topic identification, enabling efficient and targeted annotation of relevant patient-generated content. Subsequently, this study propose a two-stage QA pipeline based on a Retriever-Reader architecture, which is further enhanced through fine-tuning state-of-the-art transformer-based models on the constructed domain-specific QA dataset. Experimental results demonstrate that our fine-tuned BioBERT significantly outperforms existing benchmarks, offering accurate patient-derived insights and providing a replicable framework for building efficient medical QA systems.

AI.tldr: 该文提出利用公开健康论坛构建无偏、隐私友好的医学问答数据集，采用主题引导语义建模（TGSM）实现自动主题识别与定向标注，并基于Retriever-Reader两阶段架构、在领域数据上微调Transformer模型；微调后的BioBERT显著优于现有基线。
AI.motivation: 现有医学问答系统面临三大痛点：难以获取大规模且无偏的医学数据集、显著的隐私顾虑、以及人工标注效率低下。作者希望以公开健康论坛为数据源，绕开隐私与标注瓶颈，构建可复用的医学QA数据与系统。
AI.method: 1) 系统化地从公开在线健康论坛采集数据，构建无偏且注重隐私的QA数据集；2) 提出主题引导语义建模（TGSM）进行自动化主题识别，从而对相关患者生成内容做高效、定向的标注；3) 构建基于Retriever-Reader架构的两阶段QA流水线；4) 在构建的领域特定QA数据集上微调先进Transformer模型。
AI.result: 实验表明，微调后的BioBERT显著优于现有基准方法，能够提供准确的患者来源洞见，并形成可复现的医学QA系统构建框架。
AI.conclusion: 以公开健康论坛为数据源、结合TGSM自动主题识别与Retriever-Reader两阶段架构并微调领域预训练模型，是缓解医学QA数据稀缺、隐私与标注成本问题的有效路径，且该框架具备可复制推广性。

title: Intrinsic Attention as Navigator: A Non-Generative Retrieval Method for Multi-Hop Queries
summary: For multi-hop queries in retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), it is crucial to accurately obtain evidence pieces. In this study, we propose a training-free method for multi-hop query retrieval, named Intrinsic Navigating-based Non-Generative Retrieval (IN-Retriever). Instead of generating intermediate reasoning text, the method extracts the bridging clue from the internal attention of the embedding model based on the current context and retrieved candidate documents. During iterative clue extraction and document retrieval, IN-Retriever strips away revealed clues from the embedded query vector and then reranks candidate documents in a targeted manner, thereby steering retrieval toward hidden next-hop evidence. In the experiments, we confirm the feasibility and effectiveness of using intrinsic attention signals to guide external multi-hop retrieval. Experimental results show that our method precisely collects sufficient documents to support multi-hop queries and significantly outperforms sparse and dense retrieval methods.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练的多跳检索方法 IN-Retriever，利用嵌入模型内部注意力提取桥接线索，迭代剥离已揭示线索并重排序候选文档，定向引导检索至隐藏的下一跳证据。
AI.motivation: 多跳查询的 RAG 需准确获取证据片段，而现有方法多依赖生成中间推理文本，成本高且易引入生成误差，故需一种免训练、非生成的检索方案。
AI.method: 基于当前上下文与已检索候选文档，从嵌入模型的内部注意力中抽取桥接线索（非生成式）；在迭代的线索抽取—文档检索循环中，从查询向量中剥离已揭示线索，并对候选文档进行针对性重排序，从而将检索导向尚未发现的下一跳证据。
AI.result: 实验验证利用内在注意力信号指导外部多跳检索的可行性与有效性；该方法能精确收集支撑多跳查询的充分文档，并显著优于稀疏与稠密检索方法。
AI.conclusion: 内部注意力信号可作为免训练多跳检索的有效引导，IN-Retriever 在证据召回与检索性能上优于传统稀疏/稠密基线。

title: Self-Evolving Dual-Role Deliberation for Medication Recommendation from Clinical Records
summary: Recommending medications from electronic health records (EHRs) is a safety-critical task that demands therapeutic coverage, explicit safety constraints, traceable justification, and continual adaptivity. Supervised neural models freeze at deployment and cannot reason about new phenotypes, while existing LLM pipelines are single-pass and lack a cross-case improvement loop. We propose SEMPA, a training-free agentic framework that couples a Proposer with a Critic in multi-round adversarial deliberation, grounds candidates with molecular-aware retrieval, contrastively evolves both agents' natural-language policies under a semantic-anchor constraint, and enforces rule-based DDI and contraindication checks. On 100 MIMIC-IV encounters, SEMPA reaches 0.3116 Jaccard, 0.7295 F1, and a 0.0172 DDI rate, improving F1 by 57.7% and cutting DDI by 77.5% over the strongest supervised baseline. Two LLM judges rank SEMPA highest, and six-backbone studies confirm that gains derive from the framework rather than a specific model.

AI.tldr: 提出无训练的智能体框架SEMPA，通过Proposer-Critic多轮对抗审议、分子感知检索、语义锚点约束下的对比式策略进化与规则化DDI/禁忌检查，实现安全可追溯的用药推荐。
AI.motivation: 基于EHR的用药推荐是安全关键任务，需同时满足治疗覆盖、显式安全约束、可追溯依据与持续适应性。监督神经模型部署即冻结、无法推理新表型；现有LLM流水线为单遍推理，缺乏跨病例改进闭环。
AI.method: SEMPA为免训练智能体框架：Proposer与Critic进行多轮对抗式审议；以分子感知检索为候选提供依据；在语义锚点约束下对两智能体的自然语言策略进行对比式演化；并施加基于规则的DDI与禁忌症检查。
AI.result: 在100例MIMIC-IV病例上达到Jaccard 0.3116、F1 0.7295、DDI率0.0172；相较最强监督基线F1提升57.7%、DDI下降77.5%。两个LLM评审均将SEMPA评为最优，六种骨干模型实验表明增益源于框架而非特定模型。
AI.conclusion: 免训练、可自进化的双智能体审议框架能在不更新模型参数的前提下，同时提升用药推荐的准确性与安全性，并具备跨模型泛化性。

title: Bridging Semantics and Utilities: A Controllable and Scalable Market Simulation
summary: Large language models(LLMs) have recently been used to construct generative agents for financial market simulation. Existing approaches typically prompt each agent separately with public market information and a private investor profile, and ask the model to directly generate trading actions. In this agent-wise design, the model repeatedly interprets information shared across the population, while individual behavior is controlled through textual descriptions of investor preferences and traits. This creates two structural difficulties: continuous traits such as risk sensitivity do not reliably induce ordered behavioral changes, and repeatedly processing the same public information causes inference costs to grow with the number of agents. We propose \textbf{SUM}, a Semantic-Utility Model that separates cohort-level semantic perception from agent-level utility-based decision-making. A language model interprets public market information for each investor type and produces semantic signals shared within the corresponding cohort. Individual agents then combine these signals with their private states, preferences, and constraints to generate orders through utility-based decisions. Experiments in an A-share limit-order-book market show that \textbf{SUM} provides more stable and monotonic behavioral control than prompt-based agents while substantially reducing repeated language-model inference as the population grows. Closed-loop simulations further reproduce directional market responses, volatility persistence, differentiated investment styles, and persistent wealth heterogeneity. These results establish \textbf{SUM} as a controllable, scalable, and semantically informed framework for financial market simulation.

AI.tldr: 提出 SUM（Semantic-Utility Model），将"群体级语义感知"与"个体级效用决策"分离，用 LLM 为每类投资者解读公共市场信息生成队列内共享语义信号，个体再结合私有状态与约束经效用决策下单，从而获得更稳定单调的行为控制与更低的重复推理成本。
AI.motivation: 现有金融市场生成式智能体采用"逐智能体"设计：每个智能体单独以公共市场信息+私有投资者画像提示模型直接生成交易动作。存在两点结构性缺陷：(1) 风险敏感度等连续特质仅通过文本描述控制，难以可靠诱发有序（单调）的行为变化；(2) 每个智能体重复解读同一公共信息，推理成本随智能体数量线性增长。
AI.method: SUM 采取双层架构：队列（cohort）层由语言模型针对每类投资者解读公共市场信息，产出在该队列内共享的语义信号；个体层不再调用 LLM，而是将语义信号与个体私有状态、偏好与约束结合，通过效用函数（utility-based decision）生成订单。以此把共享信息的语言理解摊薄到队列粒度。
AI.result: 在 A 股限价订单簿市场实验中，SUM 相较基于提示的智能体具有更稳定、更单调的行为控制能力，且随群体规模扩大显著减少重复的语言模型推理；闭环仿真复现了方向性市场反应、波动率持续性、差异化的投资风格以及持续的财富异质性。
AI.conclusion: SUM 为金融市场仿真提供了一个可控、可扩展且具语义感知能力的框架：语义理解与效用决策的解耦既改善了行为参数的可控性，又缓解了 LLM 推理成本随规模膨胀的问题。

title: Many Paths to the Same Mistake: Generating Diverse Reasoning Paths Behind the Same Student Mistake
summary: Realistic evaluation of AI systems requires user simulators that capture not only cooperative behavior, but also the errors and variability that arise in real interactions. In educational technology, simulating step-by-step flawed student reasoning is essential, yet datasets mapping these pathways are scarce, and Large Language Models (LLMs) often auto-correct rather than sustain simulated mistakes. To address this, we present a generate-and-filter pipeline that produces diverse and realistic student error traces. Our approach utilizes forward consistency, a metric verifying if a flawed reasoning trace can be used to recover the student's actual incorrect answer, paired with an LLM-as-a-judge to ensure realism. Our evaluation suggests that while many LLMs struggle to maintain incorrect reasoning mid-trace, smaller supervised fine-tuned models successfully capture these divergent paths. This work provides a framework for high-fidelity error trace generation, advancing realistic, non-cooperative user simulation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出“生成-过滤”流水线，利用前向一致性（forward consistency）指标与LLM-as-a-judge，生成多样且真实的学生错误推理轨迹，用于高保真、非合作式用户模拟。
AI.motivation: 评估AI系统需要能模拟真实交互中错误与变异的用户模拟器；教育场景中逐步错误的学生推理尤为关键，但此类路径数据稀缺，且LLM倾向自动纠正而非维持模拟错误。
AI.method: 构建generate-and-filter流水线：生成候选错误推理轨迹，用“前向一致性”度量检验该错误轨迹能否复原学生真实的错误答案，并结合LLM-as-a-judge评估真实性，从而筛选高质量轨迹。
AI.result: 实验表明许多LLM难以在推理中途维持错误推理，而较小的监督微调模型能成功捕获这些偏离路径。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提供高保真错误轨迹生成框架，推动真实、非合作式用户模拟的发展。

title: One Question, Four Voices: How Advice for Alzheimer's Caregiving Differs Between Caregivers, Clinicians, and Large Language Models
comment: Accepted to ACM CSCW 2026. 35 pages, 7 figures
summary: Online caregiver forums are an important source of emotional and informational support for Alzheimer's disease and related dementias (ADRD). We compare responses to 85 real caregiver questions from ALZConnected across four responder groups: peer caregivers, physicians, ChatGPT, and a retrieval-augmented CareGPT grounded in peer discussions. Using 28 measures spanning linguistic form, emotional support, informational support, and topic scope, we examine how these voices differ when answering the same questions. Peers provided time-anchored narratives and community grounding; clinicians offered concise, advice-forward, clinically bounded guidance; and LLMs produced a formal, verbose, highly structured consultation style. CareGPT showed minimal measurable separation from ChatGPT, suggesting that retrieval plus prompt injection alone was insufficient to shift communicative stance. LLM outputs scored higher than peers on politeness and emotion-support markers and were comparable to clinicians on informativeness and physician-alignment measures, but were less narrative and less contextually situated. Topic modeling showed that LLM responses concentrated on advice-oriented themes, whereas peers covered a broader range, including emotional processing, legal and financial concerns, and daily care. These findings suggest that AI can complement, but not replace, human contributions to ADRD caregiver support and motivate hybrid systems that combine structured AI delivery with the distinct strengths of human voices.

AI.tldr: 比较85个真实照护者问题在同伴照护者、医生、ChatGPT与检索增强CareGPT四类回答者下的表现，发现AI可补充但无法替代人类支持。
AI.motivation: 在线照护者论坛是ADRD照护者重要的情感与信息支持来源，需明确AI回答与人类（同伴、医生）回答在 communicative stance 上的差异，以判断AI能否承担支持角色。
AI.method: 基于ALZConnected的85个真实照护者问题，对比四类回答者（同伴照护者、医生、ChatGPT、基于同伴讨论检索增强的CareGPT）；采用28项指标，涵盖语言形式、情感支持、信息支持与话题范围，并结合主题建模分析。
AI.result: 同伴提供时间锚定叙事与社区归属感；临床医生给出简洁、建议导向、临床边界明确的指导；LLM呈正式、冗长、高度结构化的咨询风格。CareGPT与ChatGPT差异极小，说明仅靠检索+提示注入不足以改变交际立场。LLM在礼貌与情感支持标记上高于同伴，在信息量与医生一致性上与临床医生相当，但叙事性和情境性较弱。主题建模显示LLM集中于建议类主题，同伴覆盖情感处理、法律财务、日常照护等更广主题。
AI.conclusion: AI只能补充而非替代人类对ADRD照护者的支持，应发展将结构化AI输出与人类声音独特优势相结合的混合系统。

title: KUDEX: A Zero-Shot Decompositional Framework for Logical Analysis in Natural Language
summary: While Large Language Models (LLMs) excel at generating fluent text, they often struggle with multi-step logical reasoning with inferential connections among statements. We introduce KUDEX (Knowledge-Upward-Downward Reasoning Extension), a novel zero-shot, decompositional framework for analyzing and verifying logical relationships in natural language. Unlike traditional approaches that rely on surface-level entailment checks, KUDEX leverages LLMs to decompose reasoning into atomic primitives and constructs transparent reasoning graphs that serve both as execution traces and audit logs. Our framework includes a general prompt adaptation pipeline that adapts to diverse reasoning tasks without additional fine-tuning or domain-specific pipelines. Through comprehensive experiments on benchmarks across four domains, we demonstrate that KUDEX provides superior performance compared to existing methods, offering a more granular and robust framework for assessing logical relationships between statements.

AI.tldr: 提出KUDEX——一个零样本、分解式框架，利用LLM将自然语言推理分解为原子原语并构造可解释的推理图，实现更强的语句间逻辑关系分析与验证。
AI.motivation: LLM生成文本流畅，但在涉及语句间推断连接的多步逻辑推理上表现不佳；传统方法依赖表层蕴含检查，缺乏细粒度与透明性。
AI.method: KUDEX（Knowledge-Upward-Downward Reasoning Extension）：零样本分解式框架，用LLM把推理拆解为原子原语，构建透明推理图（兼作执行轨迹与审计日志）；并配有通用提示适配流水线，无需微调或领域专用管线即可适配多种推理任务。
AI.result: 在覆盖四个领域的基准测试上，KUDEX优于现有方法，对语句间逻辑关系的评估更细粒度、更鲁棒。
AI.conclusion: 将推理分解为原子原语并显式建图，可在零样本下提升多步逻辑推理的准确性与可审计性，且具有跨任务、跨领域的通用性。

title: Sada-ASR: A Production Multidialectal Arabic Speech Recognition System
summary: Callers to Arabic customer-service lines speak their own dialect, while speech recognizers are built and evaluated mainly on Modern Standard Arabic (MSA). A recognizer that mishears the dialect breaks the call before anything else can help. We present Sada-ASR, the speech recognizer of EchoNova's production Arabic voice agent. On a 120-hour test set of MSA and eight dialects, it has the lowest word and character error rates of twelve systems, against eleven from Microsoft, ElevenLabs, Google, OpenAI, Speechmatics, IFM, Cohere, NVIDIA and Audar: 11.69% word error rate against 13.51% for the strongest, Microsoft's MAI-Transcribe-2 (a lead of 0.74 points on clips unaffected by that system's fixed number and script conventions), and 15.52% against 16.96% averaged over varieties. Its largest margins are on Omani (4.30 points), Egyptian (3.78) and Saudi (2.19) speech; it is level on Syrian and loses on Lebanese (24.96% against 23.05%), mostly because it writes Lebanese words in MSA forms and is less verbatim. On six public test sets its average word error rate under the leaderboard's current scoring is 17.17%, below every published figure we found, among them Falcon-ASR (20.92%), Jais-ASR (22.85%) and Audar-ASR-V1-Turbo (23.17%), though none of these states that it used that scoring, so the comparison is indicative. We describe the data pipeline and methodology behind Sada-ASR and release a 20-hour subset of the test set with our scoring code.

AI.tldr: Sada-ASR：面向阿拉伯语方言客服场景的生产级语音识别系统，在120小时MSA与八方言测试集上以11.69% WER优于12个系统。
AI.motivation: 客服来电者使用各自方言，而识别器主要以现代标准阿拉伯语（MSA）构建与评测，方言误识别会在对话开始前就中断通话，因此需要面向真实方言语音的生产级识别器。
AI.method: 构建 Sada-ASR（EchoNova 生产级阿拉伯语语音代理的识别器），涵盖数据流水线与方法论；在120小时、覆盖MSA与八种方言的测试集上，与来自微软、ElevenLabs、Google、OpenAI、Speechmatics、IFM、Cohere、NVIDIA、Audar 的十一个系统进行对比评测。
AI.result: 整体WER 11.69%，最强对手微软 MAI-Transcribe-2 为13.51%（在其数字/书写规范未受影响片段上领先0.74点）；方言平均15.52% vs 16.96%。优势最大的为阿曼方言（4.30点）、埃及（3.78）、沙特（2.19）；叙利亚持平；黎巴嫩落后（24.96% vs 23.05%），主要因将黎巴嫩词汇转写为MSA形式、逐字性较弱。六个公开测试集平均WER 17.17%，低于所查到的所有已公布数字（Falcon-ASR 20.92%、Jais-ASR 22.85%、Audar-ASR-V1-Turbo 23.17%），但这些系统未声明使用同一评分口径，比较仅为参考性。
AI.conclusion: Sada-ASR 在MSA与多数方言上取得领先，但在黎巴嫩方言上因规范化转写与逐字性不足而落后，揭示方言逐字转写与标准化之间的权衡；作者公开20小时测试子集与评分代码以促进可复现评测。

title: Formalizing Formal Semantics: The Formal Atlas
summary:
In this paper we present the Formal Atlas, a system for the study of natural language semantics using proof assistants. Our aim is to formalize semantic accounts,
  check their predictions and compare the implemented theories. To this end, we connect source records and formal developments with an interactive application, where
  researchers can inspect proofs and modify supported Rocq files. Montague's PTQ and Gallin provide our main cases, followed by dynamic and type-theoretic
  comparisons, RSA and distributional semantics. We also discuss what it takes to formalize less explicit analyses. Lastly, we consider the use of AI, both for
  assistance in developing these resources and for inference systems that can make use of them. This work extends an earlier programme in proof-assistant semantics,
  with research and teaching as complementary uses.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Formal Atlas：一个借助证明助手研究自然语言语义学的系统，将语义学说的文献记录与Rocq形式化开发通过交互式应用连接，用于形式化、验证与比较不同语义理论。
AI.motivation: 现有语义学分析多以自然语言描述，缺乏可机器检验的精确实现，难以系统核验其预测并横向比较不同理论。作者希望延续证明助手语义学的研究纲领，使形式化、验证与理论比较成为可操作的研究与教学实践。
AI.method: 构建"源记录—形式化开发—交互式应用"相联的系统：研究者可在应用中检视证明并修改受支持的Rocq文件。以Montague的PTQ与Gallin体系为主要案例，并扩展至动态语义与类型论比较、RSA（理性言语行为）及分布式语义；同时讨论对表述不够明确的分析进行形式化所需的条件，并探讨AI在资源开发辅助与基于该资源的推理系统两方面的用途。
AI.result: 实现了以PTQ和Gallin为核心、涵盖动态语义、类型论、RSA与分布式语义的形式化案例集合，并提供可交互的证明检视与文件编辑环境；对形式化隐式分析的方法与AI辅助/推理应用给出了建设性讨论。摘要未报告定量评测结果。
AI.conclusion: 该工作将证明助手语义学纲领扩展为兼具研究与教学用途的基础设施，使语义理论的预测可被形式化检验并相互比较；未来方向包括更不显式分析的形式化，以及AI在资源构建与推理系统中的结合。

title: Evaluating and Improving Natural Language Autoencoders
summary: Natural language autoencoders (NLAs) are a method for generating natural language explanations of LLM activations. We develop evaluations based on auditing tasks that test the ability of NLAs to surface latent knowledge, identify whether a model was misled by a hint, and catch a silent fabrication. We also develop extensions to NLAs that let them use activation information from multiple layers and positions, let us apply them more effectively to long transcripts, and reduce the number of false claims they make. These extensions result in improvements on both our auditing evaluations and auxiliary evaluations adapted from prior work. We also use the evaluations to study how different auditing capabilities change over the course of NLA training, and find that although every evaluation improves early in training, extended training can hurt performance on some of our auditing evaluations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于审计任务的评估体系来检验自然语言自编码器（NLA）解释LLM激活的能力，并扩展NLA以提升审计表现，同时发现训练后期的过训练会损害部分审计性能。
AI.motivation: NLA能生成LLM激活的自然语言解释，但缺乏对其是否真正揭示潜在知识、识别提示误导、发现无声捏造的严格检验手段，亟需针对性评估。
AI.method: 构建三类审计任务评估（潜在知识揭示、提示误导判别、无声捏造检测）；提出NLA扩展：融合多层与多位置的激活信息、适配长转录文本、减少虚假断言；并沿训练过程追踪各审计能力的变化。
AI.result: 所提扩展在自建审计评估和改编自先前工作的辅助评估上均取得提升；所有评估指标在训练早期均有改善，但延长训练会使部分审计评估性能下降。
AI.conclusion: 审计任务评估可有效刻画NLA能力；多层/多位置信息与长文本适配等扩展有效，但NLA训练存在性能与审计可靠性之间的非单调权衡，需谨慎控制训练时长。

title: Rank, Don't Regress: A 279M Text Ranker Beats 2B and 7B VLMs on Referential Urdu GUI Grounding
summary: UI grounding asks a model to find the screen element that a user instruction refers to. Most current systems use a vision-language model (VLM) that reads a screenshot and outputs pixel coordinates. We study this task on Urdu mobile web pages, a setting with no published UI grounding results. Instead of regressing coordinates, we take the candidate elements from the page DOM and train a 279M-parameter cross-encoder (mDeBERTa-v3-base) to pick one. The click point is the centre of the picked element's box, so it is exact whenever the right element is picked. We built a frozen test set of 304 instructions from six Urdu news sites; 149 of them (49%) are referential and never quote the full target text. Test domains were banned from training data before collection started. The ranker scores 73.4% point-in-box accuracy, against 29.6% for UI-TARS-2B and 23.7% for Qwen2.5-VL-7B, both zero-shot. On the referential slice the ranker scores 65.8%, against 30.2% for a string-matching baseline that needs no training. In a controlled comparison at small scale, with training data drawn from the same pages, a coordinate-regression model of similar size scores 1.6%. Adding element geometry as input tokens gives the best variant, at 75.7%. The ranker's errors concentrate in two places: elements that share identical text, and ordinal instructions such as "the fourth link".

AI.tldr: 提出在乌尔都语移动网页上做UI grounding的DOM候选重排序范式：用279M参数的mDeBERTa-v3-base交叉编码器从页面DOM候选中选出一个元素，点击点取元素框中心，取得73.4%的点在框内准确率，远超零样本VLM。
AI.motivation: 当前UI grounding多采用VLM读截图直接回归像素坐标，但该任务在乌尔都语移动网页上尚无公开结果；回归坐标存在精度与漂移问题，且参考性指令（不引用目标文本）难以靠字符串匹配解决。
AI.method: 不做坐标回归，改为从页面DOM中提取候选元素，训练279M参数的mDeBERTa-v3-base交叉编码器做候选排序；点击点取被选元素框中心。构建304条指令的冻结测试集（来自六个乌尔都语新闻站，49%为参考性指令），测试域在采集前已从训练数据中剔除；并加入元素几何作为输入token的最优变体，以及小规模同页数据下的坐标回归对照实验。
AI.result: 排序器点在框内准确率73.4%，UI-TARS-2B零样本29.6%、Qwen2.5-VL-7B零样本23.7%；参考性子集上65.8%，无需训练的字符串匹配基线30.2%。同页小规模对照中，同规模坐标回归模型仅1.6%；加入元素几何token的最优变体达75.7%。
AI.conclusion: DOM候选重排序+几何特征在小语种移动网页UI grounding上显著优于坐标回归与零样本VLM；剩余错误集中于文本完全相同的元素与序数类指令（如"第四个链接"）。

title: A Corpus-Driven SentencePiece Unigram Tokenizer for Sindhi: Design and Benchmark Against Fourteen Existing Tokenizers
comment: 13 pages; code and tokenizers at doi:10.5281/zenodo.23962474
summary: Sindhi is a low-resource Indo-Aryan language written mainly in an extended Perso-Arabic script. Several Sindhi tokenizers have been released on public model hubs, but they have not been compared with one another on shared data. We train SentencePiece Unigram tokenizers with byte fallback at four vocabulary sizes (32k to 150k) on about 1.10 million Sindhi sentences and a smaller, repeated Urdu, Persian and Arabic slice, from four public sources, and compare them with fourteen existing tokenizers on four evaluation sets: FLORES+, Sindhi Wikipedia, a news-derived sentiment corpus, and a contemporary news corpus. The metrics are fertility, single-token retention, UNK rate, byte-fallback rate, and round-trip character loss. At 64k, our tokenizer averages 1.147 tokens per word, against 1.208 for the best existing tokenizer and 1.512 for XLM-RoBERTa, and keeps 88.6% of words as single tokens.
