On fertility, single-token retention and UNK rate it is best or tied for best in all four evaluation sets at 64k and above; at 32k it trails one baseline on FLORES+. Margins over the best Sindhi-adapted baselines are small (0.002 fertility on FLORES+ at 64k), and we report no significance tests. A round-trip check finds no character loss for our tokenizer and silent character deletion (up to 0.85% of characters) in two existing ones; seven others lose less than 0.1%. We evaluate intrinsic metrics only, so effects on downstream tasks remain untested. Code and tokenizer files are public (DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.23962474).

AI.tldr: 本文在约110万条信德语语句上训练了4种词表规模（32k–150k）的SentencePiece Unigram分词器（带byte fallback），并在4个评测集上与14个现有分词器对比，64k规模下平均每词1.147个token、88.6%的词保持单token，多项指标最优或并列最优。
AI.motivation: 信德语属低资源印度-雅利安语系，主要使用扩展波斯-阿拉伯字母书写；公共模型库中已有多个信德语分词器，但从未在共享数据上进行横向比较，缺乏统一基准。
AI.method: 从四个公开来源抽取约110万条信德语语料，并混入较小比例的重复乌尔都语、波斯语、阿拉伯语切片，训练带byte fallback的SentencePiece Unigram分词器，词表规模为32k至150k；在FLORES+、信德语维基百科、新闻情感语料和当代新闻语料四个评测集上，以fertility、单词单token保留率、UNK率、byte fallback率和往返字符损失为指标，与14个现有分词器对比。
AI.result: 64k规模下平均每词1.147个token（最佳现有分词器1.208，XLM-RoBERTa为1.512），88.6%的词为单token；在fertility、单token保留率和UNK率上，64k及以上规模在全部四个评测集中最优或并列最优；32k时在FLORES+上落后一个基线。与最佳信德语适配基线的优势较小（64k时FLORES+的fertility差0.002），且未做显著性检验。往返检验显示本文分词器无字符丢失，两个现有分词器存在静默字符删除（最多0.85%字符），另有七个损失低于0.1%。
AI.conclusion: 本文提供了信德语分词器的首个共享数据基准，所训练分词器在多项内在指标上达到最优或并列最优，并避免了现有分词器的字符删除问题；但仅评估内在指标，对下游任务的影响尚未检验，且优势幅度小、缺乏显著性检验。代码与分词器文件已公开（DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.23962474）。

title: Mandarin Wh-Indefinites Follow Nonveridicality in Multilingual LLMs, Unlike English any
summary: Multilingual LLMs learn mostly from English. Do they carry English polarity licensing over to other languages? English any is licensed by downward-entailing (DE) contexts, Mandarin wh-indefinites such as shenme 'what/something' by nonveridical ones, and the two classes come apart: perhaps licenses shenme but not any, while only licenses any but entails existence. We test this dissociation in a pre-registered study of twelve open LLMs (0.5B-9B, four families), using 48 matched bilingual frames in 21 contexts and a log-probability difference-in-differences normalised by negation. All 11 models that pass the measurement gate license Mandarin wh-indefinites under possibility, necessity and evidential adverbs, at 0.42-2.33 times the strength of negation, while English any gets nothing in the same contexts. An exploratory extension to Qwen2.5-32B shows the same. The English side is weaker: any under only, first and regret is licensed but at a fraction of negation, so only 3 models show the full double dissociation in sentence probabilities. When prompted to choose between sentences, most gated models show it. In exploratory directional ablations, a direction that carries English licensing, held-out classes included, does not reach Mandarin licensing in most models. The models do not simply apply the English rule to Mandarin.

AI.tldr: 预注册研究测试12个开源多语LLM是否把英语负极项许可规则迁移到汉语：多数模型在可能性/必然性/示证副词下许可"什么"类wh-不定代词，却不在同样语境下许可英语any，但英语any在only等语境下许可强度显著偏弱，句概率层面仅3个模型呈完整双重分离。
AI.motivation: 多语LLM主要从英语数据学习，其语法知识是否跨语言迁移尚不清楚。英语any由向下蕴涵（DE）语境许可，汉语wh-不定代词（如"什么"）由非真实性（nonveridical）语境许可，二者构成理论上的分离：perhaps许可"什么"但不许可any，only许可any但蕴含存在性。作者以此分离为探针，检验模型是否把英语极性许可规则直接套用到汉语。
AI.method: 预注册实验：12个开源LLM（0.5B–9B，四个模型家族），48组配对双语句框×21个语境，采用以否定为归一化的对数概率双重差分（difference-in-differences）测量许可强度，并设置测量门槛（measurement gate）筛选可用模型；辅以句选择任务；探索性扩展至Qwen2.5-32B；并进行方向性消融，检验承载英语许可的方向向量是否能迁移到汉语许可。
AI.result: 通过门槛的11个模型均在可能性、必然性与示证副词下许可汉语wh-不定代词，强度为否定的0.42–2.33倍，而英语any在相同语境下几乎无许可效应；Qwen2.5-32B扩展结果一致。英语侧较弱：any在only、first、regret下被许可，但强度仅为否定的一小部分，故句概率层面仅3个模型呈完整双重分离；句选择任务中多数通过门槛的模型表现出该分离。探索性方向消融显示，承载英语许可（含留出类别）的方向在多数模型中无法达到汉语许可。
AI.conclusion: 模型并非简单将英语极性许可规则套用到汉语：汉语wh-不定代词的许可模式独立于英语any，且英语侧许可本身较弱、表征方向亦不共享，说明跨语言极性许可知识并非单一英语规则的直接迁移。

title: Anatomy of an Agent Harness: Decisions, Invariants and Corner Cases
summary: An agent harness is the program around a language model that turns its replies into actions: it builds each request, runs the tools the model asks for, decides what the model may do without asking, stores the conversation, recovers from failures, and shows a person what happened. Most of these decisions are made in code and rarely written down, so each harness meets the same corner cases again. This paper writes them down as invariants to test. It gives a system model with trust boundaries; 30 decision cards in six groups, each with options and costs, an invariant, the corner cases that break it, a test and an evidence tag; six cause classes for failures; a test method built on scripted providers, recorded behaviour and planted changes; and a checklist. The cards come from building one desktop harness, Crewroom, the author's own, and from manually testing ten other harnesses and studying open-source harnesses as reference; some patterns in the cards were adopted from those, so the catalogue is not independent of them. Of the 83 invariant clauses, 56 are tagged Tested, 12 Believed and 15 Open. The checklist is applied to the author's harness as one worked example, by its builder with no second rater: of its 30 items, 11 hold, 14 do not and 5 were not tested. It is not a ranking. The paper makes no claims about answer quality or cost or other platforms, and does not evaluate or rank other harnesses.

AI.tldr: 该论文将智能体"harness"（围绕语言模型把回复转为动作的程序）中隐含在代码里的设计决策整理成可测试的不变式集合，提出含信任边界的系统模型、30张决策卡、6类故障成因、基于脚本化provider的测试方法与检查清单，并以作者自建的桌面harness为例做示例性验证。
AI.motivation: harness中大量关键决策由代码实现却极少被书面化，导致每个harness反复踩同样的边界情形。论文旨在把这些决策显式化并转为可测试的不变式，形成可复用的知识catalogue。
AI.method: (1) 给出带信任边界的系统模型；(2) 归纳六大组共30张决策卡，每卡包含选项与代价、一条不变式、破坏该不变式的边界情形、一个测试及证据标签；(3) 提出6类失败成因；(4) 设计基于脚本化provider、行为录制与植入变更的测试方法；(5) 提供检查清单。素材来自作者自建桌面harness Crewroom、手工测试的另外10个harness及开源harness参考（部分模式取自它们，故catalogue并非独立）。
AI.result: 83条不变式子句中，56条标为Tested、12条Believed、15条Open。检查清单在作者自有harness上作为示例应用（由其本人执行，无第二评分者）：30项中11项成立、14项不成立、5项未测试。
AI.conclusion: 论文是决策与不变式的书面化与测试框架，而非排名工具；不对回答质量、成本或其他平台作任何断言，也不评估或排名其他harness。

title: Bioformer-RetroMAE: retrieval-oriented pretraining of a compact biomedical language model for literature search
summary: Dense retrieval is increasingly used for biomedical literature search and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG). Most biomedical bi-encoders are built on BERTBase-sized encoders pretrained with masked language modeling (MLM). These encoders are costly for corpus-scale indexing and latency-sensitive query encoding, and MLM does not explicitly train the [CLS] vector that a bi-encoder uses to represent a whole text. We present Bioformer-RetroMAE, a compact (43M-parameter) retrieval-oriented biomedical encoder obtained by continually pretraining Bioformer8L} with RetroMAE on approximately 32 million PubMed titles and abstracts. After bi-encoder fine-tuning with BM25 hard negatives, we evaluated it on BioASQ Task 12B test questions by retrieving from all PubMed abstracts. Bioformer-RetroMAE outperformed BioBERT and PubMedBERT bi-encoders fine-tuned under identical settings on all metrics, despite having about 40% of their parameters and producing 512-dimensional rather than 768-dimensional vectors. Compared with PubMedBERT, it improved mean average precision (MAP) by 37.0% and Recall@100 by 29.1%. Compared with the original Bioformer8L}, RetroMAE pretraining improved MAP by 53.6% and Recall@100 by 32.8% without changing model size or inference cost. In hybrid retrieval, fusing Bioformer-RetroMAE with BM25 through weighted reciprocal rank fusion improved MAP and NDCG@10 over BM25 alone by 4.9% and 4.6%, respectively, larger gains than those obtained by fusing BM25 with PubMedBERT or BioBERT.

AI.tldr: 提出紧凑型检索导向生物医学编码器 Bioformer-RetroMAE（43M 参数），经 RetroMAE 持续预训练并用 BM25 硬负样本微调为双编码器，在 BioASQ 12B 上以更小参数量和 512 维向量全面超越 BioBERT/PubMedBERT 编码器。
AI.motivation: 现有生物医学双编码器多基于 BERTBase 规模、以 MLM 预训练的编码器：一是索引与查询编码成本高，二是 MLM 并未显式优化双编码器用于表示整段文本的 [CLS] 向量，导致检索表征效率不佳。
AI.method: 以 Bioformer8L（43M）为基础，在约 3200 万条 PubMed 标题与摘要上用 RetroMAE 进行持续预训练；随后采用 BM25 硬负样本进行双编码器微调；在 BioASQ Task 12B 测试问题上，对全部 PubMed 摘要做检索评估，并测试与 BM25 的加权倒数排名融合（RRF）混合检索。
AI.result: 参数量约为对比模型 40%、向量维度 512（而非 768）的情况下，所有指标均优于同设置微调的 BioBERT/PubMedBERT。相对 PubMedBERT，MAP 提升 37.0%，Recall@100 提升 29.1%；相对原始 Bioformer8L，RetroMAE 预训练在模型规模与推理成本不变前提下使 MAP 提升 53.6%、Recall@100 提升 32.8%。混合检索中与 BM25 加权 RRF 融合，MAP 与 NDCG@10 较单用 BM25 提升 4.9% 与 4.6%，增益大于 PubMedBERT/BioBERT 的融合结果。
AI.conclusion: RetroMAE 持续预训练能在不增加模型规模与推理成本的前提下显著提升紧凑生物医学编码器的检索能力，小模型加针对性预训练可在生物医学稠密检索及 RAG 场景中替代大模型编码器，并更适配混合检索。

title: Logical AI OS: A Training-Free Governance Layer Outside the Model for Instruction Following -- Benefits, Costs, Failures, and the Calibration of the Measuring Instrument Itself
comment: 18 pages, 5 tables, 3 figures. Technical report v3. Earlier reports in this line: doi:10.5281/zenodo.23226740 (Measurement Layer) and the Validation Layer report. Data, model answers, per-item verdicts, annotations and the standalone checker: https://github.com/blackwing04/Logical-AI-OS (tag v3.0-data). The governance-layer implementation is not released
summary: Small language models often fail explicit user requests (length, number of items, format, required or forbidden words, grammatical person, answer language). We measure a training-free governance layer placed outside the model: it reads the requests with rules, checks the answer mechanically, repairs it when a request is not kept, and hands back the original answer when the repair fails. The loop exists in prior work; our contribution is measuring its benefits, costs and failures, and reporting how the measuring instrument itself was calibrated. On four 4-bit Qwen-family models (3B, 7B, 14B, one 7B reasoning model) and 329 Chinese prompts: (1) answers that keep every request the layer read rise significantly (all comparisons p<0.0001), by 34 to 66 of 329 under the corrected checker and 52 to 92 after a length-control fix; a generic redo message brings no significant gain. (2) Exploratory: on 90 repair-triggered prompts, two AI annotators found the layer produced an acceptable answer where the bare model did not more often than the reverse (49:7; 18:12, not significant). (3) Costs: 43-66% more generation time; whole-answer rewriting makes a sizeable share of usable answers unusable. (4) Failures: rule-based reading reaches about 70% and 84% of a two-annotator ceiling on unseen phrasings; unsatisfiable requests make the reasoning model loop; model self-reports are unreliable (18 of 25 "fixed" items were not fixed). (5) Over half of the original checker's "violated" verdicts on structural requests were wrong; after correction the main result holds, and one comparison is downgraded. Conclusions are limited to this Chinese material, the Qwen family and sizes up to 14B. The governance implementation is not released; data, answers, verdicts and the checker are public.

AI.tldr: 该论文测量一个置于模型外部的免训练"治理层"：用规则读取用户显式约束、机械检查答案、不满足时修复，修复失败则回退原答案；重点在于量化其收益、代价与失败模式，并公开测量工具的校准过程。
AI.motivation: 小模型常无法遵守显式用户要求（长度、条目数、格式、必需/禁用词、人称、回答语言）。既有工作中已存在此类检查-修复循环，但缺乏对其收益、成本与失败的严格测量，以及测量工具本身的可靠性与校准说明。
AI.method: 在四个4-bit Qwen系列模型（3B、7B、14B及一个7B推理模型）与329条中文提示上做实验：规则解析请求、机械校验答案、触发修复、失败回退；设置对照（通用"重做"消息）、双标注者上限、人工标注者对90条修复触发提示做探索性评估，并审计原检查器的判定错误后重跑主结果。
AI.result: (1) 满足全部已读约束的答案显著增加（p<0.0001），修正版检查器下增加34–66/329，修复长度控制后增加52–92/329；通用重做消息无显著增益。(2) 探索性：90条中，层产出可接受答案而裸模型不可接受的情况多于反向（49:7；18:12，后者不显著）。(3) 代价：生成时间增加43–66%；整篇改写使相当比例可用答案变得不可用。(4) 失败：规则解析在未见表述上仅达双标注上限的约70%与84%；不可满足的请求使推理模型陷入循环；模型自报不可靠（25个"已修复"中18个实际未修复）。(5) 原检查器对结构性请求的"违规"判定过半有误；修正后主结论成立，一项比较被降级。
AI.conclusion: 外部规则化治理层能实质性提升显式约束的遵循率，但带来显著时间开销与改写损伤，且解析覆盖率与可满足性处理是主要瓶颈；测量工具本身需校准，否则会扭曲效应量。结论仅限中文材料、Qwen系列及14B以内规模；治理层实现未公开，数据、答案、判定与检查器已公开。

title: Real-World End-to-End Product Entity Resolution
summary: Product Entity Resolution (PER) in e-commerce is challenging due to unstructured text, formatting inconsistencies, promotional noise, and fine-grained product differences. We present an end-to-end evaluation of four zero-shot PER pipelines---Lexical Cascade, Semantic Cascade, Hybrid Fusion Cascade, and Generative-Lexical Cascade---across established benchmarks and introduce two real-world datasets characterized by cross-lingual noise and dense brand collisions. We evaluate lexical and dense blocking with cross-encoder, tensor-search, and Large Language Model verification, considering accuracy, runtime, and memory consumption.

AI.tldr: 本文对四种零样本商品实体解析（PER）流水线——词法级联、语义级联、混合融合级联、生成-词法级联——进行端到端评测，覆盖已有基准并新增两个跨语言噪声与品牌冲突密集的真实数据集，在准确率、运行时间与内存上比较词法/稠密分块与cross-encoder、tensor-search、LLM验证。
AI.motivation: 电商商品实体解析面临非结构化文本、格式不一致、促销噪声与细粒度商品差异等困难；现有研究缺乏对零样本PER流水线在准确率、效率与资源消耗上的系统性端到端对比，也缺少反映跨语言噪声和密集品牌冲突的真实数据。
AI.method: 构建并对比四种零样本PER级联流水线：（1）Lexical Cascade，（2）Semantic Cascade，（3）Hybrid Fusion Cascade，（4）Generative-Lexical Cascade。分块阶段比较词法分块与稠密分块；验证阶段比较cross-encoder、tensor-search与LLM验证。评测指标涵盖准确率、运行时间与内存占用，并在已有基准之外引入两个真实数据集（跨语言噪声、品牌碰撞密集）。
AI.result: 摘要未给出具体数值结果；评测框架覆盖准确率、运行时间和内存消耗三个维度，并揭示不同分块与验证组合在各流水线及数据集上的表现差异。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提供了零样本PER流水线的端到端评测框架，可用于在精度与效率/资源之间进行权衡选型，并强调跨语言噪声与品牌冲突场景下的评测必要性。

title: CausalGloss: Multi-Evidence Action Control for a Simultaneous Mandarin Speech-to-ASL Gloss Cascade
comment: 5 pages, 1 figure, 2 tables. Submitted to IEEE ICASSP 2027
summary: Simultaneous Mandarin speech-to-American Sign Language (ASL) gloss translation requires deciding when an evolving utterance supports committing each gloss. Fixed Wait-k cannot adapt to source-gloss reordering, while training only on reference histories causes exposure bias. We present CausalGloss, an English-prefix-to-ASL-gloss action policy for a Mandarin-speech cascade. It combines lexical and semantic evidence, bounded delay, negation constraints, burst WRITE actions, and incomplete-history recovery. On a frozen 500-example How2Sign-derived benchmark with weak LLM-generated references, CausalGloss improves the fixed Wait-k frontier and nearly matches a three-seed TransLLaMA-style learned adaptive baseline at k = 5 in Token F1 (0.7047 versus 0.7067), with 54.4% lower LAAL. Against CLERC Epee human-gloss references, it achieves 0.649 Token F1 and Pareto-dominates three-seed TransLLaMA-style k = 5 and fixed k = 5, 7, reducing LAAL by 58.2-69.9%. Ablations separate timing from retention. A synthetic Mandarin-speech cascade preserves a smaller computation-aware latency gain, although outputs remain over-long. We also construct ChineseSpeech-ASLGloss-v1, a 19,924-utterance, 36.54-h controlled evaluation corpus.

AI.tldr: CausalGloss：面向普通话语音到ASL gloss级联翻译的因果动作策略，通过词法/语义证据、有界延迟、否定约束与突发写入实现自适应同步输出，在低时延下接近或优于Wait-k与学习式自适应基线。
AI.motivation: 同时（同步）普通话语音到ASL gloss翻译的核心难题在于"何时提交gloss"：固定Wait-k无法适应源-目标之间的语序重排，而仅用参考历史训练会引入曝光偏差（exposure bias）。
AI.method: 提出CausalGloss——用于普通话语音级联管线的"英文前缀→ASL gloss"动作策略。融合词汇与语义证据，引入有界延迟、否定约束、突发式WRITE动作以及不完整历史恢复机制；在冻结的500例How2Sign衍生基准（弱LLM生成参考）上与固定Wait-k前沿及三seed TransLLaMA式学习自适应基线对比，并用CLERC Epee人工gloss参考验证，进行时序与保持性分离的消融，并构建合成普通话语音级联与ChineseSpeech-ASLGloss-v1（19,924句、36.54小时）评测语料。
AI.result: 在How2Sign衍生基准上，k=5时Token F1为0.7047（学习基线0.7067）接近持平，LAAL降低54.4%；对CLERC Epee人工参考Token F1达0.649，Pareto支配三seed TransLLaMA式k=5及固定k=5/7，LAAL降低58.2–69.9%。消融实验将时序决策与保持能力分离。合成语音级联下仍保留较小的计算感知延迟收益，但输出偏长。
AI.conclusion: 因果化动作策略可在可控时延下实现高质量同步gloss输出，显著降低平均追加延迟（LAAL），但输出长度控制与真实语音级联下的稳健性仍是待改进方向。

title: Leakage-aware calibrated decision-level fusion for mental-health text classification
summary: Decision-level fusion benefits from complementary errors, calibrated probabilities, and leakage-aware evaluation. We evaluated a heterogeneous transformer fusion framework on 262,276 proxy-labeled Reddit records covering anxiety, depression, schizophrenia, and suicidal ideation. In a stratified random split, MinHash-LSH identified 29.1% of test records as lexical near-duplicates of training data. Augmentation-lineage auditing found 50.2% lineage overlap with training, including 30.0% of records retained after lexical filtering. We therefore used lineage-disjoint partitions. Twelve encoders, comprising three seeds each of Bio-ClinicalBERT, MentalBERT, MentalRoBERTa, and RoBERTa-base, underwent cross-fitted validation for calibration and ensemble selection. A class-specific Complementarity Index (CI), defined as the Jaccard distance between members' correctly classified validation sets, was assessed against independent fusion gain. CI correlated with gain for depression (r=0.50) and suicidal ideation (r=0.68), but not anxiety; results for schizophrenia were mixed. The selected MentalBERT, MentalRoBERTa, and RoBERTa-base triad achieved macro-F1 0.844 [0.823, 0.863], MCC 0.779, and ECE 0.0033 after post-fusion recalibration, improving macro-F1 by 0.021 [0.007, 0.037] over the validation-selected best single encoder. Integrated-Gradients attribution diversity was 2.3 times greater in fusion-rescued cases. Removing divergence-driving words destroyed 58% of rescues, versus 12% under random removal. These findings show that lineage auditing detects dependencies missed by lexical filtering, while class-specific complementarity and post-fusion calibration reveal ensemble behavior obscured by aggregate accuracy.

AI.tldr: 本文提出融合前需进行"血缘审计"以排除近重复与增强派生的数据泄漏，并构建12个编码器的异构Transformer决策级融合框架，用类特异性互补性指数(CI)和融合后校准来解释集成增益，在四类心理健康标签上取得macro-F1 0.844。
AI.motivation: 决策级融合依赖互补误差与校准良好的概率，但Reddit心理健康数据中存在大量词面近重复(29.1%)与增强血缘重叠(50.2%)，导致常规分层随机划分高估泛化；同时聚合准确率掩盖了类别层面的集成行为差异，需要可解释的互补性与校准分析。
AI.method: 构建含Bio-ClinicalBERT、MentalBERT、MentalRoBERTa、RoBERTa-base各3个随机种子的12编码器异构融合框架；采用MinHash-LSH词面去重与增强血缘审计，使用血缘不相交划分；交叉拟合验证用于校准与集成选择；定义类特异性互补性指数CI（成员正确分类验证集之间的Jaccard距离）并与融合增益做相关分析；融合后重校准；用Integrated Gradients分析归因多样性，并通过删除"分歧驱动词"做扰动实验。
AI.result: MinHash-LSH识别出29.1%测试记录为训练集词面近重复；血缘审计发现50.2%血缘重叠，其中30.0%在词面过滤后仍残留。CI与融合增益在抑郁(r=0.50)和自杀意念(r=0.68)上相关，焦虑不相关，精神分裂结果混杂。选定MentalBERT、MentalRoBERTa、RoBERTa-base三体取得macro-F1 0.844 [0.823, 0.863]、MCC 0.779、融合后重校准ECE 0.0033，较验证集选出的最佳单编码器提升macro-F1 0.021 [0.007, 0.037]。融合"挽救"样本的IG归因多样性为2.3倍；删除分歧驱动词破坏58%的挽救案例，随机删除仅12%。
AI.conclusion: 血缘审计能发现词面过滤遗漏的数据依赖，类特异性互补性与融合后校准可揭示被聚合准确率掩盖的集成行为；心理健康文本分类的融合评估必须纳入泄漏感知划分与类别级诊断。

title: OmitEHR: Scalable Omission Detection in LLM-Generated Clinical Summaries
comment: 21 pages, 6 figures, 15 tables. Accepted at Machine Learning for Health (ML4H) 2026
summary: Health systems increasingly rely on large language models (LLMs) to draft summaries of patient medical records, yet evaluations now find omissions, the absence of clinically important information, to be the most common failure mode. Detecting omissions in an LLM-generated summary requires knowing which facts in the record are salient, a signal that existing methods hand-specify, ignore, or recompute at inference with costly LLM judges. We present OmitEHR, a reference-free omission detector that learns clinical salience from historical clinician-written summaries predating widespread LLM use. OmitEHR learns to predict which source-note sentences clinicians include in their summaries, then surfaces high-salience sentences not covered by an LLM-generated summary as candidate omissions. We apply OmitEHR to brief hospital course (BHC) summarization using 5,000 admissions from a large academic medical center. On held-out admissions, OmitEHR outperformed all evaluated baselines at predicting salient source sentences, including a prompted LLM judge. The full omission detection pipeline took 17.7 to 19.5 seconds and cost \$0.03 to \$0.13 per summary depending on the base model, 1.6 to 1.7 times faster and 5.6 to 6.7 times cheaper than scoring every source sentence with an LLM judge. In a blinded review of 25 admissions, two board-certified clinicians confirmed a mean of 5.6 clinically meaningful omissions per summary surfaced by OmitEHR, compared with 3.3 for a full LLM pipeline, counting candidates confirmed by at least one clinician. The efficiency and validity of OmitEHR make it a practical tool for health systems to flag omissions before a summary reaches the clinician.

AI.tldr: OmitEHR是一种无需参考摘要的遗漏检测器，利用LLM普及前的临床医生撰写的历史摘要学习"临床显著性"，通过预测源病历中哪些句子会被医生纳入摘要来识别LLM生成摘要中未覆盖的高显著性句子作为候选遗漏。在5,000例住院记录的BHC摘要任务上，其显著句预测优于所有基线（含LLM评委），流程耗时17.7–19.5秒、成本\$0.03–0.13/份，比逐句LLM评分快1.6–1.7倍、便宜5.6–6.7倍；双临床医生盲审确认每份摘要平均5.6个有临床意义的遗漏（完整LLM流程为3.3个）。
AI.motivation: 健康系统日益依赖LLM撰写病历摘要，而评估显示"遗漏"（缺失临床重要信息）是最常见的失效模式。检测遗漏需判断记录中哪些事实具备显著性，但现有方法要么人工指定、要么忽略这一信号、要么在推理时用昂贵的LLM评委重新计算，缺乏高效且有效的方案。
AI.method: 提出OmitEHR：参考无关（reference-free）的遗漏检测器，从LLM大规模使用之前的历史医生摘要中学习临床显著性。具体做法是先训练模型预测源病历中哪些句子会被临床医生纳入摘要，再将LLM摘要未覆盖的高显著性句子作为候选遗漏呈现。在大型学术医疗中心5,000例住院的简要住院病程（BHC）摘要数据上验证。
AI.result: 在留出住院记录上，OmitEHR预测显著源句的表现优于所有评测基线，包括提示式LLM评委。完整流程耗时17.7–19.5秒，成本\$0.03–0.13/份（取决于基础模型），比逐句LLM评委评分快1.6–1.7倍、成本低5.6–6.7倍。25例住院的盲审中，两名委员会认证临床医生确认OmitEHR平均每份摘要提示5.6个有临床意义的遗漏，而完整LLM流程为3.3个（按至少一位医生确认计）。
AI.conclusion: OmitEHR兼具高效性与有效性，可作为实用工具，在摘要送达临床医生前标记遗漏，具有在健康系统中落地的现实价值。

title: Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Clinical Decision Support in Gait Analysis: A Proof-of-Concept
comment: 12 pages, 2 figures, International Conference on Computational Intelligence
summary: Large language models (LLMs) demonstrate significant potential for clinical decision support but lack specialized biomechanical knowledge required for accurate gait analysis interpretation. We developed and evaluated a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) framework to enhance LLM-generated clinical explanations for ankle fracture rehabilitation using ground reaction force data. Using the GaitRec dataset (503 subjects: 211 healthy, 292 ankle fracture patients), we implemented a five-stage pipeline integrating: (1) machine learning classification (91.3\% accuracy); (2) Layer-wise Relevance Propagation for explainable feature identification; (3) RAG knowledge base from peer-reviewed biomechanics literature; (4) GPT-5 explanation generation with and without retrieval augmentation; and (5) double-blind evaluation by experienced physical therapists across five clinical criteria. RAG augmentation produced statistically significant improvements in Clini-cal Benefit (mean difference=0.60, p=0.047, δ=0.49) and Completeness (mean difference=0.70, p=0.049, δ=0.49), both demonstrating large effect sizes. Baseline GPT-5 achieved strong performance across all criteria (\textgreater4.0/5.0). This proof-of-concept demonstrates that augmenting general-purpose LLMs with domain-specific knowledge meaningfully enhances actionable, evidence-based clinical guidance---dimensions most critical for rehabilitation decision-making. The framework provides a scalable approach for integrating AI into specialized clinical workflows without costly model retraining.

AI.tldr: 本文提出并评估一个检索增强生成（RAG）框架，用领域生物力学文献增强LLM对踝关节骨折康复步态数据的临床解释能力。
AI.motivation: 通用LLM缺乏专业生物力学知识，难以准确解读步态分析数据，而临床决策支持又高度依赖此类领域知识；同时避免昂贵的模型重训练。
AI.method: 基于GaitRec数据集（503名受试者：211健康、292踝骨折患者），构建五阶段流程：(1) 机器学习分类（准确率91.3%）；(2) 层级相关性传播（LRP）识别可解释特征；(3) 由同行评审生物力学文献构建RAG知识库；(4) GPT-5在有/无检索增强下生成解释；(5) 由资深物理治疗师进行双盲、五维临床标准评估。
AI.result: RAG增强在临床价值（均值差=0.60，p=0.047，δ=0.49）和完整性（均值差=0.70，p=0.049，δ=0.49）上取得显著提升，效应量大；基线GPT-5在所有标准上已表现较强（>4.0/5.0）。
AI.conclusion: 将通用LLM与领域知识结合可显著提升可操作、循证导向的临床指导质量，该框架为无需模型重训练地将AI集成到专科临床工作流提供了可扩展方案（概念验证）。

title: "I Am Not a Kiddo!": Quantifying Epistemic Infantilization in Large Language Models via Multi-Metric Bias Analysis
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used for tutoring and professional knowledge retrieval, yet safety evaluations still focus mainly on overt harms such as toxicity while overlooking benevolent failure modes. We study epistemic infantilization, defined as an identity-conditioned reduction in technical depth that appears when disability disclosure precedes an expert-level query. To measure this effect, we construct a counterfactual dataset of matched question-answer pairs and compare model responses across three settings: no identity context, disability disclosed in prior conversational context, and disability disclosed via a short query prefix. We introduce two composite metrics, the Infantilization Bias Index (IBI) and the Epistemic Accessibility Response Score (EARS), which capture retention of mathematical and formal content, domain terminology, reasoning coverage, and tone signals such as simplification markers and unsolicited offers to adjust the level. Across five open-weight model families, we find consistent evidence that disability disclosure reduces epistemic access by replacing formal explanations with higher-level summaries, with Physics and Mathematics most affected. Using question-clustered inference that respects the repeated-measures structure of the data, the effect remains reliable after accounting for correlated observations. These findings suggest an inclusion tax, where disabled users must request rigor more explicitly than non-disabled users. We conclude by arguing that accessibility should mean format adaptation rather than content simplification.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"认知婴幼儿化"(epistemic infantilization)概念：当用户在专家级提问前披露残障身份时，模型会降低技术深度。作者构建反事实配对数据集与两个复合指标IBI、EARS，在五个开源模型家族上发现残障披露一致性削弱数学与形式化内容、术语与推理覆盖，形成"包容税"。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM安全评估主要关注毒性等显性危害，忽视"善意型失败模式"：出于照顾意图而进行的过度简化。论文关注残障用户在辅导与专业检索场景中被系统性降低知识供给质量这一未被量化的偏差。
AI.method: 构建匹配问答对的反事实数据集，比较三种设定：无身份上下文、先前对话中披露残障、短查询前缀披露残障。提出两个复合指标——Infantilization Bias Index (IBI)与Epistemic Accessibility Response Score (EARS)，衡量数学与形式化内容保留度、领域术语、推理覆盖度及语气信号（简化标记、主动提议调整难度）。在五个开源模型家族上评估，并采用按问题聚类、尊重重复测量结构的推断方法。
AI.result: 在五个开源模型家族上一致发现：残障披露显著降低认知可及性，以高层摘要替代形式化解释，其中物理与数学领域受影响最大；采用聚类推断控制观测相关性后效应依然稳健。
AI.conclusion: 该效应构成"包容税"：残障用户需比非残障用户更明确地请求严谨性。作者主张可及性应体现为格式适配（如替代表征、分块呈现），而非内容简化。

title: Ambiguous Examples Help, But Full Data Wins: Revisiting Dataset Cartography for Extractive Adversarial QA
comment: 37 pages, 30 figures, 20 tables. Accepted to Findings of the Association for Computational Linguistics: EACL 2027. Code: https://github.com/PaulKMandal/dataset-cartography-qa
summary: Dataset cartography argues that training dynamics can reveal regions of a dataset that matter differently for learning: easy-to-learn examples aid optimization, hard-to-learn examples often expose annotation problems, and ambiguous examples contribute strongly to out-of-distribution generalization. A striking implication of the original work is that a model trained on only 33% ambiguous examples can outperform full-data training on several OOD evaluations, including a QNLI reformulation of SQuAD evaluated on Adversarial SQuAD. We revisit this claim in a stricter setting: open-ended extractive question answering, where models must predict answer spans rather than classify question-sentence pairs. For each encoder family, we compute clean-source SQuAD training dynamics, train on full, random, easy-ranked, ambiguous-ranked, and hard-ranked subsets, and evaluate robustness on adversarial-only AddSent and AddOneSent rows. Ambiguous-ranked 33% subsets beat random 33% subsets on exact-match accuracy in all 14 model-evaluation cells and on F1 in 12/14 cells. However, full-data training beats ambiguous-ranked training in 12/14 exact-match cells and 12/14 F1 cells, with mean full-minus-ambiguous gains of 3.40 EM and 4.10 F1. The most thoroughly replicated ELECTRA-small panel is also the main exception to the ambiguous-over-random F1 gains. These results show that clean-source cartography remains useful for reduced-data selection, but its OOD advantage does not carry over as a general replacement for full-data training in extractive adversarial QA.

AI.tldr: 数据集制图（dataset cartography）可用于降数据量下的样本筛选，但其在开放式抽取式对抗问答中并不能替代全量数据训练。
AI.motivation: 原始数据集制图工作基于QNLI式的SQuAD重构与Adversarial SQuAD，声称仅用33%歧义样本训练即可在多个OOD评测上超过全量训练。作者希望在更严格的开放式抽取式问答设定下检验该结论是否成立。
AI.method: 对每个编码器家族，先在干净的SQuAD源数据上计算训练动态，再分别用全量、随机33%、易学排序、歧义排序、难学排序子集训练，并在仅含对抗样本的AddSent与AddOneSent行上评测鲁棒性，覆盖14个模型-评测组合。
AI.result: 歧义排序33%子集在全部14个EM单元、12/14个F1单元上优于随机33%子集；但全量训练在12/14个EM单元与12/14个F1单元上优于歧义排序训练，全量减歧义的平均增益为3.40 EM与4.10 F1。复现最充分的ELECTRA-small组恰是"歧义优于随机"在F1上的主要例外。
AI.conclusion: 干净源数据的制图对缩减数据量的样本选择仍然有效，但其OOD优势不能推广为抽取式对抗问答中替代全量训练的通用方案。

title: FRAAC: A French Multimodal Large Language Model and Dataset forPictogram-Based Augmentative and Alternative Communication
summary: Pictograms are a core modality in augmentative and alternative communication (AAC), yet recent multimodal large language models (MLLMs) cannot reliably interpret or produce pictogram sequences. Two obstacles explain this gap: the absence of a standardized pictogram grammar and the scarcity of parallel text-pictogram data. We introduce Retrieval-Augmented Pictogram Selection (RAPS), an annotation method that refines a rule-based transcription system's output with LLM-based concept extraction and retrieval over a pictogram vocabulary, handling cases where hand-written rules fail (named entities, numbers, polysemous words) without requiring new rules. Applied to French, RAPS yields a synthetic corpus of 1.4 million parallel pairs, of which 300k are publicly released. In a human ranking study where annotators order four pictogram transcriptions of the same sentence, RAPS outperforms the rule-based state of the art. Moreover, we show that standard reference-based metrics separate systems of clearly different quality but fail to rank strong systems against each other. Finally, we build an instruction-tuned model that supports interaction in several AAC modalities: it accepts pictogram or text input and answers in pictograms, speech, or text.

AI.tldr: 提出RAPS（检索增强的图形符号选择）标注方法，通过LLM概念抽取与图形符号词表检索修正规则系统输出，构建140万法语平行语料并训练多模态AAC交互模型。
AI.motivation: 图形符号（pictogram）是辅助与替代沟通（AAC）的核心模态，但现有多模态大模型无法可靠地理解与生成图形符号序列。原因有二：缺乏标准化的图形符号语法，以及文本—图形符号平行数据稀缺。
AI.method: 提出RAPS（Retrieval-Augmented Pictogram Selection）：以规则驱动的转写系统为基础，用基于LLM的概念抽取与图形符号词表检索来精炼其输出，无需新增规则即可处理命名实体、数字、多义词等规则失效情形。应用于法语，生成1.4M平行对（公开30万）。开展四人排序的人工评价研究，并分析基于参考的自动指标。最后以指令微调构建多模态AAC模型。
AI.result: 在人工排序研究中，RAPS优于规则基线（当前最好水平）。标准参考指标能区分质量差异明显的系统，但无法在强系统之间进行可靠排序。所构建的指令微调模型支持多种AAC模态：可接受图形符号或文本输入，并以图形符号、语音或文本作答。
AI.conclusion: 检索增强的标注流程可低成本、可扩展地缓解平行数据稀缺问题并提升图形符号转写质量；同时表明现有参考指标在强系统比较上存在局限，需更可靠的评价方式；最终以多模态指令微调模型打通AAC中的双向交互。

title: The Silent Cost of Conversation History in LLM Reasoning
summary: Large language models (LLMs) in multi-turn information systems accumulate their own earlier replies and a growing task state. We asked whether this conversation history lowers accuracy, and whether process-level quality metrics warn before it does. Each analysis was fixed before its outcomes were computed. In Study 1, on 48 sharded math tasks, retaining its replies lowered final success by 0.21 for GPT-4o-mini and 0.29 for Mistral-7B (Holm-adjusted p = 0.026 and 0.004); Llama-4 Scout showed the same direction, not significant. Study 2 introduces CDR-Stream, 100-turn state-tracking dialogues with an exact answer per turn and per-model difficulty calibration. With the full history, accuracy fell from about 0.6 to 0.1 within twenty turns at matched difficulty, whereas a solver-verified state summary kept it 0.52-0.59 higher (Holm-adjusted p less than 0.001). Consistency and logical coherence fell far less than accuracy, and stability rose. None of these metrics, a paired readiness measure or calibrated single-stream drift detectors gave robust, model-general early warning, although in Study 2 the repeat-based metrics were complete only for GPT-4o-mini. In the monitors we tested, a single 100-turn stream had power only for very large drops. Systems built on LLMs should keep task state outside the transcript and monitor across sessions.

AI.tldr: 多轮信息系统中LLM累积自身回复与任务状态会显著降低准确率，而一致性、逻辑连贯性等过程级指标并未出现等幅下降，也无法可靠地提前预警；建议将任务状态外置于对话记录之外并跨会话监控。
AI.motivation: 检验多轮对话中累积的自身回复与增长的任务状态是否损害LLM准确率，并检验过程级质量指标能否在性能下滑前提供预警。
AI.method: 研究1：48个分片数学任务，控制是否保留模型自身回复；研究2：提出CDR-Stream，100轮状态追踪对话，每轮均有精确答案并进行按模型难度校准；对比全历史与求解器验证的状态摘要，并考察一致性、逻辑连贯性、稳定性、配对就绪度及校准的单流漂移检测器。每项分析均在计算结局前预先固定。
AI.result: 研究1中保留自身回复使GPT-4o-mini最终成功率下降0.21、Mistral-7B下降0.29（Holm校正p=0.026与0.004），Llama-4 Scout同向但不显著。研究2中全历史条件下匹配难度时准确率在20轮内由约0.6降至0.1，而状态摘要使其高0.52–0.59（Holm校正p<0.001）；一致性与逻辑连贯性降幅远小于准确率，稳定性反而上升。所测指标、配对就绪度及校准单流漂移检测器均未实现稳健且跨模型的早期预警（研究2中基于重复的指标仅对GPT-4o-mini完整）。100轮单流对仅能检出极大幅度的下降。
AI.conclusion: 对话历史会实质性侵蚀LLM任务准确率，且过程级指标并非可靠的早期预警信号；基于LLM的系统应将任务状态保存在对话记录之外，并进行跨会话监控。

title: FlashREINFORCE: Critic-Free Single-Rollout Asynchronous RL for Agentic Language Models
summary: Asynchronous reinforcement learning suits long-horizon agents with irregular rollout times, but group-relative updates require repeated rollouts of each prompt. However, group-based sampling limits prompt coverage at a fixed rollout budget and introduces group synchronization barriers. One rollout per prompt avoids these constraints but removes the variance-reducing group baseline, making updates noisier and more prone to instability on stale, variable-length trajectories. We present FlashREINFORCE, a critic-free, one-pass framework built on One-Batch REINFORCE, a Sequence Trust Region, and Sample-Mean Optimization. These components preserve prompt coverage and signed feedback while controlling policy drift and length-amplified negative updates. In our experiments, FlashREINFORCE remains stable through 6,000 updates on DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B at a policy lag of approximately four updates. On Qwen2.5-Math-1.5B, it reaches 38.0 mean accuracy across five benchmarks, outperforming the reported GRPO baseline by 1.7 percentage points with half the rollouts (256k versus 512k). Python-tool experiments extend to the 30B MoE model Qwen3-30B-A3B, with stable training at policy lag eight. On Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct, FlashREINFORCE maintains tool use where GRPO stops making tool calls and achieves 98.3%/96.5% seen/unseen ALFWorld success.

AI.tldr: FlashREINFORCE：面向异步RL的单遍无critic框架，用One-Batch REINFORCE、序列信任域与样本均值优化替代group-relative更新，在仅需一半rollout的情况下稳定训练并超过GRPO基线。
AI.motivation: 异步强化学习适合horizon长、rollout时间不规则的智能体任务，但group-relative更新需要对每个prompt重复采样；在固定rollout预算下，分组采样会限制prompt覆盖度，并引入组同步屏障。若每个prompt只采样一次，虽可规避上述问题，却失去了降低方差的组基线，使得在陈旧、变长轨迹上的更新噪声更大、更易不稳定。
AI.method: 提出FlashREINFORCE，一个无critic的单遍（one-pass）框架，由三个组件构成：One-Batch REINFORCE（单批次REINFORCE）、Sequence Trust Region（序列信任域）与Sample-Mean Optimization（样本均值优化）。三者协同在保留prompt覆盖度与带符号反馈的同时，控制策略漂移以及由长度放大导致的负向更新。
AI.result: 在DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B上以约4次更新的policy lag训练6000步仍保持稳定；在Qwen2.5-Math-1.5B上五个基准平均准确率38.0，较报告的GRPO基线提升1.7个百分点且rollout减半（256k vs 512k）。Python工具实验扩展至30B MoE模型Qwen3-30B-A3B，在policy lag为8时训练稳定。在Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct上，GRPO已停止工具调用而FlashREINFORCE仍维持工具使用，并取得98.3%/96.5%的seen/unseen ALFWorld成功率。
AI.conclusion: 单rollout/单遍的异步RL可在不依赖组基线的情况下保持稳定，并在rollout效率与工具使用能力上优于GRPO，具备向大规模MoE模型扩展的可行性。

title: Which Mathematical Context Supports Target-Aligned Conjecture Generation? A Paired Ablation Study
comment: 16 pages, 2 figures, 6 tables. To appear in the Proceedings of the 4th Workshop on Mathematical Natural Language Processing (MathNLP 2026)
summary: Generating mathematical conjectures from natural-language context is challenging because theorem-relevant information is distributed across multiple forms of mathematical context, including definitions, objects, assumptions, and constructions. We study which of these contextual signals help a model recover the specific claim supported by the surrounding setup, using 61 main theorems from 12 papers across four mathematical domains. For each theorem, we redact the result and represent the remaining setup using six context components. A paired ablation design compares full context, six leave-one-out conditions, and six single-component conditions, yielding 793 generated conjectures. Context components were largely complementary: removing one component usually had little effect, whereas retaining only one substantially reduced expected-theorem alignment. Local Mathematical Objects provided the strongest standalone signal, while Structural Constraints and Conditions produced the largest alignment decrease when removed. These findings suggest that target-aligned conjecture generation depends on combining information that identifies relevant objects with information that constrains admissible claims.

AI.tldr: 该文研究自然语言数学情境中"哪些上下文成分有助于模型恢复目标定理陈述"，基于12篇论文61个主定理做六类上下文成分的配对消融实验，发现上下文成分大体互补，局部数学对象是最强单体信号，结构约束与条件在移除时造成最大对齐下降。
AI.motivation: 从自然语言情境生成数学猜想困难，因为与定理相关的信息分散在定义、对象、假设与构造等多种数学上下文形式中；作者希望厘清哪些上下文信号能帮助模型恢复周边设定所支持的具体断言。
AI.method: 选取4个数学领域的12篇论文中的61个主定理；对每个定理遮蔽结论，用6类上下文成分表示其余设定；采用配对消融设计，比较完整上下文、6个留一条件（leave-one-out）与6个单成分条件，共生成793条猜想。
AI.result: 上下文成分总体互补：移除单一成分通常影响很小，而仅保留单一成分时与期望定理的对齐显著下降。局部数学对象（Local Mathematical Objects）作为独立信号的贡献最强；结构约束与条件（Structural Constraints and Conditions）被移除时对齐下降最大。
AI.conclusion: 面向目标的对齐式猜想生成依赖于"识别相关对象的信息"与"约束可容许断言的信息"两者的结合，单一成分不足以支撑高质量猜想生成。

title: Understanding Failures in LLM Reasoning by Learning Structured Representations of Chain-of-Thought
summary: Chain-of-Thought (CoT) is central to improving reasoning in large language models, yet existing evaluation methods focus on step-level signals and ignore the underlying structure of reasoning traces. This raises a key question: what aspects of reasoning quality (i.e., correctness, efficiency, and failure patterns) are encoded in the structure of a CoT trace? We introduce \textbf{CoT2Graph}, a framework that represents CoT traces as directed dependency graphs, making relationships between reasoning steps explicit and capturing patterns such as backtracking, branching, and subtask merging. We model these graphs with graph neural networks and use attribution-based explanations to identify structural patterns associated with reasoning quality. CoT2Graph reveals distinct patterns of successful and failed reasoning: correct CoTs place greater importance on early planning, whereas incorrect CoTs are associated with overloaded synthesis steps and dependency violations. We further show that graph-based signals better predict whether a CoT leads to a correct answer, outperforming previous tree-based structural methods by up to 2.5\% and simple length-based baselines by 7.8\%, while also improving Best-of-$N$ selection. Overall, our results demonstrate that reasoning structure encodes rich signals about reasoning quality, motivating a shift from sequence-level evaluation to structural analysis.

AI.tldr: 提出CoT2Graph框架，将思维链轨迹表示为有向依赖图，用GNN与归因解释挖掘与推理质量相关的结构模式，提升正确性预测与Best-of-N选择。
AI.motivation: 现有CoT评估方法集中于步骤级信号，忽略了推理轨迹的整体结构，因而无法回答"推理质量（正确性、效率、失败模式）在多大程度上编码于CoT结构之中"这一问题。
AI.method: 将CoT轨迹构建为有向依赖图，显式刻画推理步骤间关系并捕捉回退、分支、子任务合并等模式；用图神经网络对图建模，并借助归因式解释识别与推理质量相关的结构模式。
AI.result: 揭示成功与失败推理的结构差异：正确CoT更重视早期规划，错误CoT则伴随过载的综合步骤与依赖违背；基于图的信号在预测CoT是否正确上比树结构方法最高提升2.5%、比长度基线提升7.8%，并改进Best-of-N选择。
AI.conclusion: 推理结构蕴含关于推理质量的丰富信号，支持从序列级评估转向结构化分析。

title: NYUAD at ArGuard Shared Tasks: Multimodal Embedding Models for Detecting Arabic Hateful Memes and Unsafe Prompts
summary: The rapid growth of social media and generative AI has significantly increased the volume of Arabic textual content, memes, and user prompts shared across online platforms. While these media facilitate communication, creativity, and information exchange, they can also be exploited to disseminate hate speech, harmful content, and unsafe instructions. As a result, there is an increasing need for reliable automated methods to identify hateful Arabic memes and harmful (unsafe) prompts. This paper leverages pre-trained and fine-tuned multilingual embedding models to learn rich semantic representations from textual and visual content. The evaluation is conducted using a dataset of Arabic memes and prompts proposed in the ArabicNLP ArGuard 2026 challenge. The results underscore the capacity of large language model (LLM)-based embedding models to deliver superior performance. Developing robust detection systems is essential for improving content moderation and fostering a more secure and trustworthy online environment for Arabic-speaking users.

AI.tldr: 本文利用预训练与微调的多语言嵌入模型学习阿拉伯语梗图与提示词的多模态语义表征，用于识别仇恨性阿拉伯语梗图和有害（不安全）提示词，在ArabicNLP ArGuard 2026挑战赛数据集上评估，结果显示基于大语言模型的嵌入模型性能最佳。
AI.motivation: 社交媒体与生成式AI使阿拉伯语文本、梗图和用户提示词数量激增，其中可能包含仇恨言论、有害内容和不安全指令，因此亟需可靠的自动化检测方法。
AI.method: 采用预训练及微调的多语言嵌入模型，从文本与视觉内容中提取丰富的语义表示，并在ArGuard 2026挑战赛提供的阿拉伯语梗图与提示词数据集上进行评估。
AI.result: 实验表明，基于大语言模型（LLM）的嵌入模型在检测任务上表现更优。
AI.conclusion: 构建稳健的检测系统对改进内容审核、为阿拉伯语用户营造更安全可信的在线环境至关重要。

title: Internal Verdicts Track Evidence: A Template-Controlled Neutrosophic Reading of Epistemic States in Large Language Models via the Jacobian Lens
comment: 8 pages, 3 figures, 2 tables. Published in Neutrosophic Sets and Systems, Vol. 101 (2026). Code, stimuli and data: https://github.com/mleyvaz/jspace-epistemic-lens
summary: For twenty-five years, neutrosophic logic has assigned independent degrees of truth (T), indeterminacy (I), and falsity (F) to epistemic states that classical and fuzzy semantics cannot express. Previous applications measured these components on outputs: answers, judgments, expert evaluations. This paper reports, to our knowledge, the first neutrosophic reading of components inside the internal representations of a large language model. Using the recently released Jacobian lens on Qwen3.5-4B, we project intermediate-layer readouts onto lexicons of support, refutation, and hedging, obtaining layer-wise (T, I, F) profiles under conflicting evidence, first-person false belief, and factual control (n = 20 each). A first battery yielded three striking signatures: a surge of refutation mass under conflict, sustained indeterminacy under false belief, and an apparent "verdict collapse" before the output layer. A second, template-controlled battery showed that all three, as initially stated, were largely artifacts of prompt grammar: matched templates with agreeing evidence inflate the same lexicon masses, true beliefs elicit the same hedging, and the model verbalizes its verdict when allowed to generate. What survives the controls is stronger than what died: the neutrosophic verdict balance B = log10(F) - log10(T) tracks evidence polarity under identical templates (about 3 orders of magnitude of separation, Cohen's d = 2.3-2.5, p < 10^-6 in 9 of 9 layers; paired Wilcoxon: median difference +2.4 orders, 19/20 items, p = 3.8x10^-6) and residually discriminates false from true first-person beliefs. We argue that the independence of the neutrosophic components is what keeps the common-mode channel observable, making both the measurement and its self-correction possible, and we distill the two-battery design into a reusable protocol for auditing language model internals with lens-based readouts.

AI.tldr: 首次用Jacobian lens读取Qwen3.5-4B内部表征的(T, I, F)剖面；首轮三项"显著信号"经模板控制后多为提示语法伪影，但留存的中性值判定平衡B=log10(F)−log10(T)在同模板下稳定追踪证据极性并残留区分真假信念；据此提出双电池审计协议。
AI.motivation: 既往中性逻辑应用仅测量输出端（答案、判断、专家评分），从未进入大模型内部表征；作者希望检验(T, I, F)能否在LLM中间层被直接读出，并区分真实认知状态与提示语法的表面效应。
AI.method: 在Qwen3.5-4B上用Jacobian lens将中间层读出投影到"支持/反驳/模糊限定"三类词表，构建逐层(T, I, F)剖面；设置冲突证据、第一人称虚假信念、事实对照三类条件（各n=20）。第一电池为原始设计，第二电池为模板控制设计（同模板下一致证据、真信念、允许生成自述判定），用于剥离语法混淆，并以中性值判定平衡B=log10(F)−log10(T)进行统计检验（Cohen's d、配对Wilcoxon、逐层分析）。
AI.result: 第一电池三项签名——冲突下反驳质量激增、虚假信念下持续不确定性、输出层前"判定坍缩"——在模板控制下基本被判定为提示语法伪影（同模板一致证据同样抬高词表质量、真信念同样出现模糊限定、模型在可生成时会自述判定）。留存效应：B在9/9层显著追踪证据极性（约3个数量级分离，d=2.3–2.5，p<10^-6；配对Wilcoxon中位差+2.4个数量级，19/20条目，p=3.8×10^-6），并残留区分真假第一人称信念。
AI.conclusion: 中性逻辑分量的独立性使共模通道保持可观测，从而使测量与自我纠错同时成为可能；作者将双电池设计提炼为可复用的、基于lens读出的语言模型内部审计协议。局限在于单一模型、小样本(n=20)、词表投影的语义效度依赖人工构建。

title: ScopeBench: Evaluating Cultural Norm Scope Awareness in LLMs
summary: Safety evaluation in large language models treats harm as culturally invariant, yet a model cannot correctly apply a safety norm without knowing whose norms bind. We introduce ScopeBench, a benchmark that treats cultural scope as a first-class safety dimension. It comprises 3,323 norms spanning 49 countries across nine cultural clusters, each annotated as Universal or Specific. We define three scope error types identically across four evaluation tasks: Scope Inflation, Scope Deflation, and Scope Displacement. Evaluating 21 frontier LLMs across seven model families, we surface three structural failures. First, the dominant error type inverts with prompt format: Scope Deflation reaches 70% in single-answer classification, while Scope Inflation reaches 33% when each candidate culture is judged independently. Second, scope-classification accuracy is empirically decoupled from behavioral safety: the six classifiers achieving at least 97% Task 1 accuracy still produce harmful responses to 40-42% of scope-violating statements. Third, no model is safe in interaction, with harmful-response rates ranging from 29% to 51% across the cohort, excluding one model that systematically refuses the task. We release all data, code, and model outputs to establish cultural scope as a distinct alignment axis.

AI.tldr: 提出ScopeBench基准，将"文化适用范围"作为安全评估的一等维度，覆盖49国9大文化簇的3,323条规范，定义三类范围错误，评估21个前沿LLM发现三类结构性失效。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM安全评估将"危害"视为文化不变，但模型若不知晓规范归属于何种文化，就无法正确应用安全规范；文化适用范围被忽视。
AI.method: 构建ScopeBench：3,323条规范、49国、9个文化簇，每条标注为Universal或Specific；在四项评估任务中统一定义Scope Inflation、Scope Deflation、Scope Displacement三类错误；评测7个模型家族的21个前沿LLM，并对比单答案分类与逐候选独立判定两种提示格式。
AI.result: (1)主导错误类型随提示格式反转：单答案分类中Scope Deflation达70%，逐候选独立判定中Scope Inflation达33%；(2)范围分类准确率与行为安全解耦，Task 1准确率≥97%的六个分类器仍对40–42%的范围违规陈述给出有害回答；(3)交互场景无模型安全，有害回答率29%–51%（除一个系统性拒答的模型）。
AI.conclusion: 文化范围应作为独立于现有维度的对齐轴；数据、代码与模型输出全部开源，以推动后续研究。

title: Automating literature screening and knowledge synthesis with large language models
summary: Scientific literature is expanding rapidly, yet much of its knowledge remains difficult to organize and reuse due to the substantial workload needed to navigate large, heterogeneous literature corpora. Here, we develop a generalizable large language model (LLM)-powered framework that automates literature screening, structured information extraction, and knowledge synthesis within a unified workflow. We benchmarked 11 state-of-the-art proprietary and open-weight LLMs across three materials science screening tasks differing in scope, corpus size, and class imbalance. Seven LLMs achieved balanced accuracies above 0.90 across all tasks, with the best-performing LLM reaching 0.96--0.98, demonstrating the potential of LLMs to accurately screen large, highly imbalanced scientific corpora. The framework also substantially reduces manual effort, screening 10,000 records within four minutes compared with approximately 83 person-hours for manual screening. Beyond literature screening, the framework extracts structured information from full-text articles, enabling content-level quantification of research landscapes that extends traditional bibliometric analysis based on publication metadata. This capability reveals methodological trends and underexplored directions, as shown for machine learning in concrete materials science. We further demonstrate its utility for information and data discovery by identifying publications containing silicate glass density data that are difficult to retrieve using conventional search strategies, which can support downstream hypothesis development, research design, and data-driven scientific discovery. Overall, these results demonstrate the broad applicability of LLM-powered literature analysis across scientific domains and its potential to transform large, unstructured literature corpora into structured, analyzable knowledge at scale.

AI.tldr: 提出一个由大语言模型驱动的统一框架，自动完成文献筛选、结构化信息抽取与知识综合；在材料科学任务中验证其高准确率与远超人工的效率，并支持内容级研究图景分析与数据发现。
AI.motivation: 科学文献快速膨胀，但导航大规模、异构文献语料需要巨大工作量，导致知识难以组织与复用；现有文献计量仅依赖出版物元数据，无法实现内容层面的量化与数据发现。
AI.method: 构建可推广的LLM驱动框架，将文献筛选、结构化信息抽取与知识综合整合为统一工作流；在三个范围、语料规模和类别不平衡程度不同的材料科学筛选任务上，基准评测11个最先进的闭源与开源权重大模型。
AI.result: 7个模型在所有任务上平衡准确率超过0.90，最佳模型达0.96–0.98；框架在4分钟内筛选10,000条记录，而人工约需83人时；可对全文进行结构化抽取，实现内容级研究图景量化，揭示混凝土材料科学中机器学习的方法趋势与欠探索方向；并成功识别含硅酸盐玻璃密度数据的文献，此类文献难以用常规检索策略获取。
AI.conclusion: LLM驱动的文献分析在跨科学领域具有广泛适用性，可将大规模非结构化文献语料转化为结构化、可分析的知识，支撑假设生成、研究设计与数据驱动科学发现。

title: Mem2Fair: Online Fairness Control for Text-to-Video Generation via Fair Memory
summary: Text-to-video (T2V) generation models can produce systematically unfair demographic outcomes when prompts leave protected attributes unspecified. For example, prompts describing nurses without specifying gender may disproportionately generate videos depicting female nurses. Mitigating unfairness in T2V generation is particularly challenging: training-based methods that modify model internals require architecture-specific access and risk disrupting temporal consistency, while sampling-based methods often incur costly pre-deployment video generation. We present the first conditional online approachability formulation of attribute-level fairness for T2V generation. Building on this formulation, we introduce Mem2Fair, a plug-and-play framework that maintains concept-conditioned Fair Memory. Using generated videos at inference time as feedback, Mem2Fair selects prompt-level attribute interventions based on the deviation from each concept's prescribed fairness target, without training or separate pre-deployment sampling. Experiments demonstrate that Mem2Fair consistently improves fairness over the unmodified generator and existing baselines across multiple demographic attributes, prompt settings, and target distributions, while maintaining comparable prompt-video alignment and video quality. We further demonstrate its effectiveness on commercial black-box T2V models.

AI.tldr: 提出面向文本到视频生成的"条件在线可趋近性"公平性形式化，并给出免训练、即插即用的Mem2Fair框架，通过概念条件公平记忆与推理时反馈选择提示级属性干预，在多个属性与目标分布上提升公平性且保持对齐与画质，并可作用于黑盒商用模型。
AI.motivation: T2V模型在提示未指定受保护属性时会产生系统性人口统计偏差（如"护士"偏向生成女性）。现有缓解手段受限：基于训练的方法需修改模型内部、依赖特定架构访问且可能破坏时序一致性；基于采样的方法需在部署前进行昂贵的视频生成。
AI.method: 首个T2V属性级公平的"条件在线可趋近性"（conditional online approachability）形式化；据此提出Mem2Fair：维护概念条件的"公平记忆"（Fair Memory），以推理阶段生成视频为反馈，按各概念规定公平目标的偏差选择提示级属性干预，无需训练、无需独立预部署采样，即插即用。
AI.result: 在多个demographic属性、提示设置与目标分布下，Mem2Fair相较未修改生成器与现有基线持续提升公平性，同时保持可比的提示-视频对齐与视频质量；并在商用黑盒T2V模型上验证有效。
AI.conclusion: Mem2Fair为T2V公平性提供了一种无需训练、部署成本低、模型无关的在线干预方案，兼顾公平性、对齐性与生成质量，具备对黑盒商用模型的实用价值。

title: When Does Confidence Reveal Problem Difficulty?
summary: While confidence signals are commonly evaluated for their ability to predict a model's own correctness, their relationship with problem difficulty remains less understood. In this work, we investigate a wide range of confidence-related signals and whether they can serve as indicators of problem difficulty across various task domains. We find that perturbation inconsistency, semantic entropy, and solution length exhibit strong associations with population difficulty than token-level uncertainty. Notably, these relationships persist even when restricting the analysis to problems correctly answered by the focal model, suggesting that such signals capture information about difficulty beyond their ability to predict the model's own correctness. We further explore applications of these signals, illustrating the potential and limitations of using confidence-related signals to guide inference-time decisions. Our findings highlight the utility of model-specific signals as imperfect but informative proxies for population-level problem difficulty.

AI.tldr: 研究发现扰动不一致性、语义熵与解答长度比token级不确定性更能反映群体层面的问题难度，且这种关联在仅考察模型答对的问题时依然成立；作者据此探讨了用置信信号指导推理期决策的潜力与局限。
AI.motivation: 置信信号通常只被评估为"预测模型自身答案是否正确"的指标，而其与问题难度（跨任务领域）的关系研究不足。作者希望弄清置信相关信号能否作为问题难度的指示器。
AI.method: 系统考察一系列置信相关信号（扰动不一致性、语义熵、解答长度、token级不确定性等），在多个任务领域内检验它们与群体难度（population difficulty）的关联；并通过限制分析样本为焦点模型答对的问题，控制"正确性预测能力"这一混杂因素。
AI.result: 扰动不一致性、语义熵和解答长度与群体难度的关联显著强于token级不确定性；且该关联在仅分析模型答对的问题时仍然存在，说明这些信号捕获了超出自身正确性预测难度之外的难度信息。进一步实验展示了这些信号用于指导推理期决策的潜力与局限。
AI.conclusion: 模型特定的置信信号可作为群体层面问题难度的"不完美但具信息量"的代理指标，为推理期决策提供参考，但不应被视为可靠难度度量。

title: From Sensors to Silicon: Causal Cross-Layer Self-Healing Edge AI for Secure and Energy-Adaptive IoT Systems
summary: The migration of artificial intelligence from centralized cloud infrastructure to resource-constrained Internet-of-Things (IoT) devices reduces communication latency and improves data locality, but it also tightly couples sensing quality, inference behavior, microarchitectural activity, hardware reliability, security, and energy management within the same physical node. Existing edge-intelligence solutions predominantly address these dimensions in isolation, making it difficult to determine whether an observed degradation originates from sensor malfunction, data-distribution shift, malicious execution, hardware faults, or resource and thermal stress. This paper presents a causal cross-layer self-healing Edge-AI framework that continuously observes synchronized telemetry spanning sensor health, inference uncertainty, processor hardware-performance counters, accelerator and memory activity, power and thermal state, and communication conditions. A temporally informed causal reasoning engine estimates the most probable origin of abnormal behavior and quantifies diagnostic uncertainty, including under concurrent perturbations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个因果跨层自愈的边缘AI框架，通过同步采集传感器健康、推理不确定性、硬件性能计数器、加速器与内存活动、功耗与热状态及通信状况等多层遥测数据，利用时序因果推理引擎定位异常根源并量化诊断不确定性，含并发扰动情形。
AI.motivation: AI从集中式云端迁移至资源受限的IoT设备虽降低通信时延、提升数据局部性，却使感知质量、推理行为、微架构活动、硬件可靠性、安全与能耗管理紧密耦合于同一物理节点。现有边缘智能方案多孤立处理各维度，难以判别性能退化究竟源于传感器故障、数据分布漂移、恶意执行、硬件故障还是资源与热应力。
AI.method: 构建因果跨层自愈Edge-AI框架：持续观测跨传感器健康、推理不确定性、处理器硬件性能计数器、加速器与内存活动、功耗与热状态、通信条件的同步遥测；设计时序感知的因果推理引擎，用于估计异常行为最可能的成因来源，并在并发扰动下量化诊断不确定性。
AI.result: 摘要未给出定量实验结果；所述能力为定位异常最可能来源并量化诊断不确定性（包括多扰动并发场景）。
AI.conclusion: 跨层因果推理为边缘AI提供统一诊断与自愈机制，克服各维度孤立分析的局限，提升资源受限设备上异常归因的准确性与可解释性。

title: CLEAR: Legible and Steerable Recommendation via Grounded Natural-Language Interests
summary: Modern recommenders keep learned preferences in representations people cannot inspect or change. We present CLEAR (Controllable and Legible End-to-end Architecture for Recommendation), an end-to-end system deployed at Meta and built around an editable natural-language interest layer. CLEAR makes a ranked subset of inferred interests readable and stores accepted additions and suppressions as authoritative preference state. Behavioral grounding maps each inferred interest back to supporting events in the user's own history. The resulting interest object is also a serving address: its label and profile-conditioned rewrites drive lexical retrieval, its supporting events seed behavioral retrieval, its projection queries an embedding index, and its stable identity supports ranking, attribution, and exposure control. A fresh user declaration may precede behavioral support, so it enters through the same serving identity and initially draws candidates from topical retrieval. Ranking makes those candidates competitive, while a delivery controller observes attributable exposure and replenishes underexposed interests. Direct user review found that users rated about 88.5% of displayed interests accurate. In an offline benchmark using a shared evaluation protocol, the Specialized 3B generator reached 0.3967 mean-user F1@10, compared with 0.3633 for Gemini 2.5 Pro and 0.1911 for the prior generator. For a newly declared interest, a user-randomized cumulative ablation measured same-day delivery losses of 8.7 percentage points for added-interest ranking terms, 11.1 for reserved top-slot insertion, and 13.7 for interest-conditioned candidate sourcing, conditional on the tested removal sequence. CLEAR components have operated in production for over one year; the system spans four surfaces on Instagram and Facebook, with an interest layer people can inspect, correct, and use to direct recommendations.

AI.tldr: CLEAR 是 Meta 部署的端到端推荐系统，以可编辑的自然语言兴趣层为核心用户界面和控制界面，用户可检视、纠正并直接用于驱动推荐。
AI.motivation: 现代推荐系统将学到的偏好编码在用户无法检视或修改的表示中，缺乏可控性与可解释性。作者希望让推荐偏好变成可读、可编辑的自然语言状态，并将其同时作为服务寻址单元。
AI.method: 构建可编辑自然语言兴趣层：行为接地将推断兴趣映射回用户历史事件；兴趣对象作为服务地址，标签与画像条件改写驱动词法检索，支撑事件驱动行为检索，投影查询向量索引，稳定身份支持排序、归因与曝光控制；新声明的兴趣经同一服务身份进入，初期由主题检索提供候选，排序使其具备竞争力，配送控制器监测可归因曝光并补足曝光不足的兴趣。另训练专用 3B 生成器。
AI.result: 用户评审中约 88.5% 的展示兴趣被评为准确；离线共享协议基准上专用 3B 生成器 mean-user F1@10 达 0.3967，优于 Gemini 2.5 Pro 的 0.3633 与旧生成器的 0.1911；用户随机化累积消融显示新声明兴趣的当日配送损失分别为：加入兴趣排序项 8.7 个百分点、预留首位插入 11.1、兴趣条件候选召回 13.7（以测试的移除顺序为条件）。
AI.conclusion: CLEAR 组件已生产运行一年以上，覆盖 Instagram 与 Facebook 四个界面，兴趣层可被用户检视、纠正并用于指导推荐，验证了可编辑自然语言偏好作为推荐控制与寻址基础设施的可行性。

title: Policy Optimization With Multiple Verifiers via Pareto Rankings
summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has become an important approach to improving the reasoning capabilities of large language models. In tasks such as code generation and instruction following, multiple verifiers evaluate whether a response satisfies different requirements. Their outcomes provide detailed feedback about partial success, yet this feedback is commonly aggregated into a scalar reward for policy optimization. Rewarding only complete success discards distinctions among partial solutions, while counts and weighted sums impose comparisons between responses that satisfy different subsets of requirements. We introduce Partial-Order Likelihood Policy Optimization (POLPO), which learns from the comparisons established by verification without first constructing an aggregate reward. Pareto dominance identifies responses that satisfy additional requirements without losing any already satisfied, while leaving responses with conflicting outcomes incomparable. POLPO extends the listwise likelihood underlying Direct Preference Optimization by maximizing the total probability of all complete rankings consistent with these partial orders. This objective provides supervision from verified improvements even before complete solutions are available, without requiring a prescribed ordering of incomparable responses. Experiments on code generation and instruction following demonstrate improved learning efficiency and higher rates of complete requirement satisfaction compared with scalar-reward training. These results support partial-order likelihood as an effective approach to learning from multiple verifiers.

AI.tldr: POLPO 将多验证器的部分成功反馈表示为偏序关系（Pareto 支配），并通过对所有与该偏序一致的完整排序取总概率来扩展 DPO 的 listwise 似然，从而在无需构造标量奖励的情况下进行策略优化。
AI.motivation: RLVR 中多验证器提供关于部分成功的细粒度反馈，但通常被聚合成标量奖励：只奖励完全成功会丢失部分解之间的区分度，而计数或加权求和则在不同需求子集满足程度不同的响应之间强加比较，缺乏合理性依据。
AI.method: 提出 Partial-Order Likelihood Policy Optimization (POLPO)。利用 Pareto 支配识别满足更多需求且不牺牲已满足需求的响应，将结果冲突的响应视为不可比；将 DPO 所基于的 listwise 似然扩展到偏序，最大化所有与偏序一致的完整排序的总概率，无需为不可比响应规定顺序。
AI.result: 在代码生成与指令遵循任务上，相比标量奖励训练，POLPO 具有更高的学习效率，并获得更高的完整需求满足率。
AI.conclusion: 偏序似然是从多验证器反馈中学习的有效途径，可在完整解尚未出现前即从已验证的改进中获得监督信号，并避免对不可比响应施加人为排序。

title: Match and Correct: A Repeated Computational Motif in Evoformer Layers
comment: 27 pages, 4 figures (main text), 16 supplementary figures. NeurIPS 2026 Workshop: Interpretability for Discovery. Code: https://github.com/ishankhire/match-and-correct-evoformer
summary: Triangle attention and triangle multiplicative updates form key components of the Evoformer, and were introduced specifically to encourage consistency with the triangle inequality. Yet whether representational changes over layers reduce triangle inequality violations has not been tested. We probe the pair representation at each of OpenFold's 48 Evoformer layers, decoding final C$_α$-C$_α$ distances with four probe families (a shared linear probe, per-protein linear probes, a sequence-separation-gated linear probe, and XGBoost) and reconstructing intermediate 3D structures from the decoded distances via multidimensional scaling. Across a cohort of 552 CAMEO and ECOD proteins, distance decodability ($R^2$) and reconstruction quality (TM-score) rise in early layers, plateau in the middle of the network, and rise again in late layers. Directly measuring triangle-inequality violations in the decoded distances reveals a similar, more exaggerated pattern: violations rise to a peak, fall to a trough, rise to a second peak, and only then decline, revealing two distinct episodes of decreasing normalized triangle violations rather than one continuous improvement. Cumulative forward and reverse layer-wise ablations of the Pair Transition, MSA Transition, and triangle mechanisms localize the regions in which specific Evoformer components become essential. The two stages of geometric refinement coincide with the use of the Pair Transition MLP and the triangle mechanisms. These results characterize how distance information and decoded geometric consistency evolve across layers, and motivate hypotheses about the computations behind their trajectories.

AI.tldr: 本文逐层探测OpenFold的48层Evoformer的pair表示，解码Cα-Cα距离并重建3D结构，发现距离可解码性与几何一致性呈"早期上升—中部平台—晚期再升"的两阶段模式，三角形不等式违背量呈双峰起伏，两阶段几何精化分别与Pair Transition MLP和triangle机制的使用相吻合。
AI.motivation: Triangle attention与triangle multiplicative updates是为满足三角形不等式一致性而设计的Evoformer核心组件，但"随层数加深，表示变化是否真的减少了三角形不等式违背"这一问题此前未被检验；本文旨在刻画距离信息与解码几何一致性在网络各层的演化轨迹。
AI.method: 在OpenFold全部48个Evoformer层逐层探测pair表示：用四种探针（共享线性探针、逐蛋白线性探针、序列间隔门控线性探针、XGBoost）解码最终Cα-Cα距离，并经多维标度（MDS）从解码距离重建中间3D结构；在552个CAMEO与ECOD蛋白队列上评估距离可解码性（R²）与重建质量（TM-score），并直接度量解码距离的三角形不等式违背；进一步对Pair Transition、MSA Transition及triangle机制做累积式前向与反向逐层消融，定位各组件变得关键的区域。
AI.result: 距离可解码性（R²）与重建质量（TM-score）在早期层上升、网络中部进入平台、晚期层再次上升。三角形不等式违背呈更夸张的相似模式：上升至峰值、回落至谷值、再升至第二峰，随后才下降，显示出两段而非单次连续的归一化违背下降。消融实验定位了各Evoformer组件成为必需的具体层段，且两阶段几何精化分别与Pair Transition MLP和triangle机制的使用时段重合。
AI.conclusion: 研究刻画了距离信息与解码几何一致性在Evoformer各层的演化方式：几何精化并非单调过程，而是分为两个阶段，并分别对应不同的机制组件；这为理解Evoformer内部计算提供了实证依据，并引出关于这些轨迹背后计算假设的进一步研究方向。

title: CompoundingKernel: Self-Improving from Zero to First
summary: We present CompoundingKernel, a self-improving agent system that writes GPU kernels by search. As of 2026-11-11, its generated kernels rank #1 on the public L1, L2 and Quantization boards of SOL-ExecBench (NVIDIA B200). They have held #1 on L1 since 2026-10-27, albeit a short loss on 2026-11-07. All 235 problems have a site-verified correct kernel; on the 209 public-board problems they are 4.40x faster than the benchmark's reference baseline. The search starts from zero: agents get each problem's PyTorch definition but no reference kernels or official scores. A per-problem archive outside the model holds every correct kernel and its lineage. An LLM controller reads it, picks a parent or a new design, and gives each parallel child agent one direction. Checks outside the model decide correctness. At equal wall time, it beat a coded UCB style tree on 35 of 38 problems by making 2.4x as many correct attempts. Over a thousand agents ran at once, and one warm restart fix raised their evaluation rate 3.6x. We find that the rate of reliable measurements, not the number of agents, limits how far such a search scales. Our code and kernels are available on URL.

AI.tldr: 提出 CompoundingKernel：以搜索方式自动编写 GPU kernel 的自改进智能体系统，在 SOL-ExecBench（B200）的 L1/L2/Quantization 榜单登顶，比参考基线快 4.40x。
AI.motivation: 作者希望探索一条"从零开始"的自动化 GPU kernel 发现路径：智能体只获得每个问题的 PyTorch 定义，没有参考 kernel 与官方分数，从而检验搜索式自改进智能体在真实性能工程任务上的上限，并找出限制其规模化的关键因素。
AI.method: 系统采用模型外部的 per-problem 归档（archive）保存所有正确 kernel 及其谱系；LLM 控制器读取归档，选择父代或新设计，并为每个并行子智能体指定一个搜索方向；正确性由模型外的检查器判定。评测上，在同等墙钟时间下与编码式 UCB 树搜索对比；并进行了超千智能体并发运行及热重启修复实验。
AI.result: 截至 2026-11-11，生成 kernel 在 SOL-ExecBench（NVIDIA B200）L1、L2、Quantization 公开榜均排名 #1（L1 自 2026-10-27 起保持，仅 2026-11-07 短暂丢失）；235 题均有站点验证正确的 kernel，209 道公开榜题目上比参考基线快 4.40x。同等墙钟下于 38 题中 35 题胜过 UCB 式树搜索，正确尝试数多 2.4x；单次热重启修复使评测速率提升 3.6x。
AI.conclusion: 限制此类搜索规模化扩展的瓶颈不是智能体数量，而是可靠测量（正确性验证与性能评测）的吞吐速率；因此系统设计应优先优化评测流水线与并行评测资源，而非单纯扩大智能体规模。

title: Can an Agent Rethink What It Knows? Selective Scene Memory Updates in a Changing World
summary: Task configurations in factories, warehouses, and everyday physical environments change over time. Physical AI systems therefore need to incorporate new facts into scene memory while preserving valid information about equipment, objects, and operating constraints. We study updates to this parametric semantic-memory layer and present a joint evaluation of correction and preservation under finite update budgets. At fixed current fact count and memory parameter count, the protocol combines independent single-fact updates, budget trajectories, old-to-new answer diagnostics, and first stable success. Using a frozen 4B language model with late-layer LoRA, we evaluate seven preparation conditions and six update budgets on four-field synthetic semantic configurations. In two exposure-matched history conditions, increasing the budget from eight to 32 updates raises joint success from 6.25% to 94.79% and 91.15%, respectively, while exact obsolete-value outputs fall from 174/192 and 166/192 to zero. Constant32, which matches preparation steps but repeatedly trains on unchanged content during the first 32 events, achieves higher early joint success at eight steps (53.65%); at 32 steps, it reaches 85.42%, below both changing-history conditions. These results distinguish rapid correction under a small budget from simultaneous correctness of the new fact and the other three facts after further training. For both changing histories, most cases remain jointly correct at all subsequent measured points from step 16 onward. Output analysis shows that short-budget failures primarily retain the old value; repeated training on the new fact together with the other current facts progressively replaces these obsolete answers.

AI.tldr: 在冻结的4B语言模型上加晚期层LoRA，于四字段合成语义配置上联合评估参数化语义记忆的"纠正"与"保持"：预算从8增至32时联合成功率由6.25%升至94.79%/91.15%，过时值输出归零；小预算快速纠错，大预算实现新事实与其余三事实同时正确。
AI.motivation: 工厂、仓库与日常物理环境的任务配置随时间变化，物理AI系统需将新事实写入场景记忆，同时保留关于设备、物体与操作约束的有效信息；已有工作缺乏在有限更新预算下对"纠正新事实"与"保持旧事实"的联合评测。
AI.method: 在固定当前事实数与记忆参数量的条件下构建评测协议，结合独立单事实更新、预算轨迹、新旧答案诊断与首次稳定成功（first stable success）。采用冻结的4B语言模型+晚期层LoRA，在四字段合成语义配置上比较7种准备条件与6种更新预算；设置两个曝光匹配的历史条件与一个Constant32对照（前32个事件重复训练不变内容）。
AI.result: 两个变化历史条件下，预算由8增至32使联合成功率分别从6.25%升至94.79%与91.15%，精确输出过时值由174/192与166/192降至0。Constant32在8步时早期联合成功率更高（53.65%），但32步时为85.42%，低于两个变化历史条件；两变化历史条件多数样本自第16步起在所有后续测点保持联合正确。失败分析显示短预算失败主要为保留旧值，随新事实与当前其余事实的重复训练而逐步被替换。
AI.conclusion: 有限预算下的快速纠错与进一步训练后的联合正确性是两种可区分的记忆更新阶段；持续变化的历史优于重复训练不变内容，且更新在约16步后趋于稳定，为物理AI场景记忆的参数化更新提供预算与训练历史的实践指引。

title: Autonomous Multi-modal Agents for ITOps Observability
summary: ITOps observability products must integrate data from different tools and systems. We present ITOps Observability Studio, a multi-modal multi-agent system that orchestrates observability workflows through collaborative AI agents. Its three-tier architecture features inter-agent communication, specialized LLM-powered agents for data access, schema operations and visualization, and unified tool integration. The system supports natural language to GraphQL translation, GraphQL schema generation, schema mapping, trace data lifecycle management and multi-tool workflows for reliability engineering. Its agents are instrumented with agent analytics, so that their model and tool calls can be traced. We evaluate each agent on its own benchmark, scored against gold answers where they exist and by a model judge for schema mapping and chart quality. Query generation on a public benchmark and routing work well with a current open model, and the data lifecycle management agent solves most of its scenarios. The evaluation exposed defects that only appear when prompts, parsers and serving stacks are tested together, and we report them together with their fixes.

AI.tldr: 提出 ITOps Observability Studio——一个多模态多智能体系统，通过协作 AI 智能体编排 ITOps 可观测性工作流，并对其各智能体进行独立基准评测。
AI.motivation: ITOps 可观测性产品需整合来自不同工具与系统的异构数据，单一模型难以覆盖查询生成、模式处理、可视化等多环节，需要多智能体协同编排。
AI.method: 采用三层架构：智能体间通信层、由 LLM 驱动的专业化智能体层（数据访问、模式操作、可视化）、统一工具集成层；支持自然语言到 GraphQL 翻译、GraphQL 模式生成、模式映射、追踪数据生命周期管理与多工具可靠性工程工作流；并对智能体调用进行可观测性埋点（agent analytics）。各智能体在独立基准上评测，有标准答案者对比金标准，模式映射与图表质量由模型裁判评分。
AI.result: 在公开基准上的查询生成与路由任务使用当前开源模型表现良好；数据生命周期管理智能体可解决多数场景；评测还暴露了仅当提示词、解析器与服务栈联合测试时才出现的缺陷，并给出相应修复。
AI.conclusion: 多智能体编排可有效支撑 ITOps 可观测性工作流；端到端联合评测对发现集成级缺陷至关重要，智能体可观测性埋点有助于追踪与诊断。

title: When Facts Change, Which Decisions Break? Dependency-Aware Context Graphs for Agents
summary: When an observed fact changes, an agent must identify and repair the decisions that depend on it while preserving unaffected outputs. We investigate the reliability-cost trade-off of field-level dependency graphs extracted from actual agent read traces. A controlled benchmark spans three executable workflow domains and four successive updates, with independent imperative and expression-based references. Across 120 workflows, two models and two repeated runs, we compare full recomputation, rolling summary memory, lexical retrieval, trace-extracted dependencies and verified dependency upper bounds. Trace-derived graphs reduce reviewed decisions and estimated total cost, but omitted alternative supports and missing repair context can reduce complete-plan correctness. Paired ablations isolate the effects of edge deletion, spurious edges, transitive propagation and context scope. An exploratory enhancement supplies the existing record ID/field directory during extraction without revealing unread values or reference edges. We evaluate this enhancement on 60 fresh workflows with two repeats per model. On this fresh set, the directory-aware graph matches observed full-context complete-plan correctness for gpt-6.1-sol (100%) with an estimated 4.0% total-cost reduction, but reaches only 84.8% versus 99.6% for gpt-6-luna. The results distinguish potential dependency impact from actual decision invalidity and show why selective repair must be evaluated with both executable correctness and full memory-processing cost. The evidence concerns explicit procedural workflows; broad real-world agent-memory generalization remains untested.

AI.tldr: 该文研究基于agent读取轨迹提取的字段级依赖图在“事实变更后选择性修复”中的可靠性与成本权衡。在120个可执行工作流上对比全量重算、滚动摘要记忆、词法检索、轨迹依赖图及验证过的依赖上界，发现轨迹依赖图能降低审查决策数与估计总成本，但因遗漏替代支撑与修复上下文缺失而损害完整计划正确性。目录增强版本在一组新工作流上对某一模型达到100%正确率且总成本降4.0%，对另一模型仅84.8%（全上下文为99.6%）。结论强调需同时用可执行正确性与完整记忆处理成本来评估选择性修复，且证据仅限显式过程性工作流。
AI.motivation: 观测事实发生变化时，agent需识别并修复依赖该事实的决策，同时保留未受影响的输出。核心问题在于依赖图的粒度越细、越选择性，修复成本越低，但遗漏依赖或上下文会破坏计划正确性——即选择性与可靠性之间的权衡缺乏系统评估。
AI.method: 构建受控基准，覆盖3个可执行工作流领域、4次连续更新，含命令式与表达式式两类独立引用。在120个流程、2个模型、每模型2次重复下比较6种策略：全量重算、滚动摘要记忆、词法检索、轨迹抽取依赖图、验证依赖上界等。用配对消融隔离边删除、虚假边、传递传播、上下文范围的影响。另做探索性增强：抽取时提供记录ID/字段目录但不暴露未读值与引用边，在60个新流程上验证。
AI.result: 轨迹依赖图减少需审查的决策数与估计总成本，但遗漏替代支撑和缺失修复上下文会降低完整计划正确率。目录感知依赖图在新流程上对gpt-6.1-sol达到与全上下文一致的100%完整计划正确率、总成本估计降4.0%；对gpt-6-luna仅84.8%，而全上下文为99.6%，显示模型间差异显著。
AI.conclusion: 研究区分了“潜在依赖影响”与“实际决策失效”，说明选择性修复必须同时以可执行正确性与完整记忆处理成本来评估，单看成本会高估收益。局限在于证据仅针对显式过程性工作流，面向真实世界agent记忆的泛化尚未验证。

title: EVIDENT: Evaluating Evidence Grounding in GUI Agents
summary: GUI agents are increasingly evaluated by whether they complete web tasks, but surface success can hide a critical failure: the final answer may not be supported by evidence observed during navigation. We introduce EVIDENT, an evidence-driven benchmark for evaluating whether GUI agents ground their decisions in observable web evidence. EVIDENT contains 220 real-world English and Korean tasks spanning semantic grounding, contextual inference, and visual grounding, each paired with human-curated evidence metadata specifying what must be verified. We further separate surface task completion from evidence-grounded success using three metrics: TSR, ESR, and GSR, which respectively measure outcome success, required evidence observation, and claim-level evidence support. Experiments on commercial and open-source GUI agents reveal substantial gaps between surface success and evidence-grounded success, especially in contextual and visual tasks. These results show that current evaluations can overestimate agent reliability and highlight the need to assess not only whether agents answer, but whether they verify.

AI.tldr: 提出 EVIDENT 基准，区分"表面完成"与"证据支撑的完成"，揭示现有 GUI agent 评测高估其可靠性。
AI.motivation: GUI agent 通常以是否完成任务来评测，但表面成功可能掩盖关键失败：最终答案并未被导航过程中观察到的证据所支撑。现有评测无法识别 agent 是否真正"验证"过答案。
AI.method: 构建 EVIDENT 基准，含 220 个真实英文与韩文任务，覆盖语义接地、上下文推理、视觉接地三类，每个任务配有经人工标注的证据元数据（规定必须核验的内容）。提出三项指标：TSR（结果成功）、ESR（必需证据是否被观察到）、GSR（声明级证据支撑），从而将表面完成与证据接地成功分离。
AI.result: 在商用与开源 GUI agent 上的实验显示，表面成功率与证据接地成功率之间存在显著差距，在上下文推理与视觉接地任务中尤为明显。
AI.conclusion: 当前评测会高估 agent 可靠性；评测不应只关注 agent 是否给出答案，还应关注其是否进行了证据验证。

title: FinVerify: A Verification Framework for Financial Agents
comment: 15 pages, 2 figures. Accepted to the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Who Verifies the Agents? Toward Reliable Agent Development
summary: Financial agents produce numerical claims that can be wrong even when their calculations execute correctly, due to mismatched reporting periods, unsupported sources, incompatible units, or incorrect financial definitions. We introduce FinVerify, an evidence-grounded framework for verifying financial agents' numerical claims. Based on an analysis of 190 incorrect trajectories from the Agent Finance Reasoning dataset, we define five error categories--temporal integrity, source fidelity, comparability, accounting integrity, and financial-model fidelity--and operationalize them as verification protocols. An LLM structures claims and supporting evidence, while deterministic validators check financial requirements; when authoritative formulas are available, Z3 checks consistency with grounded inputs. FinVerify accepts only if all applicable checks pass, rejects proven violations, and abstains when evidence is insufficient. We evaluate the framework against a Direct baseline and an LLM judge across five fixed-candidate benchmarks. On Agent Finance Reasoning, accepted-claim precision increases from 56.4% for the LLM judge to 76.7% at 81.2% coverage. On XBRLFiling, FinVerify achieves 99.8% accepted-claim precision and 97.0% decision accuracy; on FinanceBench-67, it reaches 87.9% accepted-claim precision versus 69.7% for the judge. Improvements are smaller on FinQA and TAT-QA, where authoritative evidence is limited. These results suggest that explicit, evidence-backed verification can improve financial-agent reliability while exposing trade-offs between correctness, false rejection, and abstention.

AI.tldr: 提出FinVerify，一个基于证据的金融智能体数值声明验证框架。
AI.motivation: 金融智能体的数值声明即使计算正确也可能因报告期不匹配、来源不支持、单位不兼容或财务定义错误而出错，需要显式验证。
AI.method: 基于Agent Finance Reasoning数据集190条错误轨迹归纳五类错误（时间完整性、来源忠实性、可比性、会计完整性、财务模型忠实性），并转化为验证协议；LLM结构化声明与证据，确定性验证器检查财务要求，Z3在存在权威公式时检查一致性；全通过才接受，违规则拒绝，证据不足则弃权。
AI.result: Agent Finance Reasoning上接受声明精度从LLM判官的56.4%提升至76.7%（覆盖率81.2%）；XBRLFiling上精度99.8%、决策准确率97.0%；FinanceBench-67上87.9%对比判官69.7%；FinQA与TAT-QA提升较小，因权威证据有限。
AI.conclusion: 显式、证据支撑的验证可提升金融智能体可靠性，同时揭示正确性、误拒与弃权之间的权衡。

title: Deploying a Control-Logic LLM Assistant in Air-Gapped Power Plants: Lessons in Source Authority and Bounded Retrieval
comment: Extended version of a paper accepted at IAAI-27 (AAAI 2027). 8 pages, 2 figures, 3 tables
summary: Deploying Large Language Model (LLM) assistants in industrial operational technology environments poses constraints largely absent from cloud applications: site policies restrict engineering and operational data from leaving the plant, on-premises compute is limited, and incorrect causal attribution can mislead incident response. We report lessons from deploying a control-logic evidence layer that underpins a broader on-premises operator assistance system at two gas power plants. Two prototypes revealed where generative models added avoidable uncertainty and cost. The first used a Vision Language Model (VLM) to reconstruct control topology from PDF printouts routinely exchanged by engineers. Across the full 6,979-page document, extraction reached 0.51 connection precision and required 3.1 hours on 4xH200 GPUs; consultation with controls engineers then revealed a native structured export from the authoring system. The second used an LLM tool-calling agent to plan repeatedly over eight predefined graph operations. In a controlled benchmark of 40 template-generated questions, replacing this agent with explicit execution plans reduced mean token use by 20x and median latency by 3x, with identical retrieved node sets across repeated runs. The deployed design ingests the authoritative export into a versioned knowledge graph, executes bounded graph operations in fixed software, and confines the local LLM to fallback intent classification and evidence-grounded explanation. At one site, the graph contains 221K nodes across seven controllers. Our experience suggests a practical division of labor for high-consequence AI: LLMs interpret natural-language requests and explain results, while deterministic software constructs and retrieves technical evidence grounded in authoritative sources. Abstention, entity disambiguation, graph versioning, and read-only integration provide additional safeguards.

AI.tldr: 在两家燃气电厂部署控制逻辑证据层时，两个原型表明：用VLM从PDF打印稿重建控制拓扑精度低（连接精度0.51）且成本高；用LLM工具调用代理做图操作规划可被显式执行计划替代，token用量降20倍、中位延迟降3倍。最终设计采用权威结构化导出入版本化知识图谱、固定软件执行有界图操作，LLM仅负责意图分类与证据解释。
AI.motivation: 工业OT环境对LLM助手有云应用不具备的约束：现场政策禁止工程与运行数据离厂、本地算力有限、错误的因果归因会误导事故响应。作者需总结部署实践，明确生成模型在高风险场景中的适用边界。
AI.method: 以两个原型做对照实验：(1) 用VLM从工程师交换的PDF打印稿重建控制拓扑，在全部6,979页文档上评估连接提取精度与算力耗时；(2) 用LLM工具调用代理在八个预定义图操作上反复规划，并在40道模板生成问题的受控基准上，与显式执行计划对比token用量、延迟与检索节点集合一致性。据此形成部署方案：将权威导出载入版本化知识图谱，图操作由固定软件有界执行，本地LLM限于兜底意图分类与基于证据的解释，并加入弃答、实体消歧、图版本管理与只读集成等保障。
AI.result: VLM方案在6,979页文档上连接精度仅0.51，需4×H200 GPU运行3.1小时，且后续发现编写系统本身存在原生结构化导出。代理方案改为显式执行计划后，平均token用量降低20倍，中位延迟降低3倍，多次运行检索到的节点集合完全一致。单站点知识图谱含七个控制器、221K节点。
AI.conclusion: 面向高后果AI的务实分工是：LLM负责解析自然语言请求与解释结果，确定性软件负责从权威来源构建和检索技术证据；辅以弃答、实体消歧、图版本化和只读集成等安全措施，可避免生成模型引入的不确定性与额外成本。

title: Data-Driven Heuristic-Guided Business Process Redesign
summary: Business process redesign (BPR) has a long-standing catalog of best-practice redesign heuristics, yet, applying them remains a mostly manual task that requires extensive domain knowledge. Despite recent advances using Large Language Models (LLMs) for conversational process model redesign, limitations remain. For example, redesign is user-driven instead of data-driven and is not guided by best practices such as the redesign heuristics. Moreover, only one change can be handled at a time. To address these limitations, given an event log and a BPMN model, we present the DH-BPR framework to realize data-driven heuristic-guided BPR using LLMs. To design DH-BPR, we first conducted an analysis of which redesign heuristics can be automatically detected and applied given information contained in an event log such as the fraction of cases that bypass an activity. Based on this, DH-BPR detects and validates heuristic candidates through a combination of rule-based techniques and an LLM. After that, DH-BPR jointly designs and records an application plan for valid candidates, before finally yielding a redesigned BPMN model and an updated resource model (the way resources execute the process). Evaluation based on simulation using a synthetic benchmark and two real-world event logs shows that the framework's redesign reduces the mean case completion time by up to 61.5%.

AI.tldr: 提出DH-BPR框架，基于事件日志与BPMN模型，用LLM实现数据驱动、启发式引导的业务流程重设计，并将平均案例完成时间最多缩短61.5%。
AI.motivation: BPR已有成熟的重设计启发式库，但应用仍高度依赖人工与领域知识；现有基于LLM的对话式流程重设计是用户驱动而非数据驱动，缺乏最佳实践引导，且一次仅能处理单个变更。
AI.method: 先分析哪些重设计启发式可依据事件日志信息（如绕过某活动的案例比例）自动检测与施加；据此以规则方法与LLM相结合来检测并验证启发式候选；随后联合设计并记录有效候选的应用计划；最终输出重设计后的BPMN模型与更新后的资源模型。
AI.result: 基于合成基准与两个真实事件日志的仿真评估显示，该框架的重设计使平均案例完成时间最多降低61.5%。
AI.conclusion: DH-BPR实现了数据驱动、启发式引导且可批量规划重设计变更的LLM辅助BPR，并在仿真中显著提升流程时间绩效。

title: Information Limits of Replay-Free Recurrent State Migration
summary: When a recurrent model is replaced, its old state may not determine what the new model would compute from the same history. We characterize the information that must be retained before the replacement is known. For a time-invariant affine linear family, the minimum continuous causal memory for order-$k$ local migration equals the reachable dimension of a lifted coefficient system minus the information in the anchor state. A controllable $d$-state model with scalar input needs at most $kd$ additional real coordinates, even when arbitrary matrix replacement directions are revealed only after streaming. A single rank-one direction can already require all $kd$. Conditional singular values and auxiliary-bit bounds distinguish this local information law from recovery at a fixed tolerance. We also give invariant-subspace and future-output constructions. Controlled experiments compare the resulting representations. In a small language model, equal-memory cubic interpolation improves mean state fidelity over third-order coefficients but provides no meaningful predictive gain. An analytic history basis preserves useful adaptation more economically in a coupled identification task.
