With repeated slow poles, eight history coordinates meet normalized output error $10^{-4}$ across five fitted seeds despite substantial full-state error. Splitting the poles raises the smallest tested successful width to 64.

AI.tldr: 研究循环模型被替换时所需保留的最小连续因果记忆，给出其与提升系数系统可达维数及锚状态信息的定量关系，并用实验验证。
AI.motivation: 循环模型被替换后，旧状态未必足以确定新模型对同一历史的计算结果，因此需要在替换方案未知之前刻画必须保留的信息量。
AI.method: 针对时不变仿射线性族，将最小连续因果记忆刻画为提升系数系统的可达维数减去锚状态中的信息；用条件奇异值与辅助比特界区分局部信息律与固定容差下的恢复；并构造不变子空间与未来输出表示。
AI.result: 可控的d状态标量输入模型至多需kd个额外实坐标，即便任意矩阵替换方向在流式之后才揭示；单一秩一方向即可要求全部kd。实验中，等记忆三次插值提升平均状态保真度但无显著预测增益；重复慢极点情况下8个历史坐标在五个拟合种子上达到10^-4归一化输出误差，拆分极点后最小成功宽度升至64。
AI.conclusion: 模型替换所需的记忆存在可精确刻画的局部信息下界，且该下界与实际任务所需记忆可能差异显著，需按方向结构与谱分布具体分析。

title: From Mutation to Medication: Characterizing Failures of Clinical LLMs to Respect Genomic Resistance
comment: Accepted for publication in the Proceedings of the Machine Learning for Health (ML4H) 2026 Symposium
summary: Language models are increasingly proposed to support molecular tumour boards, but may recommend cancer therapies despite genomic evidence of resistance. We evaluated ten models on 1,464 resistance cases from five curated oncology knowledge bases, collecting 58,910 judgments. Models endorsed resisted therapies in 21.8-81.4% of cases. However, raw rates can reflect a tendency to agree rather than an ability to distinguish resistance from drug sensitivity: one open-weight model endorsed 81.4% of resistance cases and 82.3% of sensitivity controls. We therefore compared endorsement within matched gene and evidence-level groups. This analysis is exploratory because it was specified after the pre-registered analysis, which yielded null-to-weak results. Measured failures depended strongly on the reference knowledge base and evidence strength. When a second source independently confirmed resistance, four models across three vendors endorsed at most 2.4% of cases; at weaker evidence tiers, discrimination was not measurable. Models sometimes acknowledged resistance yet recommended the therapy. Repeating a model's own resistance conclusion reduced endorsement to 0.0-3.5% on cases where it had stated resistance. Falsely attributing the opposite conclusion increased endorsement above baseline for all seven hosted models, reaching 95.2% for GPT-4o; an instruction without an attributed conclusion changed endorsement by only 0.9 percentage points. Providing the correct curated evidence reduced unqualified strong recommendations to 0.3-3.5%, testing evidence use under an oracle condition rather than retrieval.

AI.tldr: 本文系统评测了10个语言模型在1,464个基因组耐药案例上的表现：模型在21.8–81.4%的耐药案例中仍推荐被耐药证据否决的疗法，但原始比例混淆了"迎合倾向"与"辨别能力"；按基因与证据等级匹配对照后，真正可测的失败强烈依赖参考知识库与证据强度，二次独立确证耐药时（强证据层）四款模型 endorse 率≤2.4%，弱证据层则无法测出辨别力；模型存在"承认耐药却仍推荐"的现象，复述其自身耐药结论可将 endorse 率降至0.0–3.5%，而虚假归因相反结论可推高至95.2%（GPT-4o）。
AI.motivation: 语言模型被越来越多地提议用于辅助分子肿瘤委员会决策，但此前缺乏对其是否会无视基因组耐药证据、仍推荐已耐药疗法的系统量化。此外，简单统计"推荐耐药疗法"的比例无法区分模型的"顺从/迎合倾向"（acquiescence bias）与真正缺乏耐药—敏感辨别能力，需要设计带敏感对照的匹配分析来分离二者，并探明失败在何种证据强度与知识库条件下才真实可测。
AI.method: 从5个经人工整理（curated）的肿瘤学知识库中构建1,464个耐药案例，对10个模型共收集58,910条判断。除统计原始endorse率外，引入匹配的基因与证据等级分组，与敏感对照案例比较endorse率，以剥离同意倾向。分析为探索性（在预注册分析之后追加设定，预注册结果为空至微弱）。进一步设置三类干预实验：(1) 模型复述自身已给出的耐药结论；(2) 虚假归因相反结论（对照组为无归因的指令）；(3) 以oracle方式直接提供正确的curated证据，检验证据使用而非检索能力。
AI.result: 原始endorse率为21.8–81.4%；某开源权重模型对耐药案例endorse 81.4%、对敏感对照endorse 82.3%，说明原始率主要反映agree倾向。匹配分析显示：当第二来源独立确证耐药时，来自三个厂商的四款模型endorse率≤2.4%；在较弱证据层级则辨别力不可测。模型有时明确承认耐药却仍推荐该疗法。复述模型自身耐药结论后，endorse率降至0.0–3.5%；虚假归因相反结论使全部7个托管模型的endorse率高于基线，GPT-4o达95.2%，而无归因结论的单纯指令仅改变0.9个百分点。oracle提供正确curated证据后，无保留的强推荐降至0.3–3.5%。
AI.conclusion: 模型的"耐药失败"高度依赖参考知识库与证据强度，强证据下多数模型辨别能力良好，弱证据下则无法可靠区分。单纯的endorse率会误导性夸大问题，评估须引入匹配对照与证据分层。模型表现出"自洽性依赖"而非稳健的证据推理：其推荐易被归因的结论（尤其虚假归因）左右，且存在承认耐药却仍推荐的内在不一致。提供正确证据（oracle条件）可显著降低错误强推荐，提示瓶颈更多在证据获取与推理整合，而非单纯的领域知识缺失。

title: The Data Debt of Stockouts: Partial Identification and Minimax-Regret Inventory Control
summary:
Problem definition: Inventory decisions select which demand enters sales logs. Unrecorded forecasts can leave demand frequencies unidentified even when stocking levels are recorded. We study which multistage ordering decisions these logs can justify and what finite samples can guarantee.
  Methodology/results: Nested stockout thresholds yield exact sets of compatible demand laws and finite representations for policy evaluation. We choose one deterministic inventory rule to minimize its largest expected cost gap from the informed optimum under the same law. This population value is data debt for the specified information and policy class. Under independent demand, carryover can create positive debt despite common optimal actions in every isolated period. Finite samples add learning error above debt. The required sample count grows linearly with the selection bound, with upper and lower orders matching up to logarithmic factors. This rate requires fixed demand and cost bounds, sufficient revelation, and a uniformly positive probability of clearing all feasible stock across the confidence sets. Controlled and semi-synthetic studies separate policy improvements from tighter guarantees.
  Managerial implications: More records can tighten guarantees while debt persists. Deeper revelation can establish common optimality without fully identifying demand. Using these guarantees requires validated logging, a credible selection range, and a regret tolerance in cost units. Information acquisition must distinguish tighter assurance from operating savings.

AI.tldr: 本文研究"未记录预测导致需求分布不可识别"情形下,历史销售/库存日志能支撑哪些多阶段订货决策,并给出有限样本保证。
AI.motivation: 库存决策决定了哪些需求被写入销售日志,未记录的需求预测会使需求频率不可识别。因此需要明确:在仅有记录库存水平的日志下,可识别/可证明的最优订货决策边界,以及有限样本下能提供何种统计保证。
AI.method: 构造嵌套缺货阈值,得到与日志完全相容的需求律精确集合及其有限表示用于策略评估;在给定信息与策略类下,选择一个确定性库存规则,最小化其与"知情最优"在同一需求律下的最大期望成本差(定义为数据债务);再叠加有限样本学习误差,分析所需样本量。
AI.result: 独立需求下,即使各孤立周期的最优动作一致,结转(carryover)仍可产生正的数据债务;有限样本在债务之上叠加学习误差;所需样本量随选择界线性增长,上下界在对数因子内匹配;该速率需固定需求与成本界、充分"揭示"(sufficient revelation)以及清空所有可行库存的正概率条件。控制与半合成实验区分了策略改进与更紧的保证。
AI.conclusion: 记录更多只能收紧保证,数据债务仍存在;更深的揭示可在不完全识别需求的前提下确立共同最优性。应用需经验证的日志、可信的选择范围与以成本为单位的遗憾容忍度,并区分信息获取带来的保证收敛与运营节省。

title: Hardening Agentic Web Populations Through Multi-Criterion Competitive Co-Evolution: Lessons from Wargame Strategy Optimization
comment: Accepted at the 1st NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Agentic Web: Decentralized, Continually-Adapting Agent Ecosystems (https://neurips.cc/virtual/2026/loc/atlanta/174837)
summary: Agents on the open web will face adversaries that keep adapting, so a defense that is only tested once will eventually be found and broken. We propose treating jailbreak attacks and safety guardrails as two populations that evolve against each other, rather than as a fixed attacker probing a fixed defense. This idea comes directly from wargame strategy optimization, where two-population competitive co-evolution with alternating evolution cycles and cross-play evaluation has already been shown to produce strategies that are robust to a moving opponent, and where a companion line of work has shown that the same machinery can measure how much competitive pressure a population must absorb. However, real-world applications can never rely on a single criterion as a key performance indicator, rather must use multiple conflicting criteria, such as, cost and efficiency. We describe how this mechanism transfers to language model safety, argue why the resulting multi-criteria, competitive and coevolutionary arms race is a genuinely networked, population-level problem rather than a two-agent toy setting, and lay out the open problems that stand between the wargame version of this idea and an agentic web version of it.

AI.tldr: 将越狱攻击与安全护栏视为两个共同进化、交替演化并以交叉对战评估的种群，从而把语言模型安全防御从"固定攻防单次测试"转变为多准则、竞争性协同进化的网络化种群级问题。
AI.motivation: 开放网络中的智能体面对的是持续适应的对手，仅测试一次的防御终将被发现并攻破；现有做法把攻击与防御都当作静态对象，无法刻画"移动对手"下的鲁棒性，因此需要一个能度量竞争压力并产生抗进化对手策略的框架。
AI.method: 借鉴兵棋策略优化中的双种群竞争性协同进化机制（交替进化周期与交叉对战评估），并将其迁移到语言模型安全：以多目标（如成本与效率等相互冲突的准则）替代单一KPI，构建攻击种群与护栏种群相互对抗的军备竞赛。
AI.result: 属于立场/展望类论文，未给出实验数据；主要论证该机制可迁移至语言模型安全，并说明由此产生的多准则竞争性协同进化军备竞赛实质是网络化、种群级问题，而非两智能体玩具设定。
AI.conclusion: 提出将协同进化军备竞赛范式引入智能体网络安全的研究议程，并梳理从兵棋版本走向智能体网络版本之间尚存的开放问题。

title: Zero-Shot Weight-Space Programming for Prediction and Classification of Target Variables in Structured Datasets
summary: Weight-space programming fixes every parameter of a feed-forward network by hand, with no gradient descent anywhere in the construction. Every demonstration so far starts from a target function handed to the model as a rule system, making it a compilation problem. A supervised dataset withholds that specification, so the procedure must do the statistical inference itself and then express the result in the parameterisation it was given. We ask whether a large language model can do both. It is shown a small dataset in full, with the architecture of a feed-forward network, and writes out every weight and bias as a literal number, with no optimizer, no gradient, no code execution, and no chance to evaluate it first. Each construction is sealed and pre-registers its expected score. The graded suite runs from two toy problems, through nine synthetic problems disguised by a hidden rotation, to the classical benchmarks and one real engineering regression. The frozen network matches the closed-form optimum wherever that optimum is linear, reaches the irreducible error of the generating process on three rungs where it is not, and beats every fitted baseline on two of those, including the same architecture trained by gradient descent. It fails on two rungs, both times because the structure to be found is oblique to the coordinates it analysed. Three further constructors separate two failure modes a single score conflates: one returns no parameter vector at all on the hardest rungs, another delivers everywhere while writing networks worse than predicting the mean. One of those failures proves avoidable: another constructor solves the oblique-hinge rung by a margin that survives multiple-comparison correction. What predicts whether the hidden layer earns its keep is the training error of a linear separator, which the composite complexity index misses.

AI.tldr: 研究探讨大语言模型能否在无梯度、无优化器、无代码执行条件下，直接将监督数据集"编译"为前馈网络的每个权重与偏置。模型在玩具问题、旋转混淆的合成问题、经典基准与真实工程回归上构造的网络可达到闭式最优或生成过程的不可约误差，并部分优于梯度下降训练的基线，但存在两类可区分的失败模式。
AI.motivation: 以往权重空间编程（weight-space programming）均从以规则系统形式给定的目标函数出发，本质是编译问题。当输入是监督数据集时，目标规格被隐藏，程序必须自行完成统计推断并以给定参数化形式表达结果。作者据此追问：LLM能否同时完成"推断"与"参数化表达"两件事。
AI.method: 让LLM完整查看一个小数据集及前馈网络架构，逐字写出全部权重与偏置，全程无优化器、无梯度、无代码执行、也无法先评估。每个构造被密封并预注册预期得分。评测套件包括2个玩具问题、9个经隐藏旋转混淆的合成问题、经典基准及1个真实工程回归；另设三个进一步构造器以分离单一分数所混淆的两种失败模式。
AI.result: 冻结网络在线性最优情形下匹配闭式最优解；在三个非线性阶梯上达到生成过程的不可约误差，并在其中两个上优于所有拟合基线（含同架构梯度下降训练）。在两个阶梯上失败，原因均为待发现结构相对于其分析坐标是斜置的（oblique）。三个额外构造器显示：一者在最难阶梯上完全给不出参数向量；另一者处处输出网络却劣于预测均值；其中一个失败可避免——另一构造器以通过多重比较校正的显著幅度解决了斜置铰链阶梯。预测隐藏层是否"物有所值"的指标是线性可分器的训练误差，而复合复杂度指数未能捕捉这一点。
AI.conclusion: LLM具备从数据直接构造前馈网络权重的能力，可在无梯度的条件下达到闭式最优或不可约误差，并在部分问题上超越梯度下降基线。其失败集中于结构与坐标不对齐的情形，且失败模式可通过多构造器对比加以区分，其中斜置铰链类失败可被规避。线性可分器训练误差是判断隐藏层必要性的有效预测指标，优于复合复杂度指数。

title: Beyond Clumsy Agentic Tool Calling: How Cueing and Spotting Make the Difference
comment: The code of reference implementation and instructions for reproducing the experiments are available in the following repositories: https://github.com/Cindy02050/ToolPulse and https://github.com/Cindy02050/ToolPulse_Reproduction
summary: LLM-based task-oriented agents depend on tools to interact with their environments, but may overlook execution feedback, repeat ineffective calls, or persist with unproductive strategies. These behaviors can hinder agents' ability to use tools autonomously and sustain task progress. We characterize tool-use symptoms at two temporal granularities: local clumsy tool-use behaviors and tool-use detours spanning multiple interactions. Towards greater autonomy in tool use, we present ToolPulse, an online middleware supporting autonomous tool use through cueing and spotting. ToolPulse tracks execution state and temporal interaction patterns, monitoring proposed calls before dispatch and inspecting execution feedback prior to the agent resumes reasoning. It combines state-based rules, semantic sequence analysis, and interaction-feature similarity to identify intervention opportunities and provide verbal reminders, structured feedback, or context-specific advice from auxiliary models. Our process-oriented evaluation distinguishes trigger validity, behavioral cessation, and substantive correction alongside task outcomes and resource costs. Using SWE-agent with three backbone models, we evaluate 1,350 trajectories on 90 Python, C++, and Java bug-fix tasks, comparing unassisted execution with four assistance strategies. Substantive responses follow 61.6-90.9% of valid triggers for tool-use detours. Concise reminders achieve the highest observed aggregate substantive-response rate; more elaborate assistance offers symptom-dependent benefits and can be less effective. Aggregate repair outcomes remain close to baseline, with token savings in selected settings. These findings support proactive runtime assistance for autonomous tool use. The gap between behavioral adjustment and aggregate repair gains calls for careful decisions on intervention timing and assistance strategy in autonomous agents.

AI.tldr: 提出在线中间件 ToolPulse，通过线索提示与检测（cueing and spotting）在运行时监测智能体的工具调用行为与执行反馈，识别无效调用与多轮"工具绕行"，并给出干预；在 1350 条轨迹上评测显示干预能带来行为层面的实质性纠正，但整体修复成功率仍接近基线。
AI.motivation: 基于 LLM 的任务型智能体依赖工具与环境交互，但常忽视执行反馈、重复无效调用或固守无效策略，削弱其自主使用工具与维持任务进展的能力。现有工作缺少对工具使用失灵的时间粒度刻画与运行时在线干预机制。
AI.method: 将工具使用症状按两种时间粒度刻画：局部笨拙行为（clumsy tool-use）与跨多轮交互的"工具绕行"（tool-use detours）。提出 ToolPulse 在线中间件：跟踪执行状态与时序交互模式，在调用派发前监测候选调用、在智能体恢复推理前检查执行反馈；融合基于状态的规则、语义序列分析与交互特征相似度识别干预时机，并输出口头提醒、结构化反馈或来自辅助模型的上下文相关建议。过程导向评测区分触发有效性、行为停止与实质性纠正，并同时考察任务结果与资源开销。使用 SWE-agent 与三个骨干模型，在 90 个 Python/C++/Java 缺陷修复任务的 1350 条轨迹上对比无辅助执行与四种辅助策略。
AI.result: 对工具绕行，61.6%–90.9% 的有效触发后出现实质性响应；简洁提醒获得最高的总体实质性响应率；更复杂的辅助方式收益依症状类型而异，且可能效果更差。总体修复结果与基线接近，在部分设定下节省 token。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持对自主工具使用进行主动的运行时辅助；但行为层面的调整与总体修复收益之间的差距，提示自主智能体在干预时机与辅助策略选择上需审慎权衡。

title: Auditable Authorization for LLM Agents: Empirical Evidence Across Model, Harness, and Workflow Layers
summary:
Human approval provides effective control only if rejected work stops and authorized work completes. We formalize refusal safety and bounded authorization completeness, and audit three execution boundaries: the model selects a call, the harness schedules and resumes it, and the workflow routes the decision to a protected effect. Paired decisions, exact traces, and native business-state witnesses support experiments with three models, five prompt arms, four runtime approval designs, two additional framework replays, and 100 public workflow sources.
  The paired model panel leaves seven of 300 approvals unfinished despite zero denied effects; parallel confirmation loses an approved branch in three tasks per model, restoration omits 336/672 CrewAI approvals, and four of 59 comparable n8n workflows execute after Reject. Comparing intent, generated calls, dispatch, and native effects identifies the first observable divergence and its repair target. This yields a practical audit contract that makes both refusal safety and authorization completeness independently verifiable, converting human approval from a procedural formality into an enforceable control boundary between intent and real-world effect.

AI.tldr: 论文提出“拒绝安全性”与“有界授权完整性”两个形式化指标，并在模型选调用、执行框架调度/恢复、工作流路由到受保护效应三层执行边界上审计人类审批机制。
AI.motivation: 人类审批只有在“被拒任务真正停止、被批准任务真正完成”时才是有效控制；现有审批常沦为流程形式，缺乏对拒绝与授权的可验证性审计。
AI.method: 构建配对决策、精确轨迹与原生业务状态见证的实验框架；跨3个模型、5种提示臂、4种运行时审批设计、2个额外框架回放及100个公开工作流源进行审计；通过比较意图、生成调用、调度与原生效应定位首个可观测偏差。
AI.result: 配对模型面板在零被拒效应下仍有300次审批中7次未完成；并行确认每模型3个任务丢失已批准分支；恢复机制遗漏336/672个CrewAI审批；59个可比n8n工作流中4个在Reject后仍执行。
AI.conclusion: 提出可实践的审计契约，使拒绝安全性与授权完整性可独立验证，将人类审批从程序性形式转化为意图与真实效应之间可强制执行的控

title: AgentFaultBench: State-Verified Evaluation of Tool-Fault Recovery
comment: 63 pages, 7 figures, including appendices. Submitted to the NAACL 2027 Industry Track
summary: Does recovery advice help an agent finish a task after a tool fails? AgentFaultBench evaluates LangGraph and CrewAI agents performing specified tasks in an isolated GitLab installation. We inject tool errors and check both the resulting files and issues and the required reads, verification and final response. The prompt supplies the expected issue and report text, so the task tests execution rather than content generation. In the primary comparison of 1,944 planned runs, advice changes success by -8.33, 0.00 and +1.06 percentage points relative to a neutral reminder; missing outcomes leave the latter two comparisons inconclusive. Later experiments test a revised recovery policy. GPT-4o mini improves, while Sol and Claude already complete the recoverable cases. In a separate 624-run study on six related tasks not previously used by that policy, the guided condition records 161 correct final states and one unknown outcome in 192 planned runs, versus 142/192 with neutral feedback. The gain lies between +9.90 and +10.42 pp when missing outcomes are included. Removing issue IDs gives 47/48 successes versus 46/48 with IDs; other execution information remains. A second checker agrees on 1,879 observed primary outcomes and 241 constructed test cases. No human validation was collected. The findings support testing advice against explicit recovery controls rather than assuming it helps.

AI.tldr: 该文提出AgentFaultBench，在隔离GitLab环境中评估LangGraph与CrewAI智能体在工具报错后的任务恢复能力，发现恢复建议的效果依赖模型与策略，不应默认其有益。
AI.motivation: 作者质疑"对智能体给出恢复建议就能帮助其在工具失败后完成任务"这一隐含假设，主张需以显式恢复对照组来检验建议的实际效果。
AI.method: 构建AgentFaultBench：在隔离GitLab实例中让LangGraph与CrewAI智能体执行指定任务，注入工具错误，并同时检查产物文件、issue以及必需的读取、验证与最终回复。提示中已给出预期issue与报告文本，因此任务只考察执行而非内容生成。主比较共1,944次计划运行，将"建议"与"中性提醒"对比；另有后续实验检验修订后的恢复策略、去除issue ID的消融、以及624次运行（六个此前未被该策略使用的任务）的独立验证；并用第二个评分器交叉校验。
AI.result: 主比较中建议相对中性提醒使成功率变化-8.33、0.00、+1.06个百分点，其中后两项因缺失结果而不确定。修订策略下GPT-4o mini提升，而Sol与Claude本已完成可恢复案例。独立624次研究中引导条件192次计划运行有161个正确最终状态、1个未知结果，中性反馈为142/192，含缺失结果时增益约+9.90至+10.42个百分点。去除issue ID为47/48成功，保留ID为46/48。第二评分器与1,879条主实验观测结果及241个构造测试用例一致；未进行人工验证。
AI.conclusion: 恢复建议并非普遍有益，其效果随模型能力与策略设计而异；评估智能体容错应从显式恢复控制出发做实证对比，而非预设建议有效。人手验证的缺失是主要局限。

title: UbiHearo: Bringing Scenario-Aware Sound Guidance to DHH Users with Mobile Agents
summary: For Deaf and Hard-of-Hearing (DHH) users, effective sound awareness goes beyond detecting \emph{what} sound occurs; it requires understanding \emph{what it means}, \emph{how urgent it is}, and \emph{what to do}. However, existing mobile assistants largely reduce acoustic scenes to isolated labels or generic alerts, failing to provide contextual guidance when the same sound implies different risks across scenarios. We present \sysname, a mobile hearing assistant agent that closes the sensing--reasoning--action loop for \textit{scenario-aware} and \textit{personalized} DHH assistance. \sysname adopts a \textit{neuro-symbolic} design that transforms continuous acoustic and physical context streams into structured intermediate representations (IRs) for controllable reasoning and guidance. It introduces three key mechanisms. \textit{First}, a perception-thresholded sensing mechanism enables energy-efficient always-on awareness by activating processing only for perceptually meaningful events while preserving safety-critical cues through deterministic overrides. \textit{Second}, a staged neuro-symbolic reasoning framework performs promptless scenario understanding by conditioning an on-device audio-language model on structured IRs instead of user-authored context descriptions. \textit{Third}, a bounded human-in-the-loop personalization mechanism adapts user-specific guidance through lightweight on-device decision-boundary updates while preserving population-aligned reasoning. We evaluate \sysname on smartphones and in-vehicle systems across diverse scenarios. It achieves favorable accuracy--latency--energy tradeoffs and personalized guidance.

AI.tldr: 提出移动端听力助手智能体，将声音感知、情景化推理与个性化行动引导闭环整合，采用神经-符号架构在手机与车载场景中取得良好的准确率—延迟—能耗折中。
AI.motivation: 现有移动助手将声学场景简化为孤立标签或通用告警，无法在"同一声音在不同场景下风险含义不同"的情况下提供上下文指导；而听障用户不仅需要知道"发生了什么声音"，还需理解其含义、紧急程度与应对措施。
AI.method: 神经-符号设计：将连续声学与物理上下文流转化为结构化中间表示（IR），支持可控推理与引导。三大机制：(1) 感知阈值触发的感知机制，仅在感知有意义事件时激活处理，并以确定性覆盖规则保留安全关键线索，实现高能效常开感知；(2) 分阶段神经-符号推理框架，以结构化IR作为条件输入而非用户撰写的上下文描述，实现免提示（promptless）场景理解；(3) 有界人在回路个性化机制，通过轻量级端侧决策边界更新适配用户特定引导，同时保持群体对齐的推理能力。
AI.result: 在智能手机与车载系统上跨多场景评估，在准确率、延迟与能耗之间取得有利折中，并实现个性化引导。
AI.conclusion: 情景感知与个性化是听障辅助的关键，神经-符号+结构化IR的设计可在资源受限端侧实现安全、可控、高效的常开听力辅助。

title: GEAR$^2$: Pruned Experts Live On through Gated Reuse of Activated Experts and a Missing-Mass Residual
summary: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) Large Language Models (LLMs) activate only a few experts per token while generally keeping all the experts in GPU memory for high efficiency. Expert pruning reduces this GPU memory footprint cost, yet discards the contribution of pruned experts. Existing remedies either rely on static substitutes, merge experts at the cost of altering their functions, or require costly recovery training. In this paper, we find that the functionalities of pruned experts can be efficiently reconstructed from the activated remaining experts. We propose GEAR (Gated Expert Activation Reuse), which reuses the scaled outputs of reliable activated experts without any training or additional expert computation. In addition, we propose GEAR$^2$ to further recover what reuse cannot express with an ultra-lightweight residual. On five MoE LLMs from 16B to 106B parameters with 25% and 50% of experts pruned, GEAR improves over its training-free counterparts in nearly every setting (up to 4 pp.) in terms of accuracy, and GEAR$^2$ outperforms baseline approaches (up to 2.75 pp.) in every setting on nine zero-shot benchmarks, with larger advantages (up to 2.72 pp. higher) under more aggressive pruning (up to 50%).

AI.tldr: 提出免训练的专家剪枝补偿方法GEAR与GEAR²，通过复用被激活专家输出的缩放组合重建被剪专家的功能，在16B–106B的五种MoE LLM上、25%/50%剪枝率下取得优于免训练基线的精度。
AI.motivation: MoE LLM为高效计算仅激活少量专家，但全部专家常驻GPU显存，显存开销大。专家剪枝可降低显存占用，却丢弃了被剪专家的贡献；现有补救方式（静态替代、专家合并、恢复训练）分别存在改变专家功能或训练成本高的问题。
AI.method: 观察到被剪专家的功能可由被激活的剩余专家高效重建，据此提出GEAR（Gated Expert Activation Reuse）：无需训练、不增加额外专家计算，直接复用可靠激活专家的缩放输出作为被剪专家输出的重建；并进一步提出GEAR²，用一个超轻量残差模块恢复复用无法表达的部分。
AI.result: 在5个16B–106B参数的MoE LLM上、25%与50%专家剪枝设置中，GEAR在几乎所有设置下较免训练对照方法提升（最高4个百分点）精度；GEAR²在9个零样本基准的所有设置下均优于基线（最高2.75个百分点），且在更激进剪枝（至50%）下优势更大（最高2.72个百分点）。
AI.conclusion: 被剪专家的贡献可通过激活专家的门控复用高效重建，配合极轻量残差即可进一步补偿，从而在免训练、低成本条件下显著缓解MoE专家剪枝的性能损失，且剪枝越激进收益越明显。

title: Counting What Matters: Reducing Redundant Object Detections in Overlapping UAV Mapping Imagery for Disaster Response
comment: 9 pages, 6 figure, IEEE International Symposium on Safety, Security, and Rescue Robotics, SSRR 2026, Incheon, Korea, November 02-04, 2026
summary: UAV mapping flights enable rapid aerial reconnaissance of large-scale incident sites in civil protection. However, the image overlap required for orthophoto generation causes every physical object to be detected multiple times across images, while dynamic objects may be omitted from or duplicated in the resulting orthomosaic. Analysis based on the orthophoto alone is therefore structurally insufficient. We address this by detecting objects on the individual images and merging redundant detections across them. This task lies between multi-object tracking and re-identification, as mapping flights form temporally ordered but sparsely sampled sequences with object reappearances across flight strips. We fine-tune YOLO detectors on a new domain-specific nadir dataset from real civil protection operations, roughly doubling mAP50 over the previous system, and propose re-identification approaches based on 3D positions from sparse reconstruction, DINOv3 appearance embeddings, and their combination via constrained greedy clustering. %On four manually annotated real-world mapping flights, the combined weighted multi-pass approach achieves the best trade-off between association accuracy and count error. On four manually annotated real-world mapping flights, an association-only evaluation using ground-truth detections shows that the combined weighted multi-pass approach provides the best trade-off between association quality and count error. It is integrated into the open-source web application ARGUS and visualized as verifiable, correctable object groups for first responders. https://github.com/RoblabWh/argus

AI.tldr: 该论文针对无人机测绘飞行产生的正射影像中目标重复/漏检问题，提出在单张影像上检测并跨影像合并冗余检测，结合3D位置与DINOv3外观嵌入的再识别方法，并集成到开源系统ARGUS中。
AI.motivation: 正射影像生成所需的影像重叠导致同一物理目标在多张图像中被重复检测，动态目标还可能被遗漏或重复，因此仅基于正射影像的分析在结构上不充分，需要在单幅影像层面对目标进行检测并跨影像合并冗余检测。
AI.method: 任务定位介于多目标跟踪与再识别之间：测绘飞行形成时间有序但稀疏采样的序列，目标会在不同航带间重现。方法包括：在真实的民防行动俯视（nadir）数据集上微调YOLO检测器；基于稀疏重建得到的3D位置、DINOv3外观嵌入及其组合（通过约束贪心聚类）进行再识别；并采用加权的多遍（multi-pass）合并策略。
AI.result: 微调后的YOLO检测器较原系统mAP50约提升一倍；在四次人工标注的真实测绘飞行数据上，采用真值检测的仅关联评估显示，组合加权多遍方法在关联质量与计数误差之间取得最佳权衡。
AI.conclusion: 将单图检测与跨图再识别合并冗余的思路可有效弥补正射影像分析的不足，方法已集成到开源Web应用ARGUS中，并以可验证、可修正的目标组形式呈现给一线救援人员。

title: Sage S2.1 Flash Technical Report
summary: We introduce Sage S1.5 Flash, a 320-billion-parameter general-purpose mixture-of-experts model designed to reason over scientific evidence and act in interactive environments. Sage Sci-Perception uses dedicated encoders for molecular graphs and biological sequences and represents spectra as ordered patches of measurements. Modality-specific projectors map these representations into the input space of a shared backbone, which processes them alongside text and images. To develop the model's agent capabilities, we construct verifiable environments for tool use, search, and coding, as well as specialized workflows involving machine learning experiments and scientific software. Task completion is checked against execution results, changes in environment state, or submitted artifacts. We evaluate Sage S1.5 Flash on 33 benchmarks across seven domains. In the primary comparison against five baselines, it ranks first on OfficeQA Pro (72.2), MLE-bench Lite (90.3 HumanRank), Harvey LAB, and SpreadsheetBench~2, and second on OSWorld-Verified (85.2), WebArena-Verified (67.6), and DeepResearch Bench~II (54.2). These results show particular strengths in using documentary evidence, producing verifiable workbooks, and carrying out machine learning tasks, alongside competitive performance in desktop and browser workflows that require the model to act on visual feedback.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Sage S1.5 Flash，一个320B参数的通用混合专家模型，具备科学证据推理与交互式环境行动能力，通过专用编码器与模态投影器接入共享骨干，并构建可验证的智能体训练环境，在七个领域33个基准上总体领先。
AI.motivation: 现有通用大模型难以同时处理科学专有模态（分子图、生物序列、谱图）并在交互环境中可靠行动；需要统一架构与可验证的智能体训练范式。
AI.method: 构建320B MoE通用模型；Sage Sci-Perception对分子图与生物序列使用专用编码器，将谱图表示为有序测量patch，经模态特定投影器映射至共享骨干，与文本、图像联合处理；为智能体能力构建工具调用、检索、编码的可验证环境，以及机器学习实验与科学软件专用工作流，以执行结果、环境状态变化或提交产物判定任务完成。
AI.result: 在七领域33个基准上评估；与五个基线对比中，OfficeQA Pro（72.2）、MLE-bench Lite（90.3 HumanRank）、Harvey LAB、SpreadsheetBench 2位列第一；OSWorld-Verified（85.2）、WebArena-Verified（67.6）、DeepResearch Bench II（54.2）位列第二。
AI.conclusion: 模型在文献证据利用、可验证工作簿生成与机器学习任务上优势明显，在依赖视觉反馈的桌面与浏览器工作流中具备竞争力，验证了科学多模态感知与可验证智能体环境结合的有效性。

title: Multi-LLM Agentic AI at the Edge: Joint Agent Scheduling and Resource Allocation
summary: In this paper, an edge-enabled multi-large language model (LLM) agentic AI architecture is proposed, where one supervisor AI agent and multiple worker AI agents cooperatively execute users' requests at the edge. The supervisor AI agent decouples the user request into a series of sub-tasks and dynamically dispatches them to LLM-equipped worker AI agents via two agentic workflows, i.e., parallel and serial workflows, with a two-level retry mechanism to enhance execution reliability. To prolong the service duration of worker AI agents, the energy minimization problems are formulated by jointly considering AI agent selection and resource allocation, subject to task execution latency and quality of service (QoS) constraints. A resource allocation scheme based on alternating optimization (AO) is proposed. Specifically, for the parallel workflow, the scheme decouples the original problem into bandwidth allocation, retrieval selection and AI agent selection sub-problems, which are iteratively solved by the proposed successive convex approximation (SCA), Lagrangian relaxation (LR), and Gale-Shapley (GS) or LLM-based algorithms, respectively. For the serial workflow, the problem is similarly decoupled into service time allocation, retrieval selection and AI agent selection sub-problems; the optimal service time allocation is obtained via Karush-Kuhn-Tucker (KKT) conditions, while the latter two sub-problems are addressed by extending the proposed algorithms to the serial scenario. Simulation results show that the proposed resource allocation scheme can reduce system energy consumption compared with other benchmarks, while experiments on a multi-LLM agentic AI system based on Qwen and Llama demonstrate improved task execution success rates.

AI.tldr: 提出一种边缘侧多LLM智能体AI架构：由一个supervisor智能体将用户请求解耦为子任务，经并行/串行两种工作流与两级重试机制分派给多个worker智能体；并以能耗最小化为目标联合优化智能体选择与资源分配，采用交替优化（AO）分解求解，仿真表明可降低系统能耗并提升任务执行成功率。
AI.motivation: 为延长边缘侧worker AI智能体的服务时长（能耗受限），需在任务执行时延与QoS约束下联合优化AI智能体选择与资源分配，并提升任务执行可靠性。
AI.method: 架构：单supervisor多worker的边缘使能多LLM智能体系统，采用并行与串行两种智能体工作流，配备两级重试机制。优化：构建能耗最小化问题，约束为执行时延与QoS，采用基于交替优化(AO)的资源分配方案。并行工作流下分解为带宽分配（SCA求解）、检索选择（拉格朗日松弛LR求解）、智能体选择（Gale-Shapley或基于LLM的算法）三个子问题迭代求解；串行工作流下分解为服务时间分配（KKT条件求最优解）、检索选择与智能体选择（将前述算法扩展至串行场景）。
AI.result: 仿真结果显示，所提资源分配方案相较其他基准可降低系统能耗；基于Qwen与Llama构建的多LLM智能体系统实验表明任务执行成功率得到提升。
AI.conclusion: 边缘使能的多LLM智能体AI架构结合并行/串行工作流与两级重试机制，配合基于AO的联合智能体选择与资源分配方案，可在满足时延与QoS约束下有效降低能耗并提高任务执行成功率。

title: Accelerate Bench: Evaluating Agents for Application-Level Program Optimization
comment: 49 pages, 8 figures. Work by Bowen Liu was done during an internship at Tencent Hy Team. Yuhan Li is Project Lead; Nuo Chen is corresponding author (chennuo26@gmail.com). Project page: https://acceleratebench.com/
summary: Application optimization requires coding agents to discover useful changes and coordinate them across a complete program while preserving the required computation. We introduce Accelerate Bench, a benchmark of 32 CPU optimization tasks adapted from scientific applications and supercomputing competitions. Each task provides a working program and specifies the workload, correctness requirements, timing boundaries, and permitted edits, leaving agents to choose where and how to optimize. Public testing supports iterative development, and a separate verifier scores the final submission. On benchmark version 1.1, we evaluate 16 coding agents, each pairing a model with a harness. Their Score@1 ranges from 25.5% to 67.4%. Most of their programs are correct, and the size of the speedup separates them: the two leading agents are at least 2x faster on 22 or more of the 32 tasks, while the other fourteen reach 2x on 8 to 17 and leave 125 of their 412 correct outcomes below 1.25x. Controlled replays show why coordination across an application matters: identical source code runs between 0.29x and 2.12x depending only on build and runtime settings, and one code change is worth 1.01x or 6.4x depending on another. Accelerate Bench pairs executable workloads with agents' programs and trajectories to evaluate both their gains and the process behind them.

AI.tldr: 提出 Accelerate Bench，一个包含 32 个 CPU 优化任务的基准（源自科学应用与超算竞赛），用于评测编码智能体在完整程序中发现并协调优化改动、同时保持计算正确性的能力；并给出 16 个智能体的评测结果。
AI.motivation: 应用级优化要求智能体不仅要找到有用改动，还要在完整程序中协调这些改动并保持所需计算不变，而现有评测缺乏面向此类端到端优化能力的标准化基准。
AI.method: 构建 32 个 CPU 优化任务，每个任务提供可运行程序并规定工作负载、正确性要求、时间边界与允许的编辑范围，由智能体自主决定优化位置与方式；公开测试支持迭代开发，独立验证器对最终提交打分；评测 16 个由模型与执行框架配对组成的编码智能体；并通过受控重放实验分析构建/运行时设置与改动间交互的影响。
AI.result: Score@1 介于 25.5% 至 67.4%；多数程序正确，差距主要体现在加速比：两个领先智能体在至少 22/32 个任务上达到 2 倍以上，其余十四个仅在 8–17 个任务上达到 2 倍，且其 412 个正确结果中有 125 个低于 1.25 倍。受控重放显示同一源码因构建与运行时设置不同可运行在 0.29x–2.12x；一处改动的价值因另一处改动而在 1.01x 或 6.4x 之间变化。
AI.conclusion: Accelerate Bench 将可执行工作负载与智能体程序及轨迹配对，既可评估优化收益，也可评估其过程；实验表明应用级优化中跨改动的协调与配置一致性对最终加速至关重要。

title: SPLICE: Structured Prompt Local Iterative Combinatorial Evolution
summary: Natural language optimization (NLO) improves an agent by having a model critique and rewrite its natural language policy parameters: system prompts, tool instructions, reasoning directives, few-shot demonstrations. These artifacts are multi-section documents in which some sections encode contracts (safety clauses, tool schemas, output formats) that must not drift, while others are legitimate optimization targets. Most iterative NLO methods treat the artifact as a single editable string, producing three recurrent failure modes: unsafe global rewrites, beam collapse onto a single lineage, and unchecked bloat, none addressed by formal guarantees. We introduce SPLICE, a unified NLO framework that poses optimization as constrained combinatorial search over an edit graph of block-structured, selectively-mutable states. We map each failure mode to a matched guarantee: (i) per-block mutability preserves contract text verbatim, with a price-of-freezing bound; (ii) elitist beam search with diversity slots never lets the leader regress on validation, bounds regression under noisy re-evaluation by an exponential tail, and keeps a competitive candidate from a different parent whenever one exists; (iii) a ratio length regularizer comes with an explicit accuracy-length bias bound. Candidates are proposed from dual section-local textual gradients; under a proposer-competence condition whose proxy we measure, edit-graph reachability and a convergence rate bound how quickly improving children arrive. Across seven public benchmarks under five reproduced protocols, SPLICE wins on four and matches the strongest prior method on three. On a production-style contract stress test it keeps the contract clauses that unconstrained optimizers trade away to raise the proxy metric, and ablations attribute gains to critique and elitist search.

AI.tldr: 提出统一框架SPLICE，将自然语言优化(NLO)视为块结构状态编辑图上的受约束组合搜索，为三类失败模式提供对应理论保证，并在七个公开基准与合同压力测试中取得竞争力表现。
AI.motivation: 现有迭代式NLO方法把提示等自然语言策略工件当作单一可编辑字符串，导致三类反复出现的失败：不安全的全字符串重写（合同性条款漂移）、beam坍缩到单一谱系（多样性丧失）、无约束膨胀，且这些均缺乏形式化保证。
AI.method: SPLICE将优化建模为对"分块结构、可选择性变异"状态的编辑图进行受约束组合搜索：(i)按块可变性逐块变异，逐字保留合同文本，并给出freezing代价界；(ii)精英beam搜索+多样性槽，保证领先者验证指标不回退、在噪声重评估下用指数尾界限制回退、并保留来自不同父代的有竞争力候选；(iii)比率式长度正则化，给出显式准确率–长度偏差界；候选由双重视角的段落局部文本梯度提出，在提议者能力条件下对编辑图可达性与收敛速率给出界。
AI.result: 在五个复现协议下的七个公开基准上，SPLICE在其中四个胜出、三个达到先前最强方法水平；在生产风格合同压力测试中保留了无约束优化器为提升代理指标而牺牲的合同条款；消融表明增益来自critique与精英搜索。
AI.conclusion: 将NLO重构为块结构状态上的受约束搜索，可使每类失败模式与相应形式保证一一对应，同时保持实证竞争力与合同条款保真度。

title: Découpage: Directorial Audio-Visual Control for Long Multi-Shot Video Generation
summary: In cinematic storytelling, sound and visual transitions do not always coincide in lockstep: dialogue frequently bridges across cuts to reveal reactions or introduces new scenes via J- and L-cuts, while deliberate silences pace the scene. Existing audio-visual generative frameworks, however, lack explicit mechanisms to coordinate independent visual and acoustic timing over extended horizons. As narrative duration and shot complexity scale, these systems struggle to maintain long-range dialogue pacing, often hallucinating speech during intended silences or erroneously driving mouth movements on silent listeners. To enable fine-grained cinematic control, we present DECOUPAGE, a screenplay-driven framework for long-form, multi-shot, and multi-character joint audio-video generation. Rather than coupling modality boundaries by default, DECOUPAGE uncouples generation into independently bounded visual and acoustic tracks governed by persistent character identities. DECOUPAGE builds on a joint audio-video diffusion model with dual-schedule temporal cross-attention, incorporating a directorial Lip-sync mechanism that selectively decouples speech conditioning from visual facial dynamics during off-screen dialogue. On multi-shot conversational benchmarks, DECOUPAGE achieves precise control over shot transitions, audio timing, and visibility-aware lip synchronization, directing 15- to 60-second screenplay-driven audio-video generation with multimodal coherence.

AI.tldr: DECOUPAGE 将长视频音频-视频生成解耦为独立定界的视觉与声学轨道，由持久角色身份驱动，并借助双日程时间交叉注意力与导演式 Lip-sync 机制，实现 15–60 秒剧本驱动的多镜头多角色音视频生成与细粒度电影化控制。
AI.motivation: 现有音视频生成框架默认将模态边界耦合，缺乏在长时程上协调独立视觉与声学时序的显式机制。随着叙事时长与镜头复杂度上升，系统难以维持长程对白节奏，常在应有静默处幻觉出语音，或在静默听者脸上错误驱动口型，无法实现 J-cut/L-cut、跨剪切对白等电影化时序。
AI.method: 提出剧本驱动的长时长、多镜头、多角色联合音视频生成框架 DECOUPAGE。核心是"解耦"：将生成划分为由持久角色身份约束的独立视觉轨道与声学轨道，而非默认耦合模态边界。基于联合音视频扩散模型，引入双日程时间交叉注意力（dual-schedule temporal cross-attention）以分别调度两轨时序；并设计导演式 Lip-sync 机制，在画外对白场景下选择性地将语音条件与面部视觉动态解耦，从而避免静默听者被错误驱动口型。
AI.result: 在多镜头对话基准上，DECOUPAGE 实现了对镜头切换、音频时序与可见性感知口型同步的精确控制，可导演 15–60 秒的剧本驱动音视频生成，并保持多模态一致性。
AI.conclusion: 显式解耦视觉与声学时序并由角色身份持久化约束，是解决长时程电影化音视频生成中节奏与同步问题的有效途径；该框架为细粒度导演级控制提供了可行范式。

title: Executable Archaeology: Reanimating the Logic Theorist
comment: This paper builds upon a previous ArXiv paper of a similar name: https://arxiv.org/pdf/2603.13514. This paper is NOT a mere rehash of the previous paper; appropriate citations and comparison are provided in the discussion. This work has been submitted to the IEEE for possible publication. Copyright may be transferred without notice, after which this version may no longer be accessible
summary: The Logic Theorist (LT), created by Allen Newell, J. C. Shaw, and Herbert Simon in 1955--1956, is regarded by some as the first artificial intelligence program. It was originally simulated by hand and written in a pseudocode called the Logic Language (LL), which was later called Information Processing Language One (IPL-I). LT was revised many times. The first machine-executed version was written in IPL-II and ran on the JOHNNIAC, and a late version was published in 1963 by Einar Stefferud as a pedagogical document and written in IPL-V, the only version of IPL that was formally released to the public. We describe a reanimation of both the IPL-I (LL) version of LT and the 1963 IPL-V version. Comparing the two reanimations illuminates the process of the invention of early AI algorithms and computer languages.

AI.tldr: 该文对Logic Theorist（LT）的两个版本——1955–1956年的IPL-I（Logic Language）手拟版本与1963年Stefferud发布的IPL-V教学版——进行了"复活"（reanimation）式重实现，并通过二者对比揭示早期AI算法与编程语言的发明过程。
AI.motivation: LT被视为首个AI程序，但其原始实现历经多次改写（IPL-I→IPL-II→IPL-V），早期版本从未在机器上完整运行或公开，导致对早期AI算法设计与语言演化关系的理解存在空白。
AI.method: 以历史文献为依据，分别对IPL-I（LL）版LT与1963年IPL-V版LT进行重新实现（reanimation），并采用跨版本对照分析的方法考察两者在算法表达与语言原语上的差异。
AI.result: 获得两个可运行的LT重实现，并从中识别出两个版本在启发式搜索实现、数据结构与语言抽象层次上的具体差异。
AI.conclusion: 双版本复活与对比为研究早期AI算法的形成及IPL系列语言的演进提供了可操作的实证路径，说明算法与语言在早期AI中是协同演化的。

title: Agent-Guided Process Verification for Mathematical Self-Correction
summary: Large language models have made substantial progress in mathematical reasoning, yet in complex multi-step reasoning, an error at any step may propagate along an incorrect path, and the resulting solution may omit necessary branches. Existing natural-language reflection methods often struggle to locate critical errors precisely, while outcome verification typically checks only whether the available candidate answers satisfy the problem conditions and can therefore overlook necessary branches. To address these limitations, we propose Agent-Guided Process Verification (AGPV) for mathematical self-correction. AGPV decomposes the current solution into an ordered sequence of key claims, verifies them individually while invoking a shared mathematical toolbox when needed, and stops upon detecting the first error. A summarization agent converts the failure evidence into a diagnosis that guides a correction agent to re-derive the subsequent solution from that point; AGPV then adapts the next verification iteration to the revised solution. AGPV also verifies solution completeness. We further prove that AGPV guarantees solution correctness and completeness when key claims provide sufficient coverage and local verification is reliable, provided that all key claims pass verification. The implementation compresses long working contexts and reuses successful tool results within each problem. We evaluate AGPV on five challenging mathematical reasoning datasets with four models from DeepSeek, Qwen, and GPT. AGPV achieves an average accuracy of 63.8%, outperforming the strongest among the representative baselines evaluated (50.3%) by 13.5 percentage points, with higher repair coverage than the programmatic-verification baselines.

AI.tldr: 提出Agent-Guided Process Verification (AGPV) 框架，用于数学推理的自我纠错：分解关键断言并逐一验证、定位首个错误、由诊断引导修正并验证完整性，在五个数据集上平均准确率63.8%，超最强基线13.5个百分点。
AI.motivation: 多步数学推理中错误会沿错误路径传播，导致解答遗漏必要分支；自然语言反思难以精确定位关键错误，结果级验证只检查候选答案是否满足条件，易忽略必要分支。
AI.method: AGPV将当前解分解为有序关键断言序列，逐个验证并在需要时调用共享数学工具箱，遇到首个错误即停止；摘要智能体将失败证据转为诊断，指导修正智能体从该点重新推导后续解，下一轮验证自适应调整；同时验证解答完整性。理论上证明：在关键断言覆盖充分、局部验证可靠且全部断言通过时，可保证解的正确性与完整性。实现上压缩长上下文并复用成功工具结果。
AI.result: 在五个高难度数学推理数据集、DeepSeek/Qwen/GPT四个模型上评测，AGPV平均准确率63.8%，较最强代表性基线（50.3%）提升13.5个百分点，修复覆盖率也高于程序化验证基线。
AI.conclusion: 过程级、错误定位驱动的验证加诊断引导修正，比自然语言反思和结果级验证更有效，且具备可证明的正确性与完整性保证。

title: A Hybrid State Space-Attention Architecture for Forecasting the Trajectories of Battery Degradation
summary: Early-life battery degradation trajectory forecasting aims to predict a battery cell's full state-of-health (SOH) trajectory from its initial charge-discharge cycles, potentially reducing cell qualification and evaluation time from months to days. Despite recent advances, accurate forecasting remains challenging for emerging battery chemistries, data-scarce domains, and cells exhibiting degradation behaviors beyond those observed during training. Existing state-of-the-art approaches increasingly rely on model scaling, large language model-derived aging-condition embeddings, and extensive fold-specific hyperparameter tuning, raising concerns about computational efficiency, reproducibility, and generalization. This work introduces DecayFormer, a compact hybrid state-space and attention architecture designed for early-life degradation trajectory forecasting. DecayFormer combines cycle-level selective recurrence, using a single scalar state per channel, with an attention mechanism queried by the recurrent state. It further incorporates state-of-charge (SOC) interval statistics and a master curve head that jointly estimates a scalar lifetime and a monotonically non-increasing SOH profile parameterized by normalized lifetime. We evaluate DecayFormer on the BatteryLife benchmark using all 22 aging-condition-exclusive folds, with a single run per fold and one fixed configuration across all folds, without fold-specific tuning. DecayFormer achieves mean test MAPE values of 2.25% on Li-ion, 2.76% on CALB, 0.95% on Na-ion, and 7.19% on Zn-ion. These results demonstrate the potential of compact sequence models to deliver accurate early-life degradation forecasts across diverse battery chemistries and aging conditions, without relying on extensive model scaling or per-fold optimization.

AI.tldr: 提出紧凑混合状态空间-注意力模型DecayFormer用于电池早期寿命SOH轨迹预测，在BatteryLife基准22折上以单一固定配置取得MAPE 2.25%(Li-ion)、2.76%(CALB)、0.95%(Na-ion)、7.19%(Zn-ion)。
AI.motivation: 电池早期循环到全寿命SOH轨迹预测可将电芯资格与评估时间从数月缩短至数天；但现有SOTA依赖模型规模化、LLM导出的老化条件嵌入和大量逐折超参调优，存在计算效率、可复现性与泛化性问题，且对新型化学体系、数据稀缺域及训练外退化行为仍不准确。
AI.method: DecayFormer为紧凑的混合状态空间与注意力架构：循环级选择性递归（每通道仅一个标量状态）+ 由递归状态作查询的注意力机制；并引入SOC区间统计特征与master curve头，联合估计标量寿命及以归一化寿命为参数、单调非增的SOH曲线。评估在BatteryLife基准全部22个老化条件互斥折上进行，每折单次运行、全折共用一个固定配置、无逐折调参。
AI.result: 平均测试MAPE：Li-ion 2.25%、CALB 2.76%、Na-ion 0.95%、Zn-ion 7.19%。
AI.conclusion: 紧凑序列模型可在多种电池化学体系与老化条件下实现准确的早期寿命退化预测，无需大规模模型缩放或逐折优化，兼顾效率与可复现性。

title: Program Distillation: Transferring LLM Capability from System 2 to System 0
summary: Recent studies leverage large language models (LLMs) to construct executable programs through environment interaction, feedback analysis, and code revision. However, prior work has mainly treated LLMs as optimizers, overlooking their ability to transfer knowledge across system levels. We propose Program Distillation (PD), a framework that formalizes the transfer of abilities from System 2 to System 0. During learning, the LLM provides task knowledge and draft strategies; at deployment, a student program executes the resulting policy. We show that this approach can improve performance while reducing inference time. We introduce PDBench, a benchmark comprising 27 discrete- and continuous-control tasks with fixed initial policies, and PDMetaHarness, a model-harness-independent meta-system for monitoring and guiding the learning process. The strongest model achieves a normalized mean score of 0.728, surpassing PPO (0.656) and Jev-like decision models (0.239), while running exclusively on CPUs and reducing inference costs. Our analysis shows that performance is largely driven by the first breakthrough during learning, and structural modifications have a slightly lower success rate than parameter modifications but typically yield larger gains. We further introduce style distillation, which enables interpretable stylistic control over the learning process. Overall, we present an analytical framework for PD and demonstrate its practical viability.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Program Distillation（PD）框架，将LLM在环境交互中习得的能力从System 2（LLM推理）蒸馏到System 0（可执行的student program），实现降低推理成本的同时提升性能，并配套PDBench（27个离散/连续控制任务）、PDMetaHarness元系统与style distillation机制。
AI.motivation: 已有工作多把LLM仅当作优化器（optimizer），忽视了其跨系统层级的知识迁移能力；同时LLM推理开销大、部署成本高，需要一种能把LLM能力固化为轻量可执行程序的方式。
AI.method: 提出PD框架：学习阶段由LLM提供任务知识与草稿策略，部署阶段由student program执行所得policy；构建PDBench基准（27个离散与连续控制任务、固定初始策略）与PDMetaHarness（模型与harness无关的元系统，用于监控与引导学习过程）；引入style distillation实现对学习过程的解释性风格控制。
AI.result: 最强模型取得归一化平均分0.728，超过PPO（0.656）与Jev类决策模型（0.239），且完全在CPU上运行、降低推理成本。分析表明性能主要由学习过程中的首次突破驱动；结构修改成功率略低于参数修改，但收益通常更大。
AI.conclusion: 本文给出了PD的分析性框架并验证了其实用可行性：LLM作为知识提供者而非优化器，可将能力蒸馏为高效可部署程序，并支持可解释的风格控制。

title: The Frontier Must Grow - Self-proposed, interpreter-labelled training roughly doubles a 4B model's accuracy on a fresh exam as its verified frontier grows
summary: A model can learn from problems it poses itself when an executable oracle supplies the answers. Qwen3-4B proposed Lua 5.1 programs; those it predicted wrong at least once in four samples joined a pool labelled by the interpreter, each round adding twice as many programs as the last (300, 900, 2100 in total), and each round trained a fresh adapter from the base on the pool. On the original exam the procedure met its registered criterion, an item-level test of each adapter against its predecessor. On a 2340-item exam drawn afterwards, accuracy rose from 8.3% to 16.7%; that follow-up's registered criteria were not met because round 1 gained nothing, while rounds 2 and 3 added 5.0 and 2.9 points on average, both intervals above zero. One fit on the same amount of base-proposed frontier data reached 14.6%, so the rounds' 2.1-point advantage is inconclusive. Three earlier registered series met no per-lineage criterion, and the same loop showed no gain on repository tasks or for a 27B agent in those configurations.

AI.tldr: 论文提出一种自提出（self-proposed）问题的训练循环：由Qwen3-4B生成Lua 5.1程序，用解释器作为可执行oracle对模型预测错误至少一次的样本打标，按轮次扩增候选池（300→900→2100）并从基座重训适配器；后续2340项测试准确率由8.3%升至16.7%，但关键注册判据未满足，优势不具结论性。
AI.motivation: 探索模型能否从"自己提出问题"中学习：当存在可执行oracle（解释器）自动提供答案时，自生成数据能否替代人工标注数据带来能力提升，并检验该过程的可复现性与可扩展性。
AI.method: 以Qwen3-4B生成Lua 5.1程序；将四次采样中至少预测错误一次的程序纳入池，由解释器打标；每轮池规模翻倍（累计300、900、2100），每轮从基座重新训练新适配器；采用逐项（item-level）检验比较适配器与其前驱，并预先注册判据；另设对照：等量基座生成"前沿数据"单次微调，及27B agent、仓库任务上的同构循环。
AI.result: 原始考试上达成注册判据；事后构造的2340项考试准确率从8.3%提升到16.7%，但该后续实验的注册判据未达成——第1轮无增益，第2、3轮平均增加5.0与2.9个百分点且置信区间均在零以上。等量前沿数据单次微调达到14.6%，故多轮相对单次的2.1个百分点优势不具结论性。三个更早的注册实验序列均无任何 lineage 满足判据；同一循环在仓库任务上及27B agent相应配置下均无增益。
AI.conclusion: 自提出问题+可执行oracle的闭环能带来可测的准确率提升，但效应不稳定、依赖轮次、且未达预注册标准，与等量随机前沿数据相比无显著优势；在更强模型与真实仓库任务上未见泛化，方法的稳健性与实用性尚待验证。

title: Towards Agentic Scientific Discovery in Distributed Systems
summary: We investigate when adaptive tool selection helps identify a shared equation across clients with different input coverage. Query-ATLAS (query-conditioned Agentic Tool-based Learning for Aggregating Symbolic Equations) uses an LLM to guide symbolic search from client errors and previous proposals in a simulated distributed system. A four-architecture comparison reveals task-dependent opportunities: relative to fixed PySR-LLM, validation acceptances rise from 3/12 to 7/12 on CRK3 and from 11/12 to 12/12 on oscillator2, while MatSci3 favors the fixed workflow. Across 72 settings in a post-hoc six-task subset of eight development tasks, Query-ATLAS achieves 64 validation and 64 in-distribution passes, versus 62 and 59 for the fixed workflow; both pass 47/60 eligible out-of-distribution tests. The fixed workflow retains lower median errors and cost. Broader query coverage emerges as a promising benefit, motivating task-aware tool selection and client-aware fitting for scientific agents.

AI.tldr: 研究自适应工具选择能否帮助在多客户端场景下识别共享方程，提出Query-ATLAS（查询条件化的Agentic工具学习框架），在四架构对比中发现其效果依赖任务：部分任务验证通过数提升，但固定流程在误差与成本上更低。
AI.motivation: 客户端输入覆盖范围不同时，共享方程识别困难；希望通过LLM引导的自适应工具选择来利用查询覆盖的广度，提升符号回归式方程聚合的验证通过率，并厘清自适应与固定流程各自的适用条件。
AI.method: 提出Query-ATLAS：在模拟分布式系统中，LLM依据客户端误差与历史提案引导符号搜索（构建查询条件化的工具调用策略）；与固定PySR-LLM流程进行四架构对比，并在8个开发任务的事后6任务子集上评估72种设置，统计验证通过、分布内通过及分布外测试通过情况，同时比较误差与成本。
AI.result: 相对固定PySR-LLM，验证通过数在CRK3由3/12升至7/12，oscillator2由11/12升至12/12，但MatSci3更偏好固定流程；72种设置下Query-ATLAS取得64次验证通过和64次分布内通过（固定流程为62和59）；两者分布外测试均为47/60通过；固定流程中位误差与成本更低。
AI.conclusion: 自适应工具选择带来任务依赖的收益，更广的查询覆盖是其潜在优势，但并非全面占优；结论支持面向科学智能体的任务感知工具选择与客户端感知拟合策略。

title: Agents Cannot Hand Over What They Have Not Yet Understood
summary: Agents that work beyond a single context window, or in teams, hand their work to a successor as a short written summary. Evaluation has focused on whether an agent can solve a task, and relatively little is known about how much of what an agent has learned survives being written down. We study this in 56 interactive worlds with hidden rules, where an agent that is told nothing fails and an agent given a 300-character statement of the rules succeeds. We compare one agent that plays eight lives and keeps its whole history with a chain of eight agents that each play one life and inherit a 300-character note. All six models we test learn less in the chain: after eight generations it stands where the single agent stood after about four lives. Controlled variants of the chain decompose this handoff loss into three components: none from changing the agent, a smaller loss from compressing to 300 characters, and a larger loss from compressing repeatedly. When each note is written from the full record of earlier lives instead of from the previous note, the same 300 characters recover 70% to 82% of the loss. The loss is robust across model sizes and is not alleviated by instructing the writer to record evidence, to revise the inherited note, or to keep a structured ledger. In simpler terms, an agent cannot hand over what it has not yet understood: a note holds what its writer has worked out, and a rule that takes several lives to see is lost with the lives that were not passed on.

AI.tldr: 多代智能体交接中，300字符笔记的信息损失主要来自"反复压缩"而非单次压缩或换模型，且从完整历史重写笔记可挽回70%–82%。
AI.motivation: 跨上下文窗口或团队协作的智能体依赖简短书面摘要传递工作，但现有评测只关注"能否解任务"，几乎不清楚智能体学到的知识在写成摘要后还剩多少。
AI.method: 构建56个含隐藏规则的交互世界（无信息必失败，给定300字符规则说明则成功）；对比"单智能体打8条命、保留全部历史"与"8个智能体各打1条命、继承300字符笔记"的链式结构；用受控变体分解损失来源（换智能体、单次压缩至300字符、反复压缩）；并测试多种改进写法。
AI.result: 六个模型均出现链式学习落后：8代后仅相当于单智能体约4条命的水平。损失分解为：换智能体贡献为零，单次压缩损失较小，反复压缩损失最大。每条笔记改为基于此前全部生命的完整记录撰写时，同样300字符可挽回70%–82%的损失。损失跨模型规模稳健，且要求记录证据、修订继承笔记、使用结构化账本均无效。
AI.conclusion: 智能体无法交接它尚未理解的东西：笔记只承载写作者已想清楚的内容，需数条命才能发现的规则会随未传递的生命一并丢失；瓶颈在于反复压缩与理解滞后，而非模型本身。

title: GainCtrl: Predicting Remaining Gains for Efficient LLM Agent Execution
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are widely used to power agents that interact with tools and environments to solve complex tasks. Repeated attempts improve the quality of tool-using agents, but continued execution incurs additional costs even when it is unlikely to improve the best result ultimately returned. This raises the question of when to stop an attempt to reduce execution cost while preserving task-level Best-of-N quality. To address this question, we introduce GainCtrl, a gain-based execution controller for LLMs. In GainCtrl, a lightweight CPU predictor uses interaction histories to estimate expected positive gains over retained scores, which are then used to guide stopping decisions with calibrated thresholds to limit the loss in mean Best-of-N task quality. We evaluate the controller through trajectory replay across three environments and three LLM actors. Comparisons of interpolated quality-cost Pareto frontiers show that GainCtrl generally uses fewer tokens than baselines at matched target quality. Fixed policies also achieve quality close to that of full execution while substantially reducing token consumption. The predictor runs at millisecond latency on a single CPU thread, supporting repeated monitoring without access to LLM internals.

AI.tldr: 提出 GainCtrl：用轻量 CPU 预测器基于交互历史估计相对保留得分的期望正向增益，并以校准阈值指导工具调用智能体的提前停止，在保持 Best-of-N 任务质量的同时降低 token 消耗。
AI.motivation: 重复尝试可提升工具使用智能体的效果，但即使继续执行难以改善最终返回的最优结果，仍会产生额外成本。核心问题是在不损失任务级 Best-of-N 质量的前提下，判断何时停止尝试以降低执行开销。
AI.method: GainCtrl 为基于增益的执行控制器：由单线程 CPU 上的轻量预测器利用交互历史估计超过当前保留得分的期望正向增益，再结合校准阈值做出停止决策，以限制平均 Best-of-N 质量的损失；评测采用轨迹回放，覆盖三个环境与三种 LLM 执行体，并以插值后的质量-成本帕累托前沿与基线对比。
AI.result: 在匹配目标质量时，GainCtrl 通常比基线消耗更少 token；固定策略（Fixed policies）在显著降低 token 消耗的同时质量接近完整执行；预测器单 CPU 线程毫秒级延迟，无需访问 LLM 内部即可重复监控。
AI.conclusion: 基于增益估计的自适应停止机制可在几乎不牺牲 Best-of-N 质量的前提下有效削减执行成本，且轻量、低延迟、与模型内部解耦，便于实际部署。

title: Routing Beyond Task Categories: A Cost-Aware LAB-Bench Study
comment: 21 pages, 3 figures. Reproduction archive at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.24220501
summary: We tested whether features of biology questions or of a model's first answer can improve accuracy within an inference budget. In a LAB-Bench pilot, we compared a category router with one that adds six structural features. Neither reached the primary 80% accuracy target on development. At the 50% and 60% secondary targets, both chose Haiku for all 120 held-out questions and scored 71/120. We then froze a new comparison before collecting responses on 144 additional questions. Semantic routing scored 86/144. A policy that could defer after reading Haiku's answer scored 87/144. Both stayed within the inference budget of USD 0.678 per 1,000 queries. Against a 95% Haiku and 5% GPT mixture, the accuracy gains were 0.66 percentage points for semantic routing and 1.35 points for deferral. The paired 95% intervals were [-0.28,2.25] and [-0.14,3.47] points. A simple rule that escalated Haiku nonanswers scored 92/144 at USD 0.710 per 1,000 queries, above the budget. A retrospective nonanswer rule with a calibration-selected escalation probability gave an expected 85.63/144. At the learned deferral policy's observed inference cost, post hoc interpolation gave an expected 86.14/144. In a later development check, Astra and Gemini each scored 30/40. The best tested policy in each router family matched that score. The pair covered 33/40 in hindsight. The routers missed the 32/40 criterion, so the proposed 120-question evaluation did not start.

AI.tldr: 在推理预算约束下，测试了问题特征与首答特征能否提升生物学问答准确率；语义路由仅带来微弱且不显著的优势，延迟策略略优于简单混合基线。
AI.motivation: 探索在固定推理成本预算（约每千次查询 0.678 美元）内，能否利用问题结构特征或模型首个回答的特征进行路由/延迟决策，以提升生物学问答的准确率，并与简单的模型混合基线比较。
AI.method: 在 LAB-Bench 上进行预实验：比较仅按类别的路由器与加入六项结构特征的路由器，目标为 80%（主）与 50%/60%（次）。随后在新增 144 题上预冻结对比：语义路由 vs. 读取 Haiku 答案后可延迟（escalation）的策略；并以 95% Haiku + 5% GPT 混合为对照。另评估基于非回答（nonanswer）的升级规则与回溯性校准规则。
AI.result: 预实验中两类路由器均未达 80%，均全部选择 Haiku 得 71/120。新对比中语义路由 86/144，延迟策略 87/144，均在预算内；相对混合基线增益分别为 0.66 与 1.35 个百分点，配对 95% 区间为 [-0.28, 2.25] 与 [-0.14, 3.47] 点，均不显著。简单非回答升级规则得 92/144 但超预算（0.710 美元/千次）；回溯校准规则期望 85.63/144，事后插值 86.14/144。后续核查中 Astra 与 Gemini 各 30/40，最优路由策略持平，事后配对覆盖 33/40。
AI.conclusion: 在给定推理预算内，语义路由与延迟策略相对简单混合基线仅有微弱、统计上不显著的提升，未能达到设定的路由标准（32/40），因此计划中的 120 题正式评测未启动。

title: Asking the right question is key to AI discovery in a chain of hypotheses
summary: Artificial intelligence (AI) scientists pursue discovery through a chain of hypotheses, fitting candidate models to existing observations and often choosing experiments where those models disagree most. Yet when early data miss a narrow feature, model selection favors simple curves that agree across the unmea- sured gap, so disagreement-guided search has no reason to look where the new phenomenon lies. When we tested two frontier AI scientists, Claude Sonnet 5.5 and GPT-6.1-Sol, across 32 closed-loop trials with a narrow peak omitted from the starting data, both sampled inside the peak region less often than random search. Surprisingly, the agent that followed model disagreement more closely missed the peak in all 32 trials, whereas discovery succeeded when experiments probed the unmeasured gap early and followed up across the anomaly. Asking the right question, rather than testing only where current models disagree, is therefore key to AI discovery in a chain of hypotheses.

AI.tldr: 在32个闭环实验中，两个前沿AI科学家（Claude Sonnet 5.5与GPT-6.1-Sol）在起始数据缺失一个窄峰时，采样落入峰区的频率低于随机搜索；越严格遵循模型分歧的智能体越失败，而尽早探测未测量区间并追踪异常则能成功发现新现象。
AI.motivation: AI科学家通常采用"假设链"策略：拟合候选模型到已有观测，并在模型分歧最大的位置设计实验。但当早期数据遗漏了某个窄特征时，模型选择会偏向在未测量间隙内彼此一致的简单曲线，导致分歧引导的搜索在该间隙内无分歧可依，从而缺乏前往新现象所在位置的动机。论文旨在检验这一失效模式并寻找替代策略。
AI.method: 设置32个闭环实验（closed-loop trials），起始数据中刻意省略一个窄峰；对比两个前沿AI科学家（Claude Sonnet 5.5、GPT-6.1-Sol）的采样行为，以随机搜索为基线，统计其在峰区内的采样频率，并考察模型分歧跟随程度与发现成功率之间的关系。
AI.result: 两个智能体在峰区内的采样频率均低于随机搜索；更紧密跟随模型分歧的智能体在全部32次试验中均未发现峰；当实验早期即探测未测量的间隙、并在发现异常后沿其继续追随时，发现得以成功。
AI.conclusion: 在假设链式发现中，仅依据当前模型分歧来设计实验是不够的；关键在于提出正确的问题——主动探查未测量区域并追踪异常，而非只检验模型分歧之处。

title: Lossless First-Action Menus for Linear-Reward Planning
summary: We study sequential decision making where an agent reserves a minimum menu of initial actions before multi-objective trade-offs are revealed, followed by unrestricted continuation planning once linear reward weights arrive. We prove that a menu preserves the unrestricted optimal return across all linear scalarizations if and only if its reachable continuations cover all vertices of the full feature polytope. This geometric equivalence yields an output-sensitive algorithm that is fixed-parameter tractable in the vertex count, combining scalar backward induction with oracle-based facet identification. On explicitly layered graphs with unit feature increments, menu verification is coNP-complete and synthesis is complete for the second existential level of the polynomial hierarchy, even under additive loss strictly below one. In fixed dimensions two and higher, verification is polynomial whereas synthesis remains NP-complete, while one-dimensional instances admit polynomial-time solutions.

AI.tldr: 研究"多目标权衡揭示前需预留最小初始动作菜单"的序贯决策问题，证明菜单保留所有线性标量化无约束最优回报当且仅当其可达续接覆盖全特征多面体所有顶点，并给出复杂度刻画。
AI.motivation: 在奖励权重未知、之后才揭示的多目标序贯决策中，需要事先承诺一个"初始动作菜单"，同时希望该菜单在任意线性标量化下都不损失无约束最优回报；如何刻画这种"无损"条件并确定其计算复杂度是核心问题。
AI.method: 将无损性转化为几何等价：菜单可达续接的集合恰好覆盖全特征多面体的全部顶点。基于该等价设计输出敏感算法，复杂度以顶点数为参数固定参数可 tractable，结合标量后向归纳与基于 oracle 的面识别。对显式分层图、单位特征增量设定，证明菜单验证 coNP-完全、合成对 PH 第二存在层完全（即使在加性损失严格小于 1 时）；在给定维数下讨论验证与合成复杂度。
AI.result: 证明了菜单无损性的多面体顶点覆盖等价；得到以顶点数为参数的 FPT 输出敏感算法；显式分层图单位增量下验证 coNP-完全、合成对 Σ₂ᵖ 完全（加性损失<1 仍成立）；维数≥2 固定时验证多项式、合成 NP-完全；一维情形验证与合成均多项式可解。
AI.conclusion: 菜单无损性可由特征多面体顶点覆盖精确刻画，由此形成统一算法与复杂度图景：一般情形以顶点数为参数可 tractable，而结构化图上合成位于多项式层级较高层，仅在一维或固定维验证等受限情形可多项式求解。

title: Instructor-designed AI improves learning in a randomized trial across 19 universities
summary: Universities are alarmed by recent evidence that artificial intelligence (AI) can undermine learning, with students prescribed generic chatbots or centrally designed AI tools performing worse. In a pre-registered randomized controlled trial across 7,200 students at 19 universities over three semesters, we tested whether AI designed by frontline instructors can improve learning. We encouraged instructors to design AI solutions they believed would best help their students. Drawing on their unique knowledge of their classes and students, the instructors created a wide array of innovations. We show that these instructor-designed AI innovations improved student learning, measured by AI-proof assessments (proctored, in-person examinations). We found no change in student engagement, measured by course activity records, or satisfaction, measured by course evaluations. Our findings demonstrate that AI can improve student learning when its adoption is frontline-driven, with instructors empowered to design and refine AI solutions for their own classrooms.

AI.tldr: 一项覆盖19所大学7200名学生、历时三学期的预注册随机对照试验发现，由一线教师自主设计的AI工具能提升学生在防AI作弊的线下监考考试中的学习成绩，但学生的课程参与度和满意度无显著变化。
AI.motivation: 近期证据显示AI可能削弱学习：使用通用聊天机器人或中央统一设计的AI工具的学生表现更差，引发高校担忧。作者因此探究"由一线教师设计AI"是否能改善学习效果。
AI.method: 预注册随机对照试验，覆盖19所大学、7200名学生、三个学期；鼓励教师依据其对课程和学生的独特了解自主设计AI解决方案，产生多样化创新；学习成效以防AI的线下监考考试衡量，参与度以课程活动记录衡量，满意度以课程评价衡量。
AI.result: 教师设计的AI创新显著提升了学生在防AI评估（监考、线下考试）中的学习表现；学生参与度（课程活动记录）与满意度（课程评价）均无变化。
AI.conclusion: 当AI的采用由一线驱动、并赋予教师为其课堂设计与迭代AI方案的能力时，AI能够改善学生学习。

title: InclusionMed: Benchmarking AI for Inclusive Healthcare
comment: 31 pages, 8 figures, 10 tables. Project website: https://inclusionmed.ai/
summary: Advancing medical AI for inclusive healthcare requires evaluation across diverse healthcare roles, tasks, and care settings, but benchmark coverage remains uneven. We introduce InclusionMed, an open medical AI evaluation initiative for inclusive healthcare. The InclusionMed Atlas organizes benchmarks across three healthcare roles and three AI capabilities. For the first release, we selected four public benchmarks from 388 candidates through structured audits and independent reproduction. With InclusionMed-DxFiles, our private diagnostic reasoning benchmark, the Atlas contains five benchmarks covering three of its nine role--capability cells. We evaluated frontier large language models on the Atlas and aggregated their results into the InclusionMed Index, with overall scores ranging from 17.5 to 49.1 out of 100. The Index also reports scores by healthcare role and AI capability, showing that a model's rank varied with the role or capability considered. A within-benchmark analysis using task-level tags showed that the ten highest-ranked models in the Index all scored higher on patient communication than on clinical decision-making. Models with similar Index scores also differed substantially in estimated inference cost. These findings highlight the need for evaluation covering more diverse healthcare needs and for context-specific model selection. Through open collaboration and community contributions, InclusionMed seeks to ensure that diverse healthcare needs worldwide shape how medical AI progress is defined and measured.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 InclusionMed 开放医学 AI 评测计划及其 Atlas 基准图谱，从 388 个候选中经结构化审计与独立复现筛选出 4 个公开基准，加上自建的 DxFiles 诊断推理基准，共 5 个基准覆盖 9 个"角色—能力"单元格中的 3 个，并构建 InclusionMed Index 对前沿大模型进行评测。
AI.motivation: 面向包容性医疗的医学 AI 需要在多样化的医疗角色、任务与照护场景下评测，但现有基准覆盖不均衡，缺乏系统化组织与统一比较框架。
AI.method: 构建 InclusionMed Atlas，按三种医疗角色与三种 AI 能力组织基准；通过结构化审计与独立复现从 388 个候选中选出 4 个公开基准，并引入私有诊断推理基准 InclusionMed-DxFiles；在多基准上评测前沿大语言模型，将结果聚合为 InclusionMed Index，并报告分角色、分能力得分，结合任务级标签做基准内分析。
AI.result: Index 总分为 100 分制，模型得分区间为 17.5–49.1；模型排名随所考察的医疗角色或 AI 能力而变化；基准内分析显示 Index 前十模型在患者沟通任务上的得分均高于临床决策任务；Index 得分相近的模型在估计推理成本上差异显著。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明需扩展覆盖更多样化医疗需求的评测，并按具体场景选择模型；InclusionMed 期望通过开放协作与社区贡献，让全球多样化医疗需求参与界定和衡量医学 AI 的进展。

title: System 1 agents: a method for local, reliable and fast agentic AI
comment: 18 pages, 5 figures, 9 tables. Code and data: https://github.com/eltzanis/SystemOneAgents
summary: Agentic artificial intelligence could automate analyses of sensitive clinical data, but current agents depend on large language models (LLMs). Cloud LLMs expose patient data. Local LLMs hallucinate, and an invented value in a tool call propagates through every later step. Here we present a method to build System 1 agents: local agents that call tools without generating text. A deterministic compiler turns each tool's schema and the request into multiple-choice questions whose options come from the request and the schema, then a one-pass decision model answers them. On 1,952 requests to 157 biomedical tools, the best System 1 agent chose the right tool, or correctly declined, for 97.0% of requests, significantly ahead of all 18 local LLM-agent settings (best 95.2%). The System 1 agent filled 97.0% of 6,056 stated argument values. No System 1 call contained invented content, against 5.5-19.7% of LLM calls. The System 1 Agents framework is freely available as open-source software at https://github.com/eltzanis/SystemOneAgents.

AI.tldr: 提出"System 1智能体"框架：用确定性编译器将工具模式与请求转为多选题，由单次决策模型作答，从而在不生成文本的情况下本地调用工具，实现零虚构、高准确率的生物医学工具调用。
AI.motivation: 临床数据分析自动化需要智能体，但现有智能体依赖大语言模型：云端LLM存在患者隐私泄露风险；本地LLM易产生幻觉，且工具调用中杜撰的数值会在后续步骤中逐级传播，造成错误累积。
AI.method: 确定性编译器将每个工具的schema与用户请求转换为多项选择题，选项来自请求与schema本身；随后由一个单次（one-pass）决策模型选择答案，全程不生成自由文本，即本地"System 1"式工具调用。
AI.result: 在157个生物医学工具、1,952条请求上，最佳System 1智能体的工具选择或正确拒答率达97.0%，显著优于全部18种本地LLM智能体配置（最佳95.2%）；在6,056个明确给出的参数值中填充正确率97.0%；System 1调用无任何虚构内容，而LLM调用虚构率为5.5%–19.7%。
AI.conclusion: 通过"判别式选择"替代"生成式输出"可有效消除工具调用中的虚构，并在准确率上超越本地LLM智能体；框架以开源软件形式发布（GitHub: eltzanis/SystemOneAgents）。

title: Hivemind: A Federated Protocol for AI-Mediated Tacit Knowledge Sharing in Organisations
summary: This paper presents Hivemind, a federated protocol that enables AI agents to exchange tacit knowledge on behalf of their users, asynchronously and without requiring any direct human interaction. Individual AI memory systems capture the decisions, reasoning, and contextual knowledge that surface during AI-assisted work. Hivemind creates the shared space in which this captured knowledge can flow between individuals across team and departmental boundaries, addressing a structural gap that neither centralised knowledge repositories nor existing AI tooling closes, even where partial solutions such as expert-finding systems exist. The paper evaluates centralised versus decentralised design approaches, proposes a federated architecture grounded in Nonaka and Takeuchi's (1995) Socialisation, Externalisation, Combination and Internalisation (SECI) model, and demonstrates a proof-of-concept implementation using Design Science Research (DSR) methodology. Measuring the enterprise benefit of federated tacit expertise sharing remains an open task for future work.

AI.tldr: 提出Hivemind——一个使AI智能体可代表用户异步交换隐性知识的联邦协议，基于SECI模型给出架构与原型验证。
AI.motivation: 个体AI记忆系统已能捕获AI辅助工作中产生的决策、推理与情境知识，但这类知识无法跨越个人、团队与部门边界流动。集中式知识库与现有AI工具均未填补这一结构性空白，专家发现系统等仅为局部方案。
AI.method: 比较集中式与去中心化设计路径，提出以Nonaka与Takeuchi（1995）SECI模型（社会化、外化、组合化、内化）为理论基础的联邦架构，并采用设计科学研究（DSR）方法论实现概念验证原型；全程无需直接人际交互，由智能体异步代行知识交换。
AI.result: 完成集中式与去中心化方案的对比评估，给出基于SECI的联邦架构设计，并通过DSR方法交付可运行的概念验证实现。
AI.conclusion: Hivemind在架构层面填补了跨边界隐性知识共享的空白；联邦式隐性专长共享的企业收益度量仍是未来工作，该方案的企业级价值尚未量化。

title: Advancing Cognitive Pairwise Comparisons for Human-Centric Artificial Intelligence and Data Science: A Human-in-the-Loop Framework
comment: 33 pages, 19 tables, 8 figures; interactive web demos available at https://kkfyuen.github.io/cpcHCADDemos ; source code and datasets at https://github.com/kkfyuen/cpcHCADDemos ; archived at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23434993 ; earlier preprint version available at SSRN 4048692 (http://dx.doi.org/10.2139/ssrn.4048692 or https://ssrn.com/abstract=4048692)
summary: Human-centric artificial intelligence and data science (HCAD) systems increasingly involve human-in-the-loop (HITL) interventions to overcome the limitations of fully automated machine learning algorithms, such as automation bias and the inability to incorporate tacit domain knowledge, and continuously improve predictive performance. Data transformations, feature selection, feature weighting, and model selection usually require laborious human involvement across iterations of artificial intelligence and data science (AI&DS) pipelines, making development a challenging and time-consuming process. The Cognitive Pairwise Comparison (CPC) framework is proposed as a human-centric methodology to elicit preferences and priorities in a structured format. To establish essential facets of human-centricity, this research advances the CPC methodology so that user preference elicitation can be systematically quantified in these challenging AI&DS tasks. To demonstrate the usability and validity of these facets, this study presents several applications within movie recommender systems using the MovieLens dataset. It exemplifies how the extended CPC framework can facilitate interactions between human judgments and data across supervised learning, dimensionality reduction, and unsupervised learning algorithms.

AI.tldr: 提出并扩展认知两两比较（CPC）框架，作为以人为中心的方法论，用结构化格式系统量化用户偏好，以支持人类在环（HITL）的AI与数据科学任务。
AI.motivation: 全自动机器学习存在自动化偏见、难以纳入隐性领域知识等局限，需引入人类在环干预；而数据变换、特征选择、特征加权与模型选择等环节通常需大量人工参与，开发过程耗时且困难，缺乏系统化的偏好量化手段。
AI.method: 以CPC框架为基础进行方法学扩展，使用户偏好获取可被系统量化；并在MovieLens数据集上的电影推荐系统中开展多个应用，考察其能支持监督学习、降维与无监督学习算法中人类判断与数据之间的交互。
AI.result: 通过多个电影推荐场景的应用，展示了扩展CPC框架在可用性与有效性方面的表现，并说明其可促进人类判断与数据在多种学习范式中的协同交互。
AI.conclusion: 扩展后的CPC框架可作为以人为中心AI&DS流程中偏好量化的可行工具，为人机协同的数据科学与建模任务提供结构化、可验证的方法支撑。

title: Agent-Guided Configuration Tuning for SMT Solvers
summary:
SMT solvers expose many configuration choices that determine how well their existing algorithms perform on a workload. We present, to our knowledge, the first workflow that uses general-purpose LLM agents to tune SMT solver configurations. Agents read solver documentation, source code, and persistent experiment records to propose option changes, and a deterministic harness measures each proposal, validates the returned models, and selects changes separately for each competition Division. Over roughly nine weeks, our tuning campaign recorded 4,545 proposals for cvc5 across 13 Divisions and 36 logics.
  We evaluate the tuned configurations on the 2026 and 2025 SMT-COMP ModelValidation benchmarks under a 24-second cutoff. On problems not used for training, they validate more problems than official cvc5 in ten of the 13 Divisions in 2026 and in eight in 2025, with geometric-mean gains of 7.8% and 6.8% across Divisions. On the complete official selections, which include training problems, the tuned floating-point counts exceed those of every individual competition participant in both years. Further studies show how configuration changes make existing algorithms effective by changing access to strategies, scheduling, and option compatibility, and how benchmark families trade off against one another. The agents' experiment traces contain hypothesis-based proposals in every tuning group, and 64.3% of the extracted hypotheses draw on prior measurements. These results show that agent-guided tuning can specialize a mature SMT solver and that accumulated experimental evidence informs sustained search.

AI.tldr: 提出首个基于通用LLM智能体的SMT求解器配置调优工作流，在cvc5的13个Division上开展约九周、4545次提议的调优实验，并在2025/2026 SMT-COMP ModelValidation基准上取得优于官方配置的模型验证性能。
AI.motivation: SMT求解器存在大量影响算法表现的配置选项，人工调优成本高且依赖专家经验；作者希望验证通用LLM智能体能否借助文档、源码与实验记录自动完成配置搜索与调优，使成熟求解器在特定赛题与逻辑上进一步专门化。
AI.method: 构建端到端的智能体调优工作流：智能体阅读求解器文档、源代码与持久化的实验记录，提出选项修改方案；确定性harness负责执行并度量每次提议、校验返回模型，并按competition Division分别选择配置。以cvc5为对象，在13个Division、36种logic上进行约九周的调优，共记录4545条提议；随后在24秒超时限制下于2026与2025年SMT-COMP ModelValidation基准上评估，并分析智能体实验轨迹中的假设及其证据来源。
AI.result: 在未参与训练的题目上，调优配置在2026年13个Division中的10个、2025年13个Division中的8个上比官方cvc5验证更多题目，Division间几何平均提升分别为7.8%和6.8%；在包含训练题目的完整官方题集上，调优后的浮点类计数在两年均超过任何单个竞赛参赛者。进一步分析表明，配置调整主要通过改变策略可及性、调度方式与选项兼容性使既有算法生效，并揭示不同基准族之间的权衡关系；每个调优组均出现基于假设的提议，抽取出的假设中有64.3%引用了先前的测量结果。
AI.conclusion: 智能体引导的调优能够对成熟的SMT求解器实现专门化配置并带来可测的性能增益；持久积累的实验证据支撑了持续、有依据的搜索过程，说明LLM智能体可作为求解器配置自动调优的可行手段。

title: A Structural Framework for Succession: Continuation, Recognition, and Realization
summary: Succession asks whether an entity encountered later is the same entity that entered an arrangement earlier. For an artificial system that is fine-tuned, distilled, or copied, it has to be answered. We look for a mathematical structure weak enough to cover any such case and strong enough to support general theorems, so that results follow from the structure's conditions rather than from a particular pipeline or criterion. Succession is modeled on state/modification graphs with relational lifts that compose along paths. Within this framework we separate four questions that are often conflated: which continuations a representation admits, which descendants are compatible with a modification, which are recognized as continuing the identity, and which are realized. The framework allows one to address systematically questions of symmetry, computational complexity, recoverability, and robustness to partial realization, and we establish what the structure settles in each case before any particular criterion of identity is chosen.

AI.tldr: 论文提出以状态/修改图及沿路径复合的关系提升为骨架的"继承"（succession）形式框架，用以统一处理微调、蒸馏、复制等人工系统中的同一性问题。
AI.motivation: 人工系统经微调、蒸馏或复制后，需回答"后遇到的实体是否就是先前进入某安排的同一实体"。作者希望找到一个既足够弱以覆盖各类情形、又足够强以支撑一般性定理的数学结构，使结论来自结构条件而非特定流水线或判据。
AI.method: 将继承建模在状态/修改图上，配备可沿路径复合的关系提升（relational lifts）；并在框架内区分四类常被混淆的问题：表示所允许的延续、与某修改相容的后代、被识别为延续同一性的后代、以及被实际实现的后代。
AI.result: 框架可系统处理对称性、计算复杂度、可恢复性以及对部分实现的鲁棒性等问题；作者明确了在尚未选定任何具体同一性判据之前，该结构本身能在各类问题上确定什么。
AI.conclusion: 通过一个弱而通用的结构，可将人工系统继承问题分解为四个层次清晰的问题，并使相关定理与复杂度结果由结构条件推出，而非依赖特定判据或流水线。

title: Behavioral Assurance for Socially Deployed AI Agents
summary: AI agents are increasingly deployed in socially consequential settings, yet existing evaluations provide limited assurance that they behave consistently with their intended characteristics across diverse interactions. We introduce an evaluation framework for measuring the behavioral consistency of socially deployed AI agents. The framework operationalizes agent behavior along five measurable axes and uses a standardized evaluation battery spanning six socially salient interaction settings to assess behavioral differentiation, consistency, and drift. Controlled persona configurations serve as experimental anchors, enabling systematic testing of whether intended behavioral differences persist across contexts rather than appearing only as stylistic variation. Preliminary analyses demonstrate measurable differentiation across configurations and suggest associations between behavioral profiles and interaction outcomes. By shifting the focus from persona design to behavioral assurance, this work provides a foundation for evaluating whether socially deployed AI agents behave as intended, consistently and measurably, across the situations in which users encounter them.

AI.tldr: 提出一个评估框架，用五个可测量维度与六个社会性交互场景的标准化测评组，衡量社会部署AI智能体的行为一致性、区分度与漂移。
AI.motivation: AI智能体日益部署于具有社会后果的场景，但现有评估无法保证其在多样交互中始终表现出一致且符合设计意图的行为特征；研究重心需从人格设定（persona design）转向行为保证（behavioral assurance）。
AI.method: 构建行为一致性评估框架：将智能体行为操作化为五个可测量轴；采用覆盖六个社会显著性交互场景的标准化测评组；以受控人格配置作为实验锚点，系统检验预期行为差异是否跨情境持续存在，而非仅表现为风格变化。
AI.result: 初步分析显示不同配置间存在可测量的行为区分度，并提示行为画像与交互结果之间存在关联。
AI.conclusion: 通过从人格设计转向行为保证，该工作为评估社会部署AI智能体能否在用户实际遭遇的各类情境中一致且可测量地按预期行为提供了基础。

title: Evidence-Conditioned Completion and Synthesis of Electronic Health Records
summary: Patient information can guide electronic health record (EHR) generation, but how its amount shapes predictive utility and disclosure risk remains poorly characterized. Here we present EHRDiB, which unifies visit completion and synthesis by distinguishing original missingness from withheld inputs and combining a shared multimodal representation with an evidence-conditioned latent diffusion bridge. We compared EHRDiB with three completion and eight synthesis methods on MIMIC-IV and numerical and discretized Duke Health representations. Evaluation covered downstream predictive utility, generative diversity, and distributional fidelity for both tasks, and disclosure risk for synthesis. EHRDiB achieved the smallest utility gaps from real-data-trained classifiers in seven of eight completion comparisons. In synthesis, AUPRC gaps were 45.2% smaller for ten MIMIC-IV principal-diagnosis targets and 53.3% smaller for numerical Duke Health data relative to the best comparator. Synthesis with calibrated thresholding yielded the lowest marginal distribution error across all three datasets, with Coverage above 0.95 for both output rules. Across twelve evidence-fraction intervals in MIMIC-IV synthesis, membership-inference AUROC increased from 0.516 to 0.598 as the mean target evidence fraction rose from 0.20 to 0.50; utility gaps narrowed relative to the lowest evidence configuration but did not decrease monotonically. Our study provides a unified framework and empirical foundation for EHR generation that considers both its utility for clinical analysis and its information disclosure risk.

AI.tldr: 提出EHRDiB统一框架，同时处理EHR补全与合成任务，系统刻画输入信息量对预测效用与披露风险的影响。
AI.motivation: 患者信息可指导EHR生成，但其信息量如何影响预测效用与披露风险尚缺乏刻画；补全与合成任务通常被分开研究。
AI.method: EHRDiB通过区分原始缺失与人为保留输入来统一访视补全与合成，结合共享多模态表示与证据条件化潜在扩散桥（latent diffusion bridge）。在MIMIC-IV及Duke Health的数值与离散化表示上，与3种补全方法和8种合成方法比较，评估下游预测效用、生成多样性、分布保真度及合成披露风险。
AI.result: 补全任务中8组比较有7组获得与真实数据训练分类器最小的效用差距；合成中相对最佳对比方法，MIMIC-IV十个主诊断目标AUPRC差距缩小45.2%，Duke Health数值数据缩小53.3%；校准阈值合成在三数据集上边际分布误差最低，两种输出规则Coverage均>0.95。MIMIC-IV合成中12个证据比例区间内，平均目标证据比例从0.20升至0.50时，成员推断AUROC由0.516升至0.598；效用差距相对最低证据配置收窄但非单调下降。
AI.conclusion: 研究提供了兼顾临床分析效用与信息披露风险的统一EHR生成框架与实证基础；更多证据提升效用同时增大披露风险。

title: LLM Trading Agents Earn Beta, Not Alpha: A Look-Ahead-Free Benchmark
comment: 23 pages, 10 figures, 15 tables. Code, frozen markets and leaderboard: https://github.com/jackson-cmd/risk-aware-trading-agents. Original empirical study: a backtest benchmark for LLM trading agents and measurements from 91 runs of six models
summary: Large language model (LLM) trading agents now trade stocks for their users, and benchmarks rank models by their agents' returns. Yet a single run's return says little about skill. In our study, two runs of the same model that differed only in the random seed ended 5.2 points apart on average, so telling skill from luck takes many backtests across markets, models and seeds. However, live arenas trade each day only once, and backtests either use the few months after a model's training cutoff or run on years the model may remember, often with news joined to prices by calendar date. In this paper, we present rta-bench-1, a backtest over three US markets (a rally, a bear market and a crash). It shows each headline only after its publication minute, plays each period blind and named, and checks every run for look-ahead. It also splits each return into factor exposure and alpha and scores every decision against random choices of the same day and sector. In 91 runs of six models from four vendors, no alpha was significant, market and style exposure accounted for a median 78% of the return, and the decisions did no better than random stocks of the same sector. The agents bought the stocks with the most positive news, yet in ablations they earned as much without their headlines. Still, the agents carried out rules reliably, since a single cash rule in the prompt cut a GPT-based agent's share in stocks by 30.3 points in all six pairs. Builders should therefore supply the edge themselves and report exposures and alpha, and benchmarks should replay news by publication time.

AI.tldr: 本文提出回测基准 rta-bench-1（覆盖三段美股行情），将收益拆分为因子暴露与 alpha，并与同日同行业随机选股对照，发现六个模型的 91 次运行中 alpha 均不显著，收益中位数 78% 来自市场与风格暴露。
AI.motivation: LLM 交易智能体已用于实际选股，但基准仅以单次收益排名模型；同一模型仅改变随机种子，两次运行平均相差 5.2 个百分点，说明单次收益难以区分能力与运气。而实盘竞技场每天只交易一次，现有回测又只覆盖训练截止后的少数月份、或模型可能"记住"的历史年份，且常按日历日期把新闻与价格拼接，存在前视偏差与数据泄漏风险。
AI.method: 构建 rta-bench-1 回测：(1) 覆盖三个美股市场阶段（上涨、熊市、崩盘）；(2) 新闻仅在其发布分钟后可见；(3) 每个时段分别以"盲测"和"命名"方式播放；(4) 对每次运行进行前视偏差检查；(5) 将收益分解为因子暴露与 alpha；(6) 将每个决策与同日同行业随机选股对比；(7) 进行消融实验（去除新闻标题）与提示词规则遵循性测试。
AI.result: 四个厂商六个模型共 91 次运行：无任何 alpha 显著；市场与风格暴露中位数占收益的 78%；选股决策不优于同行业随机选股；智能体倾向买入新闻最正面的股票，但消融实验中移除标题后收益相当；智能体对规则执行可靠——提示词中单条现金规则使基于 GPT 的智能体持股比例在全部六组配对中下降 30.3 个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 构建者应自行提供真实 edge，并报告因子暴露与 alpha；基准应按新闻发布时间回放新闻，而非按日历日期拼接，以避免前视偏差并正确评估模型能力。

title: Confidence Without Cause: Predicting and Localizing Physics-Shortcut Sensitivity in Language Model Hidden States
summary: A language model's confidence on a physics problem deserves trust only if it ignores details irrelevant to the answer.
