AI.motivation: 环境结构直接界定智能体可习得能力的上界。然而现有结构化与检索环境依赖上游预过滤：围绕金答案抽取紧凑子图、或在策略行动前检索固定段落。这种预过滤造成根本性的测量混淆——逐问题的子图包含真值路径，使候选空间被压缩数个数量级，并通过局部拓扑泄漏答案位置，导致一个与问题无关的度数启发式就能以远高于随机的方式命中金答案。因此，路径选择、候选剪枝与最优停止并非真正的策略决策，所测得的"能力"被高估。
AI.method: RISE（Interactive Structured Environment）沿两条耦合轴展开：(1) 决策空间扩展（Decision-Space Scaling）：以图无关的五阶段类型化意图适配器暴露未剪枝的完整知识图谱，并施加有界调用预算与乘性grounding奖励门控；(2) 学习前沿扩展（Learning-Frontier Scaling）：针对组归一化目标下的组内方差坍缩问题，将模型无关的结构层级推进与自演化能力前沿bandit相结合。
AI.result: 在19个基准、3种模型骨干上，RISE在域内与未见schema的知识图谱推理上大幅提升；零样本迁移至开放域段落检索；并显著增强域外数学与逻辑推理。
AI.conclusion: 上游预过滤会以测量混淆的方式虚化结构化RL的评测与学习信号；恢复全尺度交互式数据库并将候选空间、路径选择与停止决策真正交给策略，可带来更强的知识图推理、跨环境零样本迁移与非结构化推理的泛化收益。

title: MAPS: A Multimodal Agentic Framework for POI Data Production Based on Crowdsourced Street-view Imagery
comment: Accepted for presentation at the 33rd ACM SIGKDD Conference on Knowledge Discovery and Data Mining (KDD 2027), Cycle 1
summary: Point-of-interest (POI) databases support location-based services, yet urban changes quickly make their records stale and manual maintenance is costly. Crowdsourced street-view images provide timely visual evidence, but converting them into database actions requires separating multiple POIs and irrelevant text in each image, then resolving incomplete observations against ambiguous records. We study Street-view Image-based POI Data Production and propose MAPS, the first framework to integrate structured POI extraction with database maintenance from such imagery. MAPS contains two cascaded modules. SPICE progressively adapts a lightweight vision-language model to reconstruct and filter text, group entries belonging to the same POI, and classify their semantics and completeness. RIMA retrieves candidate records, performs evidence-grounded POI matching and attribute-level reasoning, and selectively acquires complementary visual, geospatial, or external-source evidence when necessary. In human-reviewed full-task evaluation, MAPS outperforms the strongest baseline by 21.8\%. MAPS has also been deployed in Kuaishou's large-scale POI production pipeline, reducing average processing time by 76.9\% relative to manual annotation. These results demonstrate the effectiveness and practical value of MAPS for scalable POI maintenance.

AI.tldr: MAPS 是首个将街景图像结构化 POI 抽取与数据库维护一体化的框架，由 SPICE 与 RIMA 两个级联模块组成，全任务评测超最强基线 21.8%，并在快手大规模 POI 生产管线中较人工标注缩短 76.9% 处理时间。
AI.motivation: POI 数据库支撑位置服务，但城市快速变化导致记录过时，人工维护成本高。众包街景图像虽提供及时视觉证据，但需解决单张图像中多 POI 与无关文本的分离，以及不完整观测与模糊记录的匹配消解，现有工作缺乏端到端的解决方案。
AI.method: MAPS 含两个级联模块：SPICE 渐进式适配轻量视觉语言模型，完成文本重建与过滤、同一 POI 条目聚合、语义与完整性分类；RIMA 检索候选记录，执行证据锚定的 POI 匹配与属性级推理，并在必要时主动获取互补的视觉、地理空间或外部来源证据。
AI.result: 在人工评审的全任务评测中，MAPS 较最强基线提升 21.8%；已部署于快手大规模 POI 生产管线，相较人工标注平均处理时间降低 76.9%。
AI.conclusion: MAPS 验证了街景图像驱动的 POI 抽取与库维护一体化方案的可行性与实用价值，可作为可扩展的 POI 更新手段。

title: Agentic On-Policy Distillation Implicitly Reshapes LLMs' ReAct Patterns
summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) transfers specialized capabilities to language-model agents, but its cross-domain effects on interaction remain unclear. We investigate how OPD reshapes ReAct interaction patterns across mathematics, ALFWorld, and $τ^2$-bench, focusing on reasoning, actions, and observation acquisition. General-reasoning supervision reduces mathematical tool attempts from 70.4% to 14.4% while increasing accuracy from 16.7% to 38.0%; code-interpreter supervision improves household actions and retail queries. In contrast, ALFWorld supervision reduces $τ^2$-bench accuracy from 41.5% to 6.6%, accompanied by frequent tool calls that violate user-information dependencies. To address negative transfer using only source-domain training trajectories, we explore selective OPD guided by teacher preference changes before and after domain-specific RL. Retaining the top 95% of positions raises $τ^2$ accuracy from 11.5% to 29.9% with a source-learning trade-off.

AI.tldr: 论文研究 on-policy distillation（OPD）对语言模型 agent 的 ReAct 交互模式的跨域影响，并提出基于 teacher 偏好变化的选择性 OPD 以缓解负迁移。
AI.motivation: OPD 能将专业能力迁移给语言模型 agent，但其对交互行为（推理、动作、观察获取）的跨域影响尚不清楚，且存在负迁移风险，需要在不使用目标域数据的前提下加以缓解。
AI.method: 在数学、ALFWorld 与 τ²-bench 三个域上对比 OPD 前后的 ReAct 交互轨迹；分析工具调用、动作选择与信息依赖行为；并利用领域特定 RL 前后 teacher 偏好变化来筛选蒸馏位置，仅保留 top 95% 位置进行选择性 OPD。
AI.result: 通用推理监督使数学工具尝试率由 70.4% 降至 14.4%，准确率由 16.7% 升至 38.0%；code-interpreter 监督改善家务动作与零售查询；ALFWorld 监督使 τ²-bench 准确率从 41.5% 跌至 6.6%，并伴随违反用户信息依赖的频繁工具调用；选择性 OPD 在仅用源域轨迹下将 τ² 准确率由 11.5% 提升至 29.9%，但以源域学习效果为代价。
AI.conclusion: OPD 的跨域效应具有方向性与任务依赖性，既能修正过度工具调用也能引发严重负迁移；基于 teacher 偏好变化的选择性蒸馏可有效缓解负迁移，但需权衡源域性能。

title: When AI Agents Should Repair, Replan, or Abandon: A Threshold Theory of Plan Commitment
summary: AI agents often discover mid-execution that their plan is broken, for example when an action fails or a tool is withdrawn. Deployed systems use conventions such as retry loops or "always replan," and a recent benchmark finds no fixed strategy dominates. This paper derives the optimal policy. In the model, a disruption destroys the causal support of part of a plan; repair is a partial reset that preserves the plan's structure, replanning is a full reset, and changing a plan is costly because others have conditioned on it. The optimal policy is a threshold in effective disruption depth: repair shallow damage, replan after deep damage, and abandon the goal when even a fresh plan is not worth its cost. Depth depends on plan structure. In expectation, a single broken action forces 1+R(G)/n actions to be revalidated, where R(G) counts the pairs of actions joined by a dependency path; to first order, a fully serial plan switches to replanning at raw damage about w times smaller than a plan of w parallel chains. A closed-form stability-price threshold determines when a worse repaired plan should be kept over a better fresh one. As language-model planners push replanning costs toward zero, the stability price becomes the only force sustaining plan commitment. Under repeated disruptions, revision frictions make commitment hysteresis optimal: the agent keeps executing a plan it would never choose fresh, and each repair adds patch debt until the debt outweighs repair's cost advantage and the agent rebuilds. A value-of-diagnosis result states when measuring damage is worth its compute and shows that "always replan" is optimal when damage is predictably deep and replanning is the better fallback. A separately implemented numerical checker tests each proposition (zero violations; 1.6 million static-model evaluations), and the model's regime map reproduces that benchmark's regime flips qualitatively.

AI.tldr: 论文为执行中被破坏的AI agent规划推导最优修复策略：以"有效破坏深度"为阈值，浅层损伤做部分重置(repair)、深层损伤做完全重置(replan)、若新计划也不值其成本则放弃目标；并给出稳定性价格阈值、承诺迟滞与"诊断价值"结果。
AI.motivation: AI agent在执行中常发现计划已失效（动作失败、工具被撤回）。现有系统依赖重试循环或"总是重规划"等约定，且已有基准显示没有固定策略占优，因此需要理论上的最优策略。
AI.method: 建立形式化模型：破坏摧毁部分计划的因果支撑；repair为保留计划结构的部分重置，replan为完全重置，改计划因他人已依赖而产生成本。对期望重验证动作数、串行/并行计划结构、稳定性价格阈值、重复破坏下的修复摩擦与patch debt、诊断价值逐一推导命题，并用独立数值检查器验证。
AI.result: 最优策略是有效破坏深度的阈值策略；期望上单个失效动作迫使1+R(G)/n个动作被重验证（R(G)为依赖路径连接的动作对数），一阶上全串行计划比w条并行链的计划在原始损伤约小w倍时即切换到replan；闭式稳定性价格阈值决定何时保留较差的修复计划；重复破坏下承诺迟滞最优，patch debt累积到超过repair成本优势时重建；"总是重规划"在损伤可预期地深且replan是更好回退时最优。数值检查零违例（160万次静态模型评估），regime map定性复现基准的regime翻转。
AI.conclusion: 计划修复/重规划的取舍可由破坏深度阈值与稳定性价格统一刻画；随LLM规划器使重规划成本趋零，稳定性价格成为维持计划承诺的唯一力量，为agent系统设计提供可操作准则。

title: Learning inadequacy of Bayesian neural operators for PDE-constrained inference and design
summary: Partial differential equations (PDEs) underpin predictive modeling across science, engineering and medicine. Their use in digital twins, parameter inference and optimal design requires repeated solutions across parameters and scenarios. For nonlinear, transient and multiphysics systems, these calculations can make numerical simulation prohibitively expensive. Here we introduce the residual-informed Bayesian neural operator (RI-BNO), which learns operator inadequacy using a posteriori error estimates from the governing PDEs and incorporates its correction and uncertainty into Bayesian training and prediction. We establish local error bounds for the residual-informed estimates under stability and smoothness assumptions. We demonstrate RI-BNO on a non-linear reaction-diffusion benchmark with DeepONet and latent-subspace architectures, Markov chain Monte Carlo inference of glioma parameter fields from magnetic resonance imaging, and Monte Carlo risk-averse optimization of three-dimensional thermal breaks in building envelopes under manufacturing uncertainty. Across the evaluated examples, RI-BNO improves agreement with finite element (FE) reference predictions, parameter posteriors and optimized designs while using half as many full nonlinear or transient training simulations as the vanilla Bayesian neural operator (vBNO). For thermal break design, online optimization time decreases from 178 hours with the FE model to 18 minutes with RI-BNO. These results demonstrate the value of explicit inadequacy modeling in neural operators for reliable PDE-based inference and design.

AI.tldr: 本文提出残差知情贝叶斯神经算子（RI-BNO），利用控制PDE的先验/后验误差估计显式建模算子不适定性，并将其修正与不确定性纳入贝叶斯训练与预测，在保证精度的同时将所需全非线性/瞬态仿真次数减半。
AI.motivation: 数字孪生、参数推断与优化设计需要跨参数与场景反复求解PDE；对非线性、瞬态与多物理场系统，传统数值仿真代价过高，而现有贝叶斯神经算子未显式刻画算子本身的不适定性（模型误差），难以保证可靠性。
AI.method: 提出RI-BNO：基于控制PDE的残差（后验误差估计）学习算子不适性，将误差修正与不确定性嵌入贝叶斯训练和预测流程；在稳定性与光滑性假设下建立局部误差界；在DeepONet与潜子空间架构上实现，并用于非线性反应-扩散基准、基于MRI的胶质瘤参数场MCMC推断、以及制造不确定性下三维建筑围护结构热断桥的蒙特卡洛风险规避优化。
AI.result: 在三个算例中，RI-BNO相对有限元（FE）参考解、参数后验与优化设计的一致性均优于vanilla贝叶斯神经算子（vBNO），且所需全非线性/瞬态训练仿真次数仅为后者的一半；热断桥设计中，在线优化时间由FE模型的178小时降至RI-BNO的18分钟。
AI.conclusion: 显式建模算子不适性可显著提升神经算子在PDE推断与设计中的可靠性，并大幅降低在线计算成本，为数字孪生与不确定性量化场景提供可行路径。

title: PEETS: Preference-aware Embeddings with Explicit Tree Structure for Auxiliary Product Bundling
summary: Auxiliary products such as flight protection and flexible-change services are recommended alongside primary travel purchases. This setting creates a granularity ambiguity: SKUs within one product type share semantics but differ in price and coverage, while rejecting one offer does not imply disinterest in the entire type. We present \textbf{PEETS} (\textbf{P}reference-aware \textbf{E}mbeddings with \textbf{E}xplicit \textbf{T}ree \textbf{S}tructure), a training-time framework for auxiliary product bundling. PEETS regularizes an existing click--conversion predictor through two conditional comparisons. Hierarchical Contrastive Loss uses the pair's common ancestor as a reference; Negative Contrastive Loss conditions structural sampling and comparison shifts on logged rejection events. Both act on shared SKU representations during training. This separates catalog relatedness from individual preference supervision and leaves the predictive serving path intact. PEETS achieves 78.20\% AUC, exceeding TWIN V2 by 0.90 percentage points and the matched base model by 1.15 points. In a 14-day online evaluation, gross auxiliary GMV per exposed user-day improves by 8.20\% over Policies, 3.06\% over Base, and 0.84\% over TWIN V2, with all three user-bootstrap 95\% intervals above zero. Bundling rate is 0.51 points below Policies. The cancellation interval's upper limit exceeds the prespecified margin. PEETS adds no auxiliary-loss computation to serving and records 42.1~ms p95 latency, compared with 42.0~ms for Base.

AI.tldr: 提出PEETS框架，通过两级对比损失正则化点击-转化预测器，解决辅助产品捆绑中的SKU粒度歧义问题，离线AUC提升、在线GMV提升，且不增加服务端计算。
AI.motivation: 辅助产品（如飞行保障、灵活变更服务）与主行程一同推荐时存在粒度歧义：同一产品类型内各SKU语义相似但价格与保障范围不同，且拒绝某一报价并不代表对整类产品不感兴趣。现有方法难以将“目录相关性”与“个体偏好监督”分离。
AI.method: PEETS（偏好感知嵌入+显式树结构）为训练期框架，通过两种条件对比对已有点击-转化预测器进行正则化：层次对比损失以样本对的共同祖先节点为参照；负对比损失基于已记录的拒绝事件调节结构采样与比较偏移。二者在训练期作用于共享SKU表示，从而分离目录相关性与个体偏好监督，而预测服务路径保持不变。
AI.result: 离线AUC达78.20%，较TWIN V2高0.90个百分点，较匹配基模型高1.15个百分点。14天在线评估中，每曝光用户日的辅助产品总GMV较Policies提升8.20%、较Base提升3.06%、较TWIN V2提升0.84%，三者的用户bootstrap 95%置信区间均高于零。捆绑率较Policies低0.51个百分点；取消率区间的上限超出预设边际。服务端未增加辅助损失计算，p95延迟42.1ms（Base为42.0ms）。
AI.conclusion: PEETS在不改变线上服务路径、几乎不增加延迟的前提下有效建模SKU层级结构与拒绝信号，显著提升辅助产品推荐的离线排序性能与在线GMV，但捆绑率略降且取消率指标未能通过预设边际检验，表明收益与体验风险需权衡。

title: AdMem: Expectation-Grounded Procedural Memory for Long-Horizon Task-Solving Agents
comment: 40th Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2026). Workshop: Agents in the Wild: Safety, Security, and Beyond
summary: An agent that carries memory across tasks is only as good as the entries it keeps. We begin from an observation that is easy to reproduce and uncomfortable for the field: naively accumulating cross-task experience can make an agent \emph{worse} than one with no memory at all. On AgentBoard, a workflow-induction memory solves fewer tasks than a memoryless ReAct agent in seven of eight domains, and a per-step procedural store with no surrounding structure loses half of ReAct's completions on Jericho. We argue that the missing ingredients are per-action credit assignment and an explicit life cycle for stored entries, and present AdMem, which supplies both. Before each action the actor commits to an expected outcome; a concurrently running critic scores the realized outcome against that expectation and writes a procedural entry carrying a binary reward and a reflection, so credit lands on the action that earned it and no environment reward is required. Each entry then carries a scalar utility, updated online under a noisy-OR reward model, that ranks retrieval jointly with context similarity and drives eviction and merging, giving the store a forgetting and consolidation policy instead of unbounded growth. Across 707 tasks in eight AgentBoard domains AdMem solves 441 against 388 for ReAct and 312 for the workflow-induction baseline --- a pooled gain significant under a two-sided Fisher exact test, concentrated in the domains that supply transferable cross-task structure. All memory stays human-readable text, which is what makes the failures above diagnosable --- and, as we discuss, also makes the store an auditable but attackable surface.

AI.tldr: 提出 AdMem：为跨任务记忆智能体引入逐动作信用分配与显式生命周期（效用打分、检索/淘汰/合并策略），在 AgentBoard 八个域 707 个任务上取得 441 成功，显著优于 ReAct（388）与工作流归纳记忆基线（312），并指出纯文本记忆同时带来可审计性与可攻击性。
AI.motivation: 朴素累积跨任务经验反而可能使智能体比无记忆更差：AgentBoard 上工作流归纳记忆在 8 个域中有 7 个不及无记忆 ReAct；Jericho 上无结构逐步程序存储使完成数减半。作者认为缺失的关键是逐动作信用分配与存储条目的显式生命周期管理。
AI.method: AdMem：执行前由 actor 承诺预期结果；并发 critic 将实际结果与该预期比对打分，写入含二元奖励与反思的程序性条目，使信用落到具体动作且无需环境奖励。每条目携带标量效用，在 noisy-OR 奖励模型下在线更新，与上下文相似度联合用于检索排序，并驱动淘汰与合并，形成遗忘与巩固策略而非无限增长。
AI.result: AgentBoard 八个域 707 题中解决 441 题，对比 ReAct 388、工作流归纳基线 312；池化增益在双侧 Fisher 精确检验下显著，且集中于可提供可迁移跨任务结构的域。
AI.conclusion: 记忆质量取决于信用分配与生命周期管理；AdMem 以文本形式保存全部记忆，既使上述失败可诊断、存储可审计，同时也构成可被攻击的表面，作者对此进行了讨论。

title: ToolGraph as a Q-Function for Test-Time Scaling of Tool-Use Agents
comment: 40th Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2026). Workshop: From Pretrained Representations to Acting Agents (PTA)
summary: Tool-use agents must chain interdependent calls, yet which outputs satisfy which later inputs in a deployed catalog is not something a general-purpose language model reliably infers from tool descriptions alone. We compile that structure once into a reusable external representation. ToolGraph is a directed, weighted dependency graph over a tool catalog: parameter matching and interventional probes, which execute a candidate chain with and without its proposed predecessor, propose edges whose evidence is combined into an edge confidence. Prior work uses such graphs to retrieve tools, search for tool paths, or score the next call. We ask instead whether the same structure can supply a \emph{multi-step} value by composing graph paths into a goal-conditioned action value \(Q(s,a,g)\). We study three estimators (dynamic programming over entity sets, a GraphSAGE estimator distilled from it, and an LLM scorer conditioned on graph evidence) plus a verbalizer that returns action--goal feedback to the agent, which keeps final action selection. Across two tool-use benchmarks and three backbones, we compare value ranking against personalized-PageRank retrieval over the identical graph, and against direct and reflective agents. Composition pays off only when the estimator also reads the concrete state: the LLM estimator improves on PageRank in every benchmark--backbone setting, by \(8.3\) points on average, while the two purely structural estimators fall below it, because a value defined over tool types cannot separate a correct tool called with a wrong argument. Graph construction is a one-time cost; we report it separately rather than assume it amortized away (at our scale it is comparable to request-time cost) and sweep four knobs controlling how much graph evidence to expose against success and tokens.

AI.tldr: 将工具目录编译为有向加权依赖图ToolGraph，并用能读取具体状态的LLM估计器把图中路径组合成目标条件动作价值Q(s,a,g)，引导多步工具调用。
AI.motivation: 通用大模型难以仅凭工具描述可靠推断"哪个工具输出能满足哪个后续工具的输入"；既有工作只把工具依赖图用于检索、路径搜索或下一调用打分，未挖掘其多步价值。
AI.method: 构建ToolGraph：基于参数匹配与干预式探针（在有/无候选前驱时执行链）提出边并融合为边置信度。在图上实现三种价值估计器（实体集动态规划、由其蒸馏的GraphSAGE、以图证据为条件的LLM打分器），外加一个把动作-目标反馈返回给代理的verbalizer（最终动作选择仍由代理负责）。在两个工具使用基准、三个骨干模型上，与同一图上的personalized-PageRank检索及直接/反思型代理对比，并扫描四个控制图证据暴露量的旋钮。
AI.result: LLM估计器在所有基准-骨干组合上均优于PageRank，平均提升8.3分；两种纯结构估计器则低于PageRank，因定义在工具类型上的价值无法区分"正确工具+错误参数"。图构建为一次性开销，在实验规模下与请求时开销相当，故单独报告而非假定可摊销。
AI.conclusion: 图结构的组合式价值只有在估计器同时读取具体状态时才有收益；工具类型的抽象不足，需状态条件化。图构建成本与证据暴露量-成功率-令牌数的权衡需显式核算。

title: Revisiting What Makes a Good Context Subset: A Sparse Latent Basis Perspective
comment: 17 pages, 2 figures. The format of ACL rolling review
summary: Selecting context subsets is increasingly important in modern LLM inference, yet what makes a subset effective remains unclear. We study this question in the controlled setting of few-shot demonstration selection. We examine a hypothesis that demonstrations should collectively provide task-relevant information needed by a target query. Assuming that the query representation provides a useful proxy for these requirements, we formulate selection as sparse reconstruction and instantiate it with Residual Explanation Search (RES), a Matching-Pursuit-style diagnostic procedure. Across seven benchmarks and eight open-weight LLMs, no retrieval objective is universally best. RES outperforms MMR in 34 of 56 model--dataset pairs, with its clearest advantage on sentiment tasks, suggesting that query-conditioned collective reconstruction may capture useful complementarity that pairwise dissimilarity misses. Relevance-based retrieval remains strong on template-heavy reasoning benchmarks, while all retrieval methods underperform zero-shot prediction on average on StrategyQA, where a solution-reconstruction analysis is consistent with the query not exposing the required external knowledge. Target-model hidden states further show that retrieval objectives interact differently with representation spaces: middle-layer representations generally favor similarity retrieval, whereas last-layer representations are often stronger for residual- and diversity-based selection. These findings support a conditional, representation-dependent account of context subset quality rather than a universally superior selector.

AI.tldr: 在few-shot示例选择这一受控设定下研究“什么样的上下文子集有效”，提出以查询表示为目标、将选择形式化为稀疏重建的RES（Residual Explanation Search）方法；结果表明不存在普遍最优的检索目标，选择器效果依赖任务类型与表示空间。
AI.motivation: 上下文子集选择在LLM推理中日益重要，但何种子集有效仍不清楚。作者希望检验一个假设：示例应集体提供目标查询所需的、与任务相关的信息，而非仅靠成对相似度或多样性来筛选。
AI.method: 将示例选择的假设刻画为：查询表示可作为其信息需求的代理，从而把选择问题形式化为稀疏重建，并用类匹配追踪的“残差解释搜索”（RES）作为诊断式实现；在7个基准、8个开放权重LLM上，与MMR、基于相关性的检索、零样本等进行对比，并分析不同层隐藏状态下的表现及StrategyQA上的“解重建”分析。
AI.result: 没有任何检索目标在所有设置下最优；RES在56个模型-数据集对中有34个优于MMR，在情感任务上优势最明显；相关性检索在模板化推理基准上仍较强；在StrategyQA上所有检索方法平均劣于零样本预测，解重建分析与“查询未暴露所需外部知识”一致；中层表示普遍偏好相似度检索，末层表示对残差/多样性选择更有利。
AI.conclusion: 应支持一种条件性、表示依赖的上下文子集质量观，而非追求普遍优越的选择器；查询条件化的集体重建可捕捉成对不相似度遗漏的互补性。

title: A Comparative Evaluation of BERT-Based and LLM-Based Models for Indic Sentence Similarity
summary: The relative effectiveness of BERT-based encoders and large language model (LLM)-based embeddings for Indic semantic textual similarity remains insufficiently characterized. We compare eight BERT-based and five LLM-based models on the 1,500-pair STS Benchmark development set translated into ten Indic languages and on the native Marathi MahaSTS test set. IndicSBERT achieves the highest Pearson correlation in all ten translated language sets, with a macro-average of 0.843, followed by BGE-M3 at 0.792. Harrier-270M is the strongest LLM-based model on translated STS-B, with a macro-average of 0.751. On MahaSTS, IndicSBERT and Bhasha-Embed-v0 achieve Pearson correlations of 0.901 and 0.900, respectively, while EmbeddingGemma leads the LLM-based models at 0.871. The highest-scoring BERT-based model thus exceeds the highest-scoring LLM-based model in both settings, although the magnitude of the difference varies across benchmarks. These findings indicate that LLM-derived embeddings do not uniformly improve Indic sentence similarity over established encoders and motivate evaluation that accounts for language coverage, task supervision, and benchmark construction.

AI.tldr: 该文系统比较8个BERT类编码器与5个LLM类嵌入模型在10种印度语言翻译版STS-B及马拉地语MahaSTS上的表现，发现IndicSBERT均最优（宏平均0.843；MahaSTS 0.901），优于最佳LLM模型，说明LLM嵌入并非普遍提升印度语言语义相似度。
AI.motivation: BERT类编码器与LLM类嵌入在印度语言语义文本相似度（STS）任务上的相对有效性尚缺乏充分刻画，需明确两类范式在低资源、多语言场景下的真实差距。
AI.method: 在翻译为10种印度语言的1500对STS Benchmark开发集及原生马拉地语MahaSTS测试集上，对8个BERT类模型与5个LLM类嵌入模型进行统一对比，以Pearson相关系数（含宏平均）为主要指标。
AI.result: 翻译STS-B上IndicSBERT在全部10个语言集中Pearson最高，宏平均0.843；BGE-M3次之0.792；最佳LLM模型Harrier-270M为0.751。MahaSTS上IndicSBERT（0.901）与Bhasha-Embed-v0（0.900）居前，LLM中EmbeddingGemma最佳（0.871）。两种设定下最高分BERT类模型均超过最高分LLM类模型，但差距幅度随基准而异。
AI.conclusion: LLM衍生嵌入并不能一致地提升印度语言句子相似度性能；后续评测应纳入语言覆盖度、任务监督信号与基准构建方式等维度。

title: SG-LegalClarify: A Large-Scale Benchmark for Legal Reasoning and Ambiguity Recognition in Singapore Law
summary: Singapore offers a distinctive testbed for legal reasoning by large language models (LLMs). Its legal system combines inherited English common law with jurisdiction-specific statutes, requiring models to distinguish local doctrine from generic common-law intuition. This setting also highlights the challenge of recognizing underspecification in lay legal queries, because the facts material to a legal outcome depend on the governing doctrine. Yet legal benchmarks rarely cover Singapore law or test this form of ambiguity recognition. To address these gaps, we introduce SG-LegalClarify, a large-scale benchmark for open-ended legal reasoning and ambiguity recognition in Singapore law. SG-LegalClarify contains 1,100 lawyer-authored source questions spanning 10 legal domains, including 340 fully specified and 760 underspecified questions. Each underspecified question has a fixed hidden-fact assignment and a fully specified counterpart, yielding 1,860 evaluation instances. Responses are graded with lawyer-authored Issue, Rule, Application, and Conclusion (IRAC) rubrics. We evaluate 19 LLMs, closed-book and with web search, using a multi-turn pipeline in which models decide whether to answer or clarify, and a user simulator reveals hidden facts only when asked. We find the benchmark far from saturated: the best models satisfy only 69.8% of mandatory rubric items closed-book (average 53.8%) and 77.8% with web search (average 63.0%). Models also struggle to recognize when clarification is necessary. We will release the public split of our benchmark, the model outputs on it, and the evaluation pipeline to support future research.

AI.tldr: 提出新加坡法律基准 SG-LegalClarify（1,100 道律师撰写题目、1,860 个评测实例），用于开放式法律推理与欠定问题识别；19 个 LLM 最高仅满足 69.8%（闭卷）/77.8%（联网）的必修评分项，且难以判断何时应澄清。
AI.motivation: 现有法律基准几乎不覆盖新加坡法，也缺乏对"外行查询欠定性（underspecification）识别"的测试。新加坡法兼采英国普通法与本地成文法，要求模型区分本地学说与一般普通法直觉，是检验该能力的理想试验台。
AI.method: 构建 SG-LegalClarify：1,100 道律师撰写源问题，覆盖 10 个法律领域，其中 340 道完全指定、760 道欠定；每个欠定题配有固定隐藏事实设定与完全指定的对应版本，共 1,860 个评测实例。采用律师撰写的 IRAC（Issue–Rule–Application–Conclusion）评分表打分；评测 19 个 LLM，设置闭卷与联网两种条件，使用多轮流程：模型自行决定作答或请求澄清，用户模拟器仅在被询问时披露隐藏事实。
AI.result: 基准远未饱和：最佳模型闭卷仅满足 69.8% 的必修评分项（平均 53.8%），联网为 77.8%（平均 63.0%）。模型在识别"何时需要澄清"方面同样表现不足。
AI.conclusion: 新加坡法场景对 LLM 法律推理构成实质性挑战，欠定识别是显著薄弱环节；作者将公开基准的公开划分、模型输出与评测流程以支持后续研究。

title: ROUNDS: Source-Framed Diagnostic Revision after Multi-Turn Clinical Evidence
comment: Accepted at Machine Learning for Health (ML4H) 2026, Proceedings Track; to appear in Proceedings of Machine Learning Research (PMLR). 17 pages
summary: Large language models (LLMs) achieve high scores on medical benchmarks, but does this performance translate into reliable diagnosis as a conversation unfolds? In diagnostic conversations, users can provide clinical findings across multiple turns, ask for a diagnosis without supplying answer options, and introduce opinions from others. Models must therefore form diagnoses from the available evidence and decide how to respond to subsequent advice. We introduce ROUNDS, a framework that evaluates these abilities after a fixed sequence of clinical evidence delivered over multiple turns. ROUNDS compares diagnosis with and without answer options, presents the same incorrect diagnosis under clinician and lay framing, and varies support for competing diagnoses in written five-clinician panels. Across seven models and 1,035 cases from five datasets, average accuracy was 76.9% with answer options and 57.0% without them. Clinician-framed misleading advice produced lower final accuracy than lay-framed advice in every model, with differences of 4.6 to 38.2 percentage points. Initially correct diagnoses more often became incorrect answers than abstentions, and many adopted the suggested disease. Conversely, accuracy increased as more panel members supported the correct diagnosis, including when the majority opinion remained unchanged. These findings reveal a gap between medical benchmark performance and reliable diagnosis in conversation: models respond to external opinions, but remain vulnerable to abandoning correct diagnoses without new clinical evidence.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ROUNDS框架，评估大语言模型在多轮诊断对话中的可靠性，揭示其"基准高分≠临床可靠"的差距。
AI.motivation: LLM在医学基准上得分高，但真实诊断是随对话展开的过程：用户会跨多轮提供临床线索、不带选项地请求诊断、并引入他人意见。现有基准无法刻画模型能否从证据中形成诊断，以及面对后续建议时如何回应，因此需要专门的对话式评估框架。
AI.method: 构建ROUNDS框架：按固定顺序在多个回合中投放临床证据，再检验四项能力——(1)有/无答案选项时的诊断表现；(2)同一错误诊断在"临床医生框架"与"外行框架"下呈现的差异；(3)由五位"临床医生"组成小组、对不同竞争诊断的支持度变化；(4)初始正确诊断在受到建议冲击后是否被放弃或转为弃答。实验覆盖7个模型、5个数据集的1,035个病例。
AI.result: 平均准确率：有选项76.9%，无选项57.0%。医生框架下的误导性建议在全部模型中都导致更低的最终准确率，差距为4.6至38.2个百分点。初始正确的诊断更常被改错而非弃答，且相当比例会采纳被建议的错误疾病。反之，支持正确诊断的小组成员越多，准确率越高，即便多数意见未改变时亦然。
AI.conclusion: 模型在医学基准上的表现无法转化为对话中的可靠诊断：它们会对外部意见敏感并随之调整，却缺乏在新临床证据缺失时坚守正确诊断的定力。这提示需要针对"抗建议干扰"与"弃答策略"进行改进与评估。

title: SemMask: Semantic-Prioritized Progressive Masking for Diffusion Language Models
summary: Diffusion Language Models (DLMs) are designed to enable globally parallel generation. However, in practice, they often exhibit pseudo-autoregressive behavior and a function-word-first bias, which undermines their performance on tasks such as text writing and code generation that benefit from global planning and parallel decoding. To address this, we propose SemMask, a novel fine-tuning paradigm that leverages a semantic-prioritized progressive masking strategy to encourage the model to decode high-information semantic tokens early and globally, thereby enhancing its global planning and parallel generation capabilities. Specifically, we first use the gradients of the original DLM with respect to each token to identify semantic tokens. During masking, these semantic tokens are preserved with priority, establishing a progressive generation order in which semantic tokens are decoded prior to function tokens. Meanwhile, we adjust the loss weight for semantic tokens to further reinforce their early prediction. Experimental results show that SemMask achieves quality comparable to strong autoregressive baselines on both text writing and code generation tasks, while providing superior semantic coherence. Notably, SemMask achieves higher accuracy with substantially fewer decoding steps, indicating that the early establishment of semantic structure improves the efficiency--accuracy trade-off.

AI.tldr: 提出SemMask微调范式，通过语义优先的渐进式掩码策略使扩散语言模型优先全局解码高信息量语义token，缓解伪自回归与功能词优先偏置，在写作与代码生成上以更少解码步数取得可比质量与更高语义连贯性。
AI.motivation: DLM理论上支持全局并行生成，但实际表现出伪自回归行为和"功能词优先"偏置，削弱了依赖全局规划与并行解码的文本写作、代码生成等任务的性能。
AI.method: 利用原始DLM对各token的梯度识别语义token；在掩码过程中优先保留语义token，构建"语义token先于功能token解码"的渐进式生成顺序；同时调整语义token的损失权重以强化其早期预测。
AI.result: 在文本写作与代码生成任务上质量与强自回归基线相当，且语义连贯性更优；以显著更少的解码步骤达到更高准确率，表明语义结构的早期建立改善了效率—精度权衡。
AI.conclusion: 语义优先的渐进式掩码能够有效引导DLM进行全局规划与并行生成，为提升扩散语言模型的生成质量与效率提供了一种简单有效的微调方案。

title: PREFACE: Separating Shared Corrections from Prefix Conditioning in PEFT
comment: 22 pages, 2 figures. Includes supplementary analyses, code, and numerical evaluation artifacts
summary: Does input-conditioned parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) improve because it uses the current input, or because it adds a useful learned correction? We investigate this distinction with PREFACE, a bounded channel controller for PEFT-adapted projections that requires no test-time gradients. The controller reads observed context; in multiple-choice likelihood scoring, its state is independent of the candidate continuation. Our central study freezes IA3, tuned LoRA, and DoRA adapters and matches controller architecture, initialization, batches, and updates across current-prefix and learned-global controls. Across ARC-Challenge and SciQ, current-prefix control improves all six mean accuracies over frozen adapters, but none of its paired contrasts with learned-global control excludes zero. Replacing its corrections with their training-prefix mean changes accuracy by at most 0.34 percentage points; input-varying corrections contribute only 1.8-2.8% of correction RMS. On ARC test, frozen-adapter current/global controls score 25.68%/25.77%, distinct from the earlier jointly trained 23.1% to 26.4% gain over IA3. We derive and evaluate static compilation of fixed corrections, separating deployment simplification from statistical equivalence. Broader GPT-2, Pythia, and Qwen experiments show family-, task-, and scoring-dependent gains, with modest recent-model effects. The study provides an intervention-based evaluation of conditional PEFT: improvements over a static adapter do not by themselves demonstrate a benefit from input matching.

AI.tldr: 该文用 PREFACE 有界通道控制器做干预式研究，验证输入条件化 PEFT 的增益究竟来自"使用当前输入"还是"学到的修正"，结论是输入变化本身贡献极小（1.8–2.8% RMS），增益主要来自静态修正。
AI.motivation: 现有输入条件化 PEFT 相对静态适配器的提升，常被默认归因于"输入匹配"能力，但缺乏对照证据；作者希望区分"真正利用当前输入"与"等价于添加一个可学习静态修正"两种解释。
AI.method: 提出 PREFACE：面向 PEFT 适配投影的有界通道控制器，无需测试时梯度；在多项选择似然打分中其状态与候选续写解耦。核心实验冻结 IA3、调好的 LoRA 与 DoRA 适配器，在控制器架构、初始化、批次和更新上对齐"当前前缀"与"学习式全局"两种控制条件；并推导固定修正的静态编译方案。
AI.result: 在 ARC-Challenge 与 SciQ 上，当前前缀控制相对冻结适配器在全部六项平均准确率上均有提升，但与学习式全局控制的配对对比均未排除零。将修正替换为其训练前缀均值后准确率变化不超过 0.34 个百分点；输入变化修正仅占修正 RMS 的 1.8–2.8%。ARC 测试集上冻结适配器下当前/全局控制为 25.68%/25.77%，与先前联合训练的 23.1%–26.4% IA3 增益不同。GPT-2、Pythia、Qwen 上增益依赖模型族、任务与打分方式，近期模型效应较小。
AI.conclusion: 相对静态适配器的改进本身并不证明输入匹配带来收益；输入条件化 PEFT 的多数增益可由静态修正解释。应通过干预式对照评估条件化机制，并将静态编译的部署简化与统计等价性区分开。

title: Offline-First Quantized AI: Design and Evaluation of an On-Device Maternal-Health Assistant for Low-Connectivity Environments
summary: Offline language models could extend access to maternal-health information where internet connectivity is unreliable, but deployment requires both clinically appropriate responses and feasible local execution. This study presents an offline Android assistant integrating ready-made quantized language models, a clinically validated local knowledge package, conversational context, and model-initiated local retrieval. Gemma 4 E2B and Qwen3.5 0.8B were compared across 45 conversations and 312 turns per configuration, including a dedicated offline agentic benchmark. Gemma achieved higher response-quality, context-retention, and safety scores; Qwen offered faster generation and lower memory use. Clinician assessment of 150 Gemma responses across nine clinical domains yielded a mean quality score of 3.80/4, with 147 responses meeting the acceptance criterion. A paired RAG-on/off experiment evaluated 74 questions: retrieval improved 11 responses, left 56 neutral, produced four adverse response changes, and left three pairs unassessable. RAG-on had descriptively higher mean usefulness, safety, correctness, and actionability in the conditional 70-pair subset excluding the four flagged pairs from both conditions. Physical-device testing demonstrated offline responses on a 6 GB Android handset, with a 14.3 s median latency, alongside successful reconnection synchronization in the integrated application. Together, the findings document clinical response quality and practical performance of the integrated offline maternal-health assistant.

AI.tldr: 该研究构建了一个集成量化小模型、临床验证本地知识包、对话上下文与模型自主本地检索的离线Android孕产妇健康助手，并对其临床应答质量与设备端性能进行了评估。
AI.motivation: 在互联网连接不稳定的地区，离线语言模型可扩展孕产妇健康信息的可及性，但实际部署需同时满足临床适宜性与本地可执行的可行性。
AI.method: 离线Android助手集成现成量化语言模型、经临床验证的本地知识包、会话上下文及模型触发的本地检索（RAG）。对比Gemma 4 E2B与Qwen3.5 0.8B（每配置45段对话、312轮次，含专门离线agentic基准）；由临床医生评估150条Gemma应答（覆盖9个临床领域）；开展74题的RAG开/关配对实验；并在6 GB Android手机上进行实机测试与重连同步验证。
AI.result: Gemma在应答质量、上下文保持与安全性上得分更高，Qwen生成更快、内存占用更低。临床评估平均质量3.80/4，150条中147条达标。RAG配对实验中：11条改善、56条中性、4条不良变化、3对无法评估；在排除4对标记样本的70对子集中，RAG开启在有用性、安全性、正确性和可操作性上均值更高。实机离线响应中位延迟14.3秒，重连同步成功。
AI.conclusion: 结果记录了该集成式离线孕产妇健康助手的临床应答质量与实际运行性能，验证了其在受限网络环境下本地部署的可行性与安全性，但RAG存在少量有害应答变化，需进一步优化检索触发与安全约束。

title: A Bag of Concepts? Testing Role-Filler Binding in the Verbalizable Workspace
comment: Accepted at Interpretability as a Science Workshop, NeurIPS 2026
summary: Runtime alignment monitors built on a verbalizable workspace have been proposed as a way to surface a model's silent cognition before it produces output. Their value rests on the workspace carrying enough structure to distinguish safety-relevant propositions, most of which are relational: "the model plans to deceive the user" and "the user plans to deceive the model" share a concept set and differ only in role assignment. We ask whether the workspace carries the role-filler bindings (which entity fills which role) such a monitor would need, on three frontier language models (Qwen3.6-27B, Gemma-3-12B, Gemma-3-27B-IT), under two lens families (J-lens and R-lens), and with two methods for fitting the role direction (difference-of-means and LRE-gradient). We find a clean dissociation: the workspace carries directions that steer what the model outputs about roles but not the representations the model uses to compute them. Linear probes recover role at near-ceiling from the residual stream but score below a rank-matched random control when reading the workspace, and steering the model along the fitted role direction changes which entity it binds to no more than strength-matched control edits do. Ablating the workspace (zeroing the residual stream's projection onto its ten most active lens directions) damages binding on one of the three models (Gemma-3-27B-IT, holding across three lens variants) and shows no binding-specific damage on the other two, with a rank-matched random subspace as the control; this confirms our design detects binding when present, though scale and instruction tuning are confounded there. A workspace-lens monitor built on these directions would therefore miss a role assignment the model itself represents.

AI.tldr: 本文检验语言模型的"可言语化工作区"(verbalizable workspace)是否携带角色—填充者绑定(role-filler binding)信息，发现工作区存在"输出可控但计算无关"的清晰分离：其方向可影响模型输出内容，但不承载模型内部计算角色分配所用的表示，故基于工作区的监控器会漏检模型实际表征的角色指派。
AI.motivation: 运行时对齐监控依赖可言语化工作区在输出前暴露模型的"沉默认知"，而多数安全相关命题是关系性的（如"模型计划欺骗用户"与"用户计划欺骗模型"概念集相同、仅角色分配不同），因此工作区必须具备角色—填充者绑定结构，才能支撑有效的安全监控。作者据此追问：工作区究竟是否携带此类绑定信息。
AI.method: 在三个前沿模型（Qwen3.6-27B、Gemma-3-12B、Gemma-3-27B-IT）上，采用两族透镜（J-lens 与 R-lens）及两种角色方向拟合方法（difference-of-means 与 LRE-gradient）。用线性探针分别从残差流与工作区读取角色信息，并设置秩匹配随机对照；通过沿拟合角色方向进行引导(steering)测试其对实体绑定的因果影响，并设置强度匹配对照；再以消融实验（将残差流在其十个最活跃透镜方向上的投影置零）检验绑定损伤，对照为秩匹配随机子空间。
AI.result: 出现清晰的分离：工作区携带的方向可以引导模型关于角色的输出，但不影响模型用于计算角色的表示。线性探针从残差流中近满值恢复角色信息，但从工作区读取时低于秩匹配随机对照；沿角色方向引导对实体绑定的改变不超过强度匹配的对照编辑。消融工作区仅在 Gemma-3-27B-IT 上损伤绑定（在三种透镜变体下稳定），另两个模型无绑定特异性损伤，说明该设计在绑定存在时确能检出，但此处规模与指令微调存在混淆。
AI.conclusion: 工作区透镜携带的是"输出可用"而非"计算所用"的角色方向，基于此类方向构建的工作区透镜监控器会漏掉模型自身已表征的角色分配，削弱可言语化工作区作为安全监控基础的可靠性。

title: Evaluation-Free Recursive Self-Improvement for Coding Agents
summary: Recent self-improving coding agents have achieved strong benchmark performance by iteratively modifying their own executable implementations. A common pattern uses downstream task-derived evidence to decide which candidates or lineages continue evolving, which we term evaluate-and-select. Obtaining this signal requires repeatedly executing evolved agents on downstream tasks, so broader exploration incurs increasing evaluation cost, while repeated optimization against a fixed evaluation distribution may encourage benchmark-specific adaptation. We ask: can coding agents self-improve without downstream task evaluation inside the evolution loop? We introduce Explore-then-Integrate (ELITE), which integrates implementation mechanisms rather than selecting a single exploratory child to continue the lineage. At each generation, ELITE proposes diverse focused improvements, implements them independently from the same parent, and inspects the resulting programs to identify complementary, redundant, and conflicting mechanisms before reimplementing a compatible subset as one coherent descendant. No downstream task outcomes or task-solving trajectories of evolved candidates are used to guide evolution; only deterministic checks of structural and operational validity are used inside the loop. On SWE-bench Pro, ELITE improves the initial agent from 60.0% to 85.6%, compared with 86.7% for the Darwin Godel Machine (DGM) and 88.3% for the Huxley-Godel Machine (HGM), while using zero candidate task evaluations and reducing observed wall-clock evolution time by 8.8x and 3.2x, respectively, under the evaluated configurations. In cross-benchmark transfer without further adaptation, ELITE averages 73.3% on SWE-bench Verified and 69.3% on Polyglot. Together, these results demonstrate the feasibility of coding-agent self-improvement without downstream candidate task evaluation in our setting.

AI.tldr: 提出 ELITE：在进化循环内不使用下游任务评估，仅通过"探索多个改进→整合互补机制"实现编码智能体自我提升，SWE-bench Pro 从 60.0% 升至 85.6%，且评估开销为零、进化时间大幅缩短。
AI.motivation: 现有自改进编码智能体依赖"评估-选择"（evaluate-and-select）：需反复在下游任务上执行进化后的智能体以判定哪些候选或谱系继续演化。这带来两个问题：(1) 探索越广，评估成本越高；(2) 针对固定评估分布反复优化，易产生 benchmark 特异性适配。作者因此质疑：能否在进化循环内完全去掉下游任务评估仍实现自改进。
AI.method: ELITE（Explore-then-Integrate）：不以"挑选单个探索子代延续谱系"为选择机制，而是整合实现机制。每一代中：(1) 从同一父代出发提出多个聚焦的改进方向并各自独立实现；(2) 检视所得程序，识别互补、冗余与冲突的机制；(3) 将兼容子集重新实现为一个连贯的后代。循环内仅使用结构与运行有效性的确定性检查，不使用下游任务结果或候选的解题轨迹。
AI.result: SWE-bench Pro 上初始智能体 60.0% → 85.6%；对比 DGM 的 86.7%、HGM 的 88.3%（候选任务评估次数为 0）。观察到墙钟进化时间分别减少 8.8x 与 3.2x。跨基准无额外适配迁移：SWE-bench Verified 平均 73.3%，Polyglot 69.3%。
AI.conclusion: 在本文设定下，编码智能体的自我改进无需在进化循环中依赖下游候选任务评估即可实现；以"机制整合"替代"评估-选择"可显著降低评估与时间成本，并具备一定的跨基准迁移能力。

title: VAHBench: A Harness Benchmark for Agentic Long-Video Generation
summary: AI agents are commonly used for everyday information retrieval and coding. We ask whether they can also interpret human requests and turn them into complete videos. We introduce VAHBench, a benchmark that tests this ability through five short-drama briefs specifying story, characters, dialogue and duration. Agents plan and carry out production using shared generation tools. Evaluation combines video completeness and basic quality with checks of production reliability and reporting accuracy. Across 240 runs covering 48 configurations of general-purpose and video-specific agents, higher quality scores do not necessarily mean more complete delivery. Missing episodes, repeated footage and static filler reveal gaps between producing a video file and fulfilling the brief. Added composition tools help some agents but do not consistently improve performance. VAHBench measures how well agents translate user intent into finished video content and helps identify where that process breaks down.

AI.tldr: 本文提出VAHBench基准，用于测试AI代理能否将人类请求转化为完整视频，通过5个短剧简报（含故事、角色、对话、时长）驱动代理规划与制作，并从视频完整性与基础质量、制作可靠性、报告准确性三方面评测。
AI.motivation: AI代理已广泛用于日常信息检索与编程，但其能否理解人类请求并产出完整视频尚不清楚；现有工作缺少从"用户意图"到"成品视频"的端到端评测手段。
AI.method: 构建VAHBench：设计5个短剧简报，明确故事、角色、对话与时长；代理使用共享生成工具自主规划并执行制作流程；评测融合视频完整性与基础质量，并辅以制作可靠性与报告准确性检查；共运行240次、覆盖48种通用型与视频专用型代理配置。
AI.result: 质量得分更高并不必然意味着交付更完整；出现缺集、素材重复、静态填充等问题，暴露出"生成视频文件"与"满足简报要求"之间的差距；增加组合工具对部分代理有帮助，但性能提升并不稳定。
AI.conclusion: VAHBench量化了代理将用户意图转化为完整视频内容的能力，并有助于定位该过程中的失效环节。

title: Conflict-Aware Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation in Aligned Action Spaces for Cross-Game Generalization
summary: Zero-shot cross-game generalization aims to consolidate accessible source-game experts into a single vision-language model (VLM) that controls unseen games from raw pixels without target-game parameter updates. While multi-teacher on-policy distillation (MOPD) mitigates offline exposure bias and single-game reinforcement learning (RL) overfitting, scaling it to autoregressive VLMs faces two bottlenecks. First, token-to-action misalignment from subword length bias distorts discrete action probabilities and uncertainty margins. Second, multi-teacher policy conflict arises as source teachers under incompatible dynamics issue contradictory closed-loop corrections, causing negative transfer. We propose CAMOPD (Conflict-Aware Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation), a post-training framework that resolves multi-teacher policy conflict within an aligned semantic action space. CAMOPD first uses complete-action alignment to normalize command completion likelihoods over each game's legal action set, forming a calibrated categorical policy that provides reliable uncertainty margins for selective on-policy retention and visual specialist probes that can be evaluated across source games. To resolve policy conflict without target-game data, conflict-aware multi-teacher consolidation cross-evaluates these specialists across source games to capture both visual identifiability and inter-teacher compatibility, upweighting compatible teachers while suppressing conflicting corrections. On GameWorld's temporal and directional transfer suites with Qwen3.5-4B, CAMOPD achieves 26/30 (86.7%) and 24/30 (80.0%) Task-1 zero-shot success on unseen GeoDash and Doodle Jump, outperforming prompting, weight-merging, and multi-task baselines.

AI.tldr: 提出CAMOPD后训练框架，解决自回归VLM多教师在线策略蒸馏中的词元-动作错位与多教师策略冲突问题，在未见游戏上实现零样本跨游戏泛化（GeoDash 26/30、Doodle Jump 24/30）。
AI.motivation: 目标是零样本跨游戏泛化：将多个源游戏专家整合为单一视觉语言模型（VLM），仅凭原始像素控制未见游戏且不做目标游戏参数更新。多教师在线策略蒸馏（MOPD）虽能缓解离线曝光偏差与单游戏RL过拟合，但扩展到自回归VLM时存在两大瓶颈：(1) 子词长度偏差导致词元到动作的错位，扭曲离散动作概率与不确定性边际；(2) 源教师在不同动力学下给出相互矛盾的闭环纠正，产生多教师策略冲突与负迁移。
AI.method: CAMOPD包含两部分：(1) 完整动作对齐（complete-action alignment）：在各游戏合法动作集合上归一化指令补全似然，形成校准的分类策略，为选择性在线策略保留提供可靠不确定性边际，并支持可跨源游戏评估的视觉专家探针；(2) 冲突感知多教师整合：无目标游戏数据，通过跨源游戏交叉评估专家，同时捕捉视觉可辨识性与教师间兼容性，对兼容教师加权、抑制冲突纠正。
AI.result: 在GameWorld的时间与方向迁移套件上，使用Qwen3.5-4B，CAMOPD在未见游戏GeoDash与Doodle Jump的Task-1零样本成功率分别达26/30（86.7%）与24/30（80.0%），优于提示、权重合并与多任务基线。
AI.conclusion: 在语义对齐的动作空间中解决多教师策略冲突，是实现自回归VLM零样本跨游戏泛化的有效后训练路径。

title: GRACE: Parallel Best-of-N Multi-Agent Analysis of Closed-Form Questions over Dataframes with Guardrail Selection and Adaptive Retry
comment: Accepted at the 5th Italian Conference on Big Data and Data Science (ITADATA 2026). To appear in CEUR Workshop Proceedings
summary: LLM agents answer closed-form questions over a tabular dataframe by writing and executing Python, almost always as a single rollout: one interpretation, one script, one result, accepted without comparison. The few pipelines that produce several candidates reconcile them by answer-agreement voting, which needs a single comparable scalar and always returns one, even when every candidate is wrong. We present GRACE (Generative, Ranked, Adaptive Code Ensemble), a production-oriented pipeline that instead runs parallel best-of-N selection specialised to dataframe code. N agents run concurrently under a strict, machine-checkable output contract, diversified by persona hints, per-retry rotation, and a two-regime temperature schedule. Rather than vote, GRACE judges the executed artefacts: a pairwise tournament pre-filters the pool and a domain-specialised guardrail either selects the best candidate or, when none is defensible, rejects the whole pool and abstains with a diagnosis (an option voting structurally lacks), which in turn drives an adaptive retry with per-agent feedback. On InfiAgent-DABench (DAEval, M = 246), using Qwen3.6-35B-A3B as the backbone, GRACE raises answer match from 39% for a single-rollout baseline to 71% (+32 pp, 1.8x), recovering 53% of previously wrong answers. On the same DAEval task, the smaller dense Qwen3.5-9B lifts answer match from 38% to 63% (+25 pp, 1.7x). A controlled 3 x 3 study that sweeps the number of parallel agents against the retry budget finds, on the 35B backbone, the two levers largely substitutable: once either one is generous, the other adds little, identifying a cheap operating point for deployment. The same directional pattern replicates on the independent DataBench benchmark, again on the Qwen3.6-35B-A3B backbone, where answer match rises by 15 percentage points (from 70% to 85%) across 400 sampled questions.

AI.tldr: GRACE是一个面向数据框代码问答的并行best-of-N流水线，用成对锦标赛+领域专用护栏替代答案投票，支持"拒答+诊断+自适应重试"，在DAEval上把答案匹配率从39%提升到71%。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM agent处理表格问答时几乎都是单次rollout（一次解读、一个脚本、一个结果），缺乏比较与校验；少数多候选流水线仅靠答案一致性投票合并，这要求候选产出单一可比较标量，且总会返回一个答案——即使所有候选都是错的。
AI.method: 提出GRACE（Generative, Ranked, Adaptive Code Ensemble）：N个agent在严格、机器可校验的输出契约下并发运行，通过persona提示、逐次重试轮换与双区间温度调度实现多样性；不投票而是评判已执行产物——成对锦标赛对候选池预筛选，领域专用护栏选出最佳候选，或在无候选可辩护时拒绝整个候选池并给出诊断式弃答，进而驱动带per-agent反馈的自适应重试。另做了3×3控制实验，扫描并行agent数与重试预算。
AI.result: InfiAgent-DABench（DAEval，M=246），backbone为Qwen3.6-35B-A3B：答案匹配率由39%提升至71%（+32pp，1.8倍），挽回53%的原有错误答案；同一任务上稠密模型Qwen3.5-9B由38%提升至63%（+25pp，1.7倍）。3×3实验表明两个杠杆（并行数、重试预算）在35B上大体可替代，任一方充足后另一方的边际收益很小，从而给出低成本的部署工作点。独立基准DataBench（同样35B backbone，400题抽样）上答案匹配率由70%升至85%（+15pp），方向性规律得到复现。
AI.conclusion: 基于执行产物评判的并行best-of-N选择优于答案投票，并且弃答机制是投票在结构上无法提供的；该方法在跨模型规模、跨基准上均稳定增益，且存在低成本部署配置。

title: Razavi-Bench: Tracking AI Progress in Analog Circuit Reasoning
comment: 6 pages, 3 figures, 2 tables. Project page: https://razavi-bench.tokenzhang.com ; code and data: https://github.com/Arcadia-1/razavi-bench
summary: We propose Razavi-Bench, a benchmark built from the 50 questions in Razavi's two Analog Design Experiments With AI articles and graded by GPT-6 Luna against reference answers and rubrics, and use it to track how fast AI models improve at analog circuit analysis. Across 73 multimodal large language models released between May 2024 and November 2026, the top score rose from 28.83% to 98.33% in 30 months, mostly before the reference answers were published. The leading models now answer almost every textbook question correctly; the hardest questions show a circuit that resembles a textbook one but works differently, or ask about behavior the obvious analysis misses. Within two and a half years, a set of questions that exposed the limits of AI models has become one they answer almost perfectly.

AI.tldr: 提出 Razavi-Bench（基于 Razavi 两篇《Analog Design Experiments With AI》中 50 道题、由 GPT-6 Luna 依据参考答案与评分标准判分），追踪 73 个多模态大模型在 2024 年 5 月至 2026 年 11 月间的模拟电路分析能力变化。
AI.motivation: 需要量化衡量 AI 模型在模拟电路分析这一专业任务上的能力进展速度，并检验曾暴露模型短板的题目是否仍是瓶颈。
AI.method: 构建 50 题基准 Razavi-Bench，采用 GPT-6 Luna 对照参考答案与评分标准进行自动评分；对 73 个已发布的多模态大模型进行横向与纵向评测，并区分题目难度类型（表面似教科书、实则机理不同的电路，以及显然分析会遗漏的行为）。
AI.result: 30 个月内最高分由 28.83% 升至 98.33%，且提升主要发生在参考答案公开之前；当前领先模型几乎答对全部教科书式题目，最难题目集中在“形似教科书但工作机理不同”的电路与易被直观分析遗漏的行为。
AI.conclusion: 两年半内，一组曾暴露 AI 模型能力边界的题目已基本被攻克；基准由“能力探针”转为“近乎饱和”的评测，未来需设计更侧重反直觉机理与新行为的题目以保持区分度。

title: Which AI Use Cases Deserve a Pilot? A Risk and Value Framework for Funding, Scoping, and Scaling AI
comment: 18 pages. All results use synthetic data. A companion Python package reproduces the tables
summary: A composite score can rank AI use cases while leaving the permitted operating scope and the evidence required for expansion unspecified. We treat the unit of decision as a use case at a proposed scope (authority, human mediation, limits, volume, environment, population) and define three decisions: screen the scope, fund the experiment, and authorize expansion only when residual risk is acceptable and evidence of incremental net value applies at that scope. A risk track (R1-R4) is implemented as an explicit decision table with vetoes and documented precedence, and a value track follows four evidence stages with each transition needing its own evidence. Funding uses expected value of perfect information as an upper bound and the value of sample information for the specific experiment. A quantified expected-loss check, required where policy says so, computes the containment an expansion needs and credits a control only on evidence measured at the proposed scope; in a synthetic scenario the highest-value control design fails that test while a smaller scope passes. A reproducible Python package with 279 passing tests demonstrates the framework on synthetic refund, reconciliation and knowledge-assistant use cases, including a synthetic matched-scope fixture and a transferability stress test (value evidence is simulated, not realized), and compares it with a public AWS sample. Thresholds and appetite are prototype policy requiring field validation.

AI.tldr: 论文提出以"特定授权范围内的用例"为决策单元，构建风险轨道（R1–R4决策表，含否决与优先级）与价值轨道（四阶段证据门槛）的双轨决策框架，用EVPI/EVSI做资金决策、用期望损失检验判断扩展所需的遏制能力，并以279项测试通过的Python包在合成场景中验证。
AI.motivation: 复合评分虽能对AI用例排序，却未明确允许的运营范围以及扩展所需的证据要求，导致排序结果无法直接支撑"筛查范围—资助实验—授权扩展"的决策。
AI.method: 将决策单元定义为"提议范围内的用例"（权限、人工介入、限制、规模、环境、人群）；风险轨道以显式决策表实现R1–R4分级，含否决条件与成文优先级；价值轨道设四个证据阶段，每次状态转移需独立证据；资金决策用完美信息期望值作上界、样本信息价值刻画具体实验；必要时执行量化期望损失检验，计算扩展所需遏制度，仅承认在提议范围内实测的控制效果。软件为可复现Python包（279项测试通过），在合成退款、对账与知识助手用例上演示，含匹配范围夹具与可迁移性压力测试，并与公开AWS样例对比。
AI.result: 在合成场景中，价值最高的控制设计未通过期望损失检验，而较小范围的方案通过；框架可在三类用例上完整运行，并与公开AWS样例完成对比。
AI.conclusion: 决策单元应与运营范围绑定，证据须在对应范围内测量方可计入；阈值与风险偏好属原型政策，需实地验证；价值证据为模拟而非实测，结论具探索性。

title: K2-Horizon: A Frontier Fleet of Open Source Language Models
summary: We present K2-Horizon, a fleet of six fully open language models, from a 0.9B dense model to a 375B-A23B MoE, built for general-purpose reasoning and agentic work across math and science, software engineering, deep research, office automation, and beyond. The models lead or are competitive with strong open models of their size on agentic and coding benchmarks. On the modeling side, to strengthen reasoning, we introduce Mixture-of-Value Attention (MoVA), applying MoE to attention value projections, and softplus attention gating, a more flexible, theoretically motivated gate. Our 36B-A4B model uses both and nearly matches a 32B dense model trained on the same data, with one-seventh the active parameters. We also introduce Uno, lossless diffusion adapters that speed up decoding by up to 2.2x without a separate draft model. Our release follows the LLM360 definition of open source for transparency and reproducibility: the full development history, including intermediate checkpoints from every training stage, pre-training data, training logs, and all training, evaluation, and infrastructure code, notably our production-scale xLLM framework for dense and MoE training and the RL360 reinforcement-learning stack. Beyond the data itself, we release and document in detail every pipeline that built it, the part of model development that open releases most rarely disclose. These pipelines produced roughly 10T synthetic pre-training tokens, showing that synthetic data can be a major ingredient of pre-training at scale. Four of the models share one 22T-token pre-training corpus and recipe, revealing consistent scaling behavior and enabling controlled studies of scale and sparsity. All artifacts are available at https://ifm.ai/k2/

AI.tldr: K2-Horizon 是六个全开放语言模型（0.9B 稠密至 375B-A23B MoE），提出 MoVA、softplus 注意力门控与 Uno 无损扩散适配器，并按 LLM360 标准全量开放训练历史、数据与流水线。
AI.motivation: 构建面向通用推理与智能体任务（数学科学、软件工程、深度研究、办公自动化）的开放模型族；同时弥补现有开放发布极少披露数据构建流水线与中间检查点的透明度缺口。
AI.method: 1) 模型族覆盖 0.9B 稠密到 375B-A23B MoE；2) 建模创新：Mixture-of-Value Attention（将 MoE 应用于注意力 value 投影）、softplus 注意力门控（更具灵活性且有理论依据）；3) 解码加速：Uno——无损扩散适配器，无需独立草稿模型；4) 开源：遵循 LLM360 定义，发布全开发历史、各阶段中间检查点、预训练数据、训练日志、全部训练/评测/基础设施代码（含生产级 xLLM 与 RL360 RL 栈）；5) 数据侧发布并详述所有构建流水线，产出约 10T 合成预训练 token。
AI.result: 模型在智能体与编程基准上领先或可比于同规模强开源模型；36B-A4B 模型同时采用 MoVA 与 softplus 门控，以约 1/7 激活参数几乎匹配同数据训练的 32B 稠密模型；Uno 实现最高 2.2× 解码加速且无损；约 10T 合成 token 表明合成数据可成为大规模预训练的主要成分；四个模型共享 22T token 语料与配方，展现一致的缩放行为。
AI.conclusion: 该工作以高透明度开放模型族证明：注意力层 MoE 化与门控改进可提升参数效率，扩散式适配器可低成本加速解码，合成数据与流水线公开可支撑可复现的缩放与稀疏性受控研究。

title: SciResearch-Eval: Evaluating Scientific Judgment in Autonomous Experimental Agents
summary: We introduce SciResearch-Eval, an interactive benchmark of scientific judgment built on a standard laboratory problem: measuring a material's thermal properties by heating it and fitting a heat-conduction simulator. An agent designs its own experiments, uses a supplied simulator that may be under-resolved or physically wrong, and reports each property with a 95% interval. To our knowledge it is the first benchmark to combine agent-designed experiments, a deliberately flawed simulator, and proper scoring of calibrated intervals against exact ground truth. On a held-out split (93 tasks, 9 models, 2,511 episodes), models handle procedural traps. When the simulator is missing physics, most report wrong values while stating they are 95% sure: their ranges contain the truth in 20-62% of cases, against 94% for GPT-6 Astra and 99% for Claude Fable 5.2. At default effort the failing Claude 5.5 models rarely diagnose the missing physics (Opus in 35% of episodes, against 66% for Astra), and even when they do, their ranges often miss; Astra and Fable design experiments in which the flawed simulator is accurate, such as gentle heating, which keeps Astra calibrated even when it does not name the cause. Asking for wider intervals does not help; stating the strategy improves interval scores 1.6-2.5-fold, replicated on a pre-registered fresh split, but coverage barely moves. A pre-registered effort ablation shows that the correction is latent in the Claude 5.5 models: at maximum effort Opus improves more than tenfold and is no longer detectably behind Astra at default, but only with 13-31 times more reasoning; older and open-weight models gain nothing. Fable 5.2 is the most accurate model at default effort (interval score 1.9 times better than Astra's) but writes 6 times as many tokens, and at Astra's token count it falls short. We release the environment, graders and harness.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 SciResearch-Eval 基准：在材料热学性质测量的实验场景中，要求智能体自主设计实验、使用可能欠分辨或物理错误的仿真器，并对每个性质输出 95% 区间。结果显示多数模型在仿真器缺失物理时仍高度自信却给出错误值，区间覆盖率仅 20-62%（Astra 94%、Fable 5.2 为 99%）；显式陈述策略可提升区间分数 1.6-2.5 倍但覆盖率几乎不变，而最大推理努力可使 Claude 5.5 的校正能力被激发（Opus 提升十倍以上）。
AI.motivation: 现有基准缺乏对科学判断中"校准性"与"对不可靠工具的诊断能力"的联合评测：需要智能体自主设计实验、面对故意带缺陷的仿真器，并在有精确真值的情况下检验其区间校准，从而暴露模型的过度自信与物理诊断短板。
AI.method: 构建交互式基准 SciResearch-Eval：以加热测热学性质并拟合热传导仿真器为标准实验任务；智能体自主设计实验、调用被故意欠分辨或物理错误的仿真器、对每个性质报告 95% 区间；采用相对于精确真值的恰当评分（proper scoring）评估区间。评测规模为留出集 93 任务、9 模型、2,511 episodes，并包含预注册的新划分复现与推理努力消融实验。
AI.result: 模型能处理程序性陷阱，但在仿真器缺失物理时多数报告错误值却声称 95% 确信，区间覆盖真值仅 20-62%，而 GPT-6 Astra 为 94%、Claude Fable 5.2 为 99%。默认努力下失败的 Claude 5.5 很少诊断出缺失物理（Opus 35% vs Astra 66%），即便诊断出区间也常失效；Astra 与 Fable 会设计使缺陷仿真器仍准确的实验（如温和加热）。加宽区间无效；陈述策略使区间分数提升 1.6-2.5 倍（预注册新划分复现），但覆盖率几乎不变。最大努力下 Opus 提升逾十倍、不再显著落后于默认 Astra，但推理量增加 13-31 倍；老旧与开放权重模型无收益。Fable 5.2 默认最准（区间分数优于 Astra 1.9 倍）但 token 量为 6 倍，在 Astra 的 token 预算下则不占优。
AI.conclusion: SciResearch-Eval 首次将智能体自主实验设计、故意带缺陷的仿真器与对校准区间的恰当评分结合，揭示当前模型的关键缺陷在于"自信地错误"及对物理缺陷的诊断不足；该校正能力在 Claude 5.5 中以潜 latent 形式存在，需极高推理预算才能激活。作者开源环境、评分器与测试框架。

title: Jev-as-a-Reward: Validating Probabilistic Safety Judges for Reinforcement Learning
summary: Probabilistic safety judges return the probability of a safety label and cheaply score reinforcement learning rollouts. A confidence gate sends only uncertain verdicts to a stronger LLM judge, which leaves confidently passed harm in a blind spot. Policies can exploit this blind spot, and commercial judges release new versions. We propose a protocol that validates such a judge before and during training, separates the share of confidently passed harm from its amount, and re-validates it after each judge change. We apply it to two versions of Jev, a commercial decision-only judge, and to an open guard classifier. Under the probability reward of Jev, passed harm shrinks in all 11 runs under the primary reference, mostly more slowly than caught harm, and concentrates in the blind spot. Binarizing this judge meets the escape criterion on Llama, and the open guard classifier shows an escape signal in one seed under a second reference. Guard classifiers share this blind spot, and even frontier LLM judges catch at most one of 10 human-labeled confident misses. Without a trained reward model, the probability reward with a helpfulness term lowers HarmBench attack success on Llama-3.1-8B from 0.287 to at most 0.033 at the final checkpoint.

AI.tldr: 该文提出一套用于验证概率式安全裁判（safety judge）在训练前、中、后的协议，揭示“置信门”造成的盲区会被策略利用，并给出量化分离与复核方法。
AI.motivation: 概率式安全裁判以概率奖励廉价地为强化学习 rollout 打分，但置信门只把不确定判定交给更强LLM裁判，导致“高置信通过的有害内容”落入盲区；策略可据此规避，且商用裁判会不断发布新版本，需要可复用的验证协议。
AI.method: 提出的协议包含三部分：训练前与训练中验证裁判；将“高置信通过有害量的占比”与其绝对量分离统计；每次裁判版本更替后重新验证。实验对象为商用决策型裁判 Jev 的两个版本及一个开源 guard 分类器，并在 Llama 上检验二值化裁判的逃逸判据。
AI.result: 在 Jev 的概率奖励下，主参考下全部 11 次运行中通过的有害量均收缩，但多数慢于被抓有害量，且集中于盲区；二值化 Jev 在 Llama 上满足逃逸判据；开源 guard 分类器在第二参考下某一随机种子出现逃逸信号。guard 分类器共有该盲区，前沿LLM裁判最多只在10个人工标注的高置信漏检中命中1个。若无训练好的奖励模型，带有用性项的概率奖励可把 Llama-3.1-8B 的 HarmBench 攻击成功率从0.287降至最终检查点的不超过0.033。
AI.conclusion: 安全裁判的置信门存在可被策略利用的系统性盲区，且难以由更强裁判补救；应采用本文协议在训练前后及裁判更替时持续验证，并将通过有害的占比与绝对量分开报告，以避免虚假的安全改善。

title: From Recursion to Convolution: Parallel Self-Improvement for Multi-Agent Systems
summary: Multi-agent self-improvement enables agents to improve through interaction and feedback. However, sequential dependencies across agents and refinement rounds can propagate errors, increase computational costs, and limit parallelism. Moreover, refining individual features or agents in isolation can overlook their dependencies and restrict collective coordination. To address these challenges, we propose ConvRSI, a framework for parallelizing multi-agent self-improvement through convolution. ConvRSI couples intra-agent convolution, which jointly refines related agent features, with inter-agent graph convolution, which aggregates messages according to the collaboration topology. Both stages operate in latent space, enabling parallel updates without repeatedly decoding and re-encoding intermediate messages. Experiments on MATH-500 show that ConvRSI achieves 5.04% performance improvement while reducing 17.27% inference cost, and 45.11% latency compared with RecursiveMAS. It also supports diverse collaboration patterns by representing their topologies as adjacency matrices. These results demonstrate the potential of convolutional co-evolution for efficient multi-agent self-improvement. Our code and datasets are provided in https://github.com/LYA2333/ConvRSI.

AI.tldr: ConvRSI通过"卷积"将多智能体自我改进并行化：以智能体内卷积联合精炼相关特征，以智能体间图卷积沿协作拓扑聚合消息，两阶段均在隐空间完成，从而避免串行依赖导致的误差传播与重复解码开销。
AI.motivation: 现有多智能体自我改进存在串行依赖问题：跨智能体、跨精炼轮次的顺序依赖会造成误差传播、算力开销上升并限制并行性；同时孤立地精炼单个特征或单个智能体会忽略其相互依赖，制约集体协同。
AI.method: 提出ConvRSI框架：1）intra-agent convolution，联合精炼相关联的智能体特征；2）inter-agent graph convolution，按协作拓扑聚合消息；两阶段均作用于隐空间（latent space），无需反复解码与重编码中间消息即可并行更新；并以邻接矩阵表示不同协作拓扑以支持多样协作模式。
AI.result: 在MATH-500上相较RecursiveMAS，性能提升5.04%，推理成本降低17.27%，时延降低45.11%；并支持以邻接矩阵表达的多种协作模式。
AI.conclusion: 结果验证了"卷积式协同演化"在多智能体高效自我改进上的潜力；代码与数据集已开源（https://github.com/LYA2333/ConvRSI）。

title: From Repositories to Training Environments: Scaling Long-Horizon Coding Agents with Environment Evolution Loop
summary: Training coding agents for long-horizon tasks requires environments with verifiable feedback. Existing pipelines often follow a linear process that ends with validation, establishing usability but providing little guidance on improving training value. Recursive self-improvement (RSI) often requires model rollouts or model training followed by downstream evaluation, with costs and feedback delays amplified on long-horizon tasks. How can we use timely, reliable proxy signals to improve training value and synthesize environments at scale? We present RepoFactory, an automated pipeline that converts real repositories into verifiable environments where agents build complete projects from scratch given a language specification. Its Environment Evolution Loop optimizes a multiplicative objective combining validity, structural coupling, and implementation scope through proxy feedback. RepoFactory produces 10,159 environments across 17 software domains. Training Qwen3.5-35B-A3B on these environments yields RepoHorizen-35B-A3B, which achieves gains of 22.6 percentage points on NL2Repo-Bench and 8.5 points on average across five benchmarks covering long-horizon coding and agentic tasks in real-world production settings, compared with 17.5 and 6.4 points without environment evolution. These results highlight the training value of RepoFactory environments and the additional gains from the Environment Evolution Loop.

AI.tldr: 提出 RepoFactory 自动化流水线，将真实仓库转化为可验证训练环境，用代理信号驱动的环境演化循环提升训练价值，产出 10,159 个环境并训练出 RepoHorizen-35B-A3B。
AI.motivation: 长时程编码智能体训练需要带可验证反馈的环境，但现有流水线为线性流程、止于验证，只保证可用性而缺乏对训练价值提升的指导；递归自我改进（RSI）依赖模型 rollout 或训练后下游评估，在长时程任务上成本与反馈延迟被放大。
AI.method: RepoFactory 将真实仓库转换为环境，智能体依据语言规范从零构建完整项目。其 Environment Evolution Loop 通过及时、可靠的代理反馈，优化由有效性、结构耦合度和实现范围构成的乘性目标函数，实现环境的大规模合成与迭代改进。
AI.result: 构建覆盖 17 个软件领域的 10,159 个环境；基于 Qwen3.5-35B-A3B 训练得到 RepoHorizen-35B-A3B，在 NL2Repo-Bench 上提升 22.6 个百分点，在五个长时程编码与智能体基准上平均提升 8.5 个百分点；无环境演化时对应提升分别为 17.5 和 6.4 个百分点。
AI.conclusion: RepoFactory 环境具有显著训练价值，且 Environment Evolution Loop 基于代理反馈的优化可在不依赖昂贵 RSI 的前提下带来额外收益，为长时程智能体环境的规模化合成提供了可行路径。

title: Staged Semantic Distillation: Preserving Free-Form Semantics in a Low-Compute Non-LLM Surrogate of a Staged LLM Agent
comment: Main text 7 pages; 18 pages total; 3 figures, 16 tables
summary: Staged LLM agents make market and social simulators realistic, but one 102-day run of a 200-agent, ten-index market simulator issues 203,100 language-model calls and returns one realization. Conventional low-compute distillation drops their free-form intermediate state. We present staged semantic distillation, a low-compute method that preserves non-structured semantics in a non-LLM student trained from one recorded trace. A frozen encoder maps each teacher output to a 1024-d vector; the student sees typed stage-tagged vectors with stage-specific visibility, is jointly supervised, and trains with scheduled self-history. One TwinMarket trace yields a 13.2M-parameter deterministic student that trains in 1,658 seconds on one 8-GB GPU and runs with zero teacher or decoder calls and no text generation (0.14 ms per decision). Its analysis stays close to the teacher (cosine 0.943), and swapping semantic inputs between agents moves 64.7% of decisions against 12.8% for a matched donor, so the channel is preserved and live. We use the surrogate to study what the transfer carries. It reaches 0.8347 balanced accuracy on the teacher-forced replay and 0.7783 [0.766,0.791] on the deployment decoder; the five-seed gain over a no-semantic retrain is +2.2 [1.21,3.14]. Against the teacher's own re-sampling level, round-one R is 97.1% [95.8,98.4] and 92.3% [89.0,95.4]; R is a diagnostic, not an accuracy. A five-seed content-by-schedule study isolates the gain: scheduled self-history carries it (+2.2 [1.21,3.14]); shuffled and constant content controls reproduce it, while content matters teacher-forced. The design rule: invest in the deployment schedule, let content earn its place at the teacher-forced operating point. A 20-seed, 200,000-decision sweep takes 12 minutes with zero LLM calls, versus three hours for the teacher. The paper is a method-and-case-study contribution on one simulator and trace.

AI.tldr: 提出"分阶段语义蒸馏"(staged semantic distillation)：从单条已录制的教师轨迹训练一个非LLM的确定性学生模型，保留分阶段智能体的自由形式中间语义（1024维编码向量、带阶段标签与可见性、联合监督、计划式自历史），从而以零LLM调用、0.14 ms/决策的低成本复现市场/社会仿真器的行为语义。
AI.motivation: 分阶段LLM智能体驱动的市场与社会仿真器虽逼真，但单次102天、200智能体、十指数运行的代价高达203,100次语言模型调用且仅得一个样本；常规低算力蒸馏会丢弃教师自由形式的中间状态语义，损失关键行为信息。
AI.method: 冻结编码器将每个教师输出映射为1024维向量；学生（13.2M参数、确定性）接收带类型与阶段标签、并具阶段特定可见性的向量，采用联合监督与"计划式自历史"（scheduled self-history）训练，仅依赖一条TwinMarket轨迹；随后用语义输入交换、教师强制回放、部署解码评估及五种子内容×调度因子实验进行诊断性分析。
AI.result: 学生单卡8-GB GPU训练1,658秒，推理零教师/解码器调用、无文本生成，0.14 ms/决策；与教师余弦相似度0.943；跨智能体交换语义输入使64.7%决策改变（匹配供体仅12.8%），表明语义通道有效且"活跃"。教师强制回放平衡准确率0.8347，部署解码器0.7783 [0.766,0.791]，较无语义重训提升+2.2 [1.21,3.14]；相对教师自身重采样，第一轮R为97.1% [95.8,98.4]与92.3% [89.0,95.4]（R为诊断指标而非准确率）。因子研究显示增益主要由计划式自历史承载，打乱/常数内容对照亦可复现，而内容在教师强制条件下仍有影响。20种子、200,000决策扫描仅12分钟（教师需3小时）。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出并验证了分阶段语义蒸馏方法，可在极低算力下保留分阶段LLM智能体的非结构化语义并复现其决策分布，支撑大规模低成本仿真实验。设计准则为：优先投入部署阶段的调度设计，内容语义则在教师强制工作点上体现价值。工作属方法加案例研究，结论基于单一仿真器与单条轨迹。

title: Do We Still Need Fine-Tuned Classifiers? Swapping Typed Decision Models into 24 ACL-Venue Papers
summary: Typed Decision Models such as TypeSafe's Jev, also called System One or System 1 models, answer typed questions about an input with a probability for each option, and they need no training. Many NLP papers still fine-tune a task-specific classifier, and prompted large language models (LLMs) trail such classifiers on most text classification benchmarks. We ask how many of these fine-tuned classifiers a Typed Decision Model can replace under each paper's own evaluation, and what is needed where it cannot. We swap the predictors of 24 ACL-venue papers for Jev, keep each paper's splits, label definitions and metric, and check the results with Cloudflare's Clef, Microsoft-Decision-1 and OpenAI's GPT-6 Luna Decisions. The resulting 46 English test sets, with their questions and published scores, form the TDM-Gauntlet benchmark. With a zero-shot prompt, Jev directly replaced the paper's predictor on 12 of the 46 test sets, mostly single judgments with plain labels, but rarely where the paper's method was trained on its labels. Where Jev scored lower, we most often attributed the shortfall to an annotation convention that the label name does not state. With 500 training labels plus validation and no user-managed GPU, calibration and GEPA-style prompt optimization closed a median 72% of the gap to the paper's method, about twice what off-the-shelf GEPA closed, for a median $1.66 per search. On the same labels, fine-tuned encoders such as RoBERTa and DeBERTa closed 59%, and LoRA fine-tuning of the open LLM Qwen3.8-27B closed 97%. Fine-tuning remains the most accurate option, but a zero-shot prompt is often enough for plain labels, and prompt optimization closes most of the remaining gap.

AI.tldr: 用 Jev 等 Typed Decision Model 零样本替换 24 篇 ACL 论文的微调分类器，构建 46 个测试集的 TDM-Gauntlet；零样本可直接替换 12/46，提示优化在 500 标注下弥合中位 72% 差距，LoRA 微调达 97%。
AI.motivation: 文本分类中微调任务专用分类器仍是主流且多数 LLM 提示方法不及，作者希望量化无需训练的 Typed Decision Model（System 1）在各论文自身评测协议下能替代多少微调分类器，并明确不能替代时所需条件。
AI.method: 将 24 篇 ACL 论文的预测器替换为 Jev，保留各自数据划分、标签定义与指标，并用 Cloudflare Clef、Microsoft-Decision-1、OpenAI GPT-6 Luna Decisions 复核；形成含 46 个英文测试集及题目与已发表分数的 TDM-Gauntlet 基准；对比零样本提示、校准+GEPA 式提示优化（500 训练标签+验证，无自管 GPU）、现成 GEPA、RoBERTa/DeBERTa 微调与 Qwen3.8-27B LoRA。
AI.result: 零样本 Jev 直接替代 12/46，多为单一判断且标签直白；论文方法经标签训练处少有成功。低分主因归为标签名未体现的标注惯例。500 标签下校准+提示优化弥合中位 72% 差距（约为现成 GEPA 的两倍），搜索中位成本 $1.66；RoBERTa/DeBERTa 弥合 59%，Qwen3.8-27B LoRA 弥合 97%。
AI.conclusion: 微调仍最准确，但标签直白的任务零样本提示常已足够，提示优化可弥合大部分剩余差距；标注惯例是零样本失败的主要瓶颈。

title: HEAMS: Holistic Evaluation of Agent Memory Systems
comment: 69 pages (26 main text), 6 figures, 29 tables. Code: https://github.com/milatechtransfer/heams
summary: Memory systems allow AI agents to persist information across interactions, making them more personalized and more capable on long-horizon tasks. This persistence introduces new risks: stored information can be disclosed in inappropriate contexts, resist correction or deletion, be retained beyond what users desire, or be poisoned to influence later agent behaviour. Yet memory systems are typically evaluated on task performance and efficiency alone. We argue that a memory system should instead be understood as the custodian of its user's persistent information, with responsibilities that extend beyond helping an agent complete its tasks, and that it should be evaluated holistically against all such responsibilities. We present Holistic Evaluation of Agent Memory Systems (HEAMS), an open-source framework for evaluating agent memory systems in this way. First, we state the responsibilities of agent memory systems as explicit behavioural desiderata spanning performance, efficiency, security, privacy, and user sovereignty. Second, we assemble a benchmark suite that covers these desiderata and acknowledge the gaps that remain. Third, we develop MilaMem, a prototype memory system, and a governance layer that can wrap any memory system, enabling controlled study of memory system design choices. Fourth, we compare memory systems across the full HEAMS benchmark suite. We find that no memory system leads every performance benchmark, and strong performance scores may coexist with poor privacy, user-sovereignty, and security scores. Governance strongly influences results: recall policies can reduce inappropriate disclosure at a cost in helpfulness, while both recall and retention policies improve poisoning resistance. Performance and efficiency benchmarks alone therefore cannot reveal how well a memory system meets its responsibilities. Code: https://github.com/milatechtransfer/heams

AI.tldr: 论文提出HEAMS框架，将AI智能体记忆系统视为用户持久信息的"托管者"，从性能、效率、安全、隐私与用户主权五个维度进行整体评估，并指出仅靠性能与效率基准无法揭示记忆系统是否履行其责任。
AI.motivation: 记忆系统让AI智能体跨交互持久化信息，从而更个性化、更擅长长时程任务，但也引入新风险：信息在不恰当情境下被披露、抗拒纠正或删除、超出用户意愿被保留、被投毒以影响后续行为。然而现有记忆系统通常仅以任务性能与效率评估，忽视了这些责任。
AI.method: 作者构建开源框架HEAMS，包含四部分：(1) 将记忆系统责任表述为跨性能、效率、安全、隐私、用户主权的显式行为期望；(2) 构建覆盖这些期望的基准套件并说明尚存空白；(3) 开发原型记忆系统MilaMem及可包裹任意记忆系统的治理层，以受控研究设计选择；(4) 在完整基准套件上横向比较多种记忆系统。
AI.result: 没有记忆系统在所有性能基准上领先，且高性能分数可能伴随较差的隐私、用户主权与安全分数。治理层对结果影响显著：召回策略可降低不当披露但以有用性为代价；召回与保留策略均能提升抗投毒能力。
AI.conclusion: 仅凭性能与效率基准无法判断记忆系统是否履行其作为用户信息托管者的责任，需要采用HEAMS式的整体评估；治理策略在隐私、安全与有用性之间存在明确权衡，应纳入设计考量。

title: GPRM: Global Perspective Process Reward Model
summary: Process Reward Models (PRMs) are widely used for step-level evaluation of multi-step reasoning in large language models, but existing methods are often limited by weak historical dependency modeling and insufficient global awareness. They typically fail to leverage prior step evaluations for coherent judgment and lack visibility into subsequent reasoning, leading to suboptimal assessment of intermediate steps. To address this issue, we propose the Global Perspective Process Reward Model (GPRM), which jointly models the problem, previous reasoning steps and their evaluations, the current step, and future steps to enable history-aware and globally informed process evaluation. We further introduce a structured evaluation framework along four dimensions---look back, look ahead, self-check, and goal alignment---to assess prior consistency, future plausibility, step validity, and task alignment. Based on this framework, we construct datasets for supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and reinforcement learning (GRPO). Experiments show that, despite using less training data and smaller model sizes, GPRM outperforms strong baseline models by 7.8 and 5.4 points on PRMBench and ProcessBench, respectively. GPRM also generalizes well across tasks, surpassing the GPT-4.1 baseline on Agent Error Bench, improving strong baselines by around 4 points under test-time scaling (TTS), and achieving competitive performance on PPE.

AI.tldr: 提出全局视角过程奖励模型GPRM，联合建模问题、历史步骤及其评价、当前步与未来步，实现历史感知与全局感知的过程评估。
AI.motivation: 现有过程奖励模型（PRM）存在历史依赖建模薄弱、缺乏全局视野两大缺陷：未能利用前序步骤的评价做连贯判断，也无法看到后续推理，导致中间步骤评估次优。
AI.method: GPRM将问题、前序推理步骤及其评价、当前步骤、未来步骤联合输入建模；构建"回望（look back）、前瞻（look ahead）、自检（self-check）、目标对齐（goal alignment）"四维结构化评价框架，分别评估前序一致性、未来合理性、步骤有效性与任务对齐度；据此构建SFT与强化学习（GRPO）数据集训练模型。
AI.result: 在训练数据更少、模型规模更小的条件下，于PRMBench和ProcessBench上分别领先强基线7.8分和5.4分；在Agent Error Bench上超过GPT-4.1基线；测试时扩展（TTS）下较强基线提升约4分；在PPE上取得有竞争力表现，跨任务泛化良好。
AI.conclusion: 双向（历史+未来）上下文与显式结构化维度设计能显著提升步骤级评估质量，且在小模型、少数据条件下仍具优势，具备良好跨任务泛化性。

title: Can LLMs Give Good Product Advice? A Framework for Diagnosing Failures
summary: Evaluating product advice from a language model requires assessing whether the recommendation meets the user's needs and identifying where the model falls short when it does not. However, matching a product mentioned in an online reply cannot answer either question on its own: several products may be suitable, and the recorded answer may itself be poor advice. When shown a community-listed alternative alongside their own sampled car recommendation, six models prefer the alternative in 1.9 to 6.5 percent of eligible disagreements, consistently across both source-blind presentation orders. We propose a diagnostic framework that separates the user's stated needs, the model's added assumptions, candidate generation, filtering, and final choice, with 19 possible failure modes and the evidence needed to assess them. We apply this framework to product-advice data and to a separate product-selection task with externally assigned relevance labels. The experiments distinguish naming a community-listed product from selecting it and show how answer extraction and candidate-list construction affect the outcome.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个诊断框架，将产品建议生成拆解为需求陈述、模型假设、候选生成、过滤与最终选择五个阶段，含19种失败模式及证据需求，并据此区分"提及产品"与"选择产品"。
AI.motivation: 评估语言模型的产品建议需要判断推荐是否满足用户需求、并定位模型不足之处；但简单匹配在线回复中出现的产品无法回答这两个问题——多个产品可能都合适，且被记录的答案本身也可能是糟糕建议。
AI.method: 构建分阶段诊断框架（用户明示需求、模型附加假设、候选生成、过滤、最终选择），定义19种失败模式及对应评估证据；将框架应用于产品建议数据及一个带外部相关性标签的产品选择任务；并进行无来源盲测的双向呈现顺序实验对比六种模型。
AI.result: 在符合条件的"分歧"样本中，当展示社区列出的替代方案与模型自身采样的汽车推荐时，六个模型在1.9%至6.5%的比例上更偏好该替代方案，且结果在两种来源盲的呈现顺序下保持一致；实验还显示答案抽取与候选列表构建会影响最终结果。
AI.conclusion: 该框架可将"提及社区列出的产品"与"真正选择该产品"区分开来，为产品建议评估提供更细粒度的失败诊断，并揭示评估流程中抽取与候选构造环节对结论的影响。

title: ANCHOR: Cluster-Grounded 5W1H Extraction via Large-Small Model Collaboration
summary: Deep semantic understanding of events requires recognizing related events and distinguishing why an event occurs from how it is carried out. 5W1H extraction provides a structured foundation for such understanding by organizing event information around six fundamental questions. However, single-event slot filling provides limited support for these distinctions. We propose ANCHOR, a cluster-grounded framework that combines a large language model (LLM) with a small language model equipped with discriminative heads for accurate 5W1H extraction. The LLM proposes candidate events and generates their initial 4W records, which guide the selection of an event cluster and the subsequent anchoring of its main event. A shared document encoder provides evidence for joint 4W refinement, and two separate sets of boundary and role-scoring heads then extract why and how under event-specific constraints, respectively. Document representations are reused across events and stages, and unsupported roles can remain empty. Following the same principles, an agent-and-skill annotation workflow constructs a benchmark of 26,110 documents from ten source corpora covering three languages and seven domains. We select nine of the resulting datasets to evaluate ANCHOR against strong baselines using four open-weight LLMs. ANCHOR achieves competitive performance. The datasets and code are available at https://github.com/revolution6575/ANCHOR-5W1H.

AI.tldr: 提出ANCHOR：LLM提出候选事件与初始4W记录，引导事件簇选择与主事件锚定；小型语言模型配判别式头，共享文档编码器联合精炼4W，两组边界与角色打分头分别抽取why与how；并构建跨3语言7领域、26,110文档的5W1H基准。
AI.motivation: 深度事件语义理解需识别相关事件，并区分事件"为何发生"（why）与"如何实施"（how）。单事件槽填充难以支撑这种区分，而5W1H抽取可为结构化理解提供基础。
AI.method: 聚类锚定框架：LLM生成候选事件及初始4W记录，指导事件簇选择与主事件锚定；共享文档编码器为4W联合精炼提供证据；两组独立的边界与角色打分头在事件特定约束下分别抽取why与how；文档表示跨事件、跨阶段复用，无支撑角色可留空。另用agent+skill标注流程构建基准。
AI.result: 构建26,110篇文档的基准，涵盖10个源语料、3种语言、7个领域；选取其中9个数据集，以4个开源权重LLM为基线对比，ANCHOR取得有竞争力的性能。
AI.conclusion: 以事件簇为锚、LLM与小模型分工协作的框架可有效完成5W1H抽取并区分why/how；数据与代码已公开。

title: Evaluating Cultural Reasoning and Robustness in LLMs for Spanish Political Discourse
comment: Accepted for publication in Latin American Conference on Informatics (CLEI 2026)
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to interpret, generate, and mediate public-facing language, which makes their reliability especially consequential in politically sensitive settings. Although sentiment analysis is a common task in this area, affective meaning in social media discourse is often conveyed through culturally situated and pragmatically indirect cues that are not well captured by label-centric evaluation alone. In this paper, we evaluate the robustness of LLMs for sentiment analysis of Spanish political discourse from social media, with emphasis on culturally situated affective interpretation. We introduce a diagnostic protocol that combines three independent human annotation views into Gold and Ambiguous subsets, and extends the corpus with a Synthetic subset built from sentiment-flipped counterfactuals selected through model-conditioned perplexity and LLM-as-a-judge criteria. Using this framework, we compare proprietary and open-weight models under zero-shot and few-shot prompting, focusing on predictive robustness across human agreement conditions and counterfactual shift. Our results show that annotation ambiguity and counterfactual perturbation reveal failure modes that conventional evaluation on the original corpus tends to obscure. GPT-4.1-mini remains the most stable among the evaluated models, whereas the two smaller open-weight models degrade more markedly under synthetic perturbations, and few-shot prompting provides only limited gains. Overall, the paper contributes a reproducible protocol for robustness-oriented evaluation in political sentiment analysis, an empirical characterization of model behavior under ambiguity and sentiment-flipped counterfactuals, and a publicly available Spanish social media dataset with three-way human sentiment annotations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个面向西班牙语政治社交媒体话语情感分析的鲁棒性诊断协议，融合三路人工标注（Gold/Ambiguous子集）与基于困惑度和LLM-as-a-judge筛选的情感翻转反事实合成子集，比较商用与开源模型在零样本/少样本下的表现，揭示传统评估所掩盖的失效模式。
AI.motivation: LLM越来越多地用于解读与生成面向公众的语言，其可靠性在政治敏感场景中后果重大。而社交媒体中的情感意义常通过文化情境化与语用间接线索传达，单一以标签为中心的评估难以捕捉；同时标注歧义与反事实扰动对模型鲁棒性的影响尚未被系统刻画。
AI.method: 构建诊断协议：将三名独立人工标注整合为Gold与Ambiguous两个子集；通过模型条件困惑度与LLM-as-a-judge准则筛选情感翻转反事实，扩展出Synthetic子集；在零样本与少样本提示下比较专有模型与开源权重模型，评估其在人工一致度条件下的预测鲁棒性与反事实偏移。
AI.result: 标注歧义与反事实扰动揭示了在原始语料上常规评估所掩盖的失效模式。GPT-4.1-mini在受评模型中最为稳定，两个较小的开源权重模型在合成扰动下退化更明显，少样本提示仅带来有限增益。
AI.conclusion: 论文贡献三点：可复现的、面向鲁棒性评估的政治情感分析协议；模型在歧义与情感翻转反事实下行为的实证刻画；以及公开可得的、含三路人工情感标注的西班牙语社交媒体数据集。

title: Embedding Cosine Measures Text Length Before It Measures Homogenization
comment: 11 pages, 10 figures, 2 tables. Re-measurement of arXiv:2608.13674
summary: Mean pairwise cosine similarity between transformer embeddings is a standard measure of whether online discourse is converging under generative AI. When the embeddings are mean-pooled outputs of an encoder never trained for sentence similarity, this measure mostly tracks text length. In 6.06 million Reddit comments, an uncentered DeBERTa-v3 measure had suggested that only conservative discourse broke toward homogeneity after late 2022. Truncating the same comments from 10 to 150 words raises their mean cosine by eight times the reported break. A placebo that swaps every comment for a random one of equal length reproduces 81% of the asymmetry, and a fixed-content simulation reproduces 78%. The leading principal direction carries 99.9% of raw DeBERTa homogeneity, and once length is handled the asymmetry disappears under every encoder. On 575,000 Stack Exchange answers the measure reports a post-ChatGPT homogenization of technical sites that the placebo fully reproduces, although answers grew longer. A census of 31 studies locates the risk where anisotropic encoders meet time-series or length-unequal designs. A reverse control on a well-known experiment shows that centering with renormalization can reverse a genuine effect. I propose a low-cost diagnostic protocol.
