AI.method: 形式化定义"救济有效性"：在不改变请求内容的前提下，仅改变解释所指涉的条件即可翻转决定。给出该性质的精确算法，并用命中集论证仅从策略本身即可预测"正确理由为何失效"。在七个规则系统（源自访问控制与美国福利资格）上验证，并对20个LLM采用两种校验（计算式/LLM-judge判断理由正确性）及一种"按解释行动是否奏效"的判断进行对比实验。
AI.result: 七个规则系统中六个上，当多条理由同时适用时，单一正确理由几乎从不提供救济。20个LLM对"所引理由是否正确"的校验（计算或judge提问）识别该失效的能力接近随机，与理论预测一致；而询问"按该解释行动是否有效"的强judge能够识别。更强的与推理型模型表现更好，但在含四个及以上独立理由的拒绝上仍大量失败。要求模型列出全部规则对每个仍有提升空间的开放模型都有帮助。
AI.conclusion: 资格类决定的解释应直接由决策函数构造，并以"据此行动是否奏效"作为评估标准，而非仅检查理由的正确性。理由正确不等于解释有用，现有LLM解释评估范式存在系统性盲区。

title: Train After You Measure: a Pre-Registered Learning Curve for Fine-Tuning Typed Decision Models on One User's Labels
comment: 9 pages, 1 figure, 6 tables. Companion to arXiv:2610.32955. Pre-registered study; code at https://github.com/federicolucca/foyer-measure (tag v2.4; registrations in prereg/); weights and data not released
summary: Fine-tuning a small typed decision model on one user's email labels did not clear the margin we pre-registered over a logistic regression trained on the same labels. In earlier work, about two hundred labels and a TF-IDF logistic regression had the highest point accuracy on this inbox, though not significantly above the best hosted model; we ask whether the same labels, given to a decision model, close the gap. A first registered study, on a generic 4B base with cross-validation and message type only, stayed below the baseline at every label budget (-1.8 to -7.3 points). The main study was registered before any fine-tuning run: a fixed test set of 135 emails never used for selection, LoRA adapters on the public Tev1-0.8B and Tev1-4B decision models, nested subsets of 50 to 587 labels, two seeds and five decision fields on a free T4 GPU. Four of its five hypotheses are refuted--two in the fine-tunes' favour--and one is confirmed for one model. On message type the 4B model misses the registered three-point margin at 400 labels (+2.6) and passes it with all 587 (+3.3); with all labels both models are above the baseline by +0.7 and +3.3 points, where one email is 0.74 points and a 95% interval is about 15 points wide, and the 4B model is clearly ahead in type macro-F1 (0.581 vs. 0.406). On the three action switches the baseline is ahead at every label budget for both models (0.931 vs. 0.904 and 0.899 mean accuracy with all labels), at under a millisecond per question against 306 and 1681 ms. The 0.8B type curve barely improves after 300 labels and then falls. The baseline never predicts the two rarest classes (7 offers and 8 spam in the training pool); the fine-tuned models find spam in some runs, not consistently across seeds. We list the explanations we did not test and say when a new attempt would be worth making. Scripts are public; weights and emails are not.

AI.tldr: 在一封用户邮箱上，用同样的标注微调小型专用决策模型（Tev1-0.8B/4B，LoRA）能否超过TF-IDF逻辑回归基线：预注册研究显示五个假设中四个被否定，仅4B模型在message type上通过三点边际，行动开关任务基线全面领先且延迟远低。
AI.motivation: 此前约200条标注下TF-IDF逻辑回归在本邮箱取得最高点精度（虽未显著优于最佳托管模型）。作者检验：把同样的标注交给专用决策模型，能否弥补与基线之间的差距，并以预注册方式进行严格对照。
AI.method: 先做一个注册研究（通用4B基座、交叉验证、仅message type，各标注预算均低于基线）；主研究在任何微调前注册：固定135封邮件测试集（从不用于选择）、对公开的Tev1-0.8B与Tev1-4B决策模型加LoRA适配器、50–587条标注的嵌套子集、两个随机种子、五个决策字段、免费T4 GPU；评估精度、macro-F1与单题延迟。
AI.result: 五个假设中四个被否定（其中两个否定方向对微调模型有利），一个对一个模型成立。message type上：4B在400标签时+2.6未达三点边际，587全量时+3.3通过；全量标签下两模型分别高于基线+0.7与+3.3点（单封邮件=0.74点，95%区间约±15点），4B的type macro-F1明显领先（0.581 vs 0.406）。三个action开关上基线在每个预算均领先（全量均值精度0.931 vs 0.904/0.899），且单题<1ms vs 306ms与1681ms。0.8B的type曲线在300标签后几乎不再提升并随后下降。基线从不预测最稀少的两类（训练池中7条offer、8条spam），微调模型部分运行能找出spam但跨种子不稳定。
AI.conclusion: 在稀疏标注与高方差（区间约±15点）下，专用决策模型微调未能稳定超越简单TF-IDF逻辑回归，尤其在高频、结构化的action开关任务上基线在精度与延迟上均占优；仅4B在message type的全量标签下表现出边际性优势与更好的macro-F1。作者列出未检验的解释，并说明何种条件下值得再次尝试；脚本公开，权重与邮件不公开。

title: Validating LLM-Based Essay Scorers: A Comparative Analysis in Critical Online Reasoning in Medical Education
summary: Automated essay scorers (AES) based on large language models (LLMs) promise human-level accuracy. However, training, fine-tuning, and evaluating LLMs for specific assessment tasks is costly. In particular, the question arises whether these AES should be trained for specific domains or whether models based on generic LLMs might be sufficient. Human annotations, by contrast, are often more valid but far more expensive. This study evaluates whether ensembles of AES systems based on general-purpose LLMs can approximate human ratings of medical-education writing tasks by leveraging encoded linguistic and conceptual knowledge. The goal is to assess whether general-purpose models are applicable for assisting or potentially replacing human annotation in this domain. We experiment with 11 AES systems and 8 different LLMs and evaluate 668 student responses to 12 tasks, using \numprint{2076} evaluations by 7 human annotators. These ratings are aggregated to create consistent performance levels that can be used as target classes for classifiers trained on AES outputs. Our results show that learner classes based on human ratings can be accurately reconstructed using a linear SVM trained on a small set of AES features. A single classifier generalized well across tasks and domains, with reasoning and content features being most predictive. This suggests that out-of-the-box LLMs, even without domain-specific fine-tuning, can support automatic essay grading in medical education. While individual AES systems are insufficient alone, their combination approximates human evaluators, pointing to a reduced need for manual scoring or its supplementation with automated methods.

AI.tldr: 该研究评估由通用大语言模型（LLM）构建的自动作文评分系统（AES）集成能否逼近医学教育写作任务的人工评分，结果表明基于少量AES特征的线性SVM可准确重建人工评分的学习者等级，且单一分类器跨任务泛化良好。
AI.motivation: AES虽被宣称可达人类水平精度，但针对特定评估任务训练、微调与评测LLM成本高昂；人工标注有效性更高但代价更大。核心疑问是：AES是否需要领域专门训练，还是基于通用LLM的模型即已足够，以及能否借此辅助甚至替代本领域的人工标注。
AI.method: 实验采用11个AES系统与8种不同LLM，对12个任务下668份学生作答进行评估，并利用7名人工标注者的2076次评测；将人工评分聚合为一致的表现层级，作为以AES输出为特征训练的分类器的目标类别，再以线性SVM进行分类。
AI.result: 基于人工评分的学习者等级可由在少量AES特征上训练的线性SVM准确重建；单一分类器在任务与领域间泛化良好，其中推理与内容特征最具预测力。单个AES系统单独使用不足，但其组合可逼近人工评分者。
AI.conclusion: 即用型（out-of-the-box）LLM即使未经领域特定微调，也能支持医学教育中的自动作文评分，从而减少人工评分需求或作为其补充手段。

title: Living Context Graphs: Continual Semantic Learning for Enterprise Data Reasoning
comment: 22 pages, 5 figures. Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Continual Learning in the Era of Foundation Models and Embodied Agents. Data splits and annotations: https://github.com/varunagrawal2002/Living-Context-Graph
summary: Enterprise AI can now perform analytics, reporting, and data-driven workflows, yet the data foundations it relies on remain hard to operationalize: business meaning, relationships, metric definitions, and reporting conventions are absent from database schemas and scattered across undocumented systems and tribal knowledge. We introduce the Living Context Graph (LCG), a continually learned context layer that makes existing enterprise data operational for AI without requiring a copy or transformation of the underlying warehouse. LCG bootstraps base semantics and relationships from the data itself, builds a concept graph that indexes business context as queries are served, writes durable semantic learnings from verified outcomes, and withdraws or re-earns context when later outcomes contradict prior routes. We evaluate LCG through text-to-SQL, a core data-reasoning task, on a transfer-aware split of three BIRD databases comprising 499 questions: 353 form the learning history and 146 are held out and never used to update the context layer. Bootstrapping alone improves overall accuracy by +4.6 percentage points. Learning only from the history raises accuracy on the untouched held-out transfer set by +22.6 points (95% CI [+14.4, +30.8]), exceeding five-shot retrieval from the same history by +12.3 points. Incremental learning reaches the one-shot endpoint within observed evaluation noise on every database. Ablating the graph changes held-out accuracy by at most one question per database but increases per-query cost 2.3-3.3x and median latency 1.8-3.4x: continually learned semantics drive accuracy, while the graph makes that context efficient to serve.

AI.tldr: 提出Living Context Graph (LCG)——一种持续学习的语义上下文层，使企业现有数据仓库无需复制或转换即可为AI提供业务语义，在text-to-SQL任务上显著提升准确率并降低服务成本。
AI.motivation: 企业AI已能完成分析、报表与数据驱动工作流，但其依赖的数据基础难以运营化：业务含义、实体关系、指标定义与报表惯例并未存在于数据库schema中，而是散落在未文档化的系统和口口相传的经验（tribal knowledge）里，导致语义上下文缺失、难以服务化。
AI.method: LCG从数据本身自举（bootstrap）基础语义与关系，构建概念图，在查询服务过程中将业务上下文索引进图；将经验证结果中的语义学习持久化写入；当后续结果与既有路由矛盾时，撤销或重新赢得该上下文。评估采用text-to-SQL任务，在三个BIRD数据库的迁移感知划分（499问，353为学习历史、146为从不参与上下文更新的留出集）上测试，并与五-shot检索、增量学习、图消融对比。
AI.result: 仅自举即提升整体准确率+4.6个百分点；仅从历史学习可使未触碰的留出迁移集准确率提升+22.6个百分点（95% CI [+14.4, +30.8]），超出同历史五-shot检索+12.3个百分点；增量学习在每个数据库上均在观测噪声范围内达到一次性学习端点。消融图结构对留出准确率影响至多每题一个数据库，但使单查询成本增至2.3–3.3倍、中位延迟增至1.8–3.4倍。
AI.conclusion: 持续学习的语义是准确率提升的驱动因素，而概念图使该上下文得以高效服务；LCG为企业数据提供了可运营、可持续演进的AI上下文层。

title: Who Writes the Codebook? An Eight-Step Framework for Auditing LLM-Generated Category Systems
summary: Large language models (LLMs) increasingly create the categories through which qualitative evidence is interpreted. Existing coding benchmarks often hold these categories fixed. We propose the Qualitative Variance Audit Framework, an eight-step method that compares codebook creation, repeated application and code distributions under controlled inputs. It combines model-owned and shared-reference codebooks to distinguish variation in the overall pipeline from application differences within a common category system. An application to 668 organisational interviews, 13,166 text units and eight models from five vendors yields 48 codebooks and 270 coding runs. Models create markedly different category structures; mean within-model reliability ranges from .76 to .92, whereas between-model agreement on the shared codebook is about .69. The framework complements LLM-assisted grounded theory by exposing model dependencies before substantive interpretation. It assesses reliability and representational consequences, not interpretive validity or the quality of resulting theory.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"定性变异审计框架"（Qualitative Variance Audit Framework），用八步方法在受控输入下比较LLM的编码本创建、重复应用与编码分布，以区分整条流水线的变异与共同类别体系内的应用差异。
AI.motivation: LLM日益参与生成用于解读定性证据的类别，而现有编码基准通常将这些类别固定不变，因而无法揭示模型本身对类别构建的依赖性与潜在偏差。
AI.method: 八步审计框架，结合"模型自有编码本"与"共享参考编码本"，在控制输入条件下比较编码本生成、重复编码应用及编码分布；应用于668份组织访谈、13,166个文本单元、来自5家厂商的8个模型。
AI.result: 共生成48个编码本、执行270次编码运行。不同模型生成的类别结构差异显著；模型内平均信度介于.76–.92，而共享编码本上的模型间一致性约为.69。
AI.conclusion: 该框架补足了LLM辅助扎根理论方法，可在实质性解读前暴露模型依赖性；其评估范围限于信度与表征性后果，不涵盖解释效度或所得理论的质量。

title: Risk-certified prompt optimization for LLM-as-a-judge guardrails
summary: LLM-as-a-judge guardrails are often controlled primarily through system prompts, yet standard prompt optimization methods target average performance rather than explicit safety constraints. This paper studies system-prompt selection as a constrained optimization problem: maximize benign pass rate while keeping the missed-attack rate below a user-specified level α with finite-sample statistical control. The framework combines LLM-based judging, automatic prompt generation, and distribution-free risk certification. This work instantiates it in two procedures: CPS and CRISP. CPS generates a fixed pool of prompts from training data, then certifies candidates on a held-out evaluation set using simultaneous upper confidence bounds and selects the certified prompt with the highest benign utility. CRISP instead integrates risk feedback into an adaptive search, using hard example-guided rewriting and a reusable-holdout interface to steer generation toward the feasible utility frontier. Experiments on four datasets covering prompt injection, system-prompt leakage, and sensitive-information disclosure show that risk-certified selection consistently respects the target missed-attack level on heldout tests, while utility improves as the permitted risk is relaxed. CRISP is especially useful when fixed-pool search fails to produce certifiable high-utility candidates.

AI.tldr: 该论文将LLM-as-a-judge护栏的系统提示选择建模为带约束的优化问题：在有限样本统计保证下将漏报攻击率控制在用户指定水平α以内，同时最大化正常样本通过率，并提出CPS与CRISP两种流程实现该框架。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM护栏主要依赖系统提示控制，但标准提示优化方法以平均性能为目标，缺乏对明确安全约束的显式控制，无法保证漏报攻击率不超过给定阈值。
AI.method: 框架结合LLM评判、自动提示生成与无分布风险认证。CPS从训练数据生成固定提示池，在留出评估集上用同时置信上界进行认证，并选择通过认证且正常效用最高的提示；CRISP则把风险反馈融入自适应搜索，通过难例引导改写与可复用留出接口，将生成导向可行效用前沿。
AI.result: 在覆盖提示注入、系统提示泄露和敏感信息泄露的四类数据集上，风险认证式选择在留出测试中持续满足目标漏报攻击水平，且随着允许风险的放宽，效用相应提升；当固定池搜索无法产生可认证的高效用候选时，CRISP尤为有效。
AI.conclusion: 将系统提示选择视为带统计风险约束的优化问题可行且有效，CPS适用于固定池的认证筛选，CRISP适用于难以认证场景下的自适应搜索，二者共同实现风险可控与效用最大化的平衡。

title: Centered Ablation: Why Last-Layer Directional Ablation Under-Fires or Collapses, and a Closed-Form Fix
summary: Directional ablation removes a hidden state's component along a "behaviour direction" while a language model runs. It is the standard way to switch a behaviour such as refusal off, but it is erratic: on some models it barely fires, on others the text collapses into repetition. We show why, and fix it. At the last residual stream, ablation is exactly a logit bias: a fixed vocabulary footprint scaled by a gate, the cosine between the hidden state and the direction. The gate is measured from the origin, but last-layer states share a large common mode far from it, so a direction that overlaps the common mode fires on benign text and under-fires on its targets. Centered Ablation (CA) projects the common mode out of the direction, in closed form. Across 8 models, CA raises attack success by 29 and 46 points where the standard recipe under-fires, cuts collapse on Gemma-2-9B from 50\% to 1\%, and preserves 12 to 40 points more benign answers on high-overlap models, 39 to 46 more than the affine offset of prior work. Two numbers computed before generation predict, on models the analysis had not seen, which gain faithfulness and which gain attack success, and a collapse index marks when text degenerates. We also show that two standard safety judges score collapsed text in opposite directions, which can fabricate a 46-point effect.

AI.tldr: 方向性消融在最后一层残差流上等价于一个由余弦门控缩放的固定logit偏置；由于末层隐状态存在远离原点的强共模分量，门控测量失准导致消融要么不触发、要么文本崩塌。作者提出闭式解的中心化消融（Centered Ablation, CA），在8个模型上显著提升攻击成功率、大幅降低崩塌率并更好保留良性回答，并给出两个生成前可计算的预测指标与一个崩塌指数。
AI.motivation: 方向性消融是关闭拒答等行为的标准手段，但表现不稳定：部分模型几乎不触发，另一些模型文本退化为重复。作者希望解释这种失效机理并给出可修复方案。
AI.method: 将末层残差流上的消融刻画为"固定词表足迹 × 门控（隐状态与方向的余弦）"形式的logit偏置；指出门控自原点测量，而末层状态共享一个远离原点的强共模分量，故方向若与共模重叠，会在良性文本上误触发、在目标文本上欠触发。CA在闭式解下把共模从方向中投影剔除。
AI.result: 在8个模型上：标准配方欠触发处，CA分别提升攻击成功率29与46个百分点；Gemma-2-9B上崩塌率由50%降至1%；高重叠模型上多保留12–40个百分点的良性回答，比先前工作的仿射偏移多39–46个百分点。两个生成前计算的数值可在未见模型上预测哪类模型获益于忠实性、哪类获益于攻击成功率；崩塌指数可标记文本退化。此外，两种标准安全评判器对崩塌文本打分方向相反，可能伪造46个百分点的效应。
AI.conclusion: 方向性消融的不稳定性源于末层共模分量与门控原点测量的错配，可通过对方向做闭式中心化投影统一修复；同时提示评测崩塌文本时需警惕评判器方向不一致导致的虚假效应。

title: Large Language Models for AI Infrastructure
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to design, optimize, and operate the infrastructure behind AI training and serving, yet the literature remains fragmented across hardware design, machine learning systems, electronic design automation, and high-performance computing. We present a comprehensive survey of LLM-assisted AI infrastructure across its lifecycle, from accelerator design and kernel engineering to compilation, deployment, operations, data management, and energy optimization. We organize the literature by the primary resource the LLM manages: artifact-centric methods for computational artifacts, operational-centric methods for deployment context and system state, and resource-centric methods for data and energy. These categories span the lifecycle and cover AI-specific concerns such as distributed-training configuration, inference serving, GPU-cluster scheduling, and data loading. Building on this taxonomy, we conduct a cross-study quantitative synthesis of reported results. Because studies adopt heterogeneous benchmarks, baselines, hardware, and metrics, we compare methods only where evaluation conditions permit and align results along common dimensions: functional correctness, execution performance, throughput, resource and energy consumption, operational outcomes, and optimization cost, keeping each result's native metric, baseline, and setting rather than collapsing them into a single score. This comparison reveals where LLM-driven methods yield consistent gains, how reported gains in workload orchestration depend on the evaluation environment, from simulators to real clusters and production, and where evidence is still lacking. Together, the taxonomy, lifecycle perspective, and quantitative evaluation provide an evidence-grounded reference for LLM-driven engineering of AI infrastructure.

AI.tldr: 本文是LLM辅助AI基础设施全生命周期的综述，提出以"LLM所管理的主要资源"为轴的三类分类法（artifact-centric、operational-centric、resource-centric），并在保持原始评测条件的前提下开展跨研究的定量综合。
AI.motivation: LLM已广泛用于AI训练与推理基础设施的设计、优化与运维，但相关文献分散在硬件设计、机器学习系统、电子设计自动化（EDA）与高性能计算等社区，缺乏统一视角与可比的证据梳理。
AI.method: 按LLM所管理的主要资源构建分类法：1）面向计算制品的artifact-centric方法；2）面向部署上下文与系统状态的operational-centric方法；3）面向数据与能耗的resource-centric方法。覆盖加速器设计、kernel工程、编译、部署、运维、数据管理与能耗优化，并涵盖分布式训练配置、推理服务、GPU集群调度、数据加载等AI特有问题。在此基础上进行跨研究定量综合：仅在评测条件可比时比较，沿功能正确性、执行性能、吞吐、资源与能耗、运维成效、优化成本等共同维度对齐，并保留各结果的原生指标、基线与设置而非压缩为单一分数。
AI.result: 定量综合揭示了LLM驱动方法取得一致增益的环节；指明工作负载编排类收益对评测环境（模拟器、真实集群、生产环境）的依赖程度；并识别出证据仍显不足的空白区域。
AI.conclusion: 分类法、生命周期视角与尊重原始条件的定量评估共同构成了LLM驱动AI基础设施工程的循证参考，为该交叉领域提供了统一框架与可比证据基础。

title: When Should Decision Models Compare Candidates?
summary: Language-model agents frequently select among candidate actions, such as tools and web elements. Should decision models score candidates independently or allow their scores to depend on other candidates? We investigate this question by comparing three approaches: Pointwise scoring, Setwise scoring, and Candidate Attention. Across five agent-decision benchmarks, Pointwise scoring remains competitive, while Setwise scoring performs better on some tool-selection and binary-decision tasks. Candidate Attention does not consistently improve upon Pointwise scoring, despite allowing cross-candidate interaction. Using two controlled synthetic tasks, we further examine whether models learn to use candidate-set information. With targeted relational training, Setwise models learn candidate dependencies and generalize to shifted inputs, while Candidate Attention shows weaker transfer. Our results show that access to other candidates does not guarantee effective comparison, and that its benefits depend on both task requirements and training.

AI.tldr: 本文系统比较了语言模型智能体在候选动作选择中的三种打分方式：逐点打分、集合打分和候选注意力；结果表明，逐点打分仍具竞争力，集合打分在部分任务上更优，而候选注意力虽允许候选间交互却未带来稳定增益，是否能利用候选集合信息取决于任务需求与训练方式。
AI.motivation: 语言模型智能体常需在工具、网页元素等候选动作中做出选择，但“独立打分”与“允许分数依赖其他候选”哪种决策范式更有效尚不明确，作者希望厘清候选集合信息的实际价值及其条件。
AI.method: 在五个智能体决策基准上对比三种方法：Pointwise scoring（逐点独立打分）、Setwise scoring（集合联合打分）与 Candidate Attention（候选间注意力交互）；并设计两个受控合成任务，检验模型是否真正学会利用候选集合信息，包括针对性关系训练与输入偏移下的泛化测试。
AI.result: 逐点打分在五个基准上保持竞争力；集合打分在部分工具选择与二元决策任务上表现更好；候选注意力未能稳定超越逐点打分。合成任务中，经针对性关系训练后集合打分模型能学到候选依赖关系并泛化到偏移输入，而候选注意力的迁移能力较弱。
AI.conclusion: 获得其他候选的信息并不保证有效比较；候选集合交互带来的收益依赖于具体任务要求与训练方式，而非由架构本身自动实现。

title: Instant Weight-Space Consolidation for Long-Term Memory in LLMs
summary: Agentic memory systems give LLMs persistent memory by extracting experience into text and retrieving it at query time, but the model itself does not evolve: however many interactions it has had, it starts each query the same. Extraction errors compound, implicit cross-session patterns that no single fragment states cannot be surfaced, and the construction cost grows with every conversation. Fine-tuning on past interactions does change the weights, but requires backpropagation at serving time and degrades on long histories. We introduce CLAM (Carried Latent Adapter Memory), which combines the strengths of both: a recurrent hypernetwork performs parametric consolidation, compiling a stream of session activations into a low-rank adapter in a single forward pass with no gradient steps and no language-model generation calls, while a complementary episodic buffer supplies verbatim detail at inference. A gated latent state carries knowledge across sessions in fixed size, so the parametric memory accumulates without growing. On LoCoMo and LongMemEval-S across three open models (2-7B parameters), CLAM leads all agentic baselines by 1-45 points and all gradient-based parametric methods by 10-45 points, while requiring zero generative LLM calls, zero gradient steps, and 3-151x less wall-clock time than extraction systems to build its memory. The two channels are complementary: the consolidated adapter adds 12-15 accuracy points when the episodic buffer misses the gold evidence, and still adds 4-5 points even with an oracle buffer.

AI.tldr: CLAM 用循环超网络在单次前向中把会话激活编译为低秩适配器，实现无梯度、无生成调用的参数化记忆巩固，并辅以片段化缓存提供原文细节。
AI.motivation: 现有 Agentic memory 仅把经验存为文本并在查询时检索，模型权重本身不演化，导致抽取误差累积、跨会话隐式模式无法浮现、构建成本随对话线性增长；而直接用微调更新权重又需在服务时反向传播，且长历史下性能退化。
AI.method: CLAM（Carried Latent Adapter Memory）双通道设计：(1) 循环超网络对会话激活流做参数化巩固，单次前向直接生成低秩适配器，无梯度步、无 LLM 生成调用；(2) 门控隐状态以固定大小跨会话传递知识，使参数化记忆累积而不增长；(3) 互补的片段化缓存（episodic buffer）在推理时提供逐字细节。
AI.result: 在 LoCoMo 与 LongMemEval-S 上、三个 2–7B 开源模型上，CLAM 领先所有 agentic 基线 1–45 分、领先所有基于梯度的参数化方法 10–45 分；构建记忆需零次生成式 LLM 调用、零梯度步，墙钟时间比抽取式系统少 3–151 倍。消融显示：当片段缓存未命中金证据时，巩固适配器额外贡献 12–15 分；即便使用 oracle 缓存，仍贡献 4–5 分。
AI.conclusion: 将"参数化巩固"与"片段化检索"解耦并组合，可在不增加记忆体积、不引入反向传播的前提下让模型跨会话演化，两通道互补且在效率与精度上同时优于单一范式。

title: MemEmo: Evaluating Emotion in Memory Systems
summary: Memory systems address the challenge of context loss in Large Language Models during prolonged interactions. However, as an essential tool for warm companionship and personalized services, the effectiveness of memory systems in processing affective information remains underexamined. To bridge this gap, we propose an emotion-enhanced memory evaluation benchmark to assess the performance of mainstream and state-of-the-art memory systems in integrating and harnessing emotional information. First, we design a benchmark called \textbf{MemEmo} to assess the affective reasoning and tracking capabilities of memory systems across four dimensions: emotional information extraction, emotional memory updating, emotional memory question-answering, and emotional conflict detection. Second, we construct the \textbf{H}uman-\textbf{L}ike \textbf{M}emory \textbf{E}motion (\textbf{HLME}) dataset to provide an empirical foundation for scrutinizing memory systems. Finally, We evaluate five representative memory systems on the HLME dataset, reporting 11 performance metrics across four dimensions. Experimental results reveal that aggregating scores for all tested memory systems is up to 45\%, far below 100\% scale, exposing a profound disparity between memory system and affective intelligence.

AI.tldr: 论文提出情感增强的记忆评估基准MemEmo与人类似记忆情感数据集HLME，从四个维度、11项指标评测主流记忆系统，发现其在情感信息处理上存在显著不足（聚合得分最高仅45%）。
AI.motivation: 现有记忆系统主要用于缓解大语言模型长对话中的上下文丢失，作为温暖陪伴与个性化服务的关键工具，其对情感信息的处理能力却缺乏系统检验，存在评估空白。
AI.method: 构建MemEmo基准，从情感信息抽取、情感记忆更新、情感记忆问答、情感冲突检测四个维度考察记忆系统的情感推理与追踪能力；构建HLME（Human-Like Memory Emotion）数据集提供实证基础；在HLME上评测5个代表性记忆系统，并报告四维度共11项性能指标。
AI.result: 实验结果显示，所有被测记忆系统的聚合得分最高仅为45%，远低于100%的水平，表明记忆系统与情感智能之间存在显著差距。
AI.conclusion: 现有记忆系统在情感信息的整合与利用方面能力明显不足，情感记忆评估应成为记忆系统研究的重要方向，MemEmo与HLME为后续改进提供了基准与数据支撑。

title: Fast at the Frontier, Wrong at the Fallback: A Commit-Level Analysis of Threshold Decoding in Diffusion Language Models
summary: Diffusion language models (DLMs) can write several tokens per forward pass. Open-weight DLMs commit, in any order, every masked position whose confidence passes a threshold. If none does, a fallback commits the most confident one, and the commits are never revised. Wide windows let the decoder commit far ahead of the text, which should speed up decoding but often costs accuracy. It is unclear where the model is confident and which commits cause errors. We trace every commit of four off-the-shelf DLMs on math, code, translation and summarization, and rerun failing answers with one step changed. Most tokens become confident only near the frontier, the leftmost masked position, so committing only there, still several tokens per step, is about as fast as committing anywhere. The accuracy loss comes from committing tokens before the text to their left, and committing one token per step does not reduce it. The worst case is an early end-of-sequence token that cuts the answer short. Fallback commits are 11-35% of commits but start 61-72% of the failures that left-to-right decoding avoids. Changing only the step where such a failure starts repairs it more often than changing a similar earlier step. Committing only at the frontier recovers most of the lost accuracy on all four models. Our code is available at https://github.com/rmakarovv/fast-at-the-frontier.

AI.tldr: 论文追踪四种开源扩散语言模型的每次提交，发现多数token只在“前沿”（最左掩码位置）附近才变自信；精度损失源于提交左侧文本尚未确定的token，回退提交虽占11-35%却引发61-72%的失败；仅在前沿提交即可恢复大部分精度损失且速度相当。
AI.motivation: 开放权重扩散语言模型（DLM）每步可并发生成多个token，宽窗口能提前提交远处token以加速解码，但常伴随精度下降。现有工作不清楚模型在何处自信、哪些提交导致错误，因此作者希望对提交行为进行细粒度诊断，定位误差来源。
AI.method: 在数学、代码、翻译、摘要四类任务上追踪四个现成DLM的每一次提交（commit），并对失败答案做单步替换的反事实重跑实验，比较不同提交策略（任意位置提交、仅前沿提交、每步单token提交）的速度与准确率。
AI.result: 多数token仅在接近前沿（最左掩码位置）时才达到置信阈值；仅在前沿提交（每步仍多个token）速度与任意位置提交相当。精度损失主要来自在左侧文本确定前提交的token，每步单token并不能缓解。最坏情况是过早的EOS截断答案。回退提交占11-35%，却启动了61-72%的、从左到右解码可避免的失败；仅修改失败起始那一步比修改更早的相似步骤更能修复答案。
AI.conclusion: 仅在前沿提交可在四个模型上恢复大部分精度损失且不牺牲速度，说明提交位置（相对于前沿的顺序）而非提交数量是精度关键；回退提交是主要误差源，应作为解码策略优化的重点。

title: LEAF-OPD: Learning to Forget from Privileged Contexts via On-Policy Distillation
summary: LLM unlearning aims to erase targeted knowledge from large language models while preserving their utility. However, many existing methods suppress target knowledge without explicitly teaching the model how to respond to queries about it. We propose LEAF-OPD (LEArning to Forget from Privileged Contexts via On-Policy Distillation), in which a frozen teacher provides token-level supervision on student-generated responses. On forget data, the teacher uses privileged contexts (instructions not to reveal knowledge about forget targets) to guide forgetting. On retain data, the teacher provides supervision without privileged context to preserve model utility. The student operates without privileged context in both cases, learning how to respond when encountering knowledge that should be forgotten. A key challenge is that the teacher often provides effective supervision only at the first few tokens of student trajectories. We introduce Supervision Signal (SS) to measure corrective supervision over a specified token interval, evaluating the entire trajectory (SS1) and its second half (SS0.5) to assess overall strength and late-stage persistence. When supervision is weak, lightweight SFT strengthens the teacher's context-conditioned refusal behavior, substantially increasing both scores. We evaluate LEAF-OPD on three widely used benchmarks: TOFU, RWKU, and MUSE-News. On TOFU, LEAF-OPD achieves the best Forget Quality, Model Utility, and Forget ROUGE-L while maintaining competitive retain performance. On RWKU, it outperforms the second-best method by 34% in Forget Quality while maintaining competitive Retain Quality. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of privileged-context supervision with on-policy token-level distillation for LLM unlearning.

AI.tldr: 提出 LEAF-OPD：用冻结教师在特权上下文下对学生自生成回复做 token 级在线策略蒸馏，使学生无需特权上下文也学会对遗忘目标给出恰当回应，并在 TOFU、RWKU、MUSE-News 上取得优效果。
AI.motivation: 现有 LLM 遗忘方法多只是压制目标知识，而没有显式教会模型如何回应对遗忘目标的查询，因此遗忘不够"行为化"、易被诱发恢复。
AI.method: 冻结教师对学生生成的轨迹提供 token 级监督：遗忘数据上教师携带特权上下文（禁止泄露遗忘目标的指令），保留数据上教师不带特权上下文以维持效用；学生始终不带特权上下文训练。引入监督信号 SS（SS1 评估全轨迹、SS0.5 评估后半段）度量指定 token 区间的纠偏监督强度与后段持续性；当监督弱时，用轻量 SFT 强化教师的条件式拒答行为。
AI.result: 在 TOFU 上取得最佳 Forget Quality、Model Utility 与 Forget ROUGE-L，并保持有竞争力的保留性能；在 RWKU 上 Forget Quality 比次优方法高 34%，Retain Quality 保持竞争水平；同时在 MUSE-News 上完成评估。
AI.conclusion: 特权上下文监督结合在线 token 级蒸馏是进行 LLM 遗忘的有效范式，且通过 SS 诊断与轻量 SFT 可缓解教师监督仅集中于前几个 token 的瓶颈。

title: Same Papers, Different Verdicts: Tracing Version Drift in LLM Peer Review
comment: 19 pages, 5 figures. Results of the registered tests that need the ICLR 2027 decisions will be added after 16 December 2026
summary: Venues and benchmarks read LLM review scores as measurements of a paper, while providers replace their models within months. We audit twenty frontier models from OpenAI, Google and Anthropic on ICLR 2027 submissions while they were under review, with tests registered before the decisions. Between an earlier and a later version of Claude Opus and of Gemini, the share of papers placed on the accept side falls by 52 and 53 percentage points on 183 and 60 randomly drawn submissions, and by 43 to 79 points in six further paired comparisons, with no paper moving up in any of them. Stating a 30% acceptance rate in the prompt leaves a gap of 79 points between the two Opus versions. When score-stripped critiques are swapped between versions, the later critiques alone lower the accept share by 35 points for Opus and 51 for Gemini; for Opus the drop is 35 points under a third-party scorer and 24 after a rewrite that keeps each technical point and removes evaluative wording. On 57 papers, the percentiles of Opus 4.6 and 5.5 correlate at 0.73 while their accept shares differ by 44 points. On 99 to 119 submissions, the self-estimated percentiles of three models correlate with two human reviewers more strongly than a third reviewer does (point estimates 0.17 to 0.21, 95% intervals between -0.04 and +0.42). All twenty models give a 2 or a 3 in 473 of their 475 reviews, against 60 of 72 human reviews. Retrospective tests on decided papers can draw on memory. Claude Opus 5.5 names the true first author of 27 decided ICLR 2026 papers from their titles alone, with no wrong name, and Claude Opus 4.6 accepted all 11 decided papers it said it recognized, against 5 expected. Thresholds on LLM-reviewer scores therefore have to be validated against human decisions for each model version; our tests against the ICLR 2027 decisions follow on 16 December 2026.

AI.tldr: 作者在ICLR 2027评审期间对OpenAI、Google、Anthropic的20个前沿模型进行审计（测试在结果公布前注册）：同一厂商的版本更新会导致"接收侧"论文占比骤降43–79个百分点且无一篇上移，分数阈值对LLM评审分数不可直接沿用，需按模型版本逐一对照人类决定进行验证。
AI.motivation: 会议与基准把LLM给出的评审分数当作对论文的"测量"，但模型提供方每隔数月就替换模型版本。若版本更替系统性改变分数分布，则基于固定阈值的接收判定将失去可比性与效度，因此需要在真实评审窗口内审计版本效应。
AI.method: 对ICLR 2027投稿在其评审期内用20个前沿模型评分，测试方案在决定前预注册。设计多组配对比较：同一投稿分别由早期与后期版本（Claude Opus、Gemini）评分，比较"接收侧"占比；控制提示中明示30%接收率；交叉互换去除分数后的评语（score-stripped critiques）；采用第三方评分器与"保留技术要点、去除评价性措辞"的改写；计算百分位相关性；比较模型自估百分位与人类审稿人的相关性；统计评分分布（2/3分比例）；并做回溯性记忆测试（从标题识别已决定论文的第一作者）。
AI.result: 早期到后期版本间，接收侧占比在183篇与60篇随机抽样上分别下降52与53个百分点，另六组配对比较下降43–79点，且无一篇上移；提示中写明30%接收率仍留79点差距。互换评语后，仅后期评语即使Opus降35点、Gemini降51点；Opus在第三方评分器下为35点，去除评价性措辞的改写后为24点。57篇上Opus 4.6与5.5百分位相关0.73但接收占比差44点。99–119篇上，三个模型的自估百分位与两位人类审稿人的相关性（点估计0.17–0.21，95%区间-0.04至+0.42）强于第三位审稿人。20个模型在475条评审中有473条给2或3分，人类72条中60条。回溯测试中Opus 5.5仅凭标题正确指认27篇ICLR 2026已决定论文的第一作者且无错误，Opus 4.6宣称"认出"的11篇全部为真（期望5篇）。
AI.conclusion: LLM评审分数不具备跨版本的可比性，以固定阈值筛选论文缺乏效度；阈值必须针对每个模型版本、以人类决定为基准进行验证。对已决定论文的回溯性测试可能受记忆污染，需前瞻性验证——作者对ICLR 2027决定的检验将于2026年12月16日公布。

title: Weight-Space Programming Changes How an LLM Uses Python for Computational Biology
comment: 16 pages, 3 figures, 6 main tables, and 1 supplementary table
summary: Weight-space programming allows a language model to edit another model's weights without gradient-based training. We used Claude Opus 5.5 to edit Qwen3.5-0.8B and investigated how the edits changed its use of Python on computational biology problems. We compared four initial edited checkpoints with the original model on 50 test problems across three test seeds, yielding 600 paired evaluations. Strictly correct answers increased from 44 to 77, and technically correct answers, which included correct final values rejected for formatting, increased from 64 to 100. Repeated Python calls decreased from 1,834 to 1,044. Among the 64 pairs in which only the edited response was technically correct, the original model had already computed the correct value in 36 but did not submit a technically correct final answer. The edited model corrected the computation in 13 of the 64 pairs. With six additional checkpoints on the same 50 problems, technically correct answers rose from 96 to 154 across 900 pairs. We explored three selected problems with ten test seeds for each of ten checkpoints. On the melting-temperature problem, correct Python outputs decreased from 60 to 22 while technically correct final answers increased from 0 to 18. Weight editing changed both the calculations Qwen ran and whether it submitted a correct answer.

AI.tldr: 通过"权重空间编程"用 Claude Opus 5.5 编辑 Qwen3.5-0.8B 的权重，研究该编辑如何改变其在计算生物学问题上的 Python 使用行为；技术上正确的答案显著增加，同时 Python 调用次数下降。
AI.motivation: 现有模型行为改进通常依赖梯度训练；本文关注免训练的权重空间编程（weight-space programming）能否有效调节一个小语言模型在计算生物学任务中"运行 Python 计算—提交最终答案"的行为链条，并刻画其作用机制。
AI.method: 用 Claude Opus 5.5 对 Qwen3.5-0.8B 进行权重编辑，得到多个编辑检查点。主实验：4 个初始检查点 × 50 道题 × 3 个测试种子 = 600 组配对评估；扩展实验：额外 6 个检查点、同 50 题、共 900 组配对。另对 3 道题分别用 10 个检查点 × 10 个种子做细粒度分析。指标包括严格正确、技术正确（含数值正确但格式被拒）、Python 调用次数及逐对归因。
AI.result: 主实验：严格正确从 44 升至 77，技术正确从 64 升至 100；Python 调用从 1,834 降至 1,044。在 64 组"仅编辑模型技术正确"的配对中，原始模型有 36 组已算出正确值却未提交合规答案，编辑模型仅在 13 组中修正了计算本身。扩展实验：技术正确从 96 升至 154（900 组配对）。熔化温度题上，Python 输出正确数从 60 降到 22，但技术正确最终答案从 0 升至 18。
AI.conclusion: 权重编辑同时改变了两件事：模型执行的计算内容，以及它是否把正确结果以合规形式提交。增益主要来自"提交/格式化行为"的改善而非计算能力提升，并伴随 Python 使用的减少（更少重复调用，部分题目计算正确率反而下降）。

title: LATTE-WordSeg-Lite: Multi-Granularity Thai Word Segmentation on a CPU, with a Reproducible Benchmark
summary: Large language models read Thai through subword tokens, without a word segmenter. Yet Thai treebanks, speech metrics and morphological resources are built on words, often at several granularities, and word boundaries resolve ambiguities that subword tokens leave open. LATTE (Lattice ATTentive Encoding) reads a text at several granularities at once, through a lattice of dictionary words, but it is a large GPU model. We distil it into LATTE-WordSeg-Lite, a CPU segmenter of 1.17M parameters that keeps the lattice as features. It outputs compounds, words and morphemes in one pass, and learns only from annotated data and text whose licences allow commercial use. To compare it with other tools, published Thai scores do not suffice, as they come from different files, splits and scorers. We therefore rebuild seven test sets from pinned sources and score twelve systems under one protocol. With the unit that fits each test set, LATTE-WordSeg-Lite scores above DeepCut on five sets, four of them from corpora that its teachers learnt from. Called line by line on one CPU thread, it runs 23 times as fast as DeepCut. We release the model, the benchmark scripts and all predictions.

AI.tldr: 将大型GPU多粒度格模型LATTE蒸馏为1.17M参数的CPU泰语分词器LATTE-WordSeg-Lite，一次输出复合词、词与语素，并重建7个测试集、在统一协议下评测12个系统；其在5个测试集上超过DeepCut，单线程逐行速度为其23倍。
AI.motivation: 泰语LLM依赖子词token而缺少词边界信息，但泰语树库、语音指标与形态资源均以多粒度"词"为单位，词边界能消解子词留下的歧义；现有LATTE模型基于词格多粒度编码但需大型GPU。同时已发表的泰语分词分数来自不同文件、划分与打分器，无法公平比较各工具。
AI.method: 将LATTE蒸馏为LATTE-WordSeg-Lite：保留词格作为特征、仅1.17M参数、可在CPU运行；单次前向同时输出复合词、词和语素；仅使用允许商用的标注数据与文本训练。评测方面从固定版本源重建7个测试集，在统一协议下对12个系统打分，并按各测试集匹配的粒度单位评估。
AI.result: 在适配各测试集的粒度单位下，LATTE-WordSeg-Lite在5个测试集上优于DeepCut（其中4个语料属于其教师模型训练过的来源）；单CPU线程逐行调用时速度是DeepCut的23倍。
AI.conclusion: 证明了通过蒸馏可将多粒度格编码压缩为轻量CPU分词器而不牺牲竞争力，并推动泰语分词评测的协议统一与可复现（公开模型、基准脚本与全部预测结果）。

title: Teaching Language Models to Adapt Answer Granularity to Their Confidence
summary: When precise details are uncertain, a coarser answer can retain useful information without guessing or abstaining. We investigate whether language models can learn this behavior through model-conditioned supervision derived from consistency across sampled responses and recognition of answers at different granularity levels. We evaluate LFM2.5-1.2B, Ministral~3~3B, Qwen3.5-9B, and Gemma~4~31B on temporal and geographic questions and three generalization datasets. In several in-domain settings, fine-tuning improves the balance of correctness and informativeness beyond coarsening base answers to the best fixed level. Across generalization datasets, all four models produce coarser answers more often at low than high base-model confidence. The three smaller models' answers are also preferred over base responses on held-out relations when correctness and granularity are considered jointly. These findings demonstrate learnable confidence-related granularity adaptation, with benefits varying by model.

AI.tldr: 研究语言模型能否通过"模型条件化监督"（基于采样响应一致性 + 多粒度答案识别）学会在细节不确定时主动给出更粗粒度（但仍有用）的答案，而非猜测或弃答。
AI.motivation: 当精确细节不确定时，粗粒度回答可在不猜测、不弃答的前提下保留有用信息。作者希望让模型习得这种"按置信度自适应粒度"的行为，并检验其可学习性与泛化性。
AI.method: 构建模型条件化（model-conditioned）监督信号：由同一问题的多次采样响应的相互一致性推断置信度，并识别答案在不同粒度层级上的正确性，据此构造训练目标。在 LFM2.5-1.2B、Ministral 3 3B、Qwen3.5-9B、Gemma 4 31B 上微调，评测时间类与地理类问题，另设三个泛化数据集（含 held-out relations），并以"正确性 + 信息量/粒度"联合指标与"将基础答案统一粗化至最优固定层级"的基线对比。
AI.result: 多个域内设置中，微调后在正确性与信息量的平衡上优于最佳固定粗粒度基线；三个泛化数据集上，四个模型均在基础模型置信度低时更频繁输出粗粒度答案；在未见关系上，三个较小模型的答案按正确性与粒度联合评估优于基座响应。
AI.conclusion: 置信度相关的粒度自适应是可学习的行为，且与模型自身的置信度信号对齐；但其收益因模型规模/类型而异，较大模型并未在同口径下显现同等泛化优势。

title: Seeing Isn't Resolving: Visual and Linguistic Disambiguation with Conversational Grounding
summary: Visual grounding benchmarks usually do not consider the contextual uncertainty of real-world scenarios. In this study, we construct a novel benchmark, the Japanese evaluation for Ambiguous visual Grounding with Dialogue (JAG-D) dataset. It consists of human-robot conversational multimodal interactions covering different types of ambiguity, arising from visual and linguistic categories. We evaluate the capabilities of different state-of-the-art Visual Language Models (VLMs) for ambiguity recognition and resolution. We compare dialogue context grounding performance for visual and linguistic ambiguity resolution. Our experiments show that VLMs can substantially improve the resolution of linguistic ambiguity, especially Japanese zero anaphora, by using dialogue context. We further conduct a comparative analysis to understand whether grounding improvements arise from the semantic content of the dialogue or from its conversational structure.

AI.tldr: 构建日语歧义视觉定位对话基准JAG-D，评估VLMs在视觉与语言歧义下的对话上下文定位能力。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉定位基准通常忽略真实场景中的上下文歧义性，缺乏对歧义识别与消解能力的系统评测。
AI.method: 构建JAG-D数据集，包含人-机器人多模态对话交互，覆盖视觉歧义与语言歧义两类来源；对多种SOTA VLM进行歧义识别与消解的评测，对比视觉歧义与语言歧义下的对话上下文定位表现，并进一步做对照分析以区分增益来源是对话语义内容还是对话结构。
AI.result: 实验显示VLM借助对话上下文可显著提升语言歧义（尤其是日语零形回指）的消解效果；对比分析用于判定定位提升源自对话的语义内容而非其会话结构。
AI.conclusion: 对话上下文对语言歧义消解尤为有效，JAG-D为歧义视觉定位提供了新的评测视角。

title: PlainPairs: A Corpus Pairing the Prescriber and Patient Texts of U.S. Prescription Medicine Labels
summary: A prescription medicine in the United States comes with labeling written for prescribers, and many medicines also carry a text written for patients: a Medication Guide or a patient package insert. The two texts describe the same medicine for two readers, yet public resources rarely hold them side by side. I present PlainPairs, an open corpus built from the openFDA drug label files. Version 0.1.0 holds 35,177 prescription labels that carry a patient text, 21,416 distinct patient texts, 250,829 patient-text segments matched to prescriber sections through their regulatory headings, reading-level measures on both sides, and rule-based counts of plain-language wording. A second source, the National Cancer Institute's cancer information summaries, adds 756 summaries in health-professional and patient versions, in English and Spanish. Measured on the structure of the label, the median Medication Guide reads at grade 8.7 by Flesch-Kincaid and at grade 11.1 by SMOG. The same guides measured on the flattened text that the bulk files serve read about two grades higher, a difference that comes from lost list and heading boundaries. Patient texts address the reader in 41 of every 100 sentences, against 0.2 in prescriber sections. A blind hand check of 100 pairs supports the heading-based alignment for seven of ten heading types. The corpus, its code and its documents are public, and the release keeps texts that show a company copyright mark out of the text tables.

AI.tldr: 本文发布开放语料 PlainPairs v0.1.0：基于 openFDA 药品标签文件，将 35,177 份处方药标签中的患者文本与同一药物的处方者文本按监管标题配对，共 21,416 份独立患者文本、250,829 个配对片段，并提供双侧可读性指标与规则化口语化措辞计数；另收录 NCI 肿瘤信息摘要 756 篇（专业版/患者版、英/西双语），代码与文档公开。
AI.motivation: 同一药品同时存在面向处方者的标签文本与面向患者的文本（Medication Guide 或患者说明书），但公开资源很少将两者并列呈现，缺乏可对照、可计算的语料来研究两者的语言差异（如可读性、口语化程度、读者称谓）。
AI.method: 以 openFDA 药品标签文件为数据源构建开放语料；依据监管标题将患者文本片段与处方者章节对齐；对两侧文本计算阅读难度指标，并采用规则化方法统计通俗语言措辞；纳入 NCI 癌症信息摘要的专业版与患者版（英、西双语）作为第二数据源；结构化解析标签（保留列表与标题边界）与扁平化文本两种读数对比；通过 100 对样本的盲式人工核查检验标题对齐质量；公开语料、代码与文档，并对含公司版权标记的文本作排除处理。
AI.result: Medication Guide 按标签结构测量，Flesch-Kincaid 中位数为 8.7 年级，SMOG 为 11.1 年级；若用批量文件提供的扁平化文本测量，则高出约两个年级，差异源于列表与标题边界的丢失。患者文本每 100 句中有 41 句使用读者称谓，而处方者章节仅为 0.2 句。盲式人工核查对 7/10 类标题的对齐给予支持。
AI.conclusion: PlainPairs 提供了可公开获取、双侧对照的药品与健康信息文本语料，可用于可读性、通俗语言与读者导向研究；测量结果强调文本结构化方式（是否保留列表与标题）会显著影响可读性估计，因此可读性指标须结合文本呈现格式解读。

title: Experience Rot: Experienced Agents Fail Where Novices Succeed
summary: Agents are increasingly built to learn from experience: they keep conversation histories, memory files, retrieved notes and skills, and reuse what worked before. We show that this experience turns against them when their tools change silently. We test a range of models with tools defined as in the Model Context Protocol (MCP). After a silent change, experienced agents fail on most tasks, while agents new to the task mostly succeed. We call this failure Experience Rot. Experienced agents copy their earlier call instead of checking the current interface, even when the tool definition shows the change. Then they report success. When the documentation is incomplete, experience is what makes agents succeed. After a change, the same experience leaves them worse off than no experience at all. The failure appears in every form of memory we test and grows with the amount of experience. Simple remedies fall short: announcing the update barely helps, and pointing the agent to the documentation fails whenever the documentation does not spell out the answer.

AI.tldr: 论文揭示并命名"经验腐化"（Experience Rot）现象：当MCP工具接口发生静默变更后，具备经验的智能体会复制旧调用而非核验当前接口，导致失败率高于无经验智能体，且简单补救手段收效有限。
AI.motivation: 智能体日益依赖经验（对话历史、记忆文件、检索笔记与技能）复用过往成功做法，但真实环境中工具接口会静默变更；现有研究未考察经验在工具变更后的负面效应，本文旨在检验经验的适用边界。
AI.method: 在Model Context Protocol（MCP）定义的工具环境下，对多种模型开展受控实验：对比有经验智能体与新手智能体在工具静默变更前后的任务表现，覆盖多种记忆形式、不同经验积累量，并测试公告更新、指向文档等补救措施，以及文档不完整场景下经验的作用。
AI.result: 静默变更后，有经验智能体在多数任务上失败，而新手智能体基本成功；有经验智能体即便工具定义已显示变更，仍复制旧调用并虚报成功；该失败在各类记忆形式中普遍存在，并随经验量增加而加剧；公告更新几乎无效，指向文档在文档未明示答案时同样失效；文档不完整时经验反而是成功的关键。
AI.conclusion: 经验的价值高度依赖环境稳定性：接口稳定且文档不完整时经验有益，接口变更后经验反而劣于无经验。需要面向接口漂移的经验管理与调用前核验机制，而非仅靠更新提示或文档引导。

title: It Depends on the Task: Rethinking Rhetorical Segmentation of Dutch Judicial Decisions
summary: Classifying the material facts, submissions, judicial reasoning, and the court's decision (rhetorical roles) in case law is a prerequisite for high-quality performance across virtually all NLP-in-law tasks, including legal information retrieval, summarisation, and LLM-based analysis. These rhetorical roles often intertwine and shift sentence by sentence, making reliable classification difficult. This paper introduces the first sentence-level annotated dataset of Dutch judicial decisions, labelled across four legally meaningful categories: material facts, submissions, judicial reasoning, and the court's decision, alongside non-annotated (None) content, and compares several classification strategies, including a staged pipeline that separates None detection from the rhetorical roles, and a Bayesian update that leverages information about the section-header a sentence belongs to. Our results show that no single strategy dominates on both precision and recall: header priors help most when the None sentences are excluded and offer little benefit for None detection itself. These trade-offs matter in practice. For instance, extractive summarisation depends more on recall so it does not miss relevant facts, whereas outcome prediction depends more on precision regarding decision and facts sentences so that the predicted ruling is not contaminated by noise. We use these trade-offs and map the approaches tested in this study onto a set of representative legal NLP use cases.

AI.tldr: 本文发布首个荷兰语判决书句子级修辞角色标注数据集（事实、主张、司法推理、法院裁判及 None），比较多种分类策略（含分离 None 检测的分阶段流水线、利用章节标题信息的贝叶斯更新），发现没有单一策略在精确率与召回率上同时占优，并按下游任务需求给出策略映射。
AI.motivation: 对判例法中材料事实、当事人主张、司法推理与法院裁判等修辞角色进行句子级分类，是法律信息检索、摘要、基于 LLM 的分析等几乎所有法律 NLP 任务高质量完成的前提。但这些角色常逐句交织、切换频繁，可靠分类困难；荷兰语领域此前缺乏句子级标注资源，且不同策略在精确率/召回率间的取舍对下游任务影响未被系统比较。
AI.method: 构建首个荷兰语判决书句子级标注数据集，标注四类法律有意义类别（材料事实、主张、司法推理、法院裁判）外加不标注的 None 内容；比较多种分类策略，包括将 None 检测与修辞角色判别分离的分阶段流水线（staged pipeline），以及利用句子所属章节标题信息的贝叶斯更新（Bayesian update）以形成标题先验。
AI.result: 没有任何单一策略在精确率与召回率上同时占优。标题先验在排除 None 句子时收益最大，而对 None 检测本身帮助有限。取舍得看任务：抽取式摘要更依赖召回率以避免漏掉相关事实；结果预测更依赖针对裁判句与事实句的精确率，以免预测结论被噪声污染。
AI.conclusion: 修辞角色分类不存在通用最优方案，需依下游任务权衡精确率与召回率；作者据此将所测试方法映射到一组代表性法律 NLP 应用场景，为实践中的策略选择提供依据。

title: Stability-Compensated Threshold Calibration for Selection-Conditioned Risk Control in Large Language Models
summary: Large language models often produce hallucinated answers, motivating selective prediction policies that abstain on uncertain queries. However, heuristic uncertainty thresholds alone do not provide statistical control of errors among accepted predictions. Linear Expectation Constraints (LEC) reduce selection-conditioned error rate (SCER) calibration to a nonpositive expected linear-loss constraint, but the associated loss is non-monotonic in the acceptance threshold. We construct an exact counterexample under i.i.d. sampling demonstrating that LEC's empirical threshold-selection rule can violate the population SCER target. To address this risk-transfer gap, we introduce Stability-Compensated Linear Expectation Control (SC-LEC), which uses the negative linear risk of a theoretical full-data reference to compensate for threshold-selection instability. For local expansion beyond a safe anchor, we derive two finite-sample certificates: a stability-based certificate exploiting rank crossings and a direct certificate using the structure of threshold expansion to reduce conservatism. With a valid population anchor margin, our certificate conditions ensure finite-sample marginal SCER control, and independent margin certification further provides a $1-δ$ high-probability guarantee for this calibration-averaged control. Experiments on CommonsenseQA, ARC-Challenge, and TriviaQA show useful retention gains beyond the same certified anchor, while revealing conservative behavior in small-margin regimes.

AI.tldr: 该论文指出LEC（线性期望约束）因损失对接受阈值非单调，其经验阈值选择规则可能违反总体SCER目标，并据此提出SC-LEC方法，通过理论全数据参考的负线性风险补偿阈值选择不稳定性，给出两张有限样本证书，实现边际SCER控制与1-δ高概率保证，并在三个QA数据集上取得保留率增益。
AI.motivation: 大模型常产生幻觉答案，需要选择性预测（对不确定查询弃答）来控制被接受预测中的错误；但启发式不确定性阈值缺乏统计控制。LEC虽将选择条件错误率（SCER）校准转化为非正期望线性损失约束，却因其损失对接受阈值非单调，存在风险转移缺口：经验阈值选择规则可能违反总体SCER目标。
AI.method: 1) 构造i.i.d.采样下的精确反例，证明LEC经验阈值选择会违背总体SCER目标；2) 提出SC-LEC，用理论全数据参考的负线性风险补偿阈值选择不稳定性；3) 在安全锚点附近做局部扩展，推导两种有限样本证书：基于秩穿越的稳定性证书，以及利用阈值扩展结构降低保守性的直接证书；4) 结合有效总体锚点边际与独立边际认证，给出1-δ高概率保证。
AI.result: 在有效总体锚点边际下，证书条件保证有限样本边际SCER控制，独立边际认证进一步给出对校准平均控制的1-δ高概率保证；在CommonsenseQA、ARC-Challenge、TriviaQA上，相对同一已认证锚点取得可用的保留率提升，同时在小边际区间表现出保守性。
AI.conclusion: SC-LEC弥补了LEC在阈值选择层面的风险转移缺口，为选择性预测提供可证明的有限样本SCER控制与高概率保证，并在实践中带来保留率增益；其局限在于小边际情形下偏保守，未来可进一步降低保守性。

title: What You Post Is What You Symptom: Estimating Psychometric Networks from Social Media Discourse
summary: Symptom networks in psychopathology are estimated almost exclusively from self-report questionnaires, restricting inference to whatever symptom set a given instrument covers. We introduce a framework for symptom-resolved network estimation directly from social media discourse and apply the framework to depression and eating disorders, with a third anorexia corpus as cross-dataset validation. To our knowledge, we are the first to estimate symptom-resolved psychometric networks from social media text, compare them to clinical co-endorsement networks, and replicate transdiagnostic linguistic markers across 3 independently recruited corpora spanning 2 disorders simultaneously. For depression, expression scores correlate with BDI-II totals at $ρ{=}0.434$, 20 of 21 items reach FDR significance, and split-half reliability is 0.935. The Network Comparison Test detects few edge differences between modalities (3-5\% of edges), while bridge symptoms diverge. For eating disorders, the item-level results are exploratory. Identified linguistic features replicate the same direction across all 3 corpora, and they cluster in three construct families.

AI.tldr: 本文提出直接从社交媒体文本进行症状级心理病理网络估计的框架，并在抑郁与进食障碍上验证其与临床共评定网络的可比性。
AI.motivation: 现有症状网络几乎完全基于自评问卷估计，推断范围被限定在特定量表覆盖的症状集合内，限制了症状粒度的网络推断。
AI.method: 构建基于社交媒体话语的症状解析网络估计框架；应用于抑郁与进食障碍，并以第三个厌食症语料作跨数据集验证；将所得网络与临床共评定网络比较，并在3个独立招募语料、2种障碍上重复检验跨诊断语言标记。
AI.result: 抑郁方面，表达得分与BDI-II总分相关ρ=0.434，21个条目中20个达FDR显著，分半信度0.935；网络比较检验显示模态间仅3-5%的边存在差异，但桥接症状出现分歧；进食障碍条目级结果属探索性；识别的语言特征在3个语料中方向一致，并聚为三类构念族。
AI.conclusion: 社交媒体文本可用于症状级心理测量网络估计，其网络结构与临床共评定网络总体相近而桥接症状存在差异，跨诊断语言标记具可重复性。

title: Does the Voice Matter? Evaluating Frustration Detection on Deployed Clinical Voice-Agent Calls
comment: Accepted to Ml4H 2026 Accepted to GenAI4H workshop @ Neurips 2026
summary: Autonomous voice agents now conduct routine clinical follow-up calls, so some automated triage is unavoidable. A patient becoming frustrated is one thing that triage should catch. These systems typically read only the transcript the speech-to-text stage produces, not the voice, and whether that is enough is largely untested on real clinical speech. We study per-turn frustration detection on real patient calls from a deployed clinical voice agent: 150 turns from six calls labelled by three annotators, with a length-matched acted corpus as a control, and 714 turns from 30 calls. Patient turns are overwhelmingly short: across the deployed calls, roughly 59% are one or two words, against 13% in the full acted corpus, and a corpus accuracy gap remains even after the acted set is length-matched. On one-word turns, transcript-only detection does not exclude chance. Across five audio-capable language models, the transcript flags 3 or 4 of the 39 frustrated one-word turns in the 30 calls, and a classifier given only the word count reaches 57.3%. Whether audio helps depends on the model and on the instruction. Asked to attend to delivery, two Gemini 2.5 models gain 3.0 pp over the transcript across 30 calls (-1.0 to 7.5 pp). Of the turns they confidently clear, 6.9% were in fact frustrated for audio against 13.0% for the transcript, a difference of 6.1 pp (2.2 to 10.4 pp). Across the 30 calls, given one prompt identical for both inputs, no model's audio-text interval excludes zero. Under the input-specific prompts, a newer Gemini model and two smaller open models do worse with audio than with the transcript (-3.5, -8.6 and -10.6 pp). A WavLM probe trained on the clinical calls matches the best prompted model overall (71.6%) but misses every frustrated one-word turn in the 24 added calls. When a patient's turn is short, the transcript alone is not enough to rule out frustration.

AI.tldr: 在真实临床语音代理的患者通话数据上，仅靠转写文本无法在短（1–2词）话轮中可靠识别患者不满；音频的作用依赖模型与指令，且不稳定，专用声学探针在单词话轮上完全失效。
AI.motivation: 自主语音代理已用于常规临床随访电话，分诊必须能捕捉患者不满情绪；但现有系统普遍只读取语音转文本的转写，而不利用原始语音，这一做法在真实临床语音上几乎未经检验。
AI.method: 构建逐话轮不满检测任务：来自已部署临床语音代理的6通电话150个话轮，由3名标注者标注，并以长度匹配的表演语料作为对照；另用30通电话714个话轮。比较仅文本检测、5个具备音频能力的语言模型（统一提示与输入特定提示），以及基于WavLM训练的声学探针；并设置仅用词数特征的分类器作为强基线。
AI.result: 患者话轮极短：部署通话中约59%为1–2词，表演语料仅13%；长度匹配后仍存在语料间准确率差距。单词话轮上仅文本检测与随机无差异（5个音频模型仅标出39个不满单词话轮中的3–4个），仅用词数的分类器达57.3%。强调"关注说话方式"时，两个Gemini 2.5模型跨30通电话提升3.0pp（区间−1.0至7.5pp）；其高置信"无不满"判定中实际不满比例音频为6.9%、文本为13.0%，相差6.1pp（2.2–10.4pp）。但统一提示下无任何模型的音文置信区间排除零；输入特定提示下，一个较新Gemini与两个小型开源模型音频反而更差（−3.5、−8.6、−10.6pp）。WavLM探针总体71.6%可比肩最佳提示模型，但在新增24通电话中漏检全部不满单词话轮。
AI.conclusion: 患者话轮较短时，仅凭转写不足以排除不满；音频收益不稳定且高度依赖模型与提示设计，声学探针在单词话轮上仍有系统性盲区。

title: Procedure without Judgment: What Small Language Models Learn under an Exact Verifier
summary: When an authorization policy blocks an agent's tool call, the audit log should name the facts that forced the decision and nothing more. For an executable policy over an enumerable context space this minimal sufficient reason can be computed exactly, so an explanation is scored against ground truth rather than a proxy for it. We use that exactness to ask what a model can learn from a verifier that has no error in it. The explainer sees one request and one decision, never the policy, and has thirty turns in which it may call the policy on altered requests and ask whether a candidate set of facts is sufficient. Frontier models find the exact reason about half the time with the tools alone, and one sentence telling them to shrink the answer lifts Haiku 4.5 from 58% to 75%. A 4B model fine-tuned on 2000 traces of the deletion algorithm reaches 92% on the policy it was trained on. Teacher kind is what moves this: at matched data size the algorithm-taught student leads the frontier-taught one in all three training seeds, and the two arms never overlap. What the student learns is a fixed schedule of sufficiency checks, and the schedule does not travel. On three public policies it never saw, its answers stay sufficient (94%) and stop being minimal (48%), while Haiku under the same sentence is exact on all 47 episodes. Reinforcement learning from the exact reward leaves held-out accuracy where it was and inverts the strategy, from probing the policy to spending the entire budget on sufficiency checks. The oracle made the effect of training legible, but it did not make training better.

AI.tldr: 在可执行策略+可枚举上下文空间上，最小充分理由可精确计算，据此把"解释"变成有真值的任务；前沿模型单靠工具约一半能给出精确理由，一句"缩小答案"提示把Haiku 4.5从58%提到75%；4B模型用2000条删除算法轨迹微调后在同策略达92%，但学到的是固定检查日程而非可迁移能力（跨策略充分性94%、最小性48%）。
AI.motivation: 审计日志应只陈述导致拒绝决定的事实，且越简洁越好；作者希望利用"精确可计算的最小充分理由"这一无误差验证器，考察模型在没有噪声的验证信号下究竟能学到什么、能否迁移。
AI.method: 构造可执行策略与可枚举上下文的设定，精确计算最小充分理由作为ground truth；解释器只见请求与决定、不见策略，30轮内可对改写请求调用策略并询问候选事实集是否充分；对比工具使用（含提示）、2000条删除算法轨迹微调的4B模型、教师模型（算法教师 vs 前沿教师）蒸馏、以及基于精确奖励的强化学习。
AI.result: 前沿模型单靠工具约50%给出精确理由，一句"缩小答案"的提示使Haiku 4.5从58%升至75%；4B学生于训练策略达92%；同数据量下算法教师学生三个随机种子均优于前沿教师且分布不重叠；跨三个未见公开策略时充分性94%、最小性降至48%，而Haiku在同提示下47个episode全部精确；用精确奖励做RL未提升留出准确率，反而把策略从"探测策略"翻转为"把预算全花在充分性检查上"。
AI.conclusion: 精确oracle让训练效应可读，但并未使训练更好；学生学到的是固定日程而非可迁移的推理能力，相关蒸馏收益高度依赖教师类型且不泛化。

title: Language-model agents' beliefs can be manipulated via truthful evidence in open channel
summary: Language-model agents' beliefs can be manipulated through open channels such as social media, even when the information they receive is truthful. When agents fill gaps between fragments with self-induced relationships, they may accept those relationships as established facts and pass the resulting rumours to others. Drawing on cognitive theory of narrative understanding and film theory of montage, we introduce Generative Montage to operationalize this failure, termed narrative overfitting, by coordinating agents to arrange truthful fragments into misleading narratives. Across 1,090 rumour targets from six Twitter events, agents often accepted rumours overconfidently, with overall acceptance exceeding 65 percent in twelve of fourteen models. Acceptance remained above 50 percent after majority voting or review of the same evidence, showing how errors can reach downstream decisions. To explain this susceptibility, fragment interventions identify posts that influence belief within complete narratives. Synthetic controls then show that similar response patterns arise from valid evidence, separating belief influence from evidential support. This distinction motivates Grounded Monitor, a proof-of-concept neuro-symbolic runtime monitor that checks direct evidential support to guide agents' judgements, improving decision accuracy by 5.6 to 29.0 percentage points across original and anonymized settings. These findings expose a cognitive route to rumour amplification and support monitoring inferred relationships before agent-generated conclusions guide public decisions.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 Generative Montage 框架，用"叙事过度拟合"（narrative overfitting）解释语言模型智能体为何会把真实信息碎片拼成误导性谣言并高置信度接受，并给出神经符号运行时监控器 Grounded Monitor 作为缓解方案。
AI.motivation: 即使输入信息本身真实，语言模型智能体也会在碎片之间用"自生成关系"填补空隙，并把这种关系当作既定事实传播，形成谣言放大。现有工作缺乏对这一失败机制的操作化刻画，也缺少区分"信念影响"与"证据支持"的评测手段。
AI.method: 借鉴认知叙事理论与电影蒙太奇理论提出 Generative Montage：协调多个智能体把真实碎片编排成误导性叙事，从而操作化 narrative overfitting。在六个 Twitter 事件的 1,090 个谣言目标上评测 14 个模型；采用多数投票与同证据复核检验稳健性；用碎片干预定位在完整叙事内影响信念的帖子；再用合成对照（synthetic controls）把信念影响与证据支持分离；据此设计概念验证的神经符号运行时监控器 Grounded Monitor，核查直接证据支持以引导判断。实验覆盖原始与匿名化两种设置。
AI.result: 14 个模型中有 12 个整体接受率超过 65%，多数投票和同证据复核后接受率仍高于 50%；错误可传导至下游决策。碎片干预识别出叙事内具有信念影响力的帖子；合成对照显示有效证据也能引发相似的响应模式，从而将信念影响与证据支持区分开。Grounded Monitor 在原始与匿名化设置下将决策准确率提升 5.6–29.0 个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 研究揭示了一条经由认知叙事建构的谣言放大路径：智能体会对推断出的关系过度自信。应在智能体生成的结论影响公共决策之前，对推断关系进行监控；Grounded Monitor 的增益表明"核查直接证据支持"是可行方向。

title: Safe Resemblance, Silent Propagation: Limits of Text-Similarity Guardrails for AI Agent Safety
summary: When AI agents relay information to one another, an output can preserve an injected instruction's effect on downstream agents even after its wording changes, yet legitimate quotation and template reuse can produce high textual overlap with the source, so text-similarity guardrails that attempt to flag the former risk conflating these two cases. We test this distinction using DonkeyRail, a public classifier combining BLEU, ROUGE-L, and METEOR features, deployed in a controlled three-agent email relay, defining a behavioral measure in which an output counts as functional (the injected procedure induces fresh computations in two subsequent agents) independent of the detector's score, alongside legitimate controls that explicitly authorize quotation and reuse. At its default threshold the classifier misses 8 of 19 functional outputs while flagging 70 of 192 legitimate replies, with every completed quotation and template-reuse reply triggering a false alert; calibrating for low false positives on one template set does not transfer, as the recalibrated threshold detects only one functional output and still produces 15 false alerts on new templates. We also identify an operating-point error in all 21 published classifier configurations, where ROC interpolation replaces direct threshold application, and show formally that high AUC against a surface-level text criterion provides no distribution-free guarantee of high AUC against the behavioral target, while the existing evaluation labels lack the joint observations needed to estimate the gap. An authorization analysis further shows that identical visible transcripts can require different safety decisions depending on the governing policy, a distinction no observation-only classifier can resolve. These results argue for behavioral and policy-grounded evaluation over text-similarity guardrails.

AI.tldr: 文本相似度护栏无法区分"功能性的提示注入传播"与"合法的引用/模板复用"；基于行为学定义与授权分析，作者主张以行为与策略为基础的评估取代文本相似度检测。
AI.motivation: AI代理间中继信息时，注入指令即使措辞改变仍可能对下游代理产生效果；但合法引用与模板复用同样会造成高文本重叠。现有基于文本相似度的护栏会把两类情况混为一谈，因此需要检验"文本重叠"与"行为影响"是否可分离，并评估现有检测器的实际可靠性。
AI.method: 使用公开分类器DonkeyRail（融合BLEU、ROUGE-L、METEOR特征），在受控的三代理邮件中继环境中部署；独立于检测器得分，定义行为学判据——只有当注入流程在后续两个代理中引发新的计算时，输出才计为"功能性"；同时设置显式授权引用与复用的合法对照；并检查全部21个已发布分类器配置的ROC阈值操作点，给出形式化分析与授权（策略）分析。
AI.result: 默认阈值下漏检19个功能性输出中的8个，同时对192条合法回复误报70条，所有完成的引用与模板复用回复均触发误警；在某模板集上为低误报调参不可迁移——重校准阈值仅检出1个功能性输出，且在新模板上仍产生15次误报。此外发现全部21个已发布配置存在操作点错误：以ROC插值替代直接阈值应用。并形式化证明：针对表层文本标准的高AUC不构成对行为目标高AUC的无分布保证；现有评估标签缺乏估计该差距所需的联合观测。授权分析表明，相同的可见对话记录在不同治理策略下需要不同的安全判定，仅凭观测的分类器无法解决。
AI.conclusion: 文本相似度护栏在行为判据上既漏检又误报，且阈值不可迁移、评估指标存在操作点缺陷；相同转录在不同策略下需不同决策，观测型分类器原理上无法消解。因而应转向行为化、以策略为依据的评估框架。

title: Harness Leverage Across Model Size: A Ladder of Five Local Agent Harnesses from 0.75B to 4.7B
summary: A harness turns a model into a system that completes tasks: it builds the prompt, exposes tools and decides when work is done. Harness comparisons hold the model fixed. Model comparisons hold the harness fixed. We vary both: five shipped harnesses, 18 artifact-producing tasks, four locally deployable open-weight models from 0.75B to 4.7B and a 35.5B anchor, with one deterministic checker scoring all 360 ladder cells. The completion-controlling harness, Mingbird, has the highest mean at every size. Of four pre-registered paired contrasts, two survive Holm correction, at 0.75B and 4.7B. Thirteen of sixteen paired intervals exclude zero under the deployment reading, with leads from 0.075 over the strongest rival to 0.819 over the weakest. The completion gate is not the carrier: disabling all six executable checks moves the mean by +0.080, +0.117, +0.003 and -0.004, every interval including zero, and only at 1.9B does disabling it create empty runs. Removing one repeat-blocking rule alone costs 0.411 at 0.75B and leaves eight of eighteen tasks with no artifact. The harness effect is a progress effect: it decides whether a run leaves anything on disk. Of 357 usable cells, 127 leave none of their declared artifacts and 85 of those exit normally, so a scorer that reads exit status credits work that was never written. Whether the effect grows or shrinks with size, four rungs cannot settle: a floor arm produces a rise, a ceiling a decline, and a cross-family rung a peak.

AI.tldr: 该文系统性地同时变化harness（5种）与模型（0.75B–4.7B及35.5B锚点），在18个产物型任务、360个梯格上用统一确定性检查器评分。结果显示：控制"完成判定"的harness Mingbird在所有规模上均值最高；harness效应本质是"进度效应"——决定一次运行是否在磁盘上留下产物，而非完成门控本身。
AI.motivation: 既有研究要么固定模型比harness，要么固定harness比模型，二者无法揭示harness与模型规模的交互。作者希望量化harness对智能体任务完成的独立贡献，并定位该效应由哪个机制承载，同时指出以退出状态评判的评分器会错误地为未写出的产物计分。
AI.method: 设计5个已发布harness × 18个产物型任务 × 4个本地可部署开源权重模型（0.75B–4.7B）加一个35.5B锚点，共360个梯格，由单一确定性检查器统一评分。采用4组预注册配对对比并做Holm校正，同时在"部署解读"下考察16组配对区间；另做消融：关闭全部6项可执行检查、单独移除一条防重复规则。
AI.result: Mingbird在各规模上均值最高；4组预注册对比中2组通过Holm校正（0.75B与4.7B）；部署解读下16组配对区间有13组不含零，领先幅度从0.075（对最强对手）到0.819（对最弱对手）。关闭6项可执行检查后均值变化为+0.080、+0.117、+0.003、-0.004，区间均含零，仅1.9B时出现空运行。单独移除一条防重复规则在0.75B损失0.411，18个任务中8个无产物。357个可用梯格中127个未留下任何声明产物，其中85个正常退出。
AI.conclusion: harness效应是进度效应：其作用在于决定运行是否产出落盘产物，而非完成门控的判断逻辑；以退出状态为准的评分会高估实际完成度。效应随规模增大或减小，四个规模档位不足以判定：下限臂呈上升、上限臂呈下降、跨家族臂呈峰值。

title: Subprocess-Constrained Markov Decision Processes
comment: To appear at NeurIPS '26. Code available at https://github.com/jrgan/VSI
summary: Constrained Markov decision processes (CMDPs) typically bound expected cumulative cost from an initial state. Such a guarantee can be insufficient when a policy must remain feasible after every history it may encounter. We introduce \emph{subprocess-constrained MDPs} (S-CMDPs), which require the expected discounted cost of each continuation, conditional on any reachable history, to satisfy a bound determined by the current state. This stronger requirement changes the structure and complexity of the problem: we show that stationary policies can be strictly suboptimal, and finding even an approximately optimal stationary policy is NP-hard. We adapt a recently introduced value-set iteration framework to show that history-dependent policies surprisingly overcome both obstacles. Our polynomial-time algorithm represents such a policy implicitly: its expected reward is within $ε$ of the optimal feasible value, it violates each subprocess cost bound by at most $δ$, and its action distribution can be computed in polynomial time for any given history.

AI.tldr: 提出子过程约束马尔可夫决策过程（S-CMDP），要求任意可达历史条件下每个延续的期望折扣成本满足由当前状态决定的界；证明平稳策略可严格次优且近似最优平稳策略求解NP-hard，但借助值集迭代给出多项式时间的历史依赖策略隐式表示。
AI.motivation: 传统CMDP只约束从初始状态出发的期望累积成本，这种全局保证不足以保证策略在遇到的每个历史之后仍然可行；因此需要更强的逐历史（子过程）可行性要求。
AI.method: 定义S-CMDP：对任意可达历史，条件于该历史的每个延续的期望折扣成本须满足由当前状态确定的界。分析平稳策略的次优性与NP-hard性；将近期提出的值集迭代（value-set iteration）框架适配到该问题，构造以隐式方式表示历史依赖策略的多项式时间算法。
AI.result: 平稳策略可严格次优；寻找近似最优平稳策略为NP-hard。所提多项式时间算法输出的历史依赖策略满足：期望奖励与最优可行值相差不超过 ε，每个子过程成本界违反量不超过 δ，且对任意给定历史其动作分布可在多项式时间内计算。
AI.conclusion: 更强的逐历史可行性约束改变了问题结构与复杂度，历史依赖策略能同时克服平稳策略的次优性与计算困难，并可在多项式时间内隐式表示与查询。

title: ChartSync: A Benchmark for Visuo-Logical Cascading Chart Editing
summary: Generative image editing models struggle with structured statistical charts when data modifications require geometric synchronization. We formalize this task as Visuo-Logical Cascading Editing (VLCE). However, existing methods remain confined to localized text substitutions and struggle with dependency-aware cascading updates. To systematically evaluate this capability, we introduce ChartSync, an expert-validated benchmark constructed via a programmatic rendering pipeline that guarantees deterministic visuo-logical coupling for the ground truth. ChartSync comprises 870 triplets across 9 chart categories and 4 task types, including 235 geometry-coupled VLCE instances that specifically test cascading text-to-geometry synchronization. We further evaluate these instances via a two-tier framework combining objective visual metrics with a vision-language model judge paradigm to assess low-level fidelity alongside multimodal comprehension and reasoning. Evaluating 14 image editing models and one code-mediated pipeline reveals a nuanced capability gap: most open-source models suffer severe drops in geometric synchronization, while only two frontier proprietary models show emerging VLCE capability, with their residual errors mainly involving semantic isolation and background corruption. Our detailed error analysis deconstructs these failure paradigms to identify core meta-abilities for guiding future multimodal architectures. The ChartSync dataset and code are publicly released at https://github.com/kaka-yjk/ChartSyncCodebase.

AI.tldr: 该文提出视觉-逻辑级联编辑（VLCE）任务与ChartSync基准，用于评估生成式图像编辑模型在统计图表数据修改中的几何同步能力，发现开源模型几何同步严重退化，仅两款闭源前沿模型具备初步VLCE能力。
AI.motivation: 生成式图像编辑模型在处理结构化统计图表时，当数据修改需要几何同步（如柱高、坐标轴、图例随之联动）往往失败。现有方法局限于局部文字替换，缺乏依赖感知的级联更新能力，且缺少系统性评测手段。
AI.method: 形式化定义为VLCE任务；构建ChartSync基准——经专家验证、由程序化渲染管线生成，保证真值的视觉-逻辑确定性耦合，含9类图表、4种任务类型共870个三元组，其中235个为几何耦合实例；采用两层评测框架：客观视觉指标 + 视觉语言模型裁判范式，兼顾低层保真度与多模态理解推理。评测14个图像编辑模型及1个代码中介管线。
AI.result: 多数开源模型几何同步性能大幅下降；仅两款前沿闭源模型呈现初步VLCE能力，其残余错误集中于语义隔离失效与背景破坏。误差分析解构了上述失败范式。
AI.conclusion: ChartSync为图表级联编辑提供可复现评测基准，揭示当前模型在视觉-逻辑耦合上的能力缺口，并提炼出指导未来多模态架构设计的核心元能力；数据集与代码已开源。

title: Generative AI and the Crisis of Higher Education Assessments: Examining 'AI-Proofing' Strategies for College-Level Assessments
summary: Higher education is confronting an academic-integrity challenge unlike any in its history. Students can now outsource homework, take-home assignments, and online examinations to large language models (LLMs) that complete them in seconds. Existing research on evaluating LLM performance on academic assessments has focused largely on standardized examinations, or on questions from college-level courses drawn from a single discipline. Far less is known about how LLMs perform on college-level assessment questions spanning multiple disciplines, that instructors have purposely designed to be AI-resistant, and about which features of such questions, if any, meaningfully constrain LLM performance. We address this gap by collecting 75 questions from authentic college coursework assessments, spanning 17 disciplines, which were contributed by 37 faculty members from ten U.S. universities and one U.K. university. Of these, 61 questions were intentionally designed by faculty members to be 'LLM-proof', while the remaining 14 questions were sourced from online courses. We then (i) evaluate three state-of-the-art LLMs' ability to correctly answer these questions with and without supplementary course materials; (ii) identify five strategies, through thematic analysis, that faculty used to make their questions harder for LLMs to solve; and (iii) test whether these strategies impact LLMs' ability to answer the questions accurately. Our experimental results show that the best-performing model scored approximately 83% without supplementary course materials and 85% with them, and we observed noteworthy differences across models, answer formats, and instructor tweaking strategies. We discuss implications for assessment design, academic-integrity policy, and the broader ethics of deploying LLMs in educational settings.

AI.tldr: 该研究收集17个学科、由美英11所高校37名教师提供的75道真实课程考核题（其中61道刻意设计为"LLM-proof"），评测三种先进LLM在有无补充课程材料下的答题能力，并通过主题分析归纳教师使题目更难被LLM解答的五种策略，检验其有效性。最佳模型无补充材料时约83%、有补充材料时约85%，不同模型、答案形式与教师"改造"策略间存在显著差异。
AI.motivation: LLM可在数秒内代做作业与在线考试，构成前所未有的学术诚信挑战。既有评测多集中于标准化考试或单一学科的大学课程题，缺乏对跨多学科、且由教师刻意设计为"抗AI"的大学水平考核题目的性能评估，也不清楚哪些题目特征能有效约束LLM表现。
AI.method: 采集37位教师（美国10所、英国1所大学）提供的75道真实课程考核题，覆盖17个学科；其中61道为教师有意设计的"LLM-proof"题，14道来自在线课程。构建三部分实验：(i) 评测三种SOTA LLM在有无补充课程材料条件下正确作答的能力；(ii) 通过主题分析识别教师提高题目难度的五种策略；(iii) 检验这些策略对LLM答题准确率的影响。
AI.result: 最佳模型在无补充材料时准确率约83%，提供补充材料时约85%；模型之间、答案格式之间以及教师改造策略之间存在值得关注的性能差异，表明多数"抗AI"设计未能有效降低LLM表现。
AI.conclusion: 跨学科、教师刻意设计的抗AI题目仍难以显著限制先进LLM的答题表现，纯粹的题目"加固"策略作用有限。作者据此讨论了考核设计、学术诚信政策以及教育场景中部署LLM的伦理意涵。

title: Benchleaking Is Accelerating: Benchmark contamination has worsened sharply in the past month -- from post-training down to pre-training base models
summary: Benchmark contamination is not new, but recent model releases show it in a sharper form. We use the term benchleaking for the case in which a benchmark's own test examples enter training data, so that a score reflects recall rather than capability. This differs from benchmaxxing, which optimizes toward a benchmark without seeing its test set. We document two escalations over the past month. First, in post-training, the traces have become explicit: recent audits show an agent stating hidden test requirements it was never given in 23% of its attempts, where its predecessor did so in none, and continuing to follow them after the task is changed to contradict them (Schaeffer and Räuker, 2026; Lo and Lo, 2026). Second, the problem has reached pre-training. Using few-shot continuation on 20 benchmarks across four public base models, we find that some base models write out other test examples---complete questions, options, and answers---that appear nowhere in their input. For the recently released ERNIE-5.5-Flash-Base, 96% of HumanEval problems leak with their reference implementations and 85% of OpenBookQA questions leak with their answers, against 9% and none for DeepSeek-V4-Flash-Base. To quantify what a reported score owes to such examples, we define an Anti-Hack score: the benchmark score recomputed with every leaked example marked wrong and the number of examples unchanged. Averaged over the suite, it costs DeepSeek-V4-Flash-Base 1.5 points and Hy3-preview-Base 1.3, against 5.0 for MiMo-V2.5-Base and 16.6 for ERNIE-5.5-Flash-Base. Open base models are the foundation of much downstream research, so benchleaking now affects more than leaderboard rankings. We call for decontamination reports and contamination-adjusted scores to become standard practice.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"benchleaking"概念（基准测试自身测试样本进入训练数据，分数反映记忆而非能力），并记录其从后训练显式泄漏扩展到预训练阶段的证据，提出Anti-Hack指标量化泄漏对分数的贡献。
AI.motivation: 基准污染并非新问题，但近期模型发布使其以更尖锐形式呈现。既有研究多关注面向基准优化的"benchmaxxing"，而测试集本身进入训练数据的"benchleaking"更隐蔽且更具危害：开放基座模型是下游研究的基础，泄漏已影响排行榜之外的研究可信度，因此需要区分概念、记录升级趋势并量化其分数代价。
AI.method: 1) 概念区分：benchleaking（测试样本进入训练数据，分数即召回）vs benchmaxxing（未见测试集的基准导向优化）。2) 证据一：后训练审计显示智能体在23%的尝试中陈述了从未给予的隐藏测试要求，且任务被改为矛盾后仍继续遵循。3) 证据二：对4个公开基座模型、20个基准进行少样本续写实验，检测模型是否输出输入中不存在的完整测试题（题干、选项、答案）。4) 指标：定义Anti-Hack score，即把所有泄漏样本判错、样本总数不变后重算的基准分数，用以衡量报告分数的泄漏收益。
AI.result: ERNIE-5.5-Flash-Base上96%的HumanEval题目连同参考实现泄漏、85%的OpenBookQA题目连同答案泄漏；DeepSeek-V4-Flash-Base分别为9%和0%。Anti-Hack分数在套件平均下的损失：DeepSeek-V4-Flash-Base 1.5分、Hy3-preview-Base 1.3分，而MiMo-V2.5-Base为5.0分、ERNIE-5.5-Flash-Base达16.6分。
AI.conclusion: benchleaking已从后训练延伸至预训练，且危害远超排行榜名次，因为开放基座模型支撑大量下游研究。作者呼吁将去污染报告与污染校正分数（如Anti-Hack）作为标准实践。

title: Learning to Reason with Predictive Gains for Generative Recommendation
summary: Reasoning-enhanced generative recommendation (GR) has attracted increasing attention for leveraging the reasoning capabilities of large language models (LLMs) to improve next-item prediction. However, existing methods primarily optimize reasoning through Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) with rule-based rewards determined by final recommendation performance, which faces two key limitations: (i) unmeasured predictive contributions within reasoning, where the predictive contributions of individual reasoning steps are not directly reflected in optimization signals, and (ii) weakly discriminative learning signals within groups, where different reasoning trajectories within the group often receive indistinguishable rewards, limiting effective policy optimization. In this paper, we propose GainReason, a simple yet effective training framework that optimizes reasoning through Predictive Gain (PG). Specifically, PG measures changes in target Semantic ID (SID) log-likelihood induced by individual reasoning sentences, providing contribution-aware and discriminative rewards. We further theoretically establish the alignment between expected PG and the recommendation ranking objective. Building on this signal, we develop PG-based Reasoning Optimization (PGRO) to optimize reasoning generation with sentence-level rewards, supported by a custom causal attention mechanism for efficient PG computation. Additionally, an auxiliary PG-based Reasoning Utilization (PGRU) task adaptively strengthens reasoning-conditioned prediction to complement PGRO. Extensive experiments on three public benchmarks demonstrate that GainReason consistently outperforms competitive baselines and achieves substantial performance gains from reasoning.

AI.tldr: 提出GainReason框架，用"预测增益"（Predictive Gain, PG，即单句推理对目标SID对数似然的变化）作为细粒度奖励替代基于最终推荐结果的规则奖励，配合句子级策略优化与因果注意力加速，在三个公开基准上取得稳定提升。
AI.motivation: 现有推理增强生成式推荐（GR）多用GRPO，以最终推荐性能构造规则奖励，存在两点不足：(i) 推理过程中各步骤的预测贡献未被度量，个体推理句的贡献无法反映到优化信号中；(ii) 组内学习信号区分度弱，同一组内不同推理轨迹常获得难以区分的奖励，限制策略优化效果。
AI.method: 以Predictive Gain为奖励：度量单条推理句引起的目标Semantic ID对数似然变化，得到贡献感知且具判别性的奖励；理论上证明期望PG与推荐排序目标对齐；据此设计PG-based Reasoning Optimization（PGRO），以句子级奖励优化推理生成，并用定制因果注意力机制高效计算PG；另加辅助任务PG-based Reasoning Utilization（PGRU），自适应增强条件于推理的预测以互补PGRO。
AI.result: 在三个公开基准上的大量实验表明，GainReason持续优于有竞争力的基线，并从推理中获得显著性能增益。
AI.conclusion: 将奖励从结果级细化到句子级的预测增益，可有效缓解GRPO的两大缺陷，为推理增强生成式推荐提供一种简单有效的训练范式。

title: Shaping AI's Beliefs Before It Generates: Human Sense of Agency in Creative AI
comment: The Proactive Co-Creator (PaCC) can be accessed at https://proactive-co-creator.github.io/. Accepted at Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2026) Creative AI Track
summary: AI systems for creative media generation expand human capabilities yet risk diminishing human agency. A core problem is anchoring, where the user's thinking becomes anchored to a polished, generated artifact, shifting the user's role from active authoring to reactive editing. We propose pre-generation belief controls that can empower creators to inspect, revise, and steer the AI's interpretation before any media is generated, so that the initial anchor is set by the human. We formalize four design principles and instantiate them in the Proactive Co-Creator (PaCC), a system for early-stage conceptual ideation and prototyping that proactively surfaces its assumptions and uncertainty through clarifications, belief graphs, and media attributes, inviting users to shape the AI's beliefs before generating the final outcome. Using PaCC as a design probe in a small-scale, single-arm exploratory user study, we observed that participants reported directionally positive sense of agency and process control relative to their familiar prompt-based AI tools, noting that surfaced assumptions helped them think through details they had overlooked, whereas their feelings about ownership and authorship diverged

AI.tldr: 论文提出"预生成信念控制"（pre-generation belief controls）以缓解生成式创作中的"锚定"问题，并实现为Proactive Co-Creator (PaCC)系统，通过澄清问答、信念图与媒体属性在生成前暴露AI的假设与不确定性；小规模单臂探索性用户研究显示参与者自评能动感与过程控制略优于熟悉的提示式工具，但所有权/作者身份感受存在分歧。
AI.motivation: 创意媒体生成的AI系统虽扩展人的能力，却可能削弱人的能动性。核心问题是锚定（anchoring）：用户思维被已生成的精致成品所锚定，角色由主动创作者退化为被动编辑者。作者希望让人来设定最初锚点。
AI.method: 提出四项设计原则并实例化为PaCC系统，面向早期概念构思与原型制作，主动通过澄清（clarifications）、信念图（belief graphs）和媒体属性呈现AI的假设与不确定性，邀请用户在生成最终结果前塑造AI的"信念"。以PaCC作为设计探针（design probe），开展小规模、单臂（single-arm）探索性用户研究。
AI.result: 参与者自评能动感（sense of agency）与过程控制相较其熟悉的提示式AI工具有方向性正向反馈；被呈现的假设有助于其思考此前忽略的细节；但关于所有权与作者身份的体验出现分歧。
AI.conclusion: 将信念控制前置到生成之前，可有效缓解锚定效应、支持人的能动性；但作者身份与所有权的主观体验尚未统一，仍需更大规模、受控的后续研究验证并细化设计。

title: Share your Screen and Talk to Gemini: How Young Learners Interact with Multimodal GenAI While Solving Scratch Tasks
comment: accepted for: The 21th WiPSCE Conference on Primary and Secondary Computing Education Research (WiPSCE 27)
summary: Children using Scratch to learn programming can struggle with text-heavy, lengthy explanations and hints during debugging. Verbal interactions based on screen sharing or camera data may be an interesting alternative for supporting learners. We therefore explore the quality, use, and perceptions of fifth- and sixth-graders' verbal interactions with a GenAI tutor. The goal is to investigate the quality and use of the multimodal GenAI tutor in the given context. First of all, a pilot study of eight tasks conducted without students helped inform the process of the tutor's classroom evaluation. The classroom study was realized after fifth- and sixth-graders had participated in six Scratch classroom lessons. Then 23 students were introduced to the tutor, worked on the eight tasks with the GenAI tutor, and completed a questionnaire. The analysis of the pilot and classroom study shows that the tutor's responses were intelligible and actionable, and no single turn revealed a complete solution. However, the tutor missed existing errors in 61.5% of 603 error-related classroom turns, compared to 15.7% in the pilot study. Children's voice prompts were brief and mostly responded to the tutor. Although a video had explained that responses could be incorrect, 39.1% of the children trusted the tutor's answers to always be correct. These findings have implications for educators and learners using multimodal GenAI tutors, as they need to be aware that an intelligible and human-like voice does not ensure correct support. For developers, our results suggest that screen sharing alone does not ensure responses that match the program state.

AI.tldr: 该研究考察五、六年级学生在Scratch调试中与多模态GenAI导师进行语音交互的质量、使用方式与感知，发现导师回复虽可理解且可操作、不直接给出完整解答，但在课堂中漏检61.5%的错误相关话语轮次（试点仅15.7%），且39.1%的学生仍相信导师总是正确。
AI.motivation: 儿童用Scratch学编程时，调试阶段面对大量文字解释与提示存在困难；基于屏幕共享或摄像头数据的语音交互可能成为替代性学习支持，但其质量与适用性尚不清楚。
AI.method: 先开展不含学生的8项任务试点研究以完善导师的课堂评估流程；随后在五、六年级学生完成6节Scratch课堂课后，让23名学生使用该多模态GenAI导师完成8项任务并填写问卷，对试点与课堂数据进行对比分析。
AI.result: 导师回复可理解且可操作，单个轮次均未泄露完整解答；但603个课堂错误相关轮次中漏检率为61.5%，试点为15.7%。儿童语音提示简短、多为对导师的回应；尽管视频已说明回复可能有误，仍有39.1%的儿童认为导师答案总是正确。
AI.conclusion: 可理解、拟人化的语音并不保证支持正确，教育者与学习者需警惕GenAI导师的可靠性；对开发者而言，仅靠屏幕共享不足以确保回复与程序实际状态相匹配。

title: VisualArtifactSpec 1.0: Evaluating Visual Artifacts under Task Specifications
summary: Visual artifact tasks test agents' ability to translate task specifications and source materials into outputs that meet practical needs. Evaluation across artifact families helps distinguish broadly applicable authoring capabilities from strengths confined to a particular medium. We introduce VisualArtifactSpec 1.0 (VAS), a benchmark of 211 creation and modification tasks spanning presentations, static graphics, animations and videos, and web interfaces. Each task specifies authoring objectives, source materials, constraints, and deliverables. Existing benchmarks provide limited support for systematically evaluating how authoring choices suit different audiences, purposes, and media across artifact families. VAS evaluates two aspects separately: Task Fulfillment verifies explicit requirements and applicable functionality, while Artifact Performance assesses Content, Organization, Visuals, and Delivery. Task-specific rating anchors instantiate shared criteria for the intended audience, purpose, and medium, with judgments grounded in source materials and artifact inspection records. We evaluate nine model-harness configurations on all 211 tasks. Overall scores range from 42.12 to 70.52, with Artifact Performance accounting for 73.4% of the gap between the highest- and lowest-scoring configurations.

AI.tldr: 提出视觉产物基准 VAS 1.0，涵盖 211 个跨演示文稿、静态图形、动画/视频与网页界面的创作与修改任务，分任务完成度与产物表现两维度评估九种模型-框架配置，总分 42.12–70.52。
